多智能体系统的安全考量* * Crew Scaler（一家正在申请 501c3 资格的组织）对 NIST RFI 2026-00206 的回应Security Considerations for Multi-agent Systems* * A Crew Scaler (501c3 pending org)’s response to NIST RFI 2026-00206
摘要Abstract
多智能体人工智能系统（MAS）是由自主智能体组成的系统，这些智能体行使被授予的工具使用权限、共享持久化记忆，并通过智能体间通信进行协调。 Multi-agent artificial intelligence systems or MAS are systems of autonomous agents that exercise delegated tool authority, share persistent memory, and coordinate via inter-agent communication. MAS 引入了与现有文献所记录的单一 AI 模型安全漏洞在性质上截然不同的安全漏洞。 MAS introduces qualitatively distinct security vulnerabilities from those documented for singular AI models. 现有安全与治理框架并非针对这些新兴攻击面而设计。 Existing security and governance frameworks were not designed for these emerging attack surfaces. 本研究系统地刻画了 MAS 的威胁态势，并据此对 16 个 AI 安全框架进行了定量评估。 This study systematically characterizes the threat landscape of MAS and quantitatively evaluates 16 security frameworks for AI against it. 本研究提出了一种四阶段方法：构建涵盖生产环境中多智能体架构的深入技术知识库；开展由生成式 AI 辅助、以 MAS 网络安全风险为范围并经领域专家验证的威胁建模；以单项威胁为粒度制定结构化调查计划；以及针对这些网络安全风险，采用三点量表对各框架进行评分。 A four-phase methodology is proposed: constructing a deep technical knowledge base of production multi-agent architectures; conducting generative AI-assisted threat modeling scoped to MAS cybersecurity risks and validated by domain experts; structuring survey plans at individual-threat granularity; and scoring each framework on a three-point scale against the cybersecurity risks. 这些风险被归纳为九个风险类别中的 193 个不同的主要威胁条目。 The risks were organized into 193 distinct main threat items across nine risk categories. 预期的最低平均得分为 2。 The expected minimal average score is 2. 所审查的框架均未在任何单一类别中实现过半覆盖。 No reviewed framework achieves majority coverage of any single category. 非确定性（Non-Determinism，在全部 16 个框架中的平均得分为 1.231）和数据泄露（Data Leakage，1.340）是应对最不充分的领域。 Non-Determinism (mean score 1.231 across all 16 frameworks) and Data Leakage (1.340) are the most under-addressed domains. OWASP Agentic Security Initiative 以 65.3% 的覆盖率在总体上领先，并在设计阶段领先；CDAO Generative AI Responsible AI Toolkit 在开发和运行阶段的覆盖率方面领先。 The OWASP Agentic Security Initiative leads overall at 65.3% coverage and in the design phase; the CDAO Generative AI Responsible AI Toolkit leads in development and operational coverage. 这些结果提供了首个针对 MAS 安全的实证性跨框架比较，并为框架选择提供了循证指导。 These results provide the first empirical cross-framework comparison for MAS security and offer evidence-based guidance for framework selection.

I 引言I Introduction
AI 系统正在跨越一个关键门槛。 AI systems are crossing a critical threshold. 现代智能体式 AI 系统行使被授予的权限，使用工具、数据库和外部 API，并协调其他智能体，在极少人工干预的情况下自主规划和执行多步骤任务 [1]。 Modern agentic AI systems exercise delegated authority over tools, databases, external APIs, and coordinating peer agents, autonomously planning and executing multi-step tasks with minimal human intervention [1]. 企业部署已从实验阶段迈向基础设施阶段，例如由智能体调度云端操作、编写并执行代码、管理财务工作流，以及在生产规模下相互编排 [2]。 Enterprise deployments have moved from experimentation to infrastructure such as agents that schedule cloud operations, write and execute code, manage financial workflows, and orchestrate one another at production scale [2]. 这种对自主行动的授权引入了一类有别于传统软件系统所面临的安全问题。 This delegation of autonomous action introduces a class of security concern that differs from those governing traditional software systems.
安全界已通过不断增多的框架作出回应。 The security community has responded with a growing body of frameworks. NIST 的 AI Risk Management Framework [3] 及其对抗性机器学习配套文档 AI 100-2e2025 [4] 为广义上的 AI 系统建立了治理结构和威胁分类体系。 NIST’s AI Risk Management Framework [3] and its adversarial machine learning companion AI 100-2e2025 [4] establish governance structures and threat taxonomies for AI systems broadly. MITRE ATLAS [5] 仿照 ATT&CK 框架，编目收录了针对 AI 赋能系统的对抗者战术与技术。 MITRE ATLAS [5] catalogs adversary tactics and techniques against AI-enabled systems, modeled after the ATT&CK framework. OWASP Agentic Security Initiative [6]、ATFAA-SHIELD [7] 和 CDAO Generative AI Responsible AI Toolkit [8] 代表了较近期面向智能体的相关工作。 The OWASP Agentic Security Initiative [6], ATFAA-SHIELD [7], and the CDAO Generative AI Responsible AI Toolkit [8] represent more recent, agent-oriented efforts. 这些框架与另外十三个框架共同构成了从业者当前在智能体式 AI 安全方面的参考体系。 Together, these and thirteen additional frameworks constitute the practitioner’s current reference landscape for agentic AI security.
然而，一个根本性缺口依然存在。 Yet a fundamental gap persists. 大多数现有框架都采用了适用于传统系统的共同安全假设：确定性的控制流、界限明确的信任边界、无状态执行，以及可识别的对抗性输入。 Most existing frameworks share security assumptions suited to traditional systems: deterministic control flow, bounded trust boundaries, stateless execution, and identifiable adversarial inputs. 这些假设对 MAS 均不成立。 None of these hold for MAS. 当自主智能体共享持久化记忆、沿委派链传播工具使用授权，并通过共享上下文相互影响推理过程时，安全面便呈现出行为性和涌现性，而非结构性和有界性。 When autonomous agents share persistent memory, propagate tool authorization across delegation chains, and influence one another’s reasoning through shared context, the security surface becomes behavioral and emergent rather than structural and bounded. 通过工具耦合实现的策略层远程代码执行、经由共享向量数据库实施的潜伏性记忆投毒、通过智能体间通信传播的自我复制提示词蠕虫，以及构成保障缺口的非确定性规划偏离，都是目前审查的各框架中很少有成熟对策目录予以应对的攻击模式 [9]。 Policy-level remote code execution through tool coupling, latent memory poisoning via shared vector databases, self-replicating prompt worms propagating through inter-agent communication, and non-deterministic planning divergence as an assurance gap represent attack patterns for which few established countermeasure catalog exists in any currently reviewed framework [9]. 从业者还缺乏可用于指导安全架构决策的实证性跨框架覆盖数据。 Practitioners also lack empirical, cross-framework coverage data to guide security architecture decisions.
我们提出了一项系统性的四阶段研究：构建覆盖生产环境中 MAS 全部架构面的深入技术知识库；开展由生成式 AI 辅助的威胁建模，明确聚焦于与单智能体风险在性质上不同的威胁，并由一名 NVIDIA 认证的智能体式 AI 专业人员进行验证；以单项风险为粒度制定结构化调查计划；以及依据所得风险分类体系，对十六个安全框架进行定量评分。 We present a systematic four-phase study: construction of a deep technical knowledge base spanning the full architectural surface of production MAS; generative AI-assisted threat modeling scoped explicitly to threats qualitatively distinct from single-agent risks, validated by NVIDIA-certified agentic AI professional; structured survey planning at individual risk granularity; and quantitative scoring of sixteen security frameworks against the resulting risk taxonomy. 该风险分类体系包含九个风险类别中的 193 个不同的主要条目：智能体与工具耦合、数据泄露、注入、身份与来源、记忆投毒、非确定性、信任利用、时序与监控，以及工作流架构。 The risk taxonomy comprises 193 distinct main items across nine risk categories: Agent-Tool Coupling, Data Leakage, Injection, Identity and Provenance, Memory Poisoning, Non-Determinism, Trust Exploitation, Timing and Monitoring, and Workflow Architecture. 采用三点量表，针对每个条目对各框架进行评分，形成了首个针对 MAS 安全的实证性跨框架比较。 Scoring each framework against every item on a three-point scale yields the first empirical cross-framework comparison for MAS security.
本研究的具体贡献如下： The specific contributions of this work are:
一套涵盖九个类别、共计 193 种智能体 AI 安全威胁的分类体系，系统地从生产环境中的多智能体架构推导而来，并明确将范围限定为与单一、无状态 AI 系统所面临的威胁存在本质区别的威胁。 A taxonomy of 193 agentic AI security threats across nine categories, systematically derived from production multi-agent architectures and explicitly scoped to threats qualitatively distinct from those affecting singular, stateless AI systems.
对十六个安全与治理框架进行定量比较分析，得出各类别的覆盖率评分、设计、开发和运行各生命周期阶段的排名、综合成熟度评分，并识别出五项未被任何受评框架覆盖的威胁。 A quantitative comparative analysis of sixteen security and governance frameworks, producing per-category coverage scores, lifecycle phase rankings across design, development, and operational phases, composite maturity scores, and identification of five threat items receiving no coverage from any reviewed framework.
基于证据的框架选择指南：OWASP ASI 以 65.3% 的覆盖率在总体上领先，并在设计阶段占据主导地位；CDAO GenAI 在开发和运行阶段的覆盖率方面领先；ATFAA-SHIELD 在非 OWASP 框架中提供了最高的架构针对性。 Evidence-based framework selection guidance: OWASP ASI leads overall at 65.3% coverage and dominates the design phase; CDAO GenAI leads in development and operational coverage; ATFAA-SHIELD provides the highest architectural specificity among non-OWASP frameworks.
前瞻性地刻画智能体 AI 威胁如何从理论构建，经由概念验证演示，逐步发展到实际利用，为从业者确定优先级提供依据，并指出未来最迫切需要开展框架开发的方向。 A forward-looking characterization of how agentic AI threats mature from theoretical construction through proof-of-concept demonstration to active exploitation, informing practitioner prioritization and identifying directions where future framework development is most urgently needed.
第 II 节介绍四阶段方法。 Section II describes the four-phase methodology. 第 III 节列述威胁分类体系。 Section III catalogs the threat taxonomy. 第 IV 节分析各项威胁如何随时间演变。 Section IV analyzes how individual threats evolve over time. 第 V 节综述十六个框架。 Section V surveys the sixteen frameworks. 第 VI 节呈现定量覆盖率分析。 Section VI presents the quantitative coverage analysis.
II 方法II Method
该方法依次分为四个阶段，旨在系统、全面地覆盖生产级多智能体 AI 系统特有的威胁态势。 The methodology proceeded in four sequential phases designed to be systematic and exhaustive with respect to the threat landscape specific to production-grade multi-agent AI systems.
阶段 1 — 系统知识库构建。 Phase 1 — System knowledge base construction. 本工作的基础是对现代智能体 AI 系统的全面技术描述，内容共计 86 章，分为十个主题部分：智能体基础；框架与工具集成；评估与优化；生产部署与规模扩展；高级推理与决策；检索增强生成；NVIDIA NeMo 框架；可靠性与成本管理；安全与治理；以及人在回路中的集成。 The foundation of this work is a comprehensive technical description of modern agentic AI systems, developed across 86 chapters organized into ten thematic parts: agent fundamentals; framework and tool integration; evaluation and optimization; production deployment and scaling; advanced reasoning and decision making; retrieval-augmented generation; the NVIDIA NeMo framework; reliability and cost management; safety and governance; and human-in-the-loop integration. 这些材料对具体架构进行了相当深入的论述。 The material addresses concrete architectures in substantial depth. 在组件层面，内容包括基于图的有状态编排、函数调用机制、多智能体通信协议（REST、gRPC 和智能体卡片）、向量数据库集成，以及 NeMo Guardrails 的 rail 类型。 At the component level, this includes graph-based stateful orchestration, function calling mechanics, multi-agent communication protocols (REST, gRPC, and agent cards), vector database integration, and NeMo Guardrails rail types. 在系统层面，内容涉及 ReAct 推理循环、分层规划、结合知识图谱的混合 RAG、基于 RLHF 的对齐，以及用于人工监督的审批工作流设计。 At the system level, it addresses ReAct reasoning cycles, hierarchical planning, hybrid RAG with knowledge graphs, RLHF-based alignment, and approval-workflow design for human oversight. 多智能体特有的现象受到特别关注：集群配置中的涌现行为、竞争性智能体环境中的纳什均衡动态、跨智能体记忆共享、联邦式编排，以及非确定性与安全保障之间的相互作用。 Multi-agent-specific phenomena receive particular attention: emergent behavior in swarm configurations, Nash equilibrium dynamics in competitive agent settings, cross-agent memory sharing, federated orchestration, and the interaction of non-determinism with safety assurance. 最终形成的知识库长达数千页，并成为后续威胁分析的主要基础。 The resulting knowledge base spans thousands of pages and served as the primary substrate for subsequent threat analysis.
阶段 2 — 生成式 AI 辅助的威胁建模。 Phase 2 — Generative AI-assisted threat modeling. 第二阶段并非仅依赖专家判断或现有分类体系，而是使用生成式 AI，针对阶段 1 生成的系统描述开展系统性的威胁建模。 Rather than relying solely on expert judgment or existing taxonomies, the second phase employed generative AI to conduct systematic threat modeling against the system descriptions produced in Phase 1. 针对知识库中描述的每个结构组件、集成边界和运行模式，使用有针对性的提示，引导模型从对抗视角推理潜在的安全威胁、风险和漏洞。 For each structural component, integration boundary, and operational pattern described in the knowledge base, targeted prompts directed the model to reason adversarially about potential security threats, risks, and vulnerabilities. 关键在于，提示要求模型阐明每项已识别威胁为何与已有文献记录的单一、无状态 AI 系统风险存在本质区别，从而避免与 NIST 的 AI 100-2e2025、《AI 风险管理框架》、SP 800-218A 等出版物及相关工作已处理的发现相混淆。 Critically, prompts required the model to articulate why each identified threat is qualitatively distinct from risks already documented for singular, stateless AI systems, preventing conflation with findings already addressed by NIST publications such as AI 100-2e2025, the AI Risk Management Framework, SP 800-218A, and related work. 这一约束还确保了对多智能体涌现风险进行单独处理，即专门由智能体协调、共享状态、权限委托和分布式工具访问所产生的风险，而不是将其归入已知的单智能体攻击模式。 This constraint also ensured that multi-agent-emergent risks—those arising specifically from agent coordination, shared state, delegated authority, and distributed tool access—received distinct treatment rather than being subsumed under known single-agent attack patterns. 首轮分析得出了约 1,700 项候选威胁，分布于十二个风险领域，涵盖通过工具耦合实现的策略层远程代码执行、通过大上下文概率性回忆造成的数据泄露、记忆投毒与潜伏后门激活、非确定性造成的保障缺口、认知行为的遥测盲区、多智能体信任利用与自我复制的提示恶意软件，以及针对 RAG 流水线和插件生态系统的工作流攻击等问题。 The first-pass analysis yielded approximately 1,700 candidate threats organized across twelve risk domains, covering concerns such as policy-level remote code execution through tool coupling, data leakage via large-context probabilistic recall, memory poisoning and latent backdoor activation, non-determinism as an assurance gap, telemetry blind spots in cognitive behavior, multi-agent trust exploitation and self-replicating prompt malware, and workflow attacks targeting RAG pipelines and plugin ecosystems. 为验证这些输出的合理性与技术准确性，由一名获得 NVIDIA 智能体 AI 系统专业认证的人员开展了初步专家审查。 To validate the plausibility and technical accuracy of these outputs, an initial expert review was conducted by an NVIDIA-certified professional in agentic AI systems. 首轮审查评估了所识别的威胁是否具有技术依据、是否被正确限定在多智能体配置范围内，以及是否与单智能体风险或传统软件风险具有充分的区别。 This first review round assessed whether the identified threats were technically grounded, correctly scoped to multi-agent configurations, and sufficiently distinct from single-agent or traditional software risks. 对于被认定为冗余、描述失当或超出范围的威胁，研究者对其进行了修订或删除；同时，审阅者的领域专业知识为完善模型表述不够精确的威胁描述提供了依据。 Threats found to be redundant, mischaracterized, or outside scope were either revised or removed, while the reviewer’s domain expertise informed refinements to threat descriptions that had been articulated imprecisely by the model.
阶段 3 — 威胁级调研规划。 Phase 3 — Threat-level survey planning. 第三阶段将阶段 2 的输出转化为可执行的结构化调研计划。 The third phase operationalized the Phase 2 output into a structured survey plan. 针对已识别出的约 1,700 项威胁中的每一项，分别构建了定制的检索式，并从对生产环境中多智能体部署的适用性、相对于现有文献的新颖性，以及实证或理论依据等方面界定了相关性标准。 For each of the approximately 1,700 identified threats, a tailored search string was constructed and relevance criteria were defined in terms of applicability to production multi-agent deployments, novelty relative to the existing literature, and empirical or theoretical grounding. 调研粒度保持在单项威胁层面，而非类别层面；这是有意作出的设计选择，旨在避免较宽泛的调研范围界定中普遍存在的不精确性。 Granularity was maintained at the individual threat level rather than the category level, a deliberate design choice to avoid the imprecision endemic to broader survey scoping. 该计划还按成熟度维度对威胁进行了分类：已在现实环境中付诸实施的威胁、有理论论证或概念验证演示支持的威胁，以及被识别为值得前瞻性研究的新兴风险的威胁。 The plan further classified threats along a maturity axis: those already operationalized in the wild, those supported by theoretical argument or proof-of-concept demonstration, and those identified as emergent risks warranting forward-looking treatment.
阶段 4 — 结合时间维度分析与持续分析开展调研。 Phase 4 — Survey execution with temporal and continuous analysis. 目前正在进行的第四阶段，针对每项威胁执行阶段 3 制定的调研计划。 The fourth phase, currently underway, executes the survey plans from Phase 3 for each individual threat. 执行过程将常规文献检索与持续调研相结合，以追踪未来进展，适应智能体式 AI 威胁态势的快速演变。 Execution couples conventional literature search with continuous surveying to track future developments, reflecting the rapid pace at which the agentic AI threat landscape evolves. 时间维度分析进一步考察单项威胁如何随时间逐渐成熟——从理论构建，经由概念验证演示，直至实际利用——从而呈现其发展轨迹，而非静态快照。 Temporal analysis further examines how individual threats mature over time—from theoretical construction through proof-of-concept demonstration to active exploitation—providing a developmental arc rather than a static snapshot. 下一节呈现的研究发现涵盖阶段 1 至阶段 3 已完成的成果及阶段 4 的早期结果，对 AI 智能体系统的威胁态势作出了严谨但必然持续演进的刻画。 The findings presented in the following section reflect the completed outputs of Phases 1 through 3 and early results from Phase 4, constituting a rigorous but necessarily evolving characterization of the threat landscape for AI agent systems.
III 影响 AI 智能体系统的安全威胁、风险与漏洞III Security Threats, Risks, and Vulnerabilities Affecting AI Agent Systems
III-A 作为“策略层面远程代码执行”的智能体–工具耦合III-A Agent–tool coupling as “policy-level remote code execution”
在智能体式 AI 中，底层工具中的漏洞与负责编排这些工具的智能体策略中的漏洞有所区别。 Agentic AI distinguishes vulnerabilities in underlying tools from vulnerabilities in agent policy that orchestrates them. 控制模型决策的攻击者无需利用代码层面的缺陷，即可间接劫持功能强大的工具。 Attackers controlling model decisions can indirectly commandeer powerful tools without exploiting code-level flaws.
具体威胁包括：工具介导的系统失陷，即成功的提示注入或观测注入使智能体浏览恶意网站、下载并运行代码、修改配置或重新配置 SaaS 系统。 Distinct threats include: Tool-mediated compromise where successful prompt or observation injection enables agents to browse malicious sites, download and run code, modify configurations, or reconfigure SaaS systems. 即使不存在传统的 RCE 漏洞，这也能通过高权限工具实现实际意义上的“RCE”。 This achieves practical ”RCE” via high-privilege tools despite no classical RCE vulnerability existing. 思维与观测层面的攻击，即攻击者扰动内部推理或工具选择步骤，同时使最终的自然语言回答保持无害。 Thought-and observation-level attacks where attackers perturb internal reasoning or tool-selection steps while keeping final natural-language answers benign. 以输出为重点的防护机制检测不到任何可疑内容，而底层系统却面临失陷。 Output-focused guards detect nothing suspicious while underlying systems face compromise.
这种“策略层面的 RCE”与操纵固定的、确定性的控制流图存在本质区别。 This ”policy-level RCE” differs qualitatively from manipulating fixed, deterministic control-flow graphs.
III-A1 RATC_1 - UI/UX 抽象与可见性缺口III-A1 RATC_1 - UI/UX Abstraction and Visibility Gaps
RATC_1_1 - 工具抽象导致的审批工作流风险校准失效。 RATC_1_1 - Approval Workflow Risk Calibration Failure Through Tool Abstraction. 审批界面通过抽象层呈现工具调用，将复杂操作简化为人类可读的描述，从而掩盖真实的风险水平。 Approval UIs present tool invocations through abstraction layers that simplify complex operations into human-readable descriptions, masking true risk levels. 当“更新客户记录”掩盖了对生产数据库的直接 SQL 修改时，人们会基于看似无害的抽象描述而非实际风险作出批准。 When ”Update customer record” hides direct SQL modifications to production databases, humans approve based on benign abstractions rather than actual risks. 多智能体系统会放大这一问题：审批界面显示 Agent A 的高层意图，却隐藏了 Agent B 调用支付 API、Agent C 修改财务数据库以及 Agent D 触发通知的事实——这些操作各有不同的失效模式。 Multi-agent systems amplify this: approval UIs show Agent A’s high-level intent while hiding that Agent B invokes payment APIs, Agent C modifies financial databases, and Agent D triggers notifications—each with distinct failure modes. 这种结构化呈现将危险的多工具操作序列压缩为单个批准按钮 [10, 11, 12, 13, 14]。 The structured presentation collapses dangerous multi-tool sequences into single approval buttons [10, 11, 12, 13, 14].
RATC_1_2 - 渐进式披露对工具链复杂性的掩盖。 RATC_1_2 - Progressive Disclosure Concealment of Tool Chain Complexity. 渐进式披露模式将技术细节隐藏在可展开的区域中，造成可见性缺口，使用户在不了解完整工具调用链的情况下作出批准。“安排后续跟进邮件”隐藏了五个具有不同失效模式的工具：render_template、query_crm_database（50K 条记录）、call_email_reputation_api、rabbitmq_publish、write_audit_log。 Progressive disclosure patterns hide technical details in expandable sections, creating visibility gaps where users approve without understanding complete tool invocation chains. ”Schedule follow-up emails” conceals five tools with distinct failure modes: render_template, query_crm_database (50K records), call_email_reputation_api, rabbitmq_publish, write_audit_log. 多智能体系统会灾难性地放大这一问题，因为工具链跨越智能体边界，且没有任何单一视图能够呈现完整的执行图。 Multi-agent systems amplify this catastrophically because tool chains span agent boundaries, and no single view presents complete execution graphs. Agent A 显示三个工具，Agent B 显示四个工具，但当 Agent A 的工作流触发 Agent B 的下游工作流时，界面从不显示合并后的十一个工具的调用序列 [15, 16, 17, 18, 19, 20, 21, 22]。 Agent A shows three tools, Agent B shows four tools, but UIs never display the combined eleven-tool sequence when Agent A’s workflow triggers Agent B’s downstream workflow [15, 16, 17, 18, 19, 20, 21, 22].
RATC_1_3 - 多种 UI 范式中的工具可见性缺口。 RATC_1_3 - Tool Visibility Gaps Across Multiple UI Paradigms. 工具可见性问题存在于多种 UI 模式中：内联建议在不可见的情况下执行工具，既不显示运行了什么，也不显示访问了哪些数据；聊天界面将工具输出显示为对话消息，却不明确指出执行了哪些工具；多模态工作流则将工具链隐藏在自然语言操作背后。 Tool visibility issues span multiple UI patterns: inline suggestions execute tools invisibly without surfacing what runs or data accessed; chat interfaces display tool outputs as conversational messages without clearly indicating which tools executed; multimodal workflows hide tool chains behind natural language operations. 在多智能体系统中，不同智能体的工具输出通过不同的 UI 通道呈现；试图拼凑完整图景的人类无法看到整合后的工具耦合关系 [23, 24, 25, 26]。 In multi-agent systems, different agents’ tool outputs appear through different UI channels; humans assembling a complete picture cannot see the integrated tool coupling [23, 24, 25, 26].
RATC_1_4 - 多智能体仪表板对工具风险的区分不足。 RATC_1_4 - Insufficient Tool Risk Differentiation in Multi-Agent Dashboards. 多智能体仪表板展示多个智能体的活动，却不按风险级别区分工具调用，对文件读取、数据库写入、API 调用和系统命令赋予相同的视觉权重。“智能体 A：正在处理数据”“智能体 B：正在更新记录”“智能体 C：正在执行分析”等信息缺少用于区分只读操作与状态修改操作的风险指示。 Multi-agent dashboards display activities from multiple agents without differentiating tool invocations by risk level, treating file reads, database writes, API calls, and system commands with equivalent visual weight. ”Agent A: Processing data,” ”Agent B: Updating records,” ”Agent C: Executing analysis” lack risk indicators distinguishing read-only from state-modifying operations. 多智能体仪表板汇集了工具访问权限各不相同的智能体——有些只调用安全的只读工具，另一些则执行特权系统命令——但统一的呈现方式模糊了安全边界，使攻击者能够将危险执行伪装成正常活动并加以触发 [27, 28, 29, 30, 31, 32, 33, 34, 35]。 Multi-agent dashboards aggregate agents with heterogeneous tool access—some invoke only safe read-only tools, others execute privileged system commands—but unified presentation obscures security boundaries where attackers trigger dangerous executions camouflaged as normal activity [27, 28, 29, 30, 31, 32, 33, 34, 35].
RATC_1_5 - 用户不知情的上下文驱动工具选择。 RATC_1_5 - Context-Driven Tool Selection Without User Awareness. 上下文感知功能使智能体能够根据对话历史和会话状态自动调用工具；当用户不知道上下文会触发执行时，这就会造成策略层面的远程代码执行（RCE）风险。在“向我展示客户数据”之后询问“我们 Q3 的收入是多少？”，可能会使具备上下文感知能力的智能体自动联接客户表和财务表——这种操作比简单聚合需要更高的权限。 Context awareness features enable agents to automatically invoke tools based on conversation history and session state, creating policy-level RCE risks when users remain unaware context triggers execution. ”What’s our Q3 revenue?” following ”Show me customer data” may cause context-aware agents to automatically join customer and financial tables—a more privileged operation than simple aggregation. 多智能体架构会放大风险，因为上下文会跨越智能体边界传播；工具选择智能体 C 可能会根据用户交互智能体 A 和数据检索智能体 B 建立的上下文调用高风险工具。用户从低风险查询开始，却可能因上下文漂移而无意中使高风险调用成为可能，而 UI 不会对此作出提示。 Multi-agent architectures amplify risk because context propagates across agent boundaries; Tool Selection Agent C may invoke high-risk tools based on context established by User Interaction Agent A and Data Retrieval Agent B. Users beginning with low-risk queries may inadvertently enable high-risk invocations through contextual drift without UI indication. [36, 37, 38, 39, 18]。 [36, 37, 38, 39, 18].
RATC_1_6 - 追踪可视化的抽象掩盖工具链复杂性。 RATC_1_6 - Trace Visualization Abstraction Concealing Tool Chain Complexity. 追踪可视化通过分层下钻来揭示嵌套操作，但多智能体系统利用这种抽象造成的可见性缺口来隐藏执行复杂性。 Trace visualization creates hierarchical drill-down to reveal nested operations, but multi-agent systems exploit this abstraction as a visibility gap to hide execution complexity. 工具调用在摘要视图中呈现为简化的操作（“分析数据”），详细的工具链只有在展开视图中才可见。 Tool invocations appear as simplified operations in summary views (”Analyze data”), with detailed tool chains visible only in expanded views. 操作人员仅审查折叠的摘要而不展开技术细节，会使策略层面的 RCE 成为可能。 Operators reviewing collapsed summaries without expanding technical details enable policy-level RCE. 跨智能体边界执行的多智能体工具容易受到攻击，因为没有任何一个展开视图会显示完整的工具链——智能体 A 的展开视图显示一部分工具，智能体 B 的展开视图则显示另一部分工具 [40, 41, 42]。 Multi-agent tools executing across agent boundaries become vulnerable because no single expanded view displays complete tool chains—Agent A’s expansion shows subset of tools, Agent B’s expansion shows different subset [40, 41, 42].
III-A2 RATC_2 - 审批工作流与用户注意力漏洞III-A2 RATC_2 - Approval Workflow and User Attention Vulnerabilities
RATC_2_1 - 审批疲劳使跨多个上下文绕过策略成为可能。 RATC_2_1 - Approval Fatigue Enabling Policy Bypass Through Multiple Contexts. 审批 UI 将过多决策交由人类处理，会造成审批疲劳；由于数量庞大导致全面审查难以实行，审查者会未经检查就予以批准。 Approval UIs routing excessive decisions to humans create approval fatigue, where reviewers approve without inspection because volume makes thorough review impractical. 每次工具调用都会生成醒目程度相近的审批卡片，导致用户形成习得性无助，并点击“全部批准”。 Every tool invocation generates approval cards with similar prominence, causing users to develop learned helplessness and click ”Approve All.” 多智能体系统尤其容易受到影响，因为分布式架构产生的请求数量比单智能体呈指数级增长。 Multi-agent systems are uniquely vulnerable because distributed architectures generate exponentially more requests than singular agents. 包含五个智能体的工作流会将概念层面的操作转化为五张依次出现的卡片。 Five-agent workflows transform conceptual operations into five sequential cards. 攻击者利用这种疲劳，在请求量较大、用户未经检查就予以批准的时段安排危险调用。 Attackers exploit fatigue by timing dangerous invocations during high-volume periods when users approve without inspection. 持续评估和基准测试会生成数千个审批请求，从而加剧这一漏洞；在这种情况下，遭到篡改的评估指标可使攻击者操纵工具执行 [43, 44, 18, 45, 46]。 Continuous evaluation and benchmarking amplify vulnerability by generating thousands of approval requests where compromised evaluation metrics enable tool execution steering [43, 44, 18, 45, 46].
RATC_2_2 - 审批工作流中的键盘快捷键劫持。 RATC_2_2 - Keyboard Shortcut Hijacking in Approval Workflows. 当浏览器扩展、注入的 JavaScript 或焦点操纵捕获按键事件时，UI 操纵会利用键盘快捷键导致非预期的批准。 UI manipulation causes unintended approvals through keyboard shortcut exploitation when browser extensions, injected JavaScript, or focus manipulation capture keystroke events. 攻击者注入隐藏对话框，并利用用户对自动跳转形成的肌肉记忆。 Attackers inject hidden dialogs and exploit auto-advance muscle memory. 相关场景包括：在快速连续呈现的 UI 中注入恶意审批项、在文本输入期间窃取焦点、在用户依惯性操作时利用自动跳转机制，以及通过剪贴板劫持使组合键被错误解释。 Scenarios include rapid-fire UIs with injected malicious approvals, focus stealing during text entry, auto-advance exploits during autopilot operation, and clipboard hijacking misinterpreting combinations. 在多智能体情境中，当审批决策影响对其他智能体的信任时，风险会被放大。 Multi-agent contexts amplify risk when approval decisions influence trust in other agents. 缓解措施需要包括：无法通过单次按键完成的意图确认、跟踪焦点持续时间的焦点验证、通过滚动浏览详细信息进行视觉确认、能够检测可疑模式的速率限制，以及防止注入的内容安全策略（Content Security Policy）[47, 48]。 Mitigation requires intent confirmation unavailable via single keypress, focus validation tracking duration, visual confirmation scrolling through details, rate limiting detecting suspicious patterns, and Content Security Policy preventing injection [47, 48].
RATC_2_3 - 针对关键决策的基于时间的默认行为利用。 RATC_2_3 - Time-Based Default Exploit for Critical Decisions. 攻击者利用审批超时机制，在合法审查者无法处理审批时触发批准，从而强制执行未经授权的操作。 Exploitation of approval timeouts forces unauthorized action execution by triggering approvals when legitimate reviewers are unavailable. 攻击者识别出允许自动执行的审批超时机制，然后有策略地在无人值守的时段提交高风险请求。 Attackers identify approval timeouts permitting auto-execution, then strategically submit high-risk requests during coverage gaps. 攻击通过以下方式利用时机：在周五提交超时时限为 2 小时的请求，使其在周一审查之前执行；针对国际组织实施时区攻击；以及通过海量审批请求淹没审查者。 Attacks exploit timing through Friday submissions with 2-hour timeouts executing before Monday review, timezone attacks targeting international organizations, mass approval flooding overwhelming reviewers. 当智能体协调请求在不同审核者之间的路由，而每位审核者都假定其他人会发现问题时，多智能体系统会放大风险。 Multi-agent systems amplify risk when agents coordinate routing across reviewers, each assuming others catch problems. 缓解措施需要包括：与风险程度相匹配的超时设置、防止单点故障的多方审批要求、标记可疑提交的时序攻击检测、超时时默认拒绝而非批准的安全默认设置，以及触发升级处理而非自动执行的升级处理链。 Mitigation requires risk-proportional timeouts, multi-approver requirements preventing single-point failures, timing attack detection flagging suspicious submissions, safe defaults rejecting rather than approving on timeout, and escalation chains triggering escalation rather than auto-execution. [49, 11, 45, 50, 44, 51]. [49, 11, 45, 50, 44, 51].
III-A3 RATC_3 - 工具过载、参数处理与选择错误III-A3 RATC_3 - Tool Overload, Parameter Handling, and Selection Errors
RATC_3_1 - 不同架构中工具过载导致的权限提升与性能退化。 RATC_3_1 - Tool Overload Privilege Escalation and Degradation Across Architectures. 在多智能体架构中，智能体具有不同的工具访问权限级别或配备过多工具，会导致权限提升和工具选择能力退化。 Multi-agent architectures with agents possessing different tool access levels or excessive tool counts create privilege escalation and selection degradation. 单智能体工具过载（20+ 个工具）会降低性能；对过载配置的基准评估表明，工具选择错误率最高可达 50%，其中智能体“经常选择不合适的工具、臆造工具名称，或默认使用熟悉的工具”。 Single-agent tool overload (20+ tools) degrades performance; benchmark evaluations of overloaded configurations show tool selection error rates as high as 50%, where agents ”frequently select inappropriate ones, hallucinate tool names, or default to familiar tools.” 这一比率在趋势上也适用于涉及权限边界的跨智能体委派——尽管实际比率因模型和工具集而异——从而产生系统性的权限提升机会。 This rate applies directionally to cross-agent delegations involving privilege boundaries—though actual rates vary by model and tool set—creating systematic escalation opportunities. 在层级式委派中，当 Agent A 与 Agent B 协调时，攻击者会利用认知过载，操纵 Agent B 代表 Agent A 执行特权操作。 In hierarchical delegation, when Agent A coordinates with Agent B, attackers exploit cognitive overload manipulating Agent B into executing privileged operations on Agent A’s behalf. 工具选择能力的退化会沿委派链级联传播，放大故障。 Tool selection degradation cascades through delegation chains amplifying failures. 缓解措施需要缩减工具集、通过明确分配工具实现专业化，以及实施明确的委派控制。 Mitigation requires tool set reduction, specialization with explicit tool assignment, and explicit delegation controls. [52, 53, 54, 55, 56]. [52, 53, 54, 55, 56].
RATC_3_2 - 工具实参注入与参数提取错误。 RATC_3_2 - Tool Argument Injection and Parameter Extraction Errors. 工具调用中的实参错误会通过跨信任边界的实参注入，成为远程代码执行的攻击途径。 Tool calling argument errors become remote code execution vectors through argument injection across trust boundaries. 当 Agent A 根据不可信数据构造实参并将其传递给 Agent B 执行时，大语言模型（LLM）的概率性生成机制使攻击者能够将恶意载荷作为参数值注入。 When Agent A constructs arguments from untrusted data and passes them to Agent B for execution, LLMs’ probabilistic generation enables attackers injecting malicious payloads as parameter values. 多智能体架构将构造与执行分离，消除了单智能体的自我验证。 Multi-agent architectures separate construction from execution, eliminating single-agent self-validation. 上下文碎片化意味着下游智能体缺乏关键的上游上下文，包括对安全至关重要的验证信息。 Context fragmentation means downstream agents lack critical upstream context including security-critical validation. 工具调用的失败率会在链式工具调用中累积——如果 Agent A 从对话历史中错误地提取了 user_id，Agent B 就会接收到错误的 user_id，并提取错误用户的账户引用。 Tool calling failure rates compound through chained tool calls—if Agent A extracts user_id incorrectly from conversation history, Agent B receives wrong user_id and extracts account references for wrong user. 多智能体系统会形成信任链，其中 Agent A 的提取错误会被 Agent B 假定为有效结果。参数提取错误会通过链式调用累积，从而产生放大效应。 Multi-agent systems create trust chains where Agent A’s extraction error gets assumed-valid by Agent B. Parameter extraction errors compound through chained calls enabling amplification. [57, 58, 59, 60, 36]. [57, 58, 59, 60, 36].
RATC_3_3 - 内联建议模式中的工具可见性缺口。 RATC_3_3 - Tool Visibility Gaps in Inline Suggestion Patterns. 内联建议用户界面直接在工作流中显示建议，同时在不可见的情况下执行工具，不向用户展示运行了什么或访问了哪些数据。 Inline suggestion UIs display recommendations directly within workflows while executing tools invisibly, without surfacing what runs or what data they access. 接受代码建议可能会在用户不知情的情况下触发：执行静态分析、为查找相似模式而发起远程 API 查询、将代码上传至云服务，以及发送分析遥测数据——所有这些都不可见。 Accepting code suggestions may unknowingly trigger: static analysis execution, remote API queries for similar patterns, code uploads to cloud services, and analytics telemetry—all invisible. 这会造成策略层面的远程代码执行（RCE），即工具执行由被动操作而非明确请求触发。 This creates policy-level RCE where tools execute from passive actions rather than explicit requests. 多智能体系统通过分布式建议流水线放大风险——安全代码检查器、性能分析器和风格检查器都会在不可见的情况下调用工具。 Multi-agent systems amplify risk through distributed suggestion pipelines—security linters, performance analyzers, style checkers each invoke tools invisibly. 用户界面仅呈现最终建议，却隐藏了生成这些建议的分布式工具调用图 [61, 62, 45, 63, 64, 44, 65, 66]。 UIs present only final suggestions while concealing distributed tool graphs generating them [61, 62, 45, 63, 64, 44, 65, 66].
RATC_3_4 - 聊天界面工具输出中的工具来源信息遮蔽。 RATC_3_4 - Tool Provenance Obscuration in Chat Interface Tool Outputs. 聊天界面将工具输出显示为对话消息，却未明确指出执行了哪些工具、这些工具接收了哪些参数，或使用了哪些权限。“我发现了 3 项合规违规”可能来自使用管理员级别的生产环境访问权限执行 query_compliance_database，但用户无法评估其是否适当。 Chat interfaces display tool outputs as conversational messages without clearly indicating which tools executed, what parameters they received, or what privileges they used. ”I found 3 compliance violations” may come from executing query_compliance_database with admin-level production access, but users cannot assess appropriateness. 多智能体聊天界面会进一步模糊来源信息，因为输出汇总了多个智能体的调用，而对话式呈现方式（“根据我的分析……”）完全隐藏了哪个智能体调用了哪些工具 [67, 23, 68, 69, 70, 71, 72, 73]。 Multi-agent chat interfaces obscure provenance further because outputs aggregate multiple agents’ invocations, with conversational presentation (”Based on my analysis…”) completely hiding which agent invoked which tools [67, 23, 68, 69, 70, 71, 72, 73].
III-A4 RATC_4 - 置信度操纵与工具授权III-A4 RATC_4 - Confidence Manipulation and Tool Authorization
RATC_4_1 - 置信度阈值操纵攻击。 RATC_4_1 - Confidence Threshold Manipulation Attack. 当基于置信度的门控机制决定自动化程度时，对抗性提示注入会人为抬高智能体的置信度分数，以绕过审批关卡。 Adversarial prompt injection artificially inflates agent confidence scores to bypass approval gates where confidence-based gating determines automation levels. 攻击者精心构造提示，使智能体对恶意操作报告高置信度。 Attackers craft prompts causing high confidence reporting for malicious actions. 当智能体未经验证就信任其他智能体提供的置信度分数时，多智能体系统便会面临危险，进而引发级联故障。 Multi-agent systems face danger when agents trust confidence scores from other agents without validation, creating cascading failures. 漏洞包括：过度依赖缺乏提示复杂度分析的自报指标、多因素验证不足导致的单点决策失效，以及缺乏准确率跟踪，导致置信度验证很少与历史准确率进行交叉核对。 Vulnerabilities include over-reliance on self-reported metrics lacking prompt complexity analysis, single-point decision failures with insufficient multi-factor validation, and absent accuracy tracking where confidence validation rarely cross-references historical accuracy. 对于采用高温度参数（0.9）调优的过载智能体，攻击者会利用表面准确性与置信度表现之间的脱节。 In overloaded agents tuned with high temperature (0.9), attackers exploit separation of apparent accuracy from confidence appearance. 当被操纵的输入导致全部 k 条采样路径都收敛到同一答案时，就会发生由多数投票造成的置信度分数虚高。 Confidence score inflation through majority voting occurs when all k sampled paths converge on an answer due to manipulated input. 缓解措施包括依据历史准确率验证置信度、结合提示分析和跨模型检查开展多因素评估、保留完整的审计记录，以及采用动态阈值 [74, 11]。 Mitigation requires confidence validation against historical accuracy, multi-factor assessment with prompt analysis and cross-model checks, comprehensive audit trails, and dynamic thresholds [74, 11].
RATC_4_2 - 不同智能体专业分工之间的工具授权范围混淆。 RATC_4_2 - Tool Authorization Scope Confusion Across Agent Specializations. 不同智能体获得的授权各不相同——研究智能体可以访问文档工具，执行智能体可以访问支付工具。 Agent authorization grants differ—research agents access document tools, execution agents access payment tools. 在多智能体系统中，攻击者攻陷同时能够访问研究工具和执行工具的中间智能体（协调智能体），从而实现“通过中介进行权限提升”：被攻陷的协调智能体使用从文档智能体输出中提取的参数调用支付工具。 In multi-agent systems, attackers compromise intermediate agents (coordination agents) that access both research and execution tools, enabling ”privilege escalation through intermediary” where compromised coordinator agents invoke payment tools with parameters extracted from document agents’ outputs. 前置条件检查会在调用工具之前验证先决条件（用户已通过身份验证、资源存在），但多智能体系统会丧失对这一过程的可见性，从而发生前置条件验证绕过——Agent A 验证前置条件，Agent B 则假定 Agent A 已验证所有条件，并跳过重新检查。 Precondition validation bypass occurs when precondition checks verify prerequisites before tool invocation (user authenticated, resource exists), but multi-agent systems lose visibility—Agent A verifies preconditions, Agent B assumes Agent A verified everything and skips rechecking. 攻击者攻陷 Agent A，使其跳过检查，从而形成传递性信任，导致 Agent B 在先决条件未经验证的情况下执行工具。 Attackers compromise Agent A to skip checks, creating transitive trust where Agent B executes tools without verified prerequisites. [31, 75, 76, 77, 78]。 [31, 75, 76, 77, 78].
III-A5 RATC_6 - 注册表与发现过程中的工具元数据投毒III-A5 RATC_6 - Tool Metadata Poisoning Across Registries and Discovery
RATC_6_1 - 集中式工具注册表投毒。 RATC_6_1 - Centralized Tool Registry Poisoning. 共享集中式工具注册表的多智能体系统面临元数据投毒攻击：攻击者一旦攻陷注册表，就能操纵所有智能体理解和调用工具的方式。 Multi-agent systems sharing centralized tool registries face metadata poisoning attacks where compromising the registry enables manipulation of how all agents understand and invoke tools. 攻击者修改描述和模式定义，诱使智能体误用合法工具。 Attackers modify descriptions and schemas inducing agents into misusing legitimate tools. 采用内嵌定义的单智能体系统能够限制投毒；多智能体共享注册表则会形成单一的语义控制点，对其进行的更改会同时影响所有智能体。 Single-agent systems with embedded definitions limit poisoning; multi-agent shared registries create single semantic control points where changes affect all agents simultaneously. 工具的有效性取决于描述质量；含糊的描述会导致智能体误解工具的用途。 Tool effectiveness depends on description quality; vague descriptions cause agents to misunderstand purposes. 针对负载过重的智能体投毒的元数据，会使危险工具显得“熟悉”。 Poisoned metadata targeting overloaded agents makes dangerous tools appear ”familiar.” 向量数据库中的元数据通过语义相似度引导工具选择；对工具描述向量投毒会导致语义搜索检索出错误的工具。 Vector database metadata guides tool selection through semantic similarity; poisoning tool description vectors causes semantic search to retrieve wrong tools. 通过少样本参数示例进行的工具元数据注入，会将恶意指令嵌入工具描述中出现的示例参数值内 [79, 80, 81, 82]。 Tool metadata injection via few-shot parameter examples embeds malicious instructions in example parameter values appearing in tool descriptions [79, 80, 81, 82].
RATC_6_2 - 针对特定框架的工具选择投毒。 RATC_6_2 - Framework-Specific Tool Selection Poisoning. 框架架构决定智能体如何选择工具。 Framework architectures determine how agents select tools. 攻击者通过对智能体评估的决策上下文投毒，利用特定框架的工具选择机制。 Attackers exploit framework-specific tool selection mechanisms by poisoning the decision context agents evaluate. 在 LangGraph 的条件边路由机制中，状态决定调用哪些工具，被投毒的状态字段会导致工具按照未经授权的顺序执行。 In LangGraph’s conditional edge routing where state determines which tools invoke, poisoned state fields cause tools to execute in unauthorized sequences. CrewAI 的分层委派机制会带来可乘之机：被篡改的任务上下文会导致管理者错误地将高权限操作委派给低权限智能体。 CrewAI’s hierarchical delegation creates opportunities where compromised task contexts cause managers delegating high-privilege operations to low-privilege agents incorrectly. 单框架系统呈现一个攻击面；跨框架的多智能体编排则会产生 N(N-1)/2 个不同的攻击面 [83, 84]。 Single-framework systems present one attack surface; multi-agent orchestrations across frameworks create N(N-1)/2 distinct surfaces [83, 84].
RATC_6_3 - 框架抽象泄漏使隐藏工具链利用成为可能。 RATC_6_3 - Framework Abstraction Leakage Enabling Hidden Tool Chain Exploitation. 框架通过抽象封装工具调用的复杂性来简化开发体验，但这种抽象会在多智能体系统中形成盲点，使工具链变为隐式而非显式。 Frameworks abstract tool invocation complexity to simplify developer experience, but this abstraction creates blind spots in multi-agent systems where tool chains become implicit rather than explicit. LangChain 对工具执行顺序进行抽象，使审核审批工作流的人员无法看到这一顺序。 LangChain abstracts tool sequencing, making it invisible to humans reviewing approval workflows. LangGraph 将实现抽象为代码，但在向操作人员展示的执行轨迹中隐藏了实现细节。 LangGraph abstracts implementation to code but hides in execution traces displayed to operators. 多智能体系统会叠加抽象层：LangChain 智能体的输出传递至 LangGraph 的边，再传递至 CrewAI 的任务执行过程。 Multi-agent systems stack abstractions: LangChain agent outputs feed to LangGraph edges feeding CrewAI task execution. 这种抽象层级结构形成了多个层次，策略层面的 RCE 在不同抽象层之下执行，导致监督不一致。 The abstraction hierarchy creates multiple layers where policy-level RCE executes beneath different abstraction levels, making oversight inconsistent. 框架的选择会影响实现细节是暴露还是隐藏，从而使隐藏工具链成为可能 [69, 62, 20, 19, 21, 85, 71, 70, 67, 72, 86]。 Framework selection affects whether implementation details are exposed or hidden, enabling hidden tool chains [69, 62, 20, 19, 21, 85, 71, 70, 67, 72, 86].
III-A6 RATC_8 - 高级工具调用模式与推断III-A6 RATC_8 - Advanced Tool Invocation Patterns and Inference
RATC_8_1 - 通过多智能体重新规划循环利用工具链。 RATC_8_1 - Tool Chain Exploitation Through Multi-Agent Replanning Loops. 规划与执行（Plan-and-Execute）系统中的动态重新规划，为迭代式工具链利用创造了攻击面。 Dynamic replanning in Plan-and-Execute systems creates attack surfaces for iterative tool chain exploitation. 攻击者在 Agent A 中诱发可控故障，触发 Agent B 重新规划，逐步将无害工具串联成危险序列。 Attackers induce controlled failures in Agent A triggering replanning in Agent B, progressively chaining innocuous tools into dangerous sequences. 攻击者精心构造输入，使 Agent A 的工具调用返回格式正确但语义错误的结果——例如，针对实际存在的资源返回资源未找到错误。 The attacker crafts an input that causes Agent A’s tool call to return a well-formed but semantically incorrect result—for example, a resource-not-found error for an existing resource. Agent B 的重新规划逻辑将被投毒的结果视为真实的故障上下文，选择权限更高的备用工具加以补偿，从而完成权限提升链中的一个步骤。 Agent B’s replanning logic, reading the poisoned result as genuine failure context, selects a higher-privilege fallback tool to compensate, completing one step of the escalation chain. 单智能体的重新规划受到边界约束；多智能体的重新规划则会在缺乏全局一致性检查的情况下造成跨智能体状态累积。 Single-agent replanning is bounded; multi-agent replanning creates cross-agent state accumulation without global consistency checks. 包含 N 个智能体的系统中存在 N(N-1)/2 对交互关系，使攻击者能够利用涌现出的漏洞 [87, 88, 89, 44, 90, 91, 14, 46, 92, 93, 94, 95, 96, 97, 98, 99, 100, 101]。 N(N-1)/2 interaction pairs in N-agent systems enable exploitation of emergent vulnerabilities [87, 88, 89, 44, 90, 91, 14, 46, 92, 93, 94, 95, 96, 97, 98, 99, 100, 101].
RATC_8_2 - 工具结果注入与观察操纵。 RATC_8_2 - Tool Result Injection and Observation Manipulation. 在 Agent A 的工具输出成为 Agent B 的观察内容的多智能体系统中，ReAct 模式的显式观察格式成为攻击途径。 ReAct pattern’s explicit observation format becomes attack vector in multi-agent systems where Agent A’s tool outputs become Agent B’s observations. 攻击者注入恶意“观察”，将其格式化为看似合法的工具结果。 Attackers inject malicious ”observations” formatted as tool results appearing legitimate. Agent B 纳入被投毒的观察内容后，会导致下游远程代码执行（RCE）。 Agent B incorporating poisoned observations causes downstream RCE. 单个智能体会验证自身的输出；多智能体链则信任上游观察内容，而不进行重新验证。 Single agents validate their own outputs; multi-agent chains trust upstream observations without re-validation. 流式攻击通过流式传输内容，使攻击者能够逐步注入升级指令，从而放大这一问题。 Streaming attacks amplify this by delivering content via streaming enabling attackers injecting progressive escalation instructions. 多智能体 ReAct 编排会造成级联式污染，流式注入的影响在其中不断叠加。 Multi-agent ReAct orchestration creates cascading corruption where streaming injections compound. [102, 103, 104, 105, 106]. [102, 103, 104, 105, 106].
RATC_8_3 - 工具模式差异与跨框架边界。 RATC_8_3 - Tool Schema Variation and Cross-Framework Boundaries. 不同框架以不同方式定义工具模式（LangChain 的结构化定义、LangGraph 的节点输入类型、AutoGen 的可用工具集合、CrewAI 的按智能体配置工具机制，以及 Semantic Kernel 的插件模式）。 Different frameworks define tool schemas differently (LangChain’s structured definitions, LangGraph’s node input types, AutoGen’s tool availability sets, CrewAI’s tools-per-agent, Semantic Kernel’s plugin schemas). 混用不同框架的多智能体系统面临工具定义发生转换的模式转换层。 Multi-agent systems mixing frameworks face schema translation layers where tool definitions transform. 攻击者精心构造工具定义，利用转换过程中的缺口——在 LangChain 中有效的参数会在 LangGraph 中触发错误，但这些错误被静默捕获。 Attackers craft tool definitions exploiting transformation gaps—a parameter valid in LangChain triggers errors in LangGraph, but errors are silently caught. 单框架系统提供一个模式接口；跨框架的多智能体编排则会产生 N(N-1)/2 个转换边界 [107, 93, 108, 69, 109, 110]。 Single-framework systems present one schema interface; multi-agent cross-framework orchestration creates N(N-1)/2 transformation boundaries [107, 93, 108, 69, 109, 110].
III-A7 RATC_9 - Web 与多模态工具利用III-A7 RATC_9 - Web and Multimodal Tool Exploitation
RATC_9_1 - Web 智能体工具漏洞。 RATC_9_1 - Web Agent Tool Vulnerabilities. Web 智能体使用专门的抓取工具从网站提取内容。 Web agents use specialized scraping tools to extract content from websites. 攻击者将指令注入网站的 JavaScript、CSS 或 HTML 中，并将其伪装成“反机器人机制规避技巧”。 Adversaries inject instructions into websites’ JavaScript, CSS, or HTML disguised as ”anti-bot evasion tips.” 当多智能体系统协同执行网页抓取时，注入的规避指令会作为合法的操作指导传播。 When multi-agent systems coordinate web scraping, injected evasion instructions propagate as legitimate operational guidance. Web 智能体使用参数化工具与表单交互，其中表单字段名从页面结构中提取。 Web agents interact with forms using parameterized tools where form field names are extracted from page structure. 攻击者精心构造带有隐藏字段的表单，并在这些字段中嵌入指令。 Attackers craft forms with hidden fields containing instructions. 对导航操作日志记录工具的操纵会导致智能体记录不完整的审计轨迹。 Navigation action logging tool manipulation causes agents to record incomplete audit trails. ARIA（无障碍富互联网应用）动态区域注入利用无障碍 API，攻击者通过这些 API 将指令注入 ARIA 属性中。 ARIA (Accessible Rich Internet Applications) live region injection exploits accessibility APIs where attackers inject instructions into ARIA attributes. [111, 106, 112, 113, 114]. [111, 106, 112, 113, 114].
RATC_9_2 - 多模态检索与视觉处理漏洞。 RATC_9_2 - Multimodal Retrieval and Vision Processing Vulnerabilities. 当智能体根据被投毒的多模态内容检索并执行工具时，多模态系统中就会发生策略层面的 RCE。 Policy-level RCE in multimodal systems occurs when agents retrieve and execute tools based on poisoned multimodal content. 在由检索智能体选择文档、由综合智能体调用工具的多智能体 RAG 中，攻击者对图文对进行投毒，确保智能体检索到特定的恶意内容。 In multi-agent RAG where retrieval agents select documents and synthesis agents invoke tools, attackers poison image-text pairs ensuring agents retrieve specifically malicious content. 专门的视觉智能体按顺序运行，其输出成为下游智能体信任的输入。 Specialized vision agents operate in sequence with outputs becoming trusted inputs for downstream agents. 通过多步处理对视觉模型输出进行洗白，会形成 RCE 洗白，使恶意视觉输出通过多步处理获得合法性。 Vision model output laundering through multi-step processing creates RCE laundering where malicious vision outputs gain legitimacy through multi-step processing. 跨模态工具参数注入使攻击成为可能：文本、图像和音频模态分别提供参数片段，而其间没有设置净化处理边界。 Cross-modal tool parameter injection enables attacks where text, image, and audio modalities contribute parameter segments without sanitization boundaries. [67, 68, 74]. [67, 68, 74].
III-A8 RATC_10 - 效率优化与资源约束III-A8 RATC_10 - Efficiency Optimization and Resource Constraints
RATC_10_2 - 迭代预算与温度调优的权衡。 RATC_10_2 - Iteration Budget and Temperature Tuning Trade-offs. 迭代预算因智能体的专门职能而异。 Iteration budgets vary per agent specialization. 攻击者精心构造需要多次迭代的工具序列，这些序列针对高预算智能体的攻击能够成功，但针对预算受限智能体的攻击则会失败。 Attackers craft tool sequences requiring many iterations succeeding against high-budget agents but failing against constrained ones. 温度调优控制错误的可见性——温度设得较高（0.9）的智能体错误率较高，却表现得很自信。 Temperature tuning controls error visibility—agents tuned high (0.9) exhibit high error rates but appear confident. 攻击者利用调优参数，使实际准确率与外显置信程度相互脱离。 Attackers exploit tuning parameters that separate actual accuracy from confidence visibility. 模型选择的多样性会造成策略不一致，使工具授权决策随模型能力而变化。 Model selection diversity creates policy inconsistency where tool authorization decisions vary by model capability. 相同的策略层面 RCE 在某些模型上能够成功，在其他模型上则会失败。 Identical policy-level RCE succeeds against some models but fails against others. 参数接受与否取决于温度，这使策略层面的 RCE 成为可能：参数在低温度下无法通过验证，却在高温度下能够通过。 Temperature-dependent parameter acceptance enables policy-level RCE where parameters fail validation at low temperatures but succeed at high temperatures. [115, 116, 69, 114, 68]. [115, 116, 69, 114, 68].
III-A9 RATC_12 - 分布式与硬件层攻击III-A9 RATC_12 - Distributed and Hardware-Level Attacks
RATC_12_1 - 张量并行通信截获。 RATC_12_1 - Tensor Parallelism Communication Interception. 张量并行将模型计算分配到多个 GPU 上，需要通过 NVLink 或 PCIe 进行 GPU 间通信，而这些通信默认不加密。 Tensor parallelism distributes model computation across GPUs requiring inter-GPU communication through NVLink or PCIe, unencrypted by default. 在一个 GPU 上计算得出并传递给其他 GPU 的策略决策可能在传输途中被篡改。 Policy decisions computed on one GPU communicated to others can be corrupted mid-transmission. 在一个 GPU 上计算得出的工具调用策略决策在到达其他 GPU 之前遭到篡改。 Tool-calling policy decisions computed on one GPU get corrupted before reaching others. 单智能体的张量并行只有一条策略路径；而在多智能体系统中，多个智能体的策略计算经过共享基础设施，因此攻击者可通过攻陷 GPU 通信来劫持多个智能体的选择。 Single-agent tensor parallelism has one policy path; multi-agent systems where multiple agents’ policy computations flow through shared infrastructure enable compromising GPU communication to hijack multiple agents’ selections. [117, 118, 119, 120, 121]. [117, 118, 119, 120, 121].
RATC_12_2 - KV 缓存与量化攻击。 RATC_12_2 - KV Cache and Quantization Attacks. 在共享 GPU 上采用 KV 缓存优化进行多用户推理时，一个用户的智能体能够利用伪造的注意力值投毒另一个用户的智能体缓存。 Multi-user inference on shared GPUs with KV cache optimization enables one user’s agent poisoning another’s cache with fabricated attention values. 当注意力机制使用 KV 值来确定哪些工具描述获得最高注意力时，被投毒的 KV 会产生对特定工具的系统性偏向。 When attention mechanism uses KV values to determine which tool descriptions receive highest attention, poisoned KV creates systematic bias toward specific tools. 对 LLM 权重进行量化会影响模型准确解析工具参数的能力。 Quantization applied to LLM weights affects the model’s ability to accurately parse tool parameters. 攻击者利用恶意工具调用对校准数据集进行投毒，使量化阈值产生偏差。 Attackers poison calibration datasets with malicious tool calls, biasing quantization thresholds. 随后执行工具的智能体会收到量化后的输出，其中的参数被篡改为偏向攻击者优化的模式。 Subsequent agents executing tools receive quantized outputs where parameters are corrupted toward attacker-optimized patterns. [122, 123, 124, 125]. [122, 123, 124, 125].
III-A10 RATC_14 - 推理与规划漏洞III-A10 RATC_14 - Reasoning and Planning Vulnerabilities
RATC_14_1 - 思维链（Chain-of-Thought）推理质量问题。 RATC_14_1 - Chain-of-Thought Reasoning Quality Issues. 当智能体作出缺乏依据的推理跳跃时，工具选择容易受到步骤内正确性失效的影响。 Tool selection vulnerable to intra-step correctness failures where agents make unsupported leaps. 当推理连贯性较低时，多步骤工具编排链容易受到攻击。 Multi-step tool orchestration chains vulnerable when reasoning has low coherence. 生成低信息量推理的智能体可能嵌入看似自然推理的工具调用。 Agents producing low-informativeness reasoning can embed tool invocations appearing as natural reasoning. 当推理轨迹被投毒，植入为危险序列辩护且各自看似合理的论据时，受损的推理就会导致协同工具滥用。 Compromised reasoning leading to coordinated tool abuse occurs when reasoning traces are poisoned with justifications for dangerous sequences appearing independently sound. 当记载着“工具 X 最高效”的推理链通过共享记忆影响其他智能体的偏好时，就会发生工具选择偏差传播。 Tool selection bias propagation occurs when reasoning chains documenting ”tool X is most efficient” influence other agents’ preferences through shared memory. [126, 127, 128, 129, 130]. [126, 127, 128, 129, 130].
RATC_14_2 - 自一致性与多数投票漏洞。 RATC_14_2 - Self-Consistency and Majority Voting Vulnerabilities. 通过采样路径分歧实施的工具调用参数注入利用了自一致性（Self-Consistency）机制，即不同采样路径得出不同工具参数的情况。 Tool calling parameter injection through sampling path divergence exploits Self-Consistency where different sampling paths arrive at different tool parameters. 攻击者在工具上下文中嵌入具有细微歧义的指令，例如略有矛盾的参数范围，使不同采样温度下生成的不同采样路径将歧义解析为不同的工具实参值；多数投票的结果随后便会体现攻击者偏好的参数，而任何单条路径看起来都没有明显恶意。 An attacker embeds a subtly ambiguous instruction in the tool context—such as slightly contradictory parameter ranges—so that different sampling temperatures cause different sampled paths to resolve the ambiguity toward different tool argument values; the majority-vote result then reflects the attacker-preferred parameter without any single path appearing obviously malicious. 当所有 k 条采样路径都因受操纵的输入而收敛到危险工具时，置信度会很高。 When all k sampled paths converge on dangerous tools due to manipulated input, confidence is high. 通过质量加权投票产生的工具选择偏差利用了 RASC（Reward-Aware Self-Consistency，奖励感知自一致性）使用质量评分为投票赋权的机制。 Tool selection bias through quality-weighted voting exploits RASC (Reward-Aware Self-Consistency) using quality scores to weight votes. 攻击者操纵质量评估指标，提高选择危险工具的推理路径的评分。 Attackers manipulate quality assessment metrics elevating scores for reasoning paths selecting dangerous tools. 思考与观察攻击放大会产生 k 个观察注入点，使跨路径的系统性错误成为可能。 Thought-and-observation attack amplification creates k observation injection points enabling systematic errors across paths. [131, 132, 133, 134]. [131, 132, 133, 134].
RATC_14_3 - 分层与树形规划漏洞。 RATC_14_3 - Hierarchical and Tree-Based Planning Vulnerabilities. 分层任务网络（HTN）规划导致工具可见性碎片化，其中高层规划缺乏对工具的感知，而工具层执行缺乏战略上下文。 Hierarchical task network (HTN) planning creates tool visibility fragmentation where high-level planning lacks tool awareness and tool-level execution lacks strategic context. 多智能体层级结构将规划工作分散，使任何单个智能体都无法理解完整的工具依赖图。 Multi-agent hierarchies distribute planning where no single agent understands complete tool dependency graphs. 方法排序约束充当隐式的工具调用顺序策略，使针对工具序列的漏洞利用成为可能。 Method ordering constraints function as implicit tool sequencing policy enabling tool sequence exploitation. 资源约束构成隐式的访问控制边界；移除互斥约束会授予未经授权的工具访问权限。 Resource constraints form implicit access control boundaries; removing exclusive constraints grants unauthorized tool access. 前置条件绕过使方法能够在无效状态下被激活：攻击者将虚假的事实断言注入任务网络的工作记忆，例如在规划器评估方法之前，将 authorized(agent, admin_tool) 断言写入符号状态存储，使 HTN 规划器将起保护作用的前置条件视为已满足，并在没有合法授权的情况下激活该方法。 Precondition bypass enables method activation in invalid states: an attacker injects a false fact assertion into the task network’s working memory—for example, asserting authorized(agent, admin_tool) into the symbolic state store before the planner evaluates the method—causing the HTN planner to treat the guarding precondition as satisfied and activate the method without legitimate authorization. 算子效果规约可通过隐藏在操作语义中的隐式权限授予，实现隐蔽的权限提升：攻击者修改算子效果子句，将 (granted high_privilege ?agent) 作为低权限动作的副作用加入其中，导致每次将该动作纳入规划时都会发生权限提升，而规划系统不会将其标记为异常。 Operator effect specification enables covert privilege escalation through implicit privilege grants hidden in operational semantics: an attacker modifying operator effect clauses to include (granted high_privilege ?agent) as a side effect of a low-privilege action causes privilege escalation every time that action is planned, without the planning system flagging it as anomalous. [135, 136, 137]. [135, 136, 137].
III-A11 RATC_15 - 情景记忆与学习III-A11 RATC_15 - Episodic Memory and Learning
RATC_15_1 - 情景记忆与轨迹投毒。 RATC_15_1 - Episodic Memory and Trajectory Poisoning. 随动作记录一同存储的情景记录了哪些工具解决过类似问题。 Episodes stored with action records document which tools solved similar problems. 攻击者通过将恶意序列记录为“成功解决方案”来投毒情景，导致检索这些情景的智能体复现恶意操作链。 Attackers poison episodes recording malicious sequences as ”successful resolutions,” causing agents retrieving episodes to replicate malicious chains. 通过共享情景记忆进行的多智能体工具协调，使单个智能体遭入侵的影响能够以习得策略的形式传播，进而影响所有智能体。 Multi-agent tool coordination through shared episodic memory enables one agent’s compromise propagating as learned policy affecting all agents. 轨迹抽象将成功情景转换为程序化工作流；攻击者精心构造情景，使其中记录的序列被抽象为危险流程。 Trajectory abstraction converts successful episodes into procedural workflows; attackers engineer episodes recording sequences that abstract into dangerous procedures. [73, 138, 139]. [73, 138, 139].
III-A12 RATC_16 - 语义记忆与 RAGIII-A12 RATC_16 - Semantic Memory and RAG
RATC_16_1 - RAG 流水线与知识库投毒。 RATC_16_1 - RAG Pipeline and Knowledge Base Poisoning. 语义记忆检索获取文档，供智能体用作工具选择的上下文。 Semantic memory retrieval retrieves documents that agents use as context for tool selection. 攻击者通过对知识库投毒，在检索到的内容中嵌入工具调用指令。 Attackers poisoning knowledge bases embed tool-invocation instructions in retrieved content. 基于语义相似性误匹配的工具参数注入利用向量相似度匹配机制，攻击者据此构造相似度高且包含隐藏指令的文档。 Semantic similarity false positive tool parameter injection exploits vector similarity matching where attackers craft documents with high similarity containing hidden instructions. 知识图谱遍历路径利用通过对表示安全工具组合的关系投毒，使不安全的组合看起来像是推荐组合。 Knowledge graph traversal path exploitation poisons relationships showing safe tool combinations causing unsafe combinations appearing recommended. 证据伪造插入虚构证据，使智能体检索到这些证据并将其信任为授权依据。 Evidence fabrication inserts fabricated evidence that agents retrieve and trust as authorization. 查询重写指令注入在优化示例中嵌入指令，影响所有智能体的查询转换。 Query rewriting instruction injection embeds instructions in optimization examples affecting all agents’ transformations. 知识库陈旧会导致工具使用指导过时，使智能体检索到过时文档，并使用过时格式调用工具。 Knowledge base staleness creates outdated tool guidance where agents retrieve obsolete documentation invoking tools with obsolete formats. [79, 140]. [79, 140].
III-A13 RATC_17 - 效用函数与决策逻辑III-A13 RATC_17 - Utility Functions and Decision Logic
RATC_17_1 - 效用加权工具选择投毒。 RATC_17_1 - Utility-Weighted Tool Selection Poisoning. 期望效用计算漏洞利用结果假设注入，通过错误假设使智能体误算工具效用。 Expected utility calculation vulnerabilities exploit outcome assumption injection where false assumptions cause agents to miscalculate tool utility. 攻击者向智能体的共享记忆中注入一条伪造的工具结果记录，声称对于某类请求，高风险工具以往获得的奖励高于权限较低的替代工具；智能体的期望效用计算纳入这条记录，即使在更安全的替代工具适用的情境中，也会选择高风险工具。 An attacker injects a fabricated tool-outcome record into the agent’s shared memory asserting that a high-risk tool has historically returned higher reward than a lower-privilege alternative for a given request class; the agent’s expected utility calculation incorporates this record, selecting the high-risk tool even in contexts where the safer alternative is appropriate. 当中间智能体歪曲未来可用的选项时，就会发生序贯期望效用误算——例如，谎报低成本工具不可用，会迫使效用计算偏向成本更高且可能具有更高权限的后备工具。 Sequential expected utility miscalculation occurs when intermediate agents misrepresent available future options—for example, falsely reporting that a low-cost tool is unavailable forces the utility calculation to favor a more expensive and potentially more privileged fallback. 权衡权重操纵通过投毒影响用于平衡相互竞争目标的多目标效用函数：攻击者修改效率与安全性的相对权重，使智能体系统性地偏向以牺牲访问控制为代价来优化吞吐量的工具。 Trade-off weight manipulation poisons multi-objective utility functions balancing competing objectives: an attacker modifying the weight assigned to efficiency versus safety causes the agent to systematically favor tools that optimize throughput at the expense of access controls. [141, 142]. [141, 142].
III-A14 RATC_18 - 基于规则与知识工程的系统III-A14 RATC_18 - Rule-Based and Knowledge-Engineered Systems
RATC_18_1 - 基于规则的工具授权绕过。 RATC_18_1 - Rule-Based Tool Authorization Bypass. 具有特异性层级的基于规则的授权系统，使攻击者能够注入更具体的规则来覆盖安全规则。 Rule-based authorization systems with specificity hierarchies enable attackers injecting more-specific rules overriding safety rules. 前向链式推理规则链利用通过注入事实来触发规则链，最终获得工具授权。 Forward chaining rule chain exploitation enables injecting facts triggering chains resulting in tool authorization. 确定性因子操纵利用规则对高置信度事实的信任来绕过风险评估。 Certainty factor manipulation exploits how rules trust high-confidence facts bypassing risk assessment. 字典序启发式目标重排利用按顺序确定优先级的机制，通过规则注入重排目标，导致错误的工具选择。 Lexicographic heuristic objective reordering exploits sequential prioritization where rule injection reorders objectives causing wrong tool selections. [143, 62, 23, 144, 145]. [143, 62, 23, 144, 145].
III-A15 RATC_19 - 学习与强化学习III-A15 RATC_19 - Learning and Reinforcement Learning
RATC_19_1 - 强化学习工具选择投毒。 RATC_19_1 - Reinforcement Learning Tool Selection Poisoning. 习得工具选择策略劫持利用奖励投毒，攻击者通过奖励信号训练智能体选择恶意工具。 Learned tool selection policy hijacking exploits reward poisoning where attackers train agents selecting malicious tools through reward signals. Q 函数高估使危险的权限提升成为可能，其中 DQN（深度 Q 网络）的偏差被加以利用。 Q-Function overestimation enables dangerous escalation where DQN (Deep Q-Network) bias gets exploited. 采用共享经验回放缓冲区的多智能体 DQN，使遭投毒的状态转移能够影响所有智能体学得的 Q 值。 Multi-agent DQN with shared replay buffers enables poisoned transitions affecting all agents’ learned Q-values. 奖励塑形扭曲使代理目标发生反转：塑形奖励用于引导学习，而攻击者则反转其与目标之间的相关性。 Reward shaping perversion inverts proxy objectives where shaping rewards guide learning but attackers invert objective correlations. 课程学习投毒将恶意中间任务注入课程，使其看起来能够推进学习。 Curriculum learning poisoning injects malicious intermediate tasks into curricula appearing to progress learning. 模仿学习轨迹投毒会破坏专家示范。 Imitation learning trajectory poisoning corrupts expert demonstrations. 多智能体 RL 价值函数利用针对协同策略，使智能体学会包含策略层面 RCE 的协调策略。 Multi-agent RL value function exploitation exploits coordinated policies where agents learn coordination strategies encoding policy-level RCE. 演员—评论家架构中的跨智能体评论家投毒，通过遭投毒的评论家提供虚假的价值估计。 Actor-critic cross-agent critic poisoning provides false value estimates through poisoned critics. 近端策略优化信赖域操纵利用信赖域机制，使攻击者持续学得受到轻微投毒的策略，并最终收敛至危险吸引子。 Proximal policy optimization trust region manipulation exploits trust regions where attackers consistently learn slightly-poisoned policies converging to dangerous attractors. [73, 146]。 [73, 146].
当并发子查询从不一致的数据库状态中检索数据时，就会发生并行检索竞态。 Parallel retrieval races occur when concurrent sub-queries retrieve from inconsistent database states. 共享索引会引发去重竞态：多个智能体同时将文档标记为已查看，从而产生重复结果或错误去重。 Shared indexes cause deduplication races where agents simultaneously mark documents as seen, producing duplicates or incorrect deduplication. 超时触发的取消操作会在智能体之间级联传播，压垮共享连接池，并导致整个智能体集群的检索服务中断。 Timeout-triggered cancellations cascade across agents, overwhelming shared connection pools and causing fleet-wide retrieval outages. 多阶段缓存会造成时间不一致性：各阶段的 TTL 在不同时间到期，导致查询混合来自不同知识状态的结果。 Multi-stage caching creates temporal inconsistency: per-stage TTLs expire at different times, causing queries to mix results from different knowledge states. 在多智能体共享缓存时，网络传播延迟会导致集群中的智能体提供不一致的结果。 Multi-agent cache sharing with network propagation delays causes agents to serve inconsistent results across the fleet. 容器镜像仓库遭入侵所引发的容器供应链漏洞，可使攻击者在自动部署期间对整个集群实施投毒。 Container supply chain vulnerabilities through registry compromise enable fleet-wide poisoning during automated deployment. 集中式推理基础设施会形成单点故障，使授权绕过、缓存冲突和张量并行故障同时影响所有依赖该基础设施的智能体。 Centralized inference infrastructure creates single points of failure where authorization bypass, cache conflicts, and tensor parallelism failures affect all dependent agents simultaneously.
多阶段流水线缓存会产生竞态条件：各阶段的 TTL 独立到期，从而形成一些时间窗口，在这些窗口内，查询会返回混合了不同流水线阶段的新旧数据的不一致结果。 Multi-stage pipeline caching creates race conditions where each stage’s TTL expires independently, producing temporal windows where queries return inconsistent results mixing stale and fresh data from different pipeline stages. 基于事件的缓存失效机制会在智能体集群中依次传播，导致不同智能体提供来自不同知识状态的数据，这种情况每次可持续数分钟。 Event-based cache invalidation propagates sequentially across the agent fleet, causing agents to serve data from different knowledge states for minutes at a time. 共享缓存基础设施会造成写入竞态、哈希碰撞攻击面以及预热不一致问题；攻击者可构造发生哈希碰撞的查询，对缓存条目实施投毒并影响所有智能体，而预热不一致则意味着只有部分智能体能受益于预先预热的缓存。 Shared caching infrastructure creates write races, hash collision attack surfaces where adversaries craft colliding queries to poison cache entries affecting all agents, and warming inconsistency where only a subset of agents benefit from pre-warmed caches. 通过镜像仓库分发的集中式模型服务容器引入了供应链攻击途径——镜像仓库凭据泄露、拼写抢注、摘要碰撞绕过以及 GitOps 自动化均可使攻击者在整个集群中部署后门。 Centralized model serving containers distributed through registries introduce supply chain attack vectors—registry credential compromise, typosquatting, digest collision bypass, and GitOps automation enable fleet-wide backdoor deployment. 在内存隔离不足的情况下，多租户共置可被用于对 GPU 之间的张量并行通信实施投毒，破坏同步的激活值，从而影响所有前向传播。 Tensor parallelism communication between GPUs can be poisoned through multi-tenant collocation with insufficient memory isolation, corrupting synchronized activations affecting all forward passes. 性能剖析遥测会暴露整个集群的依赖关系图、缓存模式和成本明细，使攻击者能够针对价值最高的瓶颈实施定向 DoS 攻击和预算耗尽攻击。 Profiling telemetry exposes fleet-wide dependency maps, cache patterns, and cost breakdowns that enable targeted DoS and budget exhaustion attacks against the highest-value bottlenecks.
多实例 GPU（Multi-Instance GPU，MIG）可将 GPU 划分为最多七个硬件隔离的实例，每个实例均拥有专用的内存和计算资源。 Multi-Instance GPU (MIG) partitions GPUs into up to seven hardware-isolated instances with dedicated memory and compute. MIG 提供硬隔离：一个实例无法降低另一个实例的性能。 MIG provides hard isolation: one instance cannot degrade another’s performance. 然而，MIG 的逻辑隔离建立在共享的物理 GPU 硬件之上，因此会产生隐性依赖。 However, MIG logical isolation operates atop shared physical GPU hardware creating hidden dependencies. 例如，电源稳压器、热管理系统、PCIe 接口和 GPU 固件都是共享的。 For example, power regulators, thermal management, PCIe interface, GPU firmware are shared. 供电故障、热节流、PCIe 错误或固件挂起都会影响所有共置实例。 Power delivery failure, thermal throttling, PCIe error, or firmware hang affects all co-located instances. 即使采用了 MIG 分区，固件漏洞仍可能使跨分区内存访问成为可能，从而破坏整个集群的隔离。 Firmware vulnerabilities can enable cross-partition memory access that breaks isolation fleet-wide despite MIG partitioning. 共享的 GPU 驱动程序栈意味着，任何租户的 CUDA 操作所触发的单个驱动程序缺陷，都可能导致整个集群中断，同时影响所有客户。 The shared GPU driver stack means a single driver bug triggered by any tenant’s CUDA operation can cause fleet-wide outage affecting all customers simultaneously.
生产环境中的多智能体工作流采用共享状态协调机制，由智能体跟踪进度。 Production multi-agent workflows implement shared state coordination where agents track progress. 并发访问需要采用乐观锁：每次修改时递增版本号，写入操作则验证当前版本是否与预期版本一致。 Concurrent access requires optimistic locking: version numbers increment on modification, write operations validate current version matches expected version. 发生冲突时，系统会抛出异常，以防止数据损坏。 On conflict, systems raise exceptions preventing data corruption. 然而，高并发会造成系统性的版本冲突：许多智能体读取同一版本的数据，独立执行任务，随后竞争写入，而只有第一个写入者能够成功。 However, high concurrency creates systematic version conflicts where many agents read at same version, work independently, then race to write with only first writer succeeding.
并发工作流会引发重试风暴，加剧争用而非消除争用；写入延迟会延长版本存续期，增加陈旧读取，而更多的陈旧读取又会引发进一步的冲突，形成正反馈循环。 Concurrent workflows generate retry storms that intensify contention rather than resolving it, delayed writes extend version epochs increasing stale reads, and more stale reads generate further conflicts in a positive feedback loop. 冲突概率随并发度呈二次增长，而有针对性的突发碰撞可耗尽重试预算，导致工作流在完成前失败。 Conflict probability scales quadratically with concurrency, and targeted collision bursts can exhaust retry budgets causing workflows to fail without completing.
护栏验证基础设施需要 GPU 推理时间、个人身份信息（PII）检测和策略规则评估，并须在超时阈值内完成验证，以防止验证无限期阻塞响应交付。 Guardrails validation infrastructure requires GPU inference time, PII detection, and policy rule evaluation under timeout thresholds that prevent validation from blocking response delivery indefinitely. 攻击者诱发的处理延迟一旦超过超时阈值，就会导致响应绕过安全检查。 Adversary-induced processing delays exceeding the timeout cause responses to bypass safety checks. 当智能体回退到交付未经验证的响应时，通过网络洪泛、资源耗尽或针对集中式验证端点的拒绝服务来使服务不可用的攻击，会导致整个智能体集群绕过护栏。 Service unavailability attacks—through network flooding, resource exhaustion, or denial-of-service against centralized validation endpoints—cause fleet-wide guardrail bypass when agents fall back to delivering unvalidated responses.
III-B 通过大上下文、日志和概率性回忆形成的新数据泄露渠道III-B New data-leakage channels via large contexts, logs, and probabilistic recall
在受模式约束的传统系统中，数据流更容易受到限制。 In traditional, schema-constrained systems, data flows are easier to restrict. 在智能体系统中，自由形式文本承载着业务逻辑、秘密信息和推理过程，并经常在组件与日志之间复制，从而增加了泄露路径的数量，也使这些路径更加隐蔽。 With agents, free-form text encodes business logic, secrets, and deliberations, routinely copied between components and logs, expanding both the number and subtlety of leakage paths.
III-B1 RDL_1 - UI/UX 模式III-B1 RDL_1 - UI/UX Patterns
RDL_1_1 - 聊天界面对话历史作为持久性敏感数据存储库。 RDL_1_1 - Chat Interface Conversation History as Persistent Sensitive Data Repository. 显示对话历史的聊天界面会形成持久保存的敏感信息库，涵盖用户的整个会话，但 UI 设计很少考虑其固有的数据泄露风险。 Chat interfaces displaying conversation history create persistent repositories of sensitive information spanning entire user sessions, but UI design rarely accounts for the inherent data leakage risks. 多智能体系统显著放大了这一问题——对话历史会累积来自多个专用智能体的数据，其中，身份验证智能体在故障排查过程中记录凭据，数据库智能体记录包含个人身份信息（PII）的查询结果，文件智能体则记录包含商业秘密的文档内容。 Multi-agent systems amplify this significantly—conversation histories accumulate data from multiple specialized agents where authentication agents log credentials during troubleshooting, database agents log query results with PII, and file agents log document contents with trade secrets. 每条消息都会保留在聊天界面可滚动的历史记录中，可能通过截图、屏幕共享、肩窥或遭入侵的会话存储而泄露。 Each message remains in the chat interface’s scrollable history where it can be exposed through screenshots, screen sharing, shoulder surfing, or compromised session storage. 传统应用程序在专门的安全视图中显示敏感数据，而聊天界面将敏感数据穿插在普通对话交流中呈现，从而降低了用户对信息敏感性的感知和安全警惕性。 Unlike traditional applications where sensitive data appears in dedicated secure views, chat interfaces present sensitive data interspersed with benign conversational exchanges, reducing users’ perception of sensitivity and security vigilance. 多智能体聊天历史会在单个对话线程中汇集来自不同来源的敏感数据——身份验证令牌、客户 PII、财务数据和专有算法——形成集成之前并不存在的高价值攻击目标。 Multi-agent chat histories create high-value targets aggregating sensitive data from diverse sources—authentication tokens, customer PII, financial data, and proprietary algorithms in single thread—that didn’t exist before integration. [147, 148, 149, 150]. [147, 148, 149, 150].
RDL_1_2 - 渐进式披露的技术视图作为机密信息暴露途径。 RDL_1_2 - Progressive Disclosure Technical Views as Secret Exposure Vectors. 将技术细节隐藏在可展开的“调试视图”中的渐进式披露模式，会造成危险的虚假安全感：开发者认为敏感信息在“默认隐藏”时就受到了保护，但展开后的视图却经常暴露机密信息、令牌、凭据和系统内部细节。 Progressive disclosure patterns hiding technical details in expandable ”debug views” create dangerous false security where developers believe sensitive information is protected when ”hidden by default,” but expanded views regularly expose secrets, tokens, credentials, and system internals. 多智能体系统会汇集来自多个智能体的调试信息，包括用于智能体间通信的身份验证令牌、来自数据访问智能体的数据库连接字符串、来自集成智能体的 API 密钥，以及会暴露架构漏洞的系统内部路径。 Multi-agent systems aggregate debugging information from multiple agents including authentication tokens for inter-agent communication, database connection strings from data access agents, API keys from integration agents, and internal system paths revealing architecture vulnerabilities. “使技术细节易于发现”这一 UI 设计原则，与尽量缩小暴露面的安全原则直接冲突。 The UI design principle of ”make technical details discoverable” directly conflicts with security principles of minimizing exposure surface. 渐进式披露鼓励以“提高透明度”为由暴露所有信息，却不实施访问控制或信息遮蔽策略。 Progressive disclosure encourages exposing everything ”for transparency” without implementing access controls or redaction policies. 多智能体架构加剧了这一漏洞，因为技术视图会显示跨智能体通信的细节，在 UI 元素中暴露整个分布式系统的安全态势。 Multi-agent architectures exacerbate this vulnerability because technical views display cross-agent communication details exposing the entire distributed system’s security posture in UI elements. 单智能体系统的技术视图只会揭示一个组件的内部细节，而多智能体调试信息的披露则会形成包含凭据的完整架构图，使展开后的视图成为可能导致整个系统全面失陷的单点故障。 Unlike singular agent systems where technical views reveal one component’s internals, multi-agent debug disclosure creates complete architectural maps with credentials, making expanded views a single point of failure for comprehensive system compromise. [151, 152, 153, 154]. [151, 152, 153, 154].
RDL_1_3 - 上下文感知功能中的会话持久化跨越安全边界。 RDL_1_3 - Context Awareness Session Persistence Across Security Boundaries. 上下文感知功能会在页面重新加载、浏览器重启或设备更换后保留会话；当来自高安全级别环境的敏感信息通过会话恢复功能在较低安全级别环境中仍可访问时，就会产生数据泄露风险。 Context awareness features persisting sessions across page reloads, browser restarts, or device changes create data leakage risks when sensitive information from high-security contexts remains accessible in lower-security contexts through session restoration. 多智能体系统存储的持久化会话包含所有参与智能体汇集的上下文——安全智能体的审计日志、人力资源智能体的人事记录、财务智能体的交易明细——在统一的会话存储中跨越了安全分级边界。 Multi-agent systems store persisted sessions containing aggregated context from all participating agents—security agent audit logs, HR agent personnel records, finance agent transaction details—crossing security classification boundaries in unified session storage. “欢迎回来！ The ”Welcome back! 继续上次会话”这一模式存在安全隐患：用户在安全工作站上讨论敏感话题后，可能稍后在个人设备、共享计算机或公共网络上恢复会话，而持久保存的上下文可能在这些环境中被截获。 Resume your last session” pattern becomes vulnerable when users who discussed sensitive topics on secure workstations later resume sessions on personal devices, shared computers, or public networks where persisted context can be intercepted. 多智能体会话持久化会以其特有的方式放大风险，因为各智能体会向同一会话提供不同敏感级别的信息——用户可能从低安全级别环境开始，转入高安全级别环境，然后再返回低安全级别环境，而持久化会话会在这些转换过程中保留所有数据。 Multi-agent session persistence uniquely amplifies risk because agents contribute different sensitivity levels to the same session—users may initiate in low-security contexts, escalate to high-security contexts, then return to low-security contexts with persisted session retaining all data across transitions. 传统应用程序为不同数据类型维护各自独立的安全上下文，但多智能体对话持久化会形成混合不同安全级别的统一会话状态，只要其中任何部分变得可访问，就可能导致泄露。 Traditional applications maintain separate security contexts for different data types, but multi-agent conversation persistence creates unified session state mixing security levels, enabling leakage when any part becomes accessible. [46, 35, 155, 156, 157]. [46, 35, 155, 156, 157].
RDL_1_4 - 命令面板的最近历史记录作为敏感操作日志。 RDL_1_4 - Command Palette Recent History as Sensitive Operation Log. 显示最近执行命令的命令面板模式，会生成用户敏感操作的日志，并将其持久保存在 UI 内存、浏览器存储和命令面板建议数据库中。 Command palette patterns displaying recently executed commands create logs of sensitive user operations persisting in UI memory, browser storage, and palette suggestion databases. 多智能体系统会揭示用户跨多个智能体的行为模式，显示诸如“导出财务数据”“查询客户 PII”“访问机密文档”“修改访问控制”等操作序列，使攻破命令面板存储的攻击者能够获得详细画像，了解用户经常执行哪些敏感操作。 Multi-agent systems reveal patterns of user behavior across multiple agents showing sequences like ”Export Financial Data,” ”Query Customer PII,” ”Access Confidential Documents,” ”Modify Access Controls,” providing attackers who compromise palette storage with detailed profiles of what sensitive operations users perform regularly. “从用户行为模式中学习以推荐相关命令”这一 UI 设计目标与隐私原则直接冲突——命令面板学习用户行为的效果越好，累积的敏感信息就越多。 The UI design goal of ”learn from user patterns to suggest relevant commands” directly conflicts with privacy principles—the more effectively the palette learns user behavior, the more sensitive information it accumulates. 多智能体命令面板会生成尤其丰富的日志，因为它们记录了所有集成智能体的命令，不仅展示用户做了什么，还展示跨智能体的操作序列——访问人力资源数据库，随后访问财务数据库，再发送电子邮件——这些序列可能表明潜在的内部威胁模式。 Multi-agent command palettes create particularly rich logs because they record commands across all integrated agents, showing not just what users did but cross-agent operation sequences—accessed HR database, then finance database, then sent email—indicating potential insider threat patterns. 与仅揭示某一工具使用情况的应用专属历史记录不同，多智能体命令面板记录了用户在整个生态系统中的全面行为，包括揭示高层意图的操作序列。 Unlike application-specific histories revealing one tool’s usage, multi-agent palettes document comprehensive user behavior across entire ecosystems including sequences revealing high-level intent. [158, 159, 160, 161]. [158, 159, 160, 161].
RDL_1_5 - 多智能体仪表板的聚合上下文显示。 RDL_1_5 - Multi-Agent Dashboard Aggregated Context Display. 多智能体仪表板用户界面同时显示多个智能体的聚合状态、输出和推理，形成全面视图，从而暴露原本应保持隔离的敏感数据源之间的关联。 Multi-agent dashboard UIs displaying aggregated status, outputs, and reasoning from multiple agents simultaneously create comprehensive views exposing correlations between sensitive data sources intended to remain compartmentalized. 仪表板可能同时显示来自 CRM 智能体的客户数据、来自会计智能体的财务预测、来自人力资源智能体的员工信息，以及来自监控智能体的安全警报——这些数据之间的关联可能揭示商业情报或侵犯隐私。 Dashboards might simultaneously show customer data from CRM agent, financial projections from accounting agent, employee information from HR agent, and security alerts from monitoring agent—correlations revealing business intelligence or privacy violations. 当仪表板视图将组织政策、监管要求或安全架构规定应保持分离的信息组合在一起时，“为监督提供全面可见性”的目标就会转变为数据聚合漏洞。 The ”comprehensive visibility for oversight” goal becomes data aggregation vulnerability when dashboard views combine information organizational policy, regulatory requirements, or security architecture intend kept separated. 多智能体仪表板会产生特有的关联风险，因为它们呈现的数据来自在不同安全上下文中运行、采用不同访问控制并服务于不同利益相关方群体的智能体，而仪表板却将所有视角整合到一个可供仪表板用户访问的视图中。 Multi-agent dashboards uniquely create correlation risks because they present data from agents operating in different security contexts with different access controls serving different stakeholder groups—yet dashboards unify all perspectives in single view accessible to dashboard users. 与仅呈现有限视角的单智能体界面或提供基于角色的视图的传统应用不同，多智能体仪表板跨越安全边界聚合完整的系统状态，使用户和攻击者能够通过跨领域关联推导出任何单个智能体或数据源单独都无法揭示的敏感信息。 Unlike singular agent interfaces showing limited perspective or traditional applications with role-based views, multi-agent dashboards aggregate complete system state across security boundaries, enabling users and attackers to derive sensitive insights from cross-domain correlation that no individual agent or data source would reveal in isolation. [162, 163]. [162, 163].
RDL_1_6 - 上下文引用链接造成的间接信息泄露。 RDL_1_6 - Context Reference Links as Indirect Information Disclosure. 上下文感知功能会创建可点击的引用链接，将当前回复与先前上下文连接起来，并通过揭示讨论主题、讨论时间及其相互关系，间接暴露敏感信息。 Context awareness features creating clickable reference links connecting current responses to earlier context expose sensitive information indirectly by revealing discussion topics, when discussed, and relationships. 多智能体引用链接构成跨智能体的信息流图，揭示本应保密的组织结构、决策过程和数据关系。 Multi-agent reference links create information flow graphs across agents revealing organizational structures, decision-making processes, and data relationships that should remain confidential. 能够访问对话的攻击者即使在个别消息已被部分遮蔽的情况下，也可以通过追踪引用链接重建敏感的业务上下文——链接结构本身就会揭示关联，展示信息在整个组织内如何相互联系。 Attackers with conversation access can reconstruct sensitive business context by following reference links even if individual messages are partially redacted—link structure itself reveals correlations showing how information relates across the organization. 多智能体上下文引用图会放大这一风险，因为它们跨越多个智能体的上下文，不仅暴露单个智能体掌握的知识，还暴露贯穿整个多智能体系统的信息流。 Multi-agent context reference graphs amplify this risk because they span multiple agents’ contexts exposing not just one agent’s knowledge but information flows through entire multi-agent system. 与局限于单个智能体对话线程内的引用不同，多智能体引用链接会形成跨智能体的信息轨迹，并持久保留在用户界面元素、浏览器历史记录和会话日志中，即使直接内容受到保护，也会向攻击者提供揭示敏感关系的元数据。 Unlike singular references staying within one agent’s thread, multi-agent reference links create cross-agent information trails persisting in UI elements, browser history, and session logs, providing attackers with metadata revealing sensitive relationships even when direct content is protected. [46, 157, 35, 155, 156]. [46, 157, 35, 155, 156].
RDL_1_8 - 审批工作流审计轨迹作为全面的行为日志。 RDL_1_8 - Approval Workflow Audit Trails as Comprehensive Behavior Logs. 审批工作流用户界面为满足合规要求而维护详细的审计轨迹，记录每一项决策请求、审查过的证据、计算出的置信度分数以及人工审核意见——这些全面的记录会成为旨在窃取数据的攻击者眼中的高价值侦察目标。 Approval workflow UIs maintaining detailed audit trails for compliance capture every decision request, evidence examined, confidence score calculated, and human review comment—comprehensive records becoming high-value reconnaissance targets for data exfiltration. 多智能体审批工作流聚合来自多个智能体的敏感业务逻辑，通过审批推理揭示定价算法，通过风险评估揭示欺诈检测模式，并通过政策评估揭示监管边界情形，实际上将整个组织的决策过程记录在可查询的日志数据库中。 Multi-agent approval workflows aggregate sensitive business logic from multiple agents revealing pricing algorithms through approval reasoning, fraud detection patterns through risk assessments, and regulatory edge cases through policy evaluations, effectively documenting entire organizational decision-making in queryable log databases. “完全透明且可审计”的要求与尽量减少敏感数据的日志记录直接冲突。 The ”full transparency and auditability” requirement directly conflicts with minimizing logged sensitive data. 多智能体审批工作流会生成尤其危险的审计轨迹，记录智能体之间的推理交流，使成功侵入日志的攻击者能够获得组织如何评估决策的完整蓝图，其中包括决策逻辑中的边界情形和漏洞。 Multi-agent approval workflows create particularly dangerous audit trails capturing inter-agent reasoning exchanges providing attackers who compromise logs with complete blueprints of how organizations evaluate decisions, including edge cases and vulnerabilities in decision logic. 与审计日志仅记录单个智能体推理的单智能体系统不同，多智能体审批轨迹记录了整个分布式决策架构，使其成为策划社会工程、欺诈或利用监管漏洞实施攻击的对手的全面情报来源。 Unlike singular agent systems where audit logs capture one agent’s reasoning, multi-agent approval trails document entire distributed decision-making architecture, making them comprehensive intelligence sources for adversaries planning social engineering, fraud, or regulatory exploitation attacks. [164, 165, 166, 167, 168, 169, 170, 171, 172, 173, 174, 175]. [164, 165, 166, 167, 168, 169, 170, 171, 172, 173, 174, 175].
RDL_1_9 - 审批工作流中的支持性证据链接作为数据聚合点。 RDL_1_9 - Approval Workflow Supporting Evidence Links as Data Aggregation Points. 审批工作流用户界面通过提供指向支持性证据的直接链接，形成集中的数据聚合点；这些证据链接使人能够访问敏感的原始材料，而这些材料可能比审批决策本身更加敏感。 Approval workflow UIs providing direct links to supporting evidence create concentrated data aggregation points where evidence links provide access to sensitive source materials potentially more sensitive than approval decision itself. 多智能体工作流汇集由不同智能体访问、跨越多个安全域的各类后端系统中的证据，但不一定实施一致的访问控制。 Multi-agent workflows aggregate evidence from diverse backend systems accessed by different agents spanning multiple security domains without necessarily applying consistent access controls. 审核审批请求的用户可能通过点击证据链接，访问其角色本不应获准访问的原始数据——审批工作流由此形成绕过常规控制的间接访问路径。 Users reviewing approvals might click evidence links gaining access to raw data their roles shouldn’t permit—approval workflows create indirect access paths bypassing normal controls. 多智能体审批工作流的独特之处在于，它会汇集来自不同安全域的证据，可能将公开数据、内部机密数据以及访问受到严格限制的监管相关链接混合在一起，而各项访问控制的可见性并不一致。 Multi-agent approval workflows uniquely aggregate evidence from diverse security domains potentially mixing public data, internal confidential data, and highly restricted regulatory links without consistent access control visibility. 单智能体系统的证据来自单一来源，且控制措施一致；与之不同，多智能体聚合会产生复杂的权限情形，使敏感性评估变得困难，并成为非预期的数据访问入口，提供超出预期范围的可见性。 Unlike singular agent systems with evidence from one source and consistent controls, multi-agent aggregation creates complex permission scenarios making sensitivity assessment difficult, becoming unintended data access portals granting broader visibility than intended. [176, 177, 178, 179, 180, 181, 182, 183, 184, 185, 186, 148]。 [176, 177, 178, 179, 180, 181, 182, 183, 184, 185, 186, 148].
