RDL_1_10 - 交互式优化迭代历史导致决策逻辑泄露。 RDL_1_10 - Interactive Refinement Iteration History as Decision Logic Disclosure. 支持通过多轮迭代进行交互式优化的协作模式，会产生详细的历史记录，暴露智能体的决策过程和用户的优化逻辑。 Collaborative patterns supporting interactive refinement through multiple iterations create detailed histories exposing both agent decision-making and user refinement logic. 用户请求草稿、提出批评意见，智能体进行修订，用户再进一步优化，这一过程形成完整的迭代历史。 Users requesting drafts, critiquing, agents revising, users refining further creates complete iteration histories. 多智能体优化涉及多个智能体，其中 Draft Agent 创建初始输出，Review Agent 提出改进建议，Refinement Agent 整合反馈，Quality Agent 验证最终版本。 Multi-agent refinements involve multiple agents where Draft Agent creates initial output, Review Agent suggests improvements, Refinement Agent incorporates feedback, Quality Agent validates final version. 完整的迭代历史揭示了每个智能体如何评估质量、哪些模式会触发修订，以及确定最终版本的标准。 Complete iteration histories reveal how each agent evaluates quality, what patterns trigger revisions, and finalization criteria. 攻击者通过分析历史记录来逆向推导决策逻辑，从而能够构造操纵迭代行为的输入，实施对抗性攻击。 Attackers analyzing histories reverse-engineer decision logic enabling adversarial attacks crafting inputs manipulating iteration behavior. 多智能体优化会暴露智能体之间的协商过程，呈现 Review Agent 对草稿的评估、Refinement Agent 的优先级排序以及 Quality Agent 的阈值——这些全面的行为画像使攻击者能够实施复杂攻击，利用决策边界，或通过精心构造的迭代请求绕过质量关卡。 Multi-agent refinement exposes inter-agent negotiation showing Draft evaluation by Review Agent, Refinement prioritization, and Quality thresholds—comprehensive behavioral profiles enabling sophisticated attacks exploiting decision boundaries or bypassing quality gates through crafted iterative requests. [39, 187, 188, 46, 189]。 [39, 187, 188, 46, 189].
RDL_1_11 - 通过替代文本和 ARIA 标签暴露敏感数据。 RDL_1_11 - Sensitive Data Exposure Through Alt Text and ARIA Labels. 支持屏幕阅读器的无障碍功能会无意中暴露可通过抓取提取的敏感数据。 Accessibility features supporting screen readers inadvertently expose sensitive data extractable via scraping. DOM（文档对象模型）中的替代文本和 ARIA（无障碍富互联网应用）内容很容易被提取，而展示敏感情报的图像可能包含未经授权的用户无法看到的详细描述。 Alt text and ARIA (Accessible Rich Internet Applications) content in DOM (Document Object Model) are easily extracted where images displaying sensitive intelligence contain detailed descriptions invisible to unauthorized users. 攻击者会利用以下情况：脱敏数据的 ARIA 标签为屏幕阅读器包含完整的未脱敏值，折叠区域通过描述性的 aria-describedby 泄露信息，以及自动化工具提取所有属性以绕过视觉层面的控制。 Attackers exploit where ARIA labels for masked data contain full unmasked values for screen readers, collapsed sections have descriptive aria-describedby revealing information, and automated tools extract all attributes bypassing visual controls. 多智能体环境会放大这一问题，因为一个智能体的无障碍输出会成为另一个智能体的输入——为无障碍访问生成的替代文本在被下游使用时可能暴露细节。 Multi-agent contexts amplify because one agent’s accessible output becomes another’s input—alt text generated for accessibility may expose details when consumed downstream. 财务智能体展示带有符合 WCAG（Web 内容无障碍指南）要求的替代文本的图表，但竞争对手会提取其中包含的精确收入、业务分部和增长数据，而 ARIA 标签则会泄露已脱敏的客户电子邮箱地址和账号。 Financial agents display charts with WCAG (Web Content Accessibility Guidelines) alt text, but competitors extract containing precise revenue, segments, and growth while ARIA labels reveal masked customer email and account numbers. 缓解措施包括：对替代文本实施访问控制，根据授权情况生成描述；实施一致的脱敏处理，对 ARIA 内容应用与可见内容相同的保护措施；进行敏感性分类标记，绝不在非必要的替代文本中包含 PII；在替代描述中使用指向可下载数据的结构性引用；以及记录 ARIA 审计日志，标记批量提取行为。 Mitigation requires access-controlled alt text generating descriptions based on authorization, consistent masking applying same protections to ARIA as visible content, sensitivity classification tagging never including PII in non-essential alt text, alternative descriptions using structural references to downloadable data, and ARIA audit logging flagging bulk extraction. [190, 191, 192, 193, 194]。 [190, 191, 192, 193, 194].
III-B2 RDL_2 - 数据持久化与缓存III-B2 RDL_2 - Data Persistence and Caching
RDL_2_1 - 会话持久化序列化导致结构化数据外泄。 RDL_2_1 - Session Persistence Serialization as Structured Data Exfiltration. 用于保持上下文感知的会话持久化机制将非结构化对话转换为结构化、可查询的格式，使敏感数据能够被高效提取。 Context awareness session persistence converting unstructured conversation into structured queryable formats enables efficient sensitive data extraction. 多智能体的序列化会话包含所有智能体交互、决策、数据访问和推理轨迹的结构化表示，其中包括时间戳、标识符、置信度分数和数据沿袭关系等元数据；这些元数据不在 UI 中显示，但会被记录以供恢复。 Multi-agent serialized sessions contain structured representations of all agent interactions, decisions, data accesses, and reasoning traces including metadata like timestamps, identifiers, confidence scores, and lineage not appearing in UI but captured for restoration. 攻陷会话存储数据库的攻击者能够使用结构化查询，从数千个会话中高效提取数据（”SELECT all sessions WHERE finance_agent_accessed AND customer_pii_present AND confidence_score ¡ 0.7”）——对非结构化日志而言，这种做法并不现实。 Attackers compromising session storage databases efficiently extract using structured queries across thousands of sessions (”SELECT all sessions WHERE finance_agent_accessed AND customer_pii_present AND confidence_score ¡ 0.7”)—impractical against unstructured logs. 多智能体序列化以可查询的格式创建丰富的结构化数据集，其中包括智能体间通信的元数据和跨域关系，使大规模发现敏感数据成为可能。 Multi-agent serialization creates rich structured datasets including inter-agent communication metadata and cross-domain relationships in queryable formats enabling large-scale sensitive data discovery. 与归属明确的单智能体会话或传统的特定任务存储不同，多智能体持久化会创建全面的快照，其中包括智能体内部协商、被否决的推理分支和带有概率的备选方案，将对话历史从文本日志转变为可查询的数据库，使大规模数据外泄行动成为可能。 Unlike singular agent sessions with clear ownership or traditional task-specific storage, multi-agent persistence creates comprehensive snapshots including internal agent negotiations, rejected reasoning branches, and probabilistic alternatives, transforming conversation history from text logs into queryable databases enabling large-scale exfiltration operations. [195, 196, 197, 198]。 [195, 196, 197, 198].
RDL_2_2 - 缓存响应在会话生命周期结束后仍保留敏感数据。 RDL_2_2 - Cached Responses Persisting Sensitive Data Beyond Session Lifetime. 为加快重复访问而缓存智能体响应的性能优化模式，会在浏览器缓存、CDN 边缘服务器和应用层中创建敏感数据的持久副本，这些副本在原始会话结束后仍然存在，却没有同等的访问控制。 Performance optimization patterns caching agent responses for faster repeated access create persistent sensitive data copies in browser caches, CDN edge servers, and application layers outliving original sessions without equivalent access controls. 多智能体缓存响应将来自多个智能体的数据——身份验证令牌、客户个人身份信息（PII）、财务预测、专有算法——聚合到单一的复合响应中。 Multi-agent cached responses aggregate data from multiple agents—authentication tokens, customer PII, financial projections, proprietary algorithms in single composites. 这些缓存的保留时间超出预期，形成数据泄露窗口，使敏感信息在会话结束、用户退出登录或权限发生变化后仍可被访问。 These caches persist longer than intended creating data leakage windows where sensitive information remains accessible after sessions end, users logout, or permissions change. 多智能体缓存会带来独特风险，因为缓存键必须标识智能体组合，而了解缓存键构造方案的攻击者可在缓存隔离不完善时，检索先前用户会话中缓存的敏感数据。 Multi-agent caching creates unique risks because cache keys must identify agent combinations and attackers understanding schemes retrieve cached sensitive data from previous users’ sessions if cache isolation imperfect. 与缓存归属明确的单智能体系统不同，多智能体复合响应的缓存需要了解所有参与智能体的安全要求——这种复杂性往往导致对高敏感度输出采用过于宽松的缓存策略，而这些输出本不应被缓存。 Unlike singular agent systems with clear cache ownership, multi-agent composite response caching requires understanding all contributing agents’ security requirements—complexity often resulting in overly permissive caching for high-sensitivity outputs that should never be cached. [199, 123, 124, 200, 201]. [199, 123, 124, 200, 201].
RDL_2_3 - 撤销功能保留已删除的敏感数据。 RDL_2_3 - Undo Functionality Preserving Deleted Sensitive Data. 提供“撤销”功能的用户控制模式会保留已删除数据的副本以便恢复，但撤销缓冲区会持续保存用户和智能体认为已被移除的敏感信息。 User control patterns providing ”Undo” functionality maintain copies of deleted data enabling recovery, but undo buffers persist sensitive information users and agents believe removed. 用于逆转多个智能体所执行操作的多智能体撤销操作，会产生临时状态：敏感数据存在于多个系统的撤销缓冲区中，但在用户界面（UI）上显示为已删除。 Multi-agent undo operations reversing actions across multiple agents create temporary states where sensitive data exists in undo buffers across multiple systems appearing deleted in UI. 用户删除敏感信息并看到“删除成功”时，可能并未意识到“撤销删除”需要保留可恢复的数据，这可能违反数据最小化原则或相关法规——GDPR 的“被遗忘权”与为支持撤销而保留数据的做法存在冲突。 Users deleting sensitive information seeing ”Successfully deleted” may not realize ”Undo Delete” requires maintaining recoverable data potentially violating data minimization principles or regulations—GDPR’s ”right to be forgotten” conflicts with undo preservation. 多智能体分布式撤销使确保各智能体之间的安全措施和保留策略一致，以及同步清空缓冲区变得复杂，往往导致缓冲区的保留时间比主数据更长，或其安全防护弱于主数据。 Multi-agent distributed undo creates complexity ensuring consistent security, retention policies, and synchronized clearing across agents often resulting in buffers persisting longer or with weaker security than primary data. 与仅管理一份状态历史的单系统撤销不同，分布式撤销会形成复杂的数据沿袭关系，使“已删除”的信息在多个系统的恢复缓冲区之间传播，造成非预期的数据持久保留和合规风险。 Unlike singular undo managing one state history, distributed undo creates complex data lineage where ”deleted” information propagates through multiple systems’ recovery buffers creating unintended data persistence and compliance risks. [202, 203, 204, 205, 206]. [202, 203, 204, 205, 206].
III-B3 RDL_3 - 流式传输与词元级泄露III-B3 RDL_3 - Streaming and Token-Level Leakage
RDL_3_1 - 流式响应中的逐词元数据泄露。 RDL_3_1 - Streaming Response Token-by-Token Data Leakage. 流式响应模式会随着智能体生成输出而逐步显示内容，这会带来细粒度的数据泄露机会：在智能体执行后处理脱敏之前，敏感信息就已逐词元出现在 UI 缓冲区、网络流和中间存储中。 Streaming response patterns displaying agent output progressively as it generates create fine-grained data leakage opportunities where sensitive information appears token-by-token in UI buffers, network streams, and intermediate storage before agents apply post-processing redaction. 多智能体流式交接会形成多个暴露点，使敏感数据在安全控制生效之前出现在未受保护的缓冲区中——Agent A 将发现结果流式传输给 Agent B，后者将分析结果流式传输给 Agent C，再由 Agent C 将最终报告流式传输给用户。 Multi-agent streaming handoffs create multiple points where sensitive data appears in unprotected buffers before security controls activate—Agent A streams findings to Agent B, which streams analysis to Agent C, which streams final report to user. UI 所带来的“降低感知延迟”的好处，是以在智能体充分分析数据是否应当共享之前就将其暴露为代价的。 The UI benefit of ”reduced perceived latency” comes at cost of exposing data before agents fully analyze whether it should be shared. 模型可能开始流式输出机密信息，在生成过程中意识到其敏感性并尝试脱敏，但早期词元已经出现在 UI 元素、浏览器内存、网络日志和屏幕录像中。 Models may begin streaming confidential information, realize mid-generation it’s sensitive, and attempt redaction, but early tokens already appear in UI elements, browser memory, network logs, and screen recordings. 多智能体架构会放大这一风险，因为每条智能体间的传输流都会产生新的暴露窗口，而且下游智能体可能直到敏感内容已处于传输途中，才知道上游智能体正在流式传输这些内容，从而无法提前脱敏。 Multi-agent architectures amplify this risk because each agent-to-agent stream creates new exposure windows, and downstream agents may not know upstream agents are streaming sensitive content until already in transit, making proactive redaction impossible. [207, 124, 208, 209]. [207, 124, 208, 209].
RDL_3_3 - 流式传输中的词元化使上下文窗口推断攻击成为可能。 RDL_3_3 - Streaming Tokenization Enabling Context Window Inference Attacks. 流式传输会揭示内容的词元化方式（词元边界、特殊词元、嵌入维度），使针对上下文窗口的推断攻击成为可能。 Streaming reveals how content is tokenized (token boundaries, special tokens, embedding dimensions) enabling inference attacks on context windows. 在多智能体系统中，攻击者可通过观察多个智能体的流式传输模式，推断上下文窗口大小、词元分配和信息优先级。 In multi-agent systems, attackers observing streaming patterns from multiple agents can infer context window sizes, token allocations, and information prioritization. 具有大上下文窗口的智能体与具有小上下文窗口的智能体在流式传输中暴露的信息有所不同，使攻击者能够通过流式传输模式刻画智能体的能力。 Large-context agents with streaming reveal differently than small-context agents, enabling attackers to map agent capabilities through streaming patterns. 这种有关系统架构的数据泄露是流式传输所特有的——批量执行不会暴露词元化模式。 This data leakage about system architecture is unique to streaming—batch execution doesn’t reveal tokenization patterns. 来自不同智能体的多智能体流式传输形成了攻击面，使攻击者能够通过观察词元边界全面刻画系统。 Multi-agent streaming from diverse agents creates attack surface for comprehensive system mapping through token boundary observation. [210, 211, 212, 213]. [210, 211, 212, 213].
RDL_3_4 - 利用流式输出长度的相关性重建会话。 RDL_3_4 - Streaming Output Length Correlation for Session Reconstruction. 流式输出长度与内容敏感性相关——很长的输出流表明进行了复杂分析，很短的输出流则表明出现错误状态或输出了摘要。 Streaming output lengths correlate with content sensitivity—very long streams indicate complex analysis, very short streams indicate error states or summary outputs. 在多智能体系统中，攻击者无需观察实际内容，仅通过观察不同会话中的流式输出长度，就能重建活动模式。 In multi-agent systems, attackers observing streaming lengths across sessions can reconstruct activity patterns without observing actual content. 安全智能体的长输出流 + 业务智能体的短输出流 + 执行智能体的中等长度输出流，可用于推断决策类型。 Long stream from security agent + short stream from business agent + medium stream from execution agent enables inference about decision types. 多智能体流式传输的元数据（而非内容）使人们能够对智能体活动和决策模式进行统计推断，从而在元数据层面造成数据泄露。 Multi-agent streaming metadata (not content) enables statistical inference about agent activities and decision patterns creating data leakage at the metadata level. [214, 215, 216, 217, 218]. [214, 215, 216, 217, 218].
RDL_3_5 - 多智能体循环中的流式状态更新泄露渐进状态。 RDL_3_5 - Streaming State Updates in Multi-Agent Cycles Leaking Progressive State. 当智能体在迭代循环中流式传输状态更新（每生成一个版本便更新 code_history）时，中间状态会在最终清理之前出现在日志中。 When agents stream state updates during iterative cycles (updating code_history with each generated version), intermediate states appear in logs before final sanitization. 在多智能体循环工作流中，Agent A 向 Agent B 流式传输更新，后者再向 Agent C 流式传输更新，这种流式交接会产生多个暴露窗口，使敏感的中间状态可见。 In multi-agent cycling workflows where Agent A streams updates to Agent B which streams to Agent C, streaming handoffs create multiple exposure windows where sensitive intermediate states are visible. 多智能体情形的区别：单智能体的流式传输发生在其自身的生成过程中；多智能体的流式传输则会随着状态跨越专业分工边界流转而产生多个暴露点。 Multi-agent distinction: Single streaming within one agent’s generation; multi-agent streaming creates multiple exposure points as state flows through specialization boundaries. [219, 220, 221, 222, 223]. [219, 220, 221, 222, 223].
RDL_3_6 - 流式响应的中间状态造成信息泄露。 RDL_3_6 - Streaming Response Intermediate States as Information Leakage. 在批处理或负载均衡场景中，流式响应会暴露中间处理状态。 Streaming responses in batched or load-balanced contexts reveal intermediate processing states. 部分响应会展示部分结果，使攻击者能够推断计算进度。 Partial responses show partial results enabling attackers to infer computation progress. 不同智能体的流式传输模式会暴露哪个智能体正在处理哪个请求。 Different agents’ streaming patterns reveal which agent is processing which request. 多智能体情形的区别：完整的批处理响应展示最终结果；流式传输则允许观察中间计算过程，从而暴露智能体身份和工作负载分布。 Multi-agent distinction: Complete batch responses show final results; streaming enables observation of intermediate computation revealing agent identities and workload distribution. [210, 124, 217, 224, 225, 226]. [210, 124, 217, 224, 225, 226].
RDL_3_7 - 利用流式响应缓存进行隐蔽数据外泄。 RDL_3_7 - Streaming Response Caching for Covert Data Exfiltration. 为提高效率而缓存的流式响应，为攻击者通过缓存侧信道窃取数据提供了机会。 Streaming responses cached for efficiency create opportunities for attackers exfiltrating data through cache side channels. 多智能体系统对流式响应的缓存，使查询缓存的攻击者能够确定生成过哪些流式内容，并可能恢复敏感信息。 Multi-agent systems caching streamed responses enable attackers querying caches to determine what streams were generated, potentially recovering sensitive information. 一个研究智能体流式传输包含敏感数据的响应；如果该响应被缓存，后续查询缓存的智能体或攻击者便可恢复这些数据。 A research agent streams response containing sensitive data; if response is cached, subsequent agents or attackers querying cache can recover data. 流式传输缓存攻击与单智能体系统中的攻击不同，因为多智能体之间的缓存共享使 N 方能够查看流式传输的内容。 The streaming caching attack differs from singular systems because multi-agent cache sharing creates N-party visibility into streaming content. 拥有缓存访问权限的攻击者可以确定发生过哪些流式查询，并可能根据缓存元数据的模式重建敏感信息。 Attackers with cache access can determine which streaming queries occurred, potentially reconstructing sensitive information from cache metadata patterns. [207, 199, 124, 227]. [207, 199, 124, 227].
III-B4 RDL_4 - 搜索与召回III-B4 RDL_4 - Search and Recall
RDL_4_1 - 通过对话搜索进行概率性召回。 RDL_4_1 - Probabilistic Recall Through Conversation Search. 实现对话搜索功能的聊天界面构成了概率性召回系统，在这类系统中，搜索某个主题可能会呈现来自相关上下文、但用户并未明确请求的敏感信息。 Chat interfaces implementing conversation search create probabilistic recall systems where searching for one topic may surface sensitive information from related contexts users don’t explicitly request. 多智能体搜索索引涵盖所有智能体的历史记录，且未设置安全边界。 Multi-agent search indexes span all agents’ histories without security boundaries. 概率匹配（语义搜索、模糊匹配）可能返回包含敏感数据的结果，这些数据虽在语义上相关，却不应被披露。 Probabilistic matching (semantic search, fuzzy matching) may return results containing sensitive data semantically related but shouldn’t be disclosed. 搜索“Q3 收入”时，搜索系统可能会呈现“Q3 机密预测”“Q3 裁员计划”或“Q3 安全事件”，因为这些内容在语义上相关，尽管用户并未请求它们。 When searching ”Q3 revenue,” search might surface ”confidential Q3 projections,” ”Q3 layoff planning,” or ”Q3 security incidents” because semantically related despite user not requesting. 多智能体对话搜索会放大风险，因为搜索索引汇集了处于不同安全上下文中的智能体的内容——搜索系统不知道财务讨论应与人力资源讨论隔离，导致语义相似性引发领域间的交叉污染。 Multi-agent conversation search amplifies risk because search indexes aggregate content from agents in different security contexts—search system doesn’t know Finance discussions should separate from HR discussions, causing semantic similarity to cross-contaminate domains. 与具有明确边界和访问控制的传统搜索不同，多智能体搜索将全部历史记录视为一个统一语料库，其中任何语义相关的内容都可能依据概率性相似度而非策略被呈现。 Unlike traditional search with explicit boundaries and access controls, multi-agent search treats entire history as unified corpus where any semantically related content might surface based on probabilistic similarity rather than policy. 这种概率性召回成为一种泄露渠道，用户可能意外发现未请求的敏感信息，而攻击者则会使用精心构造的查询进行系统性探测，旨在通过语义关联使高度敏感的内容浮现。 This probabilistic recall becomes leakage channel where users accidentally discover unrequested sensitive information, and attackers systematically probe with crafted queries designed to surface high-sensitivity content through semantic association. [228, 229, 230, 231, 232]. [228, 229, 230, 231, 232].
III-B5 RDL_5 - 归因与可观测性III-B5 RDL_5 - Attribution and Observability
RDL_5_1 - 多智能体归因日志成为组织情报来源。 RDL_5_1 - Multi-Agent Attribution Logs as Organizational Intelligence. 保留详细归因元数据的聊天界面和仪表板，会记录组织的智能体使用模式、决策权限结构和运营工作流。 Chat interfaces and dashboards maintaining detailed attribution metadata document organizational agent usage patterns, decision authority structures, and operational workflows. 归因日志揭示哪些智能体被用于哪些目的，从而暴露组织结构、安全优先事项和业务流程。 Attribution logs reveal which agents are used for which purposes exposing organizational structure, security priorities, and business processes. 攻破日志的攻击者可以对组织的多智能体使用情况进行画像，识别哪些智能体负责敏感操作、哪些用户角色访问哪些智能体，以及可用于异常检测的典型模式。 Attackers compromising logs can profile organization’s multi-agent usage identifying which agents handle sensitive operations, which user roles access which agents, and typical patterns enabling anomaly detection. 与单智能体日志相比，多智能体归因能够提供更丰富的情报，揭示生态系统层面的模式，例如财务用户主要使用 Accounting Agent，偶尔使用 Legal Agent，而高管可以访问所有智能体，但最常使用 Strategy Agent。 Multi-agent attribution creates richer intelligence than singular logs revealing ecosystem-level patterns showing Finance users primarily use Accounting Agent and occasionally Legal Agent, while Executives access all agents but most frequently Strategy Agent. 这种细粒度的归因支持复杂的侦察活动，包括绘制组织层级结构、识别高权限用户，以及了解哪些智能体控制关键职能。 This attribution granularity enables sophisticated reconnaissance mapping organizational hierarchy, identifying high-privilege users, and understanding which agents control critical functions. 与展示功能访问情况的传统日志不同，多智能体归因记录会记载智能体的专业化模式，揭示战略重点和决策工作流，使日志成为竞争情报窃取、社会工程和定向攻击的重要资源。 Unlike traditional logs showing feature access, multi-agent attribution documents agent specialization patterns revealing strategic priorities and decision workflows, making logs valuable for competitive espionage, social engineering, and targeted attacks. [233, 27, 234, 235, 236]. [233, 27, 234, 235, 236].
RDL_5_2 - 框架相关日志记录通过调试透明性导致数据泄露。 RDL_5_2 - Framework-Dependent Logging Enabling Data Leakage Through Debug Transparency. 不同框架会在日志和调试输出中暴露不同的实现细节（LangChain 对所有工具调用的详细日志记录、LangGraph 在节点之间生成的状态快照、AutoGen 的完整对话历史、CrewAI 的任务执行轨迹、Semantic Kernel 的函数调用细节）。 Different frameworks expose different implementation details in logs and debugging output (LangChain’s verbose logging of all tool calls, LangGraph’s state snapshots between nodes, AutoGen’s complete conversation histories, CrewAI’s task execution traces, Semantic Kernel’s function calling details). 运行多个框架的多智能体系统会生成聚合遥测数据，暴露完整的系统架构。 Multi-agent systems running multiple frameworks create aggregated telemetry exposing comprehensive system architecture. 攻击者通过同时分析所有框架的日志，可以全面了解系统如何协调、数据流向何处，以及哪些智能体会访问敏感信息。 An attacker analyzing logs from all frameworks simultaneously gains complete visibility into how system coordinates, which data flows where, and which agents access sensitive information. 开发者重视多智能体日志的透明性，以便进行调试；但多智能体系统在框架层面记录日志会形成庞大的数据泄露面。 Developers value transparency in multi-agent logging for debugging; multi-agent systems logging at framework level create massive data leakage surfaces. 单一系统的调试输出只揭示一个框架的内部机制，而多智能体调试日志则会暴露整个编排架构。 Unlike singular systems where debugging output reveals one framework’s internals, multi-agent debug logs expose entire orchestration architecture. 攻击者攻破日志存储后，可以获取完整的系统蓝图，包括智能体间的通信模式、数据流和易受攻击的协调点。 Attackers compromising log storage access complete system blueprints including inter-agent communication patterns, data flows, and vulnerable coordination points. 多智能体的区别：单一框架的日志记录会泄露一个组件的内部机制；多智能体框架的日志记录则会跨组件聚合信息，使完整重建系统成为可能，因此，合并后的日志在攻击规划中的价值高于任何单一框架的日志。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-framework logging leaks one component’s internals; multi-agent framework logging aggregates across components enabling complete system reconstruction, making combined logs more valuable than any single framework’s logs for attack planning. [237, 238, 239, 240, 241]. [237, 238, 239, 240, 241].
RDL_5_3 - 错误分类模式泄露。 RDL_5_3 - Error Classification Pattern Leakage. 错误分类用于区分暂时性错误和永久性错误。 Error classification distinguishes transient from permanent errors. 在多智能体监控中，哪些智能体出现哪些类型错误的模式会揭示系统的脆弱性。 In multi-agent monitoring, patterns of which agents experience which error types reveal system fragility. 攻击者将错误模式映射到基础设施，并通过反复诱发错误来寻找弱点。 Attackers map error patterns to infrastructure, using repeated error induction to find weaknesses. 多智能体的区别：单一系统中的错误分类属于内部信息；多智能体中的分布式错误则会形成可观察的模式，泄露系统架构信息。 Multi-agent distinction: Singular error classification is internal; multi-agent distributed errors create observable patterns leaking system architecture information. 当跨智能体的错误分类模式可以被观察到时，由此获得的架构情报会使攻击者能够对最有可能泄露敏感数据的组件开展高精度探测。 When error classification patterns are observable across agents, the resulting architectural intelligence allows adversaries to direct high-precision probing toward components most likely to yield sensitive data. [242, 243, 244, 245, 246]. [242, 243, 244, 245, 246].
RDL_5_4 - 延迟测量信息泄露。 RDL_5_4 - Latency Measurement Information Leakage. 执行后监控会跟踪工具延迟。 Post-execution monitoring tracks tool latency. 在多智能体系统中，不同智能体之间的延迟差异会揭示计算负载、工具可用性和服务质量。 In multi-agent systems, latency variations across agents reveal computational load, tool availability, and service quality. 攻击者利用延迟计时信息推断系统何时处于高负载状态或工具何时不可用，从而优化攻击时机。 Attackers use latency timing to infer when systems are under load or tools unavailable, optimizing attack timing. 多智能体的区别：单一系统中的工具延迟属于内部信息；多智能体中跨智能体可观察到的延迟则会泄露系统状态信息，使攻击者能够优化攻击时机。 Multi-agent distinction: Singular tool latency is internal; multi-agent observable latency across agents leaks information about system state enabling attackers to optimize attack timing. 因此，多智能体群体中可观察到的延迟模式降低了实施精确定时的数据外泄尝试的门槛，而在单智能体系统中，这类尝试的时机线索会被掩盖。 Observable latency patterns across a multi-agent fleet thus reduce the barrier to precisely timed exfiltration attempts that would be masked in single-agent systems. [247, 210, 124, 215, 248]. [247, 210, 124, 215, 248].
III-B6 RDL_7 - 工具调用与函数调用III-B6 RDL_7 - Tool Invocation and Function Calling
RDL_7_1 - 工具调用日志记录作为上下文泄露的侧信道。 RDL_7_1 - Tool Invocation Logging as Side Channel for Context Leakage. 工具通常会记录调用情况，以便进行审计和调试。 Tools often log invocations for auditing and debugging. 在多智能体系统中，全面的工具日志记录会详细记录哪些智能体使用了哪些参数调用了哪些工具。 In multi-agent systems, comprehensive tool logging creates detailed records of which agents invoked which tools with what parameters. 拥有日志访问权限的攻击者可以获取有关智能体行为、任务执行和数据流的信息。 Attackers with log access gain information about agent behavior, task execution, and data flows. 尤其是当参数包含客户信息、秘密信息或业务逻辑时，工具参数日志记录可能会泄露敏感数据。 Tool parameter logging especially may leak sensitive data if parameters contain customer information, secrets, or business logic. 多智能体的区别：单智能体工具日志记录展示一个智能体的使用情况；多智能体工具日志则展示所有智能体的工具调用模式，为分析智能体网络中工具使用情况的攻击者提供更丰富的攻击面。 Multi-agent distinction: Single agent tool logging shows one agent’s usage; multi-agent tool logs show all agents’ tool invocation patterns, creating richer attack surface for adversaries analyzing tool usage across agent networks. [249, 250, 166, 251, 252, 253, 254, 255]. [249, 250, 166, 251, 252, 253, 254, 255].
RDL_7_2 - 上下文窗口中的函数调用 JSON 作为泄露途径。 RDL_7_2 - Function Calling JSON in Context Window as Leakage Vector. 函数调用会生成在智能体上下文窗口和对话历史中可见的 JSON。 Function calling generates JSON visible in agent context windows and conversation history. 这些 JSON 包含参数值、选定的函数名称，以及有关工具选择的推理。 This JSON includes parameter values, function names selected, and reasoning about tool selection. 在共享对话历史的多智能体系统中，函数调用 JSON 会跨越智能体边界持续保留，从而可能通过多个智能体均可见的工具参数泄露敏感信息。 In multi-agent systems sharing conversation history, function calling JSON persists across agent boundaries, potentially leaking sensitive information through tool parameters visible to multiple agents. 多智能体的区别：单智能体上下文窗口将函数调用 JSON 限制在一个智能体内；多智能体共享上下文窗口则会向所有接收对话历史的智能体暴露函数调用 JSON。 Multi-agent distinction: Singular agent context windows confine function calling JSON to one agent; multi-agent shared context windows expose function calling JSON to all agents receiving conversation history. [256, 257, 225, 148, 258]. [256, 257, 225, 148, 258].
RDL_7_3 - 包含实现细节的工具错误消息。 RDL_7_3 - Tool Error Messages Containing Implementation Details. 工具在调用失败时通常会返回详细的错误消息（SQL 语法错误、API 身份验证失败、超时详情）。 Tools often return detailed error messages when invocations fail (SQL syntax errors, API authentication failures, timeout details). 这些错误消息会泄露实现细节，使攻击者能够了解工具内部机制，从而更有效地利用漏洞。 These error messages leak implementation details enabling attackers to understand tool internals for better exploitation. 在多智能体系统中，一个智能体所使用工具的错误消息可能被记录在其他智能体可见的对话历史中，从而使攻击者能够在智能体网络中开展侦察。 In multi-agent systems, error messages from tools used by one agent may be logged in conversation history visible to other agents, enabling reconnaissance across agent networks. 多智能体场景的区别：单智能体的错误消息仅保留在本地；多智能体共享错误日志则使攻击者能够通过错误分析，在整个智能体网络中开展侦察 [259, 260]。 Multi-agent distinction: Single agent error messages remain local; multi-agent shared error logging enables reconnaissance across agent network through error analysis [259, 260].
RDL_7_4 - 工具选择推理导致的认知状态泄露。 RDL_7_4 - Tool Selection Reasoning as Cognitive State Leakage. 当智能体生成关于为何选择特定工具的推理（“我选择 database_query，因为用户询问了客户历史记录”）时，这些推理会被存储在记忆和对话历史中。 When agents generate reasoning about why they selected specific tools (”I chose database_query because the user asked about customer history”), this reasoning is stored in memory and conversation history. 随着时间推移，推理模式会泄露有关智能体决策、训练和目标的信息。 Over time, reasoning patterns leak information about agent decision-making, training, and objectives. 多智能体之间共享推理，使人能够了解智能体的专长和关注领域。 Multi-agent sharing of reasoning enables understanding of agent specialization and focus areas. 多智能体场景的区别：单智能体的推理保持隔离；多智能体共享推理的可见性则使攻击者能够对网络中各智能体的能力进行画像 [261, 262, 263, 198, 37, 264]。 Multi-agent distinction: Single agent reasoning remains isolated; multi-agent shared reasoning visibility enables profiling of agent capabilities across networks [261, 262, 263, 198, 37, 264].
RDL_7_5 - 函数描述上下文导致的信息泄露。 RDL_7_5 - Function Description Context as Information Leakage. 存储在插件注册表中、可通过枚举 API 访问的函数描述会泄露组织信息。 Function descriptions stored in plugin registries accessible through enumeration APIs leak organizational information. 对函数功能的详细描述会暴露其能力、约束和运行模式。“UpdatePaymentMethod：允许更新客户支付信息。 Detailed descriptions of what functions do reveal capabilities, constraints, and operational patterns. ”UpdatePaymentMethod: Allows updating customer payment information. 注意：由于监管限制，仅支持美国银行发行的信用卡。”这暴露了合规约束和支持的地区。 Note: Only works with credit cards from US banks due to regulatory restrictions.” reveals compliance constraints and supported regions. 多智能体场景的区别：跨组织枚举注册表，使竞争对手能够根据可用插件推断安全态势；单个隐藏工具不会通过枚举泄露信息，而多智能体插件注册表将所有智能体的能力汇集为一个可枚举的攻击面 [265, 266, 267, 110, 268]。 Multi-agent distinction: Registry enumeration across organizations enables competitors inferring security posture from available plugins; singular hidden tools don’t leak through enumeration, while multi-agent plugin registries combine all agent capabilities into a single enumerable attack surface [265, 266, 267, 110, 268].
RDL_7_6 - 工具调用审计追踪投毒。 RDL_7_6 - Tool Invocation Audit Trail Poisoning. 执行跟踪会记录所有工具调用，以满足合规要求。 Execution tracking logs all tool invocations for compliance. 在多智能体审计日志系统中，攻击者会攻陷负责写入日志的智能体，使其遗漏恶意调用或注入伪造的良性调用。 In multi-agent audit log systems, attackers compromise agents writing to logs to omit malicious invocations or inject fake benign invocations. 下游合规分析因此无法发现攻击证据。 Downstream compliance analysis finds no evidence of attacks. 多智能体场景的区别：单个智能体控制自己的日志；多智能体系统汇总来自多个智能体的日志，使攻击者能够有选择地对特定智能体的日志投毒，同时保持表面上的合法性。 Multi-agent distinction: Singular agents control own logs; multi-agent systems aggregate logs from multiple agents enabling attackers to selectively poison specific agents’ logs while appearing legitimate. [166, 269, 155, 27, 270]。 [166, 269, 155, 27, 270].
RDL_7_7 - 工具成功率差异导致的信息泄露。 RDL_7_7 - Tool Success Rate Differential Leakage. 智能体可能会跟踪工具的成功率。 Agents may track tool success rates. 由于参数生成方式不同，不同智能体使用相同工具时的成功率也不同。 Different agents have different success rates with same tools due to parameter generation differences. 攻击者通过观察成功率差异，识别哪些智能体能够生成更好的参数，随后攻陷表现出色的智能体。 Attackers observe success rate differentials to identify which agents generate better parameters, then compromise high-performing agents. 多智能体场景的区别：单个智能体的工具成功率是绝对指标；多智能体之间不同的成功率则会泄露哪些智能体能力更强，使攻击者能够集中攻击高价值目标。 Multi-agent distinction: Singular tool success is absolute; multi-agent heterogeneous success rates leak which agents are more capable, enabling attackers to focus on high-value targets. [271, 272, 273, 274, 275]。 [271, 272, 273, 274, 275].
RDL_7_8 - 参数值通过操作日志和追踪记录泄露。 RDL_7_8 - Parameter Values Leaking Through Action Logs and Traces. 具备详细操作日志记录功能的离线和在线评估框架，会捕获传递给每个工具的完整参数。 Offline and online evaluation frameworks with detailed action logging capture complete parameters passed to each tool. 在多智能体系统中，操作日志通常会被集中汇总。 In multi-agent systems, action logs are often aggregated centrally. 敏感参数（API 密钥、账号、个人身份信息）会通过多个智能体可见的日志泄露。 Sensitive parameters (API keys, account numbers, personally-identifiable information) leak through logs visible to multiple agents. 多智能体场景的区别：单智能体的日志保留在隔离的上下文中。 Multi-agent distinction: Single agent logs remain in isolated context. 多智能体为实现协调而采用的集中式日志记录，会形成汇集系统中传递的所有参数的存储库。 Multi-agent centralized logging for coordination creates aggregated repositories of all parameters passed through system. 访问日志的攻击者看到的不仅是某一个智能体的参数，而是所有智能体的工具参数，从而能够实施全面的数据窃取。 An attacker accessing logs sees not just one agent’s parameters but all agents’ tool parameters, enabling comprehensive data exfiltration. “通过安全验证确保参数不违反授权边界”这一要求——在多智能体日志记录中，跨越授权边界的参数会被捕获到共享日志中，从而侵犯隐私。 The requirement for ”security validation ensuring parameters don’t violate authorization boundaries”—in multi-agent logging, parameters crossing authorization boundaries are captured in shared logs violating privacy. [166, 155, 270, 27, 269]。 [166, 155, 270, 27, 269].
RDL_7_9 - 操作准确性指标暴露运行模式。 RDL_7_9 - Action Accuracy Metrics Revealing Operational Patterns. 评估过程中会采集详细的轨迹指标（精确匹配、精确率、召回率、步骤效用）。 Detailed trajectory metrics (exact match, precision, recall, step utility) are captured during evaluation. 当这些指标在多智能体评估中汇总时，它们会暴露运行模式。 When these metrics are aggregated across multi-agent evaluations, they reveal operational patterns. 显示“Agent A 始终以 92% 的置信度选择工具 X，而 Agent B 则借助工具 Z 更谨慎地查询工具 Y”的指标，会暴露攻击者可以利用的工具使用模式。 Metrics showing ”Agent A consistently selects tool X with 92% confidence but Agent B queries tool Y more carefully with tools Z” reveals tool usage patterns attackers can exploit. 多智能体场景的区别：单智能体评估中的指标仅保留在本地。 Multi-agent distinction: Metrics in single agent evaluation are local. 多智能体评估框架公布各智能体的指标，使攻击者能够收集运行情报——攻击者通过分析已公布的指标，了解智能体依赖哪些工具、哪些故障最常见，以及智能体难以处理哪些参数类型。 Multi-agent evaluation frameworks publishing metrics across agents enable operational intelligence gathering—attackers analyzing published metrics learn which tools agents rely on, which failures are most common, what parameter types agents struggle with. [110, 266, 270, 155, 263]. [110, 266, 270, 155, 263].
RDL_7_10 - 工具执行日志聚合作为多智能体数据泄露通道。 RDL_7_10 - Tool Execution Log Aggregation as Multi-Agent Data Leakage Channel. 混合工作流汇总各智能体的工具执行日志，用于协调和审计。 Hybrid workflows aggregate tool execution logs across agents for coordination and auditing. 聚合日志包含所有智能体在工具调用中产生的敏感数据。 Aggregated logs contain sensitive data from all agents’ tool invocations. 下游智能体在分析日志时采用的概率性词元生成机制，可能泄露累积的敏感执行数据。 Probabilistic token generation in downstream agent analysis of logs may leak accumulated sensitive execution data. 多智能体场景的区别：单智能体日志仅包含该智能体的操作；多智能体聚合日志则将多个智能体的敏感操作集中到统一的追踪记录中。 Multi-agent distinction: Single agent logs contain single agent’s operations; multi-agent aggregated logs concentrate multiple agents’ sensitive operations in unified trace. 攻陷日志分析环节后，攻击者便可从整个智能体群体的操作中提取敏感数据。 Compromising log analysis enables attackers extracting sensitive data from entire agent ensemble’s operations. [242, 276, 277, 27, 270]. [242, 276, 277, 27, 270].
III-B7 RDL_9 - 多智能体记忆与状态III-B7 RDL_9 - Multi-Agent Memory and State
RDL_9_1 - 多智能体系统中的跨智能体反思记忆泄露。 RDL_9_1 - Cross-Agent Reflection Memory Leakage in Multi-Agent Systems. 在分布式反思（Reflection）架构中，当多个智能体共享基础设施时，反思记忆存储会成为未经授权的信息传递通道。 Reflection memory stores become unauthorized conduits in distributed Reflection architectures when multiple agents share infrastructure. 评判智能体在多次评估中累积评估数据，从而形成隐蔽通道——医疗智能体对诊断的反思将 PHI 存入共享的评判智能体记忆，并在评判智能体评估保险理赔智能体时影响其反馈。 Critic agents accumulating assessment data across evaluations create covert channels—healthcare agent reflection on diagnosis stores PHI in shared critic memory influencing feedback when critic evaluates insurance claim agents. LLM 的概率性回忆机制使泄露具有非确定性，导致传统审计难以检测。 Probabilistic LLM recall makes leakage non-deterministic obscuring detection through traditional audits. Plan-and-Execute 的重新规划会根据记忆重新生成上下文，可能使先前任务或其他智能体的过时信息重新浮现。 Plan-and-Execute replanning regenerates context from memories potentially surfacing stale information from previous tasks or other agents. 单智能体记忆损坏仅影响该智能体，而多智能体反思会造成跨越信任边界的系统性漏洞。 Unlike single-agent memory corruption affecting only that agent, multi-agent reflection creates systemic vulnerabilities across trust boundaries. [278, 279, 280, 281, 282, 283]. [278, 279, 280, 281, 282, 283].
RDL_9_2 - ReAct 推理轨迹持久化与取证重建攻击。 RDL_9_2 - ReAct Reasoning Trace Persistence and Forensic Reconstruction Attacks. 为调试或合规而持久化保存的 ReAct 显式推理轨迹会形成全面的攻击图，暴露超出单智能体日志范围的拓扑结构、工具依赖关系和决策逻辑。 ReAct explicit reasoning traces persisted for debugging or compliance create comprehensive attack graphs exposing topology, tool dependencies, and decision logic beyond single-agent logs. 多智能体编排会记录智能体之间的通信模式、协调协议和层级结构。 Multi-agent orchestrations document inter-agent communication patterns, coordination protocols, and hierarchical structure. 与线性的单智能体序列不同，多智能体 ReAct 会创建跨组件、相互关联的轨迹。 Unlike linear single-agent sequences, multi-agent ReAct creates interconnected traces spanning components. 攻击者访问日志后可重建系统架构：哪些智能体与工具通信、数据流向、重新规划的传播过程，以及故障点。 Attackers accessing logs reconstruct architecture: which agents communicate with tools, data flows, replanning propagation, and failure points. 上下文耗尽会造成一种特殊漏洞——智能体因容量限制而丢弃推理内容时，集中持久化保存的轨迹却会在记忆管理范围之外无限累积。 Context exhaustion creates particular vulnerability—as agents discard reasoning due to limits, persisted centralized traces accumulate indefinitely outside memory management. 攻击者通过挖掘日志，可获得智能体已不再保有的完整历史，其中包括会暴露系统内部信息的探索性操作。 Attackers mining logs obtain complete history agents no longer possess including exploratory actions revealing internals. 每天数千次请求会形成全面的行为图谱，实际上为复杂攻击提供了蓝图。 Daily thousands of requests create comprehensive behavior maps essentially blueprinting sophisticated attacks. [284, 285, 286, 287]. [284, 285, 286, 287].
RDL_9_3 - 通过时序分析造成的分布式追踪跨租户关联泄露。 RDL_9_3 - Distributed Trace Cross-Tenant Correlation Leakage Through Timing Analysis. 在多租户部署中，使用关联 ID 的分布式追踪会跨越智能体边界跟踪请求，攻击者可分析元数据，通过时序信息推断工作流模式并获取商业情报。 Distributed tracing with correlation IDs tracks requests across agent boundaries in multi-tenant deployments where attackers analyze metadata inferring workflow patterns and business intelligence through timing. 控制某个租户智能体的攻击者可观察共享基础设施中的时间戳和关联模式，并将其与已知事件相关联，通过智能体激活模式识别竞争对手的业务周期，通过法律分析与财务分析之间的关联识别收购目标，以及通过欺诈检测延迟的骤增发现事件。 Attackers controlling one tenant’s agents observe timestamps and correlation patterns in shared infrastructure correlating with known events detecting competitor cycles through agent activation patterns, identifying acquisition targets through legal and financial analysis correlation, discovering incidents through fraud latency spikes. 与单智能体的隔离日志记录不同，分布式追踪会形成跨租户的可观测性，使元数据泄露并发工作流的信息。 Unlike single-agent isolated logging, distributed tracing creates cross-tenant observability where metadata leaks concurrent workflow information. 即使内容已加密，只要元数据仍因监控需要而可见，攻击也能成功。 Attacks succeed with encrypted content if metadata remains visible for monitoring. 缓解措施需要通过独立后端实现每个租户的追踪隔离，使用差分隐私为时序和拓扑信息添加噪声，轮换关联标识以防止跟踪，通过采样防止图结构重建，以及采用感知租户的保留策略来限制时间窗口。 Mitigation requires per-tenant trace isolation with separate backends, differential privacy adding noise to timing and topology, correlation rotation preventing tracking, sampling preventing graph reconstruction, and tenant-aware retention limiting temporal windows. [288, 289, 124, 277, 290]. [288, 289, 124, 277, 290].
RDL_9_4 - 通过访问模式分析和伪共享时序攻击重建共享内存黑板状态。 RDL_9_4 - Shared Memory Blackboard State Reconstruction via Access Pattern Analysis and False Sharing Timing Attacks. 黑板式多智能体系统使用共享内存进行隐式协调，使攻击者能够通过监测访问模式重建工作流，在不访问内容的情况下推断信息。 Blackboard multi-agent systems using shared memory for implicit coordination enable attackers monitoring access patterns to reconstruct workflows inferring information without accessing content. 医疗诊断系统的日志会显示专科智能体的激活情况——心脏科智能体在放射科智能体之后、病理科智能体之前激活，可据此推断可能的诊断类别。 Medical diagnosis systems show specialist agent activation from logs—cardiology after radiology but before pathology infers probable diagnosis category. 伪共享时序攻击能够提供更精细的情报，因为相互竞争的智能体之间的内存锁争用会暴露并发处理情况。 False sharing timing attacks provide higher-resolution intelligence where competing agents’ memory lock contention reveals concurrent processing. 通过锁等待延迟可推断法律审查与合规活动正在同时进行，表明可能涉及高风险交易。 Lock delays infer simultaneous legal review and compliance activity suggesting high-risk transactions. 与单智能体的私有记忆不同，黑板访问模式会成为泄露工作流和分类信息的隐蔽通道。 Unlike single-agent private memory, blackboard access patterns become covert channels leaking workflows and classifications. 缓解措施包括：通过维持统一模式的虚拟操作来混淆访问模式，采用细粒度分布式锁消除伪共享，对索引加密以防止推断，以及对时序信息应用差分隐私，同时保留其调试效用。 Mitigation requires access pattern obfuscation through dummy operations maintaining uniform patterns, fine-grained distributed locking eliminating false sharing, encrypted indices preventing inference, and differential privacy on timing preserving debugging utility. [291, 292, 293, 294, 295]. [291, 292, 293, 294, 295].
RDL_9_5 - 多智能体仪表板通过智能体的同时活动造成关联信息泄露。 RDL_9_5 - Multi-Agent Dashboard Correlation Leakage Through Simultaneous Agent Activity. 多智能体监控仪表板同时展示多个智能体的活动，会造成关联信息泄露，因为哪些智能体共同运行的模式会暴露业务工作流和运行结构。 Multi-agent monitoring dashboards displaying simultaneous activity across multiple agents create correlation leakage where patterns of which agents operate together reveal business workflows and operational structure. 攻击者通过分析仪表板上的模式，推断哪些智能体相互协作，并通过关联分析识别专门的工作流和敏感操作。 Attackers analyzing dashboard patterns infer which agents collaborate detecting specialized workflows and sensitive operations through correlation. 多智能体场景的区别：单个智能体运行时仅显示该智能体的活动；多智能体仪表板的同时展示使攻击者能够根据协作模式推断组织结构。 Multi-agent distinction: Singular agent operation shows one agent’s activity; multi-agent dashboards’ simultaneous displays enable attackers to infer organizational structure from collaboration patterns. [296, 297, 298, 299, 300]. [296, 297, 298, 299, 300].
III-B8 RDL_10 - 推理与思维链（CoT）轨迹III-B8 RDL_10 - Reasoning and CoT Traces
RDL_10_1 - 通过记忆查询造成的 CoT 轨迹泄露。 RDL_10_1 - CoT trace leakage through memory queries. 存储在共享记忆中的思维链（Chain-of-Thought）推理轨迹通常包含其分析过的敏感上下文信息。 Chain-of-Thought reasoning traces stored in shared memory often contain the sensitive context information they analyzed. 智能体查询记忆以获取推理示例时，会无意中检索到嵌入 CoT 轨迹中的敏感数据。 Agents querying memory for reasoning examples unintentionally retrieve sensitive data embedded in the CoT traces. 多智能体场景的区别：单智能体系统将 CoT 推理保留在隔离的上下文窗口中；多智能体系统将 CoT 轨迹存储在共享记忆中，使这些推理可被查询，因此，当智能体检索编码了敏感信息的“推理示例”时，就会产生新的泄露路径 [285, 284, 291, 294, 293]。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-agent systems keep CoT reasoning in isolated context windows; multi-agent systems storing CoT traces in shared memory make that reasoning queryable, creating new leakage paths as agents retrieve ”reasoning examples” that encode sensitive information [285, 284, 291, 294, 293].
RDL_10_2 - 中间步骤的详尽表述使数据重构成为可能。 RDL_10_2 - Intermediate step verbosity enabling data reconstruction. CoT 中明确呈现的中间步骤会暴露中间计算的结构和内容。 CoT’s explicit intermediate steps reveal the structure and content of intermediate computations. 当这些轨迹被记录到日志或缓存中时，攻击者可根据逐步解释重构敏感输入（例如，根据“按年龄 ¿ 18 筛选后，我得到 450 条记录”这样的步骤推断实际客户数据）。 When these traces are logged or cached, attackers reconstruct sensitive inputs from step-by-step explanations (e.g., inferring actual customer data from steps like ”after filtering for age ¿ 18, I have 450 records”). 多智能体场景的区别：单个智能体仅在上下文中短暂保留中间步骤；多智能体系统为协调和回放而记录 CoT，会保留逐步信息，从而使数据重构攻击成为可能。 Multi-agent distinction: Single agents keep intermediate steps in context only briefly; multi-agent systems logging CoT for coordination and replay preserve step-by-step information that enables data reconstruction attacks. [295, 291, 294]. [295, 291, 294].
RDL_10_3 - 共享轨迹中嵌入推理的秘密信息。 RDL_10_3 - Reasoning-embedded secrets in shared traces. 智能体有时会记录有关敏感操作的推理（例如，“我使用 API 密钥 [显示部分密钥] 验证了凭据”）。 Agents sometimes document reasoning about sensitive operations (e.g., ”I used API key [partial key shown] to verify credentials”). 这些为多智能体协调而存储的推理轨迹会通过记录内容暴露秘密信息。 These reasoning traces, stored for multi-agent coordination, expose secrets through documentation. 多智能体场景的区别：单智能体的推理保留在短暂存在的上下文中；多智能体的共享推理则被持久记录，从而形成一个新的持久性秘密信息存储库，其中的秘密信息嵌入在看似无害的推理轨迹中。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-agent reasoning stays in ephemeral context; multi-agent shared reasoning is logged persistently, creating a new persistent repository of secrets embedded in seemingly innocent reasoning traces. [257, 110, 301, 230, 302]. [257, 110, 301, 230, 302].
RDL_10_4 - 跨智能体的推理上下文泄露。 RDL_10_4 - Cross-agent reasoning context leakage. 当智能体 A 的推理轨迹作为输入传入智能体 B 的推理过程时，A 考虑过的所有上下文（包括敏感数据）都会流向 B。如果 B 的推理随后被记录到日志或存储，原始敏感上下文就会被复制到多个系统中。 When Agent A’s reasoning trace is input to Agent B’s reasoning process, all context that A considered (including sensitive data) flows to B. If B’s reasoning is then logged or stored, the original sensitive context gets replicated across systems. 多智能体场景的区别：单个智能体处理自身的敏感上下文；在推理会成为其他智能体输入的多智能体系统中，敏感上下文会跨越智能体边界传播。 Multi-agent distinction: Single agents process their own sensitive contexts; multi-agent systems where reasoning becomes input to other agents propagate sensitive context across agent boundaries. [153, 303, 186, 294, 219]. [153, 303, 186, 294, 219].
RDL_10_5 - 通过观察树状态造成的前瞻计算信息泄露。 RDL_10_5 - Lookahead computation information leakage via tree state observation. ToT（Tree-of-Thought，思维树）智能体通过推测性地探索未来分支来执行前瞻计算。 ToT (Tree-of-Thought) agents perform lookahead by exploring future branches speculatively. 在多智能体系统中，观察前瞻计算期间探索了哪些分支，可能会暴露未来计划、策略或敏感信息。 In multi-agent systems, observing which branches are explored during lookahead can reveal future plans, strategies, or sensitive information. 多智能体场景的区别：多智能体系统会跨智能体边界暴露前瞻决策；单智能体的前瞻计算则在内部进行，其他智能体无法观察。 Multi-agent distinction: Multi-agent systems expose lookahead decisions across agent boundaries; single-agent lookahead is internal and not observable by other agents. [304, 305, 306, 307, 308, 309, 310, 311, 312, 313, 314, 315, 316]. [304, 305, 306, 307, 308, 309, 310, 311, 312, 313, 314, 315, 316].
RDL_10_6 - 保留的推理路径造成的上下文泄露。 RDL_10_6 - Preserved Reasoning Path Context Leakage. 自一致性（Self-Consistency）路径可能会为提供解释而被保留。 Self-Consistency paths may be preserved for explanation purposes. 这些保留的路径占据大量上下文窗口空间，并包含原始推理中的敏感信息。 These preserved paths occupy large context windows and contain sensitive information from the original reasoning. 在多智能体系统中，如果智能体 A 保留了包含敏感数据的路径，而下游智能体 B 或监控智能体访问了这些路径，就会通过保留的上下文发生数据泄露。 In multi-agent systems where Agent A preserves paths containing sensitive data and downstream Agent B or monitoring agents access those paths, data leakage occurs through preserved context. 与短暂存在的推理状态不同，保留的路径会持续存在，从而形成长期存在的泄露途径。 Unlike volatile reasoning states, preserved paths persist creating long-lived leakage vectors. 多智能体场景的区别：单智能体保留的路径仅存在于该智能体的上下文中；多智能体共享的保留路径存储库会造成持续性泄露，因为多个智能体都可以访问所有智能体保留路径中的敏感数据。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-agent preserved paths remain within one agent’s context; multi-agent shared preserved path repositories create persistent leakage where multiple agents can access sensitive data from all agents’ preserved paths. [291, 295, 177, 317, 277]. [291, 295, 177, 317, 277].
RDL_10_7 - 记忆整合通过共享上下文造成的数据泄露。 RDL_10_7 - Memory Consolidation Data Leakage Through Shared Context. 整合过程将多个独立的推理轨迹合并为单一的共识输出，并将其存储以供检索。 Consolidation merges multiple independent reasoning traces into a single consensus output stored for retrieval. 包含 k 条推理路径摘要的整合记忆可能会无意中保留原始轨迹中的敏感信息。 Consolidated memory containing summaries of k reasoning paths may inadvertently preserve sensitive information from original traces. 在共享整合记忆的多智能体系统中，访问该记忆的所有智能体都会接收到来自多个来源的、合并后的敏感信息。 In multi-agent systems sharing consolidated memory, all agents accessing that memory receive merged sensitive information from multiple sources. 与访问单条路径不同，整合会形成混合的敏感数据，从而扩大泄漏范围。 Unlike individual path access, consolidation creates mixed sensitive data increasing leakage scope. 多智能体场景的区别：单智能体的整合仅限于一个智能体的记忆内部；多智能体的共享整合则会形成所有智能体均可访问的多源混合敏感数据。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-agent consolidation remains within one agent’s memory; multi-agent shared consolidation creates mixed-source sensitive data accessible to all agents. [318, 319, 320, 321, 313, 322]。 [318, 319, 320, 321, 313, 322].
RDL_10_8 - 中间推理轨迹的概率性召回漏洞。 RDL_10_8 - Intermediate Reasoning Trace Probabilistic Recall Vulnerability. Self-Consistency 在生成过程中维护 k 条推理链；如果这些推理链被部分保留或记录到日志中，多智能体协调期间的概率性召回机制就可能检索出敏感的中间步骤。 Self-Consistency maintains k reasoning chains during generation; if these chains are partially preserved or included in logs, probabilistic recall mechanisms during multi-agent coordination might retrieve sensitive intermediate steps. 本章指出，智能体可以“一并检查全部 k 条推理路径，识别其中的模式”，这为日志记录创造了机会。 Chapter notes agents can examine ”all k reasoning paths together, identifying patterns,” creating logging opportunities. 在多智能体系统中，Self-Consistency 执行期间记录的中间推理轨迹可通过下游智能体的上下文检索进行查询，从而使敏感数据通过概率性召回泄漏。 In multi-agent systems, intermediate reasoning traces logged during Self-Consistency execution become query-able through downstream agents’ context retrieval, enabling sensitive data leakage through probabilistic recall. 多智能体场景的区别：单智能体的推理日志仅保留在一个智能体的私有日志系统中；多智能体的共享日志与检索系统则使敏感的中间推理能够通过概率性召回跨越智能体边界而泄漏。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-agent reasoning logs remain within one agent’s private logging; multi-agent shared logging and retrieval systems enable sensitive intermediate reasoning to leak across agent boundaries through probabilistic recall. [323, 324, 325, 326, 321, 172, 327]。 [323, 324, 325, 326, 321, 172, 327].
RDL_10_9 - 通过保留路径泄漏质量评分元数据。 RDL_10_9 - Quality Score Metadata Leakage Via Preserved Paths. 当 Self-Consistency 路径连同质量评分一起保留时，这些元数据便提供了哪些路径包含有用信息的信息。 When Self-Consistency paths are preserved with quality scores, the metadata becomes information about which paths contained useful information. 随着时间推移，对保留的高质量路径的访问模式会揭示特定领域的模式，从而造成组织推理模式的侧信道泄漏。 Over time, access patterns to high-quality preserved paths reveal domain-specific patterns, creating side-channel leakage of organizational reasoning patterns. 在共享质量元数据的多智能体系统中，攻击者会分析所有智能体所保留路径的访问模式，以推断组织的敏感模式。 In multi-agent systems sharing quality metadata, attackers analyze access patterns across all agents’ preserved paths to infer sensitive organizational patterns. 多智能体场景的区别：单智能体的质量元数据仅保留在一个智能体的路径存储中；多智能体的共享存储库则会造成聚合元数据泄漏，其中跨智能体的访问模式会揭示有关组织的信息。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-agent quality metadata remains within one agent’s path storage; multi-agent shared repositories create aggregate metadata leakage where cross-agent access patterns reveal organizational insights. [328, 329, 330, 331, 159, 292, 332]。 [328, 329, 330, 331, 159, 292, 332].
RDL_10_10 - 通过难度分类导致的失败案例日志数据泄漏。 RDL_10_10 - Failure Case Logging Data Leakage Through Difficulty Classification. 难度自适应的 Self-Consistency 对简单问题使用 k=3，对困难问题使用 k=40。 Difficulty-adaptive Self-Consistency uses k=3 for easy problems and k=40 for hard problems. 失败的 Self-Consistency 案例（低置信度投票或未收敛）通常会连同完整推理轨迹一起记录到日志中，以供调试。 Failed Self-Consistency cases (low-confidence voting or no convergence) typically logged with full reasoning traces for debugging. 如果下游智能体访问这些日志以从失败中学习，失败推理路径中的敏感信息就会泄漏。 If these logs are accessed by downstream agents for learning from failures, sensitive information from failed reasoning paths leaks. 在从失败中学习的多智能体系统中，一个智能体失败的 Self-Consistency 推理会成为其他智能体的训练数据，从而泄漏敏感信息。 In multi-agent learning-from-failure systems, one agent’s failed Self-Consistency reasoning becomes training data for other agents, leaking sensitive information. 多智能体场景的区别：单智能体的失败日志保留在内部；在失败案例成为共享训练数据的多智能体学习系统中，失败记录会导致系统性的数据泄漏。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-agent failure logging remains internal; multi-agent learning systems where failure cases become shared training data enable systematic data leakage through failure documentation. [333, 334, 335, 336, 337]。 [333, 334, 335, 336, 337].
III-B9 RDL_11 - 多模态与输入处理III-B9 RDL_11 - Multimodal and Input Processing
RDL_11_1 - 多模态上下文窗口扩展形成大规模泄漏面。 RDL_11_1 - Multimodal Context Window Expansion Creating Large-Scale Leakage Surfaces. 多模态 RAG 智能体处理更大的上下文窗口，其中结合了文本块、图像描述、提取的表格和音频转录文本。 Multimodal RAG agents process larger context windows combining text chunks, image captions, extracted tables, and audio transcripts. 扩展后的上下文增加了通过模型输出、日志和中间表示发生的被动信息泄漏。 The expanded context increases passive information leakage through model outputs, logs, and intermediate representations. 在多智能体系统中，若综合智能体同时处理图像和文本，使上下文窗口相较于纯文本扩大至 4 倍，信息泄漏渠道也会按比例扩大。 In multi-agent systems where synthesis agents process images plus text achieving 4x context window expansion compared to text-only, information leakage channels expand proportionally. 多智能体场景的区别：纯文本上下文窗口产生的泄漏范围有限；多模态上下文窗口则使嵌入在图像、音频转录文本和提取数据中的敏感信息可能泄漏，而智能体为保持连贯性必须纳入这些内容。 Multi-agent distinction: Text-only context windows create bounded leakage; multimodal context windows enable leakage of sensitive information embedded in images, audio transcripts, and extracted data that agents must include for coherence. [191, 159, 338, 339, 340, 341, 342, 343, 344]。 [191, 159, 338, 339, 340, 341, 342, 343, 344].
RDL_11_2 - 视觉模型中间表示泄漏。 RDL_11_2 - Vision Model Intermediate Representation Leakage. 视觉模型（CLIP、NeVA、DePlot）会生成中间表示（图像编码、注意力图、特征图），这些表示可能泄漏有关所处理图像的敏感信息。 Vision models (CLIP, NeVA, DePlot) produce intermediate representations (image encodings, attention maps, feature maps) that could leak sensitive information about processed images. 在视觉模型输出被传递给下游智能体的多智能体系统中，中间表示可能通过模型日志泄漏，或从最终输出中被重建。 In multi-agent systems where vision model outputs feed downstream agents, intermediate representations might leak through model logs or be reconstructed from final outputs. 包含敏感医疗数据的图像在经过 NeVA 处理后，可能通过注意力模式或中间嵌入泄漏信息。 An image containing sensitive healthcare data processed through NeVA could leak information through attention patterns or intermediate embeddings. 多智能体场景的区别：文本处理会泄漏文本语义；视觉处理还会泄漏视觉特征、布局信息和空间关系，使得从模型内部信息重建图像内容成为可能 [345, 346, 347, 348, 349, 350, 351, 352]。 Multi-agent distinction: Text processing leaks text semantics; vision processing additionally leaks visual features, layout information, and spatial relationships enabling reconstruction of image content from model internals [345, 346, 347, 348, 349, 350, 351, 352].
RDL_11_3 - 通过多模态综合泄漏音频嵌入。 RDL_11_3 - Audio Embedding Leakage Through Multimodal Synthesis. 将音频转录文本转换为嵌入表示以用于多模态检索，会形成隐私泄露渠道，嵌入表示可能通过声音特征泄露说话者身份、情绪基调或背景情境。 Audio transcripts converted to embeddings for multimodal retrieval create privacy channels where embeddings could reveal speaker identity, emotional tone, or background context through voice characteristics. 在多智能体音频 RAG 系统中，这些嵌入表示持久存储在所有智能体均可访问的向量存储中，导致敏感音频元数据泄露。 In multi-agent audio RAG systems, these embeddings persist in vector stores accessible to all agents, creating leakage of sensitive audio metadata. 多智能体场景的区别：文本嵌入会泄露语义内容；音频嵌入还会泄露副语言信息（语调、情绪、说话者特征），从而能够重建说话者身份和情绪情境。 Multi-agent distinction: Text embeddings leak semantic content; audio embeddings additionally leak paralinguistic information (tone, emotion, speaker characteristics) enabling reconstruction of speaker identity and emotional context. [353, 354, 355, 356, 357, 358, 359, 360, 361, 362]. [353, 354, 355, 356, 357, 358, 359, 360, 361, 362].
RDL_11_4 - 图表线性化通过提取的表格导致数据泄露。 RDL_11_4 - Chart Linearization Data Leakage Through Extracted Tables. DePlot 线性化从图表中提取精确数值，生成结构化数据。 DePlot linearization produces structured data extracting precise numerical values from charts. 这些提取出的表格在支持准确的 RAG 的同时，也形成了持久性泄露途径，使敏感的财务、医疗或运营数据以提取后的形式持续留存。 These extracted tables, while enabling accurate RAG, also create permanent leakage vectors where sensitive financial, healthcare, or operational data persists in extracted form. 在存储 DePlot 输出的多智能体 RAG 流水线中，能够访问向量存储的攻击者可以检索到原本包含在受保护图像中的精确数值数据。 In multi-agent RAG pipelines storing DePlot outputs, attackers accessing vector stores retrieve precise numerical data originally contained in protected images. 多智能体场景的区别：图像具有视觉上的隐蔽性；DePlot 线性化将其转换为机器可读的结构化数据，使原本隐蔽在图像中的敏感信息能够被精确提取。 Multi-agent distinction: Images provide visual obscurity; DePlot linearization converts to machine-readable structured data enabling precise extraction of sensitive information that images obscured. [363, 364, 365, 232]. [363, 364, 365, 232].
RDL_11_5 - 用于内容重建的多模态嵌入反演。 RDL_11_5 - Multimodal Embedding Inversion for Content Reconstruction. 近期研究表明，嵌入反演攻击能够从 CLIP 嵌入中重建原始图像。 Recent research demonstrates embedding inversion attacks reconstructing original images from CLIP embeddings. 在将多模态嵌入存储于共享向量数据库的多智能体系统中，攻击者通过存储的嵌入重建图像，导致视觉内容泄露。 In multi-agent systems storing multimodal embeddings in shared vector databases, attackers reconstructing images from stored embeddings leak visual content. 包含敏感示意图、文档或医学影像的图像可能通过持久存储的嵌入被重建。 Images containing sensitive diagrams, documents, or medical imagery could be reconstructed from persistent embeddings. 多智能体场景的区别：单智能体中经过嵌入的内容仅短暂存在；采用持久化嵌入存储的多智能体系统则可能造成长期的嵌入泄露，使经过该系统处理的任何图像都能被重建。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-agent embedded content remains ephemeral; multi-agent systems with persistent embedding storage enable long-term embedding leakage enabling reconstruction of any image processed through the system. [27, 366, 291, 227]. [27, 366, 291, 227].
III-B10 RDL_12 - 错误处理与优雅降级III-B10 RDL_12 - Error Handling and Graceful Degradation
RDL_12_1 - 错误消息日志记录作为数据泄露渠道。 RDL_12_1 - Error Message Logging as Data Leakage Channel. 捕获完整错误上下文的错误日志记录会形成持久化数据存储库，其中包含在错误状态下出现的敏感信息。 Error logging capturing full error context creates persistent data repositories containing sensitive information that appeared in error states. 在多智能体系统中，全面的错误日志记录会捕获故障发生时的上下文，包括用户数据、工具输出和系统状态。 In multi-agent systems, comprehensive error logging captures context including user data, tool outputs, and system state at time of failure. 这些错误日志成为试图获取敏感数据的攻击者的高价值目标。 These error logs become high-value targets for attackers seeking sensitive data exposure. 错误消息可能包含用户输入、数据库结果、API 响应以及恢复所需的凭据——这些内容均作为调试信息存储在错误日志中，从而通过错误处理基础设施形成数据泄露渠道。 Error messages may contain user input, database results, API responses, credentials needed for recovery—all stored in error logs as debugging information, creating data leakage channels through error handling infrastructure. 多智能体错误聚合意味着集中式错误日志包含来自所有智能体的敏感数据，从而通过错误消息存储库形成统一的高价值泄露点。 Multi-agent error aggregation means centralized error logs contain sensitive data from all agents, creating unified high-value leakage points through error message repositories. [367, 368, 369]. [367, 368, 369].
RDL_12_2 - 重试尝试日志记录暴露中间状态。 RDL_12_2 - Retry Attempt Logging Exposing Intermediate States. 重试逻辑会详细记录各次重试尝试，并通过恢复过程中捕获的中间状态暴露敏感数据。 Retry logic maintaining detailed logs of retry attempts exposes sensitive data through intermediate states captured during recovery. 在多智能体系统中，每次重试尝试都会记录完整状态，包括上下文、工具结果和智能体评估。 In multi-agent systems, each retry attempt logs full state including context, tool results, and agent assessments. 重试日志会累积敏感信息，并将其作为调试记录无限期保留。 Retry logs accumulate sensitive information persisting indefinitely as debugging records. 数据会出现在重试的中间状态中——包括部分结果、错误上下文和恢复决策——这些内容在成功完成后仍留存在日志中，从而通过重试尝试的遥测数据造成数据泄露。 Data appears in intermediate retry states—partial results, error context, recovery decisions—that remain in logs after successful completion, leaking data through retry attempt telemetry. [370, 371, 372]. [370, 371, 372].
RDL_12_3 - 通过替代提供商的日志记录暴露回退数据。 RDL_12_3 - Fallback Data Exposure Through Alternative Provider Logging. 将请求路由至备用提供商的回退策略会产生独立的日志流，这些日志流的访问控制或保留策略可能较为薄弱。 Fallback strategies routing to secondary providers create separate logging streams that may have weaker access controls or retention policies. 在回退路径通向监控较少的备用提供商的多智能体系统中，回退执行会生成采用较薄弱安全措施的日志。 In multi-agent systems where fallback routes to less-monitored secondary providers, fallback execution generates logs with weaker security practices. 敏感数据会通过回退提供商的日志泄露，因为这些日志未受到与主要提供商日志同等严格的访问控制。 Sensitive data leaks through fallback provider logs that weren’t subject to same access control rigor as primary provider logs. 多智能体回退链会产生安全态势不一致的多个日志流，使数据能够通过安全性最薄弱的回退日志实现泄露。 Multi-agent fallback chains create multiple logging streams with inconsistent security postures, enabling data leakage through weakest fallback logging implementation. [264, 155, 373, 374]. [264, 155, 373, 374].
RDL_12_4 - 优雅降级状态日志记录导致能力信息披露。 RDL_12_4 - Graceful Degradation State Logging Creating Capability Disclosure. 优雅降级过程会记录哪些能力被禁用及其原因，由此生成的日志会披露系统架构和能力。 Graceful degradation logging which capabilities are disabled and why creates logs disclosing system architecture and capabilities. 在多智能体系统中，降级日志会显示哪些智能体禁用了哪些能力，从而提供有关系统配置的情报。 In multi-agent systems, degradation logs show which agents disabled which capabilities, creating intelligence about system configuration. 攻击者通过分析降级日志了解系统架构，并利用对哪些能力对安全至关重要的认知实施针对性攻击。 Attackers analyzing degradation logs understand system architecture enabling targeted attacks exploiting knowledge of which capabilities are security-critical. [375, 273, 376, 377, 378, 379, 380, 381]. [375, 273, 376, 377, 378, 379, 380, 381].
RDL_12_5 - 利用断路器状态变更日志进行基础设施侦察。 RDL_12_5 - Circuit Breaker State Change Logging as Infrastructure Reconnaissance. 断路器记录状态转换（断开/闭合/半开）及其原因，会暴露基础设施的健康状况模式和故障原因。 Circuit breaker logging state transitions (open/closed/half-open) with reasons reveals infrastructure health patterns and failure causes. 在多智能体系统中，断路器状态日志会显示哪些端点发生故障及其原因，使攻击者能够了解系统拓扑和故障模式。 In multi-agent systems, circuit state logs show which endpoints fail and why, enabling attackers to understand system topology and failure patterns. 特定端点上的断路器频繁断开，会暴露哪些组件较为脆弱或正遭受攻击，从而通过错误遥测形成侦察渠道。 Frequent circuit openings on specific endpoints reveal which components are fragile or under attack, creating reconnaissance channels through error telemetry. [382, 383, 384, 385, 386]. [382, 383, 384, 385, 386].
III-B11 RDL_13 - 评估与测试泄露III-B11 RDL_13 - Evaluation and Testing Leakage
RDL_13_1 - 通过日志输出泄露评估指标计算信息。 RDL_13_1 - Evaluation Metric Computation Leakage Through Logging Outputs. 评估流水线会记录详细指标（准确率、延迟百分位数、成本明细），供审查使用。 Evaluation pipelines log detailed metrics (accuracy, latency percentiles, cost breakdowns) for review. 在指标计算涉及敏感信息的多智能体系统中（例如，详细的成本分析暴露专有算法，错误分类明细暴露用户行为模式），记录的指标会成为数据泄露渠道。 In multi-agent systems where metric computation involves sensitive information (proprietary algorithms revealed through detailed cost analysis, user patterns revealed through error breakdown), logged metrics become data leakage channels. 拥有评估日志访问权限的攻击者会从详细指标中提取敏感的系统信息。 Attackers with evaluation log access extract sensitive system information from detailed metrics. 与指标详细程度有限的单体系统不同，多智能体评估架构会记录所有评估智能体的指标，从而在日志中形成全面的系统指纹。 Unlike singular systems with bounded metric detail, multi-agent evaluation architectures logging metrics from all evaluator agents create comprehensive system fingerprints in logs. [387, 388, 389, 271, 390]. [387, 388, 389, 271, 390].
RDL_13_2 - 通过基线比较泄露评估上下文窗口中的数据。 RDL_13_2 - Evaluation Context Window Data Leakage Through Baseline Comparison. 基线比较智能体会将完整的既往评估结果加载到上下文中，以进行比较。 Baseline comparison agents load complete prior evaluation results into context for comparison. 在基线包含历史敏感数据的多智能体系统中（例如，测试数据集中的既往用户查询、基线描述中的既往系统配置），上下文窗口会泄露信息。 In multi-agent systems where baselines contain historical sensitive data (prior user queries in test datasets, prior system configurations in baseline descriptions), context windows leak information. 能够访问评估智能体上下文窗口的攻击者会提取比较基线中包含的历史数据。 Attackers accessing evaluation agent context windows extract historical data contained in comparison baselines. 与基于汇总指标进行的单次比较不同，多智能体基线加载会形成包含原始历史评估数据的大型上下文窗口。 Unlike singular comparisons operating on aggregated metrics, multi-agent baseline loading creates large context windows containing raw historical evaluation data. [225, 391, 392, 393, 256]. [225, 391, 392, 393, 256].
RDL_13_3 - 通过评估仪表板暴露测试数据集。 RDL_13_3 - Test Dataset Exposure Through Evaluation Dashboards. 展示测试用例样本和评估细节的多智能体评估仪表板会形成数据泄露途径。 Multi-agent evaluation dashboards displaying test case samples and evaluation details create data leakage vectors. 在为提高透明度而展示测试用例示例的系统中，攻击者会提取有价值的示例，从中获知评估数据集的模式。 In systems showing example test cases for transparency, attackers extract valuable examples revealing evaluation dataset patterns. 与样本可见性有限的运行监控仪表板不同，多智能体评估仪表板会展示分布于多个智能体的样本，导致评估数据集在多个仪表板智能体之间形成聚合暴露。 Unlike operational dashboards with limited sample visibility, multi-agent evaluation dashboards showing distributed samples across multiple agents create aggregated exposure of evaluation datasets across dashboard agents. [277, 276, 280, 289]. [277, 276, 280, 289].
RDL_13_4 - 评估产物存储泄露。 RDL_13_4 - Evaluation Artifact Storage Leakage. 评估流水线会在存储系统中保存产物（生成的报告、详细日志、中间计算结果）。 Evaluation pipelines maintain artifacts (generated reports, detailed logs, intermediate calculations) in storage systems. 在评估产物分散存储于各评估智能体的多智能体评估中，攻破存储访问权限的攻击者能够全面了解评估过程。 In multi-agent evaluation with distributed artifact storage across evaluation agents, attackers compromising storage access gain comprehensive visibility into evaluation process. 与采用集中式存储的单体评估不同，多智能体分布式产物存储会产生多个访问点，其中任何存储位置遭到攻破都会泄露评估机密。 Unlike singular evaluation with centralized storage, multi-agent distributed artifact storage creates multiple access points where compromise at any storage location leaks evaluation secrets. [394, 395, 396, 397, 398, 399, 289, 110, 400, 266, 265, 267]. [394, 395, 396, 397, 398, 399, 289, 110, 400, 266, 265, 267].
RDL_13_5 - 通过详细错误消息泄露评估日志信息。 RDL_13_5 - Evaluation Log Leakage Through Detailed Error Messages. 评估脚本会记录全面的信息以供调试，包括测试输入、模型输出、中间推理步骤、工具调用和错误详情。 Evaluation scripts log comprehensive information for debugging including test inputs, model outputs, intermediate reasoning steps, tool invocations, and error details. 评估智能体通常会记录详细的执行信息，包括响应、准确率、延迟、共情得分、合规标记和效率指标。 Evaluation agents typically record detailed execution information including responses, accuracy, latency, empathy scores, compliance flags, and efficiency metrics. 如果日志可被访问，或者详细信息通过错误消息泄露，攻击者就能了解评估逻辑，从而实施规避。 If logs are accessible or if detailed information is leaked through error messages, attackers gain understanding of evaluation logic enabling evasion. 多智能体特有之处：多智能体评估日志会向任何能够访问日志的智能体暴露所有智能体的执行细节，使攻击者能够从其他智能体记录的行为中了解评估模式。 Multi-agent distinction: Multi-agent evaluation logs expose all agents’ execution details to any agent accessing logs, enabling attackers learning evaluation patterns from other agents’ logged behavior. [391, 229, 257, 225]. [391, 229, 257, 225].
RDL_13_6 - 利用指标输出指纹识别进行评估架构侦察。 RDL_13_6 - Metric Output Fingerprinting for Evaluation Architecture Reconnaissance. 自定义评估指标会产生特定的输出格式，使攻击者能够通过指纹识别确定实现了哪些指标及其实现方式。 Custom evaluation metrics produce specific output formats enabling attackers to fingerprint which metrics are implemented and how. 共情指标生成介于 0-1 之间且具有特定分布的得分，会暴露共情指标的实现方式；策略合规指标对任何违规行为均输出 0.0，则会暴露合规检查的严格程度。 An empathy metric producing scores between 0-1 with specific distribution reveals empathy implementation; policy compliance producing 0.0 for any violation reveals compliance strictness. 了解指标实现方式的攻击者能够构造专门用于操纵这些实现的输入。 Attackers learning metric implementations can craft inputs specifically designed to manipulate those implementations. 多智能体特有之处：多智能体评估暴露每个智能体的指标，使攻击者能够了解所有智能体评估中实现的全部指标。 Multi-agent distinction: Multi-agent evaluation exposing each agent’s metrics enables attackers learning all implemented metrics across all agents’ evaluations. [401, 402, 403, 404, 405, 406, 407]。 [401, 402, 403, 404, 405, 406, 407].
RDL_13_7 - 用于推断行为模式的评估结果时序分析。 RDL_13_7 - Evaluation Result Temporal Analysis for Behavior Pattern Inference. 随着智能体更新或模型微调，评估结果会随时间发生变化。 Evaluation results change over time as agents are updated or models are fine-tuned. 攻击者通过分析指标变化的时序模式，可以推断进行了哪些更改以及智能体如何演变，从而实施定向投毒。 Attackers analyzing temporal patterns of metric changes could infer what changes were made and how agents are evolving, enabling targeted poisoning. 多智能体场景的区别：对所有智能体进行跨智能体时序分析，会揭示分布式变更的模式，使攻击者能够协调针对不同智能体的变更。 Multi-agent distinction: Multi-agent temporal analysis across all agents reveals patterns of distributed changes enabling attackers coordinating changes across agents. [408, 37, 409, 410, 411]。 [408, 37, 409, 410, 411].
RDL_13_8 - 通过结果聚合泄露交叉验证数据集。 RDL_13_8 - Cross-Validation Dataset Leakage Through Result Aggregation. 如果评估采用交叉验证（将数据划分为 K 折），则会汇总各折的结果以生成最终指标。 If evaluation uses cross-validation (splitting data into K folds), each fold’s results are aggregated to produce final metrics. 分析各折的结果可能揭示哪些具体测试用例或领域更难（从而暴露数据集结构）。 Analyzing individual fold results could reveal which specific test cases or domains are harder (revealing dataset structure). 这些信息使攻击者能够构造针对特定领域的攻击。 This information enables crafting domain-specific attacks. 多智能体场景的区别：在由不同智能体处理不同折的多智能体交叉验证中，攻击者能够从其他智能体的结果中获知各折特有的模式。 Multi-agent distinction: Multi-agent cross-validation where different agents process different folds enables attackers learning fold-specific patterns from other agents’ results. [412, 413, 414, 398, 415]。 [412, 413, 414, 398, 415].
RDL_13_9 - 通过审批日志泄露基准测试结果。 RDL_13_9 - Benchmark Result Leakage Through Approval Logs. 在多智能体系统中，审批日志记录哪些智能体批准了哪些决策，并附上基准测试表现作为依据。 In multi-agent systems, approval logs record which agents approved which decisions with benchmark performance attached as justification. 攻击者通过从日志中提取基准测试性能数据来利用这种泄露，从而了解智能体的能力和漏洞。 Attackers exploit this leakage by extracting benchmark performance data from logs revealing agent capabilities and vulnerabilities. 关于智能体通过或未通过哪些基准测试的信息泄露，使攻击者能够设计利用特定失效模式的定向攻击。 Information leakage about which benchmarks agents pass/fail enables attackers designing targeted attacks exploiting specific failure modes. 多智能体场景的区别：单智能体日志泄露的是个体性能；汇总各智能体审批记录的多智能体日志会形成比较数据，使攻击者能够识别较弱的智能体并将其作为攻击目标。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-agent logs leak individual performance; multi-agent logging aggregating approvals across agents creates comparative data enabling attackers to identify weaker agents for targeting. [366, 407, 256, 257, 294]。 [366, 407, 256, 257, 294].
III-B12 RDL_14 - 反馈与测试III-B12 RDL_14 - Feedback and Testing
RDL_14_1 - 通过提取用户反馈构建智能体漏洞画像。 RDL_14_1 - User Feedback Extraction as Agent Vulnerability Profiling. 在多智能体系统中，用户反馈存储在可访问的日志中，其中描述了失效模式。 In multi-agent systems, user feedback is stored in accessible logs describing failure modes. 攻击者通过分析已存储的反馈来识别系统性缺陷，从而有针对性地攻陷智能体。“用户报告称，即使上下文中已有相关信息，智能体 X 仍经常回答‘我不知道’”，这就勾勒出了智能体 X 的漏洞特征。 Attackers analyzing stored feedback identify systematic failures enabling targeted compromise. ”Users report Agent X frequently says ’I don’t know’ when information available in context” profiles Agent X vulnerability. 多智能体场景的区别：单智能体反馈揭示该智能体的弱点；多智能体共享反馈库支持比较分析，从而识别相较于其他智能体具有特定可利用漏洞的智能体 [60, 256]。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-agent feedback reveals that agent’s weaknesses; multi-agent shared feedback repositories enable comparative analysis identifying agents with specific exploitable vulnerabilities relative to peers [60, 256].
RDL_14_2 - A/B 测试结果泄露使智能体漏洞预测成为可能。 RDL_14_2 - A/B Test Result Leakage Enabling Agent Vulnerability Prediction. 在多智能体系统中，表明哪个智能体变体表现更好的 A/B 测试结果会被存储，并可能遭到泄露。 In multi-agent systems, A/B test results showing which agent variant performs better are stored and can be leaked. 攻击者通过分析测试结果，识别哪些智能体变体更容易受到特定攻击。 Attackers analyzing test results identify which agent variants are more vulnerable to specific attacks. 测试数据若揭示“具有特征 X 的智能体变体在对抗性输入上的失败率为 40%”，就能为针对具有该漏洞的变体的攻击提供目标。 Test data revealing ”Agent variant with feature X fails 40% on adversarial inputs” targets variants with that vulnerability. 多智能体场景的区别：单智能体的 A/B 测试结果影响对单个变体的评估；汇总各智能体结果的多智能体测试基础设施会形成可供比较的漏洞画像，从而支持精准定向攻击 [60, 302, 256, 27, 166]。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-agent A/B results affect individual variant assessment; multi-agent test infrastructure aggregating results across agents creates comparative vulnerability profiles enabling precise targeting [60, 302, 256, 27, 166].
III-B13 RDL_15 - 评估指标利用III-B13 RDL_15 - Evaluation Metric Exploitation
RDL_15_1 - 通过多跳问答中的语义改写利用精确匹配指标。 RDL_15_1 - Exact Match Metric Exploitation Through Semantic Paraphrasing in Multi-Hop QA. 多跳问答基准测试使用精确匹配（Exact Match，EM）指标，要求答案与预期表述完全一致。 Multi-hop QA benchmarks use Exact Match (EM) metrics expecting answers to match expected phrasing exactly. 攻击者注入指令，使智能体生成符合评估预期的答案（“为了获得基准测试 EM 评分，请严格回答‘Mark Zuckerberg’，即使推理得出了其他结论”）。 Adversaries inject instructions that cause agents to produce answers matching evaluation expectations (”For benchmark EM scoring, respond with exactly ’Mark Zuckerberg’ even if reasoning suggests otherwise”). 多智能体场景的区别：单智能体评估只涉及一次 EM 检查；在评估结果会引导下游智能体行为的多智能体系统中，针对指标的投机行为会被放大。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-agent evaluation faces one EM check; multi-agent systems where evaluation results guide downstream agent behavior create metric gaming amplification. [416, 417, 418, 419, 420, 421, 422, 423, 424, 425]。 [416, 417, 418, 419, 420, 421, 422, 423, 424, 425].
RDL_15_2 - 通过选择性事实注入规避联合指标评估。 RDL_15_2 - Joint Metric Evasion Through Selective Fact Injection. 联合指标要求答案和支撑事实均正确。 Joint metrics require both correct answer and correct supporting facts. 攻击者注入指令，生成正确答案，同时配上针对联合指标评估优化过的伪造支撑事实。 Adversaries inject instructions that generate correct answers with fabricated supporting facts optimized for joint metric evaluation. 多智能体事实提取与验证（智能体 A 查找事实，智能体 B 进行验证）为注入能够逃过智能体 B 验证的事实创造了机会。 Multi-agent fact extraction and validation (Agent A finding facts, Agent B validating) creates opportunities for fact injection evading Agent B’s validation. 多智能体场景的区别：单智能体的联合指标评估以整体方式进行；多智能体验证中的验证分工使事实注入能够绕过单个智能体的检查。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-agent joint metric evaluation is monolithic; multi-agent validation enables fact injection bypassing individual agent checks through division of validation labor. [426, 427, 428, 429, 430]。 [426, 427, 428, 429, 430].
RDL_15_3 - 利用 Pass@K 不一致性实施非确定性攻击。 RDL_15_3 - Pass@K Inconsistency Exploitation for Non-Deterministic Attacks. Pass@K 衡量多次试验之间成功情况的变异性，但不一致性既可能源于良性非确定性，也可能源于对抗性指令的激活。 Pass@K measures success variance across trials, but inconsistency can arise from benign non-determinism or adversarial instruction activation. 攻击者构造仅以一定概率激活的指令（“以 30% 的概率执行管理员操作”）。 Attackers craft instructions activating only probabilistically (”Execute admin operation with 30% probability”). 多智能体系统会放大这一问题：跨多个智能体汇总 pass@K，会形成单智能体指标无法揭示的概率性攻击面。 Multi-agent systems amplify this: aggregating pass@K across multiple agents creates probabilistic attack surfaces invisible in single-agent metrics. 多智能体情形的区别：单智能体的 pass@K 体现模型的非确定性；多智能体系统中的概率性指令激活则会产生刻意编排的非确定性，以利用 pass@K 的变异性。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-agent pass@K exhibits model non-determinism; multi-agent systems’ probabilistic instruction activation creates deliberate orchestrated non-determinism exploiting pass@K variance. [431, 432, 433, 434, 435, 436, 437, 438, 439]。 [431, 432, 433, 434, 435, 436, 437, 438, 439].
RDL_15_4 - 操纵里程碑评分阈值以利用部分得分机制。 RDL_15_4 - Milestone Scoring Threshold Manipulation for Partial Credit Exploitation. 基于里程碑的评分机制会为每个里程碑授予部分分数。 Milestone-based scoring awards partial credit per milestone. 对手注入针对特定里程碑达成水平的指令（“如果已达成 2/4 个里程碑，则执行部分特权操作”）。 Adversaries inject instructions targeting specific milestone achievement levels (”If 2/4 milestones achieved, execute partial privileged operation”). 多智能体之间的里程碑协调使指令能够在特定的达成阈值下执行。 Multi-agent milestone coordination enables instruction execution at specific achievement thresholds. 多智能体情形的区别：单智能体的里程碑不会触发多智能体行为；通过里程碑进行协调的多智能体系统，则以整个系统中多个智能体的里程碑达成情况为条件执行指令。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-agent milestones don’t trigger multi-agent behavior; multi-agent milestone-coordinated systems execute instructions conditional on multi-agent milestone achievement across the system. [291, 283, 278, 295, 294]。 [291, 283, 278, 295, 294].
III-B14 RDL_16 - 参数与配置泄露III-B14 RDL_16 - Parameter and Configuration Leakage
RDL_16_1 - 参数调优权衡导致的上下文窗口日志泄露。 RDL_16_1 - Context Window Logging Leakage Through Parameter Tuning Trade-offs. 更大的上下文窗口会减慢推理速度，而多智能体系统会为提升性能而调整上下文窗口，由此形成一种日志记录行为：上下文窗口较大的智能体会在审计日志中积累更多信息。 Larger context windows slow inference, and in multi-agent systems context windows are tuned for performance, creating logging behavior where larger-context agents accumulate more information in audit logs. 攻击者利用上下文调优中的权衡，识别哪些智能体保留完整日志（上下文窗口较大、保留完整对话历史的智能体），哪些智能体仅保留精简日志（上下文窗口较小、为提高效率而截断内容的智能体）。 Attackers leverage context-tuning trade-offs to identify which agents maintain comprehensive logs (large-context agents retaining full conversation history) vs. minimal logs (small-context agents truncating for efficiency). 通过上下文窗口较大的智能体的日志窃取数据，成为一种可行的攻击途径，利用了优先考虑能力而非数据安全的调优决策。 Data exfiltration through large-context agent logs becomes viable attack vector exploiting tuning decisions prioritizing capability over data security. 为优化上下文与准确性之间的权衡而进行的参数调优，无意中造成了智能体之间的信息泄露差异。 The parameter tuning to optimize context-accuracy trade-off inadvertently creates leakage differentials across agents. [440, 393, 441, 35, 227, 214, 442, 235, 225, 443]。 [440, 393, 441, 35, 227, 214, 442, 235, 225, 443].
RDL_16_2 - 成本优化调优导致的词元消耗模式泄露。 RDL_16_2 - Token Consumption Pattern Leakage Through Cost-Optimized Tuning. 以成本优化为目标的路由通常会将 70–80% 的查询归类为简单查询，并将其路由至成本较低的模型，同时将 20–30% 的查询路由至能力更强的模型。 Cost-optimized routing typically classifies 70–80% of queries as simple and routes them to less expensive models, with 20–30% routed to more capable models. 当对手能够观察计费或遥测数据时，词元消耗模式可能暴露查询复杂度的分布，从而使推断攻击成为可能。 Token consumption patterns can reveal query complexity distribution when billing or telemetry data is observable by adversaries, enabling inference attacks. 攻击者通过观察哪些查询触发了向高成本模型的路由（词元使用量高）来推断敏感信息——GPT-4 使用量突然激增，可能表明出现了高价值查询或安全事件。 Attackers observing which queries trigger expensive model routing (high token usage) infer sensitive information—sudden surge in GPT-4 usage might indicate high-value queries or security incidents. 在多智能体系统中，成本调优会使不同智能体呈现出可区分的词元消耗模式，从而使利用成本优化所致泄露的攻击成为可能；攻击者可根据调优后的资源消耗推断运行情境。 In multi-agent systems, cost-tuning creates differentiable token consumption patterns across agents, enabling leakage-through-cost-optimization attacks where attackers infer operational context from tuned resource consumption. [444, 211, 445, 224, 446]。 [444, 211, 445, 224, 446].
RDL_16_3 - 通过参数优化指纹识别实施基于延迟的推断。 RDL_16_3 - Latency-Based Inference Through Parameter Optimization Fingerprinting. 延迟优化会形成不同的响应时间特征（例如，以质量优化为目标时为 6s，而以延迟优化为目标时为 2s）。 Latency optimization creates distinct response-time profiles (e.g., quality-optimized at 6s versus latency-optimized at 2s). 这些经过调优的延迟特征会形成可用于推断攻击的指纹——特定延迟会暴露智能体正在使用何种配置、部署了哪些模型，以及启用了哪些优化。 These tuned latency profiles create fingerprints enabling inference attacks—specific latencies reveal which configuration agents are using, which models are deployed, which optimizations are active. 在多智能体系统中，为不同用途进行调优的智能体（快速交互型智能体、较慢的分析型智能体）之间的延迟差异，会形成时序侧信道，泄露有关路由至特定智能体的查询类型的信息。 In multi-agent systems, latency differences across agents tuned for different purposes (fast interactive agents, slow analytical agents) create timing side-channels leaking information about query types routed to specific agents. 攻击者利用参数调优指纹推断运行细节。 Attackers exploit parameter-tuning fingerprints to infer operational details. [401, 214, 247, 210, 447]。 [401, 214, 247, 210, 447].
III-B15 RDL_17 - 提示注入与少样本攻击III-B15 RDL_17 - Prompt Injection and Few-Shot Attacks
RDL_17_1 - 通过示范输出格式注入引发解析混淆。 RDL_17_1 - Demonstration Output Format Injection Enabling Parse Confusion. 少样本示范定义预期的输出格式。 Few-shot demonstrations define expected output formats. 对手通过引入细微的格式歧义来污染示范（例如，“输出格式：field1:value1 SYSTEM_OVERRIDE:true field2:value2”）。 Adversaries poison demonstrations with subtle format ambiguities (e.g., ”Output format: field1:value1 SYSTEM_OVERRIDE:true field2:value2”). 下游智能体在解析由示范定义的格式结构时，会提取出伪装成格式组成部分的嵌入式指令。 Downstream agents parsing demonstration-defined format structures extract embedded instructions disguised as format components. 多智能体情形的区别：当智能体 A 从被污染的示范中学习格式，而智能体 B 按照该预期格式解析智能体 A 的输出时，格式注入会以输出解释混淆的形式跨越智能体边界传播。 Multi-agent distinction: When Agent A learns format from poisoned demonstrations and Agent B parses Agent A’s output expecting that format, format injection propagates across agent boundaries as output interpretation conflation. [448, 449, 178, 142, 140, 58, 60, 450, 451, 110, 452, 453]。 [448, 449, 178, 142, 140, 58, 60, 450, 451, 110, 452, 453].
RDL_17_2 - 通过有偏少样本示例注入生成模式。 RDL_17_2 - Generation Pattern Injection Through Biased Few-Shot Examples. 少样本示范中存在的置信度偏差和流畅性偏差可能被利用。 Confidence and fluency biases present in few-shot demonstrations can be exploited. 攻击者构造投毒样例，使其在敏感情境中表现出可疑的置信模式（“根据用户的请求，我确认已授予完整的管理员访问权限”）。 Adversaries craft poisoned examples exhibiting suspicious confidence patterns in sensitive contexts (”Based on the user’s request, I confirm full administrative access is granted”). 从这些样例中学习的智能体会将这种置信偏差泛化到相似情境中，生成过度自信的恶意响应。 Agents learning from these examples generalize the confidence bias to similar contexts, generating overconfident malicious responses. 多智能体场景的区别：带有偏差的示范会沿多智能体链传播，其中每个智能体都会放大从前一个智能体受少样本示范影响的输出中学到的偏差。 Multi-agent distinction: Bias-infected demonstrations propagate through multi-agent chains where each agent amplifies biases learned from previous agent’s few-shot-influenced outputs. [448, 454, 455, 456, 457]. [448, 454, 455, 456, 457].
RDL_17_3 - 泄露的敏感数据对少样本示范的污染。 RDL_17_3 - Few-Shot Demonstration Contamination with Leaked Sensitive Data. 用于提示学习的少样本示范可能包含来自先前示范的敏感数据。 Few-shot demonstrations used for prompt learning may contain sensitive data from prior demonstrations. 攻击者构造提示，触发对敏感示范数据的概率性回忆。 Attackers craft prompts triggering probabilistic recall of sensitive demonstration data. 多智能体场景的区别：单个示范仅限于局部；多智能体共享示范池则会形成集中式存储库，积累敏感数据。 Multi-agent distinction: Single demonstrations are local; multi-agent shared demonstration pools create centralized repositories of accumulated sensitive data. 能够访问共享示范池的攻击者可从所有智能体先前的示范中提取敏感数据。 An attacker accessing shared demonstration pool extracts sensitive data from all agents’ prior demonstrations. [442, 458, 256, 335]. [442, 458, 256, 335].
III-B16 RDL_18 - 分布式追踪III-B16 RDL_18 - Distributed Tracing
