RDL_18_1 - 通过关联 ID 和跨度数据造成的分布式追踪泄露。 RDL_18_1 - Distributed Tracing Leakage Through Correlation IDs and Span Data. 分布式追踪系统（OpenTelemetry、Jaeger、Zipkin）通过两种机制导致工作流信息的全面泄露：(1) 追踪 ID 关联——日志中的追踪 ID 会暴露完整的操作链和工作流结构，使攻击者能够理解并利用工作流依赖关系；(2) 后端中的跨度（span）数据——存储的跨度包含流水线中每个智能体的中间结果，攻陷追踪后端即可访问完整的请求追踪记录，从中查看跨智能体的所有中间输出和数据流。 Distributed tracing systems (OpenTelemetry, Jaeger, Zipkin) create comprehensive workflow leakage through two mechanisms: (1) Trace ID correlation - trace IDs in logs reveal complete operation chains and workflow structure, enabling attackers to understand and exploit workflow dependencies; (2) Span data in backends - stored spans contain intermediate results from each agent in the pipeline, and compromising tracing backends provides access to complete request traces showing all intermediate outputs and data flows across agents. 多智能体场景的区别：单智能体的操作局限于自身范围内；多智能体分布式追踪则会形成持久的审计轨迹和全面的请求映射，暴露系统拓扑、智能体协调方式以及完整的数据流，使攻击者能够重建整个多智能体工作流。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-agent operations remain contained; multi-agent distributed traces create persistent audit trails and comprehensive request maps revealing system topology, agent coordination, and complete data flows, enabling attackers to reconstruct entire multi-agent workflows. [459, 460]. [459, 460].
RDL_18_2 - 响应模式验证日志侧信道。 RDL_18_2 - Response Schema Validation Log Side Channels. 响应验证会记录哪些模式未通过验证。 Response validation logs which schemas fail. 在采用异构模式的多智能体系统中，哪些智能体拒绝哪些响应格式所呈现的规律，会泄露有关智能体配置的信息。 In multi-agent systems with heterogeneous schemas, patterns of which agents reject which response formats reveal information about agent configurations. 攻击者利用这些信息推断目标智能体的类型，并定制攻击。 Attackers use this to infer target agent types and customize attacks. 多智能体场景的区别：单一验证仅产生一种模式验证失败类型；多智能体异构验证则会通过失败规律泄露有关智能体类型的信息。 Multi-agent distinction: Singular validation produces one schema failure type; multi-agent heterogeneous validation creates information leakage about agent types through failure patterns. [461, 462, 463, 408, 464]. [461, 462, 463, 408, 464].
III-B17 RDL_19 - 执行与编排III-B17 RDL_19 - Execution and Orchestration
RDL_19_1 - 错误消息和渐进式披露中的执行路径泄露。 RDL_19_1 - Execution Path Disclosure in Error Messages and Progressive Disclosure. 在采用共享错误处理机制的多智能体系统中，一个智能体扩充的错误详情可能会泄露另一个智能体的执行路径。 In multi-agent systems with shared error handling, one agent’s expanded error details might disclose another agent’s execution paths. 智能体 B 收到来自智能体 A 的错误消息：“在步骤 3 失败：对 account_id=12345 进行参数验证”。 Agent B receives error from Agent A saying ”Failed at step 3: parameter validation for account_id=12345”. 多智能体场景的区别：每个智能体的错误详情都会跨越智能体边界泄露执行细节。 Multi-agent distinction: Each agent’s error details leak execution details across agent boundaries. 单智能体本可将错误上下文限制在自身范围内。 Single agents would have contained error context. 多智能体分布式错误处理会造成“错误累积”：错误详情在多个智能体之间传播，每个智能体都会添加上下文，最终形成可通过聚合错误查看的详细执行轨迹。 Multi-agent distributed error handling creates ”error accumulation” where error details propagate through multiple agents each adding context, ultimately creating detailed execution traces visible through aggregated errors. [465, 236, 466, 467, 468]. [465, 236, 466, 467, 468].
RDL_19_2 - 参数溯源追踪丢失造成归因缺口。 RDL_19_2 - Parameter Provenance Tracking Loss Creating Attribution Gaps. 参数溯源追踪使用来源注解来标识参数的来源。 Parameter provenance tracking uses source annotations to identify parameter origins. 在多智能体交接过程中，溯源信息往往无法得到妥善的序列化。 In multi-agent handoff, provenance information often serializes poorly. 智能体 A 记录“参数 amount=500（来源：user_input）”，智能体 B 收到的 JSON 输出为 "amount": 500，其中没有来源注解。 Agent A logs ”parameter amount=500 (source: user_input)”, Agent B receives JSON output ”amount”: 500 without source annotation. 多智能体场景的区别：溯源信息丢失会造成“归因失忆”，使下游智能体无法追溯参数的来源。 Multi-agent distinction: Provenance loss creates ”attribution amnesia” where downstream agents can’t trace parameter origins. 攻击者通过对早期智能体的输出进行投毒，可以将恶意参数传播到下游，而其来源无法被察知。 An attacker poisoning early agent outputs can propagate malicious parameters downstream without visibility into where they originated. 安全验证要求确认“来自外部来源的参数均经过验证”——但多智能体溯源信息丢失使人无法判断参数究竟确实来自外部，还是在内部被伪造的。 Security validation requires knowing ”parameters from external sources are validated”—but multi-agent provenance loss prevents knowing whether parameter truly originated externally or was fabricated internally. [258, 469, 233, 470, 471]. [258, 469, 233, 470, 471].
III-B18 RDL_20 - 多智能体推理III-B18 RDL_20 - Multi-Agent Reasoning
RDL_20_1 - 编排器推理质量的级联效应。 RDL_20_1 - Orchestrator Reasoning Quality Cascading Effects. 中央编排智能体通过对多智能体协调进行推理，决定所有工作智能体遵循的执行模式。 Central orchestrator agents reasoning about multi-agent coordination determine execution patterns that all worker agents follow. 当编排器的目标对齐较差（在推理协调事宜时偏离原始目标）时，它们可能会将注入的逻辑嵌入所有工作智能体都会执行的协调决策中。 When orchestrators exhibit poor goal-alignment (losing sight of original objectives while reasoning about coordination), they can embed injected logic in coordination decisions that all workers execute. 多智能体特有之处：编排器的集中式推理具有不成比例的影响力——一个编排器的推理缺陷会影响所有下游智能体。 Multi-agent distinction: The centralized reasoning of orchestrators has outsized impact—one orchestrator’s reasoning flaws affect all downstream agents. 单个智能体的推理缺陷仅影响该智能体；编排器的推理缺陷则会影响整个多智能体系统。 A singular agent’s flawed reasoning affects only that agent; an orchestrator’s flawed reasoning affects entire multi-agent systems. [472, 236, 282, 27, 198, 473, 474, 475, 466, 476]。 [472, 236, 282, 27, 198, 473, 474, 475, 466, 476].
RDL_20_2 - 监督智能体委派推理的透明性悖论。 RDL_20_2 - Supervisor Delegation Reasoning Transparency Paradox. 监督智能体会对任务委派进行推理，而监督智能体推理的显式透明性可能为攻击提供可乘之机。 Supervisor agents reason about task delegation, and explicit transparency in supervisor reasoning can enable attacks. 当监督智能体的推理明确指出“将此任务委派给 Agent B，无需额外验证”时，这种透明的推理会使攻击者能够利用该委派模式。 When supervisor reasoning explicitly states ”delegate this to Agent B with no additional validation,” the transparent reasoning enables attackers to exploit the delegation pattern. 多智能体特有之处：原本旨在支持人类监督的透明性，反而使攻击者能够查看并操纵委派逻辑。 Multi-agent distinction: The transparency intended to enable human oversight instead enables attackers to see and manipulate the delegation logic. 单个智能体无法委派任务；多智能体系统产生了编排器推理，而这种推理恰恰因其透明性而成为攻击面。 Singular agents cannot delegate; multi-agent systems create orchestrator reasoning that becomes an attack surface precisely because of its transparency. [46, 471, 282, 186, 467]。 [46, 471, 282, 186, 467].
RDL_20_3 - 多智能体推理连贯性验证。 RDL_20_3 - Multi-Agent Reasoning Coherence Validation. 任何单个智能体都无法跨越多智能体边界验证系统层面的推理连贯性。 No single agent can validate system-level reasoning coherence across multi-agent boundaries. 某个智能体在局部推理中认定“此任务是安全的”，但从系统整体情境来看，该任务可能并不安全，而智能体之间并未进行跨边界的连贯性验证。 An agent reasoning ”this task is safe” locally might be globally unsafe in system context, but no coherence validation occurs across agent boundaries. 攻击者构造出单个智能体推理合理、但系统层面推理不连贯的情境，利用没有任何单个智能体进行验证的缺口。 Attackers craft scenarios where individual agent reasoning is sound but system-level reasoning is incoherent, exploiting gaps no individual agent validates. 多智能体特有之处：单个智能体验证自身的推理；多智能体系统则缺乏系统层面的连贯性验证机制。 Multi-agent distinction: Singular agents perform their own reasoning validation; multi-agent systems lack system-level coherence validation mechanisms. [477, 471, 478, 479, 480]。 [477, 471, 478, 479, 480].
RDL_20_4 - 共识推理利用。 RDL_20_4 - Consensus Reasoning Exploitation. 当多个智能体对决策进行推理并尝试达成共识时，个体推理的信息量不足，会使注入内容得以隐藏在对共识投票没有影响、也不作出贡献的推理中。 When multiple agents reason about decisions and attempt consensus, weak informativeness in individual reasoning enables injections hidden in non-contributory reasoning that doesn’t affect consensus voting. 推理信息量较低（冗长但缺乏有效信息）的智能体，可以在缺乏有效信息的部分注入指令，而其他智能体在共识验证过程中会忽略这些指令。 An agent with low-informativeness reasoning (verbose but non-informative) can inject instructions in non-informative portions that other agents miss during consensus validation. 多智能体特有之处：共识机制假定所有参与者都进行独立推理，但低信息量部分中的注入内容利用了注意力分配的不对称性，即高信息量的推理受到仔细审查，而低信息量的部分则被信任 [481, 482, 483, 484, 87, 485]。 Multi-agent distinction: Consensus mechanisms assume independent reasoning from all participants, but injections in low-informativeness portions exploit asymmetric attention where high-informativeness reasoning gets scrutinized but low-informativeness portions are trusted [481, 482, 483, 484, 87, 485].
III-B19 RDL_21 - 效率与成本归因III-B19 RDL_21 - Efficiency and Cost Attribution
RDL_21_1 - 效率日志作为信息泄露途径。 RDL_21_1 - Efficiency Logs as Information Leakage Vector. 效率监控会记录词元消耗量、API 调用、延迟测量值和缓存命中率。 Efficiency monitoring logs token consumption, API calls, latency measurements, cache hit rates. 这些日志包含有关所执行操作和所处理数据的汇总信息。 These logs contain aggregate information about operations and data processed. 攻击者通过分析效率日志推断敏感信息——词元消耗量的异常激增表明正在处理大型文档，API 调用模式揭示所访问的数据，缓存命中与未命中的比例则暗示数据的受欢迎程度。 Attackers analyzing efficiency logs infer sensitive information—unusual token spikes indicating processing of large documents, API call patterns revealing accessed data, cache hit/miss ratios suggesting data popularity. 多智能体特有之处：单智能体日志会泄露有关该智能体处理活动的信息；多智能体系统日志则会泄露跨智能体模式，揭示整个系统的数据流与处理活动，使攻击者能够根据汇总的效率指标重建敏感信息 [227, 214, 440, 218, 210, 446, 225]。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-agent logs leak information about that agent’s processing; multi-agent system logs leak cross-agent patterns revealing overall system data flows and processing, enabling attackers reconstructing sensitive information from aggregate efficiency metrics [227, 214, 440, 218, 210, 446, 225].
RDL_21_2 - 成本归因元数据导致敏感信息泄露。 RDL_21_2 - Cost Attribution Metadata as Sensitive Information Leakage. 效率系统会将成本归因于具体的操作、任务和工作流。 Efficiency systems attribute costs to specific operations, tasks, and workflows. 成本归因元数据揭示了哪些处理活动成本高昂（成本高昂 = 复杂 = 可能涉及敏感信息）。 Cost attribution metadata reveals what processing is expensive (expensive = complex = potentially sensitive). 攻击者通过分析成本模式推断出“操作 X 的成本为 $50，而操作 Y 的成本为 $0.50”，这暗示 X 处理的是需要高成本安全操作的敏感数据。 Attackers analyzing cost patterns infer that ”operation X costs $50 while operation Y costs $0.50” suggesting X processes sensitive data requiring expensive security operations. 多智能体特有之处：单智能体成本归因会泄露有关该智能体操作的信息；跨智能体的多智能体成本归因则使攻击者能够通过分析成本模式重建跨智能体数据流。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-agent cost attribution leaks information about that agent’s operations; multi-agent cost attribution across agents enables reconstructing cross-agent data flows through cost pattern analysis. [227, 214, 486, 487, 225]。 [227, 214, 486, 487, 225].
RDL_21_3 - 缓存性能指标揭示数据敏感性。 RDL_21_3 - Cache Performance Metrics Revealing Data Sensitivity. 缓存命中率反映数据的受欢迎程度或复用程度。 Cache hit rates indicate data popularity/reuse. 某些数据的缓存命中率较高，暗示其为经常被访问的敏感信息。 High cache hit rates for certain data suggest frequently-accessed sensitive information. 攻击者通过持续跟踪缓存指标来识别高价值目标。 Attackers tracking cache metrics over time identify high-value targets. 多智能体特有之处：单智能体缓存指标会泄露有关该智能体数据的信息；具有汇总缓存指标的多智能体共享缓存，则使攻击者能够推断哪些数据被多个智能体同时访问。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-agent cache metrics leak information about that agent’s data; multi-agent shared caches with aggregate cache metrics enable attackers inferring which data is accessed by multiple agents simultaneously. [124, 218, 247, 210, 123, 488, 199]。 [124, 218, 247, 210, 123, 488, 199].
RDL_21_4 - 通过延迟异常模式推断载荷大小。 RDL_21_4 - Latency Anomaly Patterns Inferring Payload Size. 延迟变化与所处理的数据相关。 Latency variations correlate with data processed. 延迟异常的操作暗示数据规模异常——速度极快的操作处理的是小规模数据，速度缓慢的操作处理的是大规模数据或敏感数据。 Operations with unusual latency suggest unusual data sizes—very fast operations process small data, slow operations process large/sensitive data. 攻击者通过观察延迟模式，推断所处理数据的属性。 Attackers observing latency patterns infer processed data properties. 多智能体情境下的区别：单智能体的延迟会泄露该智能体的操作信息；多智能体的延迟模式则会揭示多个智能体共同处理数据时的同步点，从而可据此推断协同数据处理情况。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-agent latency leaks information about that agent’s operations; multi-agent latency patterns reveal synchronization points where multiple agents process data together, inferring collaborative data handling. [489, 490]. [489, 490].
RDL_21_5 - 效率仪表板暴露系统内部信息。 RDL_21_5 - Efficiency Dashboard Exposure of System Internals. 效率仪表板展示用于监控的指标，但用户或攻击者也可能访问这些仪表板。 Efficiency dashboards display metrics for monitoring, but dashboards can be accessed by users/attackers. 仪表板会揭示运行细节：智能体延迟表明存在哪些智能体，词元消耗模式反映处理复杂度，成本明细则反映系统架构。 Dashboards reveal operational details: agent latencies show which agents exist, token consumption patterns show processing complexity, cost breakdowns show system architecture. 多智能体情境下的区别：单智能体仪表板会泄露该智能体的信息；展示各智能体效率的多智能体仪表板则会揭示系统结构，使攻击者能够通过所展示的效率指标了解多智能体架构。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-agent dashboard leaks information about that agent; multi-agent dashboards displaying per-agent efficiency reveal system structure enabling attackers understanding multi-agent architecture from efficiency metrics display. [491, 492, 443, 389, 493]. [491, 492, 443, 389, 493].
RDL_21_6 - 用于行为推断的历史效率趋势分析。 RDL_21_6 - Historical Efficiency Trend Analysis for Behavioral Inference. 随时间记录的效率指标会揭示行为模式。 Efficiency metrics recorded over time reveal behavioral patterns. 攻击者通过分析历史效率趋势识别运行模式：“每周二，词元用量都会激增，表明可能在进行批处理。”“周五下午延迟增加，表明可能存在资源限制。” Attackers analyzing efficiency trend history identify operational patterns: ”Every Tuesday, token usage spikes suggesting batch processing,” ”Latency increases Friday afternoon suggesting resource constraints.” 这些模式揭示了依赖时间安排的处理活动。 Patterns reveal schedule-dependent processing. 多智能体情境下的区别：单智能体的趋势揭示该智能体的行为模式；对所有智能体进行多智能体趋势分析，则会揭示协调开展的多智能体处理模式以及系统范围内的行为时间安排。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-agent trends reveal that agent’s patterns; multi-agent trend analysis across all agents reveals coordinated multi-agent processing patterns and system-wide behavioral schedules. [225, 302, 494, 495, 496]. [225, 302, 494, 495, 496].
RDL_21_7 - 预算重新分配模式揭示运行优先级。 RDL_21_7 - Budget Reallocation Patterns Revealing Operational Priorities. 效率管理系统根据工作负载，在智能体之间动态重新分配预算。 Efficiency systems dynamically reallocate budgets between agents based on workload. 预算重新分配模式会揭示优先级——预算增加的智能体正在处理重要工作。 Budget reallocation patterns reveal priorities—agents getting increased budgets are processing important work. 攻击者通过跟踪预算分配变化，推断系统优先处理哪些任务。 Attackers tracking budget allocation changes infer what tasks system prioritizes. 多智能体情境下的区别：单智能体的预算变化表明该智能体的优先级；多智能体的预算重新分配模式则会揭示跨智能体协调情况以及系统整体运行重点的转移。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-agent budget changes indicate that agent’s priorities; multi-agent budget reallocation patterns reveal cross-agent coordination and system-wide operational focus shifts. [497, 498, 499, 500, 501]. [497, 498, 499, 500, 501].
III-B20 RDL_22 - 基础设施与部署III-B20 RDL_22 - Infrastructure and Deployment
RDL_22_1 - 通过任务关联泄露消息队列头部元数据。 RDL_22_1 - Message Queue Header Metadata Leakage Through Task Correlation. RabbitMQ 消息头包含关联 ID，用于连接工作流不同阶段的相关消息。 RabbitMQ message headers contain correlation IDs linking related messages across workflow stages. 攻击者通过分析关联模式，可以重建用户交互过程。 Attackers analyzing correlation patterns can reconstruct user interactions. 消息关联链揭示了用户 A 提交查询 → 转发给智能体 B → 从 RAG 检索 → 调用工具 C → 向用户 A 返回结果的过程。追踪关联 ID 会泄露用户工作流的细节。 Message correlation chain reveals user A submitted query → forwarded to Agent B → retrieved from RAG → called Tool C → returned result to User A. Tracing correlation IDs leaks user workflow details. 多智能体情境下的区别：单智能体系统具有单一的关联上下文。 Multi-agent distinction: Singular agent systems have single correlation context. 多智能体系统通过消息队列传播关联 ID，会形成分布式泄露面，其中跨多个智能体的关联链会揭示多步骤工作流。 Multi-agent systems propagating correlation IDs through message queues create distributed leakage surface where correlation chains across multiple agents reveal multi-step workflows. 与单智能体请求不同，多智能体工作流会生成多条相互关联的消息，其中的关联元数据会跨越智能体边界，泄露完整的用户交互序列。 Unlike singular agent requests, multi-agent workflows generate multiple linked messages where correlation metadata leaks entire user interaction sequences across agent boundaries. [368, 502, 178, 141, 391]. [368, 502, 178, 141, 391].
RDL_22_2 - 嵌入暴露导致向量数据库相似性搜索结果泄露。 RDL_22_2 - Vector Database Similarity Search Result Leakage Through Embedding Exposure. 当向量相似性查询不仅返回 ID，还返回嵌入向量本身时，攻击者可能通过嵌入反演恢复近似的原始文本。 When vector similarity queries return not just IDs but also embedding vectors themselves, attackers can potentially recover approximate original text through inverse embedding. 智能体跨边界共享嵌入，会泄露 RAG 语料库的语义信息。 Agents sharing embeddings across boundaries leak semantic information about RAG corpus. 多智能体情境下的区别：多个智能体针对共享向量数据库进行的 RAG 查询会造成累积泄露，每个智能体的 RAG 查询都会加剧泄露。 Multi-agent distinction: Shared vector database RAG queries by multiple agents create cumulative leakage where each agent’s RAG queries contribute to leak. 采用隔离 RAG 的单智能体，其单一查询流造成的泄露可能较少。 Singular agent with isolated RAG might leak less through single query stream. 在数十个智能体查询共享向量数据库的多智能体系统中，会形成 N 条并行泄露通道，攻击者通过观察所有查询模式，可综合恢复语料库结构 [442, 503, 504, 505, 506]。 Multi-agent systems where dozens of agents query shared vector database create N parallel leakage channels where attackers observing all query patterns collectively recover corpus structure [442, 503, 504, 505, 506].
RDL_22_3 - 标签基数与运行信息暴露导致 Prometheus 指标泄露。 RDL_22_3 - Prometheus Metrics Leakage Through Label Cardinality and Operational Exposure. Prometheus 指标通过多种途径暴露敏感信息：(1) 高基数标签——user_id、tool_name、agent_name、resource_id 等标签可通过标签组合支持流量分析和行为关联；(2) 自定义应用指标——删除操作、身份验证失败及其他运行细节会揭示敏感模式；(3) 智能体间通信模式——请求速率、延迟和队列深度（尤其是在 NIM/Triton 部署中）支持时间关联分析，从而揭示工作流编排逻辑。 Prometheus metrics expose sensitive information through multiple vectors: (1) High-cardinality labels - labels like user_id, tool_name, agent_name, resource_id enable traffic analysis and behavior correlation through label combinations; (2) Custom application metrics - deletion operations, authentication failures, and other operational details reveal sensitive patterns; (3) Inter-agent communication patterns - request rates, latencies, and queue depths (particularly in NIM/Triton deployments) enable temporal correlation revealing workflow orchestration logic. 当 Prometheus 端点无需身份验证即可访问时——这是内部部署中常见的配置错误——攻击者便可通过指标关联发现用户与智能体的交互、跨智能体行为模式，并重建多智能体架构。 When Prometheus endpoints are accessible without authentication — a common misconfiguration in internal deployments — attackers can discover user-agent interactions, cross-agent behavior patterns, and reconstruct multi-agent architecture through metric correlation. 多智能体特有之处：单智能体指标揭示孤立的行为；在多智能体系统中，覆盖整个智能体集群的 Prometheus 可创建集中式视图，通过指标标签组合和时序分析暴露完整的协调图、工作流依赖关系和决策树，实际上为架构侦察提供了蓝图 [507, 508]。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-agent metrics reveal isolated behavior; multi-agent systems with fleet-wide Prometheus create centralized views exposing complete coordination graphs, workflow dependencies, and decision trees through metric label combinations and temporal analysis, effectively providing blueprints for architecture reconnaissance [507, 508].
RDL_22_4 - 通过 API 网关访问日志关联重建用户活动。 RDL_22_4 - API Gateway Access Log Correlation for User Activity Reconstruction. Kong 记录所有请求，包括时间戳、来源/目的地和载荷。 Kong logs all requests with timestamps, source/destination, and payloads. 能够访问网关日志的攻击者可以关联请求，以重建用户工作流。 Attackers accessing gateway logs can correlate requests to reconstruct user workflows. 指向 /api/agents/analysis → /api/agents/validation → /api/agents/approval 的请求序列揭示了工作流的各个阶段。 Request sequence to /api/agents/analysis → /api/agents/validation → /api/agents/approval reveals workflow stages. 多智能体特有之处：单智能体日志显示单个请求-响应对。 Multi-agent distinction: Singular agent logs show single request-response pair. 多智能体系统日志以经过网关的关联请求链形式呈现完整的工作流。 Multi-agent system logs show complete workflows as correlated request chains through gateway. 日志关联支持跨智能体边界重建完整工作流，从而造成单智能体系统中不存在的取证数据泄露。 Log correlation enables complete workflow reconstruction across agent boundaries, creating forensic data leakage absent in singular systems. [509, 295, 294, 270]。 [509, 295, 294, 270].
RDL_22_5 - 通过版本历史泄露 MLflow 制品元数据。 RDL_22_5 - MLflow Artifact Metadata Leakage Through Versioning History. MLflow 维护所有制品（模型、提示词、配置）的完整版本历史，其元数据包括版本创建者、创建时间以及变更内容。 MLflow maintains complete version history of all artifacts (models, prompts, configs) with metadata including who created versions, when, and what changed. 能够访问 MLflow 的攻击者可以查看部署历史，了解哪些提示词失效、哪些被回退，从而根据修订模式推断安全问题和漏洞。 Attackers accessing MLflow can see deployment history revealing which prompts failed, which were reverted, enabling inference about security issues and vulnerabilities based on revision patterns. 多智能体特有之处：多智能体系统共享的 MLflow 部署历史使攻击者能够根据版本的频繁变动，推断哪些智能体难以应对特定攻击向量。 Multi-agent distinction: Shared MLflow deployment history across multi-agent system enables attackers inferring which agents struggle with specific attack vectors based on version churn. 单智能体的部署历史则是彼此隔离的。 Singular agent deployment history would be isolated. 多智能体共享的 MLflow 会造成取证信息泄露，攻击者可通过分析部署模式，利用跨智能体的版本历史模式发现系统漏洞。 Multi-agent shared MLflow creates forensic leakage where version history patterns across agents reveal system vulnerabilities through deployment pattern analysis. [510, 511, 512, 513]。 [510, 511, 512, 513].
RDL_22_6 - 可用于取证的消息队列死信队列内容泄露。 RDL_22_6 - Message Queue Dead-Letter Queue Content Leakage for Forensics. RabbitMQ DLQ（死信队列）会保留处理失败的消息，包括其载荷。 RabbitMQ DLQs (Dead-Letter Queues) preserve failed messages including payloads. 能够访问 DLQ 的攻击者可以读取所有处理失败的消息内容，从而了解曾尝试执行的操作、失败请求中的用户上下文以及错误详情。 Attackers accessing DLQs can read all failed message content revealing what operations were attempted, user context from failed requests, and error details. 多智能体特有之处：单智能体错误日志泄露的是单个智能体的错误。 Multi-agent distinction: Singular agent error logs leak single agent’s errors. 多智能体 DLQ 包含来自所有智能体的处理失败消息，从而形成一个全面的取证数据库。 Multi-agent DLQ contains failed messages from all agents, creating comprehensive forensic database. 能够访问共享 DLQ 的攻击者可以全面了解整个智能体集群中的故障，包括失败的操作、用户上下文和错误模式，从而全面重建工作流并识别漏洞。 Attackers accessing shared DLQ gain complete visibility into failures across entire agent fleet including failed operations, user contexts, and error patterns, enabling comprehensive workflow reconstruction and vulnerability identification. [233, 479, 257, 460]。 [233, 479, 257, 460].
RDL_22_7 - 集中式日志管道作为数据外传途径。 RDL_22_7 - Centralized Logging Pipeline as Data Exfiltration Vector. 多智能体部署将所有智能体的日志集中到统一日志系统（ELK stack、Datadog）。 Multi-agent deployments centralize logs from all agents to unified logging (ELK stack, Datadog). 攻陷集中式日志系统的攻击者可访问所有智能体汇集的日志，从而实现全面的数据外传。 Attackers compromising centralized logging systems gain access to combined logs from all agents, enabling comprehensive data exfiltration. 多智能体特有之处：单智能体系统在本地记录日志；多智能体的集中式日志记录则形成一个汇聚点，一次入侵即可同时影响所有智能体记录的数据。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-agent systems log locally; multi-agent centralized logging creates aggregation point where single compromise affects all agents’ logged data simultaneously. 一个被攻陷且拥有 ELK 集群写入权限的日志代理可以外传所有智能体的全部日志、工具输出和内部推理内容。 A compromised logging agent with write access to ELK cluster can exfiltrate all agent logs, tool outputs, and internal reasoning from all agents. III-B21 RDL_23 - 容器化安全III-B21 RDL_23 - Containerization Security
RDL_23_1 - 容器化智能体中的共享内存/缓存侧信道。 RDL_23_1 - Shared Memory/Cache Side Channels in Containerized Agents. 共享物理主机上的容器化智能体可能通过 CPU 缓存侧信道泄露数据。 Containerized agents on shared physical hosts can leak data through CPU cache side channels. 在容器逃逸场景中，攻击者可以读取同级容器的内存内容。 Attackers in container escaping scenarios can read memory contents from sibling containers. 多智能体特有之处：单个隔离的智能体没有可供攻击的同级智能体；共享主机上的多智能体部署则提供了侧信道攻击目标——成功逃逸的智能体可以同时攻击同一物理机器上的所有同级智能体。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-isolated agent has no siblings to target; multi-agent deployments on shared hosts create side-channel targets—escaped agent can attack all sibling agents on same physical machine simultaneously. [521, 522, 23, 523, 524, 525, 526, 527]。 [521, 522, 23, 523, 524, 525, 526, 527].
RDL_23_2 - 事件流保留造成持久性数据泄露。 RDL_23_2 - Event Stream Retention Creating Persistent Data Leakage. 事件代理（Kafka）保留事件历史以供重放。 Event brokers (Kafka) retain event history for replay. 智能体向主题发布敏感数据会造成持续的数据泄露风险。 Agents publishing sensitive data to topics create durable data leakage exposure. 拥有事件代理访问权限的攻击者可以从所有智能体曾经发布的全部事件中，检索包含敏感信息的历史事件。 Attackers with broker access can retrieve historical events containing sensitive information from all events ever published by all agents. 多智能体特有之处：单智能体发布事件会暴露本地智能体的数据；使用共享事件代理的多智能体系统则使攻击者能够通过访问事件代理，获取所有智能体汇集的历史数据，事件代理对主题数据的保留由此形成了全面的数据外传通道。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-agent event publishing exposes local agent data; multi-agent systems with shared brokers enable attackers to access combined historical data from all agents through broker access, creating comprehensive data exfiltration channels through broker topic retention. [528, 529, 530]。 [528, 529, 530].
RDL_23_3 - 持久卷挂载权限提升导致日志可被访问。 RDL_23_3 - Persistent Volume Mount Permission Escalation Enabling Log Access. 挂载权限过于宽松（模式为 0777）的共享持久卷（PersistentVolumes）的智能体容器，可以访问其他智能体的日志输出。 Agent containers mounting shared PersistentVolumes with overly permissive permissions (mode 0777) can access other agents’ log outputs. 攻陷智能体的攻击者利用这一点，从其他智能体的日志中窃取敏感数据。 Attackers compromising agents exploit this to exfiltrate sensitive data from other agents’ logs. 多智能体场景的独特性：多智能体系统中的共享存储会造成跨智能体数据泄露，攻陷一个智能体即可读取其他智能体的持久化日志，从而实现横向数据窃取，而在各智能体日志相互隔离的情况下无法进行这种窃取。 Multi-agent distinction: Shared storage in multi-agent systems creates cross-agent data leakage where compromising one agent enables reading other agents’ persistent logs, creating horizontal data exfiltration unavailable with isolated per-agent logging. RDL_23_4 - 边车代理访问日志截获。 RDL_23_4 - Sidecar Proxy Access Log Interception. 服务网格中的边车（sidecar）收集所有智能体间通信的访问日志。 Service mesh sidecars collect access logs for all inter-agent communication. 攻陷边车代理的攻击者截获包含敏感数据或身份验证令牌的明文日志。 Attackers compromising sidecar proxies intercept plaintext logs containing sensitive data or authentication tokens. 多智能体场景的独特性：多智能体系统中的服务网格日志机制形成了集中的截获点，被攻陷的边车会暴露所有智能体间通信的元数据，从而使攻击者能够窃取智能体间的对话上下文。 Multi-agent distinction: Service mesh logging in multi-agent systems creates centralized interception point where compromised sidecars reveal all agent-to-agent communication metadata, enabling exfiltration of inter-agent conversation context. [534, 535, 536, 537, 538, 539, 540, 541, 542, 543]。 [534, 535, 536, 537, 538, 539, 540, 541, 542, 543].
RDL_23_5 - 初始化容器环境变量泄露。 RDL_23_5 - Init Container Environment Variable Leakage. 初始化容器接收包含凭据和配置的环境变量。 Init containers receive environment variables with credentials and configuration. 攻击者通过触发初始化容器崩溃，可使环境变量经由错误日志或容器描述信息泄露。 Attackers triggering crashes in init containers can leak environment variables through error logs or container descriptions. 多智能体场景的独特性：多智能体初始化容器在各副本间采用相同的环境变量模式，如果错误日志暴露了本应隔离的变量，就可能泄露用于协同的敏感数据。 Multi-agent distinction: Multi-agent init containers sharing environment variable patterns across replicas can leak coordinated sensitive data if error logging reveals variables intended to be isolated. RDL_23_6 - kubelet 端口 10250 未经身份验证的指标泄露。 RDL_23_6 - kubelet Port 10250 Unauthenticated Metrics Leakage. Kubelet 的指标端口（10250）暴露详细的系统指标。 Kubelet’s metrics port (10250) exposes detailed system metrics. 能够访问 Pod 网络的攻击者可以查询 kubelet 指标，从而获知详细的资源利用情况和运行模式。 Attackers with pod network access can query kubelet metrics revealing detailed resource utilization and operational patterns. 多智能体场景的独特性：多智能体集群暴露所有节点的 kubelet 指标，这些指标包含所有智能体的汇总信息，使攻击者能够推断多智能体工作流模式。 Multi-agent distinction: Multi-agent clusters expose kubelet metrics from all nodes containing aggregate information about all agents enabling inference of multi-agent workflow patterns. RDL_23_7 - Etcd 数据库备份信息泄露。 RDL_23_7 - Etcd Database Backup Information Leakage. Kubernetes 的 etcd 数据库包含全部集群状态，包括 Pod 环境变量、ConfigMap 内容和 Secret 值。 Kubernetes etcd database contains all cluster state including pod environment variables, ConfigMap contents, and Secret values. 拥有 etcd 访问权限的攻击者窃取所有智能体的全部秘密信息和环境变量。 Attackers with etcd access exfiltrate all secrets and environment variables for all agents. 多智能体场景的独特性：多智能体集群共享 etcd，意味着只需攻陷一次 etcd，即可窃取所有智能体的秘密信息，从而实现协同身份验证绕过和大规模凭据窃取。 Multi-agent distinction: Shared etcd across multi-agent cluster means single etcd compromise exfiltrates secrets for all agents, enabling coordinated authentication bypass and large-scale credential theft. III-B22 RDL_24 - 性能剖析与优化III-B22 RDL_24 - Profiling and Optimization
RDL_24_1 - 通过执行轨迹泄露性能剖析输出数据。 RDL_24_1 - Profiling Output Data Leakage Through Execution Traces. Nsight Systems 捕获详细的执行轨迹，包括内存内容、GPU 内核和时序信息。 Nsight Systems captures detailed execution traces including memory contents, GPU kernels, and timing information. 这些轨迹可能包含智能体处理的敏感数据（用户查询、工具输出、检索到的上下文）。 These traces could contain sensitive data processed by agents (user queries, tool outputs, retrieved context). 将性能剖析数据存储在智能体可访问的存储库中，会产生新的泄露渠道。 Profiling data stored in repositories accessible to agents creates new leakage channels. 多智能体场景的独特性：单个智能体的性能剖析轨迹仅保留在局部；多智能体性能剖析数据汇集于共享存储库，使所有智能体的执行轨迹流入同一存储位置，形成集中的泄露点，使攻击者能够窃取整个智能体群的敏感数据。 Multi-agent distinction: Singular agent profiling traces remain localized; multi-agent profiling data aggregated in shared repositories creates centralized leakage point where execution traces from all agents flow to same storage, enabling attackers exfiltrating sensitive data from entire fleet. RDL_24_2 - MLflow 制品注册库成为数据窃取渠道。 RDL_24_2 - MLflow Artifact Registry as Data Exfiltration Channel. MLflow 存储模型版本、提示词制品和评估数据集，其中可能包含敏感信息。 MLflow stores model versions, prompt artifacts, and evaluation datasets containing potentially sensitive information. 智能体在注册库中查询模型版本时，可能通过一同存储的提示词、工具模式或评估数据元数据暴露业务逻辑。 Agents querying registry for model versions could expose business logic through prompts, tool schemas, or evaluation data metadata stored alongside. 多智能体场景的独特性：集中式注册库存储所有智能体的制品，使访问该注册库的攻击者能够同时窃取整个多智能体群的数据。 Multi-agent distinction: Central registry storing all agents’ artifacts enables attackers accessing registry to exfiltrate data from entire multi-agent fleet simultaneously. RDL_24_3 - 基线比较导致历史行为泄露。 RDL_24_3 - Baseline Comparison Leakage of Historical Behavior. 为检测性能回退而存储的基线性能指标包含批大小、上下文长度和工具调用模式等运行参数。 Baseline performance metrics stored for regression detection include operational parameters like batch sizes, context lengths, and tool invocation patterns. 这些参数揭示了系统行为，并可能暴露有关用户请求模式的敏感信息。 These parameters reveal system behavior and could expose sensitive information about user request patterns. 多智能体场景的区别：共享的基线存储使得通过查询基线来推断系统中所有智能体的行为成为可能。 Multi-agent distinction: Shared baseline storage enables querying baselines to infer behavior of all agents in system. RDL_24_4 - 性能优化日志作为侧信道泄漏源。 RDL_24_4 - Performance Optimization Logs as Side-Channel Leakage. 优化过程会生成日志，记录配置变更、参数调优尝试和性能指标。 Optimization processes generate logs showing configuration changes, parameter tuning attempts, and performance metrics. 这些日志可能揭示系统能力、基础设施约束以及可用于攻击的配置细节。 These logs could reveal system capabilities, infrastructure constraints, and configuration details useful for attacks. 多智能体场景的区别：集中式优化日志会向潜在攻击者暴露所有智能体的配置细节。 Multi-agent distinction: Centralized optimization logs expose all agents’ configuration details to potential attackers. III-B23 RDL_25 - Kubernetes 编排III-B23 RDL_25 - Kubernetes Orchestration
RDL_25_1 - Kubernetes 事件审计泄漏多智能体编排逻辑。 RDL_25_1 - Kubernetes Event Auditing Leaking Multi-Agent Orchestration Logic. Kubernetes 会记录 Pod 创建、调度、扩缩容和故障事件。 Kubernetes logs pod creation, scheduling, scaling, and failure events. 在多智能体部署中，审计日志会揭示哪些智能体一起扩缩容、哪些智能体一起重启，从而表明智能体之间的依赖关系。 In multi-agent deployments, audit logs reveal which agents scale together, which agents restart together, indicating inter-agent dependencies. 攻击者通过分析审计日志提取多智能体工作流，识别关键智能体（其故障会触发级联重启的智能体）和优化路径（扩缩容最频繁的智能体）。 Attackers analyzing audit logs extract multi-agent workflows, identifying critical agents (those whose failures trigger cascading restarts) and optimization paths (agents scaled most frequently). 在单体部署中，审计日志揭示的是容器生命周期；而多智能体审计日志则会通过相互关联的扩缩容和故障模式泄漏编排拓扑与依赖关系图。 Unlike singular deployments where audit logs reveal container lifecycle, multi-agent audit logs leak orchestration topology and dependency graphs through correlated scaling and failure patterns. III-B24 RDL_26 - GPU 与模型内部机制III-B24 RDL_26 - GPU and Model Internals
RDL_26_1 - 通过 Prometheus 的各模型 GPU 利用率指标泄漏 GPU 内存指标。 RDL_26_1 - GPU Memory Metrics Leakage Through Prometheus GPU Utilization per Model. Triton 会报告每个模型的 GPU 内存利用率，使攻击者能够推断加载了哪些模型、使用了哪些批大小，以及呈现出哪些推理模式。 Triton reports per-model GPU memory utilization enabling attackers to infer what models are loaded, what batch sizes are used, and what inference patterns emerge. 在部署了 20+ 个不同模型的多智能体系统中，GPU 利用率模式会揭示哪些智能体处于活跃状态、它们的处理速率以及活动时序。 In multi-agent systems with 20+ different models deployed, GPU utilization patterns reveal which agents are active, their processing rates, and their timing. 攻击者通过关联不同模型的 GPU 利用率，提取智能体之间的时间关系。 Attackers correlate GPU utilization across models extracting temporal relationships between agents. 与仅有一个模型的单体系统不同，多智能体 GPU 指标会成为信息源，使攻击者能够通过利用率推断重建编排结构。 Unlike singular systems with one model, multi-agent GPU metrics become information sources enabling orchestration reconstruction through utilization inference. RDL_26_2 - 详细日志记录模式下，容器日志和标准输出（Stdout）泄漏推理中间数据。 RDL_26_2 - Container Logs and Stdout Leakage of Inference Intermediates in Verbose Logging. NIM（NVIDIA 推理微服务）和 Triton 可以在详细日志级别（–log-verbose=1）记录推理请求、词元生成和模型输出。 NIM (NVIDIA Inference Microservice) and Triton can log inference requests, token generation, and model outputs at verbose levels (–log-verbose=1). 在智能体可能处理敏感信息的多智能体部署中，Kubernetes 日志系统（Fluentd、Promtail）采集的容器日志会泄漏推理中间数据。 In multi-agent deployments where agents may process sensitive information, container logs captured by Kubernetes logging systems (Fluentd, Promtail) leak inference intermediates. 智能体 A 在通过推理处理客户数据时写入日志，而智能体 B 的安全监控会查询这些日志，从而通过日志基础设施泄漏客户数据。 Agent A’s inference processing customer data writes logs that Agent B’s security monitoring queries, leaking customer data through logging infrastructure. 在单体部署中，日志保留在服务本地；而多智能体部署会集中存储日志，使跨智能体数据泄漏能够通过集中式日志系统发生。 Unlike singular deployments where logs remain service-local, multi-agent deployments centralize logs enabling cross-agent data leakage through centralized logging systems. RDL_26_3 - 队列深度指标使推理工作负载的逆向工程成为可能。 RDL_26_3 - Queue Depth Metrics Enabling Inference Workload Reverse Engineering. Triton 的队列深度指标会揭示有多少请求正在等待推理。 Triton’s queue depth metrics reveal how many requests are pending inference. 在多智能体系统中，攻击者会监控队列深度模式，识别活动高峰时段、请求到达分布和推理需求模式。 In multi-agent systems, attackers monitor queue depth patterns identifying peak activity times, request arrival distributions, and inference demand patterns. 对队列指标进行复杂的统计分析，使攻击者能够逆向推断向哪些智能体发出了哪些请求，实质上是通过队列动态重建多智能体工作流。 Sophisticated statistical analysis of queue metrics enables attackers to reverse-engineer what requests are being made to what agents, essentially reconstructing multi-agent workflows through queue dynamics. 在单体系统中，队列指标揭示的是单个服务的负载；而多智能体队列分析则能够以概率方式重建分布式工作流模式。 Unlike singular systems where queue metrics reveal single-service load, multi-agent queue analysis enables probabilistic reconstruction of distributed workflow patterns. RDL_26_4 - 通过张量并行产生的 KV 缓存侧信道泄漏。 RDL_26_4 - KV Cache Side-Channel Leakage Through Tensor Parallelism. 张量并行将计算分配到多个 GPU 上，KV 缓存页可能被拆分存储在不同 GPU 的内存中。 Tensor parallelism distributes computation across GPUs, with KV cache pages potentially split across GPU memory. 在默认配置下，GPU 间的 NVLink 通信会以未加密方式在 GPU 之间传输 KV 缓存值。 Inter-GPU NVLink communication transfers KV cache values between GPUs without encryption in default configurations. 能够物理接触 GPU 连接的攻击者可以窃听 KV 缓存传输，从中提取先前用户对话中缓存的键值激活值。 An attacker with physical access to GPU connections can eavesdrop on KV cache transfers, extracting cached key-value activations from previous user conversations. 由于 KV 缓存包含先前输入（包括工具输出、搜索结果和上下文）的压缩表示，这会形成数据泄漏通道，暴露多个用户的上下文。 Since KV cache contains compressed representations of previous inputs (including tool outputs, search results, and context), this creates data leakage channels exposing multi-user contexts. 多智能体场景的区别：单用户 KV 缓存仅会泄漏一个用户的数据；而采用共享 KV 缓存的多租户多智能体系统会泄漏共享同一缓存页的所有智能体的数据，将泄漏范围扩大到整个多智能体系统的上下文历史。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-user KV caches leak only one user’s data; multi-tenant multi-agent systems with shared KV caches leak data from all agents sharing the cache page, amplifying leakage across the entire multi-agent system’s context history. RDL_26_5 - 引擎二进制文件的元数据泄漏。 RDL_26_5 - Engine Binary Metadata Leakage. TensorRT 引擎二进制文件包含模型架构、层配置和优化决策等元数据。 TensorRT engine binaries contain metadata including model architecture, layer configurations, and optimization decisions. 能够访问已部署引擎的攻击者可以提取架构信息，从而实施模型提取攻击，其中引擎结构会暴露底层模型的设计。 An attacker with access to deployed engines can extract architectural information enabling model extraction attacks where the engine structure reveals the underlying model design. 在多个智能体执行基于同一基础模型构建的引擎的多智能体系统中，提取一个智能体的引擎便能进一步提取所有智能体的引擎，造成全面的模型泄漏。 In multi-agent systems where multiple agents execute engines built from the same base model, extracting one agent’s engine enables extracting all agents’ engines, creating comprehensive model leakage. 多智能体场景的区别：提取单智能体的引擎会暴露该智能体的架构；在所有智能体均使用同一引擎变体的多智能体部署中，泄漏效应会被放大，攻击者只需攻破一个引擎，就能通过架构相似性分析推断所有智能体的架构。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-agent engine extraction reveals one agent’s architecture; multi-agent deployments where all agents use variants of the same engine create amplified leakage where one compromised engine enables inferring all agents’ architectures through architectural similarity analysis. [559, 388, 580, 581, 186, 510, 582]。 [559, 388, 580, 581, 186, 510, 582].
RDL_26_6 - 作为概率性泄漏通道的量化伪影。 RDL_26_6 - Quantization Artifacts as Probabilistic Leakage Channels. INT8 量化会在词元概率中引入系统性伪影，其中某些词元范围的量化程度高于其他范围。 INT8 quantization introduces systematic artifacts in token probabilities where certain token ranges are quantized more aggressively than others. 攻击者通过分析量化模型的输出，可以推断推理过程中涉及哪些激活值范围，从而揭示有关输入内容的信息。 An attacker analyzing quantized model outputs can infer which activation ranges were exercised during inference, revealing information about the input content. 如果某个智能体处理敏感查询（例如医疗信息），量化伪影就会泄漏具有这些查询特征的激活模式分布。 If one agent processes sensitive queries (e.g., medical information), quantization artifacts leak distributions of activation patterns characteristic of those queries. 多智能体场景的区别：单智能体的量化泄漏会暴露该智能体的输入特征；在各智能体处理不同数据类型（一个处理医疗查询，另一个处理金融查询）的多智能体系统中，会形成跨多个领域的泄漏通道，其中每个智能体的量化伪影都会泄漏特定领域的激活模式。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-agent quantization leakage reveals one agent’s input characteristics; multi-agent systems where agents process different data types (one handles medical queries, another handles financial queries) create multi-domain leakage channels where quantization artifacts from each agent leak domain-specific activation patterns. [583, 584, 585, 586, 587]。 [583, 584, 585, 586, 587].
RDL_26_7 - 通过引擎跟踪记录进行 GPU 内存取证。 RDL_26_7 - GPU Memory Forensics via Engine Traces. TensorRT 引擎会生成 GPU 操作的跟踪记录，用于性能分析和调试。 TensorRT engines generate traces of GPU operations for profiling and debugging. 这些跟踪记录包含时序信息、内存分配大小和内核调用，可揭示推理特征。 These traces contain timing information, memory allocation sizes, and kernel invocations that reveal inference characteristics. 能够访问多智能体部署的引擎跟踪记录的攻击者，可以通过模式分析揭示智能体执行了哪些工具、推理需要多少次迭代，以及智能体各项操作的相对时间关系。 An attacker with access to engine traces from multi-agent deployments can analyze patterns revealing which tools agents executed, how many iterations inference required, and relative timing of agent operations. 例如，如果跟踪记录显示某种特定查询类型的推理延迟长达 10x，就会泄漏该智能体正在针对该输入执行复杂推理步骤或工具调用这一信息。 For example, traces showing 10x longer inference latency for a specific query type leak that the agent is executing complex reasoning steps or tool calls on that input. 多智能体场景的区别：单智能体的跟踪记录会泄漏该智能体的操作模式；Fleet Command 的集中式监控会汇总所有智能体的跟踪记录，从而造成全面的取证信息泄漏，使访问中央监控系统的攻击者能够提取整个多智能体集群的操作模式。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-agent traces leak one agent’s operation patterns; Fleet Command’s centralized monitoring aggregates traces from all agents, creating comprehensive forensic leakage where an attacker accessing central monitoring systems extracts operation patterns from the entire multi-agent fleet. [210, 214, 124, 207]。 [210, 214, 124, 207].
RDL_26_8 - 量化统计信息中的校准数据集痕迹。 RDL_26_8 - Calibration Dataset Artifacts in Quantization Statistics. INT8 量化校准会生成统计信息（激活值的最小值/最大值范围、直方图数据），并将其与引擎元数据一同存储。 INT8 quantization calibration produces statistics (min/max activation ranges, histogram data) stored with engine metadata. 这些统计信息会泄漏有关校准数据集分布的信息。 These statistics leak information about the calibration dataset distribution. 攻击者通过分析专用智能体的量化统计信息，可以推断其校准数据所属的领域。 An attacker analyzing quantization statistics from specialized agents can infer the domain of their calibration data. 如果一个执行智能体的激活值范围针对数据库操作进行了优化，就会暴露其校准数据集主要包含数据库查询这一信息。 An execution agent with activation ranges optimized for database operations reveals the calibration dataset contained primarily database queries. 这使攻击者能够针对校准统计信息暴露了其业务领域的特定智能体实施定向攻击。 This enables targeted attacks against specific agents whose calibration statistics expose their operational domain. 多智能体场景的区别：单次校准会生成一组统计信息；在多智能体系统中，专用智能体采用特定领域的校准会生成 N 组统计信息，揭示每个智能体的校准数据领域，使攻击者能够根据所暴露的业务领域选择目标。 Multi-agent distinction: Single calibration creates one statistic set; multi-agent specialized agents with domain-specific calibration create N statistic sets revealing the calibration domain of each agent, enabling attackers selecting targets based on revealed operational domains. [289, 446, 588, 583]。 [289, 446, 588, 583].
III-B25 RDL_27 - 负载均衡III-B25 RDL_27 - Load Balancing
RDL_27_1 - 作为侧信道的负载均衡器路由决策。 RDL_27_1 - Load Balancer Routing Decisions as Side Channels. 负载均衡器的路由决策（哪个副本接收哪个请求）会形成可观察的模式。 Load balancer routing decisions (which replica receives which request) create observable patterns. 监控请求路由的攻击者可以推断系统负载、副本之间的相对能力差异，以及有关请求分布的潜在敏感模式。 Attackers monitoring request routing can infer system load, relative capability differences between replicas, and potentially sensitive patterns about request distribution. 路由决策的元数据本身就成为一种侧信道。 The metadata of routing decisions itself becomes a side-channel. 多智能体场景的区别：单智能体不存在路由决策；采用负载均衡的系统所产生的路由元数据，会形成有关智能体状态的信息泄漏通道。 Multi-agent distinction: Single agent has no routing decisions; load-balanced systems’ routing metadata creates information leakage channels about agent status. [589, 227, 588, 124]。 [589, 227, 588, 124].
RDL_27_2 - 作为信息侧信道的批处理窗口时序。 RDL_27_2 - Batching Window Timing as Information Side-Channel. 动态批处理的超时机制会形成可预测的处理窗口，并可通过延迟模式观察到这些窗口。 Dynamic batching timeouts create predictable processing windows observable as latency patterns. 攻击者可以根据响应延迟推断批次大小和批次组成。 Attackers can infer batch sizes and batch composition from response latencies. 大批次与小批次呈现不同的延迟特征。 Large batches experience different latency profiles than small batches. 这些时序信息会揭示有关请求批处理的数据。 This timing information reveals data about request batching. 多智能体场景的区别：未批处理的响应具有简单直接的延迟特征；批处理则引入时间依赖性，使攻击者能够根据时序推断批次结构。 Multi-agent distinction: Unbatched responses have straightforward latency; batching introduces temporal dependence enabling attackers to infer batch structure from timing. [440, 124, 210]。 [440, 124, 210].
RDL_27_3 - 缓存命中/未命中模式作为侧信道。 RDL_27_3 - Caching Hit/Miss Patterns as Side-Channel. 缓存行为（命中与未命中）会产生可观测的延迟差异。 Cache behavior (hits vs. misses) creates observable latency differences. 攻击者可以通过延迟分析推断智能体正在访问哪些缓存数据。 Attackers can infer what cached data agents are accessing through latency analysis. 高延迟响应表明缓存未命中，从而暴露哪些查询是新的或不常见的。 High-latency responses indicate cache misses revealing what queries are new or uncommon. 多智能体场景的区别：重新计算不提供缓存信号；缓存则会产生命中/未命中的时序侧信道，暴露访问模式。 Multi-agent distinction: Fresh computation provides no cache signals; caching creates hit/miss timing side-channels revealing access patterns. [487, 590, 284, 446, 155]。 [487, 590, 284, 446, 155].
RDL_27_4 - 通过可观测性暴露负载均衡器指标。 RDL_27_4 - Load Balancer Metrics Exposure Through Observability. 动态负载均衡器会暴露有关副本健康状况和利用率的指标。 Dynamic load balancers expose metrics about replica health and utilization. 这些指标可能通过监控端点暴露，也可能通过请求延迟模式被观测到。 These metrics can be exposed through monitoring endpoints or observable through request latency patterns. 攻击者可以利用这些信息针对特定副本发动攻击。 Attackers can use this information to target specific replicas. 多智能体场景的区别：单智能体不存在可供比较的指标；具有负载均衡器可观测性的多智能体系统则会暴露攻击者可利用的基础设施细节。 Multi-agent distinction: Single agent has no comparative metrics; multi-agent systems with load balancer observability expose infrastructure details attackers can exploit. [588, 446, 478, 46, 294]。 [588, 446, 478, 46, 294].
RDL_27_5 - 自动伸缩事件的时序作为攻击信号。 RDL_27_5 - Auto-Scaling Event Timing as Attack Signal. 自动伸缩事件（副本启动/终止）可以通过网络变化和响应延迟被观测到。 Auto-scaling events (replica launch/termination) are observable through network changes and response latencies. 攻击者可以观测系统何时扩容，从而识别副本的容量和配置。 Attackers can observe when system scales up identifying replica capacities and configurations. 缩容事件会暴露负载管理策略。 Scale-down events reveal load management strategies. 多智能体场景的区别：静态部署不提供伸缩信号；自动伸缩事件则会造成时序信息泄漏，暴露系统的自适应调整情况。 Multi-agent distinction: Static deployments provide no scaling signals; auto-scaling events create temporal information leakage revealing system adaptation. [210, 591, 592, 247, 573]。 [210, 591, 592, 247, 573].
III-B26 RDL_28 - 规划系统III-B26 RDL_28 - Planning Systems
RDL_28_1 - 上下文窗口大小作为泄漏容量的指标。 RDL_28_1 - Context Window Size as Leakage Capacity Indicator. 不同智能体会设置不同大小的上下文窗口；较大的窗口能够保留更多推理内容。 Different agents tune different context windows; larger windows enable more preserved reasoning content. 在多智能体系统中，具有较大上下文窗口的智能体会成为数据提取攻击的目标，因为它们保留了更多 Self-Consistency 推理链的细节。 In multi-agent systems, agents with larger context windows become targets for data extraction attacks because they preserve more of the Self-Consistency reasoning chain details. 攻击者知道大上下文窗口智能体保留了更多推理细节，因此会优先查询这些智能体。 Attackers preferentially query large-context agents knowing they retain more reasoning detail. 多智能体场景的区别：单智能体的上下文大小保持不变；多智能体的上下文异构性则会导致数据保留程度各异，使大上下文窗口智能体成为泄漏风险的集中点。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-agent context size remains constant; multi-agent context heterogeneity creates variable data retention making large-context agents leakage risk concentration points. [285, 284, 220, 261]。 [285, 284, 220, 261].
RDL_28_2 - 通过任务网络序列化泄漏规划历史。 RDL_28_2 - Planning History Leakage Through Task Network Serialization. HTN 规划系统会生成完整的任务网络（目标、方法、分解和约束），这些网络可能会为调试或智能体间协调而被序列化（保存到日志中或在智能体之间传输）。 HTN planning systems generate complete task networks (goals, methods, decompositions, constraints) that may be serialized (saved to logs, transmitted between agents) for debugging or inter-agent coordination. 这些任务网络可能泄漏有关系统能力、工具访问权限和推理过程的敏感信息。 These task networks can leak sensitive information about system capabilities, tool access, and reasoning processes. 攻击者查看“处理季度财务审查”任务的序列化任务网络后，就能了解哪些智能体参与、哪些工具被执行以及执行顺序——这些都是有价值的侦察数据。 An attacker viewing a serialized task network from ”process quarterly financial review” learns which agents participate, which tools execute, and in what order—valuable reconnaissance data. 在多智能体分层系统中，智能体 A 生成的任务网络必须由智能体 B 接收以进行协调，从而形成多个泄漏点。 In multi-agent hierarchical systems, Agent A generates task networks that Agent B must receive for coordination, creating multiple leakage points. 在单智能体系统中，任务网络始终保留在内部；而在多智能体系统中，任务网络在智能体之间的传输会形成数据泄漏通道。 Unlike single-agent systems where task networks remain internal, multi-agent inter-agent transmission of task networks creates data leakage channels. 多智能体场景的区别：单智能体的规划始终保留在内部；多智能体协调则需要将任务网络外部化，从而形成持续存在的泄漏途径，其中序列化的层次结构会暴露系统结构。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-agent planning remains internal; multi-agent coordination requires externalizing task networks creating persistent leakage vectors where serialized hierarchies reveal system structure. [593, 225, 594, 595, 596]。 [593, 225, 594, 595, 596].
RDL_28_3 - 通过访问注册表侦察方法库。 RDL_28_3 - Method Library Reconnaissance Through Registry Access. 共享 HTN 方法库包含完整的方法规范，包括前置条件、分解、效果和约束。 Shared HTN method libraries contain complete method specifications including preconditions, decompositions, effects, and constraints. 拥有方法注册表读取权限的攻击者可以了解智能体可用的完整规划空间，从而针对特定场景下可能执行的方法发动定向攻击。 An attacker with read access to method registries learns the complete planning space available to agents, enabling targeted attacks on methods likely to execute in particular scenarios. 方法库由此成为展示系统能力的路线图。 The method library becomes a roadmap of system capabilities. 在具有集中式方法注册表的多智能体生态系统中，拥有注册表访问权限的攻击者能够全面侦察系统。 In multi-agent ecosystems with centralized method registries, attackers with registry access gain comprehensive system reconnaissance. 多智能体区别：单智能体通过私有方法防止侦察；多智能体共享的方法注册表会暴露完整的方法库，使攻击者能够了解所有可用的分解策略。 Multi-agent distinction: Single agents with private methods prevent reconnaissance; multi-agent shared method registries expose complete method libraries enabling attackers learning all available decomposition strategies. [291, 294, 292, 282, 295]. [291, 294, 292, 282, 295].
RDL_28_4 - 约束规范泄露暴露资源边界。 RDL_28_4 - Constraint Specification Leakage Revealing Resource Boundaries. HTN 资源约束会揭示哪些资源受到限制、具有独占性或受到保护。 HTN resource constraints reveal which resources are limited, exclusive, or protected. 获知“数据库连接的独占访问”表明高价值资源受到保护，而发现“GPU 仅供智能体 A 独占访问”则会揭示哪些智能体拥有特权访问权限。 Learning that ”database connections exclusive access” indicates high-value resource protection, or discovering ”GPU exclusive access to agent A” reveals which agents have privileged access. 在约束规范可见的多智能体系统中，攻击者能够了解资源分配策略和信任边界。 In multi-agent systems with visible constraint specifications, attackers learn resource allocation strategies and trust boundaries. 多智能体区别：单智能体的约束规范保留在本地；多智能体系统中可见的约束会揭示智能体之间的资源关系，使攻击者能够针对资源边界发起攻击。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-agent constraint specifications remain local; multi-agent visible constraints reveal inter-agent resource relationships enabling attackers targeting resource boundaries. [225, 294, 597, 598, 599, 600]. [225, 294, 597, 598, 599, 600].
RDL_28_5 - 状态抽象映射暴露敏感信息结构。 RDL_28_5 - State Abstraction Mappings Revealing Sensitive Information Structure. HTN 状态投影机制将具体状态映射为抽象状态，而这些映射可能揭示哪些信息被视为敏感信息或安全关键信息。 HTN state projection mechanisms map concrete state to abstract state, and these mappings can reveal what information is considered sensitive or security-critical. 如果投影隐藏某些字段（抽象状态不包含“user_authentication_status”，但包含“user_id”），攻击者便能了解哪些信息被视为重要信息，哪些被视为不重要的信息。 If projections suppress certain fields (abstract state excludes ”user_authentication_status” but includes ”user_id”), attackers learn which information is considered important versus unimportant. 抽象结构会揭示系统的安全模型。 The abstraction structure reveals system security model. 在状态投影于智能体之间流转的多智能体分层系统中，可见的投影定义会泄露信息的分类。 In multi-agent hierarchical systems where state projections flow between agents, visible projection definitions leak information classification. 多智能体区别：单智能体的状态保留在内部；多智能体之间的状态投影会形成可见的映射，揭示信息敏感性层级。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-agent state remains internal; multi-agent state projections between agents create visible mappings revealing information sensitivity hierarchy. [594, 601, 602, 603, 604]. [594, 601, 602, 603, 604].
RDL_28_6 - 分解模式分析泄露规划策略。 RDL_28_6 - Decomposition Pattern Analysis Leaking Planning Strategy. 频繁观察特定目标的分解方式会揭示规划策略和优先级。 Frequent observation of how specific goals decompose reveals planning strategies and priorities. 如果“成本优化目标”反复被分解为优先选择低价提供商的方法，攻击者便会了解到系统优先考虑成本，从而能够针对低价提供商的漏洞发起攻击。 If ”cost optimization goals” repeatedly decompose into methods prioritizing cheap providers, attackers learn the system prioritizes cost, enabling targeting of cheap-provider vulnerabilities. 对分解进行模式分析，无需显式访问方法库，即可实现对规划策略的概率性回忆。 Pattern analysis of decompositions creates probabilistic recall of planning strategies without needing explicit method library access. 在能够跨智能体观察分解模式的多智能体系统中，攻击者通过分析这些模式，可以了解整个系统的规划偏向。 In multi-agent systems where decomposition patterns are observable across agents, attackers analyzing patterns learn system-wide planning biases. 多智能体区别：单智能体的分解模式影响一个智能体；在多智能体系统中，跨智能体汇总的模式会揭示整个系统的规划策略。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-agent decomposition patterns affect one agent; multi-agent systems where patterns aggregate across agents reveal system-wide planning strategies. [605, 606, 607, 608, 609]. [605, 606, 607, 608, 609].
RDL_28_7 - 任务完成日志记录导致执行时间线泄露。 RDL_28_7 - Task Completion Logging Creating Execution Timeline Leakage. HTN 系统记录任务执行日志，用于监控和调试（时间戳、任务名称、执行状态）。 HTN systems log task execution for monitoring and debugging (timestamps, task names, execution status). 日志会揭示时间模式（哪些任务在何时执行）、执行顺序（哪些智能体在何时进行协调）以及失败模式。 Logs reveal timing patterns (which tasks execute when), execution order (which agents coordinate when), and failure patterns. 对日志中记录的任务执行进行时间线分析，无需访问源代码即可重建系统工作流。 Timeline analysis of logged task executions reconstructs system workflows without needing source access. 在采用集中式日志记录的多智能体系统中，攻击者通过分析日志可以了解完整的执行时间线。 In multi-agent systems with centralized logging, attackers analyzing logs learn complete execution timelines. 多智能体区别：单智能体日志揭示一个智能体的活动；多智能体集中式日志揭示整个系统的工作流，从而支持全面的执行模式分析。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-agent logs reveal one agent’s activities; multi-agent centralized logs reveal system-wide workflows enabling comprehensive execution pattern analysis. [610, 611, 612]. [610, 611, 612].
III-B27 RDL_29 - 蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）III-B27 RDL_29 - Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS)
RDL_29_1 - MCTS 树作为隐式规划记忆的泄露源。 RDL_29_1 - MCTS Tree as Implicit Planning Memory Leak. MCTS 树存储完整的状态-动作对、访问次数和累积奖励，即详细的规划历史。 MCTS trees store complete state-action pairs, visit counts, and cumulative rewards—detailed planning history. 在用于智能体协调的上下文窗口中，MCTS 树的统计信息会成为共享上下文的一部分。 In context windows used for agent coordination, MCTS tree statistics become part of shared context. 树结构隐式编码了“正在探索哪些动作、这些动作的成功率以及智能体的置信度”。 The tree structure implicitly encodes ”which actions are being explored, their success rates, and agent confidence.” 攻击者通过分析上下文窗口，可以逆向推导规划决策，发现嵌入规划过程中的秘密（例如，“我们对这个动作进行了大量探索 = 我们认为这个目标很有价值”）。 Attackers analyzing context windows can reverse-engineer planning decisions, discovering secrets embedded in the planning process (e.g., ”we explored this action heavily = we think this target is valuable”). 多智能体区别：单智能体的 MCTS 规划保持私有；多智能体上下文共享使 MCTS 统计信息能够跨智能体边界被观察到。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-agent MCTS planning remains private; multi-agent context sharing makes MCTS statistics observable across agent boundaries. [305, 613, 294]. [305, 613, 294].
RDL_29_2 - 仿真轨迹作为概率性回忆的攻击面。 RDL_29_2 - Simulation Trajectory as Probabilistic Recall Attack Surface. MCTS 仿真沿树中的随机路径进行。 MCTS simulations follow stochastic paths through the tree. 仿真跟踪记录表示包含工具调用、参数值和状态转移的推演轨迹（rollout trajectories）。 Simulation traces represent rollout trajectories containing tool calls, parameter values, and state transitions. 如果出于调试或监督目的记录了仿真轨迹，其中就会包含有关曾尝试但从未实际执行的工具调用的信息。 If simulation traces are logged (for debugging or oversight), they contain information about attempted tool calls never actually executed. 这些轨迹成为概率性回忆的信息暴露面——有关“智能体可能做过什么”的信息会通过仿真历史泄露。 These traces become probabilistic recall surfaces—information about ”what the agent might have done” leaks through simulation history. 即使从未发生实际执行，攻击者也能从仿真轨迹中提取工具名称、参数模式和策略。 Attackers extract tool names, parameter patterns, and strategies from simulation traces even when actual execution never occurred. 多智能体区别：单智能体仿真保留在内部；而对仿真轨迹进行集中式日志记录的多智能体系统，使能够访问日志的攻击者可以重建多个智能体尝试采取行动的模式。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-agent simulations remain internal; multi-agent systems with centralized logging of simulation traces enable attackers accessing logs to reconstruct attempted action patterns across multiple agents. [614, 615, 616, 112, 617, 618]. [614, 615, 616, 112, 617, 618].
RDL_29_3 - 价值网络置信度分数导致的信息泄露。 RDL_29_3 - Value Network Confidence Scores as Information Disclosure. MCTS 价值网络为状态输出置信度分数（获胜概率估计）。 MCTS value networks output confidence scores (win probability estimates) for states. 这些分数揭示了战略评估——对某个特定序列的高置信度表明，该序列在智能体看来具有价值。 These scores reveal strategic assessments—high confidence in a particular sequence reveals that sequence appears valuable to the agent. 在为协调而共享价值网络输出的多智能体系统中（“此状态有 85% 的成功概率”），这些置信度估计会泄露战略意图。 In multi-agent systems sharing value network outputs for coordination (”this state has 85% chance of success”), these confidence estimates leak strategic intentions. 攻击者获知智能体最重视哪些状态，并从规划置信度分数中推断出与安全密切相关的信息。 Attackers learn which states agents value most, inferring security-critical information from planning confidence scores. 多智能体区别：单智能体的价值分数保留在内部；共享价值评估的多智能体系统则会跨智能体边界泄露战略信息。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-agent value scores remain internal; multi-agent systems sharing value assessments leak strategic information across agent boundaries. [619, 282, 620, 621]. [619, 282, 620, 621].
RDL_29_4 - 作为隐式信息源的模拟推演策略行为。 RDL_29_4 - Rollout Policy Behavior as Implicit Information Source. MCTS 模拟推演策略（rollout policy）通过随机动作选择来编码领域偏好。 MCTS rollout policies encode domain preferences through their stochastic action selection. 分析模拟推演行为（策略偏好哪些动作）会揭示隐含的策略信息。 Analyzing rollout behavior (which moves the policy prefers) reveals implicit strategy information. 在模拟推演策略被共享或被观察到的多智能体系统中（例如，通过协调过程），策略行为会成为信息泄露渠道。 In multi-agent systems where rollout policies are shared or observed (e.g., through coordination), policy behavior becomes information leak. 攻击者若观察到模拟推演策略强烈偏好“在状态 X 下采取动作 A”，就会推断 A 具有战略重要性，从而可能暴露涉及安全敏感信息的规划假设。 Attackers observing that the rollout policy strongly prefers ”action A in state X” infer that A is strategically important, potentially revealing security-sensitive planning assumptions. 多智能体区别：单智能体的模拟推演策略保持隐藏；策略可被观察的多智能体系统则会因策略行为被观察而泄露战略信息。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-agent rollout policies remain hidden; multi-agent systems with observable policies leak strategic information through policy behavior observation. [622, 623, 624, 625, 626]. [622, 623, 624, 625, 626].
RDL_29_5 - 多智能体日志中的重新规划轨迹泄露。 RDL_29_5 - Replanning Trajectory Leakage in Multi-Agent Logs. 智能体重新规划时，会生成搜索树、中间候选路径和启发式评估——这些信息包含有关系统内部状态、可用路径和工具能力的丰富上下文。 When agents replan, they generate search trees, intermediate path candidates, and heuristic evaluations—information rich in context about the system’s internal state, available routes, and tool capabilities. 在为协调而共享重新规划日志的多智能体系统中（以避免重复规划），这些日志会成为可搜索的攻击途径。 In multi-agent systems where replanning logs are shared for coordination (to avoid redundant planning), these logs become searchable attack vectors. 攻击者查询重新规划日志，以推断全局系统拓扑、识别利用不足的路径，并发现智能体曾尝试使用但认为并非最优选择的工具 API。 Attackers query replanning logs to infer global system topology, identify underutilized routes, and discover tool APIs agents attempted to use but deemed suboptimal. 多智能体区别：单智能体将规划内部信息保密；多智能体系统则为提高协调效率而在共享日志中暴露规划产物，从而形成孤立智能体中不存在的数据泄露渠道。 Multi-agent distinction: Single agents keep planning internals private; multi-agent systems expose planning artifacts in shared logs for coordination efficiency, creating data-leakage channels unavailable in isolated agents. [237, 18, 238, 166]. [237, 18, 238, 166].
III-B28 RDL_30 - 监控与回调III-B28 RDL_30 - Monitoring and Callbacks
RDL_30_1 - 通过监控回调泄露偏差信息。 RDL_30_1 - Discrepancy Leakage Through Monitoring Callbacks. 在执行监控过程中，智能体向队友广播发现的偏差（障碍、故障、工具不可用）。 During execution monitoring, agents broadcast discovered discrepancies to teammates (obstacles, failures, tool unavailability). 这些偏差消息逐一列出智能体正在探索的确切状态空间区域以及曾尝试使用的工具，从而泄露有关运行能力和约束条件的细粒度信息。 These discrepancy messages enumerate the exact state space regions agents are exploring and which tools were attempted, leaking fine-grained information about operational capacity and constraints. 多智能体区别：单智能体仅在内部泄露偏差信息；多智能体系统则为协调而通过网络广播这些信息，使窃听者能够针对智能体团队的能力和弱点构建完整的攻击画像。 Multi-agent distinction: Single agents only leak discrepancies internally; multi-agent systems broadcast this information across the network for coordination, enabling eavesdroppers to build complete attack profiles of agent team capabilities and weaknesses. [564, 170, 367]. [564, 170, 367].
III-B29 RDL_31 - 情景记忆III-B29 RDL_31 - Episodic Memory
RDL_31_1 - 作为隐蔽数据外传机制的情景记忆。 RDL_31_1 - Episodic Memory as Covert Data Exfiltration Mechanism. 将情景存储在外部数据库中会形成数据外传渠道。 Episodic storage in external databases creates exfiltration channels. 智能体将敏感数据嵌入存储在共享记忆中的情景，形成用于提取信息的侧信道。 Agents embed sensitive data in episodes stored in shared memory, creating side channels for information extraction. 具有存储访问权限的攻击者可直接外传收集到的数据。 Attackers with storage access directly exfiltrate collected data. 多智能体区别：采用隔离本地记忆的单智能体能够限制数据泄露范围；采用共享外部情景存储的多智能体系统则会形成集中式数据汇聚点，攻击者可通过攻破存储来访问整个智能体群体的敏感信息。 Multi-agent distinction: Single agents with isolated local memory contain data leakage; multi-agent systems with shared external episodic storage create centralized data aggregation points where attackers compromise storage to access sensitive information from entire agent population. [627, 628, 629]. [627, 628, 629].
RDL_31_2 - 嵌入向量推断导致的概率性回忆泄露。 RDL_31_2 - Embedding Vector Inference as Probabilistic Recall Leakage. 向量嵌入支持相似性检索，但嵌入本身也编码了有关情景的语义信息。 Vector embeddings enable similarity retrieval, but embeddings themselves encode semantic information about episodes. 攻击者通过推断嵌入空间中的模式，在无法直接访问的情况下重建情景内容。 Attackers inferring patterns in embedding spaces reconstructs episode content without direct access. 在具有数十亿个共享情景向量的多智能体系统中，推断攻击会揭示整个组织的运行模式。 In multi-agent systems with billions of shared episode vectors, inference attacks reveal organization-wide operational patterns. 多智能体区别：单智能体的嵌入保留在本地；包含数百万个向量的多智能体共享嵌入空间则使大规模推断攻击成为可能，从而推断出整个组织的运行情报。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-agent embeddings remain local; multi-agent shared embedding spaces with millions of vectors enable large-scale inference attacks inferring organization-wide operational intelligence. [630, 631, 632, 633, 634]. [630, 631, 632, 633, 634].
RDL_31_3 - 整合后的抽象表示作为导致泄露的信息聚合形式。 RDL_31_3 - Consolidated Abstractions as Information Aggregation for Leakage. 整合过程将原始情景细节概括为抽象表示。 Consolidation summarizes raw episode details into abstractions. 这些存储在语义记忆中的抽象表示保留了足以进行重建的信息。 These abstractions, stored in semantic memory, preserve enough information for reconstruction. 访问抽象表示记录的攻击者能够推断其背后的情景细节。 Attackers accessing abstraction records infer underlying episode details. 多智能体区别：单智能体系统可能保留本地语义记忆；多智能体组织基于整合后的抽象表示构建共享语义知识，由此形成汇聚整个组织信息的集中式存储库，使大规模推断成为可能。 Multi-agent distinction: Singular systems might preserve local semantic memories; multi-agent organizations with shared semantic knowledge built from consolidated abstractions create centralized repositories aggregating organization-wide information enabling large-scale inference. [237, 446, 635]. [237, 446, 635].
RDL_31_4 - 通过遍历图关系重建运行模式。 RDL_31_4 - Graph Relationship Traversal for Operational Pattern Reconstruction. 存储情景关系的图数据库支持通过遍历重建运行序列。 Graph databases storing episode relationships enable traversal reconstructing operational sequences. 攻击者通过遍历关系，对运行工作流和决策模式进行逆向工程。 Attackers traversing relationships reverse-engineer operational workflows and decision patterns. 多智能体区别：单智能体的图关系反映一个智能体的经历；多智能体关系图则反映整个组织的结构，从而能够全面重建运行情报。 Multi-agent distinction: Single agents’ graph relationships reflect one agent’s experience; multi-agent relationship graphs reflect entire organizational structure enabling comprehensive operational intelligence reconstruction. [636, 637, 638]. [636, 637, 638].
RDL_31_5 - 去重元数据作为统计信息泄露渠道。 RDL_31_5 - Deduplication Metadata as Statistical Information Leakage. 去重过程会记录“与 X 相似的情景”，从而使频率分析成为可能。 Deduplication records ”episodes similar to X” enabling frequency analysis. 攻击者通过推断去重模式，确定哪些操作属于常规操作、哪些较为罕见，从而重建威胁模型。 Attackers inferring deduplication patterns determine which operations are routine versus rare, reconstructing threat models. 多智能体区别：单智能体的去重统计数据揭示一个智能体的模式；多智能体聚合后的去重统计数据则揭示整个组织的模式，从而能够推断威胁模型。 Multi-agent distinction: Single agents’ deduplication statistics reveal one agent’s patterns; multi-agent aggregated deduplication stats reveal organization-wide patterns enabling threat model inference. [639, 640, 489]. [639, 640, 489].
RDL_31_6 - 情景回忆中的温度/采样伪影形成信息通道。 RDL_31_6 - Temperature/Sampling Artifacts in Episodic Recall Creating Information Channels. 检索根据嵌入相似度选取 topk；具体得分取决于嵌入生成过程中的温度/噪声。 Retrieval uses topk from embedding similarity; exact scores depend on temperature/noise during embedding generation. 攻击者通过分析重复检索结果中的方差，推断底层嵌入结构和情景属性。 Attackers analyzing variance in repeated retrievals infer underlying embedding structures and episode properties. 多智能体区别：单智能体的嵌入方差彼此孤立；具有数十亿次检索的多智能体系统则会形成统计模式，攻击者可利用这些统计模式推断整个组织的模式。 Multi-agent distinction: Single agents’ embedding variance remains isolated; multi-agent systems with billions of retrievals create statistical patterns attackers exploit inferring organization-wide patterns. [489, 289, 641, 366]. [489, 289, 641, 366].
III-B30 RDL_32 - 语义记忆III-B30 RDL_32 - Semantic Memory
RDL_32_1 - 通过检索文档发生的语义记忆上下文窗口泄露。 RDL_32_1 - Semantic Memory Context Window Leakage Through Retrieved Documents. RAG 系统将检索到的文档纳入上下文窗口。 RAG systems include retrieved documents in context windows. 知识库文档中的敏感信息会通过上下文泄露给智能体，也可能泄露给监控系统。 Sensitive information in knowledge base documents leaks through context to agents and potentially to monitoring systems. 多智能体区别：在由 Agent A 检索文档、Agent B 处理文档的多智能体 RAG 中，敏感数据会流向未受访问控制约束的智能体，从而导致跨智能体边界的信息泄露。 Multi-agent distinction: Multi-agent RAG where Agent A retrieves documents and Agent B processes them enables information leakage through agent boundaries where sensitive data flows to agents lacking access control. [642, 460, 643, 27, 644]. [642, 460, 643, 27, 644].
RDL_32_2 - 知识库文档枚举造成的信息披露。 RDL_32_2 - Knowledge Base Document Enumeration as Information Disclosure. 智能体查询语义记忆时，会通过检索模式暴露哪些文档存在。 Agents querying semantic memory reveal what documents exist through retrieval patterns. 攻击者通过系统性查询并分析检索结果，枚举知识库内容。 Attackers enumerate knowledge base contents through systematic queries analyzing retrieval results. 多智能体区别：分布式智能体对共享知识库的查询，使攻击者能够交叉比对智能体的查询模式，从而发现完整的知识库内容清单。 Multi-agent distinction: Distributed agents querying shared knowledge base enable attackers cross-referencing agent query patterns discovering comprehensive knowledge base inventory. [217, 645, 232, 228]. [217, 645, 232, 228].
RDL_32_3 - 嵌入相似度泄露使文档指纹识别成为可能。 RDL_32_3 - Embedding Similarity Leakage Enabling Document Fingerprinting. 嵌入编码了有关文档内容的信息。 Embeddings encode information about document content. 攻击者可以通过分析文档与查询之间的相似度模式，对文档进行指纹识别。 Attackers can fingerprint documents by analyzing similarity patterns between documents and queries. 攻击者提交用于探测已知文档特征的查询，例如标题关键词、已知数值或特定领域术语，即可通过观察哪些查询返回较高的相似度得分，确定哪些文档存在。 An attacker submitting queries that probe known document characteristics—such as title keywords, known numerical values, or domain-specific terminology—can map which documents exist by observing which queries return high similarity scores. 在多智能体系统中，对不同智能体发起的查询所产生的相似度分数进行交叉比对，可以从多个角度交叉推断文档内容。 In multi-agent systems, cross-referencing similarity scores from queries issued by different agents enables triangulating document content from multiple angles. 系统性的跨智能体嵌入相似度分析使攻击者无需直接访问文档即可重建知识库内容。 Systematic cross-agent embedding similarity analysis enables adversaries to reconstruct knowledge base contents without requiring direct document access. [646, 489, 647, 648]. [646, 489, 647, 648].
RDL_32_4 - 揭示文档历史的时间元数据泄漏。 RDL_32_4 - Temporal Metadata Leakage Revealing Document History. 知识库文档存储创建、修改和访问时间戳。 Knowledge base documents store creation, modification, and access timestamps. 时间模式会泄露有关系统演变和变更频率的信息。 Temporal patterns leak information about system evolution and change frequency. 多智能体特有之处：智能体之间共享的时间元数据使攻击者能够通过汇总时间分析重建系统运行时间线。 Multi-agent distinction: Shared temporal metadata across agents enables attackers reconstructing system operation timeline through aggregate temporal analysis. [649, 650, 651, 652, 653]. [649, 650, 651, 652, 653].
RDL_32_5 - 知识图谱结构作为信息泄漏通道。 RDL_32_5 - Knowledge Graph Structure as Information Leakage Channel. 可以根据缺失的关系推断知识图谱中的关系。 Knowledge graph relationships can be inferred from missing relationships. 关系的缺失本身就是信息——“人物 X 与组织 Y 之间没有联系”也会揭示信息。 Absence of relationships is information—”no connection between person X and organization Y” reveals information. 多智能体特有之处：共享的知识图谱结构使攻击者能够通过系统性的关系缺失模式推断敏感关系。 Multi-agent distinction: Shared knowledge graph structure enables attackers inferring sensitive relationships through systematic absence patterns. [654, 655, 232, 656, 657, 658, 659, 660, 661, 636, 662, 663]. [654, 655, 232, 656, 657, 658, 659, 660, 661, 636, 662, 663].
III-B31 RDL_33 - RAG 泄漏III-B31 RDL_33 - RAG Leakage
RDL_33_1 - RAG 相关性分数作为概率性信息泄漏。 RDL_33_1 - RAG Relevance Scores as Probabilistic Information Leakage. 语义相似度分数表明文档的相关程度。 Semantic similarity scores indicate how relevant documents are. 攻击者可以通过分析多次查询的相关性分数来推断文档内容。 Attackers can infer document content by analyzing relevance scores across multiple queries. 例如，知道某个知识库包含客户合同的攻击者，可以使用合同专用术语构造查询，并观察相关性分数，以确认特定合同是否存在及其大致日期范围。 For example, an attacker aware that a knowledge base contains client contracts can craft queries using contract-specific terminology and observe relevance scores that confirm presence and approximate date ranges of specific contracts. 在多个智能体共享同一语义索引的多智能体系统中，每个智能体都提供一个独立的观测通道，使系统性枚举语料库成为可能。 In multi-agent systems where multiple agents share the same semantic index, each agent provides an independent observation channel enabling systematic corpus enumeration. 由于无需访问文档内容即可观察相关性分数，因此这形成了一条低权限信息提取路径，任何拥有共享检索系统查询权限的主体都可以利用该路径。 Because relevance scores are observable without accessing document content, this creates a low-privilege information extraction path exploitable by any party with query access to the shared retrieval system. [664, 231, 665, 230, 666]. [664, 231, 665, 230, 666].
RDL_33_2 - 揭示操作意图的查询改写日志。 RDL_33_2 - Query Rewriting Logs Revealing Operational Intent. 查询改写通过变换用户查询来对其进行优化。 Query rewriting transforms user queries optimizing them. 改写后的查询揭示了系统对操作意图的理解。 Rewritten queries reveal system understanding of operational intent. 查询变换日志使攻击者能够了解智能体的推理过程。 Logs of query transformations enable attackers understanding agent reasoning processes. 多智能体特有之处：共享的查询改写基础设施会生成揭示多智能体操作模式的日志 [220, 261, 667, 668, 669, 670, 621, 671]。 Multi-agent distinction: Shared query rewriting infrastructure creates logs revealing multi-agent operational patterns [220, 261, 667, 668, 669, 670, 621, 671].
RDL_33_3 - 揭示内容相似性的去重产物泄漏。 RDL_33_3 - Deduplication Artifact Leakage Revealing Content Similarity. 去重会移除近似重复项，并产生反映哪些文档彼此相似的产物。 Deduplication removes near-duplicates creating artifacts about which documents are similar. 去重决策本身会泄露有关内容关系的信息。 The deduplication decision itself leaks information about content relationships. 例如，如果文档 A 因与文档 B 重复而被去重，查询系统的攻击者就会得知 A 和 B 具有共同内容，这可能揭示某项机密内部政策与一份公开可见的文档相匹配。 For example, if document A was deduplicated against document B, an attacker querying the system learns that A and B share content, potentially revealing that a confidential internal policy matches a publicly visible document. 在共享去重元数据的多智能体部署中，任何查询系统的智能体都可以访问这些信息。 In multi-agent deployments with shared deduplication metadata, this information is accessible to any agent querying the system. 因此，共享知识库中的去重产物会构成持续性的元数据泄漏，揭示单个文档的访问控制无法阻止泄露的内容关系。 Deduplication artifacts in shared knowledge bases thus constitute persistent metadata leakage revealing content relationships that individual document access controls cannot prevent. [574, 335, 672, 673, 674]. [574, 335, 672, 673, 674].
RDL_33_4 - 压缩质量验证失败导致的语义信息泄漏。 RDL_33_4 - Compression Quality Validation Failures Creating Semantic Information Leakage. 压缩验证试图通过蕴含检查和覆盖度分析来防止摘要生成过程中的幻觉，但多智能体系统中的验证失败会加剧泄漏风险。 Compression validation attempts to prevent hallucination during summarization through entailment checking and coverage analysis, but validation failures in multi-agent systems compound leakage risks. 当 Agent A 的压缩验证器静默失效时（检测到幻觉，但因超时仍允许摘要通过），含有幻觉的摘要会传播给 Agent B，并作为“已验证知识”进入情景记忆。 When Agent A’s compression validator fails silently (detecting hallucination but allowing summary anyway due to timeout), the hallucinated summary propagates to Agent B and becomes ”validated knowledge” entering episodic memory. 后续智能体将含有幻觉但“已验证”的内容视为可靠内容，使虚假信息比原始来源材料更具可信度。 Subsequent agents treat hallucinated but ”validated” content as reliable, making false information more credible than original source material. 多智能体压缩引入了下游智能体信任的元元数据（验证状态），由此造成信息泄漏：尽管验证实际上已经失败，虚假摘要仍因“Agent A 已验证此次压缩”而被视为高度可信。 Multi-agent compression introduces meta-metadata (validation status) that downstream agents trust, creating information leakage where false summaries are treated as highly credible because ”Agent A validated this compression” despite validation actually failing. [675, 676, 677, 14, 678]. [675, 676, 677, 14, 678].
RDL_33_5 - 知识蒸馏过程中从语义记忆到工作记忆的增强所导致的信息泄漏。 RDL_33_5 - Semantic-to-Working Augmentation Information Leakage During Knowledge Distillation. 当从特定的工作记忆情节中提取语义知识时（将“User_12345 通过 method_X 解决了问题”泛化为“用户通常通过 method_X 解决问题”），蒸馏会导致私有情节中的信息泄漏到共享语义知识中。 When semantic knowledge is extracted from specific working memory episodes (generalizing ”User_12345 solved problem via method_X” to ”users typically solve via method_X”), distillation creates leakage of information from private episodes into shared semantic knowledge. 在多智能体系统中，当智能体 A 从涉及多个智能体上下文的多智能体情节中蒸馏语义知识时，泛化过程可能纳入能够识别特定智能体实例、用户行为或工具链的信息。 In multi-agent systems, when Agent A distills semantic knowledge from multi-agent episodes involving multiple agents’ context, the generalization process may include identifying information about specific agent instances, user behaviors, or tool chains. 语义记忆成为隐私泄露的渠道，情节记忆中的信息通过蒸馏泄漏出来，影响所有访问语义记忆的智能体。 Semantic memory becomes a privacy breach channel where information from episodic memory leaks through distillation, affecting all agents accessing semantic memory. 与从单个情节中进行单次语义抽象不同，多智能体语义蒸馏会聚合多个智能体的私有上下文，从而在抽象边界处造成隐私泄漏。 Unlike singular semantic abstraction from single episodes, multi-agent semantic distillation aggregates across multiple agents’ private context, creating privacy leaks at abstraction boundaries. [679, 680, 681, 682, 683, 684, 685, 686, 621, 687]. [679, 680, 681, 682, 683, 684, 685, 686, 621, 687].
III-B32 RDL_34 - 效用函数与解释III-B32 RDL_34 - Utility Functions and Explanations
RDL_34_1 - 多智能体聊天界面中渐进式披露 UI 的信息泄漏。 RDL_34_1 - Progressive Disclosure UI Information Leakage in Multi-Agent Chat Interfaces. 渐进式披露将技术细节隐藏在可展开视图中，造成可观测性层面的信息泄漏：敏感上下文仅出现在用户很少查看的展开区域中。 Progressive disclosure hides technical details in expandable views, creating observability-level information leakage where sensitive context appears only in expanded sections users rarely inspect. 在多智能体聊天界面中，各智能体的披露层独立运作——某个智能体的技术视图可能包含来自另一个智能体执行上下文的 API 令牌、来自服务调用的数据库连接字符串，或内部指令产物。 In multi-agent chat interfaces, each agent’s disclosure layers operate independently—one agent’s technical view might contain API tokens from another agent’s execution context, database connection strings from service calls, or internal instruction artifacts. 专注于基本视图的用户会忽略散布在多个智能体技术披露层中的敏感数据。 Users focusing on essential views miss sensitive data scattered across multiple agents’ technical disclosure layers. 与采用集中式披露的单智能体聊天界面不同，多智能体界面将敏感数据分布在 N 个智能体的可展开区域中，形成 N 个信息泄漏途径。 Unlike singular agent chat interfaces with consolidated disclosure, multi-agent interfaces distribute sensitive data across N agents’ expandable sections, creating N information leak vectors. [495, 496, 688]. [495, 496, 688].
RDL_34_2 - 通过渐进式披露泄露聊天界面中的效用参数。 RDL_34_2 - Chat Interface Utility Parameter Disclosure Through Progressive Disclosure. 显示展开技术视图的聊天界面可能暴露智能体决策时使用的效用函数参数（权重、结果估值）。 Chat interfaces showing expanded technical views can expose utility function parameters (weights, outcome valuations) agents use for decisions. 看到这些参数的用户或攻击者可以推断优化目标，并据此设计攻击。 Users or attackers seeing these parameters can infer optimization targets and craft attacks accordingly. 多智能体系统会暴露多个智能体的参数，呈现系统完整的效用格局。 Multi-agent systems expose parameters from multiple agents showing complete utility landscape of the system. 多智能体情形的区别：单个智能体暴露一个效用函数；多智能体系统则暴露一组效用函数，显示各智能体在优化方面的差异，从而使针对特定智能体的定向攻击成为可能。 Multi-agent distinction: Single agent exposes one utility function; multi-agent systems expose utility function collections showing how agents differ in optimization, enabling targeted attacks on specific agents. [495, 23, 489, 478, 460]. [495, 23, 489, 478, 460].
RDL_34_3 - 效用解释期间流式输出的决策理由泄漏。 RDL_34_3 - Streaming Decision Rationale Leakage During Utility Explanation. 当智能体以流式方式解释决策时（例如，“我选择选项 A 是因为……”），流式解释可能泄漏智能体所使用的效用计算、结果估计和概率假设。 When agents explain decisions through streaming (e.g., ”I chose option A because…”), streaming explanation can leak utility calculations, outcome estimates, and probability assumptions agents used. 流式输出过程中尚未完成的解释，会在智能体来得及删去敏感效用细节之前暴露内部推理。 Incomplete explanations during streaming expose internal reasoning before agents can redact sensitive utility details. 多智能体情形的区别：在智能体 A 向智能体 B 解释效用的多智能体流式交接过程中，解释在删去敏感内容之前便在智能体之间传播，从而形成多个泄漏窗口。 Multi-agent distinction: Multi-agent streaming handoffs where Agent A explains utilities to Agent B create multiple leakage windows as explanations propagate through agents before redaction. [478, 460, 489, 295, 293]. [478, 460, 489, 295, 293].
RDL_34_4 - 错误消息中的结果效用泄露。 RDL_34_4 - Error Message Outcome Utility Disclosure. 当工具发生故障时，错误消息可能泄露智能体预期的结果及其效用值（“预期得到高效用结果，实际却收到错误”）。 When tools fail, error messages can disclose what outcomes the agent expected and their utility values (”expected high-utility outcome, received error instead”). 汇总多智能体系统中的错误消息会揭示效用预期，进而暴露攻击面。 Aggregated error messages across multi-agent system reveal utility expectations revealing attack surface. 多智能体情形的区别：多个智能体的错误信息披露会揭示其综合效用格局；单个智能体的错误仅揭示该智能体的效用。 Multi-agent distinction: Error disclosure from multiple agents reveals their combined utility landscape; singular agent errors reveal one agent’s utilities. [689, 23, 690]. [689, 23, 690].
RDL_34_5 - 解释生成中的推理轨迹泄漏。 RDL_34_5 - Inference Trace Leakage in Explanation Generation. 根据推理轨迹生成解释会暴露规则触发序列和中间事实，这些内容可能通过轨迹解释泄露敏感信息。 Explanation generation from inference traces exposes rule firing sequences and intermediate facts that can reveal sensitive information through trace explanation. 在轨迹沿工作流传播的多智能体系统中，敏感的中间事实可能通过原本不应暴露这些信息的解释渠道泄漏。 In multi-agent systems where traces propagate through workflows, sensitive intermediate facts may leak through explanation channels not intended for exposure. 多智能体情形的区别：单智能体的轨迹解释保留在该智能体的上下文内；为实现透明性或协调而进行的多智能体轨迹传播，则会因轨迹的共享可见性而使数据泄漏成为可能。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-agent trace explanations remain within agent context; multi-agent trace propagation for transparency/coordination enables data leakage through shared trace visibility. [261, 392, 39]. [261, 392, 39].
RDL_34_6 - 通过共享持久化存储暴露工作记忆内容。 RDL_34_6 - Working Memory Content Exposure Through Shared Persistence. 工作记忆存储当前事实和中间结论。 Working memory stores current facts and intermediate conclusions. 在采用共享持久化工作记忆的多智能体系统中，所有事实始终对各智能体可见。 In multi-agent systems with shared persistent working memory, all facts remain visible across agents. 存储在工作记忆中的敏感事实（客户凭据、病史、财务详情）会通过共享持久化存储跨越智能体边界而泄漏。 Sensitive facts stored in working memory (customer credentials, medical history, financial details) leak across agent boundaries through shared persistence. 多智能体情形的区别：单智能体的工作记忆保持私有；多智能体的共享工作记忆则会产生单智能体系统中不存在的数据暴露风险。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-agent working memory remains private; multi-agent shared working memory creates data exposure risks unavailable in singular systems. [291, 27, 590, 283]. [291, 27, 590, 283].
RDL_34_7 - 用于重建的规则条件推断。 RDL_34_7 - Rule Condition Inference for Reconstruction. 包含许多条件的详细规则可能泄露有关受保护概念的信息。 Detailed rules with many conditions can leak information about protected concepts. 规则“IF diagnosis=pneumonia AND age¿65 AND comorbidity_diabetes=true THEN refer_ICU”会通过规则结构泄露相关性模式。 A rule ”IF diagnosis=pneumonia AND age¿65 AND comorbidity_diabetes=true THEN refer_ICU” leaks correlation patterns through rule structure. 在规则可共享且可检查的多智能体系统中，规则结构会通过逻辑推理暴露受保护信息。 In multi-agent systems where rules are shared and inspectable, rule structure reveals protected information through logical inference. 多智能体情形的区别：单智能体的内部规则不可供外部检查；多智能体共享的透明规则库则使得通过检查规则结构来推断数据成为可能。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-agent internal rules hidden from inspection; multi-agent shared transparent rule bases enable data inference through rule structure examination. [691, 39, 225, 692, 693]. [691, 39, 225, 692, 693].
III-B33 RDL_35 - 强化学习与策略III-B33 RDL_35 - Reinforcement Learning and Policy
RDL_35_1 - 针对已学习策略的基于梯度的模型反演攻击。 RDL_35_1 - Gradient-Based Model Inversion Attacks on Learned Policies. 通过梯度下降训练得到的学习型策略可被反演，从而通过梯度分析暴露训练数据。 Learning-based policies trained via gradient descent can be inverted revealing training data through gradient analysis. 共享梯度的多智能体系统使攻击者能够通过分析聚合梯度，重建所有智能体的训练数据，其中包括敏感信息。 Multi-agent systems with shared gradients enable attackers analyzing aggregated gradients reconstructing all agents’ training data including sensitive information. 多智能体情形的区别：联邦学习会暴露梯度，而集中式训练会隐藏梯度，但基于梯度的攻击是学习型系统所特有的。 Multi-agent distinction: Federated learning exposes gradients; centralized training hides them, but gradient-based attacks unique to learning-based systems. [694, 695, 696, 697, 698]. [694, 695, 696, 697, 698].
