RDL_35_2 - 暴露训练情境的价值函数重建。 RDL_35_2 - Value Function Reconstruction Revealing Training Context. 学习得到的价值函数编码了从训练经验中学到的状态价值知识。 Learned value functions encode knowledge of state values learned from training experiences. 攻击者可以查询价值函数，重建训练中出现过哪些状态以及经历过哪些情境。 Attackers can query value functions reconstructing which states appeared in training and what contexts were experienced. 在共享价值网络的多智能体系统中，重建会暴露所有智能体的训练数据。 In multi-agent systems with shared value networks, reconstruction reveals all agents’ training data. 多智能体情形的区别：共享价值网络会泄露全部训练数据；分布式网络则会泄露各个智能体的数据。 Multi-agent distinction: Shared value networks leak all training data; distributed networks leak per-agent data. [699, 700]. [699, 700].
RDL_35_3 - 通过策略行为查询重建训练数据。 RDL_35_3 - Policy Behavior Querying Reconstructing Training Data. 暴露动作概率的黑盒策略查询使攻击者能够重建训练数据分布——在特定场景上接受过训练的智能体会表现出独特的行为模式。 Black-box policy queries revealing action probabilities enable attackers reconstructing training data distributions—agents that trained on specific scenarios show distinctive behavior patterns. 多智能体情形的区别：共享训练产生的同步策略会泄露同步模式，从而使关联攻击成为可能。 Multi-agent distinction: Synchronized policies from shared training leak synchronized patterns enabling correlation attacks. [701, 702, 703, 704, 705]. [701, 702, 703, 704, 705].
RDL_35_4 - 经验回放缓冲区侧信道攻击。 RDL_35_4 - Experience Replay Buffer Side-Channel Attacks. DRL（深度强化学习）系统将经验存储在回放缓冲区中。 DRL (Deep Reinforcement Learning) systems store experiences in replay buffers. 缓冲区管理（采样分布、淘汰顺序）会产生暴露缓冲区内容的侧信道。 Buffer management (sampling distributions, eviction order) creates side channels revealing buffer contents. 多智能体系统中的大型共享缓冲区会泄露聚合的训练数据。 Large shared buffers in multi-agent systems leak aggregated training data. 多智能体情形的区别：共享缓冲区会通过统一信道泄露所有智能体的数据。 Multi-agent distinction: Shared buffers leak all agents’ data through unified channels. [706, 707, 708, 709, 710]. [706, 707, 708, 709, 710].
RDL_35_5 - 奖励函数逆向工程。 RDL_35_5 - Reward Function Reverse Engineering. 训练得到的智能体的行为会暴露奖励函数的结构。 Learned agents’ behaviors reveal reward function structure. 攻击者对训练中使用的奖励函数进行逆向工程，从而发现敏感的优化目标。 Attackers reverse-engineer reward functions used in training, discovering sensitive optimization objectives. 对共享奖励进行优化的多智能体系统会通过多个智能体的行为，更快地泄露奖励函数。 Multi-agent systems optimizing shared rewards leak function faster through multiple agent behaviors. 多智能体情形的区别：聚合行为会暴露共享奖励；分布式奖励则需要逐一分析。 Multi-agent distinction: Behavior aggregation reveals shared rewards; distributed rewards require individual analysis. [711, 712, 713, 714, 715]. [711, 712, 713, 714, 715].
RDL_35_6 - 作为信息泄露途径的学习曲线分析。 RDL_35_6 - Learning Curve Analysis as Information Leakage. 训练曲线（损失随时间的变化、奖励的变化趋势）会泄露有关训练数据和训练过程的信息。 Training curves (loss over time, reward progression) leak information about training data and processes. 跨智能体聚合的多智能体训练曲线会暴露联合训练的统计模式。 Multi-agent training curves aggregated across agents reveal statistical patterns of combined training. 对手通过实验跟踪仪表板监测已发布的训练指标，可以通过观察与特定领域训练相关的特征性损失轨迹形态，检测智能体何时使用特定类型的数据进行了微调。 An adversary monitoring published training metrics accessible through experiment-tracking dashboards can detect when agents were fine-tuned on specific data types by observing characteristic loss trajectory shapes associated with domain-specific training. 训练曲线的跨智能体相关性会暴露智能体是否共享训练数据，从而使推断组织的敏感数据集成为可能。 Cross-agent correlation of training curves reveals whether agents share training data, enabling inference about sensitive organizational datasets. 因此，在多智能体集群范围内聚合的学习曲线会泄露整体训练模式，使对手能够推断训练语料库的组成及其敏感程度。 Aggregated learning curves across a multi-agent fleet thus leak collective training patterns enabling adversaries to infer the composition and sensitivity of training corpora. [213, 585, 716, 717]. [213, 585, 716, 717].
RDL_35_7 - 混合智能体协调中的上下文窗口扩展数据泄露。 RDL_35_7 - Context Window Expansion Data Leakage in Hybrid Agent Coordination. 混合多智能体系统通过扩展上下文窗口，跨智能体边界维护共享的范式状态。 Hybrid multi-agent systems expand context windows to maintain shared paradigm state across agent boundaries. 更大的上下文包含更多敏感数据，这些数据容易通过概率性词元生成而泄露。 Larger contexts contain more sensitive data vulnerable to leakage through probabilistic token generation. 多智能体特有之处：单个大型上下文中的数据在本地泄露；而在多智能体共享大型上下文的情况下，Agent A 维护的扩展上下文包含 Agent B 的状态变量，来自多个智能体的敏感数据集中在共享上下文窗口中，从而造成分布式泄露。 Multi-agent distinction: Single large contexts leak data locally; multi-agent shared large contexts where Agent A maintains expanded context including Agent B’s state variables create distributed leakage where sensitive data from multiple agents concentrates in shared context windows. 这种集中式上下文使攻击者能够从任何访问该上下文的智能体中提取敏感数据。 The centralized context enables attackers extracting sensitive data from any agent accessing the context. [237, 718, 153, 39, 719]. [237, 718, 153, 39, 719].
III-B34 RDL_36 - 多智能体协调III-B34 RDL_36 - Multi-Agent Coordination
RDL_36_1 - 通过共享历史记录泄露多智能体对话轨迹。 RDL_36_1 - Multi-Agent Conversation Trace Leakage Through Shared History. 为支持智能体间的混合协作而维护的对话历史记录，会积累来自多个智能体交互的敏感数据。 Conversation history maintained for hybrid cooperation across agents accumulates sensitive data from multiple agents’ interactions. 词元生成过程中的概率性回忆可能输出共享历史记录中的敏感数据。 Probabilistic recall in token generation may output sensitive data from shared history. 多智能体特有之处：单个对话的历史记录彼此隔离；而多智能体共享的对话轨迹会使来自 Agents A, B, C 的数据集中到统一的历史记录中。 Multi-agent distinction: Single conversation histories are isolated; multi-agent shared conversation traces enable data from Agents A, B, C concentrating in unified history. 攻击者通过触发下游智能体的概率性回忆，可提取整个多智能体对话历史记录中积累的敏感数据，而非单个智能体的孤立数据。 Attackers triggering probabilistic recall in downstream agents extract accumulated sensitive data from entire multi-agent conversation history, not isolated agent data. [62, 478, 460, 73, 293]. [62, 478, 460, 73, 293].
RDL_36_2 - 通过嵌入推断泄露知识图谱边权重。 RDL_36_2 - Knowledge Graph Edge Weight Leakage via Embedding Inference. 知识图谱存储带权重的关系，可据此推断敏感关联。 Knowledge graphs store weighted relationships enabling inference of sensitive associations. 基于知识图谱训练的嵌入可能通过概率性生成泄露关系权重。 Embeddings trained on knowledge graphs may leak relationship weights through probabilistic generation. 多智能体特有之处：单个图谱嵌入会在本地泄露图谱结构；而多个智能体使用共享知识图谱嵌入的多智能体系统会形成集中式泄露源，针对嵌入推断的攻击可提取敏感关系数据，影响使用这些嵌入的整个智能体群体。 Multi-agent distinction: Single graph embeddings leak graph structure locally; multi-agent systems using shared knowledge graph embeddings for multiple agents create centralized leakage source where attacks on embedding inference extract sensitive relationship data affecting entire agent ensemble using those embeddings. [720, 636, 622, 662]. [720, 636, 622, 662].
III-C 智能体身份、来源追溯与经济/资源攻击面III-C Agent identity, provenance, and economic/resource attack surface
智能体系统缺乏成熟的身份、来源追溯和成本控制机制，因而产生了独特的安全挑战，近期的立场论文和 NIST 信息征询（RFI）流程均强调了这些挑战。 Agentic systems lack mature identity, provenance, and cost-control mechanisms, creating distinct security challenges highlighted in recent position papers and the NIST RFI process.
独特维度： Unique dimensions:
• 智能体身份机制薄弱或缺失：智能体通常使用共享 API 密钥或通用服务账户运行，导致人类主体与智能体实例及策略之间的映射关系模糊不清。 • Weak or absent agent identity: Agents often operate using shared API keys or generic service accounts, blurring the mapping from human principals to agent instances and policies.
• 经济滥用与资源劫持：成本直接与词元、向量查询和 API 调用挂钩，使攻击者能够通过高成本计划、不必要的工具调用或插件驱动的“资源寄生”实施钱包拒绝服务攻击（denial-of-wallet），或隐蔽地向外转移资源。 • Economic abuse and resource hijacking: Costs tied directly to tokens, vector queries, and API calls enable denial-of-wallet attacks or covert resource exfiltration through expensive plans, unnecessary tool calls, or plugin-driven ”resource leeching.”
传统微服务具有稳定、明确管理的身份以及可预测的资源使用特征；与之不同，智能体系统将身份和成本与习得行为松散绑定，使攻击者对身份和成本都具有更大的操控空间。 Unlike traditional microservices with stable, explicitly managed identities and predictable resource profiles, agentic systems bind identities and costs loosely to learned behavior, giving attackers greater leverage over both.
III-C1 RIP_1 - 多智能体 UI 与仪表板攻击III-C1 RIP_1 - Multi-Agent UI & Dashboard Attacks
RIP_1_1 - 利用归属判定缺口实施多智能体仪表板身份欺骗。 RIP_1_1 - Multi-Agent Dashboard Identity Spoofing Through Attribution Gaps. 缺乏清晰身份标识（固定头像、颜色编码、密码学签名）的多智能体仪表板用户界面，使攻击者能够利用用户对不同专业化智能体角色的差异化信任实施冒充攻击。 Multi-agent dashboard UIs without clear identity indicators (persistent avatars, color coding, cryptographic signatures) enable impersonation attacks exploiting differentiated user trust in specialized agent roles. 攻击者注入的内容看似来自可信的高权限智能体，实际上却来自已被攻陷的低权限智能体。 Attackers inject content appearing from trusted high-authority agents when actually from compromised low-authority agents. 用户与专业化智能体之间会形成不对称的信任关系，从而为社会工程攻击创造机会。 Users develop asymmetric trust relationships with specialized agents, creating social engineering opportunities. 与单智能体系统不同，多智能体仪表板必须在 UI 层验证智能体身份。 Unlike singular agent systems, multi-agent dashboards must authenticate agent identity at the UI layer. 缺乏密码学验证使已被攻陷的 RAG 流水线或恶意插件能够注入经过样式包装的内容，绕过用户对未知来源通常抱有的怀疑。 The lack of cryptographic verification allows compromised RAG pipelines or malicious plugins to inject styled content bypassing skepticism applied to unknown sources. 在 UI 层缺乏密码学身份验证的情况下，仪表板无法可靠地确认消息由哪个智能体撰写。 In the absence of cryptographic identity verification at the UI layer, the dashboard cannot reliably assert which agent authored a message. [721, 45, 465, 722, 723, 724]. [721, 45, 465, 722, 723, 724].
RIP_1_2 - 多智能体仪表板的归属取证失效阻碍攻击调查。 RIP_1_2 - Multi-Agent Dashboard Attribution Forensics Failures Preventing Attack Investigation. 如果多智能体仪表板用户界面缺乏详细的归属日志，未记录哪个智能体基于哪些输入生成了哪些内容，就会造成严重的取证盲区。 Multi-agent dashboard UIs without detailed attribution logs for which agent generated which content based on which inputs create significant forensics blind spots. 当发现恶意决策时，缺乏细粒度的归属信息会使人无法确定流水线中的哪个智能体已被攻陷。 When malicious decisions are discovered, the lack of fine-grained attribution makes determining which agent in the pipeline was compromised impossible. 这种多智能体漏洞要求跨多个智能体的交互追踪因果关系，其复杂程度远高于单智能体取证。 This multi-agent vulnerability requires tracing causality across multiple agent interactions—far more complex than singular agent forensics. 攻击者可以选择攻陷可见性较低的智能体，因为他们知道，恶意输出在整个流水线中将难以追溯。 Attackers can compromise low-visibility agents knowing malicious outputs will be difficult to trace through the pipeline. [725]. [725].
RIP_1_3 - 多智能体仪表板实时成本归属判定失效。 RIP_1_3 - Multi-Agent Dashboard Real-Time Cost Attribution Failures. 多智能体仪表板用户界面展示多个智能体的输出，却未对每个智能体的贡献进行实时成本归因，这会造成经济责任追溯缺口。 Multi-agent dashboard UIs displaying outputs from multiple agents without real-time cost attribution for each agent’s contributions create economic accountability gaps. 用户无法识别遭到攻陷或配置错误的智能体何时消耗了过量资源，从而使经济攻击得以隐藏在汇总报告中。 Users cannot identify when compromised or misconfigured agents consume excessive resources, enabling economic attacks hiding in aggregate reporting. 多智能体仪表板需要提供按智能体细分的实时成本明细，以便在大量成本累积、难以追溯到具体智能体之前，识别并防止资源滥用。 Multi-agent dashboards require real-time per-agent cost breakdowns enabling identification and prevention of resource abuse before significant costs accumulate and become difficult to attribute back to the specific agents. [726, 727, 728]. [726, 727, 728].
RIP_1_4 - GroupChat 发言者归属标注因身份混淆而使社会工程攻击成为可能。 RIP_1_4 - GroupChat Speaker Attribution Enabling Social Engineering Through Identity Confusion. GroupChat 的消息历史记录将消息归属于发送者身份，但如果身份可通过提示注入被操纵，攻击者就能冒充其他智能体。 GroupChat message history attributes messages to sender identity, but if identity is manipulable through prompt injection, attackers can appear as other agents. 看似来自安全审查智能体（Security Reviewer）、实际源于遭到攻陷的研究智能体（Research Agent）的消息，使攻击者能够通过虚假的来源归属实施操纵。 Messages appearing from Security Reviewer but originating from compromised Research Agent enable manipulation through false attribution. 单智能体不会进行智能体间通信；GroupChat 的归属标注机制形成了多智能体对等通信所特有的社会工程攻击面。 Singular agents don’t communicate; GroupChat’s attribution creates social engineering surfaces unique to multi-agent peer communication. [729, 730]. [729, 730].
III-C2 RIP_2 - 审批与工作流攻击III-C2 RIP_2 - Approval & Workflow Attacks
RIP_2_1 - 审批工作流溯源追踪失效使决策归属攻击成为可能。 RIP_2_1 - Approval Workflow Provenance Tracking Failures Enabling Decision Attribution Attacks. 审批工作流用户界面缺乏密码学溯源记录，会造成责任追溯缺口。 Approval workflow UIs lacking cryptographic provenance trails create accountability gaps. 在由 Agent A 分析风险、Agent B 检查合规性、Agent C 建议批准，再由人类审核的顺序链中，遭到攻陷的智能体可以注入恶意建议，而后续审批者则因假定这些建议具有合法性而在不知情的情况下予以批准。 Sequential chains where Agent A analyzes risk, Agent B checks compliance, Agent C recommends approval, and humans review enable attacks where compromised agents inject malicious recommendations while subsequent approvers unknowingly approve based on assumed legitimacy. 每位参与者都假定前面的参与者已经履行了尽职审查义务。 Each participant assumes previous participants performed due diligence. 如果没有密码学证据证明分析由哪个智能体生成，攻击者就能在流水线的任一阶段注入恶意逻辑。 Without cryptographic proof of which agent generated analysis, attackers inject malicious logic at any pipeline stage. 当攻击者控制链中的一个智能体，使其输出经过细微操纵的分析——例如虚高的置信度分数、被压制的风险标记或伪造的前序智能体背书——而流水线的下一阶段又不加质疑地接受这些内容时，就会发生恶意注入。 Malicious injection occurs when an attacker controls one agent in the chain, causing it to output subtly manipulated analysis—inflated confidence scores, suppressed risk flags, or fabricated prior-agent endorsements—that the next pipeline stage accepts at face value. 用户界面中结构化的“AI 分析”区域缺乏密码学签名，使攻击者能够修改建议或注入伪造的分析。 The UI’s structured ”AI Analysis” sections without cryptographic signatures allow modifying recommendations or injecting fabricated analysis. [731, 732, 11, 733, 469, 258, 734]. [731, 732, 11, 733, 469, 258, 734].
RIP_2_2 - 通过选择性攻陷智能体实施的审批工作流置信度聚合攻击。 RIP_2_2 - Approval Workflow Confidence Aggregation Attacks Through Selective Agent Compromise. 审批工作流用户界面展示多个智能体的聚合置信度分数，却不展示各智能体的明细，使攻击者能够通过攻陷高权重智能体来操纵最终显示结果。 Approval workflow UIs displaying aggregated confidence scores from multiple agents without showing per-agent breakdowns enable attacks where compromising high-weight agents manipulates final displays. 在安全智能体权重为 40%、策略智能体权重为 30%、业务智能体权重为 30% 的加权系统中，攻击者可以集中攻击高权重智能体，以最大化攻击影响。 In weighted systems where security agents are weighted 40%, policy agents 30%, and business agents 30%, attackers can focus on high-weight agents to maximize impact. 攻击者在高权重智能体的分析阶段注入对抗性输入，例如遭到操纵的文档内容、被投毒的工具输出或精心构造的检索结果，从而攻陷该智能体，使其生成虚高的置信度分数，并对聚合结果造成不成比例的偏移。 Compromise of a high-weight agent is achieved by injecting adversarial inputs during its analysis phase—such as manipulated document content, poisoned tool outputs, or crafted retrieval results—causing it to generate inflated confidence scores that disproportionately skew the aggregate. 用户界面显示“置信度：92% - 建议批准”，却未披露遭到攻陷的安全智能体报告了 98% 的置信度（权重为 40%），而正常智能体报告的置信度更低。 The UI shows ”Confidence: 92% - Recommend Approve” without revealing the compromised security agent reported 98% (weighted 40%) while legitimate agents reported lower confidence. 与单智能体系统不同，多智能体置信度聚合机制允许一个高权重智能体压过多个低权重智能体的质疑。 Unlike singular agent systems, multi-agent confidence aggregation lets one high-weight agent override skepticism from multiple lower-weight agents. [23, 735, 736]. [23, 735, 736].
RIP_2_3 - 通过操纵用户界面状态篡改审批工作流的决策溯源信息。 RIP_2_3 - Approval Workflow Decision Provenance Tampering Through UI State Manipulation. 审批工作流界面将决策溯源信息存储在客户端状态或身份验证薄弱的日志中，使攻击者能够篡改记录，掩盖恶意审批。 Approval workflow interfaces storing decision provenance in client-side state or weakly authenticated logs enable attackers to tamper with records obscuring malicious approvals. 在多智能体系统中，工作流涉及复杂的状态信息，包括哪些智能体提供了分析、显示了哪些置信度分数，以及人类作出了什么决定。 In multi-agent systems, workflows involve complex state including which agents provided analysis, what confidence scores were displayed, and what humans decided. 如果存储时未使用密码学签名，攻击者就能修改记录，转移责任归属。 If stored without cryptographic signatures, attackers can modify records shifting accountability. 这种多智能体漏洞涉及复杂的溯源图，其中任何节点都可能遭到篡改。 This multi-agent vulnerability involves complex provenance graphs where tampering can occur at any point. 与审批记录简单的单智能体系统不同，多智能体工作流需要采用能够显现篡改痕迹的日志记录机制。 Unlike singular agent systems with simple approval records, multi-agent workflows require tamper-evident logging. [731, 737, 11, 58, 18]. [731, 737, 11, 58, 18].
RIP_2_4 - 智能体顺序审查中审批工作流的多阶段溯源缺口。 RIP_2_4 - Approval Workflow Multi-Stage Provenance Gaps in Sequential Agent Reviews. 审批工作流用户界面展示多阶段智能体流水线的最终建议，却未提供中间阶段的密码学溯源信息，这会造成责任追溯缺口。 Approval workflow UIs displaying final recommendations from multi-stage agent pipelines without cryptographic provenance for intermediate stages create accountability gaps. 一项建议可能产生于如下流程：Agent A 的初步评估传递给 Agent B 进行合规性检查，再传递给 Agent C 形成最终建议；但仅展示 Agent C 的输出，会使早期阶段遭到攻陷后产生的污染渗入分析。 A recommendation might result from Agent A’s initial assessment passing to Agent B’s compliance check passing to Agent C’s final recommendation, but showing only Agent C’s output allows early-stage compromise to poison analysis. 这种多智能体顺序处理漏洞增加了攻击机会——攻陷任何一个智能体都会影响最终建议。 This multi-agent sequential vulnerability amplifies attack opportunities—compromising any agent affects final recommendations. 用户界面将多阶段分析抽象为简化的“AI 建议”，使中间阶段的完整性无法得到验证。 The UI’s abstraction of multi-stage analysis into simplified ”AI Recommendation” prevents integrity verification of intermediate stages. [738, 176, 739, 79]. [738, 176, 739, 79].
RIP_2_5 - 审批决策归属不明确。 RIP_2_5 - Approval Decision Attribution Ambiguity. 当多个参与者共同促成最终决策时，HITL（Human In The Loop，人在回路）审批工作流会导致归责不明确。 HITL (Human In The Loop) approval workflows create ambiguous attribution when multiple actors contribute to final decisions. 多智能体情境会加剧这一问题，因为审批链跨越多个采用不同策略的智能体，导致归责在智能体边界之间碎片化。 Multi-agent contexts amplify this because approval chains span multiple agents with different policies—attribution fragments across agent boundaries. 缓解措施需要明确分配责任（由用户选择决策权限归属）、记录修改及其原因、跟踪批量审批的粒度、记录超时默认处理的来源，以及重建决策链，保留从初始建议到历次修改的完整沿袭关系，以确保归责在所有智能体交接过程中保持一致且可验证。 Mitigation requires explicit responsibility assignment (users selecting decision authority), modification logging with reasons, batch approval granularity tracking, timeout default provenance, and decision chain reconstruction maintaining complete lineage from initial recommendation through modifications to ensure attribution remains consistent and verifiable across all agent transitions. [44, 740, 741, 742]. [44, 740, 741, 742].
III-C3 RIP_3 - 命令面板与 UI 攻击III-C3 RIP_3 - Command Palette & UI Attacks
RIP_3_1 - 命令面板成本可见性缺口引发经济型拒绝服务。 RIP_3_1 - Command Palette Cost Visibility Gaps Enabling Economic Denial-of-Service. 命令面板在建议 AI 驱动的操作时不显示资源成本，会使拒绝服务攻击成为可能：攻击者通过操纵上下文，使系统推荐高成本操作，而用户在不了解成本的情况下执行这些操作。 Command palettes suggesting AI-powered actions without displaying resource costs enable denial-of-service attacks where context manipulation recommends expensive operations users execute without cost awareness. 在多智能体系统中，建议可能触发涉及多个高成本智能体的工作流，使总成本比用户预期高出数个数量级。 In multi-agent systems, suggestions may trigger workflows involving multiple expensive agents, and aggregate costs exceed user expectations by orders of magnitude. 攻击者污染上下文来源，促使系统主动建议资源密集型操作。 Attackers poison context sources causing proactive suggestions for resource-intensive operations. 与成本固定的传统应用程序或成本可预测的单智能体系统不同，多智能体系统的成本是动态的，并且依赖于上下文。 Unlike traditional applications with static costs or singular agent systems with predictable costs, multi-agent systems have dynamic, context-dependent costs. UI 缺乏实时成本估算，使得 API 配额或分配的资源额度可能在用户不知情的情况下被消耗殆尽。 The UI’s lack of real-time cost estimation enables consuming API quotas or exhausting allocations without user awareness. [400, 79, 743, 73]. [400, 79, 743, 73].
RIP_3_2 - 命令面板建议归属中的智能体身份混淆。 RIP_3_2 - Command Palette Agent Identity Confusion in Suggestion Attribution. 命令面板在显示建议时未明确标示生成建议的智能体，会造成归属混淆。 Command palettes displaying suggestions without clearly indicating which agent produced them create attribution confusion. 在多智能体系统中，用户会根据各智能体的过往表现形成差异化的信任。 In multi-agent systems, users develop differentiated trust based on track records. 攻击者攻陷低信任度的生产力智能体后，可以注入危险命令，使其看起来来自高信任度的安全智能体。 An attacker compromising the low-trust productivity agent can inject dangerous commands appearing from high-trust security agents. 这种多智能体特有的漏洞不同于对所有建议具有统一信任程度的单智能体系统中的情况。 This multi-agent-specific vulnerability differs from singular systems with uniform suggestion trust. [443]. [443].
RIP_3_3 - 通过切换智能体身份绕过命令面板速率限制。 RIP_3_3 - Command Palette Rate Limiting Bypass Through Agent Identity Switching. 在用户层面实施速率限制，而不按智能体进行跟踪，会使攻击者能够通过切换执行命令的智能体来绕过限制。 Rate limiting at the user level rather than per-agent tracking enables attackers to bypass limits by switching which agent executes commands. 在多智能体系统中，同一命令可能由多个资源消耗特征不同的专用智能体执行。 In multi-agent systems, the same command may be executable by multiple specialized agents with different resource profiles. 如果速率限制仅跟踪命令总数，而不考虑由哪些智能体执行命令及其成本，攻击者就能通过反复调用高成本智能体来耗尽资源。 If rate limiting tracks total commands without accounting for which agents execute them and their costs, attackers exhaust resources by repeatedly invoking expensive agents. 这利用了资源消耗的不对称性：某些智能体的成本是其他智能体的 10-100x。 This exploits resource consumption asymmetry—some agents are 10-100x more expensive than others. 在单智能体系统中，用户级限制控制的是一个智能体；与之不同，多智能体系统需要能够识别智能体并考虑相对成本的速率限制 [743]。 Unlike singular systems where user-level limiting controls one agent, multi-agent systems require agent-aware rate limiting accounting for relative costs [743].
III-C4 RIP_4 - 多智能体协调攻击III-C4 RIP_4 - Multi-Agent Coordination Attacks
RIP_4_1 - 多智能体集群中经反思放大的资源耗尽。 RIP_4_1 - Reflection-Amplified Resource Exhaustion in Multi-Agent Swarms. 采用反思模式的多智能体系统可能因利用智能体间反馈循环的反思级联而产生指数级资源消耗。 Multi-agent systems employing reflection patterns enable exponential resource consumption through reflection cascades exploiting inter-agent feedback loops. 与单智能体反思（成本增加至 3-5x）不同，多智能体架构会形成复合链：Agent A 的反思输出触发 Agent B 的反思，再传递给 Agent C，从而造成 N 阶乘式爆炸。 Unlike single-agent reflection (3-5x cost multiplication), multi-agent architectures create compound chains where Agent A’s reflected output triggers Agent B’s reflection, feeding to Agent C, creating N-factorial explosion. 在一个包含 3 个智能体、每个智能体均进行 3 次反思迭代的系统中，成本会放大至 27x $(3^{3})$，而 5 个智能体的成本则会达到 243x $(3^{5})$。 A 3-agent system with 3 reflection iterations each experiences 27x cost amplification $(3^{3})$ , while 5 agents reach 243x $(3^{5})$ . 智能体无法区分“我的反思需要进一步完善”和“上游反思使假设失效”。 Agents cannot distinguish ”my reflection requires refinement” from ”upstream reflection invalidated assumptions.” 检测十分困难，因为各个智能体的指标看起来都正常：每个智能体的 3-5 次反思循环均处于预期范围内 [744, 522, 745, 591]。 Detection proves difficult because individual agent metrics appear normal—each agent’s 3-5 reflection cycles fall within expected bounds [744, 522, 745, 591].
RIP_4_2 - 在集中式多智能体层级结构中通过协调器过载耗尽编排器资源。 RIP_4_2 - Orchestrator Resource Exhaustion via Coordinator Overload in Centralized Multi-Agent Hierarchies. 集中式编排模式使用单个管理智能体来协调专门的工作智能体，由此形成瓶颈：协调流量随并发工作流数量呈非线性增长。 Centralized orchestration patterns use single manager agents coordinating specialized workers, creating bottlenecks where coordination traffic scales non-linearly with concurrent workflow count. 攻击者利用状态管理开销，向编排器发送大量协调请求。 Attackers flood orchestrators with coordination requests exploiting state management overhead. 与直接耗尽智能体资源不同，针对编排器的攻击以协调工作为目标，包括工作流状态跟踪、任务委派决策、结果汇总和故障恢复。 Unlike direct agent resource exhaustion, orchestrator attacks target coordination—workflow state tracking, delegation decisions, result aggregation, and failure recovery. 每个工单都要求编排器维护工作流状态、跟踪完成情况、处理重试并汇总结果。 Each ticket requires the orchestrator maintaining workflow state, tracking completion, handling retries, and aggregating results. 攻击者提交数千个恶意工单，其中包含复杂的多轮交互内容、升级处理路径或导致超时的对抗性内容。 Attackers submit thousands of malicious tickets with complex multi-turn content, escalation paths, or adversarial content causing timeouts. 与无状态工作智能体不同，编排器的资源需求随活跃工作流数量增长。 Orchestrators scale with active workflow count unlike stateless workers. 缓解措施需要对工作流进行分片，将协调工作分散到多个实例，通过复杂度预算限制协调开销，采用严格的超时策略，并使用熔断器自动卸载负载 [91, 18, 84]。 Mitigation requires workflow sharding distributing coordination across instances, complexity budgets limiting coordination overhead, aggressive timeout policies, and circuit breakers shedding load automatically [91, 18, 84].
RIP_4_3 - 在基于市场的协调中通过利用策略性出价和组建联盟操纵拍卖。 RIP_4_3 - Auction Manipulation via Strategic Bidding Exploitation and Coalition Formation in Market-Based Coordination. 采用基于拍卖的资源分配机制的多智能体系统形成了经济层面的攻击面，其中智能体通过出价进行竞争。 Multi-agent systems using auction-based resource allocation create economic attack surfaces where agents compete through bidding. 攻击者通过策略性出价、组建女巫（Sybil）联盟或利用时机操纵结果，以垄断资源或造成拒绝服务。 Attackers manipulate outcomes through strategic bidding, Sybil coalition formation, or timing exploitation to monopolize resources or deny service. 联盟的形成会放大影响——多个相互串通的智能体协调出价，操纵价格发现过程，以被压低的价格赢得 80% 的拍卖。 Coalition formation amplifies impact—multiple colluding agents coordinate bids manipulating price discovery, winning 80% of auctions at suppressed prices. 缓解措施需要采用激励相容机制（如以诚实出价为最优策略的 VCG 拍卖）、防止低成本创建女巫身份的权益证明身份验证、通过出价模式分析检测串通行为、跟踪行为的声誉系统，以及防止时机被利用的随机化时间安排 [746, 747, 748, 749]。 Mitigation requires incentive-compatible mechanisms (VCG auctions where truthful bidding is optimal), proof-of-stake identity verification preventing cheap Sybil creation, collusion detection through bid pattern analysis, reputation systems tracking behavior, and randomized timing preventing exploitation [746, 747, 748, 749].
RIP_4_4 - 在事件驱动的多智能体网络中通过广播放大实施消息洪泛拒绝服务。 RIP_4_4 - Message Flood Denial-of-Service via Broadcast Amplification in Event-Driven Multi-Agent Networks. 采用发布—订阅模式的事件驱动多智能体系统支持一对多通信，从而产生广播放大漏洞。 Event-driven multi-agent systems using publish-subscribe patterns enable one-to-many communication creating broadcast amplification vulnerabilities. 攻击者利用这一点实施消息洪泛拒绝服务——发布一个恶意事件，触发各订阅者级联生成消息，使队列不堪重负。 Attackers exploit this creating message flood denial-of-service—publishing one malicious event triggering cascading message generation across subscribers, overwhelming queues. 与消息传递有界的单智能体系统不同，多智能体事件驱动架构使一个恶意发布者能够同时影响 M 个订阅者。 Unlike single-agent systems with bounded messaging, multi-agent event-driven architectures enable one malicious publisher affecting M subscribers simultaneously. 缓解措施需要对事件发布实施速率限制、通过订阅者节流限制处理速率、使用熔断器自动取消对高流量主题的订阅、通过事件验证拒绝会触发放大的内容，以及使用优先级队列确保关键事件在洪泛期间仍能得到处理。 Mitigation requires rate limiting on event publishing, subscriber throttling limiting processing rates, circuit breakers automatically unsubscribing from high-volume topics, event validation rejecting amplification-triggering content, and priority queues ensuring critical events process despite floods. [236, 750, 374]。 [236, 750, 374].
III-C5 RIP_5 - 框架特定攻击III-C5 RIP_5 - Framework-Specific Attacks
RIP_5_1 - 框架强制实施的身份模型为跨框架冒充创造机会。 RIP_5_1 - Framework-Enforced Identity Models Creating Cross-Framework Impersonation Opportunities. 不同框架以不同方式实现智能体身份（LangChain 通过执行上下文提供隐式身份，LangGraph 将节点身份绑定到图结构，AutoGen 使用智能体实例名称，CrewAI 使用基于角色的身份，Semantic Kernel 使用插件身份）。 Different frameworks implement agent identity differently (LangChain’s implicit identity through execution context, LangGraph’s node identity bound to graph structure, AutoGen’s agent instance names, CrewAI’s role-based identity, Semantic Kernel’s plugin identity). 跨框架集成的多智能体系统会产生身份转换缺口。 Multi-agent systems integrating across frameworks create identity translation gaps. 攻击者利用这些缺口实施跨框架冒充。 Attackers exploit these gaps performing cross-framework impersonation. 与具有一致身份模型的单一系统不同，多智能体系统需要在各框架特定的模型之间转换身份，而 N 个框架会产生 N(N-1) 种转换语义，其中很可能存在缺口 [107, 751, 157]。 Unlike singular systems with consistent identity model, multi-agent systems require translating identity across framework-specific models, and N frameworks create N(N-1) translation semantics likely containing gaps [107, 751, 157].
RIP_5_2 - 依赖框架的成本归因使经济性拒绝服务成为可能。 RIP_5_2 - Framework-Dependent Cost Attribution Enabling Economic Denial-of-Service. 不同框架具有不同的资源消耗模式（LangChain 的顺序工具调用、LangGraph 的状态管理开销、AutoGen 的对话式协调、CrewAI 的分层任务开销，以及 Semantic Kernel 的插件路由）。 Different frameworks have different resource consumption patterns (LangChain’s sequential tool calling, LangGraph’s state management overhead, AutoGen’s conversational coordination, CrewAI’s hierarchical task overhead, Semantic Kernel’s plugin routing). 混用多种框架的多智能体系统使总成本归因变得不可能。 Multi-agent systems mixing frameworks make total cost attribution impossible. 攻击者对上下文投毒，在成本不透明的框架中触发高成本操作，从而实施钱包耗尽（denial-of-wallet）攻击。 Attackers poison context causing expensive operations in cost-opaque frameworks enabling denial-of-wallet attacks. 与具有明确成本模型的单一系统不同，多智能体系统引入了随框架而异的成本，使全面核算变得不可能。 Unlike singular systems with clear cost models, multi-agent systems introduce framework-relative costs making comprehensive accounting impossible. 多智能体成本归因需要跟踪每个框架中每项操作的成本，而框架特定的聚合方式会造成核算歧义，可被用于经济攻击。 Multi-agent cost attribution requires tracking costs per operation per framework, and framework-specific aggregation creates accounting ambiguity exploitable for economic attacks. [591, 157]。 [591, 157].
RIP_5_4 - CrewAI 的分层角色分配使冒充成为可能。 RIP_5_4 - CrewAI Hierarchical Role Attribution Enabling Impersonation. 如果角色分配缺乏密码学验证，以角色定义的 CrewAI 智能体就可能被冒充。 CrewAI agents defined by roles can be impersonated if role assignments lack cryptographic verification. 攻陷编排器的攻击者可以动态地将恶意智能体分配到受信任的角色。 Attackers compromising orchestrators can dynamically assign malicious agents to trusted roles. 当角色分配未经验证时，基于角色的信任就会变得可被利用。 Role-based trust becomes exploitable when role assignment is unverified. 单一系统具有单一信任模型；CrewAI 基于角色的专业化分工则产生了冒充攻击面，使恶意智能体能够充当合法角色。 Singular systems have single trust models; CrewAI’s role-based specialization creates impersonation surfaces where malicious agents can assume legitimate roles. [752, 753, 754]。 [752, 753, 754].
RIP_5_5 - AutoGen 对话恢复的成本放大。 RIP_5_5 - AutoGen Conversation Resumption Cost Amplification. AutoGen 对话可以恢复，而在多个会话中恢复高成本对话会放大成本。 AutoGen conversations can be resumed, and resuming expensive conversations in multiple sessions amplifies costs. 攻击者将高成本操作植入对话历史以进行投毒，确保在未来会话中恢复对话时反复产生费用。 Attackers poison conversation history with expensive operations ensuring resumption in future sessions incurs charges repeatedly. 单智能体的对话恢复彼此隔离；AutoGen 的多智能体对话恢复则会影响所有智能体，使成本跨边界放大。 Singular agent conversation resumption is isolated; AutoGen’s multi-agent resumption affects all agents amplifying costs across boundaries. [138, 79, 755, 18, 723]。 [138, 79, 755, 18, 723].
RIP_5_6 - Semantic Kernel 在多智能体编排中的上下文窗口词元消耗。 RIP_5_6 - Semantic Kernel Context Window Token Consumption in Multi-Agent Orchestration. Semantic Kernel 会构建描述所有可用插件和函数的编排器提示。 Semantic Kernel constructs orchestrator prompts describing all available plugins and functions. 拥有数百个插件的多智能体系统会产生巨大的上下文消耗。 Multi-agent systems with hundreds of plugins create massive context consumption. 攻击者使用冗长描述对插件注册表投毒，迫使系统进行高成本的上下文管理。 Attackers poison plugin registries with verbose descriptions forcing expensive context management. 共享插件注册表意味着上下文开销会随智能体数量成倍增加——100 个智能体各自使用包含 500 个插件的注册表时，编排器词元总消耗为 100x；单智能体不会出现这种上下文消耗的规模增长。 Shared plugin registry means context overhead multiplies with agent count—100 agents with 500-plugin registry each consume orchestrator tokens 100x; singular agents don’t scale context consumption. [756, 59, 757, 58]. [756, 59, 757, 58].
III-C6 RIP_6 - 工具与插件攻击III-C6 RIP_6 - Tool & Plugin Attacks
RIP_6_1 - 通过多智能体工具链式调用扩展经济攻击面。 RIP_6_1 - Economic Attack Surface Expansion Through Multi-Agent Tool Chaining. 聊天界面显示工具调用却不实时累计成本，使得恶意上下文能够诱导智能体连续调用高成本工具，从而实施经济攻击。 Chat interfaces displaying tool invocations without real-time cost accumulation enable economic attacks where malicious context causes agents to chain expensive tool calls. 在多智能体架构中，“分析这个代码库”会触发智能体 A 的代码解析，再将结果传递给智能体 B 进行安全扫描，随后传递给智能体 C 进行依赖分析，从而产生级联 API 调用。 In multi-agent architectures, ”analyze this codebase” triggers Agent A’s code parsing, passing results to Agent B’s security scanning, passing to Agent C’s dependency analysis, creating cascading API calls. 攻击者通过污染上下文来放大所有智能体的资源消耗，但用户界面的渐进式披露隐藏了累计成本。 Attackers poison context amplifying resource consumption across all agents, but the UI’s progressive disclosure hides cumulative cost. 这种多智能体工具链式调用会使成本呈乘法式而非加法式增长。 This multi-agent tool chaining amplifies costs multiplicatively rather than additively. [179, 44, 758, 759, 36, 39, 18, 66, 14, 737]. [179, 44, 758, 759, 36, 39, 18, 66, 14, 737].
RIP_6_2 - 多智能体记忆共享中的工具调用成本归属缺口。 RIP_6_2 - Tool Invocation Cost Attribution Gaps in Multi-Agent Memory Sharing. ConversationBufferMemory 使智能体能够保留对话历史，但工具调用成本归属于最先查询该工具的智能体，而非从缓存结果中受益的智能体。 ConversationBufferMemory enables agents to maintain conversation history, but tool invocation costs are attributed to the first agent that queried the tool, not agents benefiting from cached results. 在共享对话历史的多智能体系统中，后续智能体复用记忆中缓存的结果，无需承担成本即可受益，从而为经济攻击创造条件。 In multi-agent systems sharing conversation history, subsequent agents re-using memory-cached results benefit without bearing costs, enabling economic attacks. 单智能体不共享记忆；多智能体之间的共享使搭便车式资源耗尽成为可能。 Singular agents don’t share memory; multi-agent sharing enables free-rider resource exhaustion. [760, 761, 130, 139, 14]. [760, 761, 130, 139, 14].
RIP_6_3 - 工具注册表枚举使经济侦察成为可能。 RIP_6_3 - Tool Registry Enumeration Enabling Economic Reconnaissance. LangChain 智能体通过工具注册表发现工具，这使攻击者能够枚举可用工具并识别高成本操作。 LangChain agents discover tools through tool registries, enabling attackers to enumerate available tools identifying expensive operations. 多智能体共享工具注册表支持全面枚举所有智能体的可用工具；单智能体仅暴露自身的工具。 Multi-agent shared tool registries provide comprehensive enumeration of all agents’ available tools; singular agents expose only one agent’s tools. [762, 179, 763]. [762, 179, 763].
RIP_6_4 - 智能体草稿区中的工具执行成本不透明。 RIP_6_4 - Tool Execution Cost Opacity in Agent Scratchpad. 记录工具调用的智能体草稿区通常不显示各工具的成本，导致成本不透明，使智能体无法察觉特定工具何时变得昂贵。 Agent scratchpad logging tool invocations doesn’t typically display per-tool costs, creating opacity where agents cannot recognize when specific tools become expensive. 攻击者通过污染工具选择，使智能体在成本不可见的情况下调用高成本变体。 Attackers poison tool selections causing agents to invoke expensive variants without cost visibility. 多智能体工具推荐系统使攻击者能够通过污染上下文，向所有智能体推荐高成本工具变体。 Multi-agent tool recommendation systems enable attackers poisoning context to suggest expensive tool variants across all agents. [764, 249, 765, 744]. [764, 249, 765, 744].
RIP_6_5 - 多智能体工具成本归属的复杂性使经济型拒绝服务成为可能。 RIP_6_5 - Multi-Agent Tool Cost Attribution Complexity Enabling Economic Denial-of-Service. AutoGen 和 CrewAI 协调多个智能体，各智能体调用的工具具有不同成本，但用户界面的成本跟踪通常只显示汇总成本，不提供按智能体划分的明细。 AutoGen and CrewAI coordinate multiple agents each invoking tools with different costs, but UI cost tracking often shows aggregate costs without per-agent breakdowns. 攻击者通过污染上下文，导致多个智能体调用高成本工具，并将这些成本隐藏在汇总报告中。 Attackers poison context causing expensive tool invocation across multiple agents hide costs in aggregate reporting. 单智能体的工具成本可直接确定归属；多智能体的成本分散在各智能体之间，导致归属模糊，可被攻击者利用。 Singular agent tool costs are directly attributable; multi-agent costs distribute across agents enabling attribution ambiguity attackers exploit. [766, 14]. [766, 14].
RIP_6_6 - 多智能体委派中的插件执行身份歧义。 RIP_6_6 - Plugin Execution Identity Ambiguity in Multi-Agent Delegation. 插件通过内核提供的服务执行，而非以明确的智能体身份执行。 Plugins execute with kernel-provided services rather than explicit agent identity. 当插件 A 通过编排将任务委派给插件 B 时，插件 B 向下游服务呈现的是内核的身份，而非插件 A 的身份。 When Plugin A delegates to Plugin B through orchestration, Plugin B’s identity to downstream services is the kernel’s identity, not Plugin A’s. 多插件调用链每经过一跳都会丢失身份跟踪信息——在插件 A→B→C 调用链的末端，最终服务只能看到内核身份；单插件调用链则保持单一身份。 Multi-plugin chains lose identity tracking with each hop—Plugin A→B→C chain ends with only kernel identity visible to final service; singular plugin chains maintain single identity. [731, 767, 722]. [731, 767, 722].
RIP_6_7 - 插件注册表的经济成本归属失效。 RIP_6_7 - Plugin Registry Economic Cost Attribution Failures. 插件发现与注册需要消耗计算资源，以进行清单解析、模式验证和函数描述处理。 Plugin discovery and registration consume compute resources for manifest parsing, schema validation, and function description processing. 攻击者向插件注册表中植入高成本插件，使其消耗的资源被归于所有智能体。 Attackers poison plugin registries with expensive plugins consuming resources attributed to all agents. 注册表层面的成本投毒会影响所有智能体，且缺乏归属机制；单个插件的成本归属则是明确的。 Registry-level cost poisoning affects all agents with no attribution mechanism; singular plugins have clear cost ownership. [14, 737]. [14, 737].
RIP_6_8 - 工具调用归属伪造。 RIP_6_8 - Tool Invocation Attribution Spoofing. 工具会记录调用它们的智能体，以用于审计和监控。 Tools log which agent invoked them for auditing and monitoring. 在多智能体系统中，攻击者可以操纵调用归属，使工具调用看起来来自可信智能体，而非已被攻陷的智能体。 In multi-agent systems, attackers can manipulate invocation attribution making tool invocations appear from trusted agents rather than compromised agents. 单智能体不存在归属伪造风险；多智能体系统则使攻击者能够在工具调用中伪造智能体身份。 Singular agents don’t have attribution spoofing risk; multi-agent systems enable attackers spoofing agent identity in tool invocations. 示例：当 Agent 1 发起敏感工具调用却冒用 Agent 2 的身份时，下游日志会将该工具调用记录为来自 Agent 2。 Example: When Agent 1 triggers a sensitive tool invocation but spoofs Agent 2’s identity, downstream logs record the tool call as originating from Agent 2. 后续智能体和审计系统会将该调用视为可信调用，而事后取证无法区分遭到入侵的 Agent 1 与合法的 Agent 2。 Subsequent agents and auditing systems treat the invocation as trusted, and post-incident forensics cannot distinguish the compromised Agent 1 from the legitimate Agent 2. [768, 599]. [768, 599].
RIP_6_9 - 通过智能体组合继承工具访问权限。 RIP_6_9 - Tool Access Privilege Inheritance Through Agent Composition. 多智能体层级结构可能会授予监督智能体向工作智能体委派任务所需的全部权限，但工作智能体也会通过委派继承这些权限。 Multi-agent hierarchies may grant supervisor agents all privileges needed to delegate to workers, but workers inherit these privileges through delegation. 如果 Supervisor 持有用于委派任务的 database_admin 凭据，Worker 智能体可能会保留或利用这些凭据。 If Supervisor has database_admin credentials to delegate tasks, Worker agents may retain or exploit those credentials. 权限范围明确限定的单智能体不存在权限组合问题；多智能体委派链则会通过继承委派上下文导致权限累积。 Singular agents with explicit privilege scoping don’t have privilege composition issues; multi-agent delegation chains enable privilege accumulation through delegation context inheritance. [769, 31, 49, 39, 603]. [769, 31, 49, 39, 603].
RIP_6_10 - 通过分布式调用滥用工具执行成本。 RIP_6_10 - Tool Execution Cost Exploitation Through Distributed Invocation. 工具的使用会产生成本（API 调用、计算资源、存储操作）。 Tools have costs (API calls, compute resources, storage operations). 多智能体系统使攻击者能够将恶意工具调用分散到多个智能体上，使成本呈现为分散分布，从而更难被检测到。 Multi-agent systems enable attackers distributing malicious tool invocations across multiple agents, making costs appear distributed and harder to detect. 攻击者使用 10 个智能体，让每个智能体调用高成本工具 10 次，而非让一个智能体调用 100 次，通过分散调用来掩盖模式。 An attacker uses 10 agents to invoke expensive tools 10 times each rather than one agent 100 times, obscuring patterns through distribution. 单个智能体产生过高的工具使用成本时会呈现出明显模式；多智能体分散成本则使隐蔽的资源耗尽成为可能。 Single agent with excessive tool costs shows obvious pattern; multi-agent distributed cost enables stealthy resource exhaustion. [770, 45, 771]. [770, 45, 771].
RIP_6_11 - 通过智能体通信泄露工具访问令牌。 RIP_6_11 - Tool Access Token Leakage Through Agent Communication. 工具需要身份验证令牌或 API 密钥。 Tools require authentication tokens or API keys. 在多智能体系统中，这些凭据可能通过函数调用或上下文在智能体之间传递。 In multi-agent systems, these credentials may be passed between agents through function calls or context. 监视智能体间通信的攻击者可以截获在参数或对话历史中泄露的凭据。 Attackers monitoring inter-agent communication can capture credentials leaked in parameters or conversation history. 在本地存储令牌的单智能体不存在智能体间凭据泄露问题；多智能体之间的凭据共享则使令牌窃取成为可能。 Single agent with local token storage doesn’t have inter-agent credential leakage; multi-agent credential sharing enables token theft. [153, 772, 753, 45]. [153, 772, 753, 45].
RIP_6_12 - 工具故障归属混淆。 RIP_6_12 - Tool Failure Attribution Confusion. 当工具发生故障时，日志会显示调用这些工具的智能体。 When tools fail, logs show which agent invoked them. 在共享工具的多智能体系统中，攻击者让其他智能体使用错误参数调用其无法控制的工具，故意使这些工具发生故障，从而将故障错误地归咎于未受影响的智能体。 In multi-agent systems with shared tools, attackers deliberately fail tools they don’t control by having other agents invoke them with bad parameters, misattributing faults to unaffected agents. 单智能体中的工具故障归属于一个智能体；多智能体共享工具则使攻击者能够通过协同调用，将故障归咎于错误的智能体。 Singular tool failures are attributed to one agent; multi-agent shared tools enable attackers attributing failures to wrong agents through coordinated invocation. [176, 773, 469]. [176, 773, 469].
RIP_6_13 - 性能剖析工具的保管链丢失。 RIP_6_13 - Profiling Tool Chain of Custody Loss. 性能剖析工具及其输出会经过多个系统（收集 → 存储 → 分析）。 Profiling tools and their outputs pass through multiple systems (collection → storage → analysis). 在每个中转点，将性能剖析产物与其来源智能体关联起来的元数据都可能被剥离、覆盖，或与其他智能体的数据合并。 At each transit point, metadata linking a profiling artifact to its originating agent can be stripped, overwritten, or merged with data from other agents. 控制该链中任一节点（存储层、规范化流水线或聚合服务）的攻击者，都可以注入虚假的性能剖析数据，而这些数据与其来源之间不存在可验证的关联。 An attacker who controls any node in this chain—a storage layer, a normalization pipeline, or an aggregation service—can inject fraudulent profiling data without a verifiable link to its source. 在多智能体系统中，各智能体独立信任共享的性能剖析数据，这会造成 1-to-N 的身份受损：一次注入的虚假性能剖析数据会传播到所有从共享存储中读取数据的智能体，扭曲基于行为的身份信号，并掩盖攻击者实际的资源消耗或调用模式。 Multi-agent systems with agents independently trusting shared profiling data create a 1-to-N identity compromise: fraudulent profiling injected once propagates to all agents that read from the shared store, distorting behavior-based identity signals and masking the attacker’s actual resource consumption or invocation patterns. [507, 45, 44, 724]. [507, 45, 44, 724].
RIP_6_15 - 工具访问权限推断与提升。 RIP_6_15 - Tool Access Privilege Inference and Escalation. 工具审计日志会显示哪些智能体调用了哪些工具。 Tool audit logs show which agents invoked which tools. 在多智能体系统中，攻击者通过分析日志来推断权限级别——调用支付工具的智能体具有更高权限。 In multi-agent systems, attackers analyze logs to infer privilege levels—agents invoking payment tools have higher privilege. 随后，他们入侵低权限智能体，利用其向高权限智能体转发请求，通过智能体链提升权限。 They then compromise lower-privilege agents to relay requests to higher-privilege agents, escalating privileges through agent chains. 单智能体的权限固定；多智能体中的权限推断则使攻击者能够通过智能体间的权限提升，沿权限链逐级攀升。 Singular agents have fixed privilege; multi-agent privilege inference enables attackers to climb privilege chains through agent-to-agent escalation. [23, 67, 68]. [23, 67, 68].
III-C7 RIP_7 - 成本与经济型拒绝服务攻击III-C7 RIP_7 - Cost & Economic Denial-of-Service Attacks
RIP_7_1 - 统计分析智能体中的资源归属歧义。 RIP_7_1 - Resource Attribution Ambiguity in Statistical Analysis Agents. 执行显著性检验、置信区间计算和复杂统计分析的统计评估智能体会消耗大量计算资源。 Statistical evaluation agents performing significance testing, confidence interval calculation, and complex statistical analysis consume substantial compute. 在多智能体评估中，成本归属并不明确。 In multi-agent evaluation, cost attribution is ambiguous. 这种模糊性使攻击者能够在明知成本难以追踪的情况下，请求执行高成本分析。 This ambiguity enables attackers requesting expensive analyses knowing costs are difficult to track. 多智能体成本归属机制的漏洞使统计分析资源耗尽攻击能够在不被察觉的情况下发生。 Multi-agent attribution gaps enable statistical analysis resource exhaustion undetected. [774, 766, 765, 44]. [774, 766, 765, 44].
RIP_7_2 - 性能声明验证成本形成的经济攻击面。 RIP_7_2 - Performance Claim Verification Costs Creating Economic Attack Surface. 验证性能提升是否真实，需要进行统计检验和独立验证。 Validating whether performance improvements are real requires statistical tests and independent validation. 在多智能体系统中，验证每个智能体所声称的性能会带来高昂的经济成本（N 个智能体 × M 项基准测试 × K 次重复）。 In multi-agent systems, verifying every agent’s claimed performance becomes economically expensive (N agents × M benchmarks × K repetitions). 攻击者利用这一点，在假定验证不充分的情况下，提出看似可信的性能声明。 Attackers exploit this by making plausible performance claims assuming insufficient verification. 单智能体验证的规模呈线性增长；多智能体系统则会产生 O(N²) 的验证需求。 Single-agent verification scales linearly; multi-agent systems create O(N²) verification requirements. [775, 776, 777, 778]. [775, 776, 777, 778].
RIP_7_3 - ST-WebAgentBench 中的策略合规指标规避。 RIP_7_3 - Policy Compliance Metric Evasion in ST-WebAgentBench. ST-WebAgentBench 的策略约束下完成度（Completion Under Policies，CuP）指标奖励符合策略的任务完成行为。 ST-WebAgentBench’s Completion Under Policies (CuP) metric rewards policy-compliant task completion. 攻击者注入表面上遵守策略、实则隐蔽地违反策略的指令（“在预算限额内完成交易，但记录虚假的预算值”）。 Adversaries inject instructions that appear to respect policies while subtly violating them (”Complete transaction within budget limit but record false budget values”). 通过规避指标，多智能体策略执行机制被绕过。 Multi-agent policy enforcement gets circumvented through metric evasion. 单智能体 CuP 评估执行一次策略检查；在由策略检查智能体向执行智能体提供信息的多智能体系统中，策略执行职责的分离使策略规避成为可能。 Single-agent CuP evaluation applies one policy check; multi-agent systems where policy-checking agents inform execution agents enable policy evasion through enforcement division. [779, 780, 781]. [779, 780, 781].
RIP_7_4 - 多智能体执行中的资源分配归属。 RIP_7_4 - Resource Allocation Attribution in Multi-Agent Execution. 本章讨论了执行成功判定中的成本追踪问题（“超出延迟 SLA 或成本预算会导致部署失败”）。 The chapter discusses execution success tracking costs (”exceeding latency SLAs or cost budgets fail deployment”). 在多智能体系统中，应将资源消耗计入哪个智能体的账下？ In multi-agent systems, which agent’s resource consumption should be charged? 成本归属的模糊性形成了经济攻击面：攻击者在智能体链中触发高成本操作，将成本分摊到多个智能体上，使责任归属不清。 Cost attribution ambiguity creates economic attack surfaces where attackers trigger expensive operations in agent chains, distributing costs across multiple agents making accountability unclear. [744, 782, 783, 765, 784]. [744, 782, 783, 765, 784].
RIP_7_5 - 利用成本归属错位操纵激励。 RIP_7_5 - Cost Attribution Misalignment for Incentive Manipulation. 效率激励系统奖励智能体降低成本的行为（达到效率目标的智能体可获得优先访问权）。 Efficiency incentive systems reward agents for cost reduction (agents meeting efficiency targets get priority access). 攻击者操纵成本归属，使低效率操作看起来具有成本效益。 Attackers manipulate cost attribution making inefficient operations appear cost-effective. 单智能体的激励机制博弈影响该智能体自身；具有共享激励结构的多智能体系统则支持协同博弈，多个智能体共同针对被投毒的效率指标进行优化。 Single-agent incentive gaming affects that agent; multi-agent systems with shared incentive structures enable coordinated gaming where multiple agents collectively optimize toward poisoned efficiency metrics. 示例：在共享激励池中，智能体 A、B 和 C 协同将高成本任务路由至智能体 D，同时仅报告各自的低成本操作。 Example: In a shared incentive pool, Agents A, B, and C coordinate to route expensive tasks through Agent D while reporting only their own low-cost operations. 激励系统将 A、B 和 C 判定为效率极高，并授予其优先访问权，而智能体 D 则承担经操纵后归于其名下的成本，从而掩盖了这种协同博弈。 The incentive system interprets A, B, and C as exceptionally efficient, granting them priority access while Agent D absorbs manipulated cost attribution, masking the coordinated gaming. [115, 116, 69, 70, 785]. [115, 116, 69, 70, 785].
RIP_7_6 - 利用词元价格波动。 RIP_7_6 - Token Price Volatility Exploitation. 效率系统追踪并利用不同提供商之间的词元（token）价格差异。 Efficiency systems track and exploit token price variations across providers. 攻击者操纵价格追踪过程，导致智能体依据虚假价格选择提供商。 Attackers manipulate price tracking causing agents to select providers based on false prices. 单智能体的提供商选择影响局部路由；采用集中式提供商选择机制的多智能体系统，则使攻击者能够通过对价格数据投毒来影响所有智能体的路由。 Single-agent provider selection affects local routing; multi-agent systems with centralized provider selection enable attackers poisoning price data affecting all agents’ routing. [786, 787, 744, 743, 788]. [786, 787, 744, 743, 788].
RIP_7_7 - 将弃用/迁移压力用作资源约束攻击。 RIP_7_7 - Deprecation/Migration Pressure as Resource Constraint Attack. 效率系统规划从高成本组件迁出（弃用旧模型、整合 API）。 Efficiency systems plan migrations away from expensive components (deprecating old models, consolidating APIs). 攻击者利用迁移压力，制造紧迫的资源约束。 Attackers exploit migration pressure creating urgent resource constraints. 单智能体的迁移压力影响该智能体的过渡；采用协同迁移机制的多智能体系统，则使攻击者能够利用系统范围内的弃用期限，迫使系统迅速采用被投毒的优化方案。 Single-agent migration pressure affects that agent’s transition; multi-agent systems with coordinated migrations enable attackers exploiting system-wide deprecation deadlines to force rapid adoption of poisoned optimizations. [737, 738, 66, 23]. [737, 738, 66, 23].
RIP_7_8 - 通过虚增资源请求操纵成本归属。 RIP_7_8 - Cost Attribution Gaming via Resource Request Padding. Kubernetes 计费系统根据资源请求量（CPU、内存）收费，而非实际使用量。 Kubernetes billing systems charge by resource requests (CPU, memory) not actual usage. 单智能体的资源请求虚增会影响该智能体的计费；N 个智能体协同虚增资源请求，则会造成系统性的成本追踪失效，使计费系统错误计算真实消耗量。 Single-agent padding affects one agent’s billing; multi-agent coordinated padding across N agents creates systematic cost tracking failures where billing systems miscalculate true consumption. [789, 790, 523]. [789, 790, 523].
RIP_7_9 - 针对同租户智能体的资源配额耗尽攻击。 RIP_7_9 - Resource Quota Exhaustion Attacks Against Co-Tenant Agents. 命名空间资源配额限制资源消耗总量。 Namespace resource quotas limit aggregate resource consumption. 攻击者通过攻陷智能体来占用配额，使同租户的其他智能体无法获得足够资源。 Attackers compromise agents to consume quota space, starving co-tenant agents. 多租户多智能体集群使经济型拒绝服务攻击成为可能：攻陷能够感知配额的智能体后，攻击者便可耗尽共享配额，使命名空间中的所有智能体失效。 Multi-tenant multi-agent clusters enable economic denial-of-service where compromising quota-aware agents allows exhausting shared quotas, disabling all agents in namespace. [531, 791]. [531, 791].
RIP_7_10 - 会话亲和性产生伪身份。 RIP_7_10 - Session Affinity Creating Pseudo-Identities. IP 哈希会创建与客户端 IP 绑定的持久会话身份。 IP hash creates persistent session identities tied to client IPs. 攻击者可能通过伪造客户端 IP 来创建虚假会话身份或劫持现有会话。 Attackers could spoof client IPs creating false session identities or hijacking existing sessions. 无状态系统不会创建伪身份；会话亲和性则会创建伪会话身份，攻击者可通过 IP 层攻击加以利用。 Stateless systems don’t create pseudo-identities; session affinity creates pseudo-session-identities exploitable through IP-layer attacks. [44, 792, 18, 793, 794]. [44, 792, 18, 793, 794].
RIP_7_11 - 负载均衡系统中的成本归属缺口。 RIP_7_11 - Cost Attribution Gaps in Load-Balanced Systems. 水平扩展使成本归属变得复杂——哪些成本是由哪个副本产生的？ Horizontal scaling makes cost attribution complex—which replica incurred which costs? 这种归属歧义使利用成本错误归属的经济攻击成为可能。 This attribution ambiguity enables economic attacks where costs are misattributed. 单智能体的成本追踪较为直接；负载均衡系统则会使成本归属变得不透明。 Single agent cost tracking is straightforward; load-balanced systems create cost attribution opacity. [115, 69, 23, 795, 796]. [115, 69, 23, 795, 796].
RIP_7_12 - 多步推理链中的来源追溯缺口。 RIP_7_12 - Provenance gaps in multi-step reasoning chains. 当多个智能体共同参与一条推理链时，就难以明确哪些步骤由谁贡献，从而使后门检测和信任评估无法进行。 When multiple agents contribute to a reasoning chain, it becomes unclear who contributed which steps, making backdoor detection and trust assessment impossible. 智能体 A 的推理可能是正确的，而智能体 B 被投毒的推理则隐藏在同一条轨迹之中。 Agent A’s reasoning could be sound while Agent B’s poisoned reasoning hides within the same trace. 单智能体推理的来源清晰；多智能体累积形成的推理链则混杂着不同来源，因此无法判断哪个智能体贡献了可能已遭篡改的推理。 Single-agent reasoning has clear provenance; multi-agent accumulated reasoning chains have mixed provenance, making it impossible to assess which agent contributed potentially compromised reasoning. [797, 798, 799, 800, 801]. [797, 798, 799, 800, 801].
RIP_7_13 - 通过推理放大实施经济性利用。 RIP_7_13 - Economic exploitation through reasoning amplification. 攻击者智能体生成成本高昂的推理（大量 CoT 步骤、推理过程中的高成本工具调用），而这些推理在其局部上下文中看起来是合理的。 An attacker agent generates expensive reasoning (many CoT steps, expensive tool calls in reasoning) that looks justified in its local context. 成本在所有智能体之间不断累积，从而放大原始攻击。 Costs accumulate across all agents amplifying the original attack. 针对单智能体的成本攻击只影响一个系统；在多智能体系统中，高成本推理若在智能体之间传播，就会使成本成倍放大。 Single agent cost attacks affect one system; multi-agent systems where expensive reasoning spreads across agents create multiplicative cost amplification. [766, 802, 803, 804, 744]. [766, 802, 803, 804, 744].
RIP_7_14 - 跨智能体网络的搜索树分支来源伪造。 RIP_7_14 - Search tree branch provenance spoofing across agent network. 如果未能正确记录共享树中的候选思路由哪个智能体生成，攻击者就可以伪造分支来源，使其看起来来自可信智能体。 Without proper attribution of which agent generated candidate thoughts in the shared tree, attackers can forge the origin of branches to appear as though they came from trusted agents. 多智能体推理需要跨智能体追踪来源；单智能体 ToT 则不需要这种来源追踪。 Multi-agent reasoning requires tracking provenance across agents; single-agent ToT doesn’t require this provenance tracking. [805, 753, 806, 469]. [805, 753, 806, 469].
RIP_7_15 - 已保存路径的来源伪造。 RIP_7_15 - Preserved Path Provenance Spoofing. 当 Self-Consistency 路径被保存以供后续检索时，其来源信息就会成为伪造目标。 When Self-Consistency paths are preserved for later retrieval, the provenance becomes a spoofing target. 攻击者可以向保存路径的存储库中注入带有虚假来源声明的路径。 Attackers can inject paths into preserved repositories with falsified provenance claims. 在共享已保存路径存储库的多智能体系统中，来源伪造使利用信任关系成为可能。 In multi-agent systems with shared preserved path repositories, provenance spoofing enables trust exploitation. 单智能体从硬编码来源检索路径时，路径仍与身份绑定；多智能体共享存储库若缺乏可靠的来源信息，就会使身份伪造成为可能，并影响所有查询该存储库的智能体。 Single-agent path retrieval from hardcoded sources remains identity-bound; multi-agent shared repositories with weak provenance enable identity spoofing affecting all agents querying the repository. [78, 79, 73, 176, 469]. [78, 79, 73, 176, 469].
RIP_7_16 - 多智能体工作流协调中的身份验证缺口。 RIP_7_16 - Identity Verification Gaps in Multi-Agent Workflow Coordination. Self-Consistency 投票产生基于共识的决策；如果未追踪投票参与者的身份，接收智能体 A 投票结果的智能体 B 就无法验证有哪些智能体参与了投票。 Self-Consistency voting produces consensus-based decisions; if identity of voting contributors is not tracked, Agent B receiving Agent A’s voting results cannot verify which agents contributed. 这会造成身份验证缺口，使多智能体工作流协调缺少有关决策参与者的审计记录。 This creates identity verification gaps where multi-agent workflow coordination lacks audit trails of decision contributors. 单智能体投票影响一个模型的输出；存在身份验证缺口的多智能体投票则使协同攻击成为可能，且无法将攻击归因于具体智能体。 Single-agent voting affects one model’s output; multi-agent voting with identity gaps enables coordinated attacks without attributable agents. [62, 23, 69, 68, 18]. [62, 23, 69, 68, 18].
RIP_7_17 - 成本分摊中的资源归属投毒。 RIP_7_17 - Resource Attribution Poisoning in Cost Allocation. HTN 规划跟踪资源使用情况（CPU 时间、内存、工具 API 调用），以进行成本分摊和优化。 HTN planning tracks resource usage (CPU time, memory, tool API calls) for cost allocation and optimization. 攻击者对资源归属信息进行投毒，导致成本分摊错误。 Attackers poison resource attribution causing incorrect cost assignment. 单智能体跟踪影响一个智能体的优化；多智能体共享跟踪则使资源归属信息投毒成为可能，进而影响所有智能体的资源感知规划。 Single-agent tracking affects one agent’s optimization; multi-agent shared tracking enables poisoned attribution affecting all agents’ resource-aware planning. [744, 43, 743, 755, 783]. [744, 43, 743, 755, 783].
RIP_7_18 - 多智能体分配中的经济激励操纵。 RIP_7_18 - Economic Incentive Manipulation in Multi-Agent Allocation. 当 HTN（层次任务网络，Hierarchical Task Network）规划包含经济激励（预算分配、成本优化、定价信号）时，攻击者会操纵激励信号。 When HTN (Hierarchical Task Network) planning includes economic incentives (budget allocation, cost optimization, pricing signals), attackers manipulate incentive signals. 在采用共享经济模型的多智能体系统中，遭投毒的激励会扭曲所有智能体的资源分配。 In multi-agent systems with shared economic models, poisoned incentives distort resource allocation across all agents. 单智能体激励影响一个智能体的偏好；多智能体共享经济模型则使攻击者能够扭曲所有智能体的资源分配决策。 Single-agent incentives affect one agent’s preferences; multi-agent shared economic models enable attackers distorting all agents’ resource allocation decisions. [807, 808, 809]. [807, 808, 809].
RIP_7_19 - 智能体间任务分解交接中的身份冒充。 RIP_7_19 - Identity Spoofing in Inter-Agent Decomposition Handoff. 当智能体 A 生成由智能体 B 执行的任务分解方案时，智能体 B 必须确认 A 的任务分解方案是合法的。 When Agent A produces decompositions that Agent B executes, Agent B must identify A’s decompositions as legitimate. 在多智能体层次系统中，任务分解交接缺乏身份验证，使攻击者能够注入看似来自更高权限智能体的虚假任务分解方案。 In multi-agent hierarchical systems, decomposition handoffs lack identity verification, enabling attackers injecting false decompositions appearing from higher-authority agents. 单智能体的任务分解在内部进行；多智能体的智能体间任务分解交接则需要身份验证，而许多实现中并未提供这种验证。 Single-agent decomposition is internal; multi-agent inter-agent decomposition handoff requires identity verification absent in many implementations. [49, 810, 443, 14]. [49, 810, 443, 14].
RIP_7_20 - 作为资源攻击面的并行化开销。 RIP_7_20 - Parallelization Overhead as Resource Attack Surface. MCTS（蒙特卡洛树搜索，Monte Carlo Tree Search）的并行化（在多个核心上运行多个模拟）存在同步开销。 MCTS (Monte Carlo Tree Search) parallelization (running multiple simulations on multiple cores) has synchronization overhead. 攻击者可以强制制造病态并行化场景，导致 MCTS 低效地使用资源。 Attackers can force pathological parallelization scenarios causing MCTS to use resources inefficiently. 单智能体的并行化开销影响一个智能体；采用协同并行化的多智能体系统则可能被迫陷入病态同步模式，造成成倍增加的开销。 Single-agent parallelization overhead affects one agent; multi-agent systems with coordinated parallelization can be forced into pathological synchronization patterns creating multiplicative overhead. [811, 812, 813, 814, 815]. [811, 812, 813, 814, 815].
RIP_7_21 - 重规划资源耗尽攻击。 RIP_7_21 - Replanning Resource Exhaustion Attacks. 攻击者通过注入虚假的偏差信号（虚假障碍、不存在的工具故障），在多智能体系统中触发过多的重规划循环。 Attackers trigger excessive replanning cycles in multi-agent systems by injecting false discrepancy signals (fake obstacles, phantom tool failures). 单个智能体承受的重规划开销有限；共享规划基础设施的多智能体系统则可能因分布式虚假信号而整体遭受拒绝服务，这些信号会影响团队层面的规划能力。 Single agents suffer limited replanning overhead; multi-agent systems with shared planning infrastructure can be collectively denial-of-serviced by distributed false signals affecting team-level planning capacity. [816, 817, 818, 610, 819]. [816, 817, 818, 610, 819].
RIP_7_22 - 通过匿名化整合伪造情节归属。 RIP_7_22 - Episode Attribution Spoofing Through Anonymous Consolidation. 整合会生成抽象化摘要，从而丢失原始情节的来源信息。 Consolidation creates abstracted summaries losing original episode sources. 如果整合过程将遭投毒的情节匿名化，就无法通过这些情节追溯到攻击者。 Attackers cannot be traced to poisoned episodes if consolidation anonymizes them. 单智能体的情节问责仍局限于一个智能体内部；多智能体整合后的知识会丢失来源跟踪信息，使攻击得以匿名传播，而智能体无法识别投毒源头。 Single-agent episode accountability remains within one agent; multi-agent consolidated knowledge loses source tracking, enabling anonymous attack propagation where agents cannot identify poisoning origins. [73, 72, 69, 62, 590]. [73, 72, 69, 62, 590].
RIP_7_23 - 作为虚假来源攻击的伪造经验注入。 RIP_7_23 - Fake Experience Injection as False Provenance Attacks. 攻击者构造带有时间戳的情节，使其看似来自可信的资深智能体。 Attackers craft episodes with timestamps suggesting they originate from trusted veteran agents. 单个智能体只有一个身份；多智能体系统则使攻击者能够冒充资深智能体的身份，注入来源伪造但受团队信任的情节。 Single agents have one identity; multi-agent systems enable attackers spoofing veteran agent identities injecting false-provenance episodes trusted by teams. [73, 138, 820]. [73, 138, 820].
RIP_7_24 - 通过情节去重开销耗尽资源。 RIP_7_24 - Resource Exhaustion Through Episode Deduplication Overhead. 去重需要将每个新情节与现有情节进行比较，因此会产生相似度计算成本。 Deduplication comparing each new episode against existing episodes incurs similarity computation costs. 攻击者创建数千个几乎完全相同的投毒情节，迫使去重过程计算相似度，从而耗尽计算资源。 Attackers create thousands of nearly-identical poisoned episodes forcing deduplication to compute similarities, exhausting computational resources. 单智能体去重将新情节与本地情节进行比较；多智能体共享去重则将新情节与数百万个共享情节进行比较，使攻击者能够耗尽整个组织的计算资源。 Single-agent deduplication compares against local episodes; multi-agent shared deduplication compares against millions of shared episodes enabling attackers exhausting organization-wide computational resources. [138, 73, 79, 821, 822]. [138, 73, 79, 821, 822].
RIP_7_25 - 通过存储扩张实施经济攻击。 RIP_7_25 - Economic Attack Through Storage Expansion. 云系统中的情景存储（episodic storage）按所存储的向量数量收费。 Episodic storage in cloud systems charges per stored vectors. 攻击者积累海量投毒情景记录，推高存储成本。 Attackers accumulate massive poisoned episodes driving up storage costs. 单个智能体的存储占用仍然可控；多智能体组织在整个智能体群中积累情景记录，会加剧存储扩张，使攻击者能够通过经济攻击推高基础设施成本。 Single agents’ storage footprint remains manageable; multi-agent organizations with fleet-wide episodic accumulation compound storage expansion, enabling economic attacks driving infrastructure costs. [138, 73, 400, 62, 44]. [138, 73, 400, 62, 44].
RIP_7_26 - 记忆整合计算成本攻击。 RIP_7_26 - Consolidation Compute Cost Attack. 周期性记忆整合需要调用成本高昂的 LLM，对情景记录进行抽象概括。 Periodic consolidation requires expensive LLM calls to abstract episodes. 攻击者强制系统整合海量投毒情景记录集，从而增加计算成本。 Attackers force consolidation of massive poisoned episode sets increasing compute costs. 单智能体的记忆整合成本有界；多智能体群对数以百万计的投毒情景记录进行整合，则使攻击者能够通过整合计算实施经济型拒绝服务攻击。 Single-agent consolidation has bounded cost; multi-agent fleet consolidation of poisoned episodes across millions enables economic denial-of-service through consolidation computation. [73, 823, 824]. [73, 823, 824].
RIP_7_27 - 利用嵌入缓存淘汰机制实现计算放大。 RIP_7_27 - Embedding Cache Eviction Exploitation for Computational Amplification. 嵌入缓存淘汰策略会淘汰最近最少使用的嵌入。 Embedding cache eviction policies evict least-recently used embeddings. 攻击者精心构造查询，导致频繁的缓存未命中，从而触发重新计算。 Attackers craft queries causing frequent cache misses triggering recomputation. 共享缓存抖动会同时影响所有智能体的查询延迟，导致整个系统的性能下降。 Shared cache thrashing affects all agents’ query latency simultaneously creating system-wide performance degradation. [124, 825, 826, 827, 828]. [124, 825, 826, 827, 828].
RIP_7_28 - 预算分配协商引发授权混淆。 RIP_7_28 - Budget Allocation Negotiation as Authorization Confusion. 当协调智能体向工作智能体分配 token 预算时，预算分配就会成为一种授权信号——Agent A 请求较大的输出预算，隐含地声称其需要生成大量输出。 When coordinator agents allocate token budgets to worker agents, budget allocation becomes an authorization signal—Agent A requesting large output budget implicitly claims need for extensive output. 在多智能体系统中，攻击者攻陷协调智能体，使其向恶意智能体授予过量预算，从而隐含地传递出相关操作已获授权的信号。 In multi-agent systems, attackers compromise coordinator agents to grant malicious agents excessive budgets, implicitly signaling operations are authorized. 预算固定的单个智能体不存在此类授权信号；多智能体预算协商将分配决策视为隐式授权，由此产生单智能体系统中不存在的攻击面。 Singular agents with fixed budgets have no authorization signals; multi-agent budget negotiation treats allocation decisions as implicit authorization, enabling attack surfaces absent in single-agent systems. [769, 829, 91, 760]. [769, 829, 91, 760].
RIP_7_29 - 多智能体仪表板中的效用函数归属伪造。 RIP_7_29 - Utility Function Attribution Spoofing in Multi-Agent Dashboards. 用于显示哪些效用函数驱动哪些智能体决策的仪表板可能遭到伪造，使恶意效用函数看似归属于合法智能体。 Dashboards displaying which utility functions drive which agents’ decisions can be spoofed so malicious utility functions appear attributed to legitimate agents. 当仪表板显示“安全智能体正在使用 u = 0.5×safety + …”时，攻击者可能注入看似合法的虚假归属信息。 When dashboards show ”Security Agent using u = 0.5×safety + …”, attackers might inject false attribution appearing legitimate. 单个智能体的效用函数归属清晰；多智能体仪表板中的归属信息则使伪造显得可信，因为用户无法通过密码学手段验证效用函数的分配。 Single agent’s utilities clearly attributable; multi-agent dashboard attribution makes spoofing plausible because users cannot verify utility assignment cryptographically. [830, 14, 23, 44]. [830, 14, 23, 44].
RIP_7_30 - 通过高成本效用计算消耗资源。 RIP_7_30 - Resource Consumption Through Expensive Utility Calculations. 某些效用函数的计算成本很高，例如对数千种结果进行蒙特卡洛采样或求解复杂优化问题。 Some utility functions (e.g., Monte Carlo sampling thousands of outcomes, solving complex optimization) are computationally expensive. 在多智能体系统中，攻击者可以通过协调的请求，同时触发多个智能体执行高成本效用计算，导致资源耗尽。 In multi-agent systems, attackers can trigger expensive utility calculations across multiple agents simultaneously through coordinated requests causing resource exhaustion. 单个智能体上的高成本计算会消耗其自身资源；在多个智能体上触发高成本计算，则可实施钱包拒绝服务攻击（denial-of-wallet），成倍增加整个系统的资源成本。 Expensive calculations on single agent consume its resources; expensive calculations triggered on multiple agents enable denial-of-wallet attacks multiplying resource costs across the system. [522, 765]. [522, 765].
RIP_7_31 - 经济效用优化诱发资源浪费。 RIP_7_31 - Economic Utility Optimization Incentivizing Resource Wastage. 当效用函数将成本纳入优化目标，且成本估计容易被操纵时，智能体可能在优化过程中倾向于选择成本估计虚假偏低、实际却消耗昂贵资源的操作。 When utility functions include cost as objective with easily-manipulated cost estimates, agents might optimize toward operations with false low-cost estimates consuming actual expensive resources. 在多智能体系统中，Agent A 被投毒的成本估计会影响下游智能体的工具选择，导致整个系统的资源错配。 In multi-agent systems, Agent A’s poisoned cost estimates affect downstream agents’ tool selections causing system-wide resource misallocation. 单个智能体的资源错配受限于其自身预算；多智能体围绕被投毒的成本效用进行协调，则会导致跨智能体的级联资源浪费。 Single agent misallocating resources limits to its budget; multi-agent coordination around poisoned cost utilities enables cascading resource wastage across agents. [610, 760, 91, 818]. [610, 760, 91, 818].
RIP_7_32 - 持久卷声明所有权模糊导致多智能体污染。 RIP_7_32 - Persistent Volume Claim Ownership Ambiguity Enabling Multi-Agent Contamination. 由多个智能体 Pod 挂载的持久卷，除 Kubernetes 元数据外，缺乏其他所有权标记。 Persistent volumes mounted by multiple agent pods lack ownership tagging beyond Kubernetes metadata. 如果多个智能体挂载同一个 PVC，且其中一个智能体被攻陷，该智能体便可修改其中的内容，进而影响所有智能体。 If multiple agents mount the same PVC and one agent is compromised, it can modify contents affecting all agents. 在多智能体共享模型仓库的场景中，如果 10 个智能体挂载 /models，那么一个被攻陷的智能体就能对所有模型投毒，影响整个智能体群。 In multi-agent model repository sharing where 10 agents mount /models, one compromised agent can poison all models affecting the entire fleet. 与使用独占存储的单智能体部署不同，多智能体共享存储会形成污染传播途径，使受攻击的影响通过共享声明传播至所有依赖这些声明的智能体。 Unlike singular deployments with exclusive storage, multi-agent shared storage creates contamination vectors where compromise propagates through shared claims to all dependent agents. [400, 472, 641]. [400, 472, 641].
RIP_7_33 - 基于成本的智能体选择漏洞。 RIP_7_33 - Cost-Based Agent Selection Vulnerability. Fleet Command 支持根据成本选择执行推理的智能体（旧硬件上的智能体成本更低，新硬件上的智能体速度更快）。 Fleet Command enables selecting agents for inference based on cost (cheaper agents on older hardware, faster agents on newer hardware). 攻击者可以注入有利于低成本智能体的成本假设，逐步将工具执行迁移至这些智能体，使工具执行集中在安全性可能较低的硬件上。 An attacker can gradually migrate tool execution toward cheaper agents by injecting cost assumptions favoring them, concentrating tool execution on potentially less-secure hardware. 单智能体选择是直接的；多智能体基于成本的路由则会形成经济层面的攻击面，使成本假设成为指令注入途径，系统性地将工具执行导向已被攻陷的基础设施。 Single-agent selection is direct; multi-agent cost-based routing creates economic attack surfaces where cost assumptions become instruction-injection vectors systematically biasing tool execution toward compromised infrastructure. [78, 831, 832, 833, 745]. [78, 831, 832, 833, 745].
RIP_7_34 - 通过推理引导的资源消耗实施资源劫持。 RIP_7_34 - Resource hijacking through reasoning-guided consumption. 智能体的推理过程记录了为何有必要执行资源密集型操作。 An agent’s reasoning documents why resource-intensive operations are necessary. 单个被攻击者攻陷的智能体可以通过分布式推理劫持整个系统的资源。 A single attacker-compromised agent can hijack resources across the entire system through distributed reasoning. 单智能体资源劫持仅限于该智能体获配的资源；多智能体系统则使攻击者能够通过共享的推理模式，将资源劫持分散至所有智能体。 Single-agent resource hijacking is limited to that agent’s allocation; multi-agent systems enable attackers to distribute resource hijacking across all agents through shared reasoning patterns. [834, 70, 835, 836]. [834, 70, 835, 836].
RIP_7_35 - 多连接器身份验证歧义导致凭据来源混淆。 RIP_7_35 - Multi-Connector Authentication Ambiguity Creating Credential Provenance Confusion. ETL 流水线使用凭据（数据库密码、API 令牌、OAuth）向数据源进行身份验证，但多智能体系统共享凭据会导致无法明确哪个智能体访问了哪个数据源。 ETL pipelines authenticate to sources with credentials (database passwords, API tokens, OAuth), but multi-agent systems sharing credentials create ambiguity about which agent accessed which source. 当 20 个智能体使用 postgres_password="shared_db_cred" 时，数据库日志只显示“shared_db_cred”，而不显示智能体身份。 When 20 agents use postgres_password="shared_db_cred", database logs show ”shared_db_cred” without agent identity. 可疑查询“SELECT * FROM salary_data”无法归因于智能体 A（人力资源助手）、智能体 B（分析师）或智能体 C（薪资处理）。 A suspicious query ”SELECT * FROM salary_data” cannot be attributed to Agent A (HR assistant), Agent B (analyst), or Agent C (payroll). 凭据共享使得无法跨 API 按智能体跟踪请求；凭据轮换会造成溯源缺口，需要手动将提取时间戳与轮换日志进行关联。 Credential sharing prevents per-agent request tracking across APIs; credential rotation creates provenance gaps requiring manual correlation of extraction timestamps with rotation logs. 提取敏感数据的受攻击智能体与使用共享凭据的合法智能体看起来无法区分，使事件响应更加复杂。 Compromised agents extracting sensitive data appear indistinguishable from legitimate agents using shared credentials, complicating incident response. 凭据级联会进一步加剧这一问题：智能体 A 通过共享令牌提取数据并进行转换，智能体 B 再从向量数据库中检索数据——这条链路会丢失凭据溯源信息。 Credential cascades compound this: Agent A extracts via shared token, transforms data, Agent B retrieves from vector database—the chain loses credential provenance. 使用共享服务账户访问文件系统也存在类似缺口：日志显示的是服务账户，无法细化到智能体级别。 Filesystem access with shared service accounts exhibits similar gaps: logs show the service account without agent-level granularity. 多智能体共享凭据会造成身份验证歧义，使数据源日志无法区分由哪个智能体执行了提取，从而妨碍事件处理和合规审计期间的归因。 Multi-agent shared credentials create authentication ambiguity where source logs cannot distinguish which agent performed extraction, preventing attribution during incidents and compliance audits. [731, 23, 18, 44, 62]. [731, 23, 18, 44, 62].
RIP_7_36 - 状态文件粒度过粗导致增量更新溯源缺口。 RIP_7_36 - Incremental Update Provenance Gaps from Coarse State File Granularity. ETL 增量更新通过状态文件中粒度较粗的时间戳（例如 "last_run": "2024-11-10T14:00:00Z"）跟踪进度，从而造成溯源缺口。 ETL incremental updates track progress in state files with coarse timestamps (e.g., "last_run": "2024-11-10T14:00:00Z"), creating provenance gaps. 提取在 14:00 至 15:00 之间更新的 1,247 份文档时，没有记录具体提取了哪些文档——状态不断推进，却未跟踪文档 ID。 When extracting 1,247 documents updated between 14:00 and 15:00, there’s no record of which specific documents—state advances without document ID tracking. 多智能体共享状态文件会加剧这些问题：当 20 个智能体使用同一文件时，时间戳会推进至最近一次完成时间，从而丢失智能体级别的溯源信息。 Multi-agent shared state files compound issues: when 20 agents use the same file, the timestamp advances to the latest completion, losing agent-level provenance. 如果智能体 A 在 14:05 完成，而智能体 B 在 14:10 完成，则这段 5 分钟的时间窗口内缺少智能体归因信息。 If Agent A completes at 14:05 and Agent B at 14:10, the 5-minute window lacks agent attribution. 粗粒度会造成重放歧义：将状态重置为 "last_run": "2024-11-01T00:00:00Z" 会重新处理自 11 月 1 日以来的所有文档，却无法验证所有预期文档是否均已重新处理。 Coarse granularity creates replay ambiguity: resetting state to "last_run": "2024-11-01T00:00:00Z" reprocesses all documents since November 1st without verifying all expected documents reprocessed. 故障会暴露这些缺口：如果在 1,000 份文档中提取了 500 份后发生失败，则没有记录跟踪已成功提取的 500 份文档，导致重试时出现重复。 Failures reveal gaps: if extraction fails after 500 of 1,000 documents, no record tracks the successful 500, causing duplicates on retry. 共享状态文件使合规查询无法直接完成：“显示 11 月 10 日摄取的所有患者记录”需要重新处理源系统。 Shared state files prevent compliance queries: ”show all patient records ingested November 10th” requires reprocessing source systems. 对于百万文档规模的运行，使用 "processed_doc_ids": [...] 进行详细跟踪会增加状态文件的大小开销。 Detailed tracking "processed_doc_ids": [...] adds state file size overhead for million-document runs. 单智能体仅使用时间戳进行跟踪所产生的缺口范围有限；多智能体共享状态则会造成覆盖整个智能体集群的溯源缺口，使得不重新处理就无法获得文档级审计轨迹。 Single-agent timestamp-only tracking has bounded gaps; multi-agent shared state creates fleet-wide provenance gaps preventing document-level audit trails without reprocessing. [837, 67, 70]. [837, 67, 70].
III-C8 RIP_8 - 韧性与错误处理攻击III-C8 RIP_8 - Resilience & Error Handling Attacks
RIP_8_1 - 多智能体工作流中流式响应资源消耗的不透明性。 RIP_8_1 - Streaming Response Resource Consumption Opacity in Multi-Agent Workflows. 展示智能体输出却隐藏多个智能体后台处理的流式模式会造成不透明性，使攻击者能够在用户注意力分散时隐藏高开销操作。 Streaming patterns displaying agent output while hiding background processing by multiple agents create opacity enabling attackers to hide expensive operations during user distraction. 在多智能体系统中，以流式方式输出智能体 A 的响应，可能同时触发智能体 B、C 和 D 的后台处理，由它们分析流式内容，为后续响应做准备。 In multi-agent systems, streaming Agent A’s response may simultaneously trigger background processing by Agents B, C, and D analyzing streamed content to prepare follow-ups. 攻击者注入指令，在用户专注于阅读内容的流式输出时间窗口内引发高开销的后台处理。 Attackers inject instructions causing expensive background processing during streaming windows when users focus on reading content. 单智能体流式输出呈现的是一个模型的输出，而多智能体流式输出则将响应生成与后台分析解耦。 Unlike singular agent streaming representing one model’s output, multi-agent streaming decouples response generation from background analysis. [744, 838, 507]. [744, 838, 507].
RIP_8_2 - 跨多智能体边界的重试预算归属。 RIP_8_2 - Retry Budget Attribution Across Multi-Agent Boundaries. 实施重试预算的错误处理机制缺乏明确的归属记录，无法确定由谁消耗了重试次数。 Error handling implementing retry budgets lacks clear attribution for who consumed retries. 在共享重试池的多智能体系统中，攻击者通过消耗本属于合法操作的配额来耗尽重试预算。 In multi-agent systems with shared retry pools, attackers exhaust retry budgets consuming credits belonging to legitimate operations. 归属信息缺失使系统无法确定哪个智能体消耗了重试次数，从而使攻击者能够通过耗尽重试次数实施拒绝服务攻击。 Attribution gaps prevent determining which agent consumed retries, enabling denial-of-service through retry exhaustion. [830, 744, 839, 834]. [830, 744, 839, 834].
RIP_8_3 - 备用提供商成本归属失效。 RIP_8_3 - Fallback Provider Cost Attribution Failures. 将请求路由至次级提供商的回退策略会造成成本差异。 Fallback strategies routing to secondary providers create cost differences. 在多智能体系统中，回退调用的成本归属不明确。 In multi-agent systems, cost attribution for fallback invocation is ambiguous. 归属信息缺失掩盖了通过滥用回退机制推高提供商费用的经济攻击。 Attribution gaps hide economic attacks where fallback abuse inflates provider costs. [23, 69, 71, 68, 73, 67, 72]. [23, 69, 71, 68, 73, 67, 72].
RIP_8_4 - 熔断器资源消耗的归属信息缺失。 RIP_8_4 - Circuit Breaker Resource Consumption Attribution Gaps. 熔断器保护机制的开销（监测故障、管理状态转换、执行超时逻辑）会消耗资源，但其归属不明确。 Circuit breaker protection overhead (monitoring failures, managing state transitions, timeout logic) consumes resources but attribution is unclear. 在采用集中式基础设施的多智能体系统中，资源成本分摊至所有智能体，导致归属不透明。 In multi-agent systems with centralized infrastructure, resource costs distribute across all agents creating attribution opacity. 利用熔断器开销的攻击者无法被识别，从而能够将滥用行为伪装成共享基础设施成本，实施分布式拒绝服务攻击。 Attackers exploiting circuit breaker overhead cannot be identified enabling distributed denial-of-service through abuse disguised as shared infrastructure costs. [382, 69, 731, 23, 44]. [382, 69, 731, 23, 44].
RIP_8_5 - 优雅降级中的成本失衡归属。 RIP_8_5 - Graceful Degradation Cost Imbalance Attribution. 优雅降级可使操作在能力和成本降低或成本增加的情况下继续运行，具体取决于所选的降级方式。 Graceful degradation enables operations at reduced capability/cost or increased cost depending on degradation choice. 在多智能体系统中，影响成本的降级决策归属不明确。 In multi-agent systems, degradation decisions affecting cost are attributed ambiguously. 归属信息缺失使攻击者能够故意触发向高成本替代方案的降级，并使其看起来是成本上合理且必要的选择。 Attribution gaps enable attackers deliberately triggering degradation to expensive alternatives appearing as cost-justified necessity. [814, 818, 43, 840]. [814, 818, 43, 840].
RIP_8_6 - 通过渐进式身份声明伪造流式输出的身份归属。 RIP_8_6 - Streaming Attribution Spoofing Through Progressive Identity Claims. 流式响应使身份伪造成为可能：前期词元声称某种身份（“我是安全智能体”），而后续词元则在验证完成前执行恶意操作。 Streaming responses enable identity spoofing where early tokens claim identity (”I am the Security Agent”) while later tokens execute malicious operations before verification. 在显示带有身份归属的流式输出的多智能体系统中，攻击者会构造所标示身份与实际来源不一致的流。 In multi-agent systems displaying streaming with identity attribution, attackers craft streams where attributed identity doesn’t match origin. 前期词元建立信任；后续词元利用这种信任执行操作。 Early tokens establish trust; later tokens exploit that trust executing operations. 多智能体仪表板使此类攻击成为可能：在完整流可供验证之前，前期词元已建立信任，因此身份伪造得以成功。 Multi-agent dashboards enable attacks where identity spoofing succeeds because early tokens establish trust before complete stream enables verification. [87, 140, 841, 842]. [87, 140, 841, 842].
RIP_8_7 - 流式处理中的资源消耗不透明使经济型拒绝服务攻击成为可能。 RIP_8_7 - Streaming Resource Consumption Opacity Enabling Economic Denial-of-Service. 流式响应掩盖了实时资源消耗，使经济攻击难以被检测到。 Streaming responses hide real-time resource consumption, making economic attacks difficult to detect. 采用后台流式处理的多智能体系统会导致资源消耗不透明。 Multi-agent systems with background streaming processing create resource consumption opacity. 攻击者通过投毒上下文，使用户交互期间发生高成本的后台处理，在成本未被察觉的情况下推高资源消耗。 Attackers poison context causing expensive background processing during user interactions, inflating resource consumption without cost awareness. [843, 138, 844, 845, 846, 814, 847]. [843, 138, 844, 845, 846, 814, 847].
III-C9 RIP_9 - 多模态攻击III-C9 RIP_9 - Multimodal Attacks
RIP_9_1 - 通过视觉模型输出伪造多模态内容归属。 RIP_9_1 - Multimodal Content Attribution Spoofing Through Vision Model Outputs. 在多智能体系统中，智能体的身份部分通过其输出模态来确立。 In multi-agent systems, agents’ identities are partially established through output modalities. 攻击者创建虚假内容，声称其属于不同模态。 Attackers create false content claiming different modalities. 文本内容的归属仍局限于语言领域；多模态内容的归属则使跨模态边界的伪造成为可能。 Text content attribution remains within language domain; multimodal content attribution enables spoofing across modality boundaries.
