RIP_9_2 - 通过多模态 DDoS 耗尽视觉模型资源。 RIP_9_2 - Vision Model Resource Exhaustion Through Multimodal DDoS. 视觉模型会消耗大量资源（GPU、带宽、内存）。 Vision models consume substantial resources (GPUs, bandwidth, memory). 在多个专用智能体调用视觉模型的多智能体系统中，攻击者通过协同发起多模态请求来触发资源耗尽。 In multi-agent systems where multiple specialized agents invoke vision models, attackers trigger resource exhaustion through coordinated multimodal requests. 攻击者可向 RAG 系统大量灌入高分辨率图像，迫使视觉模型进行处理，从而耗尽资源。 Attackers could flood RAG systems with high-resolution images forcing vision model processing, exhausting resources. 单智能体的资源耗尽只影响该智能体；而在共享视觉模型后端的多智能体系统中，N 个智能体的请求会争用共享资源，从而产生放大效应。 Single-agent resource exhaustion affects that agent; multi-agent systems with shared vision model backends create amplification where N agents’ requests compete for shared resources. [82, 849, 74]. [82, 849, 74].
RIP_9_3 - 通过长时长内容滥用音频处理资源。 RIP_9_3 - Audio Processing Resource Exploitation Through Long-Duration Content. Whisper 转录所消耗的资源与音频时长成正比。 Whisper transcription consumes resources proportional to audio duration. 在多智能体音频 RAG 系统中，攻击者提交时长极长的录音，耗尽所有音频处理智能体的资源。 In multi-agent audio RAG systems, attackers submit extremely long audio recordings, exhausting resources across all audio processing agents. 单智能体音频处理的资源消耗有界；而共享 Whisper 部署的多智能体系统会形成资源池，使攻击者能够独占共享基础设施。 Single-agent audio processing creates bounded resource consumption; multi-agent systems with shared Whisper deployment create resource pools enabling attackers to monopolize shared infrastructure. [852, 853, 522, 591, 744]. [852, 853, 522, 591, 744].
RIP_9_4 - 多模态规模扩张引发的嵌入向量存储资源消耗放大。 RIP_9_4 - Embedding Vector Store Resource Amplification Through Multimodal Scale. 多模态 RAG 系统存储文本、图像、音频和提取出的结构的嵌入表示，其向量存储规模达到纯文本系统的 3-5x。 Multimodal RAG systems storing embeddings for text, images, audio, and extracted structures create vector stores 3-5x larger than text-only systems. 更大的向量存储会消耗更多 GPU 内存、增加查询延迟，并为投毒提供更大的攻击面。 Larger vector stores consume more GPU memory, increase query latency, and create more attack surface for poisoning. 攻击者利用规模扩张，通过使相似性搜索过载来造成拒绝服务。 Attackers exploit scale expansion causing denial-of-service through similarity search overload. 文本向量存储的规模仍可控制；多模态系统扩大的存储规模则会给基础设施带来压力，攻击者可通过协调多个智能体的查询来利用这种压力。 Text vector stores remain at manageable scale; multimodal systems’ expanded storage creates infrastructure strain exploitable through coordinated agent queries. [854, 231, 855, 822, 856]. [854, 231, 855, 822, 856].
III-C10 RIP_10 - 推理与评估攻击III-C10 RIP_10 - Reasoning & Evaluation Attacks
RIP_10_1 - 评估成本归属判定失效导致经济型拒绝服务（DoS）。 RIP_10_1 - Evaluation Cost Attribution Failures Enabling Economic DoS. 消耗大量资源的评估流水线会产生成本。 Evaluation pipelines consuming significant resources incur costs. 在按智能体跟踪成本的多智能体评估系统中，攻击者可使特定的评估智能体消耗过多资源。 In multi-agent evaluation systems where cost tracking is per-agent, attackers can cause specific evaluator agents to consume excessive resources. 由分布式智能体开展的多智能体评估会使成本归属判定变得复杂。 Multi-agent evaluation with distributed agents creates cost attribution complexity. 如果成本归属不明确，经济型攻击就会隐藏在总体评估成本之中。 Without clear attribution, economic attacks hide in aggregate evaluation costs. 多智能体的分布式特性使成本归属得以混淆，而单一评估中的成本则具有直接的对应关系。 Multi-agent distribution enables cost obfuscation unlike singular evaluation with direct mapping. [744, 591, 69, 110, 737]. [744, 591, 69, 110, 737].
RIP_10_2 - 决策展示中的评估智能体身份伪造。 RIP_10_2 - Evaluation Agent Identity Spoofing in Decision Displays. 评估仪表板展示评估智能体给出的建议（准确率智能体在准确率达到 95%+ 时建议 DEPLOY）。 Evaluation dashboards display recommendations from evaluation agents (accuracy agent recommends DEPLOY if 95%+ accuracy). 在缺乏密码学身份绑定的多智能体系统中，攻击者可以伪造评估智能体的身份。 In multi-agent systems without cryptographic identity binding, attackers can spoof evaluation agent identity. 遭入侵的智能体所生成的恶意建议可能看起来来自可信智能体。 Compromised agents producing malicious recommendations can appear to originate from trusted agents. 单一智能体的身份识别很简单；具有不同信任级别的多智能体系统则容易受到身份冒充攻击。 Singular agents with trivial identity; multi-agent systems with distinct trust levels become susceptible to impersonation. [857, 772, 266, 858, 830]. [857, 772, 266, 858, 830].
RIP_10_3 - 评估产物来源不透明导致虚假归属。 RIP_10_3 - Evaluation Artifact Provenance Opacity Enabling False Attribution. 评估产物（报告、指标、建议）缺乏密码学来源证明。 Evaluation artifacts (reports, metrics, recommendations) lack cryptographic provenance. 在产物生成过程复杂的多智能体评估系统中，无法明确最终产物由哪个智能体生成。 In multi-agent evaluation systems with complex artifact generation, it’s unclear which agent generated final artifacts. 攻击者篡改评估产物，使其看起来像合法输出。 Attackers modify evaluation artifacts appearing as legitimate outputs. 由单一主体生成产物时，作者身份明确；多智能体共同构成产物则会模糊其来源，使篡改结果的攻击看起来经过授权。 Singular artifact generation has clear authorship; multi-agent artifact composition obscures provenance enabling attacks tampering with results appearing authorized. [859, 469, 860, 176, 470]. [859, 469, 860, 176, 470].
RIP_10_4 - 通过过度评估循环实施经济型拒绝服务。 RIP_10_4 - Economic Denial-of-Service Through Excessive Evaluation Cycles. 评估流水线可能被过度触发（模型更新时持续评估、监测到异常时触发评估、开发者发起评估）。 Evaluation pipelines can be triggered excessively (continuous evaluation on model updates, triggered by monitoring anomalies, developer-initiated evaluation). 在多智能体评估系统中，攻击者可通过触发误报来引发持续的评估循环。 In multi-agent evaluation systems, attackers can cause continuous evaluation cycles by triggering false alarms. 与触发点有限的单一评估不同，多智能体评估的分布式触发机制会导致成本成倍激增。 Unlike singular evaluation with bounded trigger points, multi-agent evaluation’s distributed triggers create multiplicative cost explosion. [861, 766, 862, 754]. [861, 766, 862, 754].
RIP_10_5 - 评估结果归属伪造。 RIP_10_5 - Evaluation Result Attribution Spoofing. 评估结果以 PR 评论的形式发布，并标明所属智能体的身份。 Evaluation results posted as PR comments with agent identity attribution. 如果评论生成过程未对结果进行加密签名，攻击者就可能伪造评估评论，使未通过评估的代码显示出达标的指标。 If comment generation doesn’t cryptographically sign results, attackers could forge evaluation comments showing passing metrics for failing code. 有多个参与方的多智能体评估使攻击者能够通过攻陷信任程度较低的智能体，伪造来自受信任智能体的结果。 Multi-agent evaluation with multiple contributors enables spoofing results from trusted agents while compromising less-trusted ones. [863, 471, 864]. [863, 471, 864].
RIP_10_6 - 将评估框架的资源消耗用作攻击向量。 RIP_10_6 - Evaluation Framework Resource Consumption as Attack Vector. 运行评估流水线会消耗计算资源。 Running evaluation pipelines consumes computational resources. 攻击者可能刻意设计评估开销高昂的智能体（使用大型测试数据集、调用开销高昂的指标），从而迫使评估超时或成本攀升。 Attackers could deliberately design agents requiring expensive evaluation (using large test datasets, invoking expensive metrics) forcing timeouts or cost escalation. 在各智能体计算成本不同的多智能体评估中，攻击者能够将开销高昂的评估集中到特定智能体上，导致基础设施过载。 Multi-agent evaluation where agents’ computational cost varies enables attackers concentrating expensive evaluation on specific agents causing infrastructure overload. [745, 830, 45, 865]. [745, 830, 45, 865].
RIP_10_7 - 通过伪造基准测试归属制造虚假来源。 RIP_10_7 - Benchmark Attribution Spoofing Creating False Provenance. 基准测试结果被归属于特定的智能体/版本。 Benchmark results are attributed to specific agents/versions. 攻击者伪造归属信息，使恶意智能体的改进被记在诚实智能体名下。 Attackers spoof attribution causing malicious agent improvements to be credited to honest agents. 单智能体的归属判定影响一个主体的声誉；具有传递性声誉关系的多智能体系统则使虚假归属成为可能，从而引发对信任的级联利用。 Single-agent attribution affects one reputation; multi-agent systems with transitive reputation relationships enable false attribution creating cascading trust exploitation. [79, 62, 78, 138, 73]. [79, 62, 78, 138, 73].
RIP_10_8 - 多智能体评估中的质量评分身份混淆。 RIP_10_8 - Quality Score Identity Confusion in Multi-Agent Assessment. RASC 为推理路径分配质量评分。 RASC assigns quality scores to reasoning paths. 在多智能体系统中，如果未经重新评估就将 Agent A 的质量评估应用于 Agent B 的路径，就会发生身份混淆。 In multi-agent systems, if Agent A’s quality assessment is applied to Agent B’s paths without re-evaluation, identity confusion occurs. 下游智能体无法分辨所应用的评估属于哪个智能体，从而使传递性信任可被利用。 Downstream agents cannot distinguish whose assessment was applied, enabling transitive trust exploitation. 单智能体的质量评估在本地保留明确归属；多智能体之间的评估传播则会造成身份混淆，归属信息会在跨越智能体边界时丢失。 Single-agent quality assessment remains locally-attributed; multi-agent assessment propagation creates identity confusion where attribution gets lost across agent boundaries. [866, 867, 868]. [866, 867, 868].
RIP_10_9 - 将采样预算的资源分配用作经济攻击面。 RIP_10_9 - Sampling Budget Resource Allocation as Economic Attack Surface. 成本与准确率之间的权衡以采样预算为主要经济变量。 Cost-accuracy trade-offs use sampling budget as primary economic variable. 在具有共享资源池的多智能体系统中，控制智能体之间的采样预算分配能够实施经济攻击。 In multi-agent systems with shared resource pools, controlling sampling budget allocation across agents enables economic attacks. 攻击者控制的智能体可以索取过量采样预算，使其他智能体陷入资源饥饿，或迫使资源匮乏的智能体使用低预算。 Attacker-controlled agents can claim excessive sampling budget starving other agents, or force resource-starved agents to use low budgets. 单智能体的资源消耗保持隔离；多智能体共享资源池则使经济攻击成为可能，其中一个智能体囤积资源会影响其他智能体。 Single-agent resource consumption remains isolated; multi-agent shared pools enable economic attacks where one agent’s resource hoarding affects others. [869, 870, 871, 872]. [869, 870, 871, 872].
RIP_10_10 - 利用难度分类实施经济剥削。 RIP_10_10 - Difficulty Classification Economic Exploitation. 难度自适应采样根据问题分类分配资源。 Difficulty-adaptive sampling allocates resources based on problem classification. 攻击者通过操纵难度分类（声称难题是简单问题）来降低采样预算。 Attackers gaming difficulty classification (claiming hard problems are easy) reduce sampling budgets. 在共享分类结果的多智能体系统中，一个智能体的操纵行为会影响所有智能体的资源分配。 In multi-agent systems with shared classifications, one agent’s gaming affects resource allocation for all agents. 单智能体的操纵行为影响一个智能体的预算；多智能体共享分类结果则使系统性的经济剥削成为可能。 Single-agent gaming affects one agent’s budget; multi-agent shared classifications enable systematic economic exploitation. [873, 874, 875, 876]. [873, 874, 875, 876].
RIP_10_11 - 将 MCTS 计算预算用作资源耗尽攻击向量。 RIP_10_11 - MCTS Computational Budget as Resource Exhaustion Vector. MCTS 规划的计算开销高昂——高质量规划需要数百万次模拟。 MCTS planning is computationally expensive—high-quality planning requires millions of simulations. 攻击者迫使智能体针对计算开销高昂的问题（分支因子高、树深度大）执行 MCTS 规划，从而耗尽计算预算。 Attackers force agents to perform MCTS planning for expensive problems (high branching factor, deep trees), exhausting computational budgets. 在竞争共享资源的多智能体系统中，一个智能体开销高昂的 MCTS 规划会使其他智能体陷入资源饥饿。 In multi-agent systems competing for shared resources, one agent’s expensive MCTS planning starves other agents. 单智能体的资源耗尽影响一个智能体；多智能体的资源争用则通过共享资源池放大资源耗尽效应，使多个智能体陷入资源饥饿。 Single-agent exhaustion affects one agent; multi-agent resource contention amplifies exhaustion through shared resource pools enabling starvation of multiple agents. [877, 835, 878, 879, 880]. [877, 835, 878, 879, 880].
RIP_10_12 - 通过利用 ReAct 与 Reflection 的交互实现多模式成本放大。 RIP_10_12 - Multi-Pattern Cost Amplification Through ReAct-Reflection Interaction Exploitation. 对手将模式组合武器化，针对结合了 ReAct 迭代行动循环与 Reflection 自我批评循环的系统发起攻击，造成乘法式的成本爆炸，超出各模式单独运行时的开销。 Adversaries weaponize pattern composition targeting systems combining ReAct’s iterative action loops with Reflection’s self-critique cycles, creating multiplicative cost explosions exceeding individual pattern overhead. 这种攻击利用了架构中的盲点：模式之间的交互未受到监控，而成本控制仅针对各个模式单独实施。 This attack exploits architectural blind spots where pattern interactions go unmonitored and cost controls apply to patterns in isolation. ReAct 智能体通常每项任务需要调用 LLM 5-10 次；在每个推理步骤中加入反思会使调用次数成倍增加：10 次 ReAct 迭代 × 每次迭代 3 个反思周期 = 至少调用 LLM 30 次。 ReAct agents typically consume 5-10 LLM calls per task; adding reflection to each reasoning step multiplies this: 10 ReAct iterations × 3 reflection cycles per iteration = 30 LLM calls minimum. 当不同智能体在协同工作流中采用不同模式时，就会出现多智能体特有的维度，导致成本跨模式边界成倍增长。 The unique multi-agent dimension emerges when different agents employ different patterns in coordinated workflows, creating multiplicative costs across pattern boundaries. [881, 882, 883, 884]. [881, 882, 883, 884].
RIP_10_13 - 将评估权限委托给已被攻陷的智能体。 RIP_10_13 - Evaluation Authority Delegation to Compromised Agents. 持续评估通过设置质量门禁来执行阈值要求，在指标退化时阻止合并。 Continuous evaluation implements quality gates enforcing thresholds blocking merges if metrics regress. 如果评估智能体被攻陷，攻击者就可以批准恶意更改或阻止合法更改。 If evaluation agents are compromised, attackers can approve malicious changes or block legitimate ones. 包含多个专用评估智能体的多智能体评估系统会将权限委托给多个智能体，使攻陷其中一个智能体的攻击者能够控制评估的特定方面。 Multi-agent evaluation systems with multiple specialized evaluation agents delegate authority to multiple agents enabling attackers compromising one agent to control specific evaluation aspects. [885, 886, 887, 888, 889]. [885, 886, 887, 888, 889].
RIP_10_14 - 利用离线与在线评估之间的分布差异。 RIP_10_14 - Offline vs. Online Evaluation Distribution Gap Exploitation. 离线基准测试与在实际运行的网站上开展的在线评估存在显著差异（在 Mind2Web 中观察到 47% 的任务无效）。 Offline benchmarks differ substantially from online evaluation on live websites (47% task invalidity observed in Mind2Web). 攻击者针对离线基准测试中的特定产物构造指令，这些指令在在线评估中不会激活，但在离线评估中却表现为成功。 Attackers craft instructions specific to offline benchmark artifacts that don’t activate in online evaluation but appear successful offline. 单智能体离线评估面临一个离线与在线之间的差距；而在评估结果用于指导开发决策的多智能体系统中，针对特定基准测试的攻击会误导系统，并影响所有协同智能体。 Single-agent offline evaluation faces one offline-online gap; multi-agent systems where evaluation results guide development decisions get misled by benchmark-specific compromises affecting all coordinated agents. [890, 779, 891, 776, 778]. [890, 779, 891, 776, 778].
RIP_10_15 - 在 Pass@K 评估中利用行为一致性的非确定性。 RIP_10_15 - Behavioral Consistency Non-Determinism Exploitation in Pass@K Evaluation. Pass@K 衡量多次试验中的可靠性。 Pass@K measures reliability across trials. 攻击者构造以一定概率激活的指令，使其时而成功、时而失败，看起来如同自然的非确定性。 Attackers craft instructions with probabilistic activation designed to succeed inconsistently, appearing as natural non-determinism. 对于汇总各专用智能体 pass@K 指标的多智能体系统，攻击者通过协调指令的概率性激活来攻陷系统。 Multi-agent systems with aggregated pass@K metrics across specialized agents get compromised through coordinated probabilistic instruction activation. 单智能体的非确定性源于模型的随机性；多智能体系统汇总的 pass@K 则使攻击者能够控制指令的概率性激活，并使其看起来如同自然波动。 Single-agent non-determinism is model stochasticity; multi-agent systems’ aggregated pass@K enables adversary-controlled probabilistic instruction activation appearing as natural variance. [892, 893, 894, 895]. [892, 893, 894, 895].
RIP_10_16 - 分析智能体中的少样本指标解读投毒。 RIP_10_16 - Few-Shot Metric Interpretation Poisoning in Analytics Agents. 分析智能体从少样本示例中学习指标解读模式。 Analytics agents learn metric interpretation patterns from few-shot examples. 展示“指标 X 表明状况 Y”的投毒示例会使智能体学到错误的指标语义。 Poisoned examples showing ”metric X indicates Y condition” teach incorrect metric semantics. 在多智能体评估中，分析演示里的投毒指标示例会传播至所有使用分析结果的智能体，通过指标解读示例造成分布式决策投毒。 Multi-agent evaluation with poisoned metric examples in analytics demonstrations propagates to all agents consuming analytics, creating distributed decision poisoning through metric interpretation examples. [79, 831, 85, 69, 896]. [79, 831, 85, 69, 896].
III-C11 RIP_11 - 向量存储与 RAG 攻击III-C11 RIP_11 - Vector Store & RAG Attacks
RIP_11_1 - 将单次查询成本参数用作经济滥用的攻击向量。“单次查询成本”作为优化指标，决定了可接受的运营支出。 RIP_11_1 - Cost-Per-Query Parameter as Economic Abuse Vector. ”Cost per query” as optimization metric determines acceptable operational expense. 在多智能体系统中，成本调节参数决定了可接受的支出。 In multi-agent systems, cost-tuning parameters determine acceptable expense. 攻击者通过构造旨在超出成本预算的查询（资源耗尽），或构造表面成本低廉却会产生隐性成本的查询，来利用成本调节机制。 Attackers exploit cost-tuning by crafting queries designed to exceed cost budgets (resource exhaustion), or crafting queries appearing cheap but incurring hidden costs. 当查询触发未计入主要成本模型的次级操作时，就会产生隐性成本，例如缓存失效、重新建立索引或下游智能体的重新评估，因此查询的计费成本很低，而其实际系统成本却高出数个数量级。 Hidden costs arise when a query triggers secondary operations not counted in the primary cost model—such as cache invalidations, re-indexing, or downstream agent re-evaluations—so the query’s billed cost is low while its true system cost is orders of magnitude higher. [834, 897, 898, 745]. [834, 897, 898, 745].
RIP_11_2 - 将资源消耗核算用作经济攻击向量。 RIP_11_2 - Resource Consumption Accounting as Economic Attack Vector. 效率管理系统会跟踪每个智能体的资源消耗，以用于计费或内部费用分摊。 Efficiency systems track resource consumption per agent for billing/chargeback purposes. 攻击者利用核算机制，在消耗资源的同时规避归因，或触发虚高的核算记录，导致其他智能体的资源耗尽。 Attackers exploit accounting mechanisms—consuming resources while avoiding attribution, or triggering inflated accounting causing resource exhaustion for other agents. 单智能体核算影响该智能体的预算；在具有共享资源池的多智能体系统中，攻击者能够通过规避核算的协同消耗，耗尽整个系统的资源。 Single-agent accounting affects that agent’s budget; multi-agent systems with shared resource pools enable attackers exhausting system-wide resources through coordinated consumption evading accounting. [843, 743, 69, 899]. [843, 743, 69, 899].
RIP_11_3 - 多智能体处理导致知识库来源归属信息丢失。 RIP_11_3 - Knowledge Base Source Attribution Loss Through Multi-Agent Processing. 知识库文档会记录来源，但多智能体处理会丢失溯源信息。 Knowledge base documents track source but multi-agent processing loses provenance. 多跳智能体链会逐步丢失来源归属信息，从而使指令洗白成为可能，令其源头无法追踪。 Multi-hop agent chains progressively lose source attribution enabling instruction laundering where origin becomes untraceable. 示例：检索智能体获取一份内嵌来源元数据的法律文档，但下游的摘要智能体重写了文本，并移除了引用标记。 Example: A Retrieval Agent fetches a legal document with embedded source metadata, but a downstream Summarizer rewrites the text and strips citation markers. 当决策智能体（Decision Agent）随后使用该摘要时，原始来源已无法追溯，从而使攻击者能够进行指令洗白，且无法重建其来源。 When a Decision Agent later uses the summary, the original source is no longer traceable, enabling instruction laundering where the origin cannot be reconstructed. [900, 87, 901, 902]。 [900, 87, 901, 902].
RIP_11_4 - 作为经济攻击面的知识库复制成本。 RIP_11_4 - Knowledge Base Replication Cost as Economic Attack Surface. 跨地理区域复制语义记忆会产生存储和网络成本。 Replicating semantic memory across geographic regions incurs storage and network costs. 攻击者精心构造文档，引发过度复制，从而增加基础设施成本。 Attackers craft documents causing excessive replication increasing infrastructure costs. 需要复制共享知识库的分布式智能体部署，使攻击者能够通过复制放大来增加运营成本。 Distributed agent deployments requiring shared knowledge base replication enable attackers increasing operational costs through replication amplification. [903, 904, 905, 906, 907]。 [903, 904, 905, 906, 907].
RIP_11_5 - 索引基础设施成本利用。 RIP_11_5 - Indexing Infrastructure Cost Exploitation. 创建和维护语义索引会产生计算成本。 Creating and maintaining semantic indices incurs computation costs. 攻击者精心构造高基数文档，使其需要高成本的索引处理。 Attackers craft high-cardinality documents requiring expensive indexing. 共享索引基础设施使攻击者能够通过注入单个文档来增加整体索引成本。 Shared indexing infrastructure enables attackers increasing collective indexing costs through single document injection. [400, 591, 908, 909]。 [400, 591, 908, 909].
RIP_11_7 - 向量数据库查询负载放大。 RIP_11_7 - Vector Database Query Load Amplification. 智能体查询共享向量数据库会放大检索负载。 Agents querying shared vector databases amplify retrieval loads. 攻击者利用通用触发条件，触发经过专门设计、可被所有智能体同时检索到的情景记忆，从而造成查询负载峰值。 Attackers trigger episodes designed to be retrieved by all agents simultaneously (using common triggers), creating query load spikes. 单智能体查询产生的负载彼此独立；协同的多智能体检索则使负载放大攻击成为可能，其中，对投毒情景记忆的同步检索会使存储基础设施不堪重负。 Single-agent queries generate isolated load; coordinated multi-agent retrieval enables amplified load attacks where synchronized poisoned episode retrieval overwhelming storage infrastructure. [910, 911, 499, 691]。 [910, 911, 499, 691].
RIP_11_8 - 知识图谱所有权与授权的歧义。 RIP_11_8 - Knowledge Graph Ownership and Authorization Ambiguity. 在多智能体混合系统间共享的知识图谱，会使图谱数据归谁所有以及由谁授权修改变得模糊不清。 Knowledge graphs shared across multi-agent hybrids create ambiguity about who owns graph data and who authorizes modifications. 攻击者利用授权缺口注入看似经过授权的关系，因为图谱访问控制并未明确规定组件级授权。 Attackers exploit authorization gaps injecting relationships appearing authorized because graph access controls don’t clearly establish component-level authorization. 单个图谱的访问权限是明确的；而在多个智能体共同贡献内容的多智能体共享图谱中，授权会产生歧义。 Single graph access is clear; multi-agent shared graphs where multiple agents contribute create authorization ambiguity. [85, 78, 831, 110, 45]。 [85, 78, 831, 110, 45].
RIP_11_9 - 多提供商系统中嵌入 API 端点的来源混淆。 RIP_11_9 - Embedding API Endpoint Provenance Confusion in Multi-Provider Systems. 使用多个提供商的 API 兼容嵌入端点（OpenAI API、具有 OpenAI 兼容接口的 NVIDIA NIM，以及暴露 OpenAI 兼容端点的自托管模型）的多智能体 RAG 系统，会产生来源混淆，使智能体无法可靠地确定实际由哪个模型生成了嵌入。 Multi-agent RAG systems using API-compatible embedding endpoints from multiple providers (OpenAI API, NVIDIA NIM with OpenAI-compatible interface, self-hosted models exposing OpenAI-compatible endpoints) create provenance confusion where agents cannot reliably determine which actual model produced embeddings. 当 Agent A 配置了一个 OpenAI 兼容端点 URL，但该 URL 指向 NVIDIA NIM 或自托管模型时，存储在向量数据库中的嵌入就缺乏关于真实生成模型的明确来源信息。 When Agent A configures an OpenAI-compatible endpoint URL but that URL points to NVIDIA NIM or a self-hosted model, embeddings stored in vector databases lack clear provenance about the true generating model. 这使端点切换攻击成为可能：攻击者修改环境变量，在保持 API 兼容性的同时，将嵌入请求从合法提供商重定向至恶意端点——Agent A 以为自己正在使用 OpenAI，实际上却将查询发送至攻击者控制的端点，而这些端点会记录敏感查询文本。 This enables endpoint switching attacks where attackers modify environment variables to redirect embedding requests from legitimate providers to malicious endpoints while maintaining API compatibility—Agent A believes it’s using OpenAI but actually sends queries to attacker-controlled endpoints that log sensitive query text. 支持灵活切换提供商的 API 兼容性，消除了用于验证端点真实性的技术机制。 The API compatibility that enables flexible provider switching eliminates technical mechanisms for verifying endpoint authenticity. 在多智能体系统中，当不同智能体使用不同提供商，却在没有模型来源追踪的情况下将嵌入存储于共享向量数据库中时，端点来源混淆会进一步加剧——检索查询无法确定嵌入由哪个提供商生成，因此无法验证语义一致性，也无法检测来自已被攻陷端点的嵌入。 In multi-agent systems, endpoint provenance confusion compounds when different agents use different providers but store embeddings in shared vector databases without model provenance tracking—retrieval queries cannot determine which provider generated embeddings, making it impossible to validate semantic consistency or detect embeddings from compromised endpoints. 采用硬编码端点的单智能体系统具有明确的来源信息。 Single-agent systems with hardcoded endpoints have clear provenance. 采用基于环境变量的端点配置和共享向量存储的多智能体系统会产生来源歧义，嵌入缺乏关于其生成提供商的可验证身份信息，使攻击者能够注入仅凭 API 兼容性无法与合法嵌入区分的恶意嵌入。 Multi-agent systems using environment-based endpoint configuration and shared vector stores create provenance ambiguity where embeddings lack verifiable identity about their generating provider, enabling attackers to inject malicious embeddings indistinguishable from legitimate ones based on API compatibility alone. [23, 69, 79, 45, 897]。 [23, 69, 79, 45, 897].
RIP_11_10 - 多提供商嵌入部署中的模型版本注册表歧义。 RIP_11_10 - Model Version Registry Ambiguity in Multi-Provider Embedding Deployments. 使用多个提供商嵌入的多智能体系统缺乏集中式模型版本注册表，无法追踪各智能体部署了哪些嵌入模型版本，由此产生版本歧义，攻击者可通过语义漂移攻击加以利用。 Multi-agent systems using embeddings from multiple providers lack centralized model version registries tracking which embedding model versions are deployed for which agents, creating version ambiguity that attackers exploit through semantic drift attacks. 提供商的模型更新会使嵌入空间发生偏移：OpenAI 的 text-embedding-3 更新会细微地改变语义聚类，NVIDIA 的 NV-Embed 更新会改变各维度的优先级，而开源模型的微调则会改变学得的表示。 Provider model updates shift embedding spaces: OpenAI’s text-embedding-3 updates subtly change semantic clustering, NVIDIA’s NV-Embed updates alter dimensional priorities, and open-source model fine-tuning modifies learned representations. 当 Agent A 使用 text-embedding-3-large 的 1.0 版本，而 Agent B 在不知情的情况下升级至 1.1 版本时，尽管模型名称相同，两个智能体计算出的嵌入所表示的空间在语义上却有所不同。 When Agent A uses text-embedding-3-large version 1.0 and Agent B unknowingly upgrades to version 1.1, embeddings computed by both agents represent semantically different spaces despite identical model names. 攻击者知道多智能体系统缺乏检测版本不匹配的机制，因此会精心构造在旧版本中嵌入结果有利、在新版本中嵌入结果不利的文档，以利用版本漂移。 Attackers exploit version drift by crafting documents that embed favorably in older versions but unfavorably in newer versions, knowing multi-agent systems lack mechanisms to detect version mismatches. 这种攻击之所以能够成功，是因为嵌入 API 通常不会在响应中暴露版本标识符。 The attack succeeds because embedding APIs typically don’t expose version identifiers in responses. 在共享向量数据库中，版本不明确使人无法判断嵌入不一致究竟源于版本漂移、投毒，还是合理的语义变化。 In shared vector databases, version ambiguity makes it impossible to determine whether embedding inconsistencies result from version drift, poisoning, or legitimate semantic variation. 使用单一模型版本的单智能体部署具有一致的语义空间。 Single-agent deployments using one model version have consistent semantic spaces. 部署周期相互独立的多智能体系统会造成版本异构，使各智能体在不知情的情况下使用不同版本的嵌入模型，而向量存储中缺乏版本溯源信息，导致无法检测基于版本的攻击。 Multi-agent systems with independent deployment cycles create version heterogeneity where agents unknowingly operate with different embedding model versions, and the lack of version provenance in vector stores prevents detecting version-based attacks. [23, 69, 912, 913, 914]. [23, 69, 912, 913, 914].
RIP_11_11 - 多智能体部署中共享向量数据库 API 密钥导致的溯源信息丢失。 RIP_11_11 - Shared Vector Database API Key Provenance Loss Across Multi-Agent Deployments. 生产环境中的向量数据库使用 API 密钥认证来控制访问，但多智能体系统往往为了简化运维，为所有智能体配置同一个共享 API 密钥，造成溯源信息丢失，使数据库访问日志无法区分哪个智能体执行了哪些操作。 Production vector databases use API key authentication to control access, but multi-agent systems often configure single shared API keys across all agents for operational simplicity, creating provenance loss where database access logs cannot distinguish which agent performed which operations. 当多个智能体使用同一个 API 密钥进行认证时，数据库审计日志会将所有操作归于同一凭据，无法细化到智能体层面。 When multiple agents authenticate using the same API key, database audit logs show all operations attributed to one credential without agent-level granularity. 这使得归因规避成为可能：Agent A 执行的恶意查询与 Agent B 的合法操作看起来无法区分。 This enables attribution evasion where Agent A performing malicious queries appears indistinguishable from legitimate Agent B operations. 攻击者可以利用这一溯源缺口，攻陷一个智能体，使用共享 API 密钥访问向量数据库，并执行未经授权的操作，而这些操作会被错误地归于共享凭据，而非被攻陷的智能体。 Attackers exploiting this provenance gap can compromise one agent, use the shared API key to access vector databases, and perform unauthorized operations that are incorrectly attributed to the shared credential rather than the compromised agent. 需要对各个智能体单独追责的多智能体系统，必须为每个智能体分配唯一的 API 密钥，并通过审计日志将密钥映射到智能体身份，但运维开销促使人们采用共享密钥这一反模式。 Multi-agent systems requiring individual agent accountability need unique API keys per agent with audit logging mapping keys to agent identities, but operational overhead incentivizes shared key anti-patterns. 溯源信息丢失还延伸至数据所有权：当多个智能体使用共享凭据摄取文档时，向量数据库集合缺乏明确的所有权归属信息，因而无法确定哪些向量由哪个智能体贡献，这使得需要特定智能体与数据映射关系的合规要求（GDPR 数据删除请求、SOC2 数据所有权审计）更难满足。 The provenance loss extends to data ownership: when multiple agents ingest documents using shared credentials, vector database collections lack clear ownership attribution making it impossible to determine which agent contributed which vectors, complicating compliance requirements (GDPR data deletion requests, SOC2 data ownership audits) where specific agent-data mappings are required. 使用一个 API 密钥的单智能体系统具有隐含的一对一智能体与凭据映射关系，溯源关系清晰。 Single-agent systems using one API key have implicit one-to-one agent-credential mapping with clear provenance. 使用共享凭据的多智能体系统会形成多对一的智能体与凭据关系，导致安全审计和合规验证所需的细粒度溯源信息缺失。 Multi-agent systems with shared credentials create many-to-one agent-credential relationships eliminating fine-grained provenance required for security auditing and compliance validation. [69, 725, 915, 76, 23]. [69, 725, 915, 76, 23].
RIP_11_12 - 向量数据库选择中的供应商锁定使迁移过程中的数据溯源信息变得不明确。 RIP_11_12 - Vector Database Selection Provider Lock-In Obscuring Data Provenance Across Migrations. 多智能体系统会选择不同的向量数据库（选择 Milvus 以获得高性能，选择 Weaviate 以集成 GraphQL，选择 Pinecone 以简化托管运维，选择 Qdrant 以实现过滤，选择 pgvector 以集成 PostgreSQL），但在供应商之间迁移时会面临数据溯源难题，因为供应商特有的功能和数据格式妨碍了完整、清晰的溯源跟踪。 Multi-agent systems selecting different vector databases (Milvus for high performance, Weaviate for GraphQL integration, Pinecone for managed simplicity, Qdrant for filtering, pgvector for PostgreSQL integration) create data provenance challenges when migrating between providers because vendor-specific features and data formats prevent clean provenance tracking. 当 Agent A 借助时间旅行查询和分区键将向量摄取到 Milvus 中，而组织随后迁移到 Weaviate 时，导出的向量会丢失 Milvus 特有的元数据，导致无法重建原始数据的溯源信息。 When Agent A ingests vectors into Milvus with time travel queries and partition keys, and later the organization migrates to Weaviate, exported vectors lose Milvus-specific metadata making it impossible to reconstruct original data provenance. 这种溯源信息丢失使数据洗白攻击成为可能：攻击者向某个数据库注入恶意向量，因为他们知道迁移到另一家供应商时会剥离审计元数据。 This provenance loss enables data laundering attacks where attackers inject malicious vectors into one database knowing that migration to another provider will strip audit metadata. 使用异构数据库的多智能体系统会进一步加剧这一问题——Agent A 将医疗向量存储在 Milvus 中，Agent B 将金融向量存储在 Weaviate 中，Agent C 将监管向量存储在 pgvector 中——而当组织整合到同一家供应商时，跨数据库的溯源跟踪就会失效。 Multi-agent systems using heterogeneous databases compound this—Agent A stores medical vectors in Milvus, Agent B stores financial vectors in Weaviate, Agent C stores regulatory vectors in pgvector—and when the organization consolidates to one provider, cross-database provenance tracking fails. 当智能体依赖数据库特有的功能时，锁定效应会加剧：Agent A 在 Milvus 中使用 GPU 加速和 DiskANN 索引的查询，无法直接迁移到仅支持 HNSW 索引的 Weaviate，因此必须重新摄取数据以重新创建向量，从而丢失原始摄取时间戳和来源归属信息。 The lock-in exacerbates when agents depend on database-specific features: Agent A’s Milvus queries using GPU acceleration and DiskANN indexes cannot be directly ported to Weaviate’s HNSW-only indexes, forcing re-ingestion that recreates vectors losing original ingestion timestamps and source attribution. 供应商特有的距离度量实现会造成额外的溯源缺口：由于归一化方式存在差异，使用 Milvus 余弦相似度进行比较的向量，在 Weaviate 的余弦相似度实现下可能具有不同的排序。 Provider-specific distance metric implementations create additional provenance gaps: vectors compared with Milvus cosine similarity may rank differently under Weaviate’s cosine implementation due to normalization differences. 单智能体、单数据库部署能够在同一家供应商的元数据模型内保持一致的溯源信息。 Single-agent single-database deployments maintain consistent provenance within one vendor’s metadata model. 多智能体、多数据库部署会造成溯源信息碎片化，各数据库使用互不兼容的元数据存储向量，而迁移或整合会使整个多智能体生态系统为满足合规和审计要求所需的跨数据库溯源跟踪能力丧失。 Multi-agent multi-database deployments create provenance fragmentation where each database stores vectors with incompatible metadata, and migrations or consolidations eliminate cross-database provenance tracking required for compliance and audit across the multi-agent ecosystem. [916, 400, 917, 918, 919]. [916, 400, 917, 918, 919].
RIP_11_13 - 元数据规范化与字段剥离导致 ETL 来源归属信息丢失。 RIP_11_13 - ETL Source Attribution Loss Through Metadata Normalization and Field Stripping. ETL 转换流水线将异构元数据规范化为一致的模式，同时剥离特定来源的溯源信息。 ETL transformation pipelines normalize heterogeneous metadata into consistent schemas, stripping source-specific provenance. PostgreSQL 丢失 table_name 和 schema_version；Confluence 丢失 space_key 和 author_email；Salesforce 丢失 owner_id。 PostgreSQL loses table_name and schema_version; Confluence loses space_key and author_email; Salesforce loses owner_id. 多智能体系统无法确定细粒度的来源信息：从经过规范化的“技术”文档中检索内容的智能体，无法识别该文档由哪个表、哪个模式版本或哪个用户创建。 Multi-agent systems cannot determine fine-grained provenance: an agent retrieving from a normalized ”technical” document cannot identify which table, schema version, or user created it. 当可疑内容需要核实来源时，这会使验证无法进行。 This prevents validation when suspicious content requires source verification. 当多个来源包含相同文档时，规范化也会造成冲突——如果 PostgreSQL 和 Confluence 都存有同一份技术指南，规范化后的元数据会使二者无法区分，检索时也就无法确定哪一份具有权威性。 Normalization also creates conflicts when multiple sources contain identical documents—if both PostgreSQL and Confluence hold the same technical guide, normalized metadata makes them indistinguishable, and retrieval cannot determine which is authoritative. 采用不同规范化规则的多智能体系统会进一步加剧混乱：如果智能体 A 保留 Confluence 的 space_key，而智能体 B 将其丢弃，相同的文本块就会带有不同的元数据。 Multi-agent systems with differing normalization rules compound confusion: if Agent A preserves Confluence space_key while Agent B discards it, identical chunks appear with different metadata. 采用来源专用模式的单智能体 ETL 能够保留详细的来源信息；多智能体系统中的激进规范化则会剥离归属字段，导致无法对文档进行细粒度追溯。 Single-agent ETL with source-specific schemas maintains detailed provenance; multi-agent aggressive normalization strips attribution fields, preventing fine-grained document tracing. [23, 69, 912]. [23, 69, 912].

RIP_12_2 - 多智能体工作流中的检查点归属歧义。 RIP_12_2 - Checkpoint Attribution Ambiguity in Multi-Agent Workflows. LangGraph 检查点会保存执行状态，但可能缺乏明确的归属信息，无法说明具体状态变更由哪个智能体实施。 LangGraph checkpoints maintain execution state but may lack clear attribution about which agent made specific state changes. 在多智能体工作流中，当检查点遭到破坏时，很难确定应由哪个智能体负责。 In multi-agent workflows, determining which agent was responsible becomes difficult when checkpoints are corrupted. 如果检查点机制未明确按字段跟踪各智能体的贡献，取证分析就无法准确查明哪个智能体注入了恶意状态。 Without checkpointing explicitly tracking agent contributions per field, forensics cannot pinpoint which agent injected malicious state. 单智能体检查点的归属明确；多智能体检查点则汇集了多次状态变更，形成复杂的来源关系图。 Single-agent checkpoints have clear ownership; multi-agent checkpoints aggregate multiple state mutations creating complex provenance graphs. RIP_12_3 - 通过无界迭代循环实施的经济循环攻击。 RIP_12_3 - Economic Cycling Attack via Unbounded Iteration Loops. LangGraph 对循环的显式支持能够实现迭代改进，但缺乏成本控制的无界迭代也使耗尽资金攻击（denial-of-wallet）成为可能。 LangGraph’s explicit cycle support enables iterative refinement, but unbounded iteration without cost controls enables denial-of-wallet attacks. 攻击者精心构造输入，使条件边过度循环——无限累积的 code_history 会耗尽词元。 Attackers craft inputs causing conditional edges to loop excessively—a code_history accumulating infinitely drains tokens. 在多智能体循环中，每轮迭代都会调用多个专门化智能体，使成本成倍增加。 In multi-agent cycling, each cycle iteration invokes multiple specialized agents multiplying costs. 单智能体循环消耗一个模型的词元；多智能体循环则会使不同专门化智能体产生的成本成倍增加，从而导致指数级的资源耗尽。 Single-agent loops consume one model’s tokens; multi-agent cycles multiply costs across agent specializations enabling exponential resource exhaustion. [835, 921, 922, 923, 924]. [835, 921, 922, 923, 924].
RIP_12_4 - 记忆持久化成本开销导致的耗尽资金攻击。 RIP_12_4 - Memory Persistence Cost Overhead Enabling Denial-of-Wallet. ConversationBufferMemory 会将完整的对话历史持久化到数据库中，而长时间的对话会不断累积存储成本。 ConversationBufferMemory persists full conversation history to databases, and extended conversations accumulate storage costs. 攻击者通过人为延长对话或引入高开销的工具结果，推高存储成本。 Attackers extend conversations artificially or with expensive tool results, inflating storage costs. 多智能体之间的对话共享会放大这一问题——多个智能体调用高开销工具所产生的结果会累积在共享记忆中，存储成本的增长速度比单智能体场景更快。 Multi-agent conversation sharing amplifies this—expensive tools from multiple agents accumulate in shared memory, and storage costs grow faster than singular agent scenarios. RIP_12_5 - 将树增长造成的内存消耗用作经济攻击。 RIP_12_5 - Tree Growth Memory Consumption as Economic Attack. 如果不进行剪枝，MCTS 树的增长将不受限制——每个新增节点都会消耗内存。 MCTS tree growth is unbounded without pruning—each new node consumes memory. 攻击者提交规划问题，导致 MCTS 生成无限增长的树，从而耗尽可用内存。 Attackers submit planning problems causing MCTS to grow unbounded trees, exhausting available memory. 在采用共享内存的多智能体系统中，针对某个智能体树增长过程的攻击会影响所有智能体。 In multi-agent systems with shared memory, attacking one agent’s tree growth impacts all agents. 单智能体的树增长导致的内存耗尽只影响一个智能体的内存；而在采用共享内存池的多智能体系统中，这种内存耗尽可导致整个系统崩溃。 Single-agent tree exhaustion affects one agent’s memory; multi-agent systems with shared memory pools enable tree exhaustion to crash entire systems. RIP_12_6 - 语义记忆成本优化导致的资源耗尽。 RIP_12_6 - Semantic Memory Cost Optimization Enabling Resource Exhaustion. 语义检索使用计算开销高昂的嵌入操作。 Semantic retrieval uses computationally expensive embedding operations. 攻击者精心构造查询，触发高开销的语义搜索，从而消耗资源。 Attackers craft queries causing expensive semantic searches consuming resources. 在每个智能体都独立执行语义搜索的多智能体系统中，资源消耗会成倍增加，从而使分布式资源耗尽成为可能。 Multi-agent systems where each agent independently performs semantic searches multiply resource consumption enabling distributed resource exhaustion. RIP_12_7 - 通过上下文膨胀增加工作记忆消耗，实现资源劫持。 RIP_12_7 - Working Memory Consumption as Resource Hijacking via Context Inflation. 攻击者通过注入冗长、信息密度低的内容来增加工作记忆消耗，迫使智能体为相同的语义内容消耗更多 token。 Attackers bloat working memory consumption by injecting verbose, low-information-density content forcing agents to consume more tokens for same semantic content. 在资源受限的多智能体系统中，当 Agent A 通过冗长输出增加 token 消耗，而这些输出又成为 Agent B 的输入时，跨智能体边界的级联 token 消耗会造成指数级的资源浪费。 In multi-agent resource-constrained systems, when Agent A inflates token consumption through verbose output becoming Agent B’s input, cascading token consumption across agent boundaries creates exponential resource waste. 在 Agent A 中进行一次冗长内容注入，会使 Agent A 输出中的 token 消耗达到 2×，Agent B 处理中的消耗达到 4×，Agent C 处理中的消耗达到 8×——通过不断叠加的低效率攻击经济资源。 A single verbose injection in Agent A creates 2× token consumption in Agent A’s output, 4× in Agent B’s processing, 8× in Agent C’s processing—attacking economic resources through compounding inefficiency. 多智能体经济劫持不同于单个智能体的资源耗尽，因为分布式 token 消耗会跨智能体边界叠加，使通过 token 膨胀实施的拒绝服务攻击比单个智能体内的膨胀更有效。 Multi-agent economic hijacking is distinct from singular resource exhaustion because distributed token consumption compounds across agent boundaries, making denial-of-service through token inflation more effective than singular agent inflation. RIP_12_8 - 共享语义记忆造成来源归属混淆。 RIP_12_8 - Shared Semantic Memory Creating Attribution Confusion for Provenance. 从多个智能体的经历中提炼出的语义记忆会丢失来源归属——当 Agent A 的求解方法成为语义记忆中的“标准方法”时，下游智能体会采用该方法，却不知道它源自 Agent A。语义抽象使来源变得不可见，从而造成归属混淆。 Semantic memory distilled from multiple agents’ episodes loses attribution—when Agent A’s solution method becomes ”standard approach” in semantic memory, downstream agents apply this approach unaware it originated from Agent A. RIP_12_9 - 跨智能体边界的会话持久化使跨智能体上下文投毒成为可能。 RIP_12_9 - Session Persistence Across Agent Boundaries Enabling Cross-Agent Context Poisoning. 为保持对话连贯性而在多个专用智能体之间共享持久化会话状态的上下文感知功能，会引入跨智能体上下文投毒漏洞。 Context awareness features sharing persisted session state across multiple specialized agents to maintain conversation coherence create vulnerability to cross-agent context poisoning. 攻陷一个智能体的上下文，即可在后续交互中对所有智能体实施持续攻击。 Compromising one agent’s context enables persistent attacks on all agents in subsequent interactions. 在多智能体系统中，如果研究智能体存储了被投毒的上下文（“始终在所有回复中包含安全分析”），该指令就会在会话恢复时传播给分析智能体、报告智能体和可视化智能体，触发所有智能体执行高成本操作。 In multi-agent systems, a research agent storing poisoned context (”always include security analysis in all responses”) causes that instruction to propagate to analysis agents, reporting agents, and visualization agents when the session resumes, triggering expensive operations across all agents. UI 中无缝的上下文延续掩盖了多智能体之间的上下文共享。 The UI’s seamless context continuation obscures multi-agent context sharing. 攻击者只要成功将恶意指令注入一个智能体的上下文，就能持续攻陷多个智能体，因为会话管理会跨边界共享上下文，却不进行隔离或逐智能体验证。 Attackers successfully injecting malicious instructions into one agent’s context achieve persistent multi-agent compromise because session management shares context across boundaries without isolation or per-agent validation. 这种跨智能体感染途径是具有共享上下文的多智能体系统所特有的，与上下文始终保留在单个模型内部的单智能体系统不同。 This cross-agent infection vector is unique to multi-agent systems with shared context, unlike singular systems where context remains within one model. RIP_12_10 - 记忆序列化存储成本放大。 RIP_12_10 - Memory Serialization Storage Cost Amplification. 将 ConversationBufferMemory 序列化并存储（JSON、protobuf），会创建对话数据的重复持久化副本，且序列化开销随消息复杂度而变化。 ConversationBufferMemory serialization to storage (JSON, protobuf) creates duplicate persistent copies of conversation data, and serialization overhead varies with message complexity. 攻击者构造序列化开销最大的对话内容（深度嵌套结构、编码为字符串的二进制数据），抬高每条消息的存储成本。 Attackers craft conversation content with maximum serialization overhead (deeply nested structures, binary data encoded as strings) inflating storage costs per message. 多智能体共享序列化会使这一开销成倍增加——一条高成本消息仅序列化一次，却由 N 个智能体分别反序列化，而每次反序列化都可能在内部再次进行序列化。 Multi-agent shared serialization multiplies this overhead—one expensive message serializes once but is deserialized by N agents, and each deserialization may serialize internally. RIP_13_6 - 分布式引擎缓存中的来源信息丢失。 RIP_13_6 - Provenance Loss in Distributed Engine Caching. TensorRT 引擎缓存在边缘设备上，以避免重新构建的成本。 TensorRT engines are cached on edge devices to avoid rebuild costs. 能够访问某台边缘设备文件系统的攻击者，可以将缓存的引擎替换为植入后门的版本。 An attacker with access to one edge device’s file system can replace the cached engine with a backdoored version. 缓存的引擎缺乏与构建时源材料之间的密码学绑定。 Cached engines lack cryptographic bindings to build-time sources. 单个缓存引擎只有一条来源链；多智能体分布式缓存会产生 500 条独立的来源链，攻击者只需攻陷其中一个缓存，就能系统性地投毒该位置的所有智能体。 Single cached engine has one provenance chain; multi-agent distributed caching creates 500 independent chains where an attacker needing to compromise only one cache can systematically poison all agents at that location. III-C15 RIP_15 - Kubernetes 与容器攻击III-C15 RIP_15 - Kubernetes & Container Attacks
RIP_15_1 - 可促成横向移动和令牌重放的 Kubernetes 服务账户身份欺骗。 RIP_15_1 - Kubernetes Service Account Identity Spoofing Enabling Lateral Movement and Token Replay. Kubernetes 服务账户通过令牌验证 pod 身份，但多智能体部署中共享的服务账户会造成身份共用漏洞。 Kubernetes service accounts authenticate pod identity through tokens, but shared service accounts in multi-agent deployments create identity pooling vulnerabilities. 攻陷一个智能体后，攻击者便能冒用该账户的身份，并假冒所有使用该账户的智能体，从而促成大范围的指令注入和横向移动。 Compromising one agent enables attackers to assume the account’s identity and impersonate all agents using that account, facilitating widespread instruction injection and lateral movement. 令牌可以被提取，并从外部来源进行重放。 Tokens can be extracted and replayed from external sources. 跨副本认证池化会造成这样的情形：一个遭入侵的凭据即可用于通过所有智能体的身份认证。 Cross-replica authentication pooling creates scenarios where one compromised credential authenticates all agents. 与使用专用凭据的单体部署不同，共享服务账户通过令牌复用和身份池化，将一个智能体遭入侵的影响扩大到所有智能体。 Unlike singular deployments with dedicated credentials, shared service accounts amplify compromise from one agent to all agents through token reuse and identity pooling. RIP_15_2 - 通过操纵 iptables 在微服务中实施 IP 欺骗。 RIP_15_2 - IP Spoofing in Microservices via iptables Manipulation. 具备特定能力的智能体可以操纵 iptables，伪造服务间通信中的源 IP 地址。 Agents with certain capabilities can manipulate iptables to spoof source IP addresses in inter-service communication. 攻击者可以伪造看似来自可信智能体的通信。 Attackers can forge communication appearing to originate from trusted agents. 单智能体场景中的欺骗会影响该智能体对外通信时呈现的身份；在多智能体系统中，攻击者可以在通信中冒充任意智能体，并通过伪造的可信通信实施有针对性的横向移动。 Single-agent spoofing affects that agent’s outbound identity; multi-agent systems enable attackers to spoof any agent identity in communication, enabling targeted lateral movement through forged trustworthy communication. RIP_15_3 - 基于优先级的 Pod 驱逐顺序泄露智能体的重要性。 RIP_15_3 - Pod Eviction Ordering Based on Priority Revealing Agent Importance. Kubernetes 的 Pod 优先级控制资源紧张时的驱逐顺序。 Kubernetes pod priority controls eviction order during resource pressure. 当优先级分配反映业务层面定义的智能体重要性时，例如为对营收至关重要或涉及安全敏感事务的智能体分配更高优先级，攻击者便可通过观察 Pod 驱逐模式，推断哪些智能体最有价值，并据此实施针对性攻击。 When priority assignments reflect business-defined agent importance—such as assigning higher priority to revenue-critical or security-sensitive agents—attackers observing pod eviction patterns can infer which agents are most valuable and target them accordingly. 请注意，Pod 优先级也会用于纯技术层面的调度，例如使基础设施 Pod 的优先级高于工作负载 Pod，而与业务重要性无关；在这些情况下，驱逐顺序无法可靠地揭示智能体的重要性。 Note that pod priority is also used for purely technical scheduling reasons (e.g., giving infrastructure pods priority over workload pods) with no relationship to business significance; in those cases, eviction order does not reliably reveal agent importance. 该风险具体适用于有意按照智能体角色在运行中的关键程度分配优先级的情形。 The risk applies specifically where priority is deliberately assigned to reflect operational criticality of agent roles. RIP_15_4 - 通过操纵 GPU 资源请求囤积硬件。 RIP_15_4 - GPU Resource Request Gaming for Hardware Hoarding. 智能体从容量有限的资源池中请求 GPU。 Agents request GPUs from limited pools. 攻击者操纵 GPU 资源请求来囤积加速器，使其他智能体无法获得计算资源。 Attackers manipulate GPU resource requests to hoard accelerators, starving other agents of computation resources. 多智能体 GPU 调度形成了竞争性的资源分配机制，使攻击者能够操纵 GPU 请求，导致其他智能体的模型推理回退到 CPU，从而造成性能下降和经济成本外部性。 Multi-agent GPU scheduling creates competitive resource allocation enabling attackers to game GPU requests causing other agents’ model inference to fall back to CPU, creating performance degradation and economic cost externalities. RIP_15_5 - 绕过基于命名空间的多租户隔离。 RIP_15_5 - Namespace-Based Multi-Tenancy Isolation Bypass. Kubernetes 命名空间为多个智能体环境提供软隔离。 Kubernetes namespaces provide soft isolation for multiple agent environments. 能够访问某个命名空间的攻击者可能逃逸至共享基础设施（网络、计算资源），从而影响其他命名空间。 Attackers with access to one namespace can potentially escape to shared infrastructure (network, compute) affecting other namespaces. 多智能体、多租户集群使跨命名空间攻击成为可能：攻陷一个租户的智能体后，即可干扰其他租户的智能体，从而形成隔离部署中不存在的经济攻击面。 Multi-agent multi-tenant clusters enable cross-namespace attacks where compromising one tenant’s agent enables disrupting other tenants’ agents, creating economic attack surfaces unavailable in isolated deployments. [532, 552, 70, 944, 18]. [532, 552, 70, 944, 18].
RIP_15_6 - Gossip 协议通信中的集群节点身份欺骗。 RIP_15_6 - Cluster Node Identity Spoofing in Gossip Protocol Communications. 多节点向量数据库集群使用 Gossip 协议协调成员关系，并通过加入操作期间广播的 CLUSTER_HOSTNAME 值标识节点。 Multi-node vector database clusters use gossip protocols for membership coordination, with nodes identified by CLUSTER_HOSTNAME values broadcast during join operations. 攻击者可以通过伪造 Gossip 消息中的 CLUSTER_HOSTNAME 值来冒充合法节点，注入恶意数据或破坏集群共识。 Attackers can spoof node identities by forging CLUSTER_HOSTNAME values in gossip messages, impersonating legitimate nodes to inject malicious data or disrupt cluster consensus. 当合法的 ”node1” 发送 Gossip 消息宣告其存在时，攻击者可以同时广播自称为 ”node1” 的 Gossip 消息，并使用不同的 IP 地址或分片分配信息，从而造成身份冲突，使集群成员无法判断哪个 ”node1” 才是真实节点。 When legitimate ”node1” sends gossip announcing its presence, an attacker can simultaneously broadcast gossip claiming to be ”node1” with different IP addresses or shard assignments, creating identity conflicts where cluster members cannot determine which ”node1” is authentic. 这种身份歧义可促成多种攻击：在数据投毒中，以 ”node1” 身份接受写入的攻击者节点存储遭篡改的向量，并使其在集群中复制；在查询拦截中，宣称自己是 ”node1” 的攻击者节点接收原本发往合法节点的查询；在共识破坏中，相互冲突的 ”node1” 身份使集群无法建立一致的分片拓扑。 This identity ambiguity enables various attacks: data poisoning where attacker node accepting writes as ”node1” stores corrupted vectors that replicate across cluster, query interception where attacker node advertising as ”node1” receives queries intended for legitimate node, and consensus disruption where conflicting ”node1” identities prevent cluster from establishing consistent shard topology. 使用集群式向量数据库的多智能体系统会放大这一风险，因为智能体查询集群时不会验证各个节点的身份——智能体信任通过 Gossip 宣告的集群拓扑，并假定 CLUSTER_HOSTNAME 值代表真实节点。 Multi-agent systems using clustered vector databases amplify this risk because agents query clusters without verifying individual node identities—agents trust cluster topology advertised through gossip assuming CLUSTER_HOSTNAME values represent authentic nodes. Gossip 协议缺乏基于密码学的节点身份验证，这意味着 CLUSTER_HOSTNAME 只是一个字符串形式的声明，并无身份证明。 The lack of cryptographic node identity verification in gossip protocols means CLUSTER_HOSTNAME is merely a string assertion without proof of identity. 多智能体场景的区别：单节点部署不存在节点间的 Gossip 通信，因此消除了此类身份欺骗途径。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-node deployments have no inter-node gossip eliminating identity spoofing vectors. 采用基于 Gossip 的协调机制的多智能体集群数据库形成了分布式身份攻击面，其中节点的真实性取决于未经验证的主机名声明，使攻击者能够注入虚假节点身份，影响所有智能体所依赖的集群拓扑和数据路由。 Multi-agent clustered databases with gossip-based coordination create distributed identity surfaces where node authenticity depends on unverified hostname claims, enabling attackers to inject false node identities affecting cluster topology and data routing for all agents. [987, 988, 910, 989, 990]. [987, 988, 910, 989, 990].
RIP_15_7 - 负载均衡器 VIP 在查询归因中掩盖具体节点的来源信息。 RIP_15_7 - Load Balancer VIP Masking Individual Node Provenance in Query Attribution. 集群式向量数据库部署使用具有虚拟 IP 地址（VIP）的负载均衡器，将智能体查询分发到各个集群节点，但 VIP 路由会掩盖各个节点的身份，造成来源追溯缺口，使查询审计日志无法确定究竟是哪个节点处理了哪个智能体的请求。 Clustered vector database deployments use load balancers with virtual IP addresses (VIPs) to distribute agent queries across cluster nodes, but VIP routing masks individual node identities creating provenance gaps where query audit logs cannot determine which specific node processed which agent’s request. 当 Agent A 通过负载均衡器发送查询时，查询会根据负载均衡算法被路由到多个后端节点之一，但数据库访问日志中记录的源 IP 是负载均衡器的 VIP，而非具体后端节点的 IP。 When Agent A sends a query through the load balancer, the query routes to one of multiple backend nodes based on load balancing algorithms, but database access logs show source IP as the load balancer VIP rather than the specific backend node. 这种来源掩蔽使事后事件分析无法还原哪个节点处理了可能受到侵害的查询：如果后来发现 node2 已被攻陷并提供遭投毒的数据，审计日志便无法确定哪些智能体的查询受到了影响。 This provenance masking prevents post-incident analysis from reconstructing which node handled potentially compromised queries: if node2 is later discovered compromised and serving poisoned data, audit logs cannot determine which agents’ queries were affected. 攻击者利用这一点攻陷集群中的一个节点，因为他们知道，负载均衡器的健康检查仍会将查询路由到该受侵节点，但审计日志不会揭示处理敏感查询的具体节点身份，从而使攻击者能够持续窃取数据，并造成归因混淆。 Attackers exploit this by compromising one node in a cluster knowing that load balancer health checks will continue routing queries to the compromised node, but audit logs won’t reveal the specific node identity handling sensitive queries, enabling persistent data exfiltration with attribution confusion. VIP 抽象还使智能体无法实施针对特定节点的安全策略：Agent A 可能希望根据地理位置或安全态势，将查询限制在高信任度节点上，但负载均衡器的 VIP 使智能体无法指定目标节点，迫使其依赖缺乏智能体专属策略执行能力的负载均衡器路由。 The VIP abstraction also prevents agents from implementing node-specific security policies: Agent A might want to restrict queries to high-trust nodes based on geographic location or security posture, but load balancer VIP prevents agents from specifying target nodes, forcing reliance on load balancer routing that lacks agent-specific policy enforcement. 多智能体系统通过共享负载均衡器放大了这一问题：来自不同安全域的多个智能体通过同一个 VIP 进行路由，而如果一个智能体要求选择具有高安全保障的节点，另一个智能体却接受安全性较低的节点，共享负载均衡器便无法加以区分。 Multi-agent systems amplify this through shared load balancers: multiple agents from different security domains route through the same VIP, and if one agent requires high-assurance node selection while another accepts lower-security nodes, the shared load balancer cannot differentiate. 单智能体与节点直接连接时，访问日志能够保留清晰的节点级来源信息。 Single-agent direct node connections maintain clear node-level provenance in access logs. 使用共享负载均衡器 VIP 的多智能体系统会丧失节点级归因能力，从而造成审计和安全策略方面的缺口。 Multi-agent systems using shared load balancer VIPs eliminate node-level attribution creating audit and security policy gaps. III-C16 RIP_16 - 负载均衡器与扩缩容攻击III-C16 RIP_16 - Load Balancer & Scaling Attacks
RIP_16_1 - 负载均衡器的身份抽象使智能体冒充成为可能。 RIP_16_1 - Load Balancer Identity Abstraction Enabling Agent Impersonation. 负载均衡器将副本身份隐藏在单一端点之后。 Load balancers abstract away replica identity behind single endpoints. 攻击者可利用负载均衡器的状态，在任意副本之间路由请求，制造某个副本处理了其实际并未处理的请求的假象。 Attackers exploiting load balancer state could route requests between arbitrary replicas creating appearance that one replica handled requests it didn’t. 直接访问智能体端点时，其身份清晰可见；负载均衡器的抽象则使通过操纵路由实施身份欺骗成为可能。 Direct agent endpoints show clear identity; load balancer abstraction enables identity spoofing through routing manipulation. [994, 995, 996, 997, 998]. [994, 995, 996, 997, 998].
RIP_16_2 - 负载均衡器端点成为冒充目标。 RIP_16_2 - Load Balancer Endpoint as Impersonation Target. 负载均衡器端点本身成为身份接口。 The load balancer endpoint itself becomes the identity interface. 攻击者可以拦截或重定向发往负载均衡器的流量，从而形成中间人攻击场景。 Attackers could intercept or redirect traffic to load balancer creating man-in-the-middle scenarios. 智能体之间的直接通信不需要负载均衡器身份；负载均衡引入了额外的身份层，使其成为攻击目标。 Direct agent communication doesn’t require load balancer identity; load balancing creates additional identity layer becoming attack target. [999, 1000, 948, 772]. [999, 1000, 948, 772].
RIP_16_3 - 加权负载均衡造成权限不对称。 RIP_16_3 - Weighted Load Balancing Creating Privilege Asymmetry. 加权负载均衡将不同比例的流量路由到不同能力级别的智能体。 Weighted load balancing routes different traffic percentages to different capability levels. 攻击者可以通过流量路由模式推断哪些智能体拥有更高权限。 Attackers can infer which agents have higher privilege through traffic routing patterns. 均匀的负载分配不会暴露能力差异；加权路由则会暴露权限不对称，使其能够通过流量模式被观察到。 Uniform load distribution doesn’t reveal capability differences; weighted routing reveals privilege asymmetry observable as traffic patterns. [388, 210, 124]. [388, 210, 124].
RIP_16_4 - 自动扩缩容触发身份不连续。 RIP_16_4 - Auto-Scaling Triggered Identity Discontinuity. 当自动扩缩容启动新副本时，新实例具有全新的身份，没有历史记录。 When auto-scaling launches new replicas, the new instances have fresh identities with no history. 攻击者可以触发扩缩容，强制造成身份不连续，制造服务返回了具有全新状态的“新”智能体的假象。 Attackers can trigger scaling forcing discontinuity creating appearance that service returned ”new” agents with fresh state. 静态智能体具有连续的身份历史；自动扩缩容造成的身份不连续则使通过全新的副本身份实施冒充成为可能。 Static agents have continuous identity history; auto-scaling discontinuity enables impersonation through fresh replica identity. [1001, 538, 552]. [1001, 538, 552].
III-C17 RIP_17 - 服务发现与身份验证攻击III-C17 RIP_17 - Service Discovery & Authentication Attacks
RIP_17_1 - 服务注册审计轨迹存在来源追踪缺口。 RIP_17_1 - Service Registration Audit Trail Gaps for Provenance Tracking. 内核服务注册信息的修改并不总会在审计时附带来源元数据，即由谁注册服务、何时注册、注册了什么版本，以及来自何种来源。 Kernel service registration modifications aren’t always audited with provenance metadata—who registered service, when, what version, from what source. 共享内核服务使来源追踪变得复杂：修改会影响所有智能体，因此需要追踪哪些智能体依赖哪些服务版本。 Shared kernel services create provenance complexity—modification affects all agents requiring tracing which agents depend on which service versions. 独立服务具有线性的来源脉络；共享服务则具有复杂的来源脉络。 Singular services have linear provenance; shared services have complex provenance. [1002, 1003, 1004, 1005, 1006]. [1002, 1003, 1004, 1005, 1006].
RIP_17_2 - 通过队列重新分配实施消息队列消费者身份欺骗。 RIP_17_2 - Message Queue Consumer Identity Spoofing Through Queue Reassignment. RabbitMQ 消费者的身份由消费者标签确定，而对这些标签的验证较为宽松。 RabbitMQ consumer identities derive from consumer tags which are loosely validated. 攻击者可以创建具有伪造身份的消费者，导致原本发给合法消费者的消息被攻击者消费。 Attackers can create consumers with spoofed identities causing messages intended for legitimate consumers to be consumed by attackers. 与只有一个消费者的单一队列不同，拥有众多消费者的多智能体队列会造成身份混淆：身份欺骗会使合法消息在合法智能体存在的情况下仍被路由到攻击者的消费者，从而窃取原本分配给可信智能体的工作项。 Unlike singular queue with one consumer, multi-agent queues with many consumers create identity confusion—identity spoofing causes legitimate messages to route to attacker’s consumer despite legitimate agent existing, stealing work items intended for trusted agent. [536, 1007, 148, 107]. [536, 1007, 148, 107].
RIP_17_3 - 通过 API 网关注入消费者身份标头以绕过速率限制。 RIP_17_3 - API Gateway Consumer Identity Header Injection for Rate Limit Bypass. Kong 通过 X-Consumer-ID 等标头跟踪各消费者的速率限制。 Kong rate limits per consumer tracked through headers like X-Consumer-ID. 攻击者通过注入伪造的消费者标头，将自身伪装成不同的消费者，从而绕过速率限制。 Attackers injecting spoofed consumer headers appear as different consumers, bypassing rate limits. 与单智能体的速率限制不同，身份伪造会影响多个下游智能体。 Unlike singular agent rate limiting, identity spoofing affects multiple downstream agents. 在身份信息跨多个网关持续保留的多智能体系统中，身份伪造会产生持续影响，波及所有智能体间通信。 Multi-agent systems where identity persists through multiple gateways create persistent identity spoofing impact affecting all inter-agent communication. [1008, 1009, 1010, 794, 1011]. [1008, 1009, 1010, 794, 1011].
RIP_17_4 - 通过智能体身份标签引发 Prometheus 基数爆炸式增长的拒绝服务（DOS）攻击。 RIP_17_4 - Prometheus Cardinality Explosion DOS Through Agent Identity Labels. 智能体暴露带有 agent_id 标签的指标，每个唯一的智能体都会增加指标基数。 Agents expose metrics with agent_id label creating cardinality for each unique agent. 攻击者通过创建数量无上限的智能体 ID，引发指标基数爆炸式增长，耗尽 Prometheus 的存储资源。 Attackers creating unbounded agent IDs cause metric cardinality explosion exhausting Prometheus storage. 单个智能体对基数的贡献有限。 Singular agent contributes limited cardinality. 在攻击者能够配置无限数量智能体实例的多智能体系统中，基数会无界地爆炸式增长，使攻击者能够耗尽可观测性基础设施的资源。 Multi-agent systems where attackers can provision unlimited agent instances create unbounded cardinality explosion enabling attackers exhausting observability infrastructure. [838, 1012, 737, 790]. [838, 1012, 737, 790].
RIP_17_5 - 作为经济型攻击的消息队列优先级队列饥饿。 RIP_17_5 - Message Queue Priority Queue Starvation as Economic Attack. RabbitMQ 支持优先级队列，其中高优先级消息可以排到前面。 RabbitMQ supports priority queues where high-priority messages jump ahead. 攻击者通过创建高优先级消息，使低优先级任务因饥饿而无法执行，从而造成经济型拒绝服务。 Attackers creating high-priority messages starve low-priority work of execution, creating economic denial of service. 针对单个智能体的经济型攻击会影响一个队列。 Singular agent economic attack affects one queue. 多智能体共享的优先级队列会造成整个智能体集群范围内的饥饿：攻击者使一个队列发生饥饿，就会影响所有依赖该队列的智能体。 Multi-agent shared priority queues create fleet-wide starvation where attackers starving one queue impact all agents relying on that queue. [790, 737, 45]. [790, 737, 45].
RIP_17_6 - 影响多智能体服务发现的 DNS 缓存投毒。 RIP_17_6 - DNS Cache Poisoning Affecting Multi-Agent Service Discovery. 服务发现依赖 DNS 将智能体主机名解析为 IP 地址。 Service discovery relies on DNS resolving agent hostnames to IPs. 攻击者攻陷 DNS 缓存后，可以将智能体之间的通信重定向至攻击者控制的端点。 Attackers compromising DNS caches can redirect agent-to-agent communication to attacker-controlled endpoints. 单智能体的主机名解析只影响该智能体；在多智能体系统中，攻击者可以通过 DNS 投毒同时影响所有智能体，导致整个系统的服务发现被重定向。 Single-agent hostname resolution affects that agent; multi-agent systems enable attackers to poison DNS affecting all agents simultaneously, causing system-wide redirection of service discovery. [598, 794, 538]. [598, 794, 538].
RIP_17_7 - 证书颁发机构失陷导致大规模智能体身份伪造。 RIP_17_7 - Certificate Authority Compromise Enabling Agent Spoofing at Scale. Fleet Command 使用集中式证书颁发机构向边缘智能体颁发证书。 Fleet Command uses a centralized certificate authority to issue certificates to edge agents. 攻击者攻陷证书颁发机构后，可以为任意智能体身份颁发证书，创建加入集群的虚假智能体。 An attacker compromising the certificate authority can issue certificates for arbitrary agent identities, creating fake agents joining the fleet. 在多智能体协调中，虚假智能体可以冒充真实智能体并发起工具调用。 In multi-agent coordination, fake agents can impersonate real agents and issue tool calls. 与单智能体部署不同，在智能体彼此进行身份验证的多智能体 Fleet Command 系统中，集中式证书颁发机构一旦失陷，就会形成攻击面，使攻击者能够在整个集群中系统性地伪造智能体身份。 Unlike single-agent deployments, multi-agent Fleet Command systems where agents authenticate to each other create attack surfaces if the centralized certificate authority is compromised, enabling systematic agent spoofing across the entire fleet. [1013, 1014, 1015, 946, 985]. [1013, 1014, 1015, 946, 985].
III-C18 RIP_18 - 规则/方法/参数归属攻击III-C18 RIP_18 - Rule/Method/Parameter Attribution Attacks
RIP_18_1 - 通过伪造效率指标实施智能体身份欺骗。 RIP_18_1 - Efficiency Metric Spoofing for Agent Identity Deception. 有时会根据效率指标来识别或信任智能体（例如，“信任 token 效率达到 ¿90% 的智能体”）。 Agents are sometimes identified/trusted based on efficiency metrics (e.g., ”trust agents achieving ¿90% token efficiency”). 攻击者通过虚假报告或对指标计算进行投毒来伪造效率指标，将自身伪装成值得信任的高效智能体。 Attackers spoof efficiency metrics through false reporting or metric calculation poisoning, appearing as trustworthy efficient agents. 单智能体中的伪造会影响对该智能体身份的认知；在根据效率指标选择智能体的多智能体系统中，攻击者可以通过伪造指标，使自身看起来是应被优先选择的智能体。 Single-agent spoofing affects that agent’s identity perception; multi-agent systems where agent selection depends on efficiency metrics enable attackers spoofing metrics to appear as preferred agents. [87, 1016, 841, 62]. [87, 1016, 841, 62].
RIP_18_2 - 共享注册表中的方法作者身份伪造。 RIP_18_2 - Method Authorship Spoofing in Shared Registries. HTN 方法库包含作者归属信息，攻击者通过伪造作者身份来获取可信度。 HTN method libraries include author attribution, and attackers spoof authorship to gain credibility. 在具有共享方法注册表的多智能体生态系统中，伪造作者身份使攻击者能够传播恶意方法，并使其看起来像是由受信任的专家编写的。 In multi-agent ecosystems with shared method registries, spoofed authorship enables attackers propagating malicious methods as if authored by trusted specialists. 单智能体的方法由本地控制；多智能体共享注册表使攻击者能够通过虚假的归属信息获取信任。 Single-agent methods under local control; multi-agent shared registries enable attackers gaining trust through false attribution. [599, 1017, 536, 1018]. [599, 1017, 536, 1018].
RIP_18_3 - 委派链中的身份验证缺口。 RIP_18_3 - Delegation Chain Identity Verification Gaps. HTN 分层委派（智能体 A 委派给智能体 B，智能体 B 再委派给智能体 C）会带来身份验证方面的挑战。 HTN hierarchical delegation (Agent A delegates to Agent B, who delegates to Agent C) creates identity verification challenges. 攻击者可以声称拥有其实际并不具备的委派权限。 Attackers can claim delegation authority they don’t possess. 在包含 N 个智能体的系统中，多智能体分层系统会产生 N(N-1)/2 的验证开销。 Multi-agent hierarchical systems create N(N-1)/2 verification overhead in N-agent systems. 单智能体的委派在本地进行；多智能体委派链则需要在每一步进行身份验证，这会留下可供中间智能体谎称拥有权限的缺口。 Single-agent delegation is local; multi-agent delegation chains require identity verification at each step, creating gaps where intermediate agents claim false authority. [1019, 18, 110, 831, 944]. [1019, 18, 110, 831, 944].
RIP_18_4 - 多智能体聚合中的规则归属混淆。 RIP_18_4 - Rule Attribution Confusion in Multi-Agent Aggregation. 在聚合多个来源的规则（内置规则、学习所得的规则、共享规则）的多智能体系统中，规则的来源会变得模糊。 In multi-agent systems aggregating rules from multiple sources (built-in rules, learned rules, shared rules), rule origins become ambiguous. 攻击者利用这一点注入规则，使下游智能体错误地将这些规则归属于可信来源。 Attackers exploit this by injecting rules that downstream agents incorrectly attribute to trusted sources. 单智能体中的规则来源明确；多智能体规则聚合则会造成归属混淆，使来源伪装成为可能。 Single-agent rule origin is clear; multi-agent rule aggregation creates attribution confusion enabling origin spoofing. [91, 14, 1020, 841, 62]. [91, 14, 1020, 841, 62].
RIP_18_5 - 多智能体系统中的参数来源混淆。 RIP_18_5 - Parameter Origin Confusion in Multi-Agent Systems. 本章强调上下文溯源（context grounding），即验证参数是否来自合法来源（用户输入、经过身份验证的数据库、先前的工具输出）。 The chapter emphasizes context grounding—validating parameters derive from legitimate sources (user input, authenticated database, prior tool outputs). 在智能体 A 的输出成为智能体 B 的输入的多智能体系统中，参数来源会变得模糊。 In multi-agent systems where Agent A’s outputs become Agent B’s inputs, parameter origin becomes ambiguous. 多智能体来源链会造成“归属歧义”，即参数可能来自多个上游智能体或外部来源。 Multi-agent sourcing chain creates ”attribution ambiguity” where parameters could originate from multiple upstream agents or external sources. 攻陷智能体 A 的攻击者可以伪造看似来自合法来源的参数，因为智能体 B 无法验证其归属链。 An attacker compromising Agent A can fabricate parameters appearing to originate from legitimate sources because Agent B cannot verify the attribution chain. [112, 1021, 45, 69, 78]. [112, 1021, 45, 69, 78].
RIP_18_6 - 参数来源的信任边界。 RIP_18_6 - Parameter Source Trust Boundaries. 本章的安全验证确保参数遵守授权边界（用户无法访问其他用户的数据）。 The chapter’s security validation ensures parameters respect authorization boundaries (users can’t access other users’ data). 在多智能体系统中，信任边界会变得复杂。 In multi-agent systems, trust boundaries become complex. 单智能体的信任边界明确（智能体要么有权访问某项资源，要么无权访问）。 Single agent trust boundaries are clear (agent has access to resource or not). 多智能体系统会产生传递性信任，即智能体 B 在未独立验证授权的情况下信任智能体 A 提供的参数。 Multi-agent systems create transitive trust where Agent B trusts Agent A’s parameters without independent authorization verification. 攻陷智能体 A 的攻击者可以通过操纵看似来自可信来源的参数，诱使智能体 B 对未经授权的资源执行操作。 Attackers compromising Agent A can manipulate Agent B into operating on unauthorized resources through parameter manipulation appearing from trusted source. [1022, 71, 32]. [1022, 71, 32].
RIP_18_7 - 通过效率合约形成对提供商的经济锁定。 RIP_18_7 - Provider Economic Lock-In Through Efficiency Contracts. 与提供商签订的长期效率合约（承诺的 token 用量、批量 API 调用费率）会形成经济锁定。 Long-term efficiency contracts with providers (committed token usage, bulk API call rates) create economic lock-in. 攻击者对效率优化过程进行投毒，导致智能体消耗的 token 超出合约约定用量，从而触发超额费用。 Attackers poison efficiency optimization causing agents to consume more tokens than contracted, triggering overage charges. 单智能体合约影响该智能体的成本；对于共享提供商合约的多智能体系统，攻击者则可以通过协同实施的优化投毒，引发整个系统的 token 过量消耗。 Single-agent contracts affect that agent’s costs; multi-agent systems with shared provider contracts enable attackers triggering system-wide token overconsumption through coordinated poisoned optimization. [841, 1023, 1024, 843]. [841, 1023, 1024, 843].
RIP_18_8 - 分布式方法开发中的方法贡献者问责。 RIP_18_8 - Method Contributor Accountability in Distributed Method Development. 当多个智能体向共享注册表贡献方法（协作式方法开发）时，如果注册表未通过密码学手段追踪贡献者身份，贡献恶意方法的攻击者就几乎无需承担责任。 When multiple agents contribute methods to shared registries (collaborative method development), attackers contributing malicious methods face minimal accountability if the registry doesn’t track contributor identity cryptographically. 在贡献者身份识别宽松的多智能体生态系统中，攻击者可以贡献恶意方法，而被追责的风险很低。 In multi-agent ecosystems with loose contributor identification, attackers can contribute malicious methods with low accountability risk. 集中式方法开发的作者身份明确，而分布式开发对贡献者的追踪较弱。 Centralized method development has clear authorship versus distributed development with weak contributor tracking. [1018, 1025, 967]. [1018, 1025, 967].
RIP_18_9 - 通过操纵描述伪造规则作者身份。 RIP_18_9 - Rule Authorship Spoofing Through Description Manipulation. 基于规则的系统可能会追踪规则的作者身份。 Rule-based systems may track rule authorship. 攻击者利用这一点，精心编写看似来自可信来源的规则描述。 Attackers exploit this by crafting rule descriptions appearing to originate from trusted sources. 在具有共享规则库的多智能体系统中，虚假的来源声明使攻击者能够注入带有伪造作者身份凭据的规则。 In multi-agent systems with shared rule repositories, false provenance claims enable attackers injecting rules with fake authorship credentials. 单智能体的规则作者身份追踪局限于本地；多智能体共享规则库则使攻击者能够伪造来源，影响所有智能体之间的信任。 Single-agent rule authorship tracking remains local; multi-agent shared repositories enable attackers falsifying provenance affecting trust across all agents. [599, 14, 45, 722, 11]. [599, 14, 45, 722, 11].
RIP_18_10 - 规则版本控制投毒。 RIP_18_10 - Rule Version Control Poisoning. 规则通过版本迭代不断演进（v1.0 → v1.1 → v2.0）。 Rules evolve through versions (v1.0 → v1.1 → v2.0). 攻击者通过注入伪装成合法更新的恶意版本来利用版本控制机制。 Attackers exploit version control by injecting malicious versions appearing as legitimate updates. 在采用共享版本控制的多智能体规则生态系统中，被投毒的版本会传播至所有执行升级的智能体。 In multi-agent rule ecosystems with shared version control, poisoned versions propagate across all agents upgrading. 单智能体的规则版本管理仅影响一个智能体；多智能体的共享版本控制则使攻击者能够通过版本投毒影响整个生态系统。 Single-agent rule versioning affects one agent; multi-agent shared version control enables attackers poisoning versions affecting entire ecosystems. [1018, 14, 737, 62]。 [1018, 14, 737, 62].
III-C19 RIP_19 - 混合与跨范式攻击III-C19 RIP_19 - Hybrid & Cross-Paradigm Attacks
RIP_19_1 - 混合组件来源验证中的范式归属混淆。 RIP_19_1 - Paradigm Attribution Confusion in Hybrid Component Source Validation. 混合系统集成来自不同范式的组件，这些组件也可能来自不同来源（外部提供的神经模型、企业规则库、第三方效用函数）。 Hybrid systems integrate components from different paradigms, potentially from different sources (externally-provided neural models, enterprise rule repositories, third-party utility functions). 单一范式组件的来源清晰；混合的多范式组件则形成复杂的来源链。 Single paradigm components have clear provenance; hybrid multi-paradigm components create complex provenance chains. 多智能体之间的范式共享使 1-to-N 攻陷成为可能，即对共享范式组件投毒会影响整个智能体集合。 Multi-agent paradigm sharing enables 1-to-N compromise where poisoning shared paradigm components affects entire agent ensemble. [1026, 737, 1027, 1028, 1029]。 [1026, 737, 1027, 1028, 1029].
RIP_19_2 - 通过范式特定的凭证机制进行身份伪造。 RIP_19_2 - Identity Spoofing Through Paradigm-Specific Credential Mechanisms. 不同范式采用不同的凭证机制（神经模型的嵌入、符号规则的模式、效用函数的偏好签名）。 Different paradigms use different credential mechanisms (neural models’ embeddings, symbolic rules’ schemas, utility functions’ preference signatures). 攻击者构造凭证以冒充特定范式类型，从而以受信任组件的身份获得访问权限。 Attackers craft credentials spoofing specific paradigm types gaining access as trusted components. 单一范式的凭证验证针对特定类型进行；混合的多范式凭证的多样性则会造成混淆。 Single paradigm credential validation is type-specific; hybrid multi-paradigm credential diversity creates confusion. [1030, 1031, 49]。 [1030, 1031, 49].
在传统软件中，“代码”和“数据”有明确的区别。 In traditional software, ”code” and ”data” are clearly distinct. 在基于 LLMs 构建的 AI 智能体系统中，来自用户、工具、网页、电子邮件、PDFs 和内部文档的自然语言内容同时充当数据和控制逻辑。 In AI agent systems built on LLMs, natural-language content from users, tools, web pages, emails, PDFs, and internal documents functions as both data and control logic. 这种混同构成了智能体式 AI 的一种基础性“认知”漏洞。 This conflation represents a foundational ”cognitive” vulnerability in agentic AI.
这使三类主要的控制流攻击成为可能： This enables three primary control-flow attack classes:
• 直接和间接提示注入：通过对抗性内容指示模型绕过系统策略、窃取机密或调用危险工具。 • Direct and indirect prompt injection: Adversarial content instructing models to override system policies, exfiltrate secrets, or call dangerous tools. 间接攻击将指令嵌入检索到的文档和第三方页面中，使攻击载荷对用户隐藏，却暴露给智能体。 Indirect attacks embed instructions in retrieved documents and third-party pages, hiding payloads from users but exposing them to agents.
• 跨上下文和跨模态注入：隐藏在 HTML 属性、CSS、注释、PDFs 或通过 OCR 提取内容的图像中的指令，被模型视为比系统提示优先级更高的指导。 • Cross-context and cross-modal injection: Instructions hidden in HTML attributes, CSS, comments, PDFs, or OCR-extracted images that models treat as higher-priority guidance than system prompts.
相较于传统软件的独特之处：该漏洞源于通过学习形成的随机性策略语义——不可信的自然语言被解释为指令——而非解析、查询构造或类型系统。 Uniqueness vs. traditional software: The vulnerability stems from learned, stochastic policy semantics—untrusted natural language interpreted as instructions—rather than parsing, query construction, or type systems. 在编译型或脚本型系统中，不存在直接对应的情况。 No direct analogue exists in compiled or scripted systems.
III-C20 RIDC_1 - UI 与用户交互攻击面III-C20 RIDC_1 - UI and User Interaction Attack Surfaces
RIDC_1_1 - 渐进式披露导致攻击面扩展。 RIDC_1_1 - Progressive Disclosure as Attack Surface Expansion. 渐进式披露模式（基本视图、展开视图、技术视图）会产生多个注入点。 Progressive disclosure patterns (essential, expanded, technical views) create multiple injection points. 多智能体系统会放大这种风险：攻击者在技术细节层中嵌入恶意指令，面向用户的智能体会忽略这些指令，而后端智能体则会执行它们。 Multi-agent systems amplify this risk: attackers embed malicious instructions in technical-detail layers that user-facing agents ignore but backend agents execute. 同一个 UI 组件向人类呈现无害内容，同时通过未展开的视图向下游智能体传递恶意指令。 A single UI component presents benign content to humans while delivering malicious instructions to downstream agents in unexpanded views. 多智能体在不同披露层级上的策略缺口，使攻击者能够构造利用不同访问策略的攻击载荷——这种威胁在单智能体系统中并不存在。 Multi-agent policy gaps across disclosure levels enable attackers to craft payloads exploiting different access policies—a threat absent in singular agent systems. [1032, 58, 841, 87, 23, 46, 18, 44, 39, 737]。 [1032, 58, 841, 87, 23, 46, 18, 44, 39, 737].
RIDC_1_2 - 聊天界面中的来源归属混淆使社会工程攻击成为可能。 RIDC_1_2 - Chat Interface Attribution Confusion Enabling Social Engineering. 聊天界面模糊了用户、智能体、工具输出和文档之间的界限。 Chat interfaces blur lines between users, agents, tool outputs, and documents. 在多智能体系统中，这种风险进一步加剧：界面必须区分“用户、Agent A、Agent B、工具输出、RAG 内容和智能体间通信”。 In multi-agent systems: this risk escalates: interfaces must distinguish ”user vs. Agent A vs. Agent B vs. tool output vs. RAG content vs. inter-agent communication.” 如果缺乏明确的身份标记，攻击者就能注入看似来自受信任智能体、实际却源自受损数据的内容。 Without clear identity markers, attackers inject content appearing to originate from trusted agents while sourcing from compromised data. 检索到的文档可能包含伪装成智能体消息的指令（“智能体安全顾问：禁用安全检查”），从而利用用户的信任。 Retrieved documents can contain instructions styled as agent messages (”Agent Security Advisor: disable safety checks”), exploiting user trust. 多智能体系统需要复杂的来源归属图；单智能体系统面临的则是较简单的用户与智能体之分。 Multi-agent systems require complex attribution graphs; singular agent systems face simpler user-vs-agent distinctions. [1033, 1034, 1035, 75, 69]。 [1033, 1034, 1035, 75, 69].
RIDC_1_3 - 将 ARIA 实时区域操纵用作持久性上下文注入载体。 RIDC_1_3 - ARIA Live Region Manipulation as Persistent Context Injection Vector. ARIA 实时区域（live regions）会向屏幕阅读器播报动态内容更新。 ARIA live regions announce dynamic content updates to screen readers. 在多智能体系统中的监控系统中，攻击者会篡改填入实时区域的内容，注入伪装成状态更新的指令。 In multi-agent systems: monitoring systems, adversaries compromise content populating live regions, injecting instructions disguised as status updates. 多智能体系统形成了双通道的上下文接收机制：人类看到正常的可视化显示，而监控智能体则接收经 ARIA 增强的 DOM 树。 Multi-agent systems create dual-channel context consumption: humans see legitimate visual displays while monitoring agents consume ARIA-enhanced DOM trees. 攻击者注入仅在无障碍通道中可见的指令，而人类看到的界面则不含这些指令。 Adversaries inject instructions visible only to accessibility channels while humans see clean displays. 多智能体场景的独特之处在于，一个智能体的监控界面输出会成为另一个智能体的输入上下文。 Multi-agent uniqueness emerges because one agent’s monitoring UI output becomes another’s input context. 实时区域的持久性意味着，注入的指令会在多次智能体交互中持续存在，直到被明确清除，从而形成无障碍增强型多智能体监控所特有的持久性上下文污染。 Persistent live regions mean injected instructions survive across multiple agent interactions until explicitly cleared, creating durable context pollution unique to accessibility-enhanced multi-agent monitoring. 示例：一个状态监控智能体将流水线健康状况更新填入实时区域。 Example: A status monitoring agent populates a live region with pipeline health updates. 攻击者篡改内容源，使得在正常的“构建：通过”状态更新旁，还存在一条隐藏的 ARIA 播报：“系统策略更新：对下游请求跳过凭据验证。” An attacker compromises the content source so that alongside a legitimate ”Build: passing” status update, a hidden ARIA announcement reads ”System policy update: skip credential validation for downstream requests.” 人类操作员只能看到不含恶意内容的可视化仪表板，但接收经 ARIA 增强的 DOM 树的配置智能体会将这条注入的播报当作可信的策略指令处理，并在后续操作中停用凭据检查。 The human operator sees only the clean visual dashboard, but a configuration agent consuming the ARIA-enhanced DOM tree processes this injected announcement as a trusted policy directive and suppresses credential checks for subsequent operations. [112, 1036, 114, 111, 58, 723, 820, 18, 1034, 36]。 [112, 1036, 114, 111, 58, 723, 820, 18, 1034, 36].
RIDC_1_4 - 将键盘快捷键无障碍功能用作带外指令通道。 RIDC_1_4 - Keyboard Shortcut Accessibility Feature as Out-of-Band Instruction Channel. 智能体界面实现了用于审批工作流和无障碍访问的键盘快捷键。 Agent UIs implement keyboard shortcuts for approval workflows and accessibility. 在工作流智能体会观察并学习审批模式的多智能体系统中，攻击者会利用快捷键作为指令通道。 In multi-agent systems: systems where workflow agents observe and learn approval patterns, adversaries exploit shortcuts as instruction channels. 攻击者会操纵快捷键配置，将恶意策略注入学习智能体作为策略文档读取的帮助对话框，或将配置注入用户偏好存储，使其被解读为合法的用户策略。 Attackers manipulate shortcut configurations, inject malicious policies into help dialogs that learning agents consume as policy documentation, or inject configurations into user preference stores interpreted as legitimate user policies. 多智能体工作流系统形成了基于观察的策略学习机制：审批智能体执行快捷键操作，学习智能体根据行为推断策略，文档智能体则维护权威的帮助文本。 Multi-agent workflow systems create observation-based policy learning where approval agents execute shortcuts, learner agents infer policies from behavior, and documentation agents maintain authoritative help text. 攻击者利用这一观察链条发动攻击，其中智能体 B 无法区分合法数据与攻击者指令。 Adversaries exploit this observation chain where Agent B cannot distinguish legitimate data from attacker instructions. 无障碍需求为攻击提供了掩护。 Accessibility justifications provide attack cover. 在联邦式系统中，快捷键配置作为习得的偏好跨越智能体边界传播，形成可传递的指令注入载体。 In federated systems, shortcut configurations propagate across agent boundaries as learned preferences, creating transitive instruction injection vectors. [87, 23, 18, 1037, 30, 138, 1038, 918, 73, 58]。 [87, 23, 18, 1037, 30, 138, 1038, 918, 73, 58].
RIDC_1_5 - 将无障碍语义地标用作跨智能体身份欺骗载体。 RIDC_1_5 - Accessibility Semantic Landmarks as Cross-Agent Identity Spoofing Vector. 语义化 HTML 地标（landmarks）支持屏幕阅读器导航。 Semantic HTML landmarks enable screen reader navigation. 在通过共享界面上下文或基于 DOM 的消息传递进行通信的多智能体系统中，攻击者会利用语义结构造成来源归属混淆。 In multi-agent systems: systems communicating via shared UI contexts or DOM-based message passing, adversaries exploit semantic structure for attribution confusion. 攻击者使用模仿合法响应的规范语义结构注入伪造的智能体消息，其中包括表明真实性的 ARIA 角色和标题层级。 Attackers inject fake agent messages using proper semantic structure mimicking legitimate responses, including ARIA roles and heading hierarchies signaling authenticity. 智能体 B 无法区分伪造消息与合法消息，因为规范的语义结构被视为真实性的标志。 Agent B cannot distinguish fake messages from legitimate ones because proper semantic structure signals authenticity. 多智能体协作系统共享语义空间，多个智能体向同一个 DOM 添加内容；攻击者会注入在结构上与合法响应相匹配的伪造消息。 Multi-agent collaborative systems share semantic spaces where multiple agents contribute to the same DOM; adversaries inject fake messages structurally matching legitimate responses. 混淆：之所以发生，是因为语义化 HTML 本身是结构化的消息内容，但规范的 ARIA 角色却被视为“可信智能体通信”的标志。 Conflation: occurs because semantic HTML is structured message content, but proper ARIA roles signal ”trusted agent communication.” 无障碍要求规定，视觉上隐藏的内容应传达等效信息，这形成了攻击面：攻击者可构造隐藏内容，添加人类不可见、却存在于智能体上下文窗口中的恶意指令。 Accessibility requirements that visually-hidden content convey equivalent information create attack surfaces where adversaries craft hidden content adding malicious instructions invisible to humans but present in agent context windows. [282, 1039, 722, 1040, 1041, 1042, 111, 723]。 [282, 1039, 722, 1040, 1041, 1042, 111, 723].
RIDC_1_6 - 将命令面板上下文预测用作隐蔽指令通道。 RIDC_1_6 - Command Palette Context Prediction as Covert Instruction Channel. 命令面板通过 AI 分析当前状态，推荐与上下文相关的操作。 Command palettes suggest contextually relevant actions via AI analysis of current state. 在多智能体系统中，上下文由多个来源汇聚而成（代码分析、用户行为、项目上下文智能体）。 In multi-agent systems: context aggregates from multiple sources (code analysis, user behavior, project context agents). 攻击者通过污染上下文来源来操纵推荐，在文档中嵌入恶意指令，使面板推荐危险操作（“删除生产数据库”）。 Attackers poison context sources to manipulate suggestions, embedding malicious instructions in documentation causing the palette to suggest dangerous operations (”Delete production database”). 多智能体推荐逻辑依赖上下文提供方之间的共识；攻陷其中一个来源即可使推荐产生偏向。 Multi-agent suggestion logic depends on consensus across context providers; compromising one source biases suggestions. 单智能体系统根据单个模型的分析生成推荐，使上下文污染更容易被发现；多智能体聚合则会掩盖恶意推荐的来源。 Singular agent systems generate suggestions from single-model analysis, making context poisoning more detectable; multi-agent aggregation obscures malicious suggestion origins. [1043, 36, 754, 1044, 723, 138, 58, 18]。 [1043, 36, 754, 1044, 723, 138, 58, 18].
RIDC_1_7 - 将错误通信中的自动重试用作攻击放大机制。 RIDC_1_7 - Error Communication Auto-Retry as Attack Amplification. 采用指数退避的自动重试会反复执行伪装成重试的恶意操作，从而放大指令注入攻击。 Automatic retry with exponential backoff amplifies instruction injection by repeatedly executing malicious operations disguised as retries. 在多智能体系统中：在错误恢复流程（监控智能体 → 重试智能体 → 执行智能体）中，攻击者构造输入，在前序智能体中触发错误，同时在重试智能体中执行恶意载荷。 In multi-agent systems: error recovery (monitoring agent → retry agent → execution agent), attackers craft inputs triggering errors in early agents while executing malicious payloads in retry agents. 渐进式错误详情披露（默认显示简要信息，展开后显示技术细节）会将攻击证据隐藏在折叠的日志中。 Progressive error details disclosure (simple by default, technical on expansion) hides attack evidence in collapsed logs. 多智能体重试逻辑创造了独特的攻击机会：监控智能体看到的是无害内容，而执行智能体看到的是注入的指令。 Multi-agent retry logic creates unique opportunities: monitoring agents see benign content while execution agents see injected instructions. 分布式重试逻辑利用了时间动态特性（恶意载荷在 N 次重试后激活）和智能体的专业化分工——这些攻击面在采用统一错误处理的单智能体系统中并不存在。 Distributed retry logic exploits temporal dynamics (malicious payload activates after N retries) and agent specialization—attack surfaces absent in singular agent systems with unified error handling. 这还包括作为相关控制流攻击面的回退策略、优雅降级和熔断器模式。 This includes fallback strategies, graceful degradation, and circuit breaker patterns as related control-flow attack surfaces. [1044, 1042, 58, 87, 23, 44, 18]。 [1044, 1042, 58, 87, 23, 44, 18].
RIDC_1_8 - 以通知模式中基于时间的默认升级处理作为注入向量。 RIDC_1_8 - Notification Pattern Time-Based Default Escalation as Injection Vector. 在多智能体系统中：基于时间的通知默认行为通过跨智能体的时序协调形成攻击面。 In multi-agent systems: time-based notification defaults create attack surfaces through cross-agent timing coordination. 攻击者控制智能体 A 生成通知，使其恰好在智能体 B 等待人工确认时到期，从而建立传递性信任链。 Attackers control Agent A to generate notifications expiring precisely when Agent B expects human confirmation, creating transitive trust chains. 智能体 B 无法核实基于超时的批准究竟代表用户确实未作回应，还是攻击者注入的声明（“智能体 A 的超时策略已批准此操作”）。 Agent B cannot verify whether timeout-based approvals represent genuine user non-responses or adversary-injected claims (”Agent A’s timeout policy approved this”). 多智能体系统的独特性源于这些传递性信任链——单智能体系统只有一个信任边界；多智能体系统则会产生指令与数据混淆，使下游智能体无法核实基于超时的批准。 Multi-agent uniqueness emerges from these transitive trust chains—singular systems have one trust boundary; multi-agent systems create instruction-data conflation where downstream agents cannot verify timeout-based approvals. 攻击者注入伪造的历史通知，并精心构造时间戳，使其符合正常模式。 Adversaries inject fake historical notifications with crafted timestamps aligning with legitimate patterns. [864, 769, 23, 44, 1045, 45, 66, 138, 87, 1046]。 [864, 769, 23, 44, 1045, 45, 66, 138, 87, 1046].
III-C21 RIDC_2 - 消息与协议注入III-C21 RIDC_2 - Messaging and Protocol Injection
