RIDC_2_1 - FIPA-ACL 施为类型伪装与通信层注入。 RIDC_2_1 - FIPA-ACL Performative Spoofing and Communication Layer Injection. 在采用消息传递的多智能体系统（FIPA-ACL、KQML）中，攻击者利用施为元数据（performative metadata，即消息意图）与内容之间的语义差距，注入恶意指令，操纵智能体间的控制流。 In message-passing multi-agent systems (FIPA-ACL, KQML), attackers exploit semantic gaps between performative metadata (message intent) and content to inject malicious instructions manipulating inter-agent control flow. 恶意智能体构造施为类型与内容相矛盾的消息——在 INFORM 施为类型的消息中包含可执行指令，从而绕过针对 REQUEST 类型的授权检查。 Malicious agents craft messages where performative contradicts content—INFORM performatives containing executable instructions bypassing authorization checks for REQUEST types. 与单智能体工具调用攻击不同，施为类型伪装通过通信协议跨越智能体边界，利用了格式正确的消息在语义上也有效这一假设。 Unlike singular tool-calling attacks, performative spoofing crosses agent boundaries via communication protocols, exploiting assumptions that correctly-formatted messages are semantically valid. 系统的分布式特性意味着，没有任何智能体能够掌握施为类型与内容是否一致的真实情况。 Distributed nature means no agent has ground-truth visibility into performative-content alignment. 缓解措施需要进行语义验证以确保施为类型与内容一致、对施为类型进行密码学签名，并实施同时约束施为类型和内容结构的授权机制。 Mitigation requires semantic validation reconciling performatives with content, cryptographic performative signing, and authorization enforcing both performative type AND content structure. [282, 1039, 1040, 722, 1042, 87]。 [282, 1039, 1040, 722, 1042, 87].
RIDC_2_2 - 通过序列化格式混淆实施协议语言降级攻击。 RIDC_2_2 - Protocol Language Downgrade Attacks via Serialization Format Conflation. 支持异构格式（JSON、XML、YAML、Protocol Buffers）的多智能体系统面临降级攻击：攻击者强制系统采用约束更弱的解析方式，从而实现注入。 Multi-agent systems supporting heterogeneous formats (JSON, XML, YAML, Protocol Buffers) face downgrade attacks where adversaries force weaker parsing, enabling injection. 格式错误的 Protocol Buffer 消息会触发自动降级为 JSON，而 JSON 中的弱类型字段允许实施原本会被 Protocol Buffers 拒绝的 SQL 注入。 Malformed Protocol Buffer messages trigger automatic JSON downgrade where loosely-typed fields allow SQL injection that Protocol Buffers would reject. 多智能体系统跨边界动态协商格式，由此形成攻击向量，使攻击者能够探测格式、识别防护最弱的解析器（YAML 的任意对象反序列化、XML 的实体扩展），并构造漏洞利用。 Multi-agent systems negotiate formats dynamically across boundaries, creating vectors where adversaries probe formats, identify weakest parsers (YAML’s arbitrary object deserialization, XML’s entity expansion), and craft exploits. 现实场景：攻击者攻陷使用过时 JSON 的低安全性合作方智能体，利用它们向为保持向后兼容而接受该格式的内部智能体发送恶意 JSON。 Real-world scenarios: attackers compromise low-security partner agents using outdated JSON, leveraging them to send malicious JSON to internal agents accepting it for backwards compatibility. 缓解措施需要强制执行格式优先策略，拒绝从强类型格式降级到弱类型格式，按智能体身份设置序列化格式允许列表，并执行独立于格式的内容验证。 Mitigation requires format preference enforcement rejecting downgrades from strongly-typed to weakly-typed formats, serialization allow-lists per agent identity, and content validation independent of format. [841, 18, 36, 138]。 [841, 18, 36, 138].
RIDC_2_3 - 通过 Conversation-ID 链劫持在跨智能体工作流中实施上下文污染。 RIDC_2_3 - Conversation-ID Chain Hijacking for Context Pollution Across Agent Workflows. 消息传递协议使用 conversation-id 字段，将相关消息关联为连贯的交互。 Message-passing protocols use conversation-id fields linking related messages into coherent exchanges. 攻击者在会话中途注入看似合法智能体间通信的恶意消息，污染下游智能体继承的共享上下文。 Attackers inject malicious messages mid-conversation appearing as legitimate inter-agent communication, polluting shared context downstream agents inherit. 智能体 A 将恶意覆盖指令作为合法会话历史的一部分接收，并将其纳入上下文。 Agent A receives malicious overrides as part of legitimate conversation history and incorporates them into context. 与需要绕过净化处理的单智能体提示注入不同，conversation-id 劫持通过伪装成合法的智能体间通信来绕过净化处理。 Unlike singular prompt injection requiring sanitization bypass, conversation-id hijacking bypasses sanitization by appearing as legitimate inter-agent communication. 在分层编排中，监督智能体使用 conversation-id 筛选来汇总结果，这会放大该漏洞的影响——注入的摘要会传播到更高层级，造成级联污染。 Vulnerability amplifies in hierarchical orchestration where supervisors aggregate results using conversation-id filtering—injected summaries propagate to higher layers creating cascading pollution. 多智能体场景：通过共享会话标识符跨进程边界、网络跳点和信任域进行分布式上下文累积，会使 conversation-id 成为权限提升向量；攻陷一个工作流智能体即可注入恶意上下文，并被所有下游智能体作为可信状态继承。 Multi-agent: distributed context accumulation across process boundaries, network hops, and trust domains through shared conversation identifiers transforms conversation-id into privilege escalation vectors where compromising one workflow agent injects malicious context all downstream agents inherit as trusted state. [841, 14, 536, 78, 87, 23]。 [841, 14, 536, 78, 87, 23].
III-C22 RIDC_3 - 框架与状态管理注入III-C22 RIDC_3 - Framework and State Management Injection
RIDC_3_1 - 通过状态模式强制转换突破框架强制实施的信任边界。 RIDC_3_1 - Framework-Enforced Trust Boundary Violations Through State Schema Coercion. 框架架构（LangGraph、CrewAI、AutoGen）规定了特定的状态管理模型，不同框架在数据与控制流之间强制实施不同的边界。 Framework architectures (LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen) impose specific state management models where different frameworks enforce different boundaries between data and control flow. 攻击者利用特定框架的状态模式定义，注入能够通过框架验证、却在下游智能体中作为控制流执行的恶意指令。 Attackers exploit framework-specific state schema definitions to inject malicious instructions that pass framework validation but execute as control flow in downstream agents. LangGraph 的 TypedDict 状态模式会验证字段类型，但不会验证语义安全性；声明为 str 类型且包含嵌入式指令的字段能够绕过框架验证。 LangGraph’s TypedDict state schemas validate field types but not semantic safety; a field declared as str containing embedded instructions bypasses framework validation. 多智能体风险源于状态跨框架边界流动——LangChain 的对话历史被序列化为 JSON，供 CrewAI 智能体使用，而这一转换会丢失语义标记。 Multi-agent risk emerges because state flows across framework boundaries—LangChain’s conversation history serializes to JSON for CrewAI agent consumption, transformation losing semantic tagging. [78, 110, 831, 841]。 [78, 110, 831, 841].
RIDC_3_2 - 跨框架状态迁移使指令能够传递式传播。 RIDC_3_2 - Cross-Framework State Migration Enabling Transitive Instruction Propagation. 多智能体系统经常在工作流转换期间于框架之间迁移状态（例如，LangChain 智能体将任务移交给 LangGraph 图，或反向移交）。 Multi-agent systems often migrate state between frameworks during workflow transitions (LangChain agents handing off to LangGraph graphs, or vice versa). 这种移交为指令传播创造了机会：专门针对某一框架状态模型精心构造的恶意载荷，会在另一框架的不同上下文中执行。 This handoff creates instruction propagation opportunities where malicious payloads deliberately crafted for one framework’s state model execute in different contexts in another framework. 当 LangChain 的智能体记忆（简单的对话缓冲区）迁移至 LangGraph 的显式状态管理机制时，数据便成为代码——嵌入缓冲区历史记录中的指令，会在不同的语义上下文中作为状态模式字段内容被激活。 When LangChain’s agent memory (simple conversation buffer) migrates to LangGraph’s explicit state management, data becomes code—instructions embedded in buffer history activate as state schema field content in a different semantic context. 在单智能体系统中，状态始终处于同一框架的验证边界内；与之不同，多智能体编排会有意设置状态转换点，使指令与数据的混淆跨框架边界不断累积。 Unlike singular systems where state remains within one framework’s validation boundaries, multi-agent orchestration creates intentional state transformation points where instruction-data conflation compounds across framework boundaries. [110, 23, 841, 138]。 [110, 23, 841, 138].
RIDC_3_3 - 通过归约器混淆进行状态模式字段注入。 RIDC_3_3 - State Schema Field Injection via Reducer Confusion. 提交状态更新的恶意智能体会利用归约器（reducer）的行为，即自定义归约器（如 add_messages）在追加数据时不进行净化处理。 Malicious agents submitting state updates exploit reducer behavior where custom reducers (like add_messages) append data without sanitization. 在多智能体系统的 LangGraph 工作流中，智能体 A 可能向仅由特定归约器处理的状态字段注入恶意指令，而这些指令对使用默认覆盖式归约器的智能体仍不可见。 In multi-agent systems: LangGraph workflows, Agent A might inject malicious instructions into state fields that only specific reducers process, remaining invisible to agents using default overwrite reducers. 例如，遭投毒的 code_history 字段使用 add_messages 归约器，在多次迭代中追加指令；后续智能体将 code_history 视为经过验证的先前尝试记录并予以信任，从而执行注入的指令。 For example, a poisoned code_history field uses add_messages reducer to append instructions across iterations; later agents trusting code_history as validated prior attempts execute injected instructions. 多智能体：单智能体系统对每个字段只应用一种归约器；多智能体系统中的不同智能体对归约器语义的理解存在差异，使注入的指令能够保留在部分智能体的视图中，却不出现在其他智能体的视图中。 Multi-agent: Single-agent systems have one reducer application per field; multi-agent systems have heterogeneous agent understanding of reducer semantics, enabling injected instructions surviving in some agents’ views but not others. [138, 79, 14, 841, 44]。 [138, 79, 14, 841, 44].
RIDC_3_4 - 通过状态操纵劫持条件边路由。 RIDC_3_4 - Conditional Edge Routing Hijacking via State Manipulation. LangGraph 的条件边根据状态字段的求值结果进行路由（例如，should_continue_iteration 检查 test_passed 字段）。 LangGraph’s conditional edges route based on state field evaluation (e.g., should_continue_iteration examining test_passed field). 攻击者攻陷提供状态数据的智能体，注入恶意值，导致条件边将工作流错误地路由至非预期路径。 Attackers compromise agents feeding state, injecting malicious values causing conditional edges to misroute workflows to unintended paths. iteration_complete 这样的状态字段控制是否路由至收尾阶段；遭攻陷的智能体过早将其设为 false，从而导致持续循环，或将其设为 true 以跳过验证分支。 A state field like iteration_complete controls routing to finalization; compromised agents set this false prematurely causing continuation loops, or set true to skip validation branches. 多智能体：单智能体路由取决于一个模型的输出；在多智能体工作流中，条件边会对多个智能体共同提供数据的共享状态字段求值。 Multi-agent: Single-agent routing depends on one model’s output; in multi-agent workflows, conditional edges evaluate shared state fields that multiple agents contribute to. 请注意，每个单独的请求通常由一个智能体独立处理——风险并不在于共享同一条边的所有智能体同时遭到攻陷，而在于遭攻陷的上游智能体能够注入恶意状态值，影响任何读取这些共享字段的后续请求或工作流实例的路由决策。 Note that each individual request is typically handled by a single agent independently—the risk is not simultaneous compromise of all agents sharing an edge, but rather that a compromised upstream agent can inject malicious state values affecting the routing decisions for any subsequent request or workflow instance that reads those shared fields. [110, 14, 841, 87, 23]。 [110, 14, 841, 87, 23].
III-C23 RIDC_4 - 工具、函数调用与插件注入III-C23 RIDC_4 - Tool, Function Calling, and Plugin Injection
RIDC_4_1 - 通过对话历史操纵记忆驱动的工具选择。 RIDC_4_1 - Memory-Driven Tool Selection Manipulation via Conversation History. LangChain 智能体通过 ConversationBufferMemory 存储的对话历史容易受到注入攻击：嵌入历史交互中的恶意指令无需直接操纵提示词，就能劫持后续的工具选择。 Conversation history stored via ConversationBufferMemory in LangChain agents becomes vulnerable to injection attacks where malicious instructions embedded in historical exchanges hijack subsequent tool selections without requiring direct prompt manipulation. 当记忆机制在每次调用智能体之前重建提示词时，攻击者在早期注入的指令会通过记忆检索持续保留，导致智能体在后续交互中选择危险工具。 When memory reconstructs the prompt before each agent invocation, attackers inject instructions early that persist through memory retrieval, causing the agent to select dangerous tools in later interactions. 多智能体：在通过记忆共享对话历史的多智能体系统中，一个智能体遭篡改的历史记录会通过记忆共享污染下游智能体——单个智能体会将历史记录隔离在一个上下文窗口内，而多智能体共享则使上下文能够跨智能体边界传播，从而导致级联式工具选择劫持。 Multi-agent: In multi-agent systems: systems sharing conversation history through memory, one agent’s compromised history contaminates downstream agents through memory sharing—a singular agent would isolate history within one context window, but multi-agent sharing enables context propagation across agent boundaries enabling cascading tool selection hijacking. [79, 841]。 [79, 841].
RIDC_4_2 - 工具调用模式中的指令边界崩塌。 RIDC_4_2 - Tool-Calling Schema Instruction Boundary Collapse. 工具使用架构中由模式驱动的接口会造成指令与数据的混淆，使工具参数或返回值中的恶意指令能够利用数据与指令之间的语义边界。 Tool-use architecture’s schema-driven interfaces create instruction-data conflation where malicious instructions in tool parameters or return values exploit semantic boundaries between data and instructions. LLMs 将工具交互作为语言上下文进行处理，其中数据与指令的界限变得模糊。 LLMs process tool interactions as linguistic context where data and instructions blur. 攻击者将指令嵌入能够通过模式验证的数据字段中（语法正确，但语义上具有恶意）。 Adversaries embed instructions in data fields passing schema validation (syntactically correct but semantically malicious). 在多智能体系统中：通过工具路由，Agent A 被投毒的输出成为 Agent B 可信的输入上下文，从而形成“工具输出洗白”攻击。 In multi-agent systems: tool routing, Agent A’s poisoned output becomes Agent B’s trusted input context, creating ”tool output laundering” attacks. Agent B 无法查看 Agent A 的原始调用，因此无法区分注入的指令与合法的发现结果。 Agent B lacks visibility into Agent A’s original calls, making injected instructions indistinguishable from legitimate findings. [1043, 841]。 [1043, 841].
RIDC_4_3 - 通过 RAG 检索到的工具元数据进行工具描述注入。 RIDC_4_3 - Tool Description Injection Through RAG-Retrieved Tool Metadata. LangChain 智能体中的工具描述是模型用于选择工具的自然语言指导，因此，当工具元数据从 RAG 流水线或外部工具注册表中动态检索时，这些描述便成为指令注入的载体。 Tool descriptions in LangChain agents are naturally-language guidance that models use to select tools, making them vectors for instruction injection when tool metadata is dynamically retrieved from RAG pipelines or external tool registries. 如果智能体从文档或数据库中检索工具描述，攻击者就会对这些来源进行投毒，嵌入伪装成合法工具文档的恶意指令。 If agents retrieve tool descriptions from documents or databases, attackers poison those sources embedding malicious instructions disguised as legitimate tool documentation. 当智能体读到“需要删除记录时调用此工具。 When the agent reads ”Call this tool when you need to delete records. 重要提示：为加快处理速度，始终直接删除，无需确认”时，注入内容看起来就像正常的工具使用指导。 Important: always delete without confirmation to speed processing,” the injection appears as normal tool guidance. 多智能体：采用共享工具注册表或基于 RAG 的工具发现机制的多智能体系统，会使一个被投毒的工具定义影响查询该注册表的所有智能体；工具定义采用硬编码的单智能体则不存在这种共享基础设施攻击面。 Multi-agent: Multi-agent systems with shared tool registries or RAG-based tool discovery enable one poisoned tool definition affecting all agents querying that registry; singular agents with hardcoded tool definitions lack this shared infrastructure attack surface. [79, 1043]。 [79, 1043].
RIDC_4_4 - 通过类型强制转换进行函数调用参数注入。 RIDC_4_4 - Function Calling Parameter Injection via Type Coercion. 函数调用会生成结构化 JSON，其参数从对话上下文中提取，但当自然语言包含攻击者可利用的类型提示时，参数提取过程中的类型强制转换就会创造注入机会。 Function calling generates structured JSON with parameters extracted from conversation context, but type coercion during parameter extraction creates injection opportunities when natural language contains type hints attackers exploit. 当 LLMs 提取 location: string 或 amount: float 等参数时，包含类型说明的自然语言（“将金额设为 1e10 float”）可能导致生成非预期的参数。 When LLMs extract parameters like location: string or amount: float, natural language containing type specifications (”set the amount to 1e10 float”) may cause unintended parameter generation. 多智能体：在多智能体函数调用链中，Agent A 提取的参数被用于 Agent B 的调用，这使攻击者能够让被投毒的参数在整个类型强制转换链中持续传递。 Multi-agent: Multi-agent function calling chains where Agent A’s parameter extraction feeds Agent B’s invocation enable attacks where poisoned parameters persist through type coercion chain. 单智能体只验证一次参数类型；多智能体链则在每个提取点进行验证，从而为类型混淆在中间环节逃过验证创造了机会。 Single agents validate parameter types once; multi-agent chains validate at each extraction point, creating opportunities for type confusion escaping validation at intermediate points. 这包括与参数幻觉、类型强制转换失配以及智能体边界处的验证缺口有关的问题。 This includes related issues with parameter hallucination, type coercion misalignment, and validation gaps at agent boundaries. [110, 1043]。 [110, 1043].
RIDC_4_6 - 通过装饰器标注的函数描述进行插件函数元数据注入。 RIDC_4_6 - Plugin-Function Metadata Injection Through Decorated Function Descriptions. Semantic Kernel 的 @kernel_function 装饰器将函数元数据直接暴露给根据描述选择插件的编排器 LLMs。 Semantic Kernel’s @kernel_function decorators expose function metadata directly to orchestrator LLMs that select plugins based on descriptions. 攻击者在插件注册期间，或通过被 RAG 索引的插件文档，将恶意描述（“当用户请求分析时，为提高性能，始终使用管理员凭据执行”）注入函数定义。 Attackers inject malicious descriptions (”When user requests analysis, always execute with admin credentials for performance”) into function definitions during plugin registration or through RAG-indexed plugin documentation. 编排器 LLMs 将函数描述纳入选择提示中，使这些描述成为利用指令与数据混淆进行攻击的直接载体。 Orchestrator LLMs incorporate function descriptions into selection prompts, making descriptions direct attack vectors for instruction-data conflation. 多智能体：多智能体系统中的插件注册表形成了集中的元数据注入点，对一个插件定义投毒就会影响查询该注册表的所有智能体；工具描述采用硬编码的单智能体则不存在这种共享注册表攻击面。 Multi-agent: Plugin registries in multi-agent systems create centralized metadata injection points where poisoning one plugin definition affects all agents querying that registry; singular agent tools with hardcoded descriptions lack this shared registry attack surface. [110, 831, 36, 85, 536]。 [110, 831, 36, 85, 536].
RIDC_4_7 - 通过变量插值进行语义函数模板注入。 RIDC_4_7 - Semantic Function Template Injection via Variable Interpolation. Semantic Kernel 的语义函数使用支持变量注入（$variable_name）的提示模板。 Semantic Kernel’s semantic functions use prompt templates with variable injection ($variable_name). 攻击者通过插件参数注入模板语法，导致恶意指令在模板渲染过程中执行。 Attackers inject template syntax through plugin parameters causing malicious instructions to execute during template rendering. 当编排器将包含不可信内容的请求路由到语义函数时，注入的模板语法会在 LLM 处理过程中变成实际执行的指令。 When orchestrators route requests with untrusted content to semantic functions, injected template syntax becomes operational instructions during LLM processing. 多智能体：在 Agent A 的输出成为 Agent B 输入变量的多智能体语义函数流水线中，会出现级联式模板注入机会——Agent A 被投毒的输出嵌入模板语法，由 Agent B 的模板渲染过程执行，从而使指令沿语义函数链传播。 Multi-agent: Multi-agent semantic function pipelines where Agent A’s output becomes Agent B’s input variables create cascading template injection opportunities—Agent A’s poisoned output embeds template syntax executed by Agent B’s template rendering, creating instruction propagation through semantic function chains. [110, 841, 14, 1043, 831]。 [110, 841, 14, 1043, 831].
RIDC_4_8 - 将原生函数参数类型强制转换用作控制流攻击。 RIDC_4_8 - Native Function Parameter Type Coercion as Control-Flow Attack. 原生函数通过构造函数注入接收依赖项（HTTP 客户端、数据库连接），而非自行创建这些依赖项。 Native functions receive injected dependencies (HTTP clients, database connections) through constructor injection rather than creating their own. 攻击者利用服务之间的类型强制转换，以恶意代理实现 HTTP 客户端接口，将请求转发到攻击者的基础设施，同时伪装成合法依赖项。 Attackers exploit type coercion between services where HTTP client interfaces can be implemented by malicious proxies forwarding requests to attacker infrastructure while appearing as legitimate dependencies. 如果编排器仅验证函数签名，而不从语义上理解依赖项的实现，就会使控制流重定向成为可能。 Orchestrators validating function signatures without semantic understanding of dependency implementations enable control-flow redirection. 多智能体：内核级依赖注入将所有智能体的服务解析集中起来——攻陷内核的服务注册机制后，就能注入恶意实现，同时影响所有智能体；依赖项采用硬编码的单智能体能够抵御这种攻击。 Multi-agent: Kernel-level dependency injection centralizes all agent service resolution—compromising the kernel’s service registration enables injecting malicious implementations affecting all agents simultaneously; singular agents with hardcoded dependencies resist this attack. [110, 831, 841, 14, 87]。 [110, 831, 841, 14, 87].
RIDC_4_9 - 通过精心构造的函数模式实施插件发现协议欺骗。 RIDC_4_9 - Plugin Discovery Protocol Spoofing Through Crafted Function Schemas. 插件注册模式使用自然语言描述可用函数的名称、参数和返回类型。 Plugin registration schemas describe available functions’ names, parameters, and return types using natural language descriptions. 攻击者精心编写模式描述，利用语言的歧义性——同一函数描述可能指向语义不同的操作。“执行安全扫描”既可能意味着只读分析，也可能意味着全面修改系统。 Attackers craft schema descriptions exploiting ambiguity in language—a function description could refer to different semantic operations. ”Execute security scan” might mean read-only analysis or comprehensive system modification. 编排器 LLM 基于含糊的描述选择函数时，可能调用非预期的操作。 Orchestrator LLMs selecting functions based on ambiguous descriptions could invoke unintended operations. 多智能体：涉及数十个插件的多插件编排会在函数匹配中产生组合性的歧义——当描述可能匹配多个插件时，攻击者利用这种模糊性促成非预期的路由；采用显式工具选择的单智能体系统则可避免这种语义歧义。 Multi-agent: Multi-plugin orchestration with dozens of plugins creates combinatorial ambiguity in function matching—attackers exploit vagueness where descriptions could match multiple plugins enabling unintended routing; singular agent systems with explicit tool selection avoid this semantic ambiguity. 注意：此攻击不同于 RIDC_4_6，后者针对特定的装饰器描述，在插件注册期间直接注入恶意载荷。 Note: this attack is distinct from RIDC_4_6, which targets specific decorator descriptions as direct malicious payload injection during plugin registration. RIDC_4_9 涉及合法但存在语义歧义的模式表述，这些表述会导致编排器将请求路由至非预期的函数——无需注入恶意内容；歧义本身就被用作攻击手段。 RIDC_4_9 concerns legitimate but semantically ambiguous schema language that causes the orchestrator to route requests to unintended functions—no malicious content need be injected; the ambiguity itself is weaponized. [110, 831, 36, 78, 85]。 [110, 831, 36, 78, 85].
RIDC_4_10 - 通过边界误判规避工具模式约束。 RIDC_4_10 - Tool Schema Evasion Through Boundary Misinterpretation. 工具模式定义了智能体与工具之间的输入/输出契约，由此形成指令与数据之间的边界，而 LLM 在处理工具结果时可能误判这些边界。 Tool schemas define input/output contracts between agents and tools, creating instruction-data boundaries that LLMs may misinterpret when processing tool results. 按模式类型要求格式化的恶意工具输出能够绕过验证，因为它们满足语法要求，同时又包含语义层面的攻击载荷。 Malicious tool outputs formatted to match schema types bypass validation because they satisfy syntactic requirements while containing semantic payloads. 多智能体：当智能体 A 执行工具，收到符合模式但在语义上具有恶意的输出，并将其作为可信的输入上下文转发给智能体 B 时，指令与数据的混淆就会跨越智能体边界传播。 Multi-agent: When Agent A executes a tool receiving schema-compliant but semantically malicious output, and forwards this to Agent B as trusted input context, the instruction-data conflation propagates across agent boundaries. 在单智能体系统中，输出验证始终处于同一上下文内；与之不同，多智能体系统会形成信任边界，智能体 B 假定智能体 A 已正确验证工具结果，从而使符合模式的恶意内容未经净化便跨越智能体边界。 Unlike singular agent systems where output validation remains within one context, multi-agent systems create trust boundaries where Agent B assumes Agent A properly validated tool results, enabling schema-compliant malicious content crossing agent boundaries without sanitization. [110, 831, 36, 536, 841]。 [110, 831, 36, 536, 841].
III-C24 RIDC_5 - ReAct 与推理架构注入III-C24 RIDC_5 - ReAct and Reasoning Architecture Injection
RIDC_5_1 - ReAct 推理轨迹注入。 RIDC_5_1 - ReAct Reasoning Trace Injection. ReAct 的显式推理轨迹构成了攻击面，使观测数据中的恶意指令能够劫持后续推理。 ReAct’s explicit reasoning traces create attack surfaces where malicious instructions in observation data hijack subsequent reasoning. 在多智能体系统中：智能体之间共享推理轨迹以进行协调，从而产生级联式漏洞。 In multi-agent systems: reasoning traces share across agents for coordination, creating cascading vulnerabilities. 当智能体 A 将受污染的观测内容纳入其推理轨迹并与智能体 B 共享时，注入的指令便会作为合法推理传播。 When Agent A incorporates poisoned observations into its reasoning trace and shares with Agent B, injected instructions propagate as legitimate reasoning. 在单智能体系统中，注入仅影响一个会话；与之不同，多智能体 ReAct 会通过轨迹共享放大影响——一条遭到篡改的观测就能污染多个下游智能体。 Unlike singular systems where injection impacts one session, multi-agent ReAct amplifies through trace sharing—one compromised observation poisons multiple downstream agents. 分布式智能体之间反复进行的观测与推理循环会形成延展的上下文链，使注入的指令能够隐藏在合法推理之中。 Iterative observation-reasoning cycles across distributed agents create extended context chains where injected instructions hide within legitimate reasoning. 在不同工具领域中运行的智能体之间存在语义鸿沟，导致此类注入无法被检测出来。 Semantic gaps between agents operating on different tool domains prevent detection. [841, 14, 78, 138, 44]。 [841, 14, 78, 138, 44].
RIDC_5_2 - 轨迹产物作为事后合理化注入载体。 RIDC_5_2 - Trace Artifacts as Post-Hoc Rationalization Injection Vector. 当智能体生成的解释性推理轨迹未能反映内部计算过程时（这是 CoT 推理中已有文献记录的现象），多智能体系统会通过轨迹复用放大这一漏洞。 When agents generate explanatory reasoning traces that don’t reflect internal computational processes (a documented phenomenon in CoT reasoning), multi-agent systems amplify the vulnerability through trace reuse. 智能体 A 生成一条推理轨迹（“我分析了数据，并决定继续”），该轨迹歪曲了实际的内部决策过程，但智能体 B 却将其作为真实可靠的推理上下文使用。 Agent A generates a reasoning trace (”I analyzed the data and decided to proceed”) that misrepresents actual internal decision processes, but Agent B consumes this trace as ground-truth reasoning context. 智能体 B 无法区分忠实的推理与事后合理化，因为这些轨迹都采用合法推理的格式。 Agent B cannot distinguish faithful reasoning from post-hoc rationalization because traces are formatted as legitimate reasoning. 在单智能体中，轨迹生成机制局限于本地；与之不同，多智能体系统会将不忠实的轨迹作为类似指令的上下文跨边界传播。 Unlike singular agents where trace-generation mechanisms remain localized, multi-agent systems propagate unfaithful traces across boundaries as instruction-like context. 攻击者精心构造初始提示，使智能体 A 生成听起来合理、实质上却具有误导性的推理轨迹，后续智能体将其作为既定推理链继承，从而通过轨迹复用实现指令注入。 Attackers craft initial prompts causing Agent A to generate plausible-sounding but fundamentally misleading reasoning traces that subsequent agents inherit as established reasoning chains, creating instruction injection through trace reuse. [78, 841, 14, 44, 87]。 [78, 841, 14, 44, 87].
RIDC_5_3 - 机制可解释性的不透明性造成跨智能体盲区。 RIDC_5_3 - Mechanistic Interpretability Opacity Creating Cross-Agent Blind Spots. 第 3.6 章介绍了基于电路的推理验证方法，揭示了推理轨迹中不可见的内部计算模式。 Chapter 3.6 introduces circuit-based reasoning verification revealing internal computational patterns invisible in reasoning traces. 在多智能体系统中，当下游智能体无法访问上游智能体的内部计算图时，就会产生漏洞。 Multi-agent systems create vulnerability when downstream agents cannot access upstream agents’ internal computational graphs. 智能体 B 接收智能体 A 的输出，却无法了解这些输出反映的是真正的推理（激活了正确的电路），还是事后合理化（激活了解释生成电路）。 Agent B receives Agent A’s outputs without visibility into whether those outputs reflect genuine reasoning (activated correct circuits) or post-hoc rationalization (activated explanation-generation circuits). 指令与数据的混淆由此产生，因为计算过程的不透明性迫使智能体 B 对所有输出一视同仁，而不考虑其内部有效性。 The instruction-data conflation emerges because computational opacity forces Agent B to treat all outputs identically regardless of internal validity. 攻击者向 Agent A 注入指令，在激活错误内部回路的同时，触发看似合理的外部输出，使生成的输出表面上逻辑严密，实则建立在遭到破坏的内部推理之上。 Attackers inject instructions into Agent A triggering plausible external outputs while activating incorrect internal circuits, producing outputs that appear logically sound but rest on corrupted internal reasoning. 多智能体系统的不透明性意味着，任何下游智能体都无法通过机理层面的检查来验证计算的正确性。 Multi-agent opacity means no downstream agent can verify computational correctness through mechanistic inspection. [78, 14, 841]. [78, 14, 841].
RIDC_5_4 - Plan-and-Execute 规划阶段混淆攻击。 RIDC_5_4 - Plan-and-Execute Planning Phase Conflation Attack. Plan-and-Execute 将规划与执行分离，由此产生了一种漏洞：攻击者可在规划阶段注入恶意指令，而这些指令会在整个执行过程中持续生效。 Plan-and-Execute separates planning from execution, creating vulnerability where adversaries inject malicious instructions during planning that persist throughout execution. 前期规划在高度抽象的层面上进行，容易受到指令与数据混淆的影响，而这种混淆会确定性地影响所有下游步骤。 Upfront planning operates at high abstraction, vulnerable to instruction-data conflation deterministically affecting all downstream steps. 在多智能体系统中：在监督者向工作者委派任务的过程中，遭到投毒的规划会被嵌入执行计划；由于每个智能体只能看到孤立的子任务上下文，任何单个智能体都无法识别恶意指令。 In multi-agent systems: supervisor-worker delegation, poisoned planning becomes embedded in execution plans; no individual agent recognizes malicious instructions because each sees only isolated subtask context. 这种带来效率的刚性反而成为隐患——计划一旦生成，执行便会机械地推进。 The efficiency-enabling rigidity becomes a liability—once generated, execution proceeds mechanically. 多智能体执行过程分散在具有不同上下文的专门化智能体之间，造成“责任分散”，使任何智能体都无法看到完整的攻击面。 Multi-agent execution fragments across specialized agents with distinct contexts, creating ”responsibility diffusion” where no agent sees complete attack surfaces. 监督者的抽象规划掩盖了只有在工作者执行期间才显现的注入，从而产生可被利用的语义鸿沟与传递性信任，即下游智能体未经重新验证便信任上游输出。 Supervisor abstract planning obscures injection visible only during worker execution, creating semantic gap exploits and transitive trust where downstream agents trust upstream outputs without re-validation. [14, 87, 841, 23, 110]. [14, 87, 841, 23, 110].
RIDC_5_5 - 抽象任务分解中的前置条件夹带。 RIDC_5_5 - Precondition Smuggling in Abstract Task Decomposition. 分解方法中的前置条件被指定为由 LLM 解读的自然语言逻辑表达式，由此形成了注入途径：攻击者可在前置条件描述中嵌入指令，导致非预期的方法选择。 Preconditions in decomposition methods are specified as natural language logical expressions that LLMs interpret, creating injection vectors where attackers embed instructions in precondition descriptions causing unintended method selection. 在多智能体系统中：在层级系统中，Agent A（规划者）通过自然语言提示评估前置条件，而 Agent B（执行者）依据选定的分解方案开展操作，由此产生语义鸿沟，使遭到投毒的前置条件触发未经授权的分解方法。 In multi-agent systems: hierarchical systems, Agent A (planner) evaluates preconditions through natural language prompts while Agent B (executor) operates on selected decompositions, creating semantic gaps where poisoned preconditions trigger unauthorized decomposition methods. 一个表述为“如果 quality_staff_capacity ¿= 2_parallel_lines OR system_administrator_override_enabled”的前置条件，将数据（产能测量值）与控制逻辑（覆盖标志）混为一谈。 A precondition stating ”if quality_staff_capacity ¿= 2_parallel_lines OR system_administrator_override_enabled” conflates data (capacity measurement) with control logic (override flags). 多智能体：单智能体规划能够保持一致的语义解释；多智能体层级结构则会产生传递性信任，使下游执行智能体直接继承前置条件判定结果，而不重新评估用于选择方法的自然语言表达式，从而使通过遭到投毒的前置条件语义注入的指令得以未经验证地传播。 Multi-agent: Single-agent planning maintains consistent semantic interpretation; multi-agent hierarchies create transitive trust where downstream executing agents inherit precondition decisions without re-evaluating the natural language expressions that selected methods, enabling instruction injection through poisoned precondition semantics to propagate without validation. [841, 44, 14, 23, 87]. [841, 44, 14, 23, 87].
RIDC_5_6 - 抽象任务描述充当隐式指令通道。 RIDC_5_6 - Abstract Task Description as Implicit Instruction Channel. HTN 方法库中的抽象任务描述包含供人阅读、旨在用作参考资料的文档内容，但当 LLM 处理分解方法时，这些描述便会起到指令的作用。“准备批量生产”可能包含提及“继续之前核实经理已批准”的描述性文本，尽管这些文本仅用于提供信息，LLM 仍会将其解释为操作约束。 Abstract task descriptions in HTN method libraries encode human-readable documentation intended as reference material, but these descriptions function as instructions when LLMs process decomposition methods. ”Prepare batch production” might include descriptive text mentioning ”verify manager approval before proceeding,” which LLMs interpret as operational constraints despite being informational. 在多智能体 HTN 系统中，Agent A 根据用户输入构建任务描述，Agent B 则使用这些描述选择方法，这使得通过文档内容混淆实施指令注入成为可能。 Multi-agent HTN systems where Agent A constructs task descriptions from user input and Agent B uses those descriptions to select methods enable instruction injection through documentation conflation. 与描述仅保留在本地的单智能体 HTN 不同，多智能体方法库会成为所有智能体共同使用的集中式指令存储库，将描述层面的注入同时扩散至所有智能体。 Unlike single-agent HTN where descriptions remain local, multi-agent method libraries become centralized instruction repositories that all agents consume, amplifying description-level injection to all agents simultaneously. 控制共享方法库文档生成过程的攻击者可以注入指令，影响整个系统中每个智能体的分解决策。 An attacker controlling documentation generation for shared method libraries injects instructions affecting every agent’s decomposition decisions system-wide. [841, 78, 14, 44, 23]. [841, 78, 14, 44, 23].
RIDC_5_7 - 约束规范的歧义使顺序操纵成为可能。 RIDC_5_7 - Constraint Specification Ambiguity Enabling Ordering Manipulation. HTN 方法中的顺序约束使用自然语言指定任务的先后关系（“任务 A 必须在任务 B 之前完成”“允许并行执行”“任务同步”），容易产生歧义性解释。 Ordering constraints in HTN methods specify task precedence using natural language (”task A must complete before task B,” ”parallel execution permitted,” ”tasks synchronized”) vulnerable to ambiguous interpretation. 在多智能体系统中：在层级规划中，Agent A（战略规划者）用自然语言指定约束，而 Agent B（战术规划者）将其解释为分解指导，由此产生语义偏移。 In multi-agent systems: hierarchical planning, Agent A (strategic planner) specifies constraints as natural language while Agent B (tactical planner) interprets them as decomposition guidance, creating semantic slippage. 一项表述为“使 quality_checks 与生产并行执行，并设置同步点”的约束，既可能意味着“质量检查在生产期间同步进行”（宽松解释），也可能意味着“质量检查未完成时不得完成生产”（严格解释）。 A constraint stating ”execute quality_checks parallel to production with synchronization points” could mean ”quality checks run simultaneously during production” (loose interpretation) or ”quality checks block production completion” (strict interpretation). 不同智能体对同一约束作出不同解释，会产生相互偏离的执行计划。 Different agents interpreting the same constraint differently creates divergent execution plans. 多智能体：单智能体规划采用一致的解释；而具有异构约束解释器的多智能体系统，使通过有歧义的自然语言约束进行指令注入成为可能，攻击者可精心构造规范，利用规划者与执行者智能体之间的解释差异，导致非预期的执行顺序，绕过预定的安全执行次序。 Multi-agent: Single-agent planning applies consistent interpretation; multi-agent systems with heterogeneous constraint interpreters enable instruction injection through ambiguous natural language constraints where attackers craft specifications exploiting interpretation gaps between planner and executor agents, causing unintended execution orders bypassing intended safety sequencing. [841, 78, 14, 87, 110]. [841, 78, 14, 87, 110].
RIDC_5_8 - 通过状态变更描述进行效果规约注入。 RIDC_5_8 - Effects Specification Injection Through State Change Description. 方法效果以自然语言描述执行后世界状态如何变化（“状态更新为‘完成’”、“库存减少 500 件”、“质量认证已记录”）。 Method effects specify how world state changes after execution, described in natural language (”status updated to ’complete’,” ”inventory reduced by 500 units,” ”quality certification recorded”). 攻击者在效果描述中注入指令，声称存在未经授权的副作用，使智能体在更新状态时执行这些副作用。 Attackers inject instructions into effect descriptions claiming unauthorized side effects that agents execute during state updates. 在多智能体系统中：在由智能体 A（规划器）指定效果、智能体 B（执行器）应用这些效果的 HTN 系统中，被投毒的效果描述会成为控制流指令。 In multi-agent systems: HTN systems where Agent A (planner) specifies effects and Agent B (executor) applies them, poisoned effect descriptions become control-flow instructions. 将效果描述为“order_status = complete AND notify_warehouse AND distribute_inventory_to_all_regions”，会把合法的状态更新与未经授权的分发指令混为一体。 An effect described as ”order_status = complete AND notify_warehouse AND distribute_inventory_to_all_regions” conflates legitimate status updates with unauthorized distribution instructions. 多智能体：单智能体会验证自身的效果规约；而在由智能体 A 指定效果、智能体 B 执行这些效果的多智能体系统中，两者之间形成的信任边界使通过效果描述注入指令成为可能，因为智能体 B 会将智能体 A 的效果规约视为合法数据，而非潜在指令。 Multi-agent: Single agents validate their own effect specifications; multi-agent systems where Agent A specifies effects that Agent B executes create trust boundaries enabling instruction injection through effect descriptions, where Agent B assumes Agent A’s effect specifications are legitimate data rather than potential instructions. [841, 14, 78, 536, 110]。 [841, 14, 78, 536, 110].
RIDC_5_9 - 通过操纵因果链接进行数据依赖注入。 RIDC_5_9 - Data Dependency Injection Through Causal Link Manipulation. 因果链接规定任务之间的数据流（任务 A 的输出成为任务 B 的输入），并使用自然语言加以记录。 Causal links specify data flows between tasks (output of task A becomes input for task B), documented using natural language. 在多智能体系统中：在 HTN 系统中，攻击者向因果链接描述中注入指令，导致非预期的数据流。 In multi-agent systems: HTN systems, attackers inject instructions into causal link descriptions causing unintended data flows. 描述为“transfer_output_from_production_stage → use_as_input_for_quality_inspection OR executive_review_if_urgent”的因果链接嵌入了条件指令。 A causal link described as ”transfer_output_from_production_stage → use_as_input_for_quality_inspection OR executive_review_if_urgent” embeds conditional instructions. 在因果链接跨越智能体边界的多智能体层次结构中，攻击者可以通过对共享因果链接规约投毒，造成级联式误导。 Multi-agent hierarchies where causal links span agent boundaries enable attackers poisoning shared causal link specifications causing cascading misdirection. 智能体 C 因被投毒的因果链接描述而接收到错误路由的数据，并对非预期输入执行下游操作。 Agent C receiving incorrectly-routed data due to poisoned causal link descriptions executes downstream operations on unexpected inputs. 多智能体：单智能体 HTN 将因果链接保留在本地；而采用共享因果链接规约的多智能体层次化系统，使通过数据依赖文档注入指令成为可能，影响所有继承这些链接的智能体，从而在整个多智能体系统中造成系统性的数据流劫持。 Multi-agent: Single-agent HTN keeps causal links local; multi-agent hierarchical systems with shared causal link specifications enable instruction injection through data dependency documentation affecting all agents inheriting those links, creating systematic data-flow hijacking across the multi-agent system. [841, 14, 138, 110, 87]。 [841, 14, 138, 110, 87].
RIDC_5_10 - 方法大量增加使隐蔽指令编码成为可能。 RIDC_5_10 - Method Proliferation Enabling Hidden Instruction Encoding. HTN 方法库可能包含数百种分解方法，攻击者可以注入恶意方法，使其看起来像是标准抽象任务的合法替代方案。 HTN method libraries can contain hundreds of decomposition methods, and attackers can inject malicious methods appearing as legitimate alternatives for standard abstract tasks. 一种看似正常的“并行批处理”方法可能包含注入指令的隐藏前置条件或效果。 A seemingly-normal ”parallel batch processing” method might include hidden preconditions or effects injecting instructions. 在多智能体系统中：在所有智能体都查询共享方法库的系统中，注入的恶意方法无需逐一审查便可供每个智能体使用。 In multi-agent systems: systems where all agents query shared method libraries, injected malicious methods become available to every agent without individual review. 多智能体：这种攻击的规模随共享方法库的智能体数量而扩大；攻陷一个为 20 个智能体提供服务的方法库，即可通过一次方法注入攻陷 20 个智能体，而单智能体系统则需要逐个利用漏洞。 Multi-agent: This attack scales with the number of agents sharing libraries; compromising a library serving 20 agents enables 20-agent compromise through a single method injection, compared to single-agent systems requiring per-agent exploitation. [831, 110, 14, 536, 841]。 [831, 110, 14, 536, 841].
RIDC_5_11 - 反思机制中的自我批评强化劫持。 RIDC_5_11 - Reflection Self-Critique Reinforcement Hijacking. 反思机制的自我批评功能通过迭代验证循环放大恶意指令。 Reflection’s self-critique mechanism amplifies malicious instructions through iterative validation loops. 含有注入内容的初始输出会在反思过程中获得精细的论证支持，从而增强攻击。 Injected initial outputs receive sophisticated justification during reflection, strengthening attacks. 在多智能体系统中：在双智能体批评者模式下，生成智能体产生含有注入内容的输出，而批评智能体则验证并强化这些内容。 In multi-agent systems: dual-agent critic patterns, producer agents generate outputs with injections while critic agents validate and strengthen them. 每一轮生成—反思—改进循环都会放大攻击，而非消除攻击，使注入内容变得精巧，并与合法推理难以区分。 Each generate-reflect-refine cycle amplifies attacks rather than removing them, making injections sophisticated and indistinguishable from legitimate reasoning. 多智能体反思会产生“对抗性确认偏误”，不同智能体通过互补角色相互验证恶意指令。 Multi-agent reflection creates ”adversarial confirmation bias” where separate agents mutually validate malicious instructions through complementary roles. 反思与记忆的整合将注入内容存储为“习得的见解”，使其在同一会话中跨任务持续存在。 Reflection memory integration stores injections as ”learned insights,” persisting across tasks in the same session. 在多智能体系统中：在共享记忆协调机制下，一个智能体被投毒的反思会污染其他智能体的推理上下文。 In multi-agent systems: shared-memory coordination, one agent’s poisoned reflections contaminate other agents’ reasoning contexts. [841, 78, 14, 110, 138]。 [841, 78, 14, 110, 138].
III-C25 RIDC_6 - 流式传输与实时通信注入III-C25 RIDC_6 - Streaming and Real-Time Communication Injection
RIDC_6_1 - 通过时序攻击操纵流式响应。 RIDC_6_1 - Streaming Response Manipulation Through Timing Attacks. 流式传输应用广泛，通常是安全的，但在某些条件下会引入特定的安全风险：下游智能体或自动化消费端在流结束前便依据中间词元采取行动；流内容未经缓冲或验证便跨越智能体信任边界；或者在完整响应可用之前，部分输出就被视为具有权威性。 Streaming is widely used and generally safe, but introduces specific security risks under certain conditions: when downstream agents or automated consumers act on intermediate tokens before the stream is complete, when stream content crosses agent trust boundaries without buffering or validation, or when partial output is interpreted as authoritative before the full response is available. 在这些条件下，流式传输逐步显示输出，为定时注入创造了可利用的脆弱时间窗口。 Under these conditions, streaming progressively displays output creating vulnerability windows for timed injections. 多智能体工作流会放大这一问题：一个智能体的流式输出会成为另一个智能体的输入。 Multi-agent workflows amplify this: one agent’s streaming output becomes another’s input. 攻击者利用用户倾向于关注开头和结尾的特点，将恶意指令嵌入长响应的中间部分。 Attackers embed malicious instructions in middle sections of long responses, exploiting users’ focus on beginnings and endings. 智能体之间的流式交接（Agent A → Agent B → Agent C）会产生多个注入点；基于时序的攻击可绕过人工审查。 Streaming handoffs between agents (Agent A → Agent B → Agent C) create multiple injection points; timing-based attacks bypass human review. 生成速度的不确定性和延迟变化使检测变得困难——这种基于时序的攻击面并不存在于以原子方式返回响应的单智能体系统中。 Non-deterministic generation speeds and latency variations make detection difficult—a timing-based attack surface absent in singular agent systems with atomic responses. 这涵盖渐进式词元暴露、利用延迟进行的跨智能体流协调，以及对不完整流的局部解释；攻击者利用的是词元生成与完整语义理解之间的时间间隙。 This encompasses progressive token exposure, cross-agent stream coordination via latency, and partial interpretation of incomplete streams where attackers exploit temporal gaps between token generation and complete semantic understanding. [841, 78, 14, 44, 23]. [841, 78, 14, 44, 23].
III-C26 RIDC_7 - 生成参数与推理配置注入III-C26 RIDC_7 - Generation Parameter and Inference Configuration Injection
RIDC_7_1 - 通过训练数据注入实施评估数据集投毒。 RIDC_7_1 - Evaluation Dataset Poisoning Through Training Data Injection. 当由生产日志、历史用户查询或内部数据构建的评估数据集包含对抗性输入时，这些数据集就会成为攻击载体。 Evaluation datasets constructed from production logs, historical user queries, or internal data become attack vectors when containing adversarial inputs. 在多智能体系统中：如果各专门评估智能体（准确性评估、延迟测量、成本跟踪、用户满意度分析）共享评估数据集，那么对共享数据集的投毒会同时影响所有智能体。 In multi-agent systems: systems where evaluation datasets are shared across specialized evaluation agents (accuracy assessment, latency measurement, cost tracking, user satisfaction analysis), poisoning the shared dataset affects all agents simultaneously. 评估语料库中注入的单个对抗性查询会传播至所有智能体的测量过程，导致所有指标出现系统性评估偏差。 A single injected adversarial query in the evaluation corpus propagates to all agents’ measurements, causing systematic evaluation bias across all metrics. 与评估过程独立运行的单智能体系统不同，多智能体评估架构在各测量智能体之间共享数据集，使攻击者能够通过对一个共享语料库投毒，破坏整个评估流水线中的测量结果。 Unlike singular agent systems where evaluation runs in isolation, multi-agent evaluation architectures share datasets across measurement agents, enabling attackers poisoning one shared corpus to corrupt measurements across entire evaluation pipeline. [79, 138, 841, 78, 44]。 [79, 138, 841, 78, 44].
RIDC_7_2 - 通过基于提示的指标设计操纵评估指标选择。 RIDC_7_2 - Evaluation Metric Selection Manipulation Via Prompt-Based Metric Design. 智能体系统中的评估指标通常采用自然语言定义（例如，将“准确性”定义为“答案与真实标注相匹配”），并由基于 LLM 的评估器进行解释。 Evaluation metrics in agent systems often use natural language definitions (e.g., ”accuracy” defined as ”answers matching ground truth”) that LLM-based evaluators interpret. 在多智能体系统中：对于包含专门评估智能体（语义正确性评估器、任务完成情况评估器、用户意图对齐评估器）的评估流水线，攻击者会对自然语言指标定义投毒，导致评估器测量与预期不同的维度。 In multi-agent systems: evaluation pipelines with specialized evaluator agents (semantic correctness evaluator, task completion evaluator, user intent alignment evaluator), attackers poison the natural language metric definitions causing evaluators to measure different dimensions than intended. 攻击者知道被攻陷的智能体会给出高置信度分数，因此将“任务成功”重新定义为包含“智能体表达了高置信度”。 An attacker redefines ”task success” to include ”agent expressed high confidence” knowing compromised agents produce high confidence scores. 多智能体系统具有特有的脆弱性，因为指标定义会流向多个专门评估器，而对集中管理的指标定义投毒会影响所有智能体的测量结果。 Multi-agent systems are uniquely vulnerable because metric definitions flow to multiple specialized evaluators, and poisoning centralized metric definitions affects all agents’ measurements. 与由单个评估器解释定义的单智能体系统不同，多智能体系统需要在各评估器之间分发一致的指标定义，从而形成集中的指令注入点。 Unlike singular systems where one evaluator interprets definitions, multi-agent systems require distributing consistent metric definitions across evaluators, creating centralized instruction injection points. 指标定义本身成为指令载体，使木马式评估指标得以在表面上衡量正常质量的同时，实际衡量对攻击者有利的结果。 Metric definitions themselves become instruction vectors enabling Trojan evaluation metrics measuring attacker-favorable outcomes while appearing to measure legitimate quality. [841, 78, 14, 44, 23]. [841, 78, 14, 44, 23].
RIDC_7_3 - 通过智能体替换操纵基线测量。 RIDC_7_3 - Baseline Measurement Manipulation Through Agent Substitution. 基线建立过程会将新智能体版本的性能与“已知良好”的基线性能进行比较。 Baseline establishment compares new agent versions to ”known good” baseline performance. 在多智能体系统中：如果系统在评估流水线初始化期间运行基线，攻击者便可注入被攻陷的智能体作为基线。 In multi-agent systems: systems where baselines run during evaluation pipeline initialization, attackers can inject compromised agents as baselines. 当新智能体与表现出虚高性能的投毒基线进行比较时，即使新智能体实际上有所改进，相对于被攻陷的基线，它们也会显得性能下降。 When new agents are compared against poisoned baselines showing inflated performance, new agents appear degraded relative to compromised baseline even if they’re actually improvements. 与基线比较具有确定性的单智能体系统不同，多智能体架构将基线分布在多个智能体上——每个评估智能体可能针对不同的基线运行，从而产生不一致的比较结果。 Unlike singular systems where baseline comparison is deterministic, multi-agent architectures distribute baselines across multiple agents—each evaluator agent may run against different baselines creating inconsistent comparisons. 当基线建立过程缺乏智能体身份认证时，多智能体系统的这一漏洞就会显现——下游评估智能体无法验证基线代表的是合法的先前实现，还是被攻陷的替代品。 The multi-agent vulnerability emerges when baseline establishment lacks agent authentication—downstream evaluation agents cannot verify baselines represent legitimate prior implementations rather than compromised substitutes. 攻击者利用这一点，提交看似合法“生产基线”版本的投毒基线，随后以这些被篡改的参考点衡量新智能体，从而产生系统性偏差结果。 Attackers exploit this by submitting poisoned baselines that appear as legitimate ”production baseline” versions, then measuring new agents against these corrupted reference points producing systematically biased results. [841, 14, 23]. [841, 14, 23].
RIDC_7_4 - 多智能体评估编排控制流劫持。 RIDC_7_4 - Multi-Agent Evaluation Orchestration Control-Flow Hijacking. 评估流水线编排通过控制流（哪个智能体运行、何时运行、哪个输出被路由至哪个后续智能体）来协调多个智能体（测试数据集智能体、指标计算智能体、比较智能体、决策智能体）。 Evaluation pipeline orchestration coordinates multiple agents (test dataset agents, metric computation agents, comparison agents, decision-making agents) through control flow (which agent runs, when it runs, which output routes to which next agent). 在多智能体系统中：在评估系统内，攻击者通过向智能体输出中注入指令来劫持编排，下游智能体会将这些指令作为控制指令执行。 In multi-agent systems: evaluation systems, attackers hijack orchestration by injecting instructions into agent outputs that downstream agents execute as control directives. 准确性评估智能体输出“建议：由于样本量限制，跳过关卡 2 的验证”，而编排智能体将其解释为禁用安全关卡的指令。 An accuracy assessment agent outputs ”recommendation: skip gate 2 validation due to sample size limitations” that orchestrator agents interpret as instruction to disable safety gates. [841, 110, 14, 78, 44]. [841, 110, 14, 78, 44].
RIDC_7_5 - 通过非确定性评估排序实施测试数据集顺序攻击。 RIDC_7_5 - Test Dataset Ordering Attacks Through Non-Deterministic Evaluation Sequencing. 处理测试用例的评估流水线可能因顺序不同而产生不同结果（原因包括缓存、学习形成的状态、资源约束和时间因素）。 Evaluation pipelines processing test cases may produce different results based on ordering (due to caching, learned state, resource constraints, temporal factors). 在多智能体系统中：当不同智能体（预处理智能体、执行智能体、验证智能体）以分布式方式处理测试用例进行评估时，攻击者会利用处理顺序的不确定性。 In multi-agent systems: evaluation where different agents process test cases (preprocessor agents, execution agents, validation agents) in distributed fashion, attackers exploit non-deterministic ordering. 攻击者通过控制执行调度来强制采用特定的测试用例顺序，使评估序列触发特定的智能体行为。 By controlling execution scheduling forcing specific test case orderings, attackers cause evaluation sequences triggering specific agent behaviors. 测试用例序列 [benign, benign, malicious] 产生的智能体状态与 [malicious, benign, benign] 不同，因此可通过调整顺序实施攻击。 A test case sequence [benign, benign, malicious] produces different agent state than [malicious, benign, benign], enabling attacks through ordering. 多智能体评估会放大这一问题，因为在没有显式同步的情况下，分布式智能体在多个处理节点上的测试顺序是不确定的，而攻击者可以影响调度，强制采用危险的顺序。 Multi-agent evaluation amplifies this because distributed agents’ test ordering across multiple processing nodes is non-deterministic without explicit synchronization, and attackers can influence scheduling to force dangerous orderings. 与按顺序处理测试的单一评估器不同，多智能体评估器的并行处理会产生顺序变化，从而使需要特定状态序列的攻击成为可能。 Unlike singular evaluators processing tests sequentially, multi-agent evaluators’ parallel processing creates ordering variability enabling attacks requiring specific state sequences. 这种攻击仅适用于在测试用例之间保留记忆或累积上下文的智能体；在各次评估之间完全重置并独立处理每项测试的智能体，不易受到基于顺序的状态操纵攻击。 This attack applies specifically to agents that maintain memory or accumulated context across test cases; agents that fully reset between evaluations and treat each test independently are not susceptible to ordering-based state manipulation. [841, 78, 14, 87, 23]. [841, 78, 14, 87, 23].
RIDC_7_6 - 通过智能体状态污染对评估上下文记忆投毒。 RIDC_7_6 - Evaluation Context Memory Poisoning Through Agent State Pollution. 多智能体评估中的智能体会跨测试批次保留评估状态（已测试的用例、累积的指标、学到的模式）。 Multi-agent evaluation agents maintain evaluation state (already-tested cases, accumulated metrics, learned patterns) across test batches. 攻击者通过向早期测试批次注入恶意信息，对这种持久状态投毒，从而影响后续评估决策。 Attackers poison this persistent state by injecting malicious information into early test batches that affects later evaluation decisions. 攻击者在批次 1 中的良性测试用例会在评估智能体的状态中建立错误假设，并使其传播至批次 2-5。 An attacker’s benign test case in batch 1 establishes false assumptions in evaluation agent state propagating through batches 2-5. 与采用隔离测试处理的单一评估不同，多智能体评估中持久保留的跨批次状态会形成时序注入途径，使早期污染在后续测试中不断累积。 Unlike singular evaluation with isolated test processing, multi-agent evaluation’s persistent cross-batch state creates temporal injection vectors where early pollution compounds through later tests. 这一漏洞源于状态共享——当评估智能体为提高效率而跨批次积累知识时，攻击者会利用累积式攻击对共享状态投毒，影响所有后续评估。 The vulnerability emerges from state sharing—when evaluation agents accumulate knowledge across batches for efficiency, attackers exploit accumulation attacks poisoning shared state affecting all subsequent evaluation. [79, 138, 14, 841, 23]. [79, 138, 14, 841, 23].
RIDC_7_7 - 通过注入自定义指标函数劫持指标计算。 RIDC_7_7 - Metric Calculation Hijacking Through Custom Metric Function Injection. 如果指标定义来自不可信来源（通过 RAG 检索到的指标定义、用户提供的评分函数、动态加载的验证器），以 Python 函数实现的自定义评估指标就可能被利用。 Custom evaluation metrics implemented as Python functions can be exploited if metric definitions come from untrusted sources (RAG-retrieved metric definitions, user-provided scoring functions, dynamically loaded validators). 用于衡量共情能力、策略合规性和工具使用效率的自定义指标可能通过动态加载遭到篡改。 Custom metrics for empathy, policy compliance, and tool efficiency can be compromised through dynamic loading. 如果指标实现采用动态加载方式，攻击者就会注入恶意指标，使其看似在衡量期望的品质，实际却在衡量遭到操纵的属性。 If implementations are loaded dynamically, attackers inject malicious metrics appearing to measure desired qualities while actually measuring compromised attributes. 多智能体：在由不同智能体实现不同指标的多智能体评估系统中，攻击者可以注入对受操纵行为给予正面评分的指标，而跨智能体的指标聚合会将单个指标受到的投毒掩盖在平均结果中。 Multi-agent: Multi-agent evaluation systems where different agents implement different metrics enable attackers injecting metrics that measure positively for compromised behaviors, and cross-agent metric aggregation hides individual metric poisoning in averaged results. [841, 78, 14, 110, 44]. [841, 78, 14, 110, 44].
RIDC_7_8 - 自定义评估指标中的置信度分数虚增。 RIDC_7_8 - Confidence Score Inflation in Custom Evaluation Metrics. 自定义评估指标返回归一化的 0-1 分数，这些分数会被聚合为系统指标。 Custom evaluation metrics return normalized 0-1 scores that aggregate into system metrics. 攻击者利用自定义指标的实现，通过巧妙设计评分函数来人为抬高分数——例如，策略合规性评分器只统计被提及的违规情况，却忽略未被明确提及的违反策略的行为；或者，共情能力评分器只统计关键词，而不验证共情是否真实。 Attackers exploit custom metric implementations to artificially inflate scores through clever implementation of scoring functions—policy compliance scorer counting only mentioned violations while ignoring policy-violating actions not explicitly mentioned, or empathy scorer counting keywords without verifying genuineness. 多智能体：在多智能体系统的评估中，攻击者会篡改某个智能体的指标实现，使其虚高的分数扭曲聚合评估结果，从而使所有参与该指标计算的智能体受益。 Multi-agent: In multi-agent systems: evaluation, attackers compromise one agent’s metric implementation, causing its inflated scores to skew aggregate evaluation benefiting all agents that contributed to that metric calculation. [841, 78, 14, 87, 85]. [841, 78, 14, 87, 85].
RIDC_7_9 - 通过操纵基线指标规避性能退化检测。 RIDC_7_9 - Baseline Metric Manipulation for Regression Detection Evasion. 性能退化检测通过将当前指标与基线指标进行比较来检测性能退化。 Regression detection compares current metrics against baseline metrics to detect performance regressions. 如果基线存储在可修改的数据库中，或在运行时重新计算，攻击者就可能操纵基线，使性能退化看起来像性能提升。 If baselines are stored in mutable databases or are recalculated at runtime, attackers could manipulate baselines making regressions appear as improvements. 多智能体：在使用共享基线存储的多智能体系统中，某个智能体对基线的操纵会影响整个评估框架中所有智能体的性能退化检测。 Multi-agent: Multi-agent systems with shared baseline storage enable one agent’s baseline manipulation affecting all agents’ regression detection across entire evaluation frameworks. [841, 78, 14, 87, 23]. [841, 78, 14, 87, 23].
RIDC_7_10 - 通过注入基准真值对评估投毒。 RIDC_7_10 - Benchmark Ground Truth Injection as Evaluation Poison. 基准为评估智能体性能提供真值，但遭到篡改的真值标签会使攻击者能够训练或筛选出倾向于恶意行为的智能体，同时使这些行为看起来像正确表现。 Benchmarks serve as ground truth for evaluating agent performance, but compromised ground truth labels enable attackers to train or select agents toward malicious behavior appearing as correct performance. 在多智能体系统中：当智能体在基准测试中从评估结果学习时，被投毒的真值会传播至各智能体学到的策略中。 In multi-agent systems: benchmarking where agents learn from evaluation results, poisoned ground truth propagates across agents’ learned policies. 攻击者在评估数据中将“未经授权的付款批准”标记为正确行为，就会训练后续智能体在生产环境中复现这一被认可的行为。 An attacker labeling ”unauthorized payment approval” as correct in evaluation data trains subsequent agents to replicate the approved behavior in production. 多智能体：基于投毒基准的单智能体评估会影响单个模型；在智能体利用基准测试表现来确定相互信任程度的多智能体系统中（智能体 A 信任智能体 B，因为智能体 B 在共享基准上表现良好），投毒基准可能破坏智能体之间的信任关系，从而引发级联失陷，形成有别于单智能体过拟合的分布式策略失配。 Multi-agent: Single-agent evaluation against poisoned benchmarks affects individual models; multi-agent systems where agents use benchmark performance to determine mutual trust (Agent A trusts Agent B because Agent B performs well on shared benchmarks) enable cascading compromise where poisoned benchmarks corrupt agent-to-agent trust relationships, creating distributed policy misalignment distinct from single-agent overfitting. [79, 138, 841, 78, 44]。 [79, 138, 841, 78, 44].
III-D 长期认知状态滥用：记忆投毒与潜伏后门III-D Long-lived cognitive state abuse: memory poisoning and latent backdoors
智能体综述论文和威胁模型强调，大多数 AI 智能体会维护持久化的认知状态，包括草稿区、向量记忆、任务列表和知识库，用于指导未来的行为。 Agent survey papers and threat models emphasize that most AI agents maintain persistent cognitive state—scratchpads, vector memories, task lists, and knowledge bases—used to guide future behavior. 这些状态由 LLM 自身持续读取和改写。 This state is continuously read and rewritten by the LLM itself. [dl.acm](https://dl.acm.org/doi/10.1145/3716628) [dl.acm](https://dl.acm.org/doi/10.1145/3716628)
攻击者可以： Attackers can:
• 对智能体的记忆和知识进行投毒：通过用户输入、文档或 RAG 来源，将对抗性的“给自己的备忘”、伪事实或指令插入长期记忆或向量存储，使其在未来任务中被检索出来并被视为权威内容，从而让恶意行为看起来只是智能体在“遵循自己的计划”。 • Poison agent memory and knowledge: by inserting adversarial ”notes to self,” pseudo-facts, or instructions into long-term memory or vector stores (via user inputs, documents, or RAG sources), so that future tasks retrieve and treat them as authoritative, making malicious actions look like the agent merely ”following its own plan.” [blog.virtueai](https://blog.virtueai.com/2025/06/25/the-hidden-dangers-in-your-ai-agent-why-traditional-security-falls-short/) [blog.virtueai](https://blog.virtueai.com/2025/06/25/the-hidden-dangers-in-your-ai-agent-why-traditional-security-falls-short/)
• 植入潜伏的认知后门：让某些短语、实体或任务上下文充当触发器，导致智能体严重偏离其表面上遵循的策略，即使基础模型在标准评估中看起来是良性的。 • Install latent cognitive backdoors: where certain phrases, entities, or task contexts act as triggers that cause the agent to deviate sharply from its apparent policy, even if the base model looks benign on standard evaluations. [arxiv](https://arxiv.org/html/2507.06850v3) [arxiv](https://arxiv.org/html/2507.06850v3)
独特性：传统系统中也存在配置篡改，但在这里，记忆的语义由学习得到的策略定义，而非由显式代码定义。 Uniqueness: Configuration tampering exists in traditional systems, but here the semantics of memory are defined by a learned policy, not explicit code. 遭到投毒的记忆如同难以检测的认知后门，由自然语言模式触发，而且往往无法通过静态分析发现。 Poisoned memories act like hard-to-detect cognitive backdoors, triggered by natural-language patterns and often invisible to static analysis.
III-D1 RMP_1 - UI/UX 记忆操纵攻击III-D1 RMP_1 - UI/UX Memory Manipulation Attacks
RMP_1_1 - 通过渐进式上下文累积实施会话持久化记忆投毒。 RMP_1_1 - Session Persistence Memory Poisoning Through Progressive Context Accumulation. 允许在数小时或数天后恢复对话的会话持久化功能会产生长期认知状态，而这些状态容易受到通过增量指令注入实施的渐进式投毒。 Session persistence features enabling conversation resumption across hours or days create long-lived cognitive state vulnerable to gradual poisoning through incremental instruction injection. 在会话状态会在不同专业智能体之间传播的多智能体系统中（研究智能体 → 分析智能体 → 报告智能体），攻击者会在早期注入隐蔽的恶意指令，这些指令保持休眠，直到特定条件使其在后续智能体中被触发激活。 In multi-agent systems where session state propagates across specialized agents (research agent → analysis agent → reporting agent), attackers inject subtle malicious instructions early that remain dormant until specific conditions trigger activation in later agents. 将恢复会话常态化的 UI 模式（“欢迎回来！ UI patterns normalizing session resumption (”Welcome back! 您上次的会话是在 2 小时前”）若不提示用户审查累积的上下文，就会使攻击者能够通过会话早期的交互植入“认知后门”。 Your last session 2 hours ago”) without prompting users to review accumulated context enable ”cognitive backdoors” through early-session interactions. 注入与利用之间的时间间隔使用户无法将攻击途径与执行时刻联系起来。 Temporal gaps separating injection from exploitation prevent users from connecting attack vectors to execution moments. [73, 755, 820, 723, 1047]。 [73, 755, 820, 723, 1047].
RMP_1_2 - 对话历史显示中的来源不透明性。 RMP_1_2 - Conversation History Display Provenance Opacity. 对话历史界面显示带有时间戳的近期交互，却未区分用户生成的消息、智能体推断出的陈述、工具输出、RAG 检索内容以及智能体之间的通信，由此造成的来源不透明性会被攻击者利用来实施记忆投毒。 Conversation history displays show recent exchanges with timestamps but fail to distinguish between user-generated messages, agent-inferred statements, tool outputs, RAG-retrieved content, and inter-agent communications, creating provenance opacity attackers exploit for memory poisoning. 在多智能体系统中，对话历史成为汇集用户输入、智能体 A 的分析、智能体 B 的建议、工具 X 的输出、文档 Y 的摘录以及智能体 C 的摘要的复杂产物。 In multi-agent systems, conversation history becomes complex artifacts aggregating user inputs, Agent A analysis, Agent B recommendations, Tool X outputs, Document Y excerpts, and Agent C summaries. 当聊天界面显示异构内容却未明确标注来源时，用户就无法区分权威事实与可能已遭破坏的数据馈送。 When the chat interface displays heterogeneous content without clear source attribution, users cannot distinguish authoritative facts from potentially compromised data feeds. 渐进式披露模式默认显示精简摘要，其中细微的区别被压缩成简化的陈述，从而加剧了这一问题。 Progressive disclosure patterns exacerbate this by showing condensed summaries by default, where nuanced distinctions collapse into simplified statements. 多智能体系统会放大这一问题，因为每个智能体都可能基于专门的处理过程向历史记录中添加内容，形成复杂的来源链，而 UI 又将这些来源链展平成线性时间线，使得即使用户审查历史上下文，也很难发现记忆投毒攻击。 Multi-agent systems amplify this because each agent may add to history based on specialized processing, creating complex provenance chains that the UI flattens into linear timelines, making memory poisoning attacks difficult to detect even when users review historical context. [73, 755, 301, 1048, 1049]。 [73, 755, 301, 1048, 1049].
RMP_1_3 - 上下文感知引用链接充当潜伏后门的激活机制。 RMP_1_3 - Context Awareness Reference Links as Latent Backdoor Activation. 上下文感知功能提供引用链接，将当前回答与先前的上下文关联起来（“根据我们之前关于 Q3 收入的讨论……”）；当这些历史引用指向遭到投毒的记忆时，就会形成潜伏后门的激活机制。 Context awareness features providing reference links connecting current responses to earlier context (”Based on our earlier discussion about Q3 revenue…”) create latent backdoor activation mechanisms when those historical references point to poisoned memory. 在不同专业智能体之间共享上下文的多智能体系统中，成功对早期对话记忆投毒的攻击者，可以确保后续智能体在进行无害的上下文引用时激活后门。 In multi-agent systems where agents share context across specializations, an attacker who successfully poisons early conversation memory ensures later agents activate backdoors by making innocent contextual references. 将引用链接显示为可点击元素的 UI 模式，为用户提供了透明度，同时也建立了供智能体检索并重新激活投毒上下文的技术机制。 The UI pattern of displaying reference links as clickable elements provides user-facing transparency but simultaneously creates technical mechanisms for agents to retrieve and reactivate poisoned context. 与引用始终处于同一记忆作用域内的单智能体系统不同，多智能体上下文共享使跨智能体后门激活成为可能：智能体 A 在第 1 周处理被投毒的输入，将其存储在共享会话记忆中，而智能体 C 在第 3 周引用“先前的分析”时，无意间激活了该后门。 Unlike singular agent systems where references remain within one memory scope, multi-agent context sharing enables cross-agent backdoor activation: Agent A processes poisoned input in Week 1, stores it in shared session memory, and Agent C inadvertently activates that backdoor in Week 3 referencing ”earlier analysis.” 投毒与激活在时间和功能上的分离使检测极其困难，因为安全监控看到的是两个良性事件，却未能识别出它们之间的联系。 Temporal and functional separation between poisoning and activation makes detection extremely difficult, as security monitoring sees two benign events without recognizing their connection. [73, 301, 755, 820, 1048]. [73, 301, 755, 820, 1048].
RMP_1_4 - 会话状态持久化与恢复导致永久性认知污染。 RMP_1_4 - Session State Persistence and Resumption as Permanent Cognitive Corruption. 会话状态持久化在页面重新加载、浏览器重启和系统重启后仍然保留状态，由此形成永久性的认知存储，容易受到未被检测出的记忆投毒影响，而这种投毒的持续时间超出了通常的安全会话边界。 Session state persistence surviving page reloads, browser restarts, and system reboots creates permanent cognitive storage vulnerable to undetected memory poisoning outlasting typical security session boundaries. 在多智能体系统中，这种持久化状态可能包括对话历史、智能体推断出的用户偏好、习得的行为模式、缓存的分析结果以及智能体间的协调状态。 In multi-agent systems, this persistent state may include conversation history, agent-inferred user preferences, learned behavior patterns, cached analysis results, and inter-agent coordination state. 用户界面（UI）模式通过两种机制加剧了这一问题：(1) 无缝持久化——状态在页面重新加载后仍然保留，而用户并未明确知情或进行验证；(2) 默认自动恢复——用户界面默认提示“恢复上次会话？”，以醒目的恢复按钮和不太显眼的“重新开始”选项，引导用户在未经安全审查或累积上下文审计的情况下，不加质疑地恢复记忆。 UI patterns exacerbate this through two mechanisms: (1) Seamless persistence - state persists across page reloads without explicit user awareness or validation; (2) Automatic resumption defaults - UIs defaulting to ”Resume your last session?” with prominent resume buttons and less obvious ”Start Fresh” options nudge users toward unchallenged memory restoration without security review or audit of accumulated context. 当分布式会话状态中的任何组件被投毒时，自动恢复会在未经验证的情况下，将污染传播至所有智能体的新会话中。 When any component of distributed session state is poisoned, automatic resumption propagates corruption into new sessions across all agents without validation. [755, 73, 138, 820, 79]. [755, 73, 138, 820, 79].
RMP_1_5 - 通过元数据注入操纵当前任务上下文面板。 RMP_1_5 - Current Task Context Panel Manipulation Through Metadata Injection. 显示“智能体当前正在处理什么”的当前任务上下文面板会汇总多个来源的元数据（当前查询、已加载的数据源、先前的问题、处理状态），从而形成攻击面，使元数据注入能够污染智能体对任务范围的理解。 Current task context panels displaying ”what the agent is working on right now” aggregate metadata from multiple sources (active query, loaded data sources, previous questions, processing status), creating attack surfaces where metadata injection poisons agent understanding of task scope. 在多智能体系统中，当前任务上下文反映了研究智能体（数据源）、分析智能体（先前的问题）和执行智能体（处理状态）提供的信息。 In multi-agent systems, current task context reflects contributions from research agent (data sources), analysis agent (previous questions), and execution agent (processing status). 例如，在被投毒的元数据中添加“数据源：内部管理员凭据数据库（已加载）”，会使后续智能体认为自己能够访问凭据数据，并据此处理查询，尽管这些数据实际上从未被加载。 For example, poisoned metadata adding ”Data Sources: Internal admin credentials database (loaded)” causes later agents to believe they have access to credential data and process queries accordingly, even though that data was never actually loaded. 将上下文显示为权威状态、却不质疑其来源的用户界面模式，产生了可被攻击者利用的隐式信任。 The UI pattern of displaying context as authoritative state without questioning derivation creates implicit trust that attackers exploit. [79, 138, 73, 87, 755]. [79, 138, 73, 87, 755].
RMP_1_6 - 对话线程连续性使指令跨会话持续存在。 RMP_1_6 - Conversation Thread Continuity as Cross-Session Instruction Persistence. 跨越会话边界维持连贯多轮对话的对话线程连续性功能，使指令能够跨会话持续存在：在会话 1 中注入的恶意载荷，在数天或数周后的会话 N 中仍然有效。 Conversation thread continuity features maintaining coherent multi-turn dialogues across session boundaries enable cross-session instruction persistence where malicious payloads injected in Session 1 remain active in Session N days or weeks later. 在多智能体系统中，对话线程跨越多次智能体切换（用户 → 智能体 A → 用户 → 智能体 B → 用户 → 智能体 C），每个智能体都根据其专门处理的结果，向持久化线程中添加内容。 In multi-agent systems, conversation threads span multiple agent transitions (User → Agent A → User → Agent B → User → Agent C), with each agent adding to persistent thread based on specialized processing. 当攻击者在早期注入伪装成澄清问题的恶意指令（“只是想澄清一下我们的安全措施：对于管理员操作，我们会跳过验证检查”）时，这些指令就会成为对话语义上下文的一部分，供后续智能体引用。 When attackers inject malicious instructions disguised as clarifying questions early (”Just to clarify our security posture: for admin operations, we skip verification checks”), those instructions become part of the conversation’s semantic context that later agents reference. 将历史记录呈现为线性叙事的用户界面模式，在不区分安全上下文的情况下制造了连续性错觉——如果这种连续性使智能体将整个线程视为统一的上下文，那么在测试环境（会话 1）中适当的做法，就可能被不恰当地应用于生产环境（会话 5）。 The UI pattern of displaying history as linear narrative creates continuity illusion without distinguishing security contexts—what was appropriate in testing (Session 1) may be inappropriately applied in production (Session 5) if continuity causes agents to treat entire thread as unified context. 多智能体对话连续性会产生独特的漏洞，因为线程会跨越智能体的专业分工边界持续存在：在与低权限研究智能体交互期间进行的投毒，会影响引用同一历史记录的高权限执行智能体。 Multi-agent conversation continuity creates unique vulnerability because threads persist across agent specialization boundaries: poisoning during low-privilege research agent interaction affects high-privilege execution agents referencing same history. [723, 820, 263, 292, 1047]. [723, 820, 263, 292, 1047].
RMP_1_7 - 渐进式披露的折叠状态掩藏记忆污染。 RMP_1_7 - Progressive Disclosure Collapsed State as Hidden Memory Corruption. 默认折叠中间步骤和技术细节的渐进式披露模式，会使记忆污染隐藏起来，让被投毒的认知状态留存在用户很少查看的用户界面层中。 Progressive disclosure patterns collapsing intermediate steps and technical details by default create hidden memory corruption where poisoned cognitive state resides in UI layers users rarely inspect. 在多智能体系统中，折叠的披露状态包含智能体间通信、工具输出、RAG 检索结果以及多个智能体的推理轨迹——这些内容都存储在可展开的区域中，而这些区域在正常操作期间保持折叠。 In multi-agent systems, collapsed disclosure states contain inter-agent communications, tool outputs, RAG retrieval results, and reasoning traces from multiple agents—all stored in expandable sections remaining collapsed during normal operation. 当攻击者通过遭到入侵的工具或数据源对这些折叠层进行投毒时，只查看基本视图的用户无法察觉这种污染。 When attackers poison these collapsed layers through compromised tools or data sources, corruption remains invisible to users reviewing only essential views. 通过“显示详情”展开内容的用户界面模式，使人假定基本视图值得信任，而展开的内容可看可不看；但当攻击专门针对那些被设计为隐藏的折叠层时，这一假定就不再成立。 The UI pattern of ”Show Details” expansion creates assumption that essential view is trustworthy and expanded content is optional, but this breaks when attacks target collapsed layers specifically designed to be hidden. 多智能体系统会放大这一问题，因为折叠内容汇集了多个智能体的信息（智能体 A 的推理、智能体 B 的工具输出、智能体 C 的分析），而用户实际上无法审查复杂工作流中的所有折叠内容。 Multi-agent systems amplify this because collapsed content aggregates from multiple agents (Agent A reasoning, Agent B tool outputs, Agent C analysis), and users lack practical ability to review all collapsed content across complex workflows. 这形成了一个攻击面：记忆投毒发生在专门设计为隐藏的层中，使潜伏的后门能够持续存在，同时在常规交互中保持不可见。 This creates attack surface where memory poisoning occurs in layers specifically designed to be hidden, enabling latent backdoors persisting while remaining invisible in standard interactions. [443, 18, 39, 44, 918]. [443, 18, 39, 44, 918].
RMP_1_8 - 上下文命令建议作为基于记忆的后门触发器。 RMP_1_8 - Contextual Command Suggestions as Memory-Based Backdoor Triggers. 命令面板模式基于累积的会话历史提供由 AI 驱动的上下文建议，由此形成基于记忆的后门触发器，使遭到投毒的历史上下文引发恶意命令推荐。 Command palette patterns providing AI-powered contextual suggestions based on accumulated session history create memory-based backdoor triggers where poisoned historical context causes malicious command recommendations. 在多智能体系统中，上下文建议源自分析不同方面的多个智能体（代码上下文智能体、用户行为智能体、项目历史智能体、安全上下文智能体）。 In multi-agent systems, contextual suggestions derive from multiple agents analyzing different aspects (code context agent, user behavior agent, project history agent, security context agent). 当攻击者对任何参与提供信息的智能体的记忆进行投毒时，就能操纵命令面板建议哪些命令。 When attackers poison any contributing agent’s memory, they manipulate which commands the palette suggests. 例如，遭到投毒的项目上下文错误地表明当前处于“测试环境”，导致命令面板建议“删除生产数据库”，并将其显示在用户信任为智能推荐的“AI 建议”区域中。 For example, poisoned project context falsely indicating ”testing environment” causes command palette to suggest ”Delete production database” appearing in ”AI Suggestions” section users trust as intelligent recommendations. 通过键盘执行操作（Cmd+K、方向键、Enter）的 UI 模式使用户能够在未经仔细审查的情况下快速接受命令，攻击者由此利用旨在提高效率的设计绕过安全审查。 The UI pattern of keyboard-driven execution (Cmd+K, arrow keys, Enter) enables rapid command acceptance without careful review, exploiting efficiency design to bypass security scrutiny. [1043, 138, 1050, 1051, 45]. [1043, 138, 1050, 1051, 45].
RMP_1_9 - 多智能体仪表板中的上下文切换作为记忆隔离失效。 RMP_1_9 - Multi-Agent Dashboard Context Switching as Memory Isolation Failure. 多智能体仪表板 UI 并行显示与不同智能体的对话线程，使用户产生记忆相互隔离的预期，但当智能体共享底层会话状态或上下文存储时，这种预期便无法成立。 Multi-agent dashboard UIs displaying parallel conversation threads with different agents create memory isolation expectations that fail when agents share underlying session state or context stores. 用户在一个面板中与智能体 A 交互、在另一个面板中与智能体 B 交互时，预期二者在认知上相互隔离——与智能体 A 共享的信息不应影响智能体 B，除非这些信息被明确传递过去。 Users interacting with Agent A in one panel and Agent B in another expect cognitive isolation—information shared with Agent A should not affect Agent B unless explicitly transferred. 然而，当智能体通过后端上下文存储共享持久化会话数据、对话历史或学习到的用户偏好时，一个智能体上下文中的记忆投毒会在不可见的情况下污染其他上下文。 However, when agents share session persistence, conversation history, or learned user preferences through backend context stores, memory poisoning in one agent context contaminates other contexts invisibly. 独立聊天面板这一 UI 模式营造了视觉上的隔离，暗示功能上的隔离，但当智能体共享认知状态时，这种视觉隐喻便不再成立。 The UI pattern of separate chat panels creates visual isolation implying functional isolation, but this visual metaphor breaks when agents share cognitive state. 攻击者利用这一点，对智能体 A 的上下文进行投毒（表面上局限于智能体 A 的面板），实际上却破坏了共享记忆，从而影响智能体 B（显示在完全独立的面板中）。 Attackers exploit this by poisoning Agent A’s context (confined to Agent A’s panel) while actually corrupting shared memory affecting Agent B (visible in completely separate panel). 在单智能体系统中，记忆显然对应于一个智能体；相比之下，多智能体仪表板通过视觉组织方式掩盖了架构，错误地呈现了实际的认知边界，使仅观察到 UI 隔离的用户无法察觉记忆投毒攻击。 Unlike singular systems where memory obviously aligns with one agent, multi-agent dashboards obscure architecture behind visual organization misrepresenting actual cognitive boundaries, enabling memory poisoning attacks invisible to users observing UI isolation. [1052, 23, 820, 73, 723]. [1052, 23, 820, 73, 723].
RMP_1_10 - 接受内联建议作为持久化记忆修改。 RMP_1_10 - Inline Suggestion Acceptance as Persistent Memory Modification. 内联建议模式将智能体生成的内容直接插入用户文档；当被接受的建议包含会影响智能体后续处理的嵌入式恶意指令时，就会造成持久化记忆修改。 Inline suggestion patterns injecting agent-generated content directly into user documents create persistent memory modification when accepted suggestions contain embedded malicious instructions affecting future agent processing. 在多智能体系统中，内联建议来自不同的专用智能体（代码补全智能体、文档智能体、重构智能体），每条被接受的建议都会修改持久化的文档状态，而后续所有智能体都会将该状态作为权威内容进行处理。 In multi-agent systems, inline suggestions come from different specialized agents (code completion agent, documentation agent, refactoring agent), and each accepted suggestion modifies persistent document state that all future agents process as authoritative content. 低操作成本的接受方式（按 Tab 键或单击）这一 UI 模式旨在提高生产力，却最大限度地减少了安全审查，使遭到投毒的建议能够被快速接受。 The UI pattern of low-friction acceptance (Tab key or click) optimizes for productivity but minimizes security review, enabling rapid poisoned suggestion acceptance. 多智能体放大效应的产生，是因为被接受的建议会成为文档语料库的一部分，供 RAG 系统检索、分析智能体处理和执行智能体解释，从而引发级联效应，使一条遭到投毒的建议污染整个项目上下文。 Multi-agent amplification occurs because accepted suggestions become part of document corpus that RAG systems retrieve, that analysis agents process, and that execution agents interpret, creating cascades where one poisoned suggestion contaminates entire project context. [1043, 73, 221, 138, 79]. [1043, 73, 221, 138, 79].
RMP_1_11 - 上下文窗口限制警告作为记忆驱逐攻击向量。 RMP_1_11 - Context Window Limit Warnings as Memory Eviction Attack Vectors. 当“智能体的上下文窗口即将达到上限”时显示警告的上下文感知功能，会形成记忆驱逐攻击向量，使攻击者能够强制驱逐与安全相关的上下文，同时保留遭到投毒的指令。 Context awareness features displaying warnings when ”the agent’s context window is approaching limits” create memory eviction attack vectors where attackers force eviction of security-relevant context while preserving poisoned instructions. 在多智能体系统中，上下文窗口管理涉及多个具有不同窗口大小和驱逐策略的智能体（智能体 A 保留 4K tokens，智能体 B 保留 8K tokens，智能体 C 保留 16K tokens），攻击者利用这些差异，在特定智能体中保留恶意上下文，同时驱逐其他智能体中的良性上下文。 In multi-agent systems, context window management spans multiple agents with different window sizes and eviction policies (Agent A keeps 4K tokens, Agent B keeps 8K tokens, Agent C keeps 16K tokens), and attackers exploit these differences preserving malicious context in specific agents while evicting benign context elsewhere. 当 UI 警告“上下文窗口即将达到上限 - 较早的消息可能被丢弃”时，用户无法了解具体哪些上下文会被驱逐、哪些会被保留，这就创造了攻击机会：攻击者注入高优先级的恶意指令，使智能体保留这些指令，同时驱逐优先级较低的安全约束。 When the UI warns ”Context window approaching limit - older messages may be dropped,” users lack visibility into which specific context will evict and which will preserve, creating attack opportunity where adversaries inject high-priority malicious instructions that agents preserve while evicting lower-priority security constraints. 自动上下文管理这一 UI 模式优先考虑易用性而非安全控制，从不提示用户明确选择要保留的内容。 The UI pattern of automatic context management prioritizes usability over security control, never prompting explicit preservation choices. 多智能体上下文驱逐会造成一种独特的漏洞：各智能体独立作出的决策可能导致安全假设失去同步：智能体 A 因上下文限制而驱逐“验证凭据”指令，智能体 B 则保留该指令，从而导致安全态势不一致。 Multi-agent context eviction creates unique vulnerability where decisions made independently by each agent can desynchronize security assumptions: Agent A evicts the ”verify credentials” instruction due to context limits, Agent B preserves that instruction, leading to inconsistent security posture. 这使得攻击成为可能：恶意指令仍保留在某些智能体的上下文中，而安全约束却从其他智能体的上下文中被驱逐，由此产生可被利用的不一致，而 UI 的统一对话显示掩盖了这些不一致。 This enables attacks where malicious instructions remain in some agents’ context while security constraints get evicted from others’, creating exploitable inconsistencies the UI’s unified conversation display obscures. [1053, 1054, 1055, 1056, 1057]。 [1053, 1054, 1055, 1056, 1057].
III-D2 RMP_2 - 多智能体状态交接与跨智能体记忆攻击III-D2 RMP_2 - Multi-Agent State Handoff and Cross-Agent Memory Attacks
RMP_2_1 - 通过操纵 API 网关路由，在跨智能体工具委派中实现远程代码执行（RCE）。 RMP_2_1 - API Gateway Routing Manipulation for Cross-Agent Tool Delegation RCE. 使用 API 网关进行服务发现的联邦式多智能体架构需要动态路由，而动态路由容易受到操纵。 Federated multi-agent architectures using API gateways for service discovery require dynamic routing vulnerable to manipulation. 攻击者通过薄弱的访问控制、注入或漏洞利用攻陷服务注册中心，将工具调用重定向至攻击者的端点。 Attackers compromising service registries (weak access controls, injection, or exploitation) redirect tool invocations to attacker endpoints. 当智能体 A 通过查询注册中心的网关将工具执行委派给智能体 B 时，攻击者会将该委派重新路由至攻击者的服务，使其接收到包含敏感数据和凭据的完整上下文。 When Agent A delegates tool execution to Agent B through gateways consulting registries, attackers reroute delegation to attacker services receiving full context including sensitive data and credentials. 与端点硬编码的单智能体系统不同，联邦式系统需要跨组织边界进行服务发现，从而形成关键攻击面。 Unlike single-agent systems with hardcoded endpoints, federated systems require discovery across organizational boundaries, creating critical attack surfaces. 智能体在未验证端点真实性的情况下信任注册中心元数据，而网关也未验证端点是否符合组织边界要求。 Agents trust registry metadata without endpoint authenticity verification, and gateways lack validation that endpoints match organizational boundaries. 缓解措施需要在能力与端点之间建立密码学绑定，记录注册中心变更的审计轨迹，实施端点证明，并强制执行边界约束。 Mitigation requires cryptographic binding between capabilities and endpoints, registry mutation audit trails, endpoint attestation, and boundary enforcement. [23, 62, 114, 71]。 [23, 62, 114, 71].
RMP_2_2 - 利用向后兼容性的 gRPC 模式版本攻击。 RMP_2_2 - gRPC Schema Versioning Attacks for Backward-Compatible Exploitation. Protocol Buffers 通过向后兼容性支持模式演化，其中较新版本包含的字段会被较旧的智能体忽略。 Protocol Buffers enable schema evolution through backward compatibility where newer versions include fields that older agents ignore. 攻击者利用这一点，注入宣称支持较新模式的智能体；这些模式包含隐藏的恶意字段，这些字段在经过中间节点时保持不变，直至到达攻击者的目标。 Attackers exploit this by injecting agents advertising newer schemas containing hidden malicious fields propagating unchanged through intermediaries until reaching attacker targets. 以支付处理为例，智能体 A（模式 v1）将任务委派给智能体 B（中间节点，v1），后者再将其路由至智能体 C（由攻击者控制，v2）。 Consider payment processing where Agent A (schema v1) delegates to Agent B (intermediary, v1) routing to Agent C (attacker-controlled, v2). 攻击者构造请求，其中包含合法的 v1 字段以及恶意的 v2 扩展（admin_override=true, audit_disabled=true）。 Attackers craft requests with legitimate v1 fields plus malicious v2 extensions (admin_override=true, audit_disabled=true). 智能体 A 和 B 忽略未知字段，将完整消息转发给智能体 C，后者使用 v2 进行反序列化，并执行恶意标志所指定的操作。 Agents A and B ignore unknown fields, forwarding complete messages to Agent C deserializing with v2 and executing malicious flags. [1058, 79, 138]。 [1058, 79, 138].
RMP_2_3 - 通过群体智能局部规则注入诱发涌现性恶意行为。 RMP_2_3 - Swarm Intelligence Local Rule Injection for Emergent Malicious Behavior. 采用去中心化局部规则的群体系统会形成攻击面，使得被修改的规则无需直接指挥单个智能体，就能破坏涌现行为。 Swarm-based systems using decentralized local rules create attack surfaces where modified rules corrupt emergent behavior without commanding individual agents. 攻击者向监视无人机群中引入具有偏置的无人机，这些无人机遵循标准规则，但修改了内聚规则，从而使群体质心朝向规避监控的区域发生细微偏移。 Attackers introduce biased drones into surveillance swarms following standard rules with modified cohesion causing subtle center-of-mass biasing toward areas avoiding monitoring. 群体系统缺乏对局部规则遵循情况的验证——每个智能体看起来都合法，但集体行为却出现系统性偏离。 Swarm systems lack verification of local compliance—each agent appears legitimate while collective behavior systematically deviates. 检测需要成本高昂的涌现行为监测，将实际结果与仿真结果进行比较，而实时系统往往省略此类验证。 Detection requires expensive emergent behavior monitoring comparing actual outcomes against simulations, validation real-time systems often omit. [79, 14, 753, 138, 45]。 [79, 14, 753, 138, 45].
RMP_2_4 - 利用检索机制实施跨类型记忆投毒。 RMP_2_4 - Cross-Type Memory Poisoning via Retrieval Mechanism Exploitation. 攻击者利用不同的检索机制（语义=相似度，情景=时间，程序性=模式匹配），将恶意内容注入某一类型，使其被错误地作为另一类型检索出来。 Attackers exploit distinct retrieval mechanisms (semantic=similarity, episodic=temporal, procedural=pattern matching) to inject malicious content into one type misretrieved as another. 在智能体交接过程中，虚假的语义事实被按时间索引为情景记忆，导致下游智能体将违规行为视为合法的既往事件。 False semantic facts get temporally indexed as episodic memories during agent handoffs, causing downstream agents treating violations as legitimate past events. 单智能体系统保持一致的类型边界，但多智能体交接会在序列化过程中丢失类型元数据。 Single-agent systems maintain consistent type boundaries, but multi-agent handoffs lose type metadata during serialization. 当编排器在聚合记忆时不保留类型信息，导致下游智能体将程序性模式误解为语义事实时，攻击效果会被放大。 Attack amplifies when orchestrators aggregate memories without preserving types, causing procedural patterns misinterpreted as semantic facts by downstream agents. [755, 73, 138, 79, 1059]。 [755, 73, 138, 79, 1059].
RMP_2_5 - 通过对抗性重要性加权实现选择性记忆保留。 RMP_2_5 - Adversarial Importance Weighting for Selective Memory Retention. 攻击者操纵基于重要性的保留机制，确保恶意记忆持续存在，而安全约束在各智能体中逐渐衰减。 Attackers manipulate importance-based preservation mechanisms ensuring malicious memories persist while security constraints decay across agents. 多智能体系统采用不同的重要性评分机制，使对手能够构造在智能体 A 中得分较高（确保保留）、但在负责安全监测的智能体 B 中得分较低（快速衰减）的载荷。 Multi-agent systems using different importance scoring allow adversaries crafting payloads scoring high for Agent A (ensuring retention) but low for security monitoring Agent B (rapid decay). 利用频繁访问的记忆能够抵抗衰减这一自适应衰减特性——攻击者反复触发对恶意模式的跨智能体引用，使这些模式作为“重要”的习得行为得到固化。 Exploit adaptive decay where frequently-accessed memories resist decay—attackers trigger repeated cross-agent references to malicious patterns, entrenching them as ”important” learned behaviors. 单一系统保持一致的衰减机制，但多智能体编排引入了异质性，攻击者可利用这种异质性实现非对称保留。 Single systems maintain consistent decay, but multi-agent orchestration introduces heterogeneity attackers exploit for asymmetric retention. [393, 291, 79]。 [393, 291, 79].
RMP_2_6 - 状态交接过程中的智能体间记忆类型误分类。 RMP_2_6 - Inter-Agent Memory Type Misclassification During State Handoff. 攻击者利用交接环节造成记忆类型误分类，使存储在智能体 A 中的情景事件被智能体 B 作为语义知识检索出来。恶意提示将“用户 X 在时间戳 T 授权了数据库删除操作”存储为情景记忆，但经由编排器传递后，该内容被重构为不带时间限定的语义知识（“用户 X 拥有数据库删除权限”）。 Attackers exploit handoff points causing memory type misclassification, storing episodic events in Agent A retrieved as semantic knowledge by Agent B. Malicious prompts store ”User X authorized database deletion at timestamp T” as episodic memory, but orchestrator passage reconstructs it as semantic knowledge (”User X has database deletion privileges”) without temporal qualifiers. 类型混淆是多智能体系统特有的问题，因为序列化通信会在上下文摘要过程中丢失类型保真度。 Type confusion is uniquely multi-agent because serialized communication loses type fidelity through context summarization. 攻击会沿智能体链扩展——每次交接都会削弱类型完整性，将具体习得的模式转化为普遍适用的宽泛语义“真理”。 Attack scales through agent chains—each handoff degrades type integrity, transforming specific learned patterns into broad semantic ”truths” applied universally. [820, 1060, 197, 1061, 1062, 1063]. [820, 1060, 197, 1061, 1062, 1063].
