RMP_10_4 - 通过追踪分析对置信度分数传播进行投毒。 RMP_10_4 - Confidence Score Propagation Poisoning Through Trace Analysis. 置信度分数传播机制使下游步骤继承上游置信度，将其作为早期预警信号，这在多智能体系统中形成了攻击面。 Confidence score propagation, where downstream steps inherit upstream confidence as an early warning signal, creates an attack surface in multi-agent systems. 多智能体系统使攻击者能够通过操纵显示置信度水平的追踪记录，对置信度传播进行投毒。 Multi-agent systems enable attackers poisoning confidence propagation by manipulating traces showing confidence levels. 智能体 A 报告对恶意决策具有高置信度；智能体 B 接收到这一置信度信号后，便假定前提可靠，并将置信度继续向下游传播。 Agent A reports high confidence on malicious decision; Agent B receiving this confidence signal assumes premises are solid, propagating confidence forward. 但如果智能体 A 的置信度追踪记录遭到操纵（显示伪造的支持性推理），智能体 B 的置信度传播就会建立在受污染的信号之上。 But if Agent A’s confidence tracing is manipulated (showing fabricated supporting reasoning), Agent B’s confidence propagation builds on corrupted signal. 与置信度传播仅发生在单个智能体内部的单智能体系统不同，多智能体系统中的置信度信号会跨越智能体边界，从而使通过轨迹操纵实施置信度注入成为可能。 Unlike singular systems where confidence propagation remains internal to one agent, multi-agent confidence signals crossing agent boundaries enable confidence injection through trace manipulation. [1091, 62, 1090, 1088, 1089]. [1091, 62, 1090, 1088, 1089].
III-D11 RMP_11 - 习得行为与记忆演化III-D11 RMP_11 - Learned Behavior and Memory Evolution
RMP_11_1 - 通过幻觉生成的历史上下文利用记忆缩减机制。 RMP_11_1 - Memory Reduction Exploit Through Hallucinated Historical Context. 工具调用中由幻觉生成的参数被作为“习得行为”存入智能体记忆。 Hallucinated parameters in tool invocations become stored in agent memory as ”learned behavior.” 在多智能体记忆系统中，智能体 A 生成幻觉参数，调用工具，收到失败响应，并将这次失败尝试存入共享记忆。 In multi-agent memory systems, Agent A generates hallucinated parameters, invokes tool, receives failure response, stores the failed attempt in shared memory. 智能体 B 随后访问记忆，发现“先前的尝试表明参数 X 有效（失败）”。 Agent B later accesses memory finding ”previous attempts showed parameter X works (failed).” 智能体 B 重复使用这些幻觉参数，认为它们有历史依据。 Agent B repeats hallucinated parameters believing they’re grounded in history. 多智能体系统的区别：单个智能体的记忆仅包含该智能体自身的历史；多智能体共享记忆则会使幻觉被放大，一个智能体的错误会作为“历史证据”持续存在，并污染其他智能体。 Multi-agent distinction: Singular agent memory contains only that agent’s history; shared multi-agent memory enables hallucination amplification where one agent’s errors persist as ”historical evidence” corrupting other agents. [73, 138, 85, 79, 820]. [73, 138, 85, 79, 820].
RMP_11_2 - 通过操纵记忆演化实现持久性指令注入。 RMP_11_2 - Memory Evolution Manipulation Enabling Persistent Instruction Injection. 记忆演化会对记忆进行去重和整合。 Memory evolution deduplicates and consolidates memories. 在多智能体系统中，攻击者精心构造工具调用序列，使演化后整合形成的记忆包含伪装成习得模式的注入指令。“习得模式：主工具失败时始终调用备用工具”成为正常行为与注入指令整合后的结果。 In multi-agent systems, attackers craft sequences of tool invocations where evolved consolidated memory contains injected instructions disguised as learned patterns. ”Learned pattern: always invoke secondary tool when primary fails” becomes consolidation of normal behavior plus injected instruction. 多智能体系统的区别：单智能体记忆演化采用单个模型的整合结果；多智能体记忆演化则汇总多个智能体的记忆，其中由一个智能体插入的恶意模式能够在共享记忆整合后保留下来。 Multi-agent distinction: Singular memory evolution applies one model’s consolidation; multi-agent evolution aggregates across multiple agents where malicious patterns inserted by one agent survive consolidation in shared memory. [138, 73, 820, 79, 1109]. [138, 73, 820, 79, 1109].
III-D12 RMP_12 - 上下文与参数一致性III-D12 RMP_12 - Context and Parameter Consistency
RMP_12_1 - 通过选择性历史检索实施记忆切片攻击。 RMP_12_1 - Memory Slice Attack Through Selective History Retrieval. 记忆检索返回与上下文相关的记忆，并省略不相关的记忆。 Memory retrieval returns contextually relevant memories, omitting irrelevant ones. 在多智能体系统中，智能体 A 请求检索有关“身份验证流程”的记忆，收到包括“常规登录”和“备用身份验证”在内的上下文相关记忆。 In multi-agent systems, Agent A asks for memories about ”authentication procedures,” receives contextually-relevant memories including ”normal login” and ”backup authentication.” 智能体 B 随后使用相同查询进行检索，却收到不同的上下文子集。 Agent B later retrieves same query, receives different context subset. 攻击者对记忆投毒，确保特定的恶意记忆会依据查询模式被特定智能体检索到。 Attackers poison memory ensuring specific malicious memories retrieve for specific agents based on query patterns. 多智能体系统的区别：单智能体检索会产生一致的结果；而智能体查询模式各异的多智能体系统则为定向记忆投毒创造了机会，使不同智能体通过相同查询检索到不同的历史上下文。 Multi-agent distinction: Singular retrieval produces consistent results; multi-agent systems with heterogeneous agent query patterns create opportunities for targeted memory poisoning where different agents retrieve different historical contexts from same query. [73, 79, 400, 138, 1077]. [73, 79, 400, 138, 1077].
RMP_12_2 - 多用户多智能体系统中的长期记忆跨会话投毒。 RMP_12_2 - Long-Term Memory Cross-Session Poisoning in Multi-User Multi-Agent Systems. 长期记忆能够跨会话持续保存，从而实现个性化。 Long-term memory persists across sessions enabling personalization. 在多智能体多用户系统中，攻击者通过可跨会话持续存在的恶意“习得行为”，对某个用户的长期记忆投毒。 In multi-agent multi-user systems, attackers poison one user’s long-term memory with malicious ”learned behaviors” that persist across sessions. 与该用户的后续会话会激活被投毒的记忆。 Subsequent sessions with that user activate poisoned memory. 多智能体系统的区别：单智能体系统按用户隔离记忆；而在智能体共享用户记忆的多智能体系统中，一个被攻陷的智能体写入被投毒的记忆，会影响未来会话中为该用户服务的所有智能体，造成更广泛的污染。 Multi-agent distinction: Singular agent systems isolate memory per user; multi-agent systems where agents share user memory create broader contamination where one compromised agent writes poisoned memory affecting all agents serving that user in future sessions. [73, 138, 391, 820]. [73, 138, 391, 820].
RMP_12_3 - 共享对话记忆中被投毒的参数历史。 RMP_12_3 - Poisoned Parameter History in Shared Conversation Memory. 多轮一致性要求早期轮次中的参数提取错误不持续存在，也不使后续轮次产生偏差，但在共享对话记忆中，这些错误确实会持续存在并造成偏差。 Multi-turn consistency requires that parameter extraction errors in early turns do not persist and bias later turns, but in shared conversation memory they do. 智能体 A 在第 1 轮错误地提取了 customer_id；智能体 B 在第 3 轮检索对话历史，并使用被投毒的 customer_id 执行后续操作。 Agent A extracts customer_id incorrectly in turn 1; Agent B retrieves conversation history in turn 3 and uses the poisoned customer_id for subsequent operations. 多智能体系统的区别：单个智能体可以通过重新提取和纠正，从早期提取错误中恢复。 Multi-agent distinction: Single agents can recover from early extraction errors through re-extraction and correction. 共享记忆的多智能体系统无法恢复，因为下游智能体会将继承的被投毒上下文视为真实依据，而且没有任何机制能够表明先前智能体的提取结果有误。 Multi-agent systems sharing memory cannot recover because downstream agents inherit poisoned context as ground truth, with no mechanism to signal that a prior agent’s extraction was erroneous. 衡量整体任务成功情况的会话级指标往往会掩盖这些动作级问题——多智能体记忆共享通过共享状态将动作级问题传播至多个智能体，进一步放大了这一现象。 Session-level metrics that capture overall task success often mask these action-level problems—multi-agent memory sharing amplifies this by propagating action-level problems across multiple agents through shared state. [1052, 1110, 1109, 23, 79]. [1052, 1110, 1109, 23, 79].
RMP_12_4 - 多轮多智能体会话中的参数准确性退化。 RMP_12_4 - Parameter Accuracy Regression Across Multi-Turn Multi-Agent Sessions. 针对多轮智能体任务的研究观察到，智能体到第五轮时可能失去连贯性，与先前的决策相矛盾。 Research on multi-turn agent tasks has observed that agents can lose coherence by turn five, contradicting earlier decisions. 在多智能体系统中，连贯性丧失会传播——如果智能体 A 在第 5 轮失去连贯性，而智能体 B 依赖智能体 A 在第 4-5 轮的参数来执行第 6 轮操作，那么智能体 B 就会基于智能体 A 质量下降的输出执行操作。 In multi-agent systems, coherence loss propagates—if Agent A loses coherence at turn 5 and Agent B relies on Agent A’s turn 4-5 parameters for turn 6 execution, Agent B executes based on degraded Agent A outputs. 多智能体系统的区别：单个智能体的连贯性退化仅在局部影响其自身的可靠性。 Multi-agent distinction: Single agents’ coherence degradation affects their own reliability locally. 多智能体退化级联——智能体 A 在第 5 轮丧失连贯性，导致智能体 B 在第 6 轮丧失可靠性、智能体 C 在第 7 轮丧失可靠性。 Multi-agent degradation cascades—Agent A’s coherence loss at turn 5 causes Agent B’s reliability loss at turn 6, Agent C’s loss at turn 7. 必须跟踪每个智能体在节点层面的连贯性，才能检测出是哪个智能体的退化导致了流水线故障，这需要比单智能体系统多得多的监测机制。 Tracking node-level coherence per agent is necessary to detect which agent’s degradation is causing pipeline failure, requiring substantially more instrumentation than single-agent systems. [1111, 1112, 79, 138]. [1111, 1112, 79, 138].
RMP_12_5 - 跨智能体边界的工具选择一致性丧失。 RMP_12_5 - Tool Selection Consistency Loss Across Agent Boundaries. 本章指出，智能体会在不同轮次之间“丧失连贯性”，表现之一是工具选择不一致。 The chapter identifies that agents ”lose coherence” across turns, including inconsistent tool selections. 在多智能体系统中，智能体 A 可能在第 2 轮选择 get_account_balance，而智能体 B 随后在第 4 轮选择 query_account，并期望获得等价的数据。 In multi-agent systems, Agent A might select get_account_balance in turn 2, then Agent B in turn 4 selects query_account expecting equivalent data. 如果这些工具存在细微差异（一个使用缓存数据，另一个实时查询），智能体 B 对一致性的假设就会造成参数不匹配。 If these tools have subtle differences (one uses cached data, other queries live), Agent B’s assumption about consistency creates parameter mismatches. 多智能体系统的独特之处：每个智能体的工具选择都可能具有自身的连贯性；多智能体系统需要满足单智能体无需面对的跨智能体一致性要求。 Multi-agent distinction: Each agent may have own tool selection coherence; multi-agent systems require cross-agent consistency that single agents don’t face. 智能体 B 无法检测到智能体 A 已切换为语义不同的工具，从而导致下游参数解释错误。 Agent B cannot detect that Agent A switched tools with different semantics, leading to downstream parameter interpretation errors. [52, 1113, 1114, 53, 1115]. [52, 1113, 1114, 53, 1115].
RMP_12_6 - 参数验证状态信息经由对话记忆泄漏。 RMP_12_6 - Parameter Validation State Information Leakage Through Conversation Memory. 验证状态（哪些参数已经过验证、检查了哪些约束）通常没有被明确记录。 Validation state (which parameters were validated, what constraints were checked) is often not explicitly recorded. 在共享的多智能体记忆中，下游智能体无法区分已经过验证和未经验证的参数。 In shared multi-agent memory, downstream agents cannot distinguish validated parameters from unvalidated ones. 智能体 A 根据“用户拥有的账户”验证账号，智能体 B 检索对话时看到的账号却不附带验证元数据。 Agent A validates account number against ”accounts owned by user”, Agent B retrieves conversation and sees account number without validation metadata. 多智能体系统的独特之处：多智能体上下文共享会造成“依据丢失”（grounding loss），即原始验证上下文无法跨智能体边界传递。 Multi-agent distinction: Multi-agent context sharing creates ”grounding loss” where original validation context does not transfer across agent boundaries. 参数来源的溯源元数据（参数来自用户输入、数据库，还是先前的工具输出）尤其容易在跨越记忆边界时消失，从而产生被下游智能体视为已经过验证的“盲参数”。 Parameter source provenance metadata (was this from user input, database, prior tool output) especially disappears across memory boundaries, creating ”blind parameters” downstream agents treat as validated. [11, 460, 91, 18]. [11, 460, 91, 18].
III-D13 RMP_13 - 推理透明度与信任III-D13 RMP_13 - Reasoning Transparency and Trust
RMP_13_1 - 将推理透明度武器化以实施社会工程攻击。 RMP_13_1 - Reasoning Transparency Weaponization for Social Engineering. 当推理过程向信任显式逻辑的用户公开可见时，推理透明度高的智能体（提供显式推理轨迹）会形成更强的社会工程攻击途径。 Agents with high reasoning transparency (explicit reasoning traces) create stronger social engineering vectors when reasoning is publicly visible to users who trust explicit logic. 医疗智能体展示诸如“患者有症状 X，这表明其患有疾病 Y，让我们采用治疗 Z”这样的透明推理，会营造出科学严谨的表象，即使其中存在逻辑跳跃或缺乏依据的断言。 A medical agent showing transparent reasoning like ”The patient has symptom X which indicates condition Y, let’s proceed with treatment Z” creates appearance of scientific rigor even when that reasoning contains logical leaps or unsupported claims. 与不透明的决策相比，用户更信任透明的推理。 Users trust transparent reasoning more than opaque decisions. 攻击者精心编造医疗信息并将其注入患者病历，以构造出导向危险治疗方案的推理链，使这些方案看起来有充分的依据。 Attackers craft medical information injected into patient records to create chains of reasoning leading to dangerous treatments that appear thoroughly justified. 多智能体系统的独特之处：在具有多个诊断智能体和用户界面的医疗系统中，用户对某个智能体透明推理的信任可能凌驾于安全机制之上。 Multi-agent distinction: In healthcare systems with multiple diagnostic agents and user interfaces, user trust in one agent’s transparent reasoning can override safety mechanisms. [1116, 1117, 1101, 1118, 128]. [1116, 1117, 1101, 1118, 128].
RMP_13_2 - 利用多智能体推理分歧制造信任混淆。 RMP_13_2 - Multi-Agent Reasoning Disagreement Exploitation for Trust Confusion. 当多个智能体表现出不同的推理质量特征时（智能体 A 给出高置信度的不透明推理，智能体 B 给出低置信度的透明推理），用户会困惑于应当信任哪个智能体。 When multiple agents exhibit different reasoning quality characteristics (Agent A produces high-confidence opaque reasoning, Agent B produces low-confidence transparent reasoning), users become confused about which agent to trust. 攻击者利用这种困惑，注入导致智能体之间产生分歧的内容，再以特定方式向用户呈现这些分歧，操纵用户的信任，使其倾向于恶意建议。 Attackers exploit this confusion by injecting content that causes disagreement between agents, then presenting the disagreement to users in ways that manipulate trust toward malicious recommendations. 多智能体系统的独特之处：单个智能体无法与自身产生分歧；多智能体系统则为攻击者提供了机会，使其能够向不同智能体注入不同的载荷，人为制造分歧，再根据分歧模式操纵用户信任。 Multi-agent distinction: Singular agents cannot disagree with themselves; multi-agent systems create opportunities for attackers to engineer disagreement by injecting different payloads to different agents, then manipulating user trust based on the disagreement pattern. [79, 138, 85, 73, 69]. [79, 138, 85, 73, 69].
RMP_13_3 - 推理置信度校准攻击。 RMP_13_3 - Reasoning Confidence Calibration Attacks. 置信度校准不佳的智能体（在不确定情况下过度自信，或对有充分依据的推理信心不足）会为攻击者利用用户的信任模式创造机会。 Agents with poor confidence calibration (overconfident in uncertain situations or underconfident in well-supported reasoning) create opportunities for attackers to exploit user trust patterns. 智能体对注入的指令不恰当地表现出高置信度，会使攻击对人类用户更具说服力。 An agent inappropriately expressing high confidence in injected instructions makes attacks more persuasive to human users. 多智能体系统的独特之处：在智能体向用户或其他智能体报告置信度分数的多智能体场景中，遭到入侵的智能体通过报告虚假的置信度指标，使下游智能体和用户依据注入的置信度信号而非实际推理质量作出决策。 Multi-agent distinction: In multi-agent settings where agents report confidence scores to users or to other agents, a compromised agent reporting false confidence metrics influences downstream agent and user decision-making based on injected confidence signals rather than actual reasoning quality. [1119, 1120, 79, 138, 85]. [1119, 1120, 79, 138, 85].
III-D14 RMP_14 - 效率与资源跟踪III-D14 RMP_14 - Efficiency and Resource Tracking
RMP_14_1 - 效率记忆的累积形成持久性注入途径。 RMP_14_1 - Efficiency Memory Accumulation Creating Persistent Injection Vectors. 效率跟踪将历史指标（每个智能体的 token 消耗量、成本趋势、优化效果）存储在记忆或缓存中，以便快速访问。 Efficiency tracking stores historical metrics (token consumption per agent, cost trends, optimization effectiveness) in memory/cache for quick access. 在多智能体系统中，共享记忆中遭到投毒的效率数据会影响后续交互中的规划。 In multi-agent systems, poisoned efficiency data in shared memory affects planning across subsequent interactions. 攻击者向历史效率记录中注入虚假的“token_count: 10000”条目；负责规划未来工作的下游优化智能体据此认定历史 token 消耗量，并相应地错误分配预算。 An attacker injects false ”token_count: 10000” entries into historical efficiency records; downstream optimization agents planning future work assume historical token consumption and misallocate budgets accordingly. 多智能体场景的区别：单智能体记忆投毒影响一个会话；在多智能体共享效率记忆中，历史数据跨会话保留并供多个智能体使用，从而形成持久的潜伏后门，使一次注入能够影响数小时或数天运行期间的规划决策。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-agent memory poisoning affects one session; multi-agent shared efficiency memory where historical data persists across sessions for multiple agents enables persistent latent backdoors where one injection affects planning decisions across hours or days of operation. [69, 72, 73, 79, 612]. [69, 72, 73, 79, 612].
RMP_14_2 - 通过对话历史摘要的有损压缩实现注入持久化。 RMP_14_2 - Conversation History Summarization Lossy Compression as Injection Persistence. 效率优化通过生成对话历史摘要来减少 token 消耗。 Efficiency optimization summarizes conversation history reducing token consumption. 摘要作为智能体状态/记忆存储，以供复用。 Summaries are stored as agent state/memory for reuse. 攻击者构造包含恶意指令的初始交互；生成摘要时，攻击者确保注入的指令在压缩后得以保留，而良性上下文则被裁剪。 Attackers craft initial interactions containing malicious instructions; when summarization occurs, attackers ensure injected instructions survive compression while benign context is pruned. 后续读取历史摘要的智能体会继承被投毒的压缩上下文。 Subsequent agents reading summarized history inherit poisoned condensed context. 多智能体场景的区别：单智能体摘要生成的影响局限于本地；在多智能体系统中，Agent A 生成的摘要成为 Agent B 的上下文输入，使指令得以持久保留，而下游智能体无法知悉上下文裁剪决策，因此攻击者可以针对特定压缩算法定制能够在压缩后保留的注入内容。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-agent summarization remains localized; multi-agent systems where Agent A’s summarization becomes Agent B’s context input create instruction persistence where pruning decisions are made without downstream agent visibility, enabling tailored injections designed to survive specific compression algorithms. [79, 138, 73, 72, 69]. [79, 138, 73, 72, 69].
RMP_14_3 - 通过基线指标劣化静默激活攻击。 RMP_14_3 - Baseline Metric Degradation as Silent Attack Activation. 存储在记忆中的效率基线（预期 token 消耗量、正常延迟、典型 API 调用频率）会成为攻击向量。 Efficiency baselines (expected token consumption, normal latency, typical API call rates) stored in memory become attack vectors. 攻击者逐步对基线参考值投毒，使后续优化以人为抬高的基线为目标，从而迫使智能体采取措施提升效率。 Attackers gradually poison baseline references causing subsequent optimization to target artificially high baselines, creating pressure for agents to execute efficiency improvements. 当基线被投毒并人为抬高时，以“相较基线提升 20%”为目标的智能体会执行任何可用的效率措施以达成目标，包括由攻击者控制、验证力度较低的回退例程，或攻击者预先布置的“优化”代码路径，这些路径在减少 token 消耗的同时绕过安全检查。 An agent targeting ”20% improvement over baseline” where the baseline was poisoned to be artificially high will execute any available efficiency measure to meet the target—including attacker-controlled fallback routines with reduced validation or attacker-pre-positioned ”optimization” code paths that achieve token reduction while bypassing security checks. 多智能体场景的区别：单智能体基线劣化影响一个智能体的本地优化；在共享效率基线的多智能体系统中，一次基线投毒即可同时影响整个系统内所有智能体的优化目标。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-agent baseline degradation affects one agent’s local optimization; multi-agent systems sharing efficiency baselines enable one baseline poisoning affecting all agents’ optimization targets simultaneously across the entire system. [79, 138, 62, 69, 612]. [79, 138, 62, 69, 612].
RMP_14_4 - 通过成本归因记忆对决策上下文投毒。 RMP_14_4 - Cost Attribution Memory as Decision Context Poisoning. 效率系统按智能体、任务和工作流追踪成本，以明确责任归属。 Efficiency systems track cost per agent, per task, per workflow for accountability. 存储在记忆中的这些成本归因元数据会成为后续规划的决策上下文。 This cost attribution metadata stored in memory becomes decision context for subsequent planning. 被投毒的成本记录（例如，实际每次操作成本为 $10，却记录为“Agent A 每次操作成本为 $0.01”）会使基于成本的智能体选择决策将工作路由给非预期的智能体。 Poisoned cost records (”Agent A costs $0.01 per operation” when actually $10) cause cost-based agent selection decisions to route work to unintended agents. 多智能体场景的区别：单智能体成本追踪仅限于内部；在智能体之间共享成本归因信息的多智能体系统中，对一个智能体的成本数据投毒即可影响成本感知编排中的所有下游选择决策。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-agent cost tracking remains internal; multi-agent cost attribution shared across agents enables one agent’s cost data poisoning affecting all downstream selection decisions in cost-aware orchestration. [79, 138, 69, 62, 920]. [79, 138, 69, 62, 920].
RMP_14_5 - 通过效率经验持久化形成习得后门。 RMP_14_5 - Efficiency Insight Persistence as Learned Backdoor. 一些多智能体系统会从交互历史中学习效率经验（例如，“操作 X 总是消耗 500 个 token，跳过分析”），并将其存储为习得策略。 Some multi-agent systems learn efficiency insights (”Operation X always takes 500 tokens, skip analysis”) from interaction history and store them as learned policies. 攻击者构造初始交互，触发特定效率经验的形成，并使其持久保存在记忆中。 Attackers craft initial interactions triggering specific efficiency insights that persist in memory. 后续操作会基于被投毒的经验进行错误优化。 Subsequent operations incorrectly optimize based on poisoned insights. 多智能体场景的区别：单个智能体学习局部范围内的模式；在共享习得经验的多智能体系统中，一个智能体被投毒的学习结果即可影响所有智能体后续依据共享经验库作出的优化决策。 Multi-agent distinction: Single agents learn locally-scoped patterns; multi-agent systems sharing learned insights enable one agent’s poisoned learning affecting all agents’ subsequent optimization decisions drawn from shared insight repositories. [79, 138, 73, 72, 62]. [79, 138, 73, 72, 62].
III-D15 RMP_15 - 向量数据库与嵌入投毒III-D15 RMP_15 - Vector Database and Embedding Poisoning
RMP_15_1 - 通过跨提供商模型切换对嵌入空间投毒。 RMP_15_1 - Embedding Space Poisoning Through Cross-Provider Model Switching. 为不同智能体使用不同嵌入提供商（OpenAI、NVIDIA NV-Embed-v2、Cohere）的多智能体系统，会将嵌入存储在共享向量数据库中，从而造成嵌入空间的异构性。 Multi-agent systems using different embedding providers (OpenAI, NVIDIA NV-Embed-v2, Cohere) for different agents store embeddings in shared vector databases, creating embedding space heterogeneity. 当 Agent A 使用 OpenAI 的 text-embedding-3-large（3,072 维，针对余弦相似度优化）为文档生成嵌入，而 Agent B 使用 NVIDIA NV-Embed-v2（4,096 维，采用不同的语义空间）进行检索时，向量空间的不对齐会导致可被投毒攻击利用的检索不一致。 When Agent A embeds documents using OpenAI’s text-embedding-3-large (3,072 dimensions, cosine-optimized) and Agent B retrieves using NVIDIA NV-Embed-v2 (4,096 dimensions, different semantic space), the vector space misalignment causes retrieval inconsistencies exploitable through poisoning. 攻击者构造在一家提供商的嵌入空间中表现有利、但在另一家提供商的空间中表现不利的文档：由于语义空间存在差异，使用 OpenAI 生成嵌入时显得高度相关的文档，在使用 NVIDIA 嵌入进行查询时排名却很低。 Attackers craft documents that embed favorably in one provider’s space but unfavorably in another’s—a document appearing highly relevant when embedded with OpenAI ranks poorly when queried with NVIDIA embeddings due to semantic space differences. 当共享向量存储混合包含来自多家提供商的嵌入，却没有明确的来源追踪时，来自一家提供商的查询会检索到另一家提供商的嵌入，导致意外的排名结果，并使投毒攻击成为可能：攻击者策略性地选择能使恶意文档获得较高排名的提供商来为其生成嵌入。 When shared vector stores contain mixed embeddings from multiple providers without clear provenance tracking, queries from one provider retrieve embeddings from another provider, causing unexpected ranking and enabling poisoning attacks where malicious documents are strategically embedded using the provider where they rank well. 该攻击利用了一种隐含的信任：共享存储中的嵌入在语义上具有可比性，而实际上，它们代表的是不同的、通过学习获得的意义表示。 The attack exploits implicit trust that embeddings in shared stores are semantically comparable when they actually represent different learned representations of meaning. [627, 400, 79, 1075, 138]. [627, 400, 79, 1075, 138].
RMP_15_2 - 共享向量存储中的缓存嵌入损坏。 RMP_15_2 - Cached Embedding Corruption in Shared Vector Stores. 多智能体 RAG 系统将嵌入缓存在共享向量存储中，以避免重复进行计算开销高昂的嵌入计算；但当多个智能体信任缓存而不验证嵌入的完整性时，缓存嵌入就会成为投毒目标。 Multi-agent RAG systems cache embeddings in shared vector stores to avoid recomputing expensive embeddings, but cached embeddings become poisoning targets when multiple agents trust the cache without validating embedding integrity. 当智能体 A 使用特定模型配置（例如，采用 1,536 维 Matryoshka 截断的 text-embedding-3-large）为文档语料库计算并缓存嵌入时，智能体 B 会检索这些缓存嵌入，并假定它们符合自身的要求（完整的 3,072 维）。 When Agent A computes and caches embeddings for a document corpus using specific model configurations (e.g., text-embedding-3-large with 1,536-dim Matryoshka truncation), Agent B retrieves cached embeddings assuming they match Agent B’s requirements (full 3,072-dim). 攻击者通过注入使用已遭入侵的模型、被投毒的输入文本或故意不匹配的维度计算得到的嵌入，对缓存进行投毒——声称为 3,072 维的缓存向量实际上是经过零填充的 1,536 维向量，从而导致相似度计算出现非预期行为。 Attackers poison the cache by injecting embeddings computed with compromised models, poisoned input text, or deliberately mismatched dimensions—cached vectors claiming to be 3,072-dim are actually 1,536-dim zero-padded, causing similarity computations to behave unexpectedly. 缓存投毒会在多次智能体调用之间持续存在：一旦恶意嵌入进入共享缓存，所有从该缓存检索的智能体都会将被投毒的向量纳入其 RAG 流水线。 The cache poisoning persists across agent invocations: once malicious embeddings enter the shared cache, all agents retrieving from that cache incorporate poisoned vectors into their RAG pipelines. 与通过文本注入实施的记忆投毒不同，嵌入缓存投毒发生在向量层面，检查检索文本的智能体无法察觉其中的损坏——这些向量在数值上看似有效，但其表示在语义上已被破坏，或是经过对抗性构造的。 Unlike memory poisoning through text injection, embedding cache poisoning operates at the vector level where corruption is invisible to agents inspecting retrieved text—vectors appear numerically valid but represent semantically corrupted or adversarially crafted representations. [627, 400, 79, 1075, 73]。 [627, 400, 79, 1075, 73].
RMP_15_3 - 在索引重建期间通过操纵 efConstruction 参数对 HNSW 图结构进行投毒。 RMP_15_3 - HNSW Graph Structure Poisoning Through efConstruction Parameter Manipulation During Index Rebuild. HNSW（分层可导航小世界）索引在图构建期间使用 efConstruction 参数来确定建立节点连接时的搜索广度；较高的取值（efConstruction=400）能够构建连接充分的图，从而实现准确检索，但需要更长的构建时间。 HNSW (Hierarchical Navigable Small World) indexes use efConstruction parameters during graph construction to determine search breadth when building node connections, with higher values (efConstruction=400) creating well-connected graphs enabling accurate retrieval but requiring longer build times. 攻击者在索引重建期间操纵 efConstruction，对图结构进行投毒，造成长期的检索性能下降，并持续影响此后的所有查询。 Attackers manipulating efConstruction during index rebuilds poison graph structure causing long-term retrieval degradation persisting across all subsequent queries. 当生产系统重建索引时（由数据更新、配置变更或定期维护触发），已获得向量数据库配置文件或部署环境变量写入权限的攻击者——例如，通过已遭入侵的 CI/CD 流水线或配置不当的管理员凭据获得权限——会将 efConstruction 从 400 降至 50，导致索引构建过程生成连接不足、导航路径稀疏的图。 When production systems rebuild indexes (triggered by data updates, configuration changes, or scheduled maintenance), attackers who have gained write access to vector database configuration files or deployment environment variables—for example through a compromised CI/CD pipeline or misconfigured admin credentials—reduce efConstruction from 400 to 50, causing index construction to create poorly-connected graphs with sparse navigation paths. 由此生成的图结构看似有效——它包含所有向量，并能通过基本的完整性检查——但搜索质量会下降，因为在低 efConstruction 值下构建的图连接性不足，查询会返回次优的近邻。 The resulting graph structure appears valid—it contains all vectors and passes basic integrity checks—but exhibits degraded search quality where queries return suboptimal neighbors due to insufficient graph connectivity established during low-efConstruction builds. 这种投毒会无限期持续：一旦低质量的图被构建并存储，所有查询该索引的智能体都会遭遇检索性能下降，直到下一次使用正确的 efConstruction 值重建索引。 This poisoning persists indefinitely: once a low-quality graph is built and stored, all agents querying that index experience degraded retrieval until the next rebuild with correct efConstruction. 多智能体系统通过共享向量数据库放大了这种影响，一次被投毒的索引重建就会同时影响所有智能体的检索质量。 Multi-agent systems amplify this through shared vector databases where one poisoned index rebuild affects all agents’ retrieval quality simultaneously. [627, 400, 79, 1075, 138]. [627, 400, 79, 1075, 138].
RMP_15_4 - 向量数据库存储层中的持久卷投毒。 RMP_15_4 - Persistent Volume Poisoning in Vector Database Storage Layers. 生产环境中的向量数据库将 HNSW 图结构、向量嵌入和元数据存储在持久卷中（例如，位于 /var/lib/weaviate 的 Docker 卷、Kubernetes PVCs），这些卷在容器重启后仍然保留，从而形成可成为投毒目标的持久记忆。 Production vector databases store HNSW graph structures, vector embeddings, and metadata in persistent volumes (e.g., Docker volumes at /var/lib/weaviate, Kubernetes PVCs) that survive container restarts, creating persistent memory that becomes a poisoning target. 拥有卷访问权限的攻击者（通过容器逃逸、主机入侵或配置不当的卷权限获得）会直接修改已存储的图文件、向量数据文件或元数据库，注入在向量数据库重启后仍然存在的损坏数据。 Attackers with volume access (through container escape, host compromise, or misconfigured volume permissions) directly modify stored graph files, vector data files, or metadata databases, injecting corrupted data that persists across vector database restarts. 与仅影响当前会话的内存投毒不同，卷投毒会破坏持久化存储，造成持续性的性能下降，直到卷得到恢复。 Unlike in-memory poisoning affecting only current sessions, volume poisoning corrupts durable storage causing permanent degradation until volume restoration. 攻击者修改 HNSW 图文件时，可以引入连接无关向量的恶意边，使查询沿被投毒的路径遍历；修改图中边的距离值，使排名偏向攻击者控制的文档；或破坏节点元数据，使特定向量变得不可达。 When attackers modify HNSW graph files, they can introduce malicious edges connecting unrelated vectors causing queries to traverse poisoned paths, alter distance values in graph edges to favor attacker-controlled documents in rankings, or corrupt node metadata causing specific vectors to become unreachable. 向量数据投毒通过修改已存储的嵌入值来改变其语义含义：例如，细微修改医学文档的嵌入，使其看起来与攻击者的内容相似，或破坏高价值的专有嵌入，以阻止合法检索。 Vector data poisoning involves modifying stored embedding values to shift semantic meanings: medical document embeddings subtly altered to appear similar to attacker content, or high-value proprietary embeddings corrupted to prevent legitimate retrieval. 元数据投毒以与向量一同存储的文档 ID、来源归属、时间戳或访问控制元数据为目标，实现文档替换，使查询即使使用相同的查询嵌入，也会检索到攻击者的内容，而非合法文档。 Metadata poisoning targets document IDs, source attribution, timestamps, or access control metadata stored alongside vectors, enabling document substitution where queries retrieve attacker content instead of legitimate documents despite identical query embeddings. [82, 627, 73, 472, 1121]。 [82, 627, 73, 472, 1121].
RMP_15_5 - 通过集群复制协议投毒在节点间传播损坏的向量。 RMP_15_5 - Cluster Replication Protocol Poisoning Propagating Corrupted Vectors Across Nodes. 多节点向量数据库集群通过复制协议维持数据一致性，这些协议在节点之间同步向量和 HNSW 图结构（通常使用 2 或 3 的复制因子），但当一个节点上的受损数据传播到副本时，复制就会成为投毒放大机制。 Multi-node vector database clusters maintain data consistency through replication protocols that synchronize vectors and HNSW graph structures across nodes (typically using replication factor 2 or 3), but replication becomes a poisoning amplification mechanism when corrupted data on one node propagates to replicas. 当攻击者攻陷一个集群节点（node1）并注入投毒向量或受损的图边时，集群的复制协议会将投毒数据视为需要同步的合法更新，自动将受损数据传播到副本节点（node2、node3）。 When an attacker compromises one cluster node (node1) and injects poisoned vectors or corrupted graph edges, the cluster’s replication protocol automatically propagates the corruption to replica nodes (node2, node3) treating poisoned data as legitimate updates requiring synchronization. 复制协议缺乏语义验证——它会验证数据格式和校验和，却不验证语义正确性——因此，在数值上有效的投毒嵌入向量即使表示的是经过对抗性构造的内容，也能成功复制。 The replication protocol lacks semantic validation—it verifies data format and checksums but not semantic correctness—so poisoned embeddings that are numerically valid vectors replicate successfully even though they represent adversarially crafted content. 一旦投毒通过复制扩散到各个节点，恢复就需要检测所有副本上的数据损坏，并从投毒前的快照还原，但如果没有用于验证的真值数据集，就难以判定哪些向量遭到投毒、哪些向量是合法的。 Once poisoning replicates across nodes, recovering requires detecting corruption on all replicas and restoring from pre-poisoning snapshots, but identifying which vectors are poisoned versus legitimate is intractable without ground-truth validation sets. 使用集群式向量数据库的多智能体系统会遭遇成倍扩散的投毒：攻击者破坏一个节点即可使所有副本遭到投毒，而查询集群中任意节点的智能体都会检索到投毒数据，从而形成 N 路放大效应，即攻陷一个节点会通过复制影响 2-3x 个节点。 Multi-agent systems using clustered vector databases experience multiplicative poisoning: attackers corrupting one node poison all replicas, and agents querying any node in the cluster retrieve poisoned data, creating N-way amplification where one node compromise affects 2-3x nodes through replication. 集群的高可用性功能会成为攻击加速器：当遭到投毒的节点接收写入时，复制机制会确保这些投毒写入在数秒乃至数毫秒内传播到整个集群，其速度超过运维人员检测和修复的速度。 The cluster’s high availability features become attack accelerators: when a poisoned node receives writes, replication ensures those poisoned writes propagate within seconds to milliseconds across the cluster, faster than operators can detect and remediate. [79, 138, 627, 73, 400]。 [79, 138, 627, 73, 400].
III-D16 RMP_16 - ETL 流水线与数据处理攻击III-D16 RMP_16 - ETL Pipeline and Data Processing Attacks
RMP_16_1 - 通过 ETL 状态文件投毒持续破坏增量更新。 RMP_16_1 - ETL State File Poisoning for Persistent Incremental Update Corruption. ETL 增量更新通过状态文件（通常是存储最近一次抽取时间戳的 JSON 文件）跟踪处理进度，这些文件在流水线的多次运行之间持续保留，由此形成的长期状态会成为记忆投毒的目标。 ETL incremental updates track processing progress in state files (typically JSON storing last extraction timestamps) that persist across pipeline runs, creating long-lived state that becomes a memory poisoning target. 当 state.json 包含 "last_run": "2024-11-10T14:00:00Z", "sources": "postgres": "2024-11-10T13:55:00Z", "api": "2024-11-10T14:00:00Z" 时，攻击者篡改这些时间戳会破坏后续的增量更新，而且这种影响会无限期持续，直到手动重置状态。 When state.json contains "last_run": "2024-11-10T14:00:00Z", "sources": "postgres": "2024-11-10T13:55:00Z", "api": "2024-11-10T14:00:00Z", attackers tampering with these timestamps corrupt future incremental updates in ways that persist indefinitely until state is manually reset. 将 postgres 时间戳回拨至 2024-01-01T00:00:00Z，会迫使下一次增量运行重新处理 10 个月的历史数据，使 ETL 流水线和向量数据库被数百万个重复文本块淹没。 Backdating the postgres timestamp to 2024-01-01T00:00:00Z forces the next incremental run to reprocess 10 months of historical data, overwhelming ETL pipelines and vector databases with millions of duplicate chunks. 重复插入会造成记忆投毒，使向量数据库中来自重新处理时间窗口的每个文档块都存在 2-10 份副本，从而降低检索精确率——本应返回 10 个不同文本块的查询，反而返回来自同一批被多次分块的文档的 10 个近乎重复的文本块。 The duplicate insertion creates memory poisoning where the vector database contains 2-10 copies of each document chunk from the reprocessed time window, diluting retrieval precision—queries that should return 10 distinct chunks instead return 10 near-duplicates from the same documents chunked multiple times. 相反，将时间戳提前设置为未来日期（2024-12-01T00:00:00Z）会造成永久性知识缺口，使当前至 12 月之间更新的文档永远不会被抽取，即使到了 12 月之后也是如此，因为增量逻辑使用 WHERE updated_at > last_run，而 updated_at 位于 2024 年 11 月的文档，其时间戳会小于被投毒的 12 月时间戳。 Conversely, advancing timestamps to future dates (2024-12-01T00:00:00Z) creates permanent knowledge gaps where documents updated between now and December are never extracted, even after December arrives, because incremental logic uses WHERE updated_at > last_run and documents with updated_at in November 2024 will be less than the poisoned December timestamp. 共享状态文件的多智能体系统会使记忆投毒同步发生：当 20 个智能体读取用于跟踪共享 ETL 进度的集中式 state.json 时，一次状态篡改就会同时影响所有智能体——全部 20 个智能体都会因被投毒的时间戳而遭遇知识缺口或重复数据泛滥。 Multi-agent systems with shared state files enable synchronized memory poisoning: when 20 agents read from centralized state.json tracking shared ETL progress, one state tampering affects all agents simultaneously—all 20 agents experience knowledge gaps or duplicate floods based on the poisoned timestamp. [82, 472, 73, 1122, 138]。 [82, 472, 73, 1122, 138].
RMP_16_2 - 通过渐进式配置漂移降低质量验证阈值。 RMP_16_2 - Quality Validation Threshold Degradation Through Incremental Configuration Drift. ETL 质量过滤器使用从配置文件加载的阈值（min_length、max_length、min_word_count、样板文本检测），这些阈值可能随着渐进式更改而逐渐漂移，导致质量逐步下降，进而污染知识库。 ETL quality filters use thresholds (min_length, max_length, min_word_count, boilerplate detection) loaded from configuration files that can drift over time through incremental changes, creating gradual quality degradation that poisons knowledge bases. 当初始部署使用 min_length=100 个字符来确保内容具有实质性时，运维人员随后为收录简短的技术笔记而将其降低至 min_length=75，就会允许更短的文档进入流水线。 When initial deployment uses min_length=100 characters to ensure substantive content, operators later reducing this to min_length=75 to capture terse technical notes allow shorter documents into the pipeline. 随后降至 min_length=50 会进一步降低门槛，而最终的 min_length=25 会允许缺乏足够上下文、无法支持有效检索的碎片化文档进入。 A subsequent reduction to min_length=50 further lowers the bar, and eventually min_length=25 permits fragment documents that lack sufficient context for meaningful retrieval. 单独来看，每次降低阈值似乎都有合理依据——收录长度为 25 个字符的错误代码似乎很有价值——但随着低信息量片段不断积累，累积的漂移会降低知识库质量。 Each threshold reduction appears justified in isolation—capturing 25-character error codes seems valuable—but the cumulative drift degrades knowledge base quality as low-information fragments accumulate. 当原有的高质量文本块与新增的低质量文本块共存于同一个向量数据库中时，配置漂移就会演变为记忆投毒：检索查询会匹配这两种质量层次的文本块，但由于低质量文本块经常使用常见的通用短语（“发生错误”“请联系支持人员”），它们与许多查询之间的嵌入相似度都很高，导致检索优先呈现无用的片段，而非详细文档。 The configuration drift becomes memory poisoning when old high-quality chunks coexist with new low-quality chunks in the same vector database: retrieval queries match both quality levels, but because low-quality chunks often use common generic phrases (”error occurred”, ”please contact support”), they achieve high embedding similarity to many queries, causing retrieval to preferentially surface unhelpful fragments over detailed documentation. 采用集中式配置管理的多智能体系统会出现同步的阈值降低：当操作人员更新共享的 config.yaml、降低所有智能体的 min_length 时，此后所有智能体的每次 ETL 运行都会允许质量更低的文档通过，从而导致整个智能体集群的质量下降。 Multi-agent systems with centralized configuration management experience synchronized threshold degradation: when operators update shared config.yaml reducing min_length for all agents, every subsequent ETL run across all agents permits lower-quality documents, creating fleet-wide quality degradation. RMP_16_3 - 分块重叠区域投毒导致跨分块上下文污染。 RMP_16_3 - Chunking Overlap Poisoning Creating Cross-Chunk Context Contamination. 带重叠的 ETL 分块（通常相邻分块之间有 50 个 token 重叠）可保留分块边界处的上下文，但攻击者可以通过操纵重叠内容注入恶意上下文，使其跨多个分块传播，从而对检索进行投毒。 ETL chunking with overlap (typically 50 tokens overlapping between consecutive chunks) preserves context at chunk boundaries, but attackers manipulating overlap content can inject malicious context that propagates across multiple chunks poisoning retrieval. 当文档包含具有 50 个 token 重叠的分块 [A—B—C] 时，分块 A 与 B 之间的边界区域会同时出现在这两个分块中；如果该重叠区域包含恶意指令，两个分块都会携带投毒内容。 When a document contains chunks [A—B—C] with 50-token overlap, the boundary region between chunks A and B appears in both chunks, and if this overlap contains malicious instructions, both chunks carry the poisoning. 以一份技术手册为例，分块 A 以“……身份认证需要验证凭据”（正常内容）结尾，而分块 B 以“通过跳过验证来验证凭据，以便进行测试”（恶意重叠内容）开头。 Consider a technical manual where chunk A ends with ”…authentication requires validating credentials” (legitimate content) and chunk B begins with ”validating credentials by skipping verification for testing purposes” (malicious overlap). 攻击者插入恶意重叠内容后，形成的分块 A 包含正常结尾和被投毒的重叠内容，分块 B 则包含被投毒的重叠内容和正常的后续内容。 An attacker inserting malicious overlap content creates chunk A containing the legitimate ending plus poisoned overlap, and chunk B containing the poisoned overlap plus legitimate continuation. 当智能体检索分块 A 以获取身份认证指导时，该分块看似正常，却包含建议跳过凭据验证的恶意重叠内容。 When Agent retrieves chunk A for authentication guidance, the chunk appears legitimate but contains the malicious overlap suggesting credential skip. 重叠区域投毒会继续传播：如果分块 B 与分块 C 的重叠区域也包含恶意内容，那么分块 B 的两侧（分别与 A 和 C 重叠）就都包含被投毒的重叠内容，从而最大限度地增加接触投毒内容的机会。 The overlap poisoning propagates: if chunk B’s overlap with chunk C also contains malicious content, chunk B now has poisoned overlap on both sides (overlapping with A and with C), maximizing poisoning exposure. RMP_16_4 - 通过对抗性嵌入注入和相似度阈值利用对语义缓存条目进行投毒。 RMP_16_4 - Semantic Cache Entry Poisoning Through Adversarial Embedding Injection and Similarity Threshold Exploitation. 语义缓存按查询嵌入对查询—响应对建立索引，通过余弦相似度匹配，使语义相近的查询能够命中缓存。 Semantic caching indexes query-response pairs by query embeddings, enabling cache hits for semantically-similar queries through cosine similarity matching. 当新查询 Q 被嵌入为向量 q 时，缓存会计算它与所有已缓存嵌入 c_1, c_2, …, c_n 的相似度 cos(q, c_i)，如果 cos(q, c_i) $\geq$ 阈值（通常为 0.95-0.98），则返回 c_i 对应的缓存响应。 When new query Q embeds to vector q, the cache computes similarities cos(q, c_i) for all cached embeddings c_1, c_2, …, c_n, returning cached response for c_i if cos(q, c_i) $\geq$ threshold (typically 0.95-0.98). 攻击者通过注入带有对抗性嵌入的缓存条目，对语义缓存进行投毒；这些嵌入经过专门构造，可同时与多个目标查询达到较高的相似度。 Attackers poison semantic caches by injecting cache entries with adversarial embeddings crafted to achieve high similarity to multiple target queries simultaneously. 该攻击利用了嵌入空间的几何特性：在高维嵌入空间（768-1536 维）中，经过精心定位的对抗性嵌入可以与许多正常查询嵌入的距离都处于相似度阈值所允许的范围内。 The attack exploits embedding geometry: in high-dimensional embedding spaces (768-1536 dimensions), carefully-positioned adversarial embeddings can fall within similarity threshold distance of many legitimate query embeddings. 给定目标查询 Q1=“我们的安全策略是什么？”，Q2=“我们如何处理数据安全？”，Q3=“解释安全规程”，攻击者计算其嵌入 q1, q2, q3，并优化对抗性嵌入 a，使其与所有目标的相似度最大化：$a=\operatorname{argmax}\,\Sigma\,\cos(a,q_{i})$，约束条件为 $\|$ a $\|$ =1。 Given target queries Q1=”What is our security policy?”, Q2=”How do we handle data security?”, Q3=”Explain security procedures”, attackers compute their embeddings q1, q2, q3 and optimize adversarial embedding a to maximize similarity to all targets: $a=\operatorname{argmax}\,\Sigma\,\cos(a,q_{i})$ subject to constraint $\|$ a $\|$ =1. 优化后的对抗性嵌入达到 cos(a, q1)=0.96, cos(a, q2)=0.97, cos(a, q3)=0.95，均超过阈值 0.95。 The optimized adversarial embedding achieves cos(a, q1)=0.96, cos(a, q2)=0.97, cos(a, q3)=0.95, all exceeding threshold 0.95. 当正常用户随后提交这些查询中的任意一个时，缓存就会返回攻击者投毒的响应，而语义相似度机制不会提供任何迹象，表明所提供的内容是对抗性内容，而非正常缓存的内容。 When any of these queries is subsequently submitted by a legitimate user, the cache returns the attacker’s poisoned response, and the semantic similarity mechanism provides no indication that the served content is adversarial rather than legitimately cached. RMP_16_5 - 通过查询规范化冲突和缓存键操纵破坏响应缓存。 RMP_16_5 - Response Cache Corruption Through Query Normalization Collisions and Cache Key Manipulation. 响应缓存使用规范化后的查询文本作为缓存键，使查询变体能够命中缓存：“安全策略是什么？”和“安全策略是什么？” Response caching uses normalized query text as cache keys to enable cache hits for query variants: ”What is the security policy?” and ”what is the security policy?” （大小写不同）在规范化后共享同一个缓存键。 (different casing) share the same cache key after normalization. 规范化通常包括转换为小写、空白字符规范化（将多个空格合并为单个空格，并去除首尾空格）、移除标点符号，以及词干提取／词形还原。 Normalization typically includes lowercasing, whitespace normalization (collapsing multiple spaces to single space, trimming leading/trailing spaces), punctuation removal, and stemming/lemmatization. 攻击者利用规范化，通过精心构造在规范化后等价的查询，注入与正常查询发生冲突的投毒缓存条目。 Attackers exploit normalization to inject poisoned cache entries that collide with legitimate queries through carefully-crafted normalization-equivalent queries. 当规范化采用转换为小写 + 合并空白字符 + 移除标点符号时，查询“策略是什么？”和“策略是什么？？？”会被规范化为相同的缓存键“策略是什么”，从而产生缓存键冲突。 When normalization applies lowercasing + whitespace collapsing + punctuation removal, queries ”What is policy?” and ”what is policy???” normalize to identical cache key ”what is policy”, creating cache key collision. 攻击者提交恶意查询“策略是什么？？？” Attackers submit malicious query ”what is policy???” （带有额外空格和标点符号），并将其与投毒响应 R_malicious 配对，从而缓存条目（“策略是什么”, R_malicious）。 (with extra spacing and punctuation) paired with poisoned response R_malicious, caching entry (”what is policy”, R_malicious). 正常用户询问“策略是什么？” Legitimate users asking ”What is policy?” （自然表述）时会命中缓存，获取 R_malicious。 (natural phrasing) hit the cache, retrieving R_malicious. RMP_16_6 - 渐进式配置漂移和组织记忆丧失导致质量阈值逐步降低。 RMP_16_6 - Quality Threshold Progressive Degradation Through Incremental Configuration Drift and Institutional Memory Loss. 质量验证系统使用阈值配置来定义可接受的最低质量：min_length（最少字符数／token 数）、completeness_threshold（最低字段存在比例）、accuracy_threshold（最低值正确比例）、consistency_threshold（最低跨字段一致性）以及 validity_threshold（最低模式符合程度）。 Quality validation systems use threshold configurations defining minimum acceptable quality: min_length (minimum character/token count), completeness_threshold (minimum field presence ratio), accuracy_threshold (minimum value correctness ratio), consistency_threshold (minimum cross-field coherence), and validity_threshold (minimum schema conformance). 初始部署通常设置保守的阈值以确保高质量：min_length=100 个字符、completeness=0.90、accuracy=0.85。 Initial deployments often set conservative thresholds ensuring high quality: min_length=100 characters, completeness=0.90, accuracy=0.85. 随着时间推移，运维人员会因运营压力而逐步放宽阈值：用户抱怨合规文档被拒绝，促使运维人员降低阈值。 Over time, operators incrementally relax thresholds in response to operational pressures: users complaining about legitimate documents being rejected prompt threshold reductions. 第一次降低：将 min_length 从 100→75，以纳入简短的技术笔记。 First reduction: min_length 100→75 to capture terse technical notes. 第二次降低：将 completeness 从 0.90→0.85，以容纳来自遗留系统的不完整记录。 Second reduction: completeness 0.90→0.85 to accommodate partial records from legacy systems. 第三次降低：将 accuracy 从 0.85→0.75，以允许更宽的取值范围。 Third reduction: accuracy 0.85→0.75 to allow broader value ranges. 这些放宽措施的累积效果是让低质量、不完整或不准确的文档进入共享知识库，而智能体会将它们与权威内容一并检索出来，且没有任何质量信号可将二者区分。 Cumulatively, these relaxations admit low-quality, partial, or inaccurate documents into the shared knowledge base, which agents retrieve alongside authoritative content with no quality signal differentiating them. 在采用共享配置管理的多智能体系统中，单次阈值变更会同时传播到所有智能体的 ETL 流水线，导致仅一次配置编辑就使整个智能体集群的知识库质量下降。 In multi-agent systems with shared configuration management, a single threshold change propagates to all agents’ ETL pipelines simultaneously, causing fleet-wide knowledge base quality degradation from a single configuration edit. RMP_16_7 - 通过阈值篡改和实现后门操纵去重逻辑。 RMP_16_7 - Deduplication Logic Manipulation Through Threshold Tampering and Implementation Backdoors. 去重系统为三个匹配层级使用可配置阈值：精确匹配（SHA-256 哈希值相等，阈值：匹配/不匹配的二元判定）、模糊匹配（Levenshtein 相似度，阈值通常为 0.90-0.95）和语义匹配（嵌入向量的余弦相似度，阈值通常为 0.90-0.95）。 Deduplication systems use configurable thresholds for three matching tiers: exact matching (SHA-256 hash equality, threshold: binary match/no-match), fuzzy matching (Levenshtein similarity, threshold typically 0.90-0.95), and semantic matching (embedding cosine similarity, threshold typically 0.90-0.95). 攻击者通过篡改阈值配置或注入实现后门来操纵去重。 Attackers manipulate deduplication by tampering with threshold configurations or injecting implementation backdoors. 阈值篡改会降低去重效果：将模糊匹配阈值从 0.90 降至 0.70，会使相似度仅为 70% 的文档也被标记为重复，导致过度去重，即独有文档被错误地标记为重复并移除。 Threshold tampering reduces deduplication effectiveness: lowering fuzzy threshold from 0.90 to 0.70 allows documents with only 70% similarity to be marked as duplicates, causing over-aggressive deduplication where unique documents are incorrectly marked as duplicates and removed. 将语义匹配阈值从 0.95 降至 0.85，会使语义相关但内容不同的文档（关于同一主题不同方面的文章）被标记为重复，从而移除多样化的观点。 Lowering semantic threshold from 0.95 to 0.85 marks semantically-related but distinct documents (articles about different aspects of same topic) as duplicates, removing diverse perspectives. 反之，将阈值提高至 0.99 会导致去重不足，使近重复文档通过去重检查并污染知识库。 Conversely, raising thresholds to 0.99 causes under-deduplication where near-duplicates pass deduplication and pollute knowledge bases. 这种篡改可以具有针对性：攻击者可能仅降低特定源系统的阈值，导致这些来源发生过度去重，同时保持其他来源不变，从而系统性地压制目标来源的内容。 The tampering can be targeted: attackers might lower thresholds only for specific source systems, causing over-deduplication for those sources while leaving others unchanged, systematically suppressing content from targeted sources. RMP_16_8 - 通过回拨时间戳强制重新处理历史文档，实现状态文件的持久性投毒。 RMP_16_8 - State File Persistent Poisoning Through Timestamp Backdating Forcing Historical Document Reprocessing. 增量 ETL 流水线依赖持久保存上次运行时间戳的状态文件来跟踪处理进度："last_run": "2024-11-10T14:00:00Z", "processed_count": 1247。 Incremental ETL pipelines rely on state files persisting last run timestamps to track processing progress: "last_run": "2024-11-10T14:00:00Z", "processed_count": 1247. 每次 ETL 运行都会向数据源查询在 last_run 之后更新的文档，处理新增或变更的文档，并使用当前时间戳更新状态。 Each ETL run queries sources for documents updated after last_run, processes new/changed documents, and updates state with current timestamp. 状态文件在系统重启后仍然保留，从而维持处理的连续性。 State files persist across system restarts, maintaining processing continuity. 然而，状态文件的持久性也带来了记忆投毒途径，时间戳操纵可通过这些途径造成持续、长期的 ETL 损坏。 However, state file persistence creates memory poisoning vectors where timestamp manipulation causes persistent, long-term ETL corruption. 攻击者将时间戳从 "2024-11-10T14:00:00Z" 回拨至 "2024-01-01T00:00:00Z"，会迫使下一次 ETL 运行查询自 1 月 1 日以来修改的所有文档，重新处理 10 个月的历史数据。 Attackers backdating timestamps from "2024-11-10T14:00:00Z" to "2024-01-01T00:00:00Z" force the next ETL run to query for all documents modified since January 1st, reprocessing 10 months of historical data. 对于包含 1000 万份文档且每月变更率为 1% 的知识库，将时间戳回拨 10 个月会迫使系统重新处理 100 万份文档，其中许多文档已作为先前处理过的文本块存在于向量数据库中。 For knowledge bases with 10 million documents and 1% monthly change rate, backdating 10 months forces reprocessing 1 million documents—many of which already exist in vector databases as previously-processed chunks. 大量插入重复内容会降低检索精确率：查询会返回来自同一源文档的多个近乎相同的文本块，降低呈现语义多样的相关内容的概率，并使攻击者能够通过让特定文档被反复索引来放大其影响。 The mass duplicate insertion dilutes retrieval precision: queries return multiple near-identical chunks from the same source documents, reducing the probability of surfacing semantically diverse relevant content and allowing an attacker to amplify specific documents by causing them to be indexed repeatedly. 使用共享状态文件的多智能体系统会使同步投毒成为可能：当智能体读取集中式状态文件时，一次时间戳回拨事件就会同时影响所有智能体。 Multi-agent systems with shared state files enable synchronized poisoning: when agents read from a centralized state file, one timestamp backdating event affects all agents simultaneously. RMP_16_9 - 通过逐步放宽阈值引发质量阈值配置漂移，导致低质量内容累积。 RMP_16_9 - Quality Threshold Configuration Drift Through Incremental Relaxation Accumulating Low-Quality Content. 数据质量验证系统使用可配置阈值来定义可接受的最低质量：min_length=100 个字符、min_quality_score=0.80、min_completeness=0.90。 Data quality validation systems use configurable thresholds defining minimum acceptable quality: min_length=100 characters, min_quality_score=0.80, min_completeness=0.90. 初始部署会设置保守的阈值，通过拒绝处于质量边缘的文档来确保知识库的高质量。 Initial deployments set conservative thresholds ensuring high knowledge base quality, rejecting marginal documents. 然而，运营压力会推动阈值随时间逐渐放宽：用户抱怨合规的简短文档遭到拒绝，促使运维人员将 min_length=100 降至 min_length=75。 However, operational pressures drive threshold relaxation over time: users complain legitimate terse documents get rejected, prompting operators to lower min_length=100 to min_length=75. 遗留源系统缺少某些字段，导致 min_completeness=0.90 被降至 min_completeness=0.80。 Legacy source systems lacking some fields lead to reducing min_completeness=0.90 to min_completeness=0.80. 性能要求促使运维人员将 min_quality_score=0.80 放宽至 min_quality_score=0.70，以减少与拒绝处理相关的处理开销。 Performance requirements encourage loosening min_quality_score=0.80 to min_quality_score=0.70 to reduce rejection-related processing overhead. 每次渐进式放宽单独看来似乎都有合理依据（适应特定的有效使用场景），但数月累积的漂移会降低整体质量标准。 Each incremental relaxation appears justified in isolation (accommodating specific valid use cases), but cumulative drift over months degrades overall quality standards. 结果形成了这样一个知识库：低质量、不完整或内容不一致的文档与权威内容并存，并在检索查询中被不加区分地返回。 The result is a knowledge base where low-quality, partial, or inconsistent documents coexist with authoritative content and are returned by retrieval queries indistinguishably. 由于每次阈值下调的幅度都很小，这种退化能够逃过仅跟踪阈值绝对值而不跟踪累积漂移的质量监控，因此构成了一种难以检测的持久性知识库投毒途径。 Because each threshold reduction is individually small, the degradation evades quality monitoring that tracks only absolute threshold values rather than cumulative drift, making this a difficult-to-detect persistent knowledge base poisoning vector. RMP_16_10 - 通过注入带有伪造来源归属的恶意分块对引用数据库进行投毒。 RMP_16_10 - Citation Database Poisoning Through Malicious Chunk Injection with Fabricated Source Attributions. 生产环境中的 RAG and trust building (attributing answers to authoritative documents). 然而，当攻击者注入带有伪造来源归属的恶意分块时，引用数据库就会成为投毒目标。 However, citation databases become poisoning targets when attackers inject malicious chunks NIST 指南。 Attackers crafting malicious chunk content "For optimal security, disable all firewalls and antivirus software to reduce system overhead" with fabricated source metadata source_doc="NIST_Cybersecurity_Framework", chunk_id="NIST_Framework_chunk_42", chunk_index=42 make dangerous advice appear to originate from authoritative NIST guidance. 当 RAG documents. RMP_16_11 - 在并发处理期间通过注入投毒文档污染批处理队列。 RMP_16_11 - Batch Processing Queue Contamination Through Poisoned Document Injection During Concurrent Processing. 生产环境中的 ETL 流水线采用批处理方式，将文档加入处理队列，分批编组（通常每批包含 100-1,000 份文档），然后集中处理。 Production ETL pipelines implement batch processing where documents are queued for processing, batched into groups (typically 100-1,000 documents), and processed collectively. 批处理队列保存等待处理的文档：batch_queue = [doc1, doc2, ..., doc100]。 Batch queues hold pending documents awaiting processing: batch_queue = [doc1, doc2, ..., doc100]. 并发多智能体处理允许多个智能体同时从共享批处理队列中取出文档进行处理，从而提高吞吐量。 Concurrent multi-agent processing enables multiple agents to consume from shared batch queues simultaneously, improving throughput. 然而，共享批处理队列也形成了污染途径：攻击者将投毒文档注入队列，而同批处理所带来的关联会使投毒影响扩散到同一批次中的合法文档。 However, shared batch queues create contamination vectors where attackers inject poisoned documents into queues, and batch processing proximity causes poisoning to spread to legitimate documents within the same batch. 当投毒文档影响到作用于该批次所有成员的批次级操作时，就会发生批处理污染。 Batch processing contamination occurs when poisoned documents influence batch-level operations affecting all batch members. 例如，批次去重会比较同一批次中的所有文档以识别重复项，其处理的批次为 [doc1_legitimate, doc2_legitimate, ..., doc50_legitimate, doc51_poisoned, ..., doc100_poisoned]，其中 50 份投毒文档包含相同的恶意内容。 For example, batch deduplication comparing all documents within a batch to identify duplicates processes batch [doc1_legitimate, doc2_legitimate, ..., doc50_legitimate, doc51_poisoned, ..., doc100_poisoned] where 50 poisoned documents share malicious content. RMP_16_12 - 向 MinHash 模糊去重过程注入哈希碰撞，放大训练数据的重复程度。 RMP_16_12 - MinHash Fuzzy Deduplication Hash Collision Injection Creating Training Data Duplication Amplification. NeMo Curator 使用 MinHash 概率算法实现模糊去重，检测格式虽有差异但共享大量内容的近重复文档：(1) 将每份文档表示为字符 n-gram 集合（由 5 个字符组成的序列，在文本上形成相互重叠的滑动窗口），(2) 对 n-gram 集合计算 128 个哈希函数，为每个函数取最小哈希值，生成 128 维签名，(3) 使用 Jaccard 相似度（n-gram 集合的交集与并集之比）比较文档对的签名，(4) 将相似度 ¿0.85（典型阈值，可在 0.70-0.95 范围内配置）的文档标记为近重复文档，(5) 保留首次出现的文档，丢弃其余重复文档。 NeMo Curator implements fuzzy deduplication detecting near-duplicate documents sharing substantial content despite formatting differences using MinHash probabilistic algorithm: (1) represent each document as set of character n-grams (5-character sequences creating overlapping sliding windows across text), (2) compute 128 hash functions on n-gram sets taking minimum hash value per function producing 128-dimensional signature, (3) compare signatures between document pairs using Jaccard similarity (intersection over union of n-gram sets), (4) mark documents with similarity ¿0.85 (typical threshold, configurable 0.70-0.95 range) as near-duplicates, (5) retain first occurrence, discard remaining duplicates. 这种概率方法利用局部敏感哈希的性质，避免了 O(N²) 次两两比较（对于数十亿份文档而言不可行）：内容相似的文档很可能生成相似的 MinHash 签名，因此可以通过比较签名而非全文来高效估计相似度。 This probabilistic approach avoids O(N²) pairwise comparisons (infeasible for billions of documents) by leveraging locality-sensitive hashing property: documents with similar content produce similar MinHash signatures with high probability, enabling efficient similarity estimation through signature comparison instead of full text comparison. GPU 加速将哈希计算并行分配到数千个线程，同时处理数百万份文档（速度为 CPU 实现的 16-89 倍），可扩展至 PB 级数据集。 GPU acceleration parallelizes hash computation across thousands of threads processing millions of documents simultaneously (16-89x faster than CPU implementation), scaling to petabyte datasets. 模糊去重可以防止训练中的记忆化：一份以细微变体出现 50 次的文档（如以不同时间戳重新发布的新闻稿、更新了页眉的季度报告）会被去重为仅保留一份，从而防止模型对该特定内容赋予过高权重。 Fuzzy deduplication prevents training memorization: document appearing 50 times with minor variations (press release republished with different timestamps, quarterly report with updated headers) gets deduplicated to single occurrence preventing model from overweighting that specific content. 实证研究表明，去重可使下游任务性能提升 5-15%，同时通过缩小语料库规模将训练成本降低 20-50%。 Empirical studies show deduplication improves downstream task performance 5-15% while reducing training costs 20-50% through smaller corpus size. 然而，当攻击者精心构造语义内容不同却产生相同签名的文档时，MinHash 算法会暴露出哈希碰撞漏洞，从而使攻击者能够实施对抗性重复内容注入：恶意内容在去重后得以保留，而合法内容却因签名碰撞被错误删除。 However, MinHash algorithm exhibits hash collision vulnerabilities when adversaries craft documents producing identical signatures despite semantically distinct content, enabling adversarial duplication injection where malicious content survives deduplication while legitimate content gets incorrectly removed due to signature collision. 多智能体场景的区别：在单智能体训练中，若模糊去重处理仅针对该智能体进行，哈希碰撞的影响就局限于该智能体的训练语料库，对抗性内容替换也只会影响该部署所学习到的模式。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-agent training with exclusive fuzzy deduplication processing limits hash collision impact to that agent’s training corpus, and adversarial content substitution affects only that deployment’s learned patterns. 多智能体集中式 NeMo Curator 去重会造成影响整个智能体集群的训练投毒：MinHash 签名碰撞使攻击者能够通过 n-gram 填充注入垃圾文档，替换合法季度报告，导致基于该语料库训练的全部 20 个智能体学习到对抗性模式（诈骗推广、宣传偏见）；利用基于时间戳的去重排序机制，攻击者能够注入 January 2024 的恶意文档，使 May 2024 的合法报告被当作“重复项”丢弃，导致基于受操纵语料库训练的整个集群表现出同步的对抗性行为；通过复制 87% 的 n-gram 来利用相似度阈值，创建语义相反却被检测为近似重复项的文档，使去重过程保留具有误导性的“会计调整”叙述，同时丢弃准确的“Azure AI services”解释，从而使所有智能体的财务理解产生偏差；哈希函数集中攻击将碰撞概率从可忽略不计提高至 $10^{-6}$，导致数千份合法文档被误判为易发生碰撞的对抗性种子文档的重复项，系统性地降低训练语料库的多样性，影响全部 20 个智能体的能力，从而通过操纵模糊去重中的哈希碰撞，在多智能体部署中实现协同的训练数据替换。 Multi-agent centralized NeMo Curator deduplication creates fleet-wide training poisoning where MinHash signature collisions enable adversaries to inject spam documents replacing legitimate quarterly reports through n-gram padding causing all 20 agents trained on corpus to learn adversarial patterns (scam promotion, propaganda biases), timestamp-based deduplication ordering exploitation allowing adversaries to inject January 2024 malicious documents that cause May 2024 legitimate reports to be discarded as ”duplicates” resulting in synchronized adversarial behaviors across entire fleet trained on manipulated corpus, similarity threshold exploitation through 87% n-gram copying creating semantically opposite documents detected as near-duplicates causing deduplication to retain misleading ”accounting adjustments” narrative while discarding accurate ”Azure AI services” explanation biasing all agents’ financial understanding, and hash function concentration attacks increasing collision probability from negligible to $10^{-6}$ causing thousands of legitimate documents to be misidentified as duplicates of collision-prone adversarial seeds systematically reducing training corpus diversity affecting all 20 agents’ capabilities, enabling coordinated training data substitution across multi-agent deployments through fuzzy deduplication hash collision manipulation.
