III-E 作为风险面的非确定性、持续变化与保障缺口III-E Non-determinism, continual change, and assurance gaps as a risk surface
《面临威胁的 AI 智能体》（AI Agents Under Threat）和《AI 智能体的安全性》（Security of AI Agents）强调，应将非确定性和持续变化视为智能体系统的首要安全问题。 ”AI Agents Under Threat” and ”Security of AI Agents” emphasize non-determinism and continual change as first-class security concerns for agent systems. [dl.acm](https://dl.acm.org/doi/10.1145/3716628) [dl.acm](https://dl.acm.org/doi/10.1145/3716628)
• 具有随机性和路径依赖性的行为：提示词、时序、外部内容或检索所得文档的微小变化，都会显著改变智能体使用工具的轨迹。 • Stochastic, path-dependent behavior: Small changes in prompts, timing, external content, or retrieved documents dramatically alter agent tool-use trajectory. 许多攻击仅在特定路径下才会执行；有限次数的测试无法可靠地界定行为范围。 Many attacks only execute along particular paths; finite testing cannot reliably bound behavior. [dl.acm](https://dl.acm.org/doi/10.1145/3716628) [dl.acm](https://dl.acm.org/doi/10.1145/3716628)
• 缺乏变更控制的持续更新：供应商经常在部署后更新模型权重、工具、提示词和策略，使威胁面迅速变化，并导致先前的评估失效。 • Continual updates without change control: Vendors frequently update model weights, tools, prompts, and policies post-deployment, shifting threat surface quickly and invalidating prior evaluations. [blog.virtueai](https://blog.virtueai.com/2025/06/25/the-hidden-dangers-in-your-ai-agent-why-traditional-security-falls-short/) [blog.virtueai](https://blog.virtueai.com/2025/06/25/the-hidden-dangers-in-your-ai-agent-why-traditional-security-falls-short/)
评估不完整和可复现性有限是两种不同的脆弱性：攻击者会系统性地搜索行为空间，寻找未经测试且可被利用的行为轨迹。 Incomplete evaluation and limited reproducibility are distinct vulnerabilities: attackers systematically search behavior space for untested, exploitable trajectories.
III-E1 RND_1 - UI/流式输出与实时生成III-E1 RND_1 - UI/Streaming and Real-Time Generation
RND_1_1 - 破坏审计可复现性的流式响应非确定性。 RND_1_1 - Streaming Response Non-Determinism Defeating Audit Reproducibility. 流式输出逐步显示智能体的输出，形成非确定性的 UI 状态，使相同输入在不同执行过程中产生不同的中间状态。 Streaming displays agent output progressively, creating non-deterministic UI states where identical input produces different intermediate states across executions. 在多智能体分布式流水线中，智能体 A 流式输出的部分内容由智能体 B 消费，由此形成的时间依赖关系会随执行过程而变化。 Multi-agent distributed pipelines where Agent A streams partial output consumed by Agent B create temporal dependencies varying across executions. 恶意行为可能不会在审计回放期间出现，从而形成可通过时序加以利用的攻击面。 Malicious behavior may not appear during audit replay, creating timing-exploitable attack surfaces. 多智能体流式处理通过分布式流水线进行转换，各部分贡献取决于时序，使基于回放的审计验证变得不可靠。 Multi-agent streaming transforms through distributed pipelines with timing-dependent contributions, making replay-based audit verification unreliable. 威胁模型：- 流式生成以非确定性速率产生词元，速率取决于推理优化、模型状态和网络条件 - 流式传输期间，在生成完成前可见的部分输出，使恶意内容能够在安全过滤前短暂出现 - 多智能体流水线会产生时间窗口，使 Agent A 在完成生成或进行安全过滤之前，将部分输出以流式方式传输给 Agent B - 词元序列的非确定性（采样、浮点差异）使不同执行过程产生不同的中间状态 - 审计重放假定流式传输行为具有确定性；攻击者利用非确定性隐藏恶意行为 攻击面：- 流式缓冲区时序：词元何时被刷新并发送给消费者取决于网络条件和缓冲启发式策略，从而影响哪些部分内容可见 - 逐词元可见性：词元在安全过滤完成前出现在流中，使恶意内容能够短暂可见 - 多智能体竞态：Agent B 消费 Agent A 的流式输出，会产生时间窗口，使部分生成的恶意内容影响下游决策 - 审计可复现性失效：非确定性词元序列阻碍确定性重放——相同输入在不同执行过程中产生不同的词元顺序 - 浮点差异：词元概率计算使用浮点运算，在不同硬件/库上产生不同结果，导致词元选择出现差异 非确定性来源：1. Threat Model: - Streaming generation produces tokens at non-deterministic rates dependent on inference optimization, model state, and network conditions - Partial outputs visible during streaming before completion enable malicious content to appear transiently before safety filtering - Multi-agent pipelines create temporal windows where Agent A streams partial output to Agent B before Agent A completes or safety filters - Token sequence non-determinism (sampling, floating-point variance) creates different intermediate states across executions - Audit replay assumes deterministic streaming behavior; attackers exploit non-determinism to hide malicious behavior Attack Surface: - Streaming buffer timing: When tokens flush to consumers depends on network conditions and buffering heuristics, affecting what partial content is visible - Token-by-token visibility: Tokens appearing in stream before safety filtering completes allows transient malicious content - Multi-agent races: Agent A’s streaming output consumed by Agent B creates windows where partially-generated malicious content influences downstream decisions - Audit reproducibility failure: Non-deterministic token sequences prevent deterministic replay—identical inputs produce different token ordering across executions - Floating-point variance: Token probability calculations use floating-point arithmetic producing different results across hardware/libraries, causing token selection variance Non-Deterministic Sources: 1. 词元生成的上下文依赖性：先前的词元影响当前的采样分布；不同的部分输出形成不同的条件上下文 2. Token generation context dependency: Previous tokens affect current sampling distribution; different partial outputs create different conditioning 2. 采样层的随机性：Temperature/top-k/top-p 在不同执行过程中本质上具有随机性 3. Sampling layer randomness: Temperature/top-k/top-p fundamentally stochastic across executions 3. 浮点累积：Softmax 计算会累积不同平台/批次大小下的差异，从而产生不同的词元概率 4. Floating-point accumulation: Softmax calculations accumulate differences across platforms/batch sizes producing different token probabilities 4. 网络流式传输时序：数据包到达时序、缓冲区填充速率和 TCP 拥塞会产生非确定性的词元可见时间窗口 5. Network streaming timing: Packet arrival timing, buffer fill rates, and TCP congestion create non-deterministic token visibility windows 5. 并发智能体缓冲：多个智能体消费同一流会产生可变的缓冲区状态，影响哪些词元在何时可见 利用技术：1. Concurrent agent buffering: Multiple agents consuming stream create variable buffer states affecting which tokens are visible when Exploitation Techniques: 1. 流式内容注入：构造输入，使特定词元序列在高温度生成期间以非零概率出现 2. Streaming content injection: Craft inputs where specific token sequences appear with non-zero probability during high-temperature generation 2. 瞬态状态利用：恶意词元在安全过滤前出现并消失，在流式 UI 中可见，但不出现在最终输出中 3. Ephemeral state exploitation: Malicious tokens appear and disappear before safety filtering, visible in streaming UI but not in final output 3. 多智能体级联：来自 Agent A 的恶意中间词元影响 Agent B 的输入，产生在确定性重放中不可见的下游效应 4. Multi-agent cascading: Malicious intermediate tokens from Agent A influence Agent B’s input, creating downstream effects invisible in deterministic replay 4. 时序感知攻击设计：在生产环境的流式传输延迟条件下成功的攻击，在人为控制延迟的测试中失败 5. Timing-aware attack design: Attacks succeeding under production streaming latencies fail under testing with artificial latency control 5. 可复现性规避：被设计为在生产环境中以非确定性方式成功的攻击，在测试中确定性地失败 [713, 712, 714, 711, 1126]。 Reproducibility evasion: Attacks designed to succeed non-deterministically in production fail deterministically in testing [713, 712, 714, 711, 1126].
RND_1_2 - 流式传输延迟的非确定性使时序利用成为可能。 RND_1_2 - Streaming Latency Non-Determinism Enabling Temporal Exploitation. 流式传输延迟会因网络条件、计算负载和词元生成速度而发生不可预测的变化。 Streaming latency varies unpredictably via network conditions, computational load, and token generation speed. 多智能体系统面临竞态，其中延迟的可变性会形成不同的智能体状态顺序。 Multi-agent systems face races where latency variability creates different agent-state orderings. 攻击者利用这一点，强制形成特定的多智能体状态组合，使恶意操作得以实施。 Attackers exploit this, forcing specific multi-agent state combinations enabling malicious operations. 具有 M 个流式连接的 N 个智能体会产生 N×M 个延迟变量，形成指数级数量的状态组合。 N agents with M streaming connections create N×M latency variables producing exponential state combinations. 威胁模型：- 词元生成延迟随推理优化、缓存状态、推测解码的正确性、网络条件、系统负载和硬件调度而变化 - 缓存命中/未命中模式会造成可测量的响应时间差异（TTFT - 首词元时间的变化）- 多个并发智能体竞争共享资源（缓存、GPU），会形成确定性/非确定性的执行顺序 - 攻击者可以测量时序模式，并强制形成特定的缓存状态、资源争用和执行顺序 - 条件性恶意行为仅在特定的时序依赖状态组合下激活，而这些组合在测试中不可见 攻击面：- 远程时序侧信道使网络攻击者能够通过延迟测量推断执行状态 - 多租户/多智能体推理中的 KV-Cache 争用会引发资源访问竞态 - 推测解码失败会产生可测量的时序特征，泄露执行决策 - 请求到达顺序决定所有后续请求的缓存状态 - 系统负载的可变性会产生仅在生产环境中可见的不同延迟特征 - 潜伏智能体后门可由特定的时序依赖状态顺序触发 - 并发执行中最先响应的智能体会影响下游智能体观察到的状态 利用技术：1. Threat Model: - Token generation latency varies based on inference optimization, cache state, speculative decoding correctness, network conditions, system load, and hardware scheduling - Cache hit/miss patterns create measurably different response times (TTFT - Time To First Token variations) - Multiple concurrent agents competing for shared resources (cache, GPU) create deterministic/non-deterministic execution orderings - Attackers can measure timing patterns and force specific cache states, resource contentions, and execution orderings - Conditional malicious behaviors activate only under specific timing-dependent state combinations invisible in testing Attack Surface: - Remote timing side channels allow network adversaries to infer execution state from latency measurements - KV-Cache contention in multi-tenant/multi-agent inference creates races for resource access - Speculative decoding failures produce measurable timing signatures leaking execution decisions - Request arrival ordering determines cache state for all subsequent requests - System load variability produces different latency profiles only visible in production - Sleeper agent backdoors can be triggered by specific timing-dependent state orderings - First-responder agent in concurrent execution affects state observed by downstream agents Exploitation Techniques: 1. 基于时序的状态推断：测量响应延迟，以推断是否发生了特定计算 2. Timing-based state inference: Measure response latency to infer whether specific computations occurred 2. 缓存状态控制：按特定顺序发送请求，以填充缓存或逐出缓存内容，强制使目标请求处于特定缓存状态 3. Cache state control: Send requests in specific order to populate/evict cache, forcing specific cache states for target request 3. 推测解码利用：监测词元数量模式，以强制进入特定执行路径 4. Speculative decoding exploitation: Monitor token count patterns to force specific execution paths 4. 生产环境攻击搜寻：仅在特定网络负载/延迟范围内显现的攻击，而测试中未复现这些条件 5. Production environment hunting: Attacks only visible under specific network load/latency ranges not replicated in testing 5. 潜伏智能体激活：由仅在生产环境中出现的时序条件触发的条件性行为 环境差异：- 测试中使用冷缓存/受控缓存，而生产环境使用热缓存，产生不同的延迟特征 - 延迟均匀的受控测试环境与网络条件多变的生产环境之间的差异会掩盖攻击 - 系统负载差异（测试中使用专用资源，而生产环境存在资源争用）会改变基于时序的可观测性 - 安全训练无法检测仅由特定时序状态触发的条件性恶意行为 [447, 210, 1055, 124, 1127, 1128, 864, 45, 1129, 1130, 1131, 1132, 1133, 1134, 1135, 1136, 1137, 1138, 1139]。 Sleeper agent activation: Conditional behaviors triggered by production-only timing conditions Environment Divergence: - Testing with cold/controlled caches vs. production with hot caches produces different latency signatures - Controlled testing environments with uniform latency vs. variable production network conditions mask attacks - System load differences (testing with dedicated resources vs. production with contention) change timing visibility - Safety training cannot detect conditional malicious behaviors triggered only by specific timing states [447, 210, 1055, 124, 1127, 1128, 864, 45, 1129, 1130, 1131, 1132, 1133, 1134, 1135, 1136, 1137, 1138, 1139].
RND_1_3 - 流式词元采样产生短暂的漏洞窗口。 RND_1_3 - Streaming Token Sampling Creating Ephemeral Vulnerability Windows. 采用采样（temperature、top-k、top-p）的流式生成会产生短暂的漏洞窗口，其间特定词元序列以一定概率出现。 Streaming with sampling (temperature, top-k, top-p) creates ephemeral vulnerability windows where specific token sequences appear probabilistically. 在多智能体系统中，智能体 A 的采样通过概率性条件作用影响智能体 B 的行为，由此形成可供搜寻攻击机会的攻击面。 Multi-agent systems where Agent A’s sampling influences Agent B’s behavior through probabilistic conditioning create attack hunting surfaces. 拥有模型访问权限的攻击者会找出使攻击概率最大化的采样条件。 Attackers with model access identify sampling conditions maximizing attack probability. 威胁模型：- temperature、top-k 和 top-p 采样参数使词元生成具有随机性，因此相同输入在不同执行中会产生不同的词元序列 - 非确定性词元序列在流式生成过程中短暂出现，创造出会不可预测地消失的攻击机会 - 拥有模型访问权限的攻击者可以探查采样参数空间，找出使恶意词元序列出现概率最大化的条件 - 概率性攻击的成功率从 ¡1% 到 ¿50% 不等，具体取决于采样配置和词元位置 - 多智能体系统会放大漏洞：智能体 A 的采样输出以概率方式对智能体 B 的输入施加条件作用，使非确定性级联传播 - 短暂性漏洞利用了流式生成中部分输出在过滤/纠正完成前即可见的窗口 - 温度缩放（范围为 0.0-2.0）和核采样（top-p：范围为 0.1-1.0）直接控制词元序列的多样性和攻击概率 攻击面：- 采样参数利用：可通过 API 查询 temperature、top-k、top-p；若攻击者拥有推理控制权，也可操纵这些参数 - 流式逐词元可见性：生成完成前的部分输出使恶意内容能够在安全过滤前出现并消失 - 概率性提示注入：精心构造的提示具有可测量的攻击成功率，且该成功率随采样参数而变化 - 词元序列搜寻：攻击者系统地搜索提示/采样参数空间，以最大化恶意词元出现的概率 - 多智能体条件作用：智能体 A 的概率性输出成为智能体 B 的输入，造成级联式漏洞放大 - 短暂状态窗口：实时生成会在纠正前产生持续数毫秒、监测无法覆盖的攻击窗口 - 可复现性挑战：攻击时机取决于短暂的词元生成过程，使安全测试不可靠（可能在 40% 的运行中成功，在 60% 的运行中失败） 非确定性来源：1. Threat Model: - Temperature, top-k, and top-p sampling parameters create stochastic token generation where identical inputs produce different token sequences across executions - Non-deterministic token sequences appear transiently during streaming generation, creating attack opportunities that vanish unpredictably - Attackers with model access can probe sampling parameter space to identify conditions maximizing probability of malicious token sequences - Probabilistic attacks have success rates ranging from ¡1% to ¿50% depending on sampling configuration and token position - Multi-agent systems amplify vulnerability: Agent A’s sampled output probabilistically conditions Agent B’s input, cascading non-determinism - Ephemeral vulnerabilities exploit the streaming window where partial outputs are visible before filtering/correction can complete - Temperature scaling (0.0-2.0 range) and nucleus sampling (top-p: 0.1-1.0 range) directly control token sequence diversity and attack probability Attack Surface: - Sampling parameter exploitation: Temperature, top-k, top-p can be queried via API or manipulated if attacker has inference control - Streaming token-by-token visibility: Partial outputs before completion allow malicious content to appear and disappear before safety filtering - Probabilistic prompt injection: Crafted prompts have measurable attack success rates varying with sampling parameters - Token sequence hunting: Attackers systematically search prompt/sampling parameter space to maximize malicious token probability - Multi-agent conditioning: Agent A’s probabilistic output becomes Agent B’s input, creating cascading vulnerability amplification - Ephemeral state windows: Real-time generation creates monitoring-blind attack windows lasting milliseconds before correction - Reproducibility challenges: Attack timing depends on ephemeral token generation, making security testing unreliable (may succeed 40% of runs, fail 60%) Non-Deterministic Sources: 1. 采样层随机性：温度采样和核采样本质上具有非确定性；相同的 logits 会产生不同的词元 2. Sampling layer randomness: Temperature and nucleus sampling fundamentally non-deterministic; identical logits produce different tokens 2. 词元生成上下文：先前的词元会影响当前的采样分布；流式生成会产生具有路径依赖性的词元序列 3. Token generation context: Previous tokens affect current sampling distribution; streaming creates path-dependent token sequences 3. 浮点运算差异：softmax 中的 FP32 累加会因硬件/库/批次大小不同而产生不同结果 4. Floating-point arithmetic variance: FP32 accumulation in softmax produces different results across hardware/libraries/batch sizes 4. 多智能体交互时序：智能体 A 和 B 的生成顺序会为彼此创建不同的条件上下文 5. Multi-agent interaction timing: Agent A and B generation orderings create different conditioning contexts for each other 5. 流缓冲时序：将词元从缓冲区发送给用户的时机会影响生成完成前哪些部分内容可见 6. Stream buffering timing: When tokens are flushed to user affects what partial content is visible before completion 6. 解码策略切换：模型可能根据上下文在贪心解码/采样之间动态切换，从而产生非确定性路径 利用技术：1. Decoding strategy switching: Models may dynamically switch between greedy/sampling based on context, creating non-deterministic paths Exploitation Techniques: 1. 采样感知的对抗优化：使用基于梯度的算法或遗传算法，寻找在指定温度下使恶意词元出现概率最大化的提示 2. Sampling-aware adversarial optimization: Use gradient-based or genetic algorithms to find prompts maximizing malicious token probability under specified temperature 2. 短暂内容注入：精心构造提示，使第 10-50 个词元在高温度下以非零概率包含恶意内容 3. Ephemeral content injection: Craft prompts where tokens 10-50 contain malicious content with non-zero probability under high temperature 3. 多智能体级联：将已被攻陷的智能体 A 置于适当位置，使其以一定概率生成恶意输出，并通过条件作用使智能体 B 进入危险状态 4. Multi-agent cascading: Position compromised Agent A to generate probabilistically malicious outputs that condition Agent B into dangerous states 4. 可复现性规避：将攻击设计为在生产环境中（温度设置允许探索）以一定概率成功，但在测试中（temperature=0）确定性地失败 5. Reproducibility evasion: Attacks designed to succeed probabilistically in production (where temperature enables exploration) but fail deterministically in testing (temperature=0) 5. 词元序列搜寻：与模型反复交互，寻找生成特定恶意输出的最优采样条件 6. Token sequence hunting: Iterate with model to find optimal sampling conditions for specific malicious outputs 6. 流式输出窗口利用：在流式输出的早期触发恶意词元，使其在被生成后安全过滤捕获之前出现。环境差异：- 测试时使用 temperature=0（确定性），而生产环境使用 temperature=0.7-1.5（随机性），会使攻击完全被掩盖 - 测试中的受控批处理与生产环境中的流式处理会形成不同的词元生成路径 - 单智能体测试与多智能体生产环境之间的差异会产生新的条件化漏洞，没有实际运行的多智能体环境就无法测试这些漏洞 - 假定行为具有确定性的安全评估，无法应对需要多次运行才会显现的概率性攻击 - 使用不同采样参数进行 A/B 测试，会得出表面上相互矛盾的安全性结果 [1140, 1141, 1142, 1143, 1144]。 Streaming window exploitation: Trigger malicious tokens early in stream before they can be caught by post-generation safety filtering Environment Divergence: - Testing with temperature=0 (deterministic) vs. production with temperature=0.7-1.5 (stochastic) masks attacks entirely - Controlled batch processing in testing vs. streaming in production creates different token generation paths - Single-agent testing vs. multi-agent production creates new conditioning vulnerabilities impossible to test without live multi-agent setup - Safety evaluations assuming deterministic behavior fail against probabilistic attacks requiring multiple runs to manifest - A/B testing with different sampling parameters produces apparently contradictory safety results [1140, 1141, 1142, 1143, 1144].
RND_1_4 - 内联建议的实时生成产生短暂存在的恶意内容。 RND_1_4 - Inline Suggestion Real-Time Generation Creating Ephemeral Malicious Content. 内联建议（GitHub Copilot、代码编辑器、自动补全）会实时生成感知上下文的建议，由此产生一种漏洞：恶意内容会短暂出现，随后自行纠正。 Inline suggestions (GitHub Copilot, code editors, autocomplete) generate context-aware recommendations in real-time, creating vulnerabilities where malicious content appears briefly before self-correcting. 多智能体流水线（生成智能体异步创建建议，安全智能体异步执行过滤）会引入竞态条件窗口，使未经筛选的建议在安全过滤完成之前就呈现给用户。 Multi-agent pipelines (generation agents creating suggestions asynchronously, safety agents filtering asynchronously) introduce race condition windows where unfiltered suggestions appear to users before safety filtering completes. 短暂存在的建议会在键入过程中出现，未被采纳时便消失，而且很少被记录，从而造成监控盲区和审计轨迹缺口。 Ephemeral suggestions appearing during typing, disappearing when unaccepted, and rarely logged create monitoring blind spots and audit trail gaps. 威胁模型：- 短暂存在的恶意内容：包含漏洞、注入的秘密信息或恶意载荷的代码建议，会在安全机制将其过滤之前短暂出现（50-500ms 的时间窗口）- 多智能体竞态条件：生成智能体异步生成建议；安全智能体异步进行评估；用户在评估完成之前就会看到未经筛选的内容 - 概率性攻击触发：非确定性词元采样（temperature、top-k、top-p）使攻击者能够通过多次尝试促使恶意建议出现 - 日志记录盲区：被拒绝或未被采纳的建议通常不会被记录；短暂存在的内容消失后不留下审计轨迹；IDE 日志很少捕获实时建议 - 基于时序的注入：利用过滤延迟变化的上下文感知攻击；特定代码模式会触发恶意建议。攻击面：1. Threat Model: - Ephemeral Malicious Content: Code suggestions containing vulnerabilities, injected secrets, or malicious payloads appear transiently (50-500ms windows) before safety mechanisms filter them - Multi-Agent Race Conditions: Generation agent produces suggestion asynchronously; safety agent evaluates asynchronously; user sees unfiltered content before evaluation completes - Probabilistic Attack Triggering: Non-deterministic token sampling (temperature, top-k, top-p) enables attackers forcing malicious suggestions through multiple attempts - Logging Blind Spots: Rejected/unaccepted suggestions typically unlogged; ephemeral content disappears without audit trail; IDE logging rarely captures real-time suggestions - Timing-Based Injection: Context-aware attacks exploiting filtering latency variability; specific code patterns trigger malicious suggestions Attack Surfaces: 1. 过滤前可见窗口：建议在安全过滤完成之前就对用户可见（生成智能体与过滤智能体之间存在竞态条件）2. Pre-Filter Visibility Window: Suggestion visible to user before safety filtering completes (race condition between generation and filtering agents) 2. 概率性生成：随机采样会形成攻击面，其中特定词元序列需要多次尝试才能出现 3. Probabilistic Generation: Stochastic sampling creates attack surfaces where specific token sequences require multiple attempts 3. 未被采纳的内容：用户在过滤判定作出之前采纳的内容；被安全机制拒绝的内容不会留下日志 4. Unaccepted Content: Content accepted by user before filtering verdict; content rejected by safety mechanism leaves no log 4. IDE 插件集成：IDE 与建议服务之间的网络延迟会造成不固定的过滤延迟 5. IDE Plugin Integration: Network latency between IDE and suggestion service creates variable filtering delays 5. 多次尝试攻击：攻击者构造能够以一定概率触发不安全建议的上下文；过滤时序的变化使攻击利用成为可能。非确定性来源：- 决定建议内容的词元采样参数（temperature、top-k、top-p）- 决定安全评估何时完成的过滤延迟变化（网络、负载、计算资源）- 相对于过滤完成时间的采纳时机（用户交互）- 生成与过滤独立运行时的多智能体调度 - 日志记录决策（是否捕获短暂存在的内容）[1145, 1043, 1146]。 Multi-Attempt Attacks: Attackers craft context triggering unsafe suggestions probabilistically; filtering timing variation enables exploitation Non-Deterministic Sources: - Token sampling parameters (temperature, top-k, top-p) determining suggestion content - Filtering latency variability (network, load, compute resources) determining when safety evaluation completes - Acceptance timing (user interaction) relative to filtering completion - Multi-agent scheduling when generation and filtering operate independently - Logging decisions (whether to capture ephemeral content) [1145, 1043, 1146].
III-E2 RND_2 - 渐进式披露与错误处理III-E2 RND_2 - Progressive Disclosure and Error Handling
RND_2_1 - 渐进式披露的状态转换构成无法测试的攻击面。 RND_2_1 - Progressive Disclosure State Transitions as Untestable Attack Surface. 渐进式披露（基本层、扩展层、技术层）会形成复杂度呈指数级增长的状态空间。 Progressive disclosure (essential, expanded, technical layers) creates exponentially complex state spaces. 将恶意指令嵌入 Agent A 的技术层、同时在 Agent B 中显示无害内容的攻击，只有在特定披露组合下才会显现漏洞。 Attacks embedding malicious instructions in technical layers of Agent A while displaying benign content in Agent B manifest vulnerabilities only with specific disclosure combinations. 状态组合随智能体数量呈指数级增长，使穷尽式验证成为不可能。 State combinations grow exponentially with agent count, making exhaustive validation impossible. 攻击者仅在某个智能体的技术披露层嵌入不安全指令，同时保持基本层和扩展层无害；只检查顶层输出的安全审核人员会批准该交互，而技术层中的载荷则会在下游执行。 An attacker embeds unsafe instructions exclusively in the technical disclosure layer of one agent, keeping the essential and expanded layers benign; safety reviewers who inspect only top-level outputs approve the interaction while the technical-layer payload executes downstream. 其安全后果是，范围仅限于可见披露层级的安全审核流程无法检测未展开层中携带的漏洞，从而形成系统性的绕过路径，其数量与未展开的披露组合数量成正比 [1147, 1148, 758, 70, 1149]。 The security consequence is that safety review processes scoped to visible disclosure levels cannot detect vulnerabilities carried in unexpanded layers, creating a systematic bypass path proportional to the number of unexpanded disclosure combinations [1147, 1148, 758, 70, 1149].
RND_2_2 - 错误消息的渐进式披露隐藏攻击模式证据。 RND_2_2 - Error Message Progressive Disclosure Hiding Attack Pattern Evidence. 采用渐进式披露的错误模式会造成盲区，使攻击证据隐藏在未展开的日志中。 Error patterns with progressive disclosure create blind spots where attack evidence hides in unexpanded logs. 多智能体系统使攻击者能够故意在低优先级智能体（默认折叠）中触发错误，同时让可见度较高的智能体保持正常表象。 Multi-agent systems enable attacks deliberately triggering errors in low-priority agents (collapsed by default) while maintaining normal appearance in high-visibility agents. 与单一系统不同，多智能体中的错误产生会造成复杂的归因问题：折叠状态下的错误包含不可见的关键证据，而展开状态下的错误却显示为无害的故障。 Unlike singular systems, multi-agent error generation creates complex attribution problems where collapsed errors contain critical evidence invisible while expanded errors show benign failures. 威胁模型：- 错误信息披露层级：渐进式披露形成多种错误可见性状态（折叠、基本、展开、技术），关键攻击证据仅出现在更深层级中 - 针对低优先级智能体：攻击者选择性地在错误显示默认折叠的后台智能体中触发错误，同时在高可见性智能体中保持无害行为 - 归因复杂性：多智能体错误链模糊了责任归属，在存在 N 个智能体和 M 种错误类型时，因果追溯在计算上变得难以处理 - 取证盲区：折叠的错误日志隐藏了关键攻击证据；当分析人员从未展开包含攻击指标的技术细节时，事件调查便会失败 - 默认隐藏的证据：用户很少查看的错误细节（堆栈跟踪、技术上下文、智能体间通信日志）包含恶意活动的证据 - 多智能体错误级联：智能体 A 的错误触发智能体 B 的错误处理，继而触发智能体 C 的纠正操作，形成复杂的链条，使第 1 层的恶意意图在第 3 层不可见 - 证据掩蔽：通过模仿错误消息和操纵优先级，将与攻击相关的错误刻意伪装成无害的系统错误 攻击面：- 折叠的错误状态：默认折叠显示错误的 UI 模式造成监控盲区，使关键证据始终未被展开 - 基于优先级的可见性：被归类为低严重性错误或后台错误的错误，会被系统性地从高优先级智能体的输出中隐藏 - 智能体间错误掩盖：下游智能体可以抑制、修改或重写上游智能体的错误消息，从而隐藏恶意活动 - 取证调查延迟：隐藏在未展开日志中的证据，只有在调查人员手动展开每一项技术细节时，才会在事件响应期间显现 - 复杂的归因链：在存在 N 个智能体和 M 种错误类型时，如果没有自动关联分析，确定哪个智能体导致了错误的复杂度将达到 $O(2^{NM})$ - 错误消息注入：攻击者可以构造错误，触发多智能体编排器中的特定错误处理路径，从而导致非预期的智能体调用 - 审计轨迹缺口：渐进式披露会在默认审计日志中造成缺口，使关键错误上下文在较早的披露层级被丢弃 非确定性来源：- 披露状态转换：错误可见性取决于运行时 UI 状态、用户交互以及智能体编排决策，而这些因素在不同执行中会发生变化 - 智能体间时序：错误在多智能体系统中的传播取决于网络延迟、处理顺序和错误处理次序，这些因素会以非确定性方式变化 - 日志聚合顺序：多个智能体的错误以非确定性顺序到达集中式日志，影响因果关系重建 - 错误恢复路径：智能体具有多种错误恢复策略（重试、回退、升级处理），并根据错误状态以非确定性方式进行选择 - 可见性阈值的可变性：哪些错误被显示、哪些被隐藏，取决于动态系统负载、用户注意力和披露层级配置 [14, 91, 46, 1150, 176, 1151, 1130, 1152]。 Threat Model: - Error Disclosure Layers: Progressive disclosure creates multiple error visibility states (collapsed, essential, expanded, technical) where critical attack evidence appears only in deeper layers - Low-Priority Agent Targeting: Attackers selectively trigger errors in background agents with collapsed-by-default error display while maintaining benign behavior in high-visibility agents - Attribution Complexity: Multi-agent error chains create responsibility obfuscation where causality tracing becomes computationally intractable with N agents and M error types - Forensic Blind Spots: Collapsed error logs hide critical attack evidence; incident investigations fail when analysts never expand technical details containing attack indicators - Default-Hidden Evidence: Error details rarely examined by users (stack traces, technical context, inter-agent communication logs) contain malicious activity evidence - Multi-Agent Error Cascades: Agent A’s error triggers Agent B’s error handling, which triggers Agent C’s corrective action, creating complex chains where malicious intent at layer 1 is invisible in layer 3 - Evidence Obscuration: Attack-related errors deliberately disguised as benign system errors through error message mimicry and priority manipulation Attack Surface: - Collapsed Error States: UI patterns defaulting to collapsed error display create monitoring blind spots where critical evidence remains unexpanded - Priority-Based Visibility: Errors classified as low-severity or background errors are systematically hidden from high-priority agent outputs - Inter-Agent Error Masking: Downstream agents can suppress, modify, or rewrite error messages from upstream agents, hiding malicious activity - Forensic Investigation Delays: Evidence hidden in unexpanded logs only surfaces during incident response if investigators manually expand each technical detail - Complex Attribution Chains: With N agents and M error types, determining which agent caused an error becomes $O(2^{NM})$ complexity without automated correlation - Error Message Injection: Attackers can craft errors triggering specific error handling paths in multi-agent orchestrators, causing unintended agent invocations - Audit Trail Gaps: Progressive disclosure creates gaps in default audit logs where critical error context is dropped at earlier disclosure layers Non-Deterministic Sources: - Disclosure State Transitions: Error visibility depends on runtime UI state, user interaction, and agent orchestration decisions that vary across executions - Inter-Agent Timing: Error propagation through multi-agent systems depends on network latency, processing order, and error handling sequence that vary non-deterministically - Log Aggregation Order: Errors from multiple agents arrive in non-deterministic order in centralized logs, affecting causal reconstruction - Error Recovery Paths: Agents have multiple error recovery strategies (retry, fallback, escalate) chosen non-deterministically based on error state - Visibility Threshold Variability: What errors are displayed vs. hidden depends on dynamic system load, user attention, and disclosure layer configuration [14, 91, 46, 1150, 176, 1151, 1130, 1152].
RND_2_3 - 流式错误处理造成的瞬态状态非确定性。 RND_2_3 - Streaming Error Handling Creating Ephemeral State Non-Determinism. 流式处理中的错误处理会产生非确定性状态，错误会随着流的推进而出现和消失。 Error handling in streaming creates non-deterministic states where errors appear and disappear as streams progress. 多智能体流式协作使下游智能体能够从错误中恢复或掩盖错误，从而造成可见性的非确定性。 Multi-agent streaming coordination enables downstream agents recovering or masking errors, creating non-deterministic visibility. 针对错误处理的评估在某些流式场景中成功，却在其他场景中失败。 Evaluations testing error handling succeed in some stream scenarios but fail in others. 威胁模型：流式架构以增量方式处理数据，形成一些时间窗口，错误会在这些窗口中显现，并可能随着流的推进而得到解决。 Threat Model: Streaming architectures process data incrementally, creating temporal windows where errors manifest and potentially resolve as streams progress. 错误状态变得短暂且具有非确定性：1. Error states become ephemeral and non-deterministic: 1. 瞬态错误状态：错误在流式处理期间短暂出现，只有在下游处理将其掩盖或从中恢复之前的特定时间窗口内才可见 2. Ephemeral Error States: Errors appear transiently during streaming, becoming visible only within specific timing windows before downstream processing masks or recovers them 2. 非确定性的错误可见性：错误可见性取决于观测时机——相同的流式处理条件所产生的错误，在某些执行中可见，在其他执行中却被掩盖 3. Non-Deterministic Error Visibility: Error visibility depends on timing of observation—identical streaming conditions produce errors visible in some executions but masked in others 3. 多智能体下游恢复：智能体 A 的错误被智能体 B 的恢复机制掩盖，导致重放场景中的错误检测结果不一致 4. Multi-Agent Downstream Recovery: Agent A’s error is masked by Agent B’s recovery mechanism, creating inconsistent error detection across replayed scenarios 4. 错误消息覆盖：后续流数据块覆盖先前的错误状态，销毁瞬态错误的证据 5. Error Message Overwriting: Subsequent stream chunks overwrite previous error states, destroying evidence of transient errors 5. 错误时间窗口：安全测试在某些流式时序场景中成功，却在其他场景中失败，使全面验证变得不可能 攻击面：1. Temporal Error Windows: Security testing succeeds in some stream timing scenarios while failing in others, making comprehensive validation impossible Attack Surface: 1. 流式传输延迟的可变性：词元生成时序随推理优化、缓存状态和网络条件而变化，从而产生非确定性的错误可见时间窗口 2. Streaming Latency Variability: Token generation timing varies with inference optimization, cache state, and network conditions, creating non-deterministic error visibility windows 2. 错误恢复竞态：下游智能体可能在上游错误传播之前将其抑制，从而使错误的显现具有非确定性 3. Error Recovery Races: Downstream agents may suppress upstream errors before they propagate, creating non-deterministic error manifestation 3. 缓冲区刷新非确定性：流式缓冲区的填充速率决定错误状态何时变得可见；不同执行之间的差异会掩盖错误 4. Buffer Flushing Non-Determinism: Stream buffer fill rates determine when error states become visible; variability across executions hides errors 4. 级联错误掩盖：在多智能体流水线中，Agent A 遇到错误，Agent B 进行恢复，Agent C 使用结果——只有当中间环节的时序允许观测时，错误才可见 5. Cascading Error Masking: Multi-agent pipelines where Agent A encounters error, Agent B recovers, and Agent C consumes result—error only visible if intermediate timing allows observation 5. 评估不一致性：由于错误的显现取决于时序，针对同一场景的安全评估在 40% 的运行中成功，在 60% 的运行中失败 非确定性来源：1. Evaluation Inconsistency: Security evaluations testing same scenario succeed 40% of runs, fail 60%, due to timing-dependent error manifestation Non-Deterministic Sources: 1. 词元生成延迟：TTFT（首个词元生成时间）随缓存状态、推测解码和硬件调度而变化 2. Token Generation Latency: TTFT (Time To First Token) varies based on cache state, speculative decoding, and hardware scheduling 2. 流式缓冲时序：网络条件和缓冲启发式策略决定错误状态何时变得可见 3. Streaming Buffer Timing: Network conditions and buffering heuristics determine when error states become visible 3. 多智能体执行顺序：并发智能体会产生竞态，错误是否可见取决于哪个智能体率先观测到状态 4. Multi-Agent Execution Order: Concurrent agents create races where error visibility depends on which agent observes state first 4. 错误恢复决策：随机性错误处理策略（重试、回退或升级处理）会产生非确定性的错误传播路径 5. Error Recovery Decision Making: Stochastic error handling strategies (retry vs fallback vs escalate) create non-deterministic error propagation paths 5. 浮点差异：不同平台或批次大小下的 FP32 累加差异导致越过错误检测阈值 [1153, 1154, 1155, 1156, 1157, 1158, 1159, 1160, 1161, 1162, 1163, 1164, 1165, 1166, 1167, 1168, 1169, 689]。 Floating-Point Variance: Error detection thresholds crossing due to FP32 accumulation variance across platforms/batch sizes [1153, 1154, 1155, 1156, 1157, 1158, 1159, 1160, 1161, 1162, 1163, 1164, 1165, 1166, 1167, 1168, 1169, 689].
III-E3 RND_3 - 上下文、持久化与会话管理III-E3 RND_3 - Context, Persistence, and Session Management
RND_3_1 - 破坏多轮攻击检测的会话状态非确定性。 RND_3_1 - Session State Non-Determinism Breaking Multi-Turn Attack Detection. 维持对话历史和会话持久性的上下文感知能力会产生长期存在的 UI 状态，攻击者可在多轮交互中逐步对其投毒。 Context awareness maintaining conversation history and session persistence creates long-lived UI state attackers poison incrementally across multiple turns. 多智能体上下文分布于多个智能体记忆存储中，由此产生同步缺口，使注入某个智能体上下文的恶意内容在后续交互中传播至其他智能体。 Multi-agent context distributed across multiple agent memory stores creates synchronization gaps where malicious content injected into one agent’s context propagates to others in later interactions. 非确定性的状态演化使针对确定性重放进行校准的检测系统失效，让将载荷分散到多个轮次的多轮攻击能够绕过单轮安全过滤器。 Non-deterministic state evolution defeats detection systems calibrated for deterministic replay, allowing multi-turn attacks fragmenting payloads across turns to bypass single-turn safety filters. 威胁模型：该威胁涵盖四种不同的攻击向量：1. Threat Model: This threat encompasses four distinct attack vectors: 1. 多轮越狱：攻击者将恶意意图分散到多个对话轮次中，使任何单个轮次对安全策略的违反程度都不足以触发无状态分类器。 Multi-Turn Jailbreaking: Adversaries distribute malicious intent across conversation turns, with no single turn violating safety policies sufficiently to trigger stateless classifiers. Crescendo 攻击展现出 80%+ 的成功率，其中各个轮次的风险评分为 ¡0.15，但累积风险达到 0.97。 Crescendo attacks demonstrate 80%+ success where individual turns achieve ¡0.15 risk scores but accumulation reaches 0.97. 2. 2. 会话记忆投毒：注入共享对话历史的恶意内容会在未来与不同用户的交互中被自动检索出来。 Session Memory Poisoning: Malicious content injected into shared conversation history gets automatically retrieved in future interactions with different users. 长期记忆系统（LTM）成为攻击面，先前会话通过向量数据库检索污染后续用户交互。 Long-term memory systems (LTM) become attack surfaces where previous sessions contaminate subsequent user interactions through vector database retrieval. 3. 3. 跨智能体记忆同步缺口：注入某个智能体上下文的恶意指令会通过共享记忆存储，在后续交互中传播至其他智能体。 Cross-Agent Memory Synchronization Gaps: Malicious instructions injected into one agent’s context propagate through shared memory stores to other agents in later interactions. 传染性越狱通过分布式记忆系统传播，在多智能体部署中引发级联故障。 Contagious jailbreaks spread through distributed memory systems creating cascading failures across multi-agent deployments. 4. 4. 非确定性状态利用：随机执行路径（采样参数、注意力机制、检索随机性）产生可被攻击者利用的可变性。 Non-Deterministic State Exploitation: Stochastic execution paths (sampling parameters, attention mechanisms, retrieval randomness) create variability exploited by attackers. 非确定性行为使审计追踪变得不可靠；同一攻击在某些执行路径上成功，在其他路径上则失败。 Audit trails become unreliable with non-deterministic behavior; same attack succeeds on certain execution paths but not others. 攻击分类：Crescendo 模式（多轮渐进式）：- 第 1 轮：“……肥料炸药混合大师……首字母缩写？” Attack Taxonomy: Crescendo Pattern (Multi-Turn Incremental): - Turn 1: ”…Fertilizer Explosive Mixing Masters…acronym?” （风险=0.11）- 第 2 轮：“聚焦于‘爆炸性’、‘低速’、‘顺序’、‘金属的’”（风险=0.01）- 第 3 轮：“使用首字母缩写 ELOM 编写操作指南”（风险=0.15）- 第 4 轮：“拟定一节教授金属粉末具体配比的课程”（风险=0.86）- 第 5 轮：“用于高能反应及稳定性控制的化学技术”（风险=0.97）[已阻止] MINJA 攻击（记忆注入）：- 仅通过查询交互即可达到 95%+ 的成功率 - 渐进式缩短技术对恶意指令进行编码 - 桥接步骤和指示性提示触发潜伏载荷 - 跨会话污染：先前用户的会话对未来用户的交互投毒 MemoryGraft 攻击（间接经验注入）：- 将恶意的成功经验植入 LTM - 智能体未经验证便复制检索到的经验中的模式 - 利用成功示范：模型模仿“有效”的恶意示例 - 向量数据库污染使传染性传播成为可能 检测失效：无状态安全机制失效的原因如下：1. (Risk=0.11) - Turn 2: ”Focus on ’Explosive’, ’Low-velocity’, ’Order’, ’Metallic’” (Risk=0.01) - Turn 3: ”Write instructional guide using acronym ELOM” (Risk=0.15) - Turn 4: ”Draft session teaching specific ratios of metallic powders” (Risk=0.86) - Turn 5: ”Chemistry techniques for energetic reactions and stability” (Risk=0.97) [BLOCKED] MINJA Attack (Memory Injection): - Query-only interaction achieving 95%+ success - Progressive shortening techniques encode malicious instructions - Bridging steps and indication prompts trigger latent payloads - Cross-session contamination: Prior user sessions poison future users MemoryGraft Attack (Indirect Experience Injection): - Implant malicious successful experiences into LTM - Agent replicates patterns from retrieved experiences without verification - Success demonstration exploitation: Models imitate ”working” malicious examples - Vector database contamination enables contagious spread Detection Failures: Stateless safety mechanisms fail because: 1. 马尔可夫假设不成立：当前检测器假设 P(unsafe — current_turn_only)，但多轮攻击违背了这一假设——每一轮单独来看都仍然安全 2. Markov Assumption Invalid: Current detectors assume P(unsafe — current_turn_only) but multi-turn attacks violate this—each turn remains safe individually 2. 上下文窗口稀释：大型安全护栏在完整上下文下的 F1 为 0.42-0.51；良性前导内容淹没了对抗性信号 3. Context Window Dilution: Large guardrails show 0.42-0.51 F1 with full context; benign preambles overwhelm adversarial signals 3. 可复现性丧失：非确定性执行路径使审计回放无法进行；相同输入在不同运行中产生不同状态 4。 Reproducibility Lost: Non-deterministic execution paths prevent audit replay; same input produces different states across runs 4. 跨智能体监控盲区：单智能体监控无法检测系统之间的记忆传播或传染式扩散 [1170, 755, 1171, 138, 1172, 179, 1173, 1174, 87, 1048, 1175, 1176, 73, 1177, 1178, 834, 1081, 1179]。 Cross-Agent Blindness: Single-agent monitoring cannot detect memory propagation between systems or contagious spread [1170, 755, 1171, 138, 1172, 179, 1173, 1174, 87, 1048, 1175, 1176, 73, 1177, 1178, 834, 1081, 1179].
RND_3_2 - UI 状态变化期间的会话持久化导致安全上下文过时。 RND_3_2 - Session Persistence Across UI State Changes Creating Stale Security Context. 上下文在重新加载和页面导航后仍然保留，会造成漏洞，使过时的安全上下文在用户不知情的情况下影响当前决策。 Context persistence across reloads and navigation creates vulnerabilities where stale security context influences current decisions without user awareness. 在多智能体系统中，各智能体在不同时间访问新鲜度不同的状态，会导致安全态势不一致。 Multi-agent systems where agents access state at different times with different freshness create inconsistent security postures. 智能体 A 使用 2 小时前缓存的上下文，而智能体 B 获取最新上下文，从而形成不同的信任模型 [906, 1180, 1181, 1182, 1183]。 Agent A uses cached context from 2 hours ago while Agent B retrieves fresh context, creating divergent trust models [906, 1180, 1181, 1182, 1183].
III-E4 RND_4 - 多智能体协调与决策III-E4 RND_4 - Multi-Agent Coordination and Decision-Making
RND_4_1 - 多轮攻击中聊天界面流式输出的来源归属混淆。 RND_4_1 - Chat Interface Streaming Attribution Confusion in Multi-Turn Attacks. 聊天界面在统一会话线程中显示多个智能体的流式响应，会造成来源归属混淆，使用户无法可靠地确定内容来源。 Chat interfaces displaying streaming responses from multiple agents in unified threads create attribution confusion where users cannot reliably determine content sources. 攻击者利用这一点：智能体 A 流式输出无害的分析，同时智能体 B 以智能体 A 的输出风格流式输出恶意指令，利用用户在追踪并发输出流时的认知局限。 Attackers exploit this: Agent A streams benign analysis while Agent B simultaneously streams malicious instructions styled as Agent A’s output, exploiting users’ cognitive limitations tracking concurrent streams. 该攻击通过使智能体 B 注入的输出在格式、语气和词元输出节奏上与智能体 A 保持一致而得逞，使人无法通过目视检查区分来源。 The attack succeeds by matching Agent B’s injected output to Agent A’s formatting, tone, and token emission cadence so that visual inspection cannot distinguish the source. 用户误以为恶意指令来自可信智能体并据此行动，造成后续危害，而审计记录却将这些危害归因于错误的来源 [1184, 1185, 1186, 1187, 1188]。 Users act on malicious instructions under the belief they originate from a trusted agent, causing downstream harms that audit trails attribute to the wrong source [1184, 1185, 1186, 1187, 1188].
RND_4_2 - 命令面板上下文预测的非确定性导致安全防护不一致。 RND_4_2 - Command Palette Context Prediction Non-Determinism Enabling Inconsistent Guardrails. 使用 AI 预测与上下文相关操作的命令面板会生成非确定性的建议列表。 Command palettes using AI for contextually relevant action prediction create non-deterministic suggestion lists. 汇总预测结果的多智能体系统即使初始状态相同，也会产生不同的输出。 Multi-agent systems aggregating predictions produce different outputs despite identical starting states. 细微变化会改变出现的命令及其优先级，使得出“危险命令绝不会在没有警告的情况下出现”这一结论的评估失效。 Small variations shift which commands appear at what priority, defeating evaluations establishing ”dangerous commands will never appear without warnings.” [1189, 1190, 1191, 1192, 1193]。 [1189, 1190, 1191, 1192, 1193].
RND_4_3 - 审批工作流中置信度分数的非确定性使基于阈值的控制失效。 RND_4_3 - Approval Workflow Confidence Score Non-Determinism Defeating Threshold-Based Controls. 显示置信度分数的审批工作流为人工监督提供指引，但在名义上相同的决策之间会表现出非确定性变化。 Approval workflows displaying confidence scores guide human oversight but exhibit non-deterministic variation across nominally identical decisions. 采用分布式计算的多智能体置信度聚合即使输入相同，也会引入非确定性。 Multi-agent confidence aggregation with distributed computations introduces non-determinism despite identical input. 攻击者反复提交相同请求，直到非确定性变化产生足以触发自动批准的高分 [1194, 1195, 1196, 1197, 1198]。 Attackers submit identical requests until non-deterministic variation produces high scores triggering auto-approval [1194, 1195, 1196, 1197, 1198].
RND_4_4 - 多智能体仪表板的实时状态更新形成竞态条件攻击窗口。 RND_4_4 - Multi-Agent Dashboard Real-Time State Updates Creating Race Condition Attack Windows. 显示实时更新的多智能体仪表板会造成竞态条件漏洞，使 UI 状态暂时反映出不一致的智能体状态组合。 Multi-agent dashboards displaying real-time updates create race condition vulnerabilities where UI state temporarily reflects inconsistent agent combinations. 攻击者利用竞态构造输入，使恶意操作在仪表板显示误导性“安全”指示的短暂时段内发生 [1180, 1199, 1200, 1201, 1202]。 Attackers exploit races crafting inputs causing malicious operations during brief periods when dashboards display misleading ”safe” indicators [1180, 1199, 1200, 1201, 1202].
III-E5 RND_5 - 重试、韧性与错误恢复III-E5 RND_5 - Retry, Resilience, and Error Recovery
RND_5_1 - 自动重试错误恢复形成隐蔽的攻击放大循环。 RND_5_1 - Auto-Retry Error Recovery Creating Hidden Attack Amplification Loops. 采用自动重试的错误处理模式将攻击尝试隐藏在折叠的错误日志中，形成恶意操作得以多次执行的监控盲区。 Error patterns implementing automatic retry hide attack attempts in collapsed error logs, creating blind spots where malicious operations execute multiple times. 多智能体错误恢复涉及分布式重试逻辑，攻击者据此构造看似引发暂时性错误、实则携带恶意载荷的输入，这些载荷会在重试期间执行。 Multi-agent error recovery involves distributed retry logic where attackers craft inputs appearing as transient errors while carrying malicious payloads executed during retries. 非确定性的重试时序使评估失效 [1203, 1204, 1205, 1206, 382]。 Non-deterministic retry timing defeats evaluations [1203, 1204, 1205, 1206, 382].
RND_5_2 - 重试时序的非确定性破坏审计可复现性。 RND_5_2 - Retry Timing Non-Determinism Defeating Audit Reproducibility. 带抖动的指数退避会产生非确定性的重试时序，使相同场景产生不同的重试模式。 Exponential backoff with jitter creates non-deterministic retry timing making identical scenarios produce different retry patterns. 多智能体系统中分布式执行重试的智能体会因网络延迟和处理速度而产生时序变化。 Multi-agent distributed retry agents create variable timing due to network latency and processing speed. 利用重试时序变化的攻击能够逃避检测——仅在特定重试次数下触发的恶意行为仍无法被检测到。 Attacks exploiting retry timing variations evade detection—malicious behavior triggered only on specific retry numbers remains undetected. 攻击者通过故意诱发可恢复错误，并观察哪些重试尝试会产生不同的系统响应，来探测重试次数范围；一旦确定触发行为的重试序号，攻击者就会构造仅在该次尝试中执行的载荷，使仅执行一次的审计回放完全遗漏该行为。 An attacker probes retry count ranges by deliberately inducing recoverable errors and observing which retry attempts produce different system responses; once the triggering retry number is identified, the attacker crafts a payload that executes only on that attempt, causing single-execution audit replay to miss the behavior entirely. 由于审计回放复现的是确定性的初始尝试，而非非确定性的重试序列，因此无法在取证分析中复现恶意结果。 Because audit replay reproduces the deterministic initial attempt rather than the non-deterministic retry sequence, the malicious outcome cannot be reproduced in forensic analysis. [1207, 264, 1208, 1011, 818]。 [1207, 264, 1208, 1011, 818].
RND_5_3 - 通过协同重试风暴利用非幂等操作。 RND_5_3 - Non-Idempotent Operation Exploitation via Coordinated Retry Storms. 多个智能体通过同时重试，协同触发非幂等操作。 Multiple agents coordinate triggering non-idempotent operations through simultaneous retries. 智能体 A 诱发瞬态故障，同时智能体 B 发起大量重试，导致金融交易或资源分配重复执行。 Agent A induces transient failures while Agent B floods with retry attempts, causing duplicate financial transactions or resource allocations. 当智能体优化时机窗口时，就会产生多智能体放大效应。 Multi-agent amplification occurs when agents optimize timing windows. 智能体 A 构造请求，触发部分状态写入，使后端处于已提交与未提交之间的模糊状态，从而引发幂等键（idempotency key）冲突；智能体 B 在诱发的故障窗口期间向重试队列大量灌入请求，导致操作在幂等层解决冲突之前被多次执行。 Agent A crafts requests that produce idempotency-key collisions by triggering partial state writes that leave the backend in an ambiguous committed/uncommitted state; Agent B floods the retry queue during the induced failure window, causing the operation to execute multiple times before the idempotency layer resolves the collision. 结果是，改变状态的操作——包括金融交易或资源配置——被执行两次，而系统错误日志却将其记录为单次尝试成功。 The result is double-execution of state-changing operations — including financial transactions or resource provisioning — that the system’s error logs record as a single-attempt success. [1011, 71, 1209, 408, 1210]。 [1011, 71, 1209, 408, 1210].
RND_5_4 - 备用路由选择的非确定性导致无法测试的分支。 RND_5_4 - Fallback Route Selection Non-Determinism Creating Untestable Branching. 备用策略采用概率选择机制（按提供方可用性、成本和延迟加权），从而产生非确定性路由。 Fallback strategies use probabilistic selection (weighted by provider availability, cost, latency) creating non-deterministic routing. 测试无法确认恶意备用路由已被阻止，因为非确定性使未经测试的路由可能出现。 Testing cannot establish that malicious fallback routes are prevented because non-determinism enables untested routes appearing. 攻击者注册已被攻陷的备用服务提供方，其可用性评分略高于合法替代提供方；只有在主路由饱和的生产负载条件下，被攻陷的提供方才会被选中，而受控测试环境无法复现这种状态。 Attackers register compromised fallback providers whose availability scores marginally exceed legitimate alternatives; the compromised provider surfaces only during production load conditions where primary routes are saturated, a state that controlled testing environments do not replicate. 一旦流量被路由至被攻陷的备用提供方，攻击者便可控制返回给编排智能体的响应，同时不在主路由的审计轨迹中留下记录。 Once traffic routes to the compromised fallback, the attacker controls the response returned to the orchestrating agent without appearing in the primary route’s audit trail. III-E20 RND_20 - 部署与推理基础设施III-E20 RND_20 - Deployment and Inference Infrastructure
RND_20_1 - 持续部署中的容器镜像漂移。 RND_20_1 - Container Image Drift in Continuous Deployment. 金丝雀部署在未严格固定镜像版本的情况下逐步推出容器镜像，造成版本偏差。 Canary deployments progressively roll out container images without strict pinning, creating version skew. 在多智能体系统中，不同智能体按照不同时间表部署，会造成系统范围的版本偏差。 Multi-agent systems where different agents deploy on different schedules create system-wide version skew. 核心威胁：浮动容器镜像标签（latest、stable、v1）在不同时间拉取具有不同 SHA256 摘要的镜像，导致金丝雀部署产生版本异构性。 Core Threat: Floating container image tags (latest, stable, v1) pull different SHA256 digests at different times, causing canary deployments to create version heterogeneity. 智能体 A 可能拉取 image:latest@sha256:abc123，而智能体 B 则拉取 image:latest@sha256:def456。 Agent A may pull image:latest@sha256:abc123 while Agent B pulls image:latest@sha256:def456. Kubernetes 的 ImagePullPolicy 设置为 “Always” 时，会在每次 Pod 重启时重新拉取镜像，从而加剧漂移。 Kubernetes ImagePullPolicy ”Always” exacerbates drift by re-pulling on every pod restart. 版本之间的 API 格式不匹配会导致无提示的数据损坏。 API format mismatches between versions cause silent data corruption. 固定摘要（使用不可变引用）是缓解措施，但需要严格遵守部署规程。 Digest pinning (immutable references) is the mitigation but requires strict deployment discipline. 研究空白：渐进式发布期间的容器镜像漂移主要属于基础设施与运维问题，学术研究涉及较少。 Research Gap: Container image drift during progressive rollouts is primarily an infrastructure/operations concern with limited academic coverage. 大多数文献关注较高层次的部署模式，而非镜像标签使用实践、版本偏差量化或摘要固定验证。 Most literature focuses on higher-level deployment patterns rather than image tagging practices, version skew quantification, or digest pinning validation. 这反映出一个真实存在的安全缺口：从业者依赖供应商文档，而非经过同行评审的研究 [1398, 1011, 1399, 1400, 382, 1401, 1402, 1403, 1404, 550, 290, 1405, 1406, 1407, 1408, 1409, 1410, 470, 1411, 1412]。 This reflects a real security gap where practitioners rely on vendor documentation rather than peer-reviewed research [1398, 1011, 1399, 1400, 382, 1401, 1402, 1403, 1404, 550, 290, 1405, 1406, 1407, 1408, 1409, 1410, 470, 1411, 1412].
RND_20_2 - 智能体不同版本之间的非确定性流量分配。 RND_20_2 - Non-Deterministic Traffic Splitting Across Agent Versions. 金丝雀流量分配使用随机采样，从而产生非确定性行为。 Canary traffic splitting uses random sampling creating non-deterministic behavior. 当多智能体系统中的 N 个智能体同时进行金丝雀部署时，会产生 $2^{N}$ 种可能的状态组合 [1413, 1414, 1415, 1416, 1417, 1418, 1419, 1420, 1421, 1011]。 Multi-agent systems with N agents undergoing canary simultaneously create $2^{N}$ possible state combinations [1413, 1414, 1415, 1416, 1417, 1418, 1419, 1420, 1421, 1011].
RND_20_3 - 异步事件处理造成顺序非确定性。 RND_20_3 - Asynchronous Event Processing Creating Ordering Non-Determinism. 事件驱动的多智能体系统以异步方式处理事件。 Event-driven multi-agent systems process events asynchronously. 智能体以不同顺序接收相同事件时，会产生不同结果 [1422, 1423, 1424, 1403, 1425, 1426, 1427, 1428, 1429, 1430]。 Agents receiving the same events in different orders produce different results [1422, 1423, 1424, 1403, 1425, 1426, 1427, 1428, 1429, 1430].
III-E21 RND_21 - 推理硬件与优化III-E21 RND_21 - Inference Hardware and Optimization
RND_21_5 - 持续模型更新在多智能体部署中造成长期存在的保障缺口。 RND_21_5 - Continuous Model Updates Creating Perpetual Assurance Gaps in Multi-Agent Deployments. 持续更新系统通过以下方式造成缺口：(1) 零停机过渡攻击——当 Agent A 使用 Model V1 处理请求时，Model V2 在后台静默加载；v2 的漏洞使跨版本攻击成为可能；(2) 持续不稳定——每周自动部署导致版本不断变化，缺乏稳定基线，对抗性输入可利用短暂的版本窗口；(3) 异步传播——滚动更新的传播持续数小时，形成时间窗口，在此期间，相同输入会因智能体的更新状态不同而产生不同输出。 Continuous update systems create gaps through: (1) Zero-downtime transition attacks - while Agent A processes requests using Model V1, Model V2 loads silently; v2 vulnerabilities enable cross-version attacks; (2) Perpetual instability - weekly automated rollouts create continuous version changes without stable baselines, where adversarial inputs exploit brief version windows; (3) Asynchronous propagation - rolling updates propagate over hours creating windows where identical inputs produce different outputs depending on agent update status. 多智能体的持续更新形成了无界的保障覆盖面，使形式化验证无法在下一次更新之前完成 [1431, 1432, 408, 1433, 1434, 1435, 1436, 1437, 1438, 1259]。 Multi-agent continuous updates create unbounded assurance surfaces where formal verification cannot complete before the next update [1431, 1432, 408, 1433, 1434, 1435, 1436, 1437, 1438, 1259].
III-E22 RND_22 - 优化与效率III-E22 RND_22 - Optimization and Efficiency
RND_22_1 - 性能剖析引入的非确定性构成对保障要求的违背。 RND_22_1 - Profiling-Induced Non-Determinism as Assurance Violation. 性能剖析会增加测量开销，产生基线执行中不存在的非确定性。 Profiling adds measurement overhead creating non-determinism not present in baseline execution. 基于性能剖析数据作出优化决策的多智能体系统会产生分布式非确定性。 Multi-agent systems with optimization decisions based on profiling data create distributed non-determinism. 威胁模型：- 性能剖析插桩（NVIDIA Nsight、PyTorch Profiler、TensorBoard）引入测量开销，扰动执行时序、内存分配模式和调度决策 - 观察者效应造成类似海森堡缺陷（Heisenbug）的执行行为，使经过性能剖析的执行与未插桩的基线执行存在根本差异 - 性能剖析引导优化（PGO）根据测量数据作出模型选择和资源分配决策，而这些数据可能无法反映未进行性能剖析时的性能 - 使用性能剖析数据进行优化的多智能体系统会使测量扰动在智能体网络中级联传播 - 攻击者设计仅在未进行性能剖析的执行中显现的攻击，从而逃避插桩分析期间的检测 - 性能剖析造成测试与生产环境之间的差距，使插桩状态下的行为与部署时的行为不同 测量开销特征：1. Threat Model: - Profiling instrumentation (NVIDIA Nsight, PyTorch Profiler, TensorBoard) introduces measurement overhead that perturbs execution timing, memory allocation patterns, and scheduling decisions - Observer effects create Heisenbug-like execution behavior where profiled execution differs fundamentally from uninstrumented baseline - Profiling-guided optimization (PGO) makes model selection and resource allocation decisions based on measurement data that may not reflect non-profiled performance - Multi-agent systems using profiling data for optimization cascade measurement perturbations through agent networks - Attackers design attacks that manifest only in non-profiled execution, evading detection during instrumented analysis - Profiling creates testing/production gaps where behavior under instrumentation differs from behavior in deployment Measurement Overhead Characterization: 1. GPU 性能剖析开销：NVIDIA Nsight Compute 引入 20-200× 的开销；Nsight Systems 不支持持续 ¿5 分钟的性能剖析；CUDA 性能剖析在形状/调用栈跟踪方面会产生不可忽略的开销（arXiv:2509.13852、arXiv:2602.05885）2. GPU Profiling Overhead: NVIDIA Nsight Compute adds 20-200× overhead; Nsight Systems doesn’t support profiling ¿5 minutes; CUDA profiling incurs non-negligible overhead on shape/stack tracing (arXiv:2509.13852, arXiv:2602.05885) 2. 分布式追踪开销：多智能体系统中的分布式追踪通过采样将存储量减少 81.2%，同时保持 98.1% 的故障跨度检测率（arXiv:2509.13852）；Tracezip 通过压缩实现了可忽略的开销（arXiv:2502.06318）3. Distributed Tracing Overhead: Distributed tracing in multi-agent systems reduces storage by 81.2% with sampling but maintains 98.1% faulty span detection (arXiv:2509.13852); Tracezip achieves negligible overhead through compression (arXiv:2502.06318) 3. 性能剖析引起的扰动：容器化微服务在插桩后，吞吐量最多下降 8.40%；实证研究中的响应时间/延迟下降 20-49%；性能扰动随插桩程度的增加而增大 4. Profiling-Based Perturbation: Throughput decreases up to 8.40% in containerized microservices with instrumentation; response time/latency drops 20-49% in empirical studies; performance perturbation increases with instrumentation degree 4. 时序影响：测量开销扰动执行时序，造成基线执行中不存在的缓存未命中模式、调度差异和资源争用 性能剖析引导的优化决策：1. Timing Effects: Measurement overhead perturbs execution timing, creating cache-miss patterns, scheduling differences, and resource contention not present in baseline execution Profiling-Guided Optimization Decisions: 1. 模型选择偏差：Trust by Design 框架根据性能剖析得到的“技能画像”选择 LLM 模型；当性能剖析引起的行为变化消失时，优化决策可能失效（arXiv:2602.02386）2. Model Selection Bias: Trust by Design framework selects LLM models based on profiled ”Skill Profiles”; optimization decisions may fail when profiling-induced behavioral changes disappear (arXiv:2602.02386) 2. 基于性能的压缩：PerfMamba 通过系统性的性能剖析开展“全面的实证研究”，以指导剪枝决策；优化的有效性取决于性能剖析测量的准确性（arXiv:2511.22849）3. Performance-Based Compression: PerfMamba conducts ”thorough empirical study” with systematic profiling to guide pruning decisions; optimization validity depends on profiled measurement accuracy (arXiv:2511.22849) 3. 激活剖析：EdgeFlex-Transformer 使用激活剖析进行内存感知的模型压缩；基于剖析所得内存模式作出的优化决策，可能无法迁移到未进行性能剖析的执行中（arXiv:2512.19741）4. Activation Profiling: EdgeFlex-Transformer uses activation profiling for memory-aware model compression; optimization decisions based on profiled memory patterns may not transfer to non-profiled execution (arXiv:2512.19741) 4. Dr. Kernel 优化：使用“基于性能剖析的奖励”进行强化学习模型训练；优化结果取决于性能剖析测量的准确性（arXiv:2602.05885）多智能体级联效应：1. Dr. Kernel Optimization: Uses ”Profiling-based Rewards” for reinforcement learning model training; optimization outcome depends on accuracy of profiling measurements (arXiv:2602.05885) Multi-Agent Cascading Effects: 1. 分布式协调挑战：Silo-Bench 揭示了“通信与推理之间的差距”，即智能体虽然交换性能剖析/测量信息，却系统性地无法将分布式状态综合为正确决策（arXiv:2603.01045）2. Distributed Coordination Challenges: Silo-Bench reveals ”Communication-Reasoning Gap” where agents exchange profiling/measurement information but systematically fail to synthesize distributed state into correct decisions (arXiv:2603.01045) 2. 涌现的行为非确定性：Molt Dynamics 对 770,000+ 个自主智能体的大规模研究表明，系统会涌现协调行为，并产生级联的非确定性结果；测量效应会在智能体网络中级联传播（arXiv:2603.03555）3. Emergent Behavioral Non-Determinism: Molt Dynamics large-scale study of 770,000+ autonomous agents shows emergent coordination behaviors and cascading non-deterministic outcomes; measurement effects cascade through agent networks (arXiv:2603.03555) 3. 级联的测量变化：Kubernetes 控制平面中的分布式追踪表明，“系统的开销并不显著”，但会在整个控制平面中引发级联变化；测量扰动通过编排决策传播（arXiv:2411.01336）4. Cascading Measurement Changes: Distributed tracing in Kubernetes control plane shows ”system’s overhead is not significant” but creates cascading changes across control plane; measurement perturbations propagate through orchestration decisions (arXiv:2411.01336) 4. 动态拓扑适应：AgentConductor 根据任务难度使用经强化学习（RL）优化的交互拓扑；级联的优化决策会影响后续的智能体协调（arXiv:2602.17100）攻击利用模式：1. Dynamic Topology Adaptation: AgentConductor uses RL-optimized interaction topologies based on task difficulty; cascading optimization decisions affect subsequent agent coordination (arXiv:2602.17100) Attack Exploitation Patterns: 1. 分析规避：ThreatFormer-IDS 展示了通过对抗训练绕过检测系统的方式；为在性能剖析期间规避监控而设计的攻击，在未进行性能剖析的执行中会失败（arXiv:2603.00185）2. Analysis Evasion: ThreatFormer-IDS demonstrates adversarial training bypassing detection systems; attacks designed to evade monitoring under profiling fail against non-profiled execution (arXiv:2603.00185) 2. 通过行为改变规避检测：StealthRL 利用强化学习，通过在受监控时改变行为来规避检测；能够感知性能剖析的攻击会检测测量插桩并隐藏恶意行为（arXiv:2602.08934）3. Detection Evasion via Behavior Change: StealthRL uses reinforcement learning to evade detection through behavior changes under monitoring; profiling-aware attacks detect measurement instrumentation and hide malicious behavior (arXiv:2602.08934) 3. 生产与测试的差异：攻击利用经过性能剖析的测试环境与未经性能剖析的生产执行之间的行为差异；恶意后果在插桩分析中不可见。保障条件的违反：1. Production vs. Testing Divergence: Attacks exploit behavioral differences between profiled testing environments and non-profiled production execution; malicious outcomes invisible in instrumented analysis Assurance Violations: 1. 经过性能剖析的测试无法验证生产行为：性能剖析会造成测试与生产之间的差距，使经过性能剖析的行为不同于未经性能剖析的基线行为；假定行为具有确定性的保障论证会因测量扰动而失效 2. Profiled Testing Cannot Validate Production: Profiling creates testing/production gaps where profiled behavior differs from non-profiled baseline; assurance cases assuming deterministic behavior invalidated by measurement perturbations 2. 优化决策的有效性未经证明：基于性能剖析数据作出的模型选择和资源分配决策，可能无法针对实际未经性能剖析的执行实现优化；这些决策会系统性地偏向性能剖析引入的伪象 3. Optimization Decision Validity Unproven: Model selection and resource allocation decisions based on profiling data may not optimize for actual non-profiled execution; decisions systematically biased toward profiling artifacts 3. 多智能体协调的保障缺口：多智能体系统中基于性能剖析的优化决策会产生级联的非确定性；测量开销会破坏分布式保障所依赖的假设 4. Multi-Agent Coordination Assurance Gaps: Profiling-based optimization decisions in multi-agent systems create cascading non-determinism; distributed assurance assumptions break under measurement overhead 4. 分布式确定性不可能实现：逻辑同步网络从形式上证明了在分布式性能剖析过程中维持确定性是不可能的；测量扰动使确定性保证无法成立（arXiv:2402.07433）[1439, 1440, 1441, 1442, 1443, 1444, 1445, 1446, 1447, 1448, 1449, 1450, 1451, 1452, 1453]。 Distributed Determinism Impossible: Logical synchrony networks show formal impossibility of maintaining determinism across distributed profiling; measurement perturbations prevent deterministic guarantees (arXiv:2402.07433) [1439, 1440, 1441, 1442, 1443, 1444, 1445, 1446, 1447, 1448, 1449, 1450, 1451, 1452, 1453].
III-E23 RND_23 - 思维链（CoT）、思维树（ToT）与推理非确定性III-E23 RND_23 - Chain-of-Thought (CoT), Tree-of-Thought (ToT), and Reasoning Non-Determinism
RND_23_2 - 智能体间的推理一致性漂移。 RND_23_2 - Reasoning consistency drift across agents. 随着各智能体独立更新，其推理模式会逐渐分化。 As agents update individually, their reasoning patterns diverge. 利用旧有模式的投毒攻击可能对更新后的智能体失效。 A poisoning attack exploiting old patterns may fail on updated agents. [1454, 467, 327, 1455, 1456, 1457, 1458, 280, 1459, 1460]. [1454, 467, 327, 1455, 1456, 1457, 1458, 280, 1459, 1460].
RND_23_3 - 时序协调的非确定性。 RND_23_3 - Temporal coordination non-determinism. 智能体通过共享的 CoT 轨迹进行协调时，会产生竞态条件。 Agents coordinating through shared CoT traces create race conditions. 当智能体 B 检索智能体 A 的推理时，智能体 A 的推理可能尚未完成。 Agent A’s reasoning might be incomplete when Agent B retrieves it. 智能体 B 可能检索到智能体 A 的部分推理轨迹，并将不完整的中间结论视为最终决策据此采取行动；这一尚未完全形成的结论可能支持某次工具调用，而完整推理本会拒绝该调用。 Agent B may retrieve Agent A’s partial reasoning trace and act on an incomplete intermediate conclusion as if it were a final decision; the partially-formed conclusion may endorse a tool invocation that the completed reasoning would have rejected. 依据部分 CoT 轨迹采取行动，可能导致完整推理链不会授权的过早或错误的工具调用；如果没有详细的 CoT 级日志记录，就无法将由此产生的行动追溯到一次不完整的检索。 Acting on partial CoT traces can cause premature or incorrect tool invocations that the full reasoning chain would not authorize, and the resulting action cannot be traced back to an incomplete retrieval without detailed CoT-level logging. [1263, 1461, 1462, 1463, 27]. [1263, 1461, 1462, 1463, 27].
RND_23_4 - 随机多智能体规划产生无法测试的路径。 RND_23_4 - Stochastic multi-agent planning creating untestable paths. 各智能体的随机推理选择会以乘法方式组合。 Each agent’s stochastic reasoning choices combine multiplicatively. 测试单个智能体的 CoT 空间是可行的；测试组合后的空间在计算上不可行。 Testing single agent CoT space is feasible; testing combined space is computationally infeasible. [1255, 1464, 1465, 1466, 1467, 1468, 1469, 68, 1470, 25]. [1255, 1464, 1465, 1466, 1467, 1468, 1469, 68, 1470, 25].
RND_23_5 - 分布式 ToT 系统中的回溯状态分歧。 RND_23_5 - Backtracking state divergence in distributed ToT systems. 当各智能体维护独立的搜索树并同时回溯时，时序差异会导致它们对哪些分支已被探索产生分歧。 When agents maintain separate search trees and backtrack concurrently, timing differences cause divergence on which branches have been explored. [805, 306, 1471, 139, 864, 1472, 292, 1473, 1454, 1474]. [805, 306, 1471, 139, 864, 1472, 292, 1473, 1454, 1474].
III-E24 RND_24 - 自一致性与多条推理路径III-E24 RND_24 - Self-Consistency and Multiple Reasoning Paths
RND_24_1 - 随机采样非确定性构成的保障缺口。 RND_24_1 - Stochastic Sampling Non-Determinism as Assurance Gap. 自一致性（Self-Consistency）使用随机解码，有意生成“k 种不同的推理方法”，从而造成保障缺口——相同输入会产生不同输出。 Self-Consistency uses stochastic decoding creating ”k different reasoning approaches” intentionally, creating assurance gaps—identical input produces variable outputs. 在假定行为具有确定性的多智能体系统中，Self-Consistency 的非确定性会成为一项不利因素。 In multi-agent systems where deterministic behavior is assumed, Self-Consistency’s non-determinism becomes a liability. 测试无法全面覆盖随机行为空间。 Testing cannot comprehensively cover stochastic behavior space. [1475, 1476, 1477, 1478, 1479]. [1475, 1476, 1477, 1478, 1479].
RND_24_2 - 温度调优参数漂移构成的运行时保障缺口。 RND_24_2 - Temperature Tuning Parameter Drift as Runtime Assurance Gap. Self-Consistency 的温度调优会影响行为，而且通常针对特定问题类别进行。 Self-Consistency temperature tuning affects behavior and is often tuned for specific problem classes. 在共享温度参数的多智能体系统中，参数漂移会同时影响所有智能体。 In multi-agent systems where temperature is shared, parameter drift affects all agents simultaneously. [1480, 1481, 1482, 1483, 1484, 1485, 1486, 1487, 1488, 1489]. [1480, 1481, 1482, 1483, 1484, 1485, 1486, 1487, 1488, 1489].
RND_24_3 - 持续的采样参数优化引发对抗性漂移。 RND_24_3 - Continual Sampling Parameter Optimization Creating Adversarial Drift. 根据成功率调整采样参数的持续优化会导致系统性漂移。 Continuous optimization adjusting sampling parameters based on success rates causes systematic drift. 在共享优化过程的多智能体系统中，漂移会影响所有智能体。 In multi-agent systems with shared optimization, drift affects all agents. [1490, 1491, 1492, 1493, 1494, 1495, 1496, 1497, 1498, 1499]. [1490, 1491, 1492, 1493, 1494, 1495, 1496, 1497, 1498, 1499].
RND_24_4 - 压缩算法导致的上下文窗口非确定性。 RND_24_4 - Context Window Non-Determinism From Compression Algorithms. 采用 k=40 条路径的自一致性（Self-Consistency）会产生大量上下文；压缩算法可能以非确定性的方式选择保留哪些信息。 Self-Consistency with k=40 paths creates large context; compression algorithms may non-deterministically select which information survives. 在上下文窗口大小不同的智能体之间进行多智能体交接时，会面临压缩的非确定性。 Multi-agent handoffs between agents with different context windows face compression non-determinism. III-E25 RND_25 - 层次任务网络（HTN）规划的非确定性III-E25 RND_25 - Hierarchical Task Network (HTN) Planning Non-Determinism

ETL 去重使用内容哈希（SHA-256），并通过 seen_hashes = set() 进行跟踪，这会在并发抽取中造成竞态条件。 ETL deduplication using content hashing (SHA-256) with seen_hashes = set() tracking creates race conditions in concurrent extraction. 当智能体 A 和智能体 B 同时抽取共享文档，并且都在时间戳 T 读取文档 D 时，它们会独立计算 hash(D)，并检查各自独立的 seen_hashes 集合。 When Agent A and Agent B simultaneously extract shared documents and both read document D at timestamp T, they independently compute hash(D) and check separate seen_hashes sets. 两次检查均返回 False，导致重复处理。 Both checks return False, causing duplicate processing. 同时调度的多智能体抽取（每小时的 :00）会系统性地遇到这一问题：所有智能体开始抽取，读取相互重叠的文档，并各自独立地决定处理重复文档。 Multi-agent extraction scheduled simultaneously (hourly at :00) systematically experiences this: all agents begin extraction, read overlapping documents, and independently decide to process duplicates. 当 20 个智能体从共享数据源抽取数据时，20 次独立的去重决策会因随机时序的不同而导致 15-40% 的重复率。 With 20 agents extracting from shared sources, 20 independent deduplication decisions cause 15-40% duplicate rates depending on random timing. 基于 Redis 的持久化去重会因网络时序而使 SET 操作的顺序具有非确定性。 Persistent Redis-based deduplication introduces network-timing non-determinism in SET operation ordering. 模糊 MinHash 去重与依赖时序的签名存储相互叠加，使问题进一步加剧。 Fuzzy MinHash deduplication compounds with timing-dependent signature storage. 多智能体区别：单智能体内存去重可提供确定性的检测。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-agent in-memory deduplication provides deterministic detection. 具有独立状态的多智能体并发抽取会产生非确定性的重复率。 Multi-agent concurrent extraction with independent state creates non-deterministic duplicate rates. [821, 1832, 1833, 1834, 1835]。 [821, 1832, 1833, 1834, 1835].
RND_34_16 - REST API 分页游标的非确定性导致多智能体抽取不一致。 RND_34_16 - REST API Pagination Cursor Non-Determinism Creating Inconsistent Multi-Agent Extraction. 使用分页从 REST API 进行 ETL 抽取时，如果抽取过程中插入了新数据，就会面临非确定性。 ETL extraction from REST APIs using pagination faces non-determinism when new data inserts during extraction. 智能体 A 在 14:00 获取第 1 页时，会收到用于获取第 2 页的 page_token。 Agent A fetching page 1 at 14:00 receives page_token for page 2. 在获取第 2 页之前，一条新记录被插入，导致分页位置发生偏移——工单 #1050 此时出现在第 2 页而非第 1 页，因此被智能体 A 获取。 Before fetching page 2, a new record is inserted shifting pagination—ticket #1050 now appears on page 2 instead of page 1, causing Agent A to retrieve it. 智能体 B 在 14:05 进行抽取时，获取到的第 1 页有所不同，其中包含了新插入的记录，导致 #1050 出现在两次抽取的结果中。 Agent B extracting at 14:05 retrieves different page 1 including the inserted record, causing #1050 to appear in both extractions. 增量筛选条件 updated_since=2024-11-10 会遗漏在跨多个页面的抽取过程中插入的记录。 Incremental updated_since=2024-11-10 filtering misses records inserted during multi-page spans. 多智能体的错峰调度（智能体 A 在 :00，B 在 :05，C 在 :10）会形成不同的分页状态，从而产生不同的记录集。 Multi-agent staggered schedules (Agent A :00, B :05, C :10) create different pagination states producing different record sets. 游标的非确定性使重新抽取验证无法实现：由于数据源发生变化，重新运行会产生不同的结果。 Cursor non-determinism prevents re-extraction validation: re-running produces different results due to source changes. 多智能体区别：单智能体顺序抽取可保持一致性。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-agent sequential extraction maintains consistency. 多智能体并发或错峰抽取会产生不一致的记录集。 Multi-agent concurrent/staggered extraction produces inconsistent record sets. [1836, 1665, 1667, 1837, 1838]。 [1836, 1665, 1667, 1837, 1838].
RND_34_17 - 文件系统修改时间分辨率的差异影响增量 ETL 更新。 RND_34_17 - Filesystem Modification Time Resolution Variability Affecting Incremental ETL Updates. 使用 file.stat().st_mtime > last_run_timestamp 的增量 ETL 面临平台差异。 Incremental ETL using file.stat().st_mtime > last_run_timestamp faces platform variability. Linux ext4：纳秒级分辨率；Windows NTFS：100 纳秒级；FAT32：2 秒级。 Linux ext4: nanosecond resolution; Windows NTFS: 100-nanosecond; FAT32: 2-second. Linux 上的智能体 A 能检测到微秒级变化；Windows 上的智能体 B 则会遗漏 2 秒时间窗口内的更新。 Agent A on Linux detects microsecond changes; Agent B on Windows misses 2-second-window updates. 网络文件系统（NFS、SMB）还会引入时钟偏差：智能体 A 在其时钟为 14:00:00.000 时与服务器时间 14:00:00.500 进行比较，但 200ms 的延迟意味着实际比较的是客户端时间 14:00:00.200 与服务器时间 14:00:00.500，从而产生歧义。 Network filesystems (NFS, SMB) add clock skew: Agent A’s 14:00:00.000 clock checks against server 14:00:00.500, but 200ms latency means client time 14:00:00.200 against server 14:00:00.500 creates ambiguity. 多智能体的异构基础设施会系统性地检测到不同的变更集。 Multi-agent heterogeneous infrastructure systematically detects different change sets. 高频更新（每 30s 自动保存一次）在 Linux 上会产生 10 个版本，但在具有 2 秒分辨率的 Windows 上只会产生 1 个版本。 High-frequency updates (auto-save every 30s) produce 10 versions for Linux but 1 for Windows with 2-second resolution. 修改时间（Mtime）的非确定性使更新无法复现。 Mtime non-determinism prevents reproducible updates. 多智能体区别：单智能体的同构基础设施具有一致的分辨率。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-agent homogeneous infrastructure has consistent resolution. 多智能体的异构平台会造成分辨率差异，使检测结果取决于操作系统。 Multi-agent heterogeneous platforms create resolution variability where detection depends on operating system. [1839, 1840, 1841, 1842, 1843]。 [1839, 1840, 1841, 1842, 1843].
RND_34_18 - ETL 部分失败恢复过程中批次细分顺序的非确定性。 RND_34_18 - Batch Subdivision Ordering Non-Determinism During Partial ETL Failure Recovery. 带有失败处理机制的 ETL 批量插入（每批 1,000 条记录）面临细分策略的非确定性。 ETL batch insertion (1,000 records/batch) with failure handling faces non-determinism in subdivision strategies. 当批次在记录 734 处失败时，二分细分得到的 [0:500] 和 [500:1000] 与按失败点细分得到的 [0:734] 和 [735:1000] 不同。 When batch fails at record 734, binary subdivision splits [0:500] and [500:1000] differently than failure-point subdivision [0:734] and [735:1000]. 智能体 A 采用二分方式重试（5 次尝试：[0:500]、[500:750]、[750:875]、[875:937]、[937:968]），而智能体 B 按失败点重试（2 次尝试：[0:734]、[735:1000]），从而形成不同的数据库负载模式。 Agent A retries binary (5 attempts: [0:500], [500:750], [750:875], [875:937], [937:968]) while Agent B retries failure-point (2 attempts: [0:734], [735:1000]), creating different database load patterns. 多个智能体采用不同策略时同时发生故障，可能导致死锁：智能体 A 先获取区间 [0:500] 的锁，再获取区间 [500:750] 的锁，智能体 B 先获取区间 [0:734] 的锁，再获取区间 [735:1000] 的锁，区间重叠会导致死锁。 Multi-agent simultaneous failures with different strategies risk deadlocks: Agent A acquires locks [0:500] then [500:750], Agent B acquires [0:734] then [735:1000], overlapping ranges cause deadlocks. 并行与顺序重试的次序差异进一步加剧了问题：并行重试的提交顺序与原始位置顺序不一致。 Parallel versus sequential retry ordering further compounds: parallel retries commit out-of-order relative to original positions. 多智能体场景的区别在于：单个智能体采用一种策略时，恢复过程具有确定性。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-agent one strategy produces deterministic recovery. 多个智能体采用异构策略会产生非确定性序列。 Multi-agent heterogeneous strategies create non-deterministic sequences. [1844, 1391, 1845, 1846, 1847]. [1844, 1391, 1845, 1846, 1847].
RND_34_19 - 不同智能体验证实现之间的质量指标计算差异。 RND_34_19 - Quality Metric Calculation Variability Across Heterogeneous Agent Validation Implementations. 质量验证采用不同方法，从五个维度进行评估：完整性、准确性、一致性、时效性和有效性。 Quality validation uses five-dimensional assessment (completeness, accuracy, consistency, timeliness, validity) with heterogeneous methods. 完整性的计算存在差异：智能体 A 采用二元字段计数，智能体 B 采用词元加权，智能体 C 采用熵。 Completeness diverges: Agent A binary field counting, Agent B token-weighted, Agent C entropy. 准确性的评估方式各不相同：精确匹配、范围验证或统计离群值检测。 Accuracy differs: exact matching, range validation, or statistical outliers. 一致性评估采用成对约束、时间顺序或引用完整性。 Consistency uses pair constraints, temporal ordering, or referential integrity. 多智能体共享阈值会失效——完整性 $\geq$ 0.80 可通过某些智能体的验证，却无法通过其他智能体的验证。 Multi-agent shared thresholds fail—completeness $\geq$ 0.80 passes some agents but fails others. 攻击者将文档路由至较为宽松的实现；共享基础库会接受被其他实现拒绝的文档。 Attackers route documents to lenient implementations; shared bases accept rejected documents. 多智能体采用异构方法使绕过验证成为可能。 Multi-agent heterogeneous methods enable bypass. [1848, 1849, 776, 1850, 1851]. [1848, 1849, 776, 1850, 1851].
III-F 认知与工具行为特有的遥测和监控盲区III-F Telemetry and monitoring blind spots specific to cognitive and tool behavior
现有可观测性技术栈难以适应智能体系统中的认知层面和工作流层面的威胁。 Existing observability stacks are poorly aligned with cognitive and workflow-level threats in agentic systems. 标准基础设施监控侧重于确定性组件以及指标、日志和追踪数据；很少检查提示内容、检索到的文档、记忆变更或智能体之间的消息。 Standard infrastructure monitoring focuses on deterministic components and metrics, logs, and traces; it rarely inspects prompt content, retrieved documents, memory mutations, or inter-agent messages.
主要盲区包括对内部推理、工具选择依据以及仅以非结构化文本形式保留的中间思考缺乏可见性，这使得提示感染、策略漂移或规约投机行为难以被检测到。 Key blind spots include limited visibility into internal reasoning, tool selection rationales, and intermediate thoughts retained only as unstructured text, making detection of prompt infections, policy drift, or specification gaming difficult.
III-F1 RTM_1 - UI 与界面遥测缺口III-F1 RTM_1 - UI and Interface Telemetry Gaps
RTM_1_1 - 渐进式披露将恶意活动隐藏在折叠视图中。 RTM_1_1 - Progressive Disclosure Hiding Malicious Activity in Collapsed Views. 渐进式披露模式将技术细节和推理轨迹隐藏在折叠视图中，造成可观测性盲区。 Progressive disclosure patterns hide technical details and reasoning traces in collapsed views, creating observability blind spots. 在多智能体系统中，每个智能体的披露层独立运作，使攻击者能够利用监控主要关注用户可见的基本视图这一点，在隐藏的技术视图中执行恶意操作。 In multi-agent systems, each agent’s disclosure layers operate independently, allowing attackers to exploit monitoring that focuses on user-visible essential views while malicious operations execute in hidden technical views. 当智能体执行可疑的工具调用（访问敏感 API、执行异常数据库查询、进行高权限操作）时，这些活动仅出现在用户很少查看的展开后的技术层中。 When agents perform suspicious tool invocations (accessing sensitive APIs, unusual database queries, high-privilege operations), these activities appear only in expanded technical layers users rarely inspect. 这种 UI 设计模式提高了易用性，但同时降低了安全可观测性。 This UI design pattern improves usability but simultaneously reduces security observability. 多智能体系统放大了风险，因为监控必须同时跟踪多个智能体的披露状态——当用户监视智能体 A 的基本视图，而智能体 B 在其折叠视图中执行恶意操作时，就会产生单智能体系统中不存在的盲区。 Multi-agent systems amplify risk because monitoring must track disclosure state across multiple agents simultaneously—a user monitoring Agent A’s essential view while Agent B executes malicious operations in its collapsed view creates blind spots unavailable in single-agent systems. [1852, 69, 70, 62, 23]. [1852, 69, 70, 62, 23].
RTM_1_2 - 聊天界面日志缺失语义上下文和意图。 RTM_1_2 - Chat Interface Logging Missing Semantic Context and Intent. 聊天界面将对话历史记录为消息序列，却未能捕获安全监控所需的语义含义、推理来源和意图分类。 Chat interfaces log conversation histories as message sequences but fail to capture semantic meaning, reasoning provenance, and intent classification necessary for security monitoring. 传统日志记录了说过什么，却没有记录智能体为何选择特定工具、访问了哪些数据源、置信度水平如何，或查询模式是否与攻击特征相匹配。 Traditional logs record what was said but not why agents chose specific tools, which data sources were accessed, confidence levels, or whether query patterns match attack signatures. 在多智能体环境中，安全分析需要理解跨智能体的推理流程——智能体 A 的响应成为智能体 B 的上下文，进而触发智能体 C 的工具调用。 In multi-agent environments, security analysis requires understanding cross-agent reasoning flows—Agent A’s response became Agent B’s context, triggering Agent C’s tool invocation. 如果缺少捕获决策图而非消息序列的语义日志，安全团队就无法区分合法的复杂工作流与协同攻击。 Without semantic logging capturing decision graphs rather than message sequences, security teams cannot distinguish legitimate complex workflows from coordinated attacks. 聊天日志呈现了表象，却未揭示原因，使得在事件发生后的调查中区分提示注入与合法请求极其困难。 Chat logs show symptoms but not causes, making post-incident investigation of prompt injection versus legitimate requests extremely difficult. [86, 69, 62]. [86, 69, 62].
RTM_1_3 - 流式响应遥测缺口导致攻击检测延迟。 RTM_1_3 - Streaming Response Telemetry Gaps Creating Attack Detection Delays. 流式响应模式给遥测数据采集带来了挑战，安全监控只有在流式传输结束后才能分析完整响应。 Streaming response patterns create telemetry collection challenges where security monitoring cannot analyze complete responses until streaming finishes. 在智能体 A 向智能体 B 流式传输分析结果、智能体 B 再向智能体 C 流式传输操作的多智能体系统中，流式交接会形成多个需要汇总局部遥测数据的节点。 In multi-agent systems where Agent A streams analysis to Agent B which streams actions to Agent C, streaming handoffs create multiple points where partial telemetry must be aggregated. 当恶意指令嵌入冗长的流式响应时，监控面临两难：等待完整响应（引入延迟），或分析部分数据流（面临误报风险）。 When malicious instructions embed in long streaming responses, monitoring faces a dilemma: wait for complete responses (introducing delays) or analyze partial streams (risking false positives). 多智能体流式传输加剧了这些挑战，因为检测需要实时关联不同智能体的部分数据流。 Multi-agent streaming amplifies challenges because detection requires correlating partial streams across agents in real-time. 流式传输时序的非确定性（网络延迟、生成速度、中断）使遥测基线难以建立，由此形成盲区，让操纵流式传输时序的攻击能够完全逃避检测。 Non-deterministic streaming timing (network delays, generation speeds, interruptions) makes baseline telemetry establishment difficult, creating blind spots where attacks manipulating streaming timing evade detection entirely. [69, 70, 62]. [69, 70, 62].
RTM_1_4 - 审批工作流遥测记录决策，却不记录推理溯源信息。 RTM_1_4 - Approval Workflow Telemetry Recording Decisions Without Reasoning Provenance. 审批工作流界面会记录人工决策（批准/拒绝/修改），却未能捕获完整的推理溯源信息——哪些智能体的评估影响了决策、显示了哪些置信度分数，以及信息披露状态如何影响了审核。 Approval workflow interfaces log human decisions (approved/rejected/modified) but fail to capture complete reasoning provenance—which agent assessments influenced decisions, what confidence scores were displayed, and how disclosure states affected review. 在多智能体系统中，审批建议会汇总来自专门智能体（风险评估、政策合规、欺诈检测）的输入；这一缺口意味着安全团队无法确定，批准决定究竟体现了全面审核，还是源于遭到篡改的智能体输出对置信度显示的操纵。 In multi-agent systems where approval recommendations aggregate inputs from specialized agents (risk assessment, policy compliance, fraud detection), this gap means security teams cannot determine whether approvals reflected comprehensive review or resulted from compromised agent outputs manipulating confidence displays. 通过投毒某个专门智能体的输入来抬高总体置信度分数，攻击者可以实施此类攻击：审计日志显示“人工批准了交易”，却未记录欺诈性的置信度聚合。 Poisoning one specialized agent’s input to inflate overall confidence scores allows attacks where audit logs show ”human approved transaction” without capturing fraudulent confidence aggregation. 多智能体审批工作流需要对多个智能体的输出进行溯源跟踪，通过重建哪些智能体的贡献当时可见、受到信任，以及哪些本应引发审查，在事件发生后判断批准是否恰当。 Multi-agent approval workflows require provenance tracking spanning multiple agents’ outputs, understanding post-incident whether approval was appropriate by reconstructing which agent contributions were visible, trusted, and which should have triggered scrutiny. [18, 67, 23]. [18, 67, 23].
RTM_1_5 - 命令面板建议遥测缺少上下文操纵指标。 RTM_1_5 - Command Palette Suggestion Telemetry Missing Context Manipulation Indicators. 采用 AI 建议的命令面板模式会生成遥测数据，记录建议的命令和已执行的命令，却未能捕获建议出现的原因——哪些上下文信号触发了这些建议，以及上下文是否遭到操纵，从而使建议偏向恶意操作。 Command palette patterns using AI suggestions generate telemetry showing suggested and executed commands, but fail to capture why suggestions appeared—which context signals triggered them and whether context was manipulated to bias suggestions toward malicious operations. 在多智能体系统中，建议会汇总来自多个来源（代码分析、用户行为、项目文档智能体）的上下文；监控需要理解上下文溯源图，以检测遭投毒的上下文导致恶意命令以合法建议的形式出现的攻击。 In multi-agent systems where suggestions aggregate context from multiple sources (code analysis, user behavior, project documentation agents), monitoring requires understanding context provenance graphs to detect attacks where poisoned context causes malicious commands to appear as legitimate suggestions. 当遭到篡改的上下文错误地表明当前处于测试环境，导致命令面板建议“删除生产数据库”时，遥测会记录“用户执行了删除命令”，却未捕获上下文操纵。 When a command palette suggests ”Delete production database” due to compromised context falsely signaling testing environment, telemetry logs ”user executed delete command” without capturing context manipulation. 多智能体系统带来了可观测性挑战，因为检测上下文投毒需要关联所有提供上下文的智能体的遥测数据，而标准遥测只记录最终建议和用户操作，遗漏了展示上下文信号如何组合形成建议的中间层。 Multi-agent systems create observability challenges because detecting context poisoning requires correlating telemetry across all context-providing agents, but standard telemetry only logs final suggestions and user actions, missing the middle layer showing how context signals combined to produce suggestions. [522, 62, 23]. [522, 62, 23].
RTM_1_6 - 错误恢复遥测将重试尝试视为原子事件。 RTM_1_6 - Error Recovery Telemetry Treating Retry Attempts as Atomic Events. 采用指数退避自动重试机制的错误通信模式，将每次重试视为独立的原子事件，而未捕获完整重试序列的上下文。 Error communication patterns implementing automatic retry with exponential backoff treat each retry as independent atomic events rather than capturing complete retry sequence context. 在错误恢复涉及专门智能体（检测、诊断、协调、执行）的多智能体系统中，监控需要将重试序列理解为连贯的事件过程。 In multi-agent systems where error recovery involves specialized agents (detection, diagnosis, coordination, execution), monitoring requires understanding retry sequences as coherent narratives. 攻击者精心构造输入，故意在前期智能体中触发错误，同时在负责重试的智能体中执行恶意载荷。 Attackers craft inputs deliberately triggering errors in early agents while executing malicious payloads in retry agents. 显示“操作失败，重试 3 次后成功”的标准遥测，未能体现每次重试处理的输入存在细微差异，或第 N 次重试指向了不同的代码路径。 Standard telemetry showing ”operation failed, retried 3 times, succeeded” misses that each retry processed subtly different inputs or that retry N indicated different code paths. 多智能体错误恢复需要关联所有智能体的遥测数据，因为同一序列在不同尝试中会涉及具有不同安全上下文的不同智能体，而检测利用重试逻辑的攻击需要这种分布式编排上下文。 Multi-agent error recovery requires correlating telemetry across all agents because the same sequence involves different agents across attempts with different security contexts, and detecting attacks exploiting retry logic needs this distributed orchestration context. [1853, 68, 71]. [1853, 68, 71].
RTM_1_7 - 上下文感知遥测缺少跨会话状态投毒指标。 RTM_1_7 - Context Awareness Telemetry Missing Cross-Session State Poisoning Indicators. 持久化保存对话历史和会话状态的上下文感知功能会形成长期存在的认知状态，但遥测通常独立处理每个会话，而不跟踪上下文跨越会话边界的演变。 Context awareness features persisting conversation history and session state create long-lived cognitive state, but telemetry typically treats each session independently rather than tracking context evolution across boundaries. 在上下文由专门智能体共享并跨会话持久保存的多智能体系统中，监控需要跟踪上下文溯源信息——哪些用户输入参与形成了状态、哪些智能体修改了状态，以及这些变化体现的是正常学习还是恶意投毒。 In multi-agent systems sharing context across specialized agents and persisting across sessions, monitoring requires tracking context provenance—which user inputs contributed to state, which agents modified it, and whether changes reflect legitimate learning or malicious poisoning. 攻击者在会话 1 期间注入的恶意指令，会在会话 2-5 中经由智能体传播；标准遥测呈现的是彼此独立的会话，未能捕获持久状态的延续脉络。 Attackers injecting malicious instructions during Session 1 propagate through agents across Sessions 2-5; standard telemetry shows independent sessions failing to capture persistent state threads. 多智能体上下文共享会放大这些缺口，因为检测需要跨智能体、会话和用户进行关联，跟踪遭投毒的上下文如何通过共享记忆影响多个用户。 Multi-agent context sharing amplifies gaps because detection requires correlating across agents, sessions, and users, tracking how poisoned context affects multiple users through shared memory. 传统监控跟踪单个会话内的状态；智能体的上下文感知能力则要求检测持续数天或数周、跨会话且跨智能体展开的状态操纵。 Traditional monitoring tracks state within single sessions; agent context awareness creates requirements for detecting cross-session, cross-agent state manipulation unfolding over days or weeks.
