[73, 72, 62]. [73, 72, 62].
RTM_1_8 - 多智能体仪表板的归属遥测缺口使身份冒充成为可能。 RTM_1_8 - Multi-Agent Dashboard Attribution Telemetry Gaps Enabling Impersonation. 多智能体仪表板展示来自多个智能体的消息、分析和建议，由此带来的归属识别挑战要求不仅跟踪内容，还要跟踪内容由哪个智能体生成，以及归属信号是否可能遭到操纵。 Multi-agent dashboards displaying messages, analyses, and recommendations from multiple agents create attribution challenges requiring tracking not just content but which agent generated it and whether attribution signals could be manipulated. 在智能体相互通信并呈现综合输出的系统中，需要了解完整的归因链：Agent A 生成了分析，Agent B 对其进行了验证，Agent C 将其呈现出来，但 Agent A 的身份是否经过了适当认证？ Systems where agents communicate and present synthesized outputs require understanding complete attribution chains—Agent A generated analysis, Agent B verified it, Agent C presented it, but was Agent A’s identity properly authenticated? 标准遥测仅记录“显示了来自 Risk Agent 的欺诈风险评估”，却未记录其身份是否经过验证，或内容是否绕过了输出验证。 Standard telemetry logs ”displayed fraud risk assessment from Risk Agent” without capturing whether identity was verified or whether content bypassed output verification. 多智能体归因要求跟踪每个交接点的身份验证情况。 Multi-agent attribution requires tracking identity verification at every handoff point. 当仪表板显示“Agent Security Advisor 建议禁用身份认证”，而遥测未记录验证被绕过的情况时，监控就无法区分合法建议与身份冒充。 When dashboards show ”Agent Security Advisor recommends disabling authentication” without telemetry capturing verification bypass, monitoring cannot distinguish legitimate recommendations from impersonation. 这种溯源缺口是多智能体系统特有的：单智能体系统的归因较为简单，而多智能体系统需要复杂的关系图，标准基础设施无法记录这些关系图。 This provenance gap is specific to multi-agent systems—singular systems have simple attribution while multi-agent systems require complex graphs that standard infrastructure doesn’t capture. [18, 23, 62]. [18, 23, 62].
RTM_1_9 - 行内建议遥测缺少拒绝模式分析。 RTM_1_9 - Inline Suggestion Telemetry Missing Rejection Pattern Analysis. 在用户工作过程中提供 AI 建议的行内建议模式，会生成反映采纳情况的遥测数据，却未记录拒绝模式。 Inline suggestion patterns offering AI recommendations during user work generate telemetry showing acceptance but fail to capture rejection patterns. 在由专门智能体生成不同建议（代码补全、文档编写、测试生成）的多智能体系统中，监控需要跨智能体分析拒绝模式，以检测遭到入侵的智能体是否生成了越来越可疑、且被用户持续拒绝的建议。 In multi-agent systems where specialized agents generate different suggestions (code completion, documentation, test generation), monitoring requires analyzing rejection patterns across agents to detect compromised agents generating increasingly suspicious suggestions users consistently reject. 显示“采纳率为 20%”的标准采纳率指标，无法揭示用户专门拒绝身份认证代码建议、同时采纳 UI 组件建议这一情况。 Standard acceptance rate metrics showing ”20% acceptance” miss that users specifically reject authentication code suggestions while accepting UI components. 多智能体建议系统需要跨智能体进行拒绝分析，因为检测投毒需要比较不同智能体、上下文和用户的拒绝率。 Multi-agent suggestion systems require cross-agent rejection analysis because detecting poisoning requires comparing rejection rates across agents, contexts, and users. 如果遥测未记录拒绝原因（点击别处、编辑、举报不当内容），监控就无法区分正常波动与具有安全意义的性能退化；在后一种情况下，遭到入侵的智能体会系统性地建议存在漏洞的模式。 Without telemetry capturing rejection reasons (clicked away, edited, reported inappropriate), monitoring cannot distinguish normal variation from security-relevant degradation where compromised agents systematically suggest vulnerable patterns. [69, 23, 62]. [69, 23, 62].
RTM_1_10 - 工具调用日志缺少参数语义分析。 RTM_1_10 - Tool Invocation Logging Without Parameter Semantic Analysis. 记录工具调用的智能体 UI 模式会记录调用了哪些工具及其参数，但将参数视为不透明值，而不结合对话上下文分析其语义是否恰当。 Agent UI patterns logging tool invocations capture which tools were called and parameters, but treat parameters as opaque values rather than analyzing semantic appropriateness given conversation context. 在 Agent A 的调用受 Agent B 所提供上下文影响的多智能体系统中，监控需要了解客户 ID 是来自合法上下文，还是来自 Agent B 中遭到投毒的上下文。 In multi-agent systems where Agent A’s invocations are influenced by Agent B’s context provision, monitoring requires understanding whether customer IDs came from legitimate context or poisoned Agent B context. 如果日志仅显示“调用了 delete_records(table=’audit_logs’)”，却未记录参数来源，就无法检测参数注入攻击。 Logs showing ”called delete_records(table=’audit_logs’)” without capturing parameter provenance cannot detect parameter injection attacks. 多智能体工具调用要求跨智能体追踪参数来源：哪个智能体提供了哪些参数，以及参数提供过程是合法的，还是已遭到入侵？ Multi-agent tool invocation requires tracing parameter provenance across agents—which agent provided which parameters, and was provision legitimate or compromised? 传统日志记录函数调用及其参数；智能体日志则必须记录语义来源，以检测合法工具调用因遭到投毒的跨智能体上下文而变成恶意调用的攻击。 Traditional logging captures function calls with parameters; agent logging must capture semantic provenance to detect attacks where legitimate tool invocations become malicious through poisoned cross-agent context. [69, 23, 62]. [69, 23, 62].
RTM_1_11 - 置信度分数遥测缺少分解信息和聚合透明度。 RTM_1_11 - Confidence Score Telemetry Missing Decomposition and Aggregation Transparency. 显示置信度分数的界面有助于用户校准信任，但遥测未能记录计算方法和多智能体聚合过程。 Interfaces displaying confidence scores help users calibrate trust but telemetry fails to capture calculation methods and multi-agent aggregation. 在总体置信度由加权聚合得出的系统中（Agent A：90%，Agent B：70%，显示值：85%），监控需要了解完整的计算链，才能检测操纵行为。 In systems where overall confidence represents weighted aggregation (Agent A: 90%, Agent B: 70%, display: 85%), monitoring requires understanding the complete calculation chain to detect manipulation. 如果遥测仅显示“为退款审批显示了 85% 的置信度”，却未记录遭到入侵的欺诈检测智能体报告了 95%、而策略合规智能体报告了 60%，就无法检测显示结果受到操纵的情况。 Telemetry showing ”displayed 85% confidence for refund approval” without capturing that compromised fraud detection agent reported 95% while policy compliance reported 60% cannot detect manipulated displays. 多智能体置信度聚合需要分解遥测数据，显示哪些智能体作出了贡献、各自的权重、智能体是否针对某些请求类型报告了异常值，以及聚合逻辑是否受到投毒上下文的影响。 Multi-agent confidence aggregation requires decomposition telemetry showing which agents contributed, weighting, whether agents reported anomalously for request types, and whether aggregation logic was influenced by poisoned context. 这种分解对于检测复杂攻击至关重要：攻击者知道特定智能体的贡献会对用于引导人工监督的显示结果产生不成比例的影响，因此会入侵这些智能体。 This decomposition is critical for detecting sophisticated attacks compromising specific agents knowing their contributions disproportionately affect displays driving human oversight. [67, 62, 23, 1854]. [67, 62, 23, 1854].
RTM_1_12 - 会话持久化遥测缺少状态恢复验证。 RTM_1_12 - Session Persistence Telemetry Missing State Restoration Verification. 支持恢复对话的上下文感知能力依赖会话持久化，但遥测仅记录加载过程，未验证完整性，也未检测未经授权的修改。 Context awareness enabling conversation resumption relies on session persistence, but telemetry captures loading without verifying integrity or detecting unauthorized modifications. 在状态包含智能体之间共享上下文的多智能体系统中，监控需要了解状态是否在会话之间被修改、谁访问了已存储的状态，以及恢复过程是否验证了真实性。 In multi-agent systems where state includes context shared across agents, monitoring requires understanding whether state was modified between sessions, who accessed stored state, and whether restoration verified authenticity. 当遥测显示“已为用户 X 加载对话历史”，却未记录通过数据库层面的状态修改注入恶意指令的情况时，监控就无法检测利用持久化缺口实施的投毒。 When telemetry shows ”loaded conversation history for user X” without capturing database-level state modifications injecting malicious instructions, monitoring cannot detect poisoning exploiting persistence gaps. 多智能体持久化会放大风险，因为恢复过程可能同时从分布式存储中加载多个智能体的上下文，因此不仅需要检查单个智能体的状态，还需要检查跨智能体的一致性。 Multi-agent persistence amplifies risk because restoration may load context for multiple agents simultaneously from distributed storage, requiring checking not just individual state but cross-agent consistency. 如果没有遥测数据记录恢复验证过程（哈希检查、访问日志、一致性验证），监控就无法判断恢复后的会话反映的是真实交互，还是已遭篡改的存储内容。 Without telemetry capturing restoration verification (hash checks, access logs, consistency validation), monitoring lacks visibility into whether resumed sessions reflect authentic interactions or compromised storage. [73, 72, 69]. [73, 72, 69].
RTM_1_13 - 实时推理轨迹遥测的性能开销导致采样偏差。 RTM_1_13 - Real-Time Reasoning Trace Telemetry Performance Overhead Creating Sampling Bias. 通过推理轨迹实现透明性面临挑战：全面记录日志会产生性能开销，迫使系统采用会遗漏安全事件的采样策略。 Transparency through reasoning traces faces challenges where comprehensive logging creates performance overhead, forcing sampling strategies missing security events. 在需要完整轨迹来记录跨智能体决策流程的多智能体系统中（Agent A 的推理引发查询，查询结果影响 Agent B 的推理，进而决定 Agent C 的工具调用），轨迹数据量可能超出基础设施的承载能力。 In multi-agent systems requiring complete traces capturing decision flows across agents (Agent A’s reasoning led to queries, results influenced Agent B’s reasoning, determining Agent C’s tool invocation), trace volume can overwhelm infrastructure. 采样（每隔 10 步记录一次，或仅记录被标记的对话）会造成盲区，使未被采样的攻击逃过检测。 Sampling (every 10th step, or only flagged conversations) creates blind spots where non-sampled attacks evade detection. 多智能体追踪带来了独特挑战，因为攻击可能针对未被采样的智能体或时间窗口——如果始终对 Agent A 的轨迹进行采样，而仅在高风险操作中对 Agent B 的轨迹进行采样，攻击者就会通过 Agent B，将恶意操作伪装成被归类为低风险的请求来执行。 Multi-agent tracing creates unique challenges because attacks may target non-sampled agents or timing windows—if Agent A’s traces are always sampled but Agent B’s only for high-risk operations, attackers route malicious operations through Agent B for low-risk classified requests. 在多智能体系统中，性能与可观测性之间的权衡更为严峻，因为全面的跨智能体遥测需要实时关联分析，而计算成本可能迫使系统采用采样，从而造成安全盲区。 Performance-observability tradeoffs are more severe in multi-agent systems because comprehensive cross-agent telemetry requires real-time correlation, and computational cost may force sampling creating security blind spots. 传统监控可以在不遗漏关键事件的情况下进行采样，但对智能体轨迹进行采样可能会遗漏揭示协同攻击的特定跨智能体推理关联。 Traditional monitoring can sample without missing critical events, but agent trace sampling risks missing the specific cross-agent reasoning connections revealing coordinated attacks. [69, 70, 62]. [69, 70, 62].
RTM_1_14 - 用户干预遥测缺少干预前的状态上下文。 RTM_1_14 - User Intervention Telemetry Missing Pre-Intervention State Context. 允许用户暂停、停止、修改或覆盖智能体操作的控制机制会生成表明干预已发生的遥测数据，却未能捕获完整的干预前状态。 User control mechanisms enabling pausing, stopping, modifying, or overriding agent actions generate telemetry showing interventions occurred but fail to capture complete pre-intervention state. 在干预会影响多个正在运行的智能体的多智能体系统中（暂停工作流会使正在分析的 Agent A 和正在执行工具的 Agent B 中途停止），监控需要了解干预发生时各智能体的分布式状态。 In multi-agent systems where interventions affect multiple in-flight agents (pausing workflow stops Agent A mid-analysis and Agent B mid-tool-execution), monitoring requires understanding distributed agent state at intervention time. 如果遥测数据仅显示“用户取消了数据库删除”，却没有记录该删除操作是基于遭投毒的 Agent B 上下文、以 95% 的置信度推荐的，就无法判断此次干预是阻止了攻击，还是取消了合法操作。 Telemetry showing ”user cancelled database deletion” without capturing that deletion was recommended with 95% confidence based on poisoned Agent B context cannot determine whether intervention prevented attacks or cancelled legitimate operations. 多智能体干预需要捕获分布式状态，包括活跃智能体、待执行操作、跨智能体上下文，以及影响人类决策的 UI 信息披露状态。 Multi-agent intervention requires capturing distributed state including active agents, pending operations, cross-agent context, and UI disclosure states affecting human decisions. 如果没有干预前的遥测数据，监控就无法从干预模式中学习以改进检测——例如，用户可能总是在特定智能体组合生成高置信度建议时进行干预，这表明这些交互应触发自动警报。 Without pre-intervention telemetry, monitoring cannot learn from intervention patterns to improve detection—perhaps users consistently intervene when specific agent combinations generate high-confidence recommendations, signaling those interactions should trigger automated alerts. [67, 23, 62]. [67, 23, 62].
RTM_1_15 - 成本与资源遥测掩盖经济型攻击迹象。 RTM_1_15 - Cost and Resource Telemetry Hiding Economic Attack Indicators. 显示 token 用量和 API 成本等资源消耗的界面会生成用于运营目的的遥测数据，但即使经济层面的模式表明存在攻击，这些数据也未被用于安全分析。 Interfaces displaying resource consumption including token usage and API costs create telemetry captured for operational purposes but not analyzed for security despite economic patterns indicating attacks. 在具有不同成本特征的多智能体系统中（轻量分析使用少量 token，重量级研究使用大量 token），监控需要判断异常模式反映的是合理的任务复杂性，还是蓄意触发高成本操作的攻击。 In multi-agent systems with different cost profiles (lightweight analysis uses few tokens, heavyweight research uses many), monitoring requires understanding whether unusual patterns reflect legitimate complexity or attacks deliberately triggering expensive operations. 如果遥测数据仅显示“API 成本增加了 300%”，却未判断遭入侵的智能体是否为简单查询反复调用高成本操作，就会遗漏消耗预算或造成钱包拒绝服务（denial-of-wallet）的经济型攻击。 Telemetry showing ”API costs increased 300%” without determining whether compromised agents repeatedly invoked expensive operations for trivial queries misses economic attacks burning budgets or enabling denial-of-wallet. 多智能体归因需要关联不同智能体、用户和时间段的成本，以检测某个智能体遭入侵是否会引发连锁的高成本下游操作，或者某个遭入侵的账户是否推高了共享基础设施的成本。 Multi-agent attribution requires correlating costs across agents, users, and time to detect whether one agent’s compromise cascades to expensive downstream operations or whether one compromised account drives costs for shared infrastructure. 传统监控将资源数据视为运营遥测而非安全遥测，但智能体的行为模式能够揭示安全事件——异常 token 用量表明提示注入导致过量处理，异常 API 使用模式表明工具滥用，资源耗尽则表明存在传统警报未能检测到的拒绝服务。 Traditional monitoring treats resources as operational rather than security telemetry, but agent patterns reveal security events—unusual token usage indicates prompt injection causing excessive processing, abnormal API patterns indicate tool misuse, resource exhaustion indicates denial of service undetected by traditional alerts. [1855, 1856, 745, 62]. [1855, 1856, 745, 62].
RTM_1_16 - HITL 监控的遥测盲区。 RTM_1_16 - HITL Monitoring Telemetry Blind Spots. HITL（Human-in-the-Loop，人在回路）工作流监控存在缺口，标准指标会掩盖关键决策点。 HITL (Human-in-the-Loop) workflow monitoring suffers gaps where standard metrics hide critical decision points. 监控跟踪的是汇总指标，而单笔事务会因人员未深入查看而悄然失败；团队以提高自动批准率为优化目标，却没有意识到，如果监控 UI 呈现了用户可以据此采取行动的早期预警，自动批准率本应更低；仪表板显示“系统健康”，但具体操作却运行困难。 Monitoring tracks aggregate metrics while individual transactions fail silently because humans don’t drill down, teams optimize for high auto-approval rates without realizing they would be lower if monitoring UIs surfaced early warnings users could act on, and dashboard visibility shows ”system healthy” while specific operations struggle. 多智能体系统会放大这一问题，因为对某个智能体工作流的干预可能防止依赖它的其他智能体发生级联故障，但遥测数据并未捕获干预的跨智能体影响。 Multi-agent systems amplify this because intervention in one agent workflow may prevent cascading failures in dependent agents, but telemetry doesn’t capture cross-agent intervention effects. 汇总指标掩盖了哪些智能体受益于人工监督，以及哪些智能体是在缺乏有效监控的情况下运行的。 Aggregate metrics obscure which agents benefited from human oversight versus operating without effective monitoring. 例如，一个交易算法仪表板显示已完成 847 笔交易，成功率为 94%，利润为 $12K；一名交易员注意到某个持仓正在迅速亏损，于是暂停了算法，避免了 $50K 的损失，但遥测仅记录了“于 14:37 暂停”，没有捕获触发因素、指标或反应时间，因而无法据此改进监控用户界面。 For example, a trading algorithm dashboard shows 847 trades with 94% success and $12K profit; a trader pauses the algorithm noticing one position losing quickly, preventing $50K loss, but telemetry records only ”paused at 14:37” without capturing triggers, metrics, or reaction times, preventing improvement of monitoring UIs. 缓解措施需要记录干预事件及其详细上下文，包括触发指标和反应时间；跟踪险些发生的事件，记录指标接近阈值但随后恢复的情况；开展仪表板交互分析，跟踪用户与哪些监控界面元素交互、忽略哪些元素；以及通过反事实分析估算干预的价值。 Mitigation requires intervention event logging with detailed context including trigger metrics and reaction times, near-miss tracking logging when metrics approached thresholds but recovered, dashboard interaction analytics tracking which monitoring UI elements users interact with versus ignore, and counterfactual analysis estimating intervention value. [67, 23, 62]. [67, 23, 62].
RTM_1_17 - 屏幕阅读器使用中的无障碍遥测缺口。 RTM_1_17 - Accessibility Telemetry Gaps in Screen Reader Usage. 针对视觉扫视优化的监控仪表板无法满足屏幕阅读器用户的需求，却缺乏检测这些问题的遥测，因为分析机制假定用户采用视觉交互模式，而屏幕阅读器的导航行为（地标之间的跳转、标题层级遍历、ARIA 实时区域）未被测量。 Monitoring dashboards optimized for visual scanning fail screen reader users, but lack telemetry detecting failures because analytics assume visual interaction patterns while screen reader navigation (landmark-to-landmark jumping, heading hierarchy traversal, ARIA live regions) goes unmeasured. 多智能体监控仪表板使这一问题更加严重，因为屏幕阅读器用户可能能够成功监控某些智能体，却无法访问其他智能体的关键细节；缺少无障碍遥测，就无法识别这些障碍。 Multi-agent monitoring dashboards compound this because screen reader users may successfully monitor some agents while unable to access critical details for others; without accessibility telemetry, identifying barriers is impossible. 仪表板可能通过 ARIA 实时区域完美地播报汇总状态，却无法让用户通过屏幕阅读器下钻查看交易细节，而没有遥测，团队就无法发现 15% 的用户无法有效监控行为。 A dashboard may perfectly announce aggregate status via ARIA live regions but fail drill-down to transaction details via screen reader, and without telemetry, teams cannot identify that 15% of users cannot effectively monitor behavior. 一次仪表板重新设计改善了视觉布局，使视力正常用户从发现问题到实施干预的时间缩短了 30%；分析数据显示有所改进，但此次重新设计改变了标题层级，破坏了屏幕阅读器导航，使得用户原先可以直接跳转至“错误日志”，现在却必须按 Tab 键逐一经过 40 个元素。 A dashboard redesign improves visual layout reducing sighted user time-to-intervention by 30%; analytics show improvement, but the redesign changed heading hierarchy breaking screen reader navigation where users previously could jump to ”Error Log” now must tab through 40 elements. 如果不存在妨碍测量屏幕阅读器使用模式的遥测缺口，团队却仍会对无障碍功能的退步感到意外。 Without telemetry gaps preventing measurement of screen reader patterns, teams are surprised by accessibility regression. 缓解措施需要在用户同意的情况下检测辅助技术、采集地标导航遥测、测量 ARIA 实时区域的有效性，以及为键盘和屏幕阅读器导航生成无障碍热力图，以显示其与鼠标用户不同的行为模式。 Mitigation requires assistive technology detection with user consent, landmark navigation telemetry, ARIA live region effectiveness measurement, and accessibility heatmaps for keyboard and screen reader navigation showing different patterns from mouse users. [69, 70, 62]. [69, 70, 62].
III-F2 RTM_2 - 特定框架的架构与日志记录缺口III-F2 RTM_2 - Framework-Specific Architecture and Logging Gaps
RTM_2_1 - 多层智能体层级结构中规划与执行（Plan-and-Execute）的不透明性。 RTM_2_1 - Plan-and-Execute Opacity in Multi-Tier Agent Hierarchies. 多层 Plan-and-Execute 架构会产生可观测性盲区，其中监督智能体负责规划，工作智能体负责执行，子工作智能体负责完成专门任务。 Multi-tier Plan-and-Execute architectures create observability dead zones where supervisor agents plan, workers execute, and sub-workers perform specialized tasks. 层级系统将执行工作分配给具有不同记忆上下文、工具访问权限和日志记录粒度的智能体。 Hierarchical systems distribute execution across agents with different memory contexts, tool access, and logging granularity. 监控缺口源于不同层级之间的上下文碎片化。 The monitoring gap emerges from context fragmentation across tiers. 监督智能体生成计划；工作智能体通过将任务委派给维护独立上下文和日志流的子工作智能体来执行各个步骤。 Supervisors generate plans; workers execute steps by delegating to sub-workers maintaining separate contexts and logging streams. 下游工作智能体接收到的是汇总结果，无法了解其推导历史，导致调查过程中无法进行因果归因。 Downstream workers receive aggregated results lacking visibility into derivation history, making causal attribution impossible during investigation. 安全团队无法确定数据损坏是由哪个层级引入的。 Security teams cannot determine which tier introduced corruption. 攻击者通过多层提示注入利用这种不透明性，将恶意指令嵌入子工作智能体访问的数据源中。 Adversaries exploit opacity through multi-tier prompt injection, embedding malicious instructions in data sources sub-workers access. [69, 1853, 62]. [69, 1853, 62].
RTM_2_2 - 工具链监控缺口使隐蔽的权限提升成为可能。 RTM_2_2 - Tool Chain Monitoring Gaps Enabling Covert Privilege Escalation. 工具访问权限分散的多智能体系统会产生盲区：单个工具调用孤立来看似乎无害，但按顺序跨智能体串联后却构成攻击链。 Multi-agent systems with distributed tool access create blind spots where individual tool calls appear benign in isolation but form attack chains sequenced across agents. 按智能体分别开展的安全监控会遗漏跨智能体编排模式，使权限提升、数据外泄和未经授权的操作成为可能。 Security monitoring per-agent misses cross-agent orchestration patterns enabling privilege escalation, data exfiltration, and unauthorized actions. 该漏洞源于能力的分散配置。 Vulnerability stems from capability distribution. 智能体 A（只读数据库查询）可以访问客户数据，但无法修改记录或发送电子邮件。 Agent A (read-only database queries) accesses customer data but cannot modify records or send emails. 智能体 B（通信工具）可以发送电子邮件，但无法查询数据库。 Agent B (communication tools) sends emails but cannot query databases. 每个智能体的权限看起来都受到了适当限制。 Each agent’s permissions appear properly constrained. 攻击者利用跨智能体串联来提升权限。 Attackers exploit cross-agent chaining to escalate. 他们提交查询，使智能体 A 获取敏感数据（属于合法读取，并按常规记录日志）。 They submit queries causing Agent A to fetch sensitive data (legitimate read, logged normally). 智能体 A 的输出被传递给智能体 B，后者据此将获取的客户数据发送至攻击者控制的外部电子邮件地址，从而完成一次任何单个智能体的逐工具审计都无法检测到的数据外泄攻击。 Agent A’s output passes to Agent B, which uses it to send the fetched customer data to an external email address under attacker control, completing an exfiltration attack that no single agent’s per-tool audit would detect. [1855, 62, 23]. [1855, 62, 23].
RTM_2_3 - 操纵关联 ID 造成分布式追踪盲区和因果关系歧义。 RTM_2_3 - Correlation ID Manipulation Creating Distributed Tracing Blind Spots and Causal Ambiguity. 多智能体系统使用关联 ID 将跨越智能体边界的分布式操作关联起来，从而能够追踪复杂工作流中的执行流程。 Multi-agent systems use correlation IDs linking distributed operations across agent boundaries, enabling trace flows through complex workflows. 攻击者通过操纵关联 ID 使追踪记录碎片化、切断因果联系，或制造歧义，从而阻碍调查和归因。 Attackers manipulating correlation IDs fragment traces, sever causal links, or create ambiguity preventing investigation and attribution. 在文档处理工作流中，合法操作依次关联为：接收 → OCR → 分类 → 提取 → 存储。 In document processing workflows, legitimate operations link intake → OCR → classification → extraction → storage. 攻击者通过以下方式操纵 ID：(1) 碎片化——在工作流中途更改 ID，使各项操作看起来互不相关，从而阻止重建；(2) 碰撞——复用合法 ID，将恶意操作混入正常活动，造成歧义；(3) 洪泛——生成数千条带有随机 ID 的追踪记录，利用噪声掩盖恶意追踪记录。 Attackers manipulate IDs through: (1) fragmentation—changing IDs mid-workflow so operations appear unrelated, preventing reconstruction; (2) collision—reusing legitimate IDs blending malicious operations with normal activity, creating ambiguity; (3) flooding—generating thousands of traces with random IDs obscuring malicious traces through noise. 攻击之所以能够成功，是因为追踪机制假定 ID 可信，却缺乏对其真实性的密码学验证或因果关系证明。 Attacks succeed because tracing assumes IDs are trustworthy, lacking cryptographic verification of authenticity or causal proofs. 与单智能体的原子日志记录不同，多智能体追踪依赖跨智能体协作，这使 ID 成为可被操纵的攻击载体。 Unlike single-agent atomic logging, multi-agent tracing depends on cross-agent cooperation, transforming IDs into manipulation vectors. 缓解措施需要采用基于密码学的关联 ID 链，由智能体对修改进行签名以证明沿袭关系；利用区块链进行关联 ID 证明，以确保历史记录不可篡改；通过异常检测识别可疑模式（复用、碎片化、过量生成）；以及开展多源重建，将 ID 与时序分析和溯源信息相结合。 Mitigation requires cryptographic correlation ID chains where agents sign modifications proving lineage, correlation ID attestation using blockchain for tamper-proof history, anomaly detection identifying suspicious patterns (reuse, fragmentation, excessive generation), and multi-source reconstruction combining IDs with timing analysis and provenance. [69, 23, 62]. [69, 23, 62].
RTM_2_4 - 去中心化群体系统中的涌现行为盲点造成监控缺口。 RTM_2_4 - Emergent Behavior Blind Spots in Decentralized Swarm Systems Creating Monitoring Gaps. 群体智能系统在没有集中控制的情况下，通过简单的局部规则实现协调，并通过分布式交互产生涌现行为。 Swarm intelligence systems achieve coordination through simple local rules without centralized control, creating emergent behavior from distributed interactions. 去中心化会造成监控盲点：个体遥测数据看似正常，但系统层面的行为却是恶意的或性能退化的。 Decentralization creates monitoring blind spots where individual telemetry appears normal while system-level behavior is malicious or degraded. 在采用局部规则（分离／对齐／聚合）的监视无人机群中，监控系统跟踪个体指标（电池电量、GPS 精度、邻居数量、延迟）——所有指标均处于规范规定的正常范围内。 In drone surveillance swarms using local rules (separation/alignment/cohesion), monitoring tracks individual metrics (battery, GPS accuracy, neighbor count, latency)—all healthy within specification. 对抗性无人机注入带有偏差的避障信号，导致涌现出无法通过个体遥测数据察觉的覆盖缺口。 Adversarial drones inject biased obstacle avoidance signals causing emergent coverage gaps invisible to individual telemetry. 每架无人机的行为单独来看都是正确的，但带有偏差的交互通过共识过程传播，使整个无人机群形成系统性盲点。 Each drone’s behavior is individually correct yet swarm collectively develops systematic blind spots from biased interactions propagating through consensus. 与由集中式编排器提供全局可见性的层级系统不同，群体系统中没有任何智能体具备全面感知能力——涌现属性仅存在于分布式交互所产生的集体行为之中。 Unlike hierarchical systems with centralized orchestrators providing global visibility, swarm systems have no agent with comprehensive awareness—emergent properties only exist in collective behavior from distributed interactions. 监控缺口之所以存在，是因为智能体级遥测数据（CPU、内存、网络、任务完成情况）无法检测涌现性失调，而检测此类失调需要系统仿真或外部验证。 Monitoring gaps exist because agent-level telemetry (CPU, memory, network, task completion) cannot detect emergent misalignment requiring system simulation or external verification. 缓解措施需要监控涌现行为，将实际结果（覆盖范围、任务分配、共识收敛情况）与符合规范的规则所应产生的预期行为进行比较；利用独立传感器开展外部验证，以确认目标是否达成；通过群体级不变量定义系统范围内的属性；通过异常检测识别个体报告与集体行为之间的系统性偏差；以及采用能够抵御拜占庭故障的共识机制，防止遭到破坏的智能体使结果产生偏差。 Mitigation requires emergent behavior monitoring comparing actual outcomes (coverage, task distribution, consensus convergence) against expected behavior from specification-compliant rules, external verification using independent sensors validating objectives, swarm-level invariants defining system-wide properties, anomaly detection identifying systematic deviations between individual reports and collective behavior, and Byzantine-resilient consensus preventing corrupted agents from biasing outcomes. [91, 1857, 62, 23]. [91, 1857, 62, 23].
RTM_2_5 - 框架特有的监控盲点造成分布式可观测性缺口。 RTM_2_5 - Framework-Specific Monitoring Blind Spots Creating Distributed Observability Gaps. 不同框架提供不同的运行指标和遥测数据（LangChain 的工具调用日志、LangGraph 的状态转换事件、AutoGen 的消息历史、CrewAI 的任务完成跟踪、Semantic Kernel 的函数调用遥测数据）。 Different frameworks expose different operational metrics and telemetry (LangChain’s tool invocation logging, LangGraph’s state transition events, AutoGen’s message histories, CrewAI’s task completion tracking, Semantic Kernel’s function calling telemetry). 结合多个框架的多智能体系统会产生可观测性缺口，攻击可在框架边界处发生，而任何单一监控系统都无法完全观测这些位置。 Multi-agent systems combining frameworks create observability gaps where attacks occur at framework boundaries where no single monitoring system has complete visibility. 由于监控系统具有框架特定性，通过框架专用工具执行的恶意操作会出现在某个框架的遥测数据中，却不会出现在其他框架的遥测数据中。 Malicious operations executing through framework-specific tools appear in one framework’s telemetry but not others’ because monitoring systems are framework-specific. 经由 Semantic Kernel 插件实施的攻击可能执行 LangGraph 状态监控无法察觉的工具调用，而 LangGraph 的状态变化也可能触发 LangChain 工具日志无法记录的跨框架行为。 An attack routing through Semantic Kernel plugins might execute tool calls invisible to LangGraph state monitoring, and LangGraph state changes might trigger cross-framework behaviors invisible to LangChain’s tool logging. 不同智能体框架的调试和可观测性能力差异显著，而多智能体系统需要跨越框架边界的统一可观测性，当前的监控工具尚无法提供这种能力。 Debugging and observability capabilities differ substantially across agent frameworks, and multi-agent systems require unified observability across framework boundaries that current monitoring tooling does not provide. 单一系统可以利用一个框架的可见性实现全面监控，而多智能体系统会在框架之间产生盲点，协同攻击可利用这些监控缺口。 Unlike singular systems with comprehensive monitoring from one framework’s visibility, multi-agent systems create blind spots between frameworks where coordinated attacks exploit monitoring gaps. 攻击者系统性地将操作路由至监控最薄弱的框架，或利用框架边界逃避检测。 Attackers systematically route operations through least-monitored frameworks or exploit framework boundaries to evade detection. 多智能体的区别在于：单框架监控能够全面观测该框架；多智能体监控则必须整合各框架特有的遥测模型，而不同框架所提供信息的差异会造成持久性盲点，仅靠框架级监控无法发现这些盲点。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-framework monitoring provides comprehensive visibility for that framework; multi-agent monitoring must integrate across framework-specific telemetry models, and framework differences in what they expose create permanent blind spots undetectable through framework-level monitoring alone. [1857, 70, 23, 62]. [1857, 70, 23, 62].
RTM_2_6 - 框架架构文档缺口为攻击侦察提供便利。 RTM_2_6 - Framework Architecture Documentation Gaps Enabling Attack Reconnaissance. 公开可获取的框架文档提供了各框架的详细架构比较；但仅在框架层面编写文档的多智能体系统，很少说明跨框架集成模式或框架边界处的行为，从而为侦察创造了机会。 Publicly available framework documentation provides detailed architecture comparisons for each framework; multi-agent systems documented at framework level rarely explain cross-framework integration patterns or framework boundary behavior, creating reconnaissance opportunities. 分析框架文档的攻击者能够了解各个框架的威胁模型；而多智能体系统缺乏有文档记录的集成威胁模型。 Attackers analyzing framework documentation understand each framework’s threat model; multi-agent systems lack documented integration threat models. 解释“LangGraph 使状态操作显式化”和“Semantic Kernel 使用动态路由”的文档，有助于攻击者了解：基于状态的攻击在 LangGraph 中有效，而基于路由的攻击在 Semantic Kernel 中有效。 Documentation explaining ”LangGraph makes state manipulation explicit” and ”Semantic Kernel uses dynamic routing” helps attackers understand that state-based attacks work in LangGraph while routing-based attacks work in Semantic Kernel. 缺乏明确集成文档的多智能体系统未能突出说明，跨越框架边界的转换会产生新的攻击面——同一条恶意指令可能无法通过一个框架的输出验证，却能通过另一个框架的输入解析。 Multi-agent systems without explicit integration documentation fail to highlight that framework boundary transitions create new attack surfaces—the same malicious instruction might fail validation in one framework’s output validation but pass in another framework’s input parsing. 这种公开可获取的框架分析为了解各个框架的漏洞提供了侦察蓝图；攻击者利用它来策划跨框架攻击。 This publicly available framework analysis serves as a reconnaissance blueprint for understanding individual framework vulnerabilities; attackers leverage it to plan multi-framework attacks. 单一系统的文档将其描述为单一架构，而多智能体系统的文档将其描述为框架集合，这使攻击者能够根据各框架的专门文档综合制定跨框架攻击计划。 Unlike singular systems documented as single architectures, multi-agent systems documented as framework collections enable attackers to synthesize cross-framework attack plans from framework-specific documentation. 多智能体系统的区别：单框架文档描述该框架的威胁模型；多智能体文档应描述组合后的威胁模型，但实际上几乎从不如此，因此攻击者能够通过组合各框架的专门知识来推导跨框架攻击。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-framework documentation describes that framework’s threat model; multi-agent documentation should describe combined threat models, but practically never does, enabling attackers to derive multi-framework attacks by composing framework-specific knowledge. [62, 23, 18]. [62, 23, 18].
RTM_2_7 - 借助检查点规避审计追踪的状态变更。 RTM_2_7 - Checkpoint-Mediated State Mutations Evading Audit Trails. 检查点机制支持状态恢复，但智能体可以在创建检查点之前修改状态，再依靠检查点恢复来掩盖这些修改，从而利用该机制。 Checkpointing enables state restoration, but agents can exploit checkpointing by modifying state before checkpointing, then relying on checkpoint recovery to obscure modifications. 审计日志显示最终恢复的状态，却不显示中间发生的状态破坏。 Audit logs show the final restored state but not intermediate corruptions. 在多智能体工作流中，智能体可以在注入后立即创建检查点，使该检查点成为后续恢复执行的“基线”。 In multi-agent workflows, an agent can checkpoint immediately after injection, letting that checkpoint become the ”baseline” for subsequent resumptions. 检测需要比较检查点状态变更的校验和，但多智能体系统会带来检测难题：涉及多个智能体上下文的变更，在逐一审查时可能显得合理。 Detection requires comparing checksums of checkpoint state changes, but multi-agent systems create detection challenges where changes across multiple agents’ contexts may appear legitimate when individually reviewed. 多智能体系统的区别：单智能体检查点取证需要分析一个智能体的状态；多智能体检查点分析则需要验证跨智能体的状态一致性。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-agent checkpoint forensics require analyzing one agent’s state; multi-agent checkpoint analysis requires cross-agent state consistency verification. [73, 69, 62]. [73, 69, 62].
RTM_2_8 - 多智能体监控中条件路由决策的不透明性。 RTM_2_8 - Conditional Routing Decision Opacity in Multi-Agent Monitoring. 条件边决定控制流，但其路由决策并不总是连同推理上下文一起记录在日志中。 Conditional edges determine control flow but their routing decisions aren’t always logged with reasoning context. 监控能看到“已路由至 finalize_node”，却看不到原因——究竟是因为测试确实通过了，还是因为状态遭到了投毒？ Monitoring sees ”routed to finalize_node” but not why—was it because tests passed legitimately or state was poisoned? 在多智能体系统中，一个智能体的条件边决策会影响下游智能体的状态输入，因此，如果不了解路由决策，审计记录就不足以支持安全分析。 In multi-agent systems, conditional edge decisions for one agent influence downstream agents’ state inputs, making audit trails insufficient for security analysis without understanding routing decisions. 多智能体系统的区别：单智能体的编排逻辑内部只涉及单个智能体的路由；多智能体路由会产生级联决策，每个智能体的条件路由都会影响其他智能体接收到的状态，因此需要完整的路由决策图才能形成全面的审计记录。 Multi-agent distinction: Single routing within one agent’s orchestration logic; multi-agent routing creates cascading decisions where each agent’s conditional routing affects others’ received state, requiring complete routing decision graphs for comprehensive audit trails. [91, 69, 62, 23]. [91, 69, 62, 23].
RTM_2_9 - 归约器（Reducer）状态演变跟踪缺口。 RTM_2_9 - Reducer State Evolution Tracking Gaps. 日志并不总是跟踪状态归约器的执行，因此难以了解字段值在各次迭代中如何变化。 State reducer execution is not always traced in logging, making it difficult to understand how field values transformed across iterations. 在使用自定义归约器的多智能体工作流中，要了解字段内容的增长源于正常累积还是恶意注入，就需要跟踪归约器的执行。 In multi-agent workflows with custom reducers, understanding whether field growth results from legitimate accumulation or malicious injection requires tracing reducer execution. 多智能体系统无法统一观测所有专用智能体的归约器操作，从而产生可观测性缺口，使监控智能体无法看到某个智能体的归约器行为。 Multi-agent systems lack unified visibility into all reducer operations across specialized agents, creating observability gaps where one agent’s reducer behavior remains invisible to monitoring agents. 多智能体系统的区别：单智能体场景跟踪的是一个字段的单个归约器行为；在多个智能体对共享字段使用不同归约器的多智能体系统中，则需要跨越智能体边界，全面跟踪归约器的执行。 Multi-agent distinction: Single reducer behavior tracking for one field; multi-agent systems with multiple agents using different reducers on shared fields require comprehensive reducer execution tracing across agent boundaries. [1052, 73, 69, 62]. [1052, 73, 69, 62].
RTM_2_10 - ConversationBufferMemory 在注入检测方面的遥测缺口。 RTM_2_10 - ConversationBufferMemory Telemetry Gap for Injection Detection. LangChain 的对话记忆通常以消息序列的形式记录在日志中，而不对注入模式进行语义分析。 LangChain’s conversation memory is typically logged as message sequences without semantic analysis of injection patterns. 遥测会记录“用户说了 X，智能体回复了 Y”，却不识别回复是否表明存在提示注入（如可疑的工具选择、相互矛盾的陈述）。 Telemetry captures ”user said X, agent responded Y” without identifying whether responses indicate prompt injection (suspicious tool selections, contradictory statements). 多智能体系统的区别：多智能体消息日志必须捕获跨智能体的通信模式，以识别被投毒数据的传播位置；单一系统只需分析单个智能体的输出。 Multi-agent distinction: Multi-agent message logging must capture cross-agent communication patterns identifying where poisoned data propagates; singular systems need only analyze single agent outputs. [1858, 69, 62, 23]. [1858, 69, 62, 23].
RTM_2_11 - 智能体草稿区推理轨迹的日志记录缺口。 RTM_2_11 - Agent Scratchpad Reasoning Trace Logging Gaps. 尽管 agent_scratchpad 表示完整的推理过程，但遥测中很少包含这一内容，通常只记录“智能体在 N 步内完成”。 While agent_scratchpad represents complete reasoning, it’s rarely included in telemetry beyond ”agent finished in N steps.” 包含注入迹象或策略漂移的完整推理轨迹未得到自动监控。 Complete reasoning traces containing injection indicators or policy drift are not monitored automatically. 遥测显示结果，却不显示推理质量。 Telemetry shows outcomes but not reasoning quality. 多智能体系统的区别：多智能体推理轨迹必须在智能体之间建立关联，以展示一个智能体的推理如何影响下游智能体；单智能体轨迹跟踪则侧重于个体推理。 Multi-agent distinction: Multi-agent reasoning traces must correlate across agents showing how one agent’s reasoning influenced downstream agents; singular tracing focuses on individual reasoning. [1859, 69, 62]. [1859, 69, 62].
RTM_2_12 - 工具调用语义分析缺口。 RTM_2_12 - Tool Invocation Semantic Analysis Gaps. LangChain 遥测会记录工具调用及其参数，但缺乏对参数适当性的语义分析。 LangChain telemetry logs tool invocations with parameters but lacks semantic analysis of parameter appropriateness. 遥测显示“调用了 delete_table(table=’audit_logs’)”，却无法检测该删除操作在当前上下文中是否适当，或是否由投毒驱动。 Telemetry shows ”called delete_table(table=’audit_logs’)” without detecting whether deletion is contextually appropriate or poisoning-driven. 多智能体场景的区别：多智能体工具调用监控必须跨智能体追踪参数来源，以检测通过参数链实施的注入。 Multi-agent distinction: Multi-agent tool invocation monitoring must trace parameter provenance across agents detecting injection through parameter chains. [91, 1857, 62, 23]. [91, 1857, 62, 23].
RTM_2_13 - 用于状态投毒检测的记忆更新溯源缺口。 RTM_2_13 - Memory Update Provenance Gaps for State Poisoning Detection. 遥测会捕获记忆状态快照，但不会记录哪个智能体修改了状态，也不会记录这些修改反映的是正常学习还是投毒。 Telemetry captures memory state snapshots but not which agent modified state or whether modifications reflect legitimate learning or poisoning. 状态变化表现为正常演变，未能区分投毒与正常更新。 State changes appear as normal evolution without distinguishing poisoning from normal updates. 多智能体场景的区别：多智能体记忆遥测必须追踪哪个智能体修改了共享状态，以及这些修改是否意外传播到了其他智能体。 Multi-agent distinction: Multi-agent memory telemetry must track which agent modified shared state and whether modifications propagated unexpectedly to other agents. [1052, 73, 72, 62]. [1052, 73, 72, 62].
RTM_2_14 - 错误恢复序列的遥测缺口。 RTM_2_14 - Error Recovery Sequence Telemetry Gaps. 当 LangChain 错误恢复机制（handle_parsing_errors=True）被触发时，遥测会记录重试次数，但不会记录重试执行了哪些代码路径。 When LangChain error recovery (handle_parsing_errors=True) triggers, telemetry logs retry counts but not which code paths retries exercise. 攻击者故意触发错误以强制执行特定重试路径时，留下的遥测证据极少。 Attackers deliberately triggering errors to force specific retry paths leave minimal telemetry evidence. 多智能体场景的区别：多智能体错误编排遥测必须关联不同智能体的错误，以检测协同错误注入攻击。 Multi-agent distinction: Multi-agent error orchestration telemetry must correlate errors across agents detecting coordinated error injection attacks. [1859, 69, 62, 23]. [1859, 69, 62, 23].
RTM_2_15 - 置信度分数计算的分解缺口。 RTM_2_15 - Confidence Score Calculation Decomposition Gaps. 当智能体使用隐式置信度评分（通过模型概率）时，遥测缺乏分解信息，无法显示哪些方面对最终置信度作出了贡献。 When agents use implicit confidence scoring (through model probability), telemetry lacks decomposition showing which aspects contributed to final confidence. 分数变化看起来是随机的，未能显示出操纵迹象。 Score changes appear random rather than indicating manipulation. 多智能体场景的区别：多智能体置信度聚合遥测必须显示每个智能体的分数及其权重，以便检测单个智能体被攻陷后对总体分数的影响。 Multi-agent distinction: Multi-agent confidence aggregation telemetry must show per-agent scores and weighting enabling detection of single-agent compromise affecting overall scores. [1859, 62, 23]. [1859, 62, 23].
RTM_2_16 - AutoGen GroupChat 消息历史记录造成归因盲区。 RTM_2_16 - AutoGen GroupChat Message History Logging Creating Attribution Blind Spots. AutoGen 的共享消息历史会记录所有智能体间通信，但不会对消息意图、推理依赖关系或攻击模式进行语义分析。 AutoGen’s shared message history logs all inter-agent communication without semantic analysis of message intent, reasoning dependencies, or attack patterns. 安全团队能够看到消息序列，却无法理解哪些消息代表攻击，哪些属于正常协商。 Security teams see message sequences without understanding which messages represented attacks versus legitimate negotiation. 多智能体场景的区别：单智能体日志展示一个智能体的推理过程；AutoGen 日志展示对等通信，若不对对话模式进行语义分析，就无法进行攻击归因。 Multi-agent distinction: Singular agent logs show one agent’s reasoning; AutoGen logs show peer-to-peer communication making attack attribution impossible without semantic analysis of dialogue patterns. [1052, 91, 69, 62, 23]. [1052, 91, 69, 62, 23].
RTM_2_17 - 层级委派中 CrewAI 任务执行轨迹的不透明性。 RTM_2_17 - CrewAI Task Execution Trace Opacity in Hierarchical Delegation. CrewAI 的层级任务轨迹会记录哪些智能体接收了任务，但无法捕获任务上下文操纵、委派是否适当，以及工作智能体是否按预期行事。 CrewAI hierarchical task traces log which agents received tasks but fail to capture task context manipulation, whether delegations were appropriate, or whether workers acted as intended. 监控只能看到“已委派给工作智能体”，却无法理解该委派是否具有恶意，或其范围是否恰当。 Monitoring sees ”delegated to worker” without understanding if delegation was malicious or properly scoped. 多智能体场景的区别：单个任务的执行日志展示执行顺序；CrewAI 日志缺乏用于理解层级委派是否适当的决策上下文。 Multi-agent distinction: Singular task execution logs show execution sequence; CrewAI logs lack decision context for understanding whether hierarchical delegation was appropriate. [91, 1857, 69, 62, 23]. [91, 1857, 69, 62, 23].
RTM_2_18 - 多智能体监控仪表板的可视化盲区。 RTM_2_18 - Multi-Agent Monitoring Dashboard Visualization Blind Spots. 多智能体仪表板汇总来自多个来源的智能体状态，由此带来可视化难题，使同时发生的活动模式难以解读。 Multi-agent dashboards aggregating agent status from multiple sources create visualization challenges where simultaneous activity patterns become uninterpretable. 展示所有智能体并发操作的仪表板缺乏语义组织，无法帮助安全团队识别协同行为模式。 Dashboards showing all agents’ concurrent operations lack semantic organization enabling security teams to identify coordinated behavior patterns. 协同智能体产生的攻击特征在汇总仪表板中仍然不可见。 Attack signatures from coordinated agents remain invisible in aggregate dashboards. 多智能体场景的区别：单智能体仪表板展示一个操作序列；多智能体仪表板必须区分正常并行活动与协同攻击。 Multi-agent distinction: Singular agent dashboards show one operation sequence; multi-agent dashboards must distinguish between legitimate parallelism and coordinated attacks. [70, 1857, 69, 62, 23]. [70, 1857, 69, 62, 23].
RTM_2_19 - AutoGen 对话模式的非确定性阻碍基线建立。 RTM_2_19 - AutoGen Conversation Pattern Non-Determinism Preventing Baseline Establishment. AutoGen 对话流程的非确定性使得无法为异常检测建立可靠的基线模式。 AutoGen’s non-deterministic conversation flows prevent establishing reliable baseline patterns for anomaly detection. 消息序列在不同执行过程中各不相同，使得基于静态模式的检测无法实现。 Message sequences vary across executions making static pattern-based detection impossible. 安全监控无法可靠地区分正常变化与攻击驱动的变化。 Security monitoring cannot reliably differentiate normal variation from attack-driven variation. 多智能体区别：对于确定性操作，可以建立单智能体基线；AutoGen 对话的非确定性使基于基线的监控失效。 Multi-agent distinction: Singular agent baselines can be established for deterministic operations; AutoGen’s conversation non-determinism defeats baseline-based monitoring. [1859, 69, 62, 23]. [1859, 69, 62, 23].
RTM_2_20 - CrewAI 分层监控的不透明性阻碍各层责任归因。 RTM_2_20 - CrewAI Hierarchical Monitoring Opacity Preventing Tier Responsibility Attribution. CrewAI 中的多层级结构带来了监控难题：针对某一层级的攻击会影响其他层级的结果，使责任归因变得困难。 Multi-tier hierarchies in CrewAI create monitoring challenges where attacks at one tier affect outcomes at other tiers making responsibility attribution difficult. 当输出包含错误时，安全团队无法确定是哪个管理层级引入了数据篡改。 Security teams cannot determine which management level introduced corruption when output contains errors. 层级结构的不透明性阻碍了取证归因。 Hierarchical opacity prevents forensic attribution. 多智能体区别：单智能体取证可以追溯到单一来源；CrewAI 的多层级架构造成了不透明性，导致无法确定哪个管理层级遭到了入侵。 Multi-agent distinction: Singular agent forensics can trace to one source; CrewAI’s multi-tier architecture creates opacity preventing determination of which management level was compromised. [91, 69, 62, 23]. [91, 69, 62, 23].
RTM_2_21 - 插件执行轨迹抽象掩盖插件链的可见性。 RTM_2_21 - Plugin Execution Trace Abstraction Hiding Plugin Chain Visibility. Semantic Kernel 的编排机制将多插件执行链抽象为高层操作摘要。 Semantic Kernel’s orchestration abstracts multi-plugin execution chains into high-level operation summaries. 遥测仅显示“编排已成功完成”，却不展示执行了哪些插件、执行顺序如何以及使用了哪些参数。 Telemetry shows ”orchestration completed successfully” without exposing which plugins executed, in what order, with what parameters. 多智能体区别：对跨多个编排智能体的插件执行进行抽象，会阻碍插件链的端到端追踪；单一编排则能够完整呈现每个插件的执行顺序。 Multi-agent distinction: Abstracting plugin execution across multiple orchestration agents prevents end-to-end tracing of plugin chains; singular orchestration maintains full visibility into each plugin’s execution sequence. [179, 91, 69, 62, 23]. [179, 91, 69, 62, 23].
RTM_2_22 - 函数描述处理遥测缺失注入检测。 RTM_2_22 - Function Description Processing Telemetry Missing Injection Detection. Semantic Kernel 通过处理插件函数描述来构建编排器提示词。 Semantic Kernel processes plugin function descriptions to construct orchestrator prompts. 遥测会记录“已注册插件 X，包含 Y 个函数”，却不会分析描述内容中是否存在注入的指令。 Telemetry captures ”registered plugin X with Y functions” without analyzing description content for injected instructions. 污染编排器上下文的恶意描述不会留下任何遥测证据。 Malicious descriptions poisoning orchestrator context leave no telemetry evidence. 多智能体区别：共享插件注册表意味着描述仅处理一次，却会影响所有智能体——注册表层面的投毒形成了所有监控均无法察觉的攻击面；单独的插件则按智能体分别处理描述，从而能够针对每个智能体进行注入检测。 Multi-agent distinction: Shared plugin registry means description processing happens once affecting all agents—poisoning at registry level creates invisible attack surface for all monitoring; singular plugins have per-agent description processing enabling per-agent injection detection. [179, 91, 62, 23]. [179, 91, 62, 23].
RTM_2_23 - 依赖注入解析中的遥测缺口。 RTM_2_23 - Dependency Injection Resolution Telemetry Gaps. 内核服务解析并不总是配备遥测埋点，以显示哪些插件在何时解析了哪些服务。 Kernel service resolution isn’t always instrumented with telemetry showing which plugins resolved which services and when. 当恶意服务实现被注入时，遥测无法呈现这种替换。 When malicious service implementations are injected, telemetry lacks visibility into substitution. 使用攻击者控制的依赖项运行的插件在执行时不会留下日志证据。 Plugins operating with attacker-controlled dependencies execute without logging evidence. 多智能体区别：内核级服务注入会在不可见的情况下影响所有智能体；按智能体分别进行的联邦式依赖解析，则提供了共享内核配置中所不具备的逐智能体检测机会。 Multi-agent distinction: Kernel-level service injection affects all agents invisibly; federated per-agent dependency resolution creates per-agent detection opportunities not present in shared kernel configurations. [179, 62, 23]. [179, 62, 23].
RTM_2_24 - 编排器提示词构建遥测缺失上下文污染检测。 RTM_2_24 - Orchestrator Prompt Construction Telemetry Missing Context Pollution Detection. 编排器提示词汇集了所有可用插件的函数描述。 Orchestrator prompts aggregate function descriptions from all available plugins. 遥测不会记录提示词内容，也无法检测描述何时向提示词中注入了恶意指令。 Telemetry doesn’t capture prompt content or detect when descriptions inject malicious instructions into prompts. 编排器执行遭到篡改的提示词时，留下的遥测只会显示编排成功，而不会记录指令注入。 Orchestrators executing compromised prompts leave telemetry showing successful orchestration without capturing instruction injection. 多智能体区别：共享的编排器提示词构建机制意味着上下文污染会影响所有智能体的路由决策；单一编排则可在一个集中的提示词构建点检测到投毒。 Multi-agent distinction: Shared orchestrator prompt construction means context pollution affects all agents’ routing decisions; singular orchestration detects poison at one centralized prompt construction point. [80, 612, 62, 23, 69]. [80, 612, 62, 23, 69].
RTM_2_25 - 可观测性中的插件路由决策不透明问题。 RTM_2_25 - Plugin Routing Decision Opacity in Observability. 当由 LLM 驱动的路由选择插件时，遥测通常只显示所选插件，而不记录推理过程——哪条描述促成了选择、考虑过哪些备选项，以及特定插件为何在路由竞争中胜出。 When LLM-driven routing selects plugins, telemetry typically shows selected plugin without capturing reasoning—which description caused selection, what alternatives were considered, why specific plugin won routing competition. 这种不透明性使人无法检测到遭投毒的描述何时成功地使路由产生偏向。 This opacity prevents detecting when poisoned descriptions successfully bias routing. 多智能体区别：采用分布式路由决策的多智能体编排会带来可观测性难题，需要跨智能体关联分析才能检测出有偏的路由模式；单一路由则是透明的，因为所有插件选择的推理过程都记录在一个智能体的日志中。 Multi-agent distinction: Multi-agent orchestration with distributed routing decisions creates observability challenges requiring correlation across agents to detect biased routing patterns; singular routing is transparent because all plugin selection reasoning is captured within one agent’s logging. [790, 179, 62, 23, 69]. [790, 179, 62, 23, 69].
RTM_2_26 - Semantic Kernel 框架特有的监控盲点。 RTM_2_26 - Framework-Specific Semantic Kernel Monitoring Blind Spots. Semantic Kernel 提供了独有的遥测点（插件生命周期事件、编排器路由决策、内核服务解析），而通用框架监控无法捕获这些遥测点。 Semantic Kernel exposes unique telemetry points (plugin lifecycle events, orchestrator routing decisions, kernel service resolution) that generic framework monitoring doesn’t capture. 将 LangChain 或 LangGraph 监控作为标准的组织，可能缺乏针对 Semantic Kernel 的专用可观测能力。 Organizations standardized on LangChain or LangGraph monitoring may lack Semantic Kernel-specific observability. 将 Semantic Kernel 与其他框架混合使用的多智能体系统会产生盲点，使 Semantic Kernel 操作在缺乏框架专用监控的情况下执行。 Multi-agent systems mixing Semantic Kernel with other frameworks create blind spots where Semantic Kernel operations execute without framework-specific monitoring. 多智能体区别：混合框架监控会在 Semantic Kernel 边界处形成缺口；采用单一框架的系统则能在整个技术栈中保持一致的遥测。 Multi-agent distinction: Mixed-framework monitoring creates gaps at Semantic Kernel boundaries; singular framework systems maintain consistent telemetry across the entire stack. [186, 1860, 1861, 1862, 1863]. [186, 1860, 1861, 1862, 1863].
III-F3 RTM_3 - 工具调用与函数调用监控III-F3 RTM_3 - Tool Invocation and Function Calling Monitoring
RTM_3_1 - 工具调用遥测关联攻击。 RTM_3_1 - Tool Invocation Telemetry Correlation Attacks. 工具遥测系统跟踪哪些智能体调用了哪些工具，从而支持模式分析。 Tool telemetry systems track which agents invoke which tools, enabling pattern analysis. 在多智能体系统中，攻击者通过构造特定的工具调用模式（工具 A → 工具 B → 工具 C 序列）来利用遥测；这些模式对于合法任务而言看似合理，却能够实现隐蔽通信信道或协同。 In multi-agent systems, attackers exploit telemetry by creating specific tool invocation patterns (Tool A → Tool B → Tool C sequence) that appear legitimate for legitimate tasks but enable hidden communication channels or coordination. 遥测呈现出看似正常的工具调用序列，而这些序列实际上编码了攻击者的命令。 Telemetry shows normal-appearing tool sequences that actually encode attacker commands. 多智能体区别：单智能体的工具调用模式针对该智能体进行整体分析；多智能体的工具调用模式横跨多个智能体，使攻击者能够构造跨智能体的模式，以规避单智能体检测阈值。 Multi-agent distinction: Single agent tool patterns are analyzed holistically for one agent; multi-agent tool patterns across multiple agents enable attackers creating patterns spanning agents to avoid single-agent detection thresholds. [753, 1864, 1865, 62, 23]. [753, 1864, 1865, 62, 23].
RTM_3_2 - 通过分布式调用规避函数调用异常检测。 RTM_3_2 - Function Calling Anomaly Detection Evasion Through Distributed Invocation. 异常检测会监控智能体是否存在异常的函数调用模式（从未调用过的工具、异常参数值）。 Anomaly detection monitors agents for unusual function calling patterns (never-before-called tools, unusual parameter values). 多智能体系统使攻击者能够将异常调用分散到多个智能体上——每个智能体单独看来都正常，但它们共同实施攻击。 Multi-agent systems enable attackers distributing anomalous invocations across multiple agents—each agent individually appears normal while collectively they perform attacks. 智能体 A 偶尔调用异常工具 X，智能体 B 偶尔调用异常工具 Y，但二者共同执行协同攻击。 Agent A occasionally invokes unusual tool X, Agent B occasionally invokes unusual tool Y, but together they execute coordinated attack. 多智能体区别：所有异常调用都集中在单个智能体上时，会呈现明显的异常；分散在多个智能体上的异常则能够规避针对单个智能体的异常检测。 Multi-agent distinction: Single agent with all unusual invocations shows obvious anomaly; multi-agent distributed anomalies evade per-agent anomaly detection. [1866, 87, 1867, 11, 62]. [1866, 87, 1867, 11, 62].
RTM_3_3 - 并行执行中的工具延迟监控盲区。 RTM_3_3 - Tool Latency Monitoring Blind Spots in Parallel Execution. 工具性能监控会跟踪调用延迟（API 响应时间、查询执行时间）。 Tool performance monitoring tracks invocation latency (API response time, query execution time). 多智能体系统并行调用工具时，聚合指标可能掩盖缓慢的工具调用。 Multi-agent systems invoking tools in parallel may mask slow tool invocations through aggregated metrics. 如果工具 A 耗时 5 秒，工具 B 耗时 100ms，则并行执行总共耗时 5 秒——尽管工具 B 实际上已被调用，延迟监控仍显示 5 秒，因为工具 A 的延迟主导了聚合指标。 If Tool A takes 5 seconds and Tool B takes 100ms, parallel execution takes 5 seconds total—latency monitoring shows 5 seconds when Tool B actually invoked but Tool A’s latency dominates aggregated metrics. 攻击者利用各工具延迟可见性方面的盲区。 Attackers exploit blind spots in per-tool latency visibility. 多智能体区别：单个智能体按顺序调用工具时，各工具的延迟清晰可见；多智能体并行执行则会掩盖各工具的延迟。 Multi-agent distinction: Single agent with sequential tool invocation shows clear latency per tool; multi-agent parallel execution obscures per-tool latency. [258, 1868, 1869, 1870, 1871]. [258, 1868, 1869, 1870, 1871].
RTM_3_4 - 跨智能体边界的工具输出验证监控缺口。 RTM_3_4 - Tool Output Validation Monitoring Gaps Across Agent Boundaries. 工具输出验证（检查结果是否处于预期范围内、格式是否符合要求）在智能体层面进行。 Tool output validation (checking results are within expected range, format validates) occurs at agent level. 在多智能体系统中，经智能体 A 验证的工具 A 输出，可能不会由使用该输出的智能体 B 再次验证。 In multi-agent systems, Tool A’s output validated by Agent A may not be re-validated by Agent B consuming the output. 监控显示“工具 A 输出已验证”，却无法反映智能体 B 跳过了对所接收的工具 A 输出的验证。 Monitoring shows ”Tool A output validated” without visibility that Agent B skipped validation of inherited Tool A output. 攻击者利用跨智能体边界的验证缺口——输出通过了智能体 A 的验证，但对于智能体 B 的上下文而言却是损坏或恶意的。 Attackers exploit validation gaps across agent boundaries—output passes Agent A’s validation but is corrupted/malicious for Agent B’s context. 多智能体区别：单个智能体对工具输出进行一次验证；多智能体系统在智能体边界处存在验证缺口，使受损的工具输出能够在未经再次验证的情况下传播。 Multi-agent distinction: Single agent validates tool outputs once; multi-agent systems have validation gaps at agent boundaries enabling tool output corruption to propagate without re-validation. [11, 18, 1872, 62, 23]. [11, 18, 1872, 62, 23].
RTM_3_5 - 工具授权范围审计盲区。 RTM_3_5 - Tool Authorization Scope Audit Blind Spots. 审计系统跟踪哪些智能体获得了调用哪些工具的授权。 Audit systems track which agents have authorization to invoke which tools. 具有委派机制的多智能体系统会产生盲区——审计日志可能显示“智能体 A 获准调用工具 X”，却无法反映智能体 A 将任务委派给了智能体 B，而智能体 B 使用智能体 A 的授权上下文调用了工具 X。 Multi-agent systems with delegation create blind spots—audit logs may show ”Agent A authorized to invoke Tool X” without visibility that Agent A delegates to Agent B, and Agent B invokes Tool X using Agent A’s authorization context. 日志中的授权看似正确，但实际调用者并未获得授权。 Authorization appears correct in logs but actual invoker was unauthorized. 多智能体区别：单智能体的授权明确无歧义；多智能体委派则会在审计轨迹中造成授权责任归属缺口。 Multi-agent distinction: Single agent authorization is unambiguous; multi-agent delegation creates authorization accountability gaps in audit trails. [50, 1873, 303, 1874, 80]. [50, 1873, 303, 1874, 80].
RTM_3_6 - 异步执行中的工具调用因果关系跟踪失效。 RTM_3_6 - Tool Invocation Causality Tracking Failures in Asynchronous Execution. 工具框架支持异步工具调用，智能体可以将工具调用加入队列，而无需等待其完成。 Tool frameworks enable asynchronous tool invocation where agents can queue tool calls without waiting for completion. 在多智能体系统中，用于确定哪个智能体发起了哪个工具调用的因果关系跟踪会变得不明确——工具可能由智能体 B 调用，但实际上是智能体 A 在先前步骤中通过将异步请求加入队列而发起的。 In multi-agent systems, causality tracking which agent initiated which tool becomes unclear—Tool may be invoked by Agent B but actually initiated by Agent A in prior step through asynchronous request queueing. 监控系统可能错误地归属工具调用。 Monitoring systems may attribute tool invocations incorrectly. 多智能体区别：单个智能体同步调用工具时，因果关系清晰；多智能体异步执行则会造成因果关系歧义，使攻击者能够伪造日志中的因果关系。 Multi-agent distinction: Single agent with synchronous tool invocation has clear causality; multi-agent asynchronous execution creates causality ambiguity enabling attackers spoofing causality in logs. [69, 70, 62, 91, 1857]. [69, 70, 62, 91, 1857].
III-F4 RTM_4 - 多模态与流式响应处理III-F4 RTM_4 - Multimodal and Streaming Response Processing
RTM_4_1 - 多模态处理的不透明性造成监控盲区。 RTM_4_1 - Multimodal Processing Opacity Creating Monitoring Blind Spots. 视觉模型处理（CLIP 嵌入、NeVA 图像描述、DePlot 提取）产生的输出很少被纳入日志或监控仪表板。 Vision model processing (CLIP embeddings, NeVA captions, DePlot extractions) produces outputs rarely included in logs or monitoring dashboards. 在多智能体系统中，智能体调用视觉模型所产生的结果对安全监控不可见，形成了无法检测到视觉模型恶意行为的盲区。 In multi-agent systems, agents invoke vision models producing results not visible to security monitoring, creating blind spots where malicious vision model behavior goes undetected. 智能体遵循视觉模型建议进行的工具调用，不会揭示工具选择是由恶意 NeVA 输出驱动的。 An agent’s tool invocations following vision model suggestions wouldn’t reveal that malicious NeVA output drove tool selection. 多智能体场景的区别：单智能体的工具调用可以被监控；而在由视觉模型驱动隐蔽工具选择的多智能体系统中，会出现监控缺口，被追溯为源于“智能体推理”的决策实际上源于未经监控的视觉模型输出。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-agent tool invocations are monitorable; multi-agent systems where vision models drive hidden tool selections create monitoring gaps where decisions traced to ”agent reasoning” actually originated from unmonitored vision model outputs. [1875, 70, 62, 23, 179]. [1875, 70, 62, 23, 179].
RTM_4_2 - 工具调用追踪中的多模态归因不透明性。 RTM_4_2 - Multimodal Attribution Opacity in Tool Invocation Tracing. 当智能体基于多模态 RAG 结果调用工具时，监控无法确定工具的执行是由文本查询、图像证据、音频上下文还是它们的组合所触发。 When agents invoke tools based on multimodal RAG results, monitoring cannot determine whether tools executed due to text queries, image evidence, audio context, or combinations. 多模态 RAG 检索后调用的数据库访问工具，可能被归因于合法的文本查询，而实际上却是由检索所得图像中注入的指令所驱动。 A database access tool invoked after multimodal RAG retrieval could be attributed to legitimate text queries while actually driven by injected instructions in retrieved images. 在多智能体系统中，智能体 A 的视觉处理以不可见的方式驱动智能体 B 的工具选择，使跨智能体边界的归因变得不透明。 Multi-agent systems obscure attribution across agent boundaries where Agent A’s vision processing drives Agent B’s tool selection invisibly. 多智能体场景的区别：基于文本的工具调用追踪保持透明；多模态工具调用追踪在跨越模态边界时会丧失保真度，使攻击得以发生，同时在表面上呈现为合法的多模态推理。 Multi-agent distinction: Text-based tool invocation tracing remains transparent; multimodal tool invocation tracing loses fidelity across modality boundaries enabling attacks while appearing as legitimate multimodal reasoning. [282, 110, 302]. [282, 110, 302].
RTM_4_3 - 监控中缺乏视觉模型幻觉检测。 RTM_4_3 - Vision Model Hallucination Detection Absence in Monitoring. 视觉模型会幻觉出图像中不存在的内容（NeVA 幻觉出物体，DePlot 幻觉出数据关系，Whisper 幻觉出语音）。 Vision models hallucinate content not present in images (NeVA hallucinating objects, DePlot hallucinating data relationships, Whisper hallucinating speech). 监控系统无法检测出幻觉，因为这些输出符合预期格式（图像描述、表格、转录文本）。 Monitoring systems don’t detect hallucinations because outputs match expected format (captions, tables, transcripts). 在多智能体系统中，幻觉内容会驱动工具调用和决策，而监控无法发现源数据是幻觉产物。 In multi-agent systems, hallucinated content drives tool invocations and decisions without monitoring detecting that source data was hallucinated. 智能体根据 Whisper 转录中幻觉出的交易数据调用支付工具，在工具调用日志中会显得合法。 An agent invoking payment tools based on hallucinated transaction data from Whisper transcription appears legitimate in tool invocation logs. 多智能体场景的区别：单智能体的幻觉局限于局部；而在多智能体系统中，一个智能体的幻觉输出会驱动依赖它的其他智能体进行决策，导致未被检测到的幻觉级联传播。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-agent hallucination remains local; multi-agent systems where hallucinated outputs from one agent drive dependent agents’ decisions create cascading undetected hallucination propagation. [1876, 1877, 1878, 1879, 1880]. [1876, 1877, 1878, 1879, 1880].
RTM_4_4 - 检索监控中的嵌入相似度阈值不透明性。 RTM_4_4 - Embedding Similarity Threshold Opacity in Retrieval Monitoring. 多模态 RAG 系统根据嵌入相似度阈值检索内容（返回 top-K 或 similarity¿0.8）。 Multimodal RAG systems retrieve content based on embedding similarity thresholds (return top-K or similarity¿0.8). 监控不会跟踪检索所得内容是否跨过阈值，或是否仅略微超过阈值，从而形成盲区，使智能体检索到相关性极低的内容。 Monitoring doesn’t track whether retrieved content crossed thresholds or marginally exceeded them, creating blind spots where agents retrieve barely-relevant content. 在多智能体系统中，攻击者精心构造刚好高于检索阈值的投毒嵌入，使其在日志中显得合法，却持续检索出恶意内容。 In multi-agent systems, attackers craft poisoned embeddings sitting just above retrieval thresholds, appearing legitimate in logs while consistently retrieving malicious content. 多智能体场景的区别：单智能体的检索阈值分析范围有限；而在多智能体系统中，基于相似度的检索发生在分布式智能体之间，产生的阈值判定过多，难以进行全面监控。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-agent retrieval threshold analysis remains contained; multi-agent systems where similarity-driven retrieval occurs across distributed agents create too many threshold decisions to monitor comprehensively. [627, 641, 400]. [627, 641, 400].
RTM_4_5 - 流式多模态输出处理中的监控缺口。 RTM_4_5 - Streaming Multimodal Output Processing Monitoring Gaps. 多模态合成会产生结合文本、嵌入式图像引用和音频链接的流式输出。 Multimodal synthesis produces streaming outputs combining text, embedded images references, and audio links. 在多智能体系统中，流式输出处理会产生一些时间窗口，使依赖该输出的智能体在完整输出生成之前就处理部分输出，从而形成未经监控的中间状态。 In multi-agent systems, streaming output processing creates windows where partial output is processed by dependent agents before complete output is generated, creating intermediate states unmonitored. 图像引用先于恶意指令以流式方式输出，使依赖该输出的智能体能够使用中间状态。 An image reference streaming before malicious instructions stream enables dependent agents using intermediate state. 多智能体场景的区别：文本流式输出形成线性推进过程；混合多种模态的多模态流式输出则会形成复杂的顺序依赖关系，使监控难以验证各模态流之间的一致性。 Multi-agent distinction: Text streaming creates linear progression; multimodal streaming with mixed modalities creates complex ordering dependencies where monitoring struggles to validate consistency across modality streams. [62, 45, 1881]. [62, 45, 1881].
RTM_4_6 - 监控中缺乏跨模态一致性验证。 RTM_4_6 - Cross-Modal Consistency Validation Absence in Monitoring. 监控不会验证各模态之间的一致性（图像内容是否与文本描述相符、音频是否与转录文本相符、提取的数据是否与源图表相符）。 Monitoring doesn’t validate consistency across modalities (whether image content matches text descriptions, audio matches transcripts, extracted data matches source charts). 在一致性失效可能表明存在攻击的多智能体系统中，缺乏跨模态监控会造成盲区。 In multi-agent systems where consistency failures could indicate attacks, lack of cross-modal monitoring creates blind spots. 如果 DePlot 从图表中提取的结果与图表显示的数值相矛盾，可能表明提取过程遭到操纵，而在没有显式跨模态验证的情况下，这种操纵无法被检测到。 A chart with DePlot extraction contradicting displayed values might indicate extraction manipulation undetectable without explicit cross-modal validation. 多智能体场景的区别：单模态监控在模态域内进行验证；多模态系统则需要跨域验证，而监控基础设施很少实现这种验证。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-modality monitoring validates within domain; multimodal systems require cross-domain validation rarely implemented in monitoring infrastructure. [69, 177, 1882]. [69, 177, 1882].
RTM_4_7 - 错误消息内容的不透明性造成检测盲区。 RTM_4_7 - Error Message Content Opacity Creating Detection Blind Spots. 错误日志记录能够捕获错误消息，但缺乏对消息内容的语义分析。 Error logging captures error messages but lacks semantic analysis of message content. 攻击者精心构造包含指令或可疑模式的错误消息，遥测系统会捕获这些消息，却不会对其进行分析。 Attackers craft error messages containing instructions or suspicious patterns that telemetry captures but doesn’t analyze. 在多智能体系统中，分析错误消息内容对于检测在错误上下文中嵌入指令的攻击至关重要，但标准遥测将错误消息视为非结构化文本。 In multi-agent systems, error message content analysis is essential for detecting attacks embedding instructions in error context, but standard telemetry treats error messages as unstructured text. 监控系统看到“发生错误：[恶意指令]”，却不解析其中的指令内容，从而形成盲区，使复杂攻击能够隐藏在错误语义之中。 Monitoring sees ”error occurred: [malicious instruction]” without parsing instruction content, creating blind spots where sophisticated attacks embed in error semantics. [282, 110, 302]. [282, 110, 302].
RTM_4_8 - 重试序列遥测缺失攻击指标。 RTM_4_8 - Retry Sequence Telemetry Missing Attack Indicators. 重试遥测显示重试次数和成功率，却未能捕获能够表明攻击的重试序列特征。 Retry telemetry shows retry counts and success rates but fails to capture retry sequence characteristics that indicate attacks. 在多智能体系统中，特定的重试模式——短时间内连续重试、针对本应不可重试的错误进行重试、多个智能体同时触发重试——可能表明存在攻击。 In multi-agent systems, specific retry patterns—rapid succession retries, retries on supposedly non-retryable errors, retries from multiple agents triggering simultaneously—may indicate attacks. 标准遥测记录“操作重试 3 次后成功”，却遗漏了能够揭示攻击模式的详细重试序列。 Standard telemetry recording ”operation retried 3 times then succeeded” misses detailed retry sequence revealing attack patterns. 检测基于重试的攻击需要对重试序列进行语义分析，但遥测并未提供这种可见性。 Semantic analysis of retry sequences is required for detecting retry-based attacks but telemetry doesn’t provide this visibility. [1204, 177, 69]. [1204, 177, 69].
RTM_4_9 - 回退路由遥测缺失上下文触发因素。 RTM_4_9 - Fallback Routing Telemetry Missing Context Triggers. 回退路由遥测显示选择了哪些回退路由，却不显示选择的原因——哪些错误条件触发了回退，或者上下文是否遭到操纵以强制触发回退。 Fallback routing telemetry shows which fallback routes were selected but not why—what error conditions triggered fallback or whether context was manipulated to force fallback. 在多智能体系统中，检测回退攻击需要了解回退的触发条件。 In multi-agent systems, detecting fallback attacks requires understanding fallback trigger conditions. 缺乏对上下文触发因素分析的遥测无法检测这类攻击：攻击者刻意构造错误，强制系统回退至已被攻陷的替代方案。 Telemetry lacking context trigger analysis cannot detect attacks deliberately crafting errors forcing fallback to compromised alternatives. 要实现回退过程的可见性，就需要捕获回退触发时的上下文，而标准遥测遗漏了这些信息。 Fallback visibility requires capturing fallback trigger context that standard telemetry omits. [282, 280, 198, 294]. [282, 280, 198, 294].
RTM_4_10 - 熔断器状态转换的遥测缺口。 RTM_4_10 - Circuit Breaker State Transition Telemetry Gaps. 熔断器遥测会记录状态变化，但缺乏能够解释熔断器为何断开的详细故障分析。 Circuit breaker telemetry logs state changes but lacks detailed failure analysis explaining circuit opening. 在多智能体系统中，熔断器相关故障可能表明存在攻击，即攻击者故意触发故障，迫使熔断器状态发生变化。 In multi-agent systems, circuit breaker failures may indicate attacks deliberately triggering failures forcing circuit state changes. 遥测若仅显示“熔断器于 14:35 断开”，却未捕获触发断开的具体故障模式，就会遗漏攻击指标。 Telemetry showing ”circuit opened at 14:35” without capturing which specific failure patterns triggered opening misses attack indicators. 标准遥测缺乏详细的故障分析，而此类分析是检测利用熔断器状态转换的攻击所必需的。 Detailed failure analysis required for detecting attacks exploiting circuit breaker state transitions is absent from standard telemetry. [382, 1204, 177]. [382, 1204, 177].
RTM_4_11 - 遥测中优雅降级决策的不透明性。 RTM_4_11 - Graceful Degradation Decision Opacity in Telemetry. 降级遥测显示哪些能力发生了降级，却不显示为何作出特定的降级决策。 Degradation telemetry shows which capabilities degraded but not why specific degradation decisions were made. 在多智能体系统中，受投毒的组件健康状态数据影响而作出的降级决策，看起来像是对故障的合理响应。 In multi-agent systems, degradation decisions influenced by poisoned component health data appear as legitimate responses to failures. 缺乏降级决策依据的遥测无法检测通过操纵组件健康状态信号来触发非预期降级的攻击。 Telemetry lacking degradation decision reasoning cannot detect attacks manipulating component health signals triggering unintended degradation. 安全监控需要透明的降级决策遥测，以捕获影响降级选择的因素，但此类遥测通常缺失。 Transparent degradation decision telemetry capturing factors influencing degradation choices is required for security monitoring but typically absent. [69, 177, 382]. [69, 177, 382].
RTM_4_12 - 错误恢复协调遥测缺失跨智能体因果关系。 RTM_4_12 - Error Recovery Coordination Telemetry Missing Cross-Agent Causality. 多智能体系统中的错误恢复涉及智能体之间的协调操作，但遥测仅捕获各个智能体的操作，未进行跨智能体因果关系分析。 Error recovery in multi-agent systems involves coordinated actions across agents, but telemetry captures individual agent actions without cross-agent causality analysis. 在多智能体错误恢复过程中，检测协同攻击需要了解一个智能体的错误如何通过恢复逻辑传播，进而触发依赖该智能体的其他智能体发生故障。 In multi-agent error recovery, detecting coordinated attacks requires understanding how one agent’s error propagates through recovery logic triggering dependent agent failures. 缺乏跨智能体因果关系分析的遥测无法检测利用恢复协调机制的分布式错误注入攻击。 Telemetry lacking cross-agent causality analysis cannot detect distributed error injection attacks exploiting recovery coordination. 全面的错误恢复监控需要捕获完整的恢复编排过程，而标准的单智能体遥测遗漏了这一过程。 Comprehensive error recovery monitoring requires capturing complete recovery orchestration that standard per-agent telemetry omits. [1883, 177, 69]. [1883, 177, 69].
RTM_4_13 - 流式错误处理遥测缺乏中间状态可见性。 RTM_4_13 - Streaming Error Handling Telemetry Missing Intermediate State Visibility. 流式场景中的错误处理会产生在响应完成前便已消除的临时错误状态，但遥测可能无法捕获流式处理中的瞬态错误状态。 Error handling in streaming contexts creates temporary error states that resolve before response completion, but telemetry may not capture transient error states in streaming. 在多智能体流式协调过程中，流式处理中途出现并消除的错误，对于关注最终结果的遥测而言仍然不可见。 In multi-agent streaming coordination, errors appearing and resolving mid-stream remain invisible to telemetry focused on final outcomes. 利用流式错误处理行为的攻击（临时故障触发回退，且回退在监控察觉之前便已完成）只会留下极少的遥测证据。 Attacks exploiting streaming error handling behavior (temporary failures triggering fallback that completes before monitoring notices) leave minimal telemetry evidence. 检测流式处理特有的错误处理攻击，需要能够捕获中间状态的全面流式遥测。 Comprehensive streaming telemetry capturing intermediate states is required for detecting streaming-specific error handling attacks. [70, 1466, 1275, 1884]。 [70, 1466, 1275, 1884].
RTM_4_14 - 流式遥测采集缺口导致实时攻击不可见。 RTM_4_14 - Streaming Telemetry Collection Gaps Creating Real-Time Attack Opacity. 流式响应给遥测采集带来了挑战，只有在流式传输结束后才能进行完整分析。 Streaming responses create telemetry collection challenges where complete analysis only possible after streaming finishes. 实时监控必须分析不完整的数据流，承担误报风险，或者等待传输完成，从而丧失响应的及时性。 Real-time monitoring must analyze partial streams risking false positives, or wait for completion losing responsiveness. 在多个智能体同时进行流式传输的多智能体系统中，会出现聚合难题——监控 N 条并发数据流中的恶意内容，要么需要分析尚不完整的部分数据流，要么需要延迟检测。 Multi-agent systems with multiple streaming agents simultaneously create aggregation challenges—monitoring N concurrent streams for malicious content requires either analyzing incomplete partial streams or delaying detection. 攻击者利用流式遥测缺口，注入在部分数据流中看似无害、但在完整形态下具有恶意的内容。 Attackers exploit streaming telemetry gaps by injecting content appearing benign in partial streams but malicious in complete form. 流式传输完成与监控分析之间的时间滞后会造成漏洞，使攻击能够利用检测系统完成分析之前的时间窗口。 The temporal lag between streaming completion and monitoring analysis creates vulnerabilities where attacks exploit windows before detection systems complete analysis. [1885, 177, 69]。 [1885, 177, 69].
RTM_4_15 - 操纵流式传输进度指示器以掩盖活动。 RTM_4_15 - Streaming Progress Indicator Manipulation for Activity Obfuscation. 显示内容交付速率的流式传输进度指示器可能被攻击者操纵；攻击者通过控制流式传输速度来隐藏高开销操作。 Streaming progress indicators showing content delivery rate can be manipulated by attackers controlling streaming speed to hide expensive operations. 一边缓慢地流式传输无害内容，一边在内部快速处理恶意操作，会制造实际进度与流式传输速率一致的假象。 Slow streaming of benign content while rapid internal processing of malicious operations creates illusion of aligned progress with streaming rate. 观察可见流式传输进度的多智能体监控会遗漏其他智能体在后台进行的处理。 Multi-agent monitoring observing visible streaming progress misses background processing by other agents. 攻击者利用流式传输速率与实际处理速率之间的脱钩，在可见数据流看似缓慢传输的同时进行隐蔽计算。 Attackers exploit streaming rate decoupling from actual processing rates enabling covert computation during deceptively-slow visible streams. 批量执行的输出速率反映实际处理情况，而流式传输可以使可见进度与实际系统负载脱钩。 Unlike batch execution where output rate reflects actual processing, streaming can decouple visible progress from actual system load. [227, 199, 124, 488]。 [227, 199, 124, 488].
RTM_4_16 - 分布式追踪中的跨智能体流式传输关联失效。 RTM_4_16 - Cross-Agent Streaming Correlation Failures in Distributed Tracing. 多智能体系统使用关联 ID 关联不同智能体的流式传输追踪记录时，如果流式传输的时序变化导致事件在日志中呈现乱序，就会发生关联失效。 Multi-agent systems correlating streaming traces across agents using correlation IDs face failures when streaming timing variations cause events to appear out-of-order in logs. 由于缓冲和时序因素，智能体 A 的流事件在日志中的记录顺序可能与实际流式传输顺序不同，而使用这些数据流的智能体 B 会面临追踪混乱。 Agent A’s stream events might log in different order than actual streaming due to buffering and timing, and Agent B consuming those streams faces tracing confusion. 攻击者通过操纵流式传输顺序，可以使追踪记录碎片化，从而无法重建跨智能体的因果关系。 Attackers manipulating streaming order can fragment traces making cross-agent causality reconstruction impossible. 分布式追踪依赖一致的事件顺序；流式传输在时间上的可变性使事件顺序不可预测，从而阻碍追踪重建。 Distributed tracing depends on consistent event ordering; streaming’s temporal variability creates ordering unpredictability defeating trace reconstruction. 多智能体追踪会放大这一问题，因为与集中式单一数据流的排序相比，N 个智能体的流式传输排序会产生 N! 种可能的事件顺序。 Multi-agent tracing amplifies this because N agents’ streaming ordering creates N! possible event orderings compared to centralized single-stream ordering. [1886, 814]。 [1886, 814].
RTM_4_17 - 流式传输缓冲区溢出的遥测缺口。 RTM_4_17 - Streaming Buffer Overflow Telemetry Gaps. 采用固定大小缓冲区的流式传输实现，在流式传输内容超出缓冲区容量时可能发生溢出。 Streaming implementations with fixed buffers can overflow when streamed content exceeds buffer capacity. 缓冲区溢出遥测通常只记录发生了溢出，而不捕获溢出的内容（这些内容已被丢弃）。 Buffer overflow telemetry often logs the fact of overflow without capturing overflow content (which was discarded). 在流式传输内容因缓冲区溢出而丢失的多智能体系统中，监控无法检测到数据已经丢失。 In multi-agent systems where streamed content overflows buffers and is lost, monitoring cannot detect that data was lost. 攻击者故意流式传输大量内容，利用缓冲区溢出使恶意载荷被丢弃——遥测显示发生了溢出，却不显示被丢弃的具体内容。 Attackers deliberately stream large content exploiting buffer overflow to discard malicious payload—telemetry shows overflow occurred but not what content was discarded. 多智能体在多个流式传输通道上发生缓冲区溢出，会形成难以关联的分布式丢失模式，使攻击者能够将载荷分散到多次溢出中，从而规避检测。 Multi-agent buffer overflows across multiple streaming channels create distributed loss patterns difficult to correlate, enabling attackers fragmenting payload across multiple overflows evading detection. [70, 1887, 1888]。 [70, 1887, 1888].
RTM_4_18 - 通过分散流式传输规避速率限制。 RTM_4_18 - Streaming Rate Limiting Evasion Through Distribution. 在多智能体系统中，可以通过将流式传输分散到多个智能体来规避流式传输端点的速率限制。 Rate limiting on streaming endpoints can be evaded in multi-agent systems by distributing streaming across multiple agents. 攻击者通过多个并发智能体流式传输高开销内容，每个智能体均低于各自的速率限制，但总量超出系统容量。 Attackers stream expensive content through multiple concurrent agents, each below individual rate limits but aggregate exceeding system capacity. 单一流式传输的速率限制较为直接，而多智能体流式传输需要通过跨智能体协调来实施速率限制。 Unlike singular streaming with straightforward rate limiting, multi-agent streaming requires cross-agent coordination for rate limit enforcement. 为实施总量限制而监控 N 个并发流式传输智能体，会增加运行管理的复杂性，使攻击者能够通过精心安排传输的分配与时序来规避限制。 Monitoring N concurrent streaming agents for aggregate limit enforcement creates operational complexity enabling evasion through careful distribution timing. [23, 18, 522]。 [23, 18, 522].
III-F5 RTM_5 - 评价与评估遥测缺口III-F5 RTM_5 - Evaluation and Assessment Telemetry Gaps
RTM_5_1 - 评价结果异常检测遗漏注入迹象。 RTM_5_1 - Evaluation Result Anomaly Detection Missing Injection Indicators. 评价监控系统跟踪指标趋势，并在出现异常时发出警报。 Evaluation monitoring systems track metric trends and alert on anomalies. 然而，它们不会对评价结果进行语义分析，以识别提示注入或操纵的迹象。 However, they don’t analyze evaluation results semantically for prompt injection or manipulation indicators. 在多智能体评价中，语义分析能够检测到“指标定义更新后，评价指标突然变得有利”这一现象，表明可能存在指标指令注入。 In multi-agent evaluation, semantic analysis would detect ”evaluation metrics suddenly favorable after metric definition update” indicating possible metric instruction injection. 缺乏语义分析的监控会漏检此类攻击：评估结果呈现可疑的变化模式，暴露出系统已遭入侵。 Monitoring lacking semantic analysis misses attacks where evaluation results change in suspicious patterns revealing compromises. 与检测资源异常的基础设施监控不同，评估专用监控需要对指标行为进行语义分析，而当前系统尚不具备这种能力。 Unlike infrastructure monitoring detecting resource anomalies, evaluation-specific monitoring requires semantic analysis of metric behaviors absent in current systems. [302, 111, 1889]. [302, 111, 1889].
RTM_5_2 - 评估智能体决策推理的遥测缺口。 RTM_5_2 - Evaluation Agent Decision Reasoning Telemetry Gaps. 评估智能体会决定哪些指标重要、应采用哪些阈值，以及是否批准部署。 Evaluation agents make decisions about what metrics matter, which thresholds to apply, whether to approve deployment. 这些决策缺少记录其推理过程的遥测数据——智能体为何将安全指标的权重设为 40%，将性能指标的权重设为 60%？ These decisions lack telemetry capturing reasoning—why did the agent weight security metrics 40% and performance 60%? 在多智能体评估系统中，决策权重可能因注入的评估上下文而遭到投毒，而缺乏决策溯源信息的遥测无法检测权重操纵。 In multi-agent evaluation systems where decision weights can be poisoned through injected evaluation context, telemetry lacking decision provenance cannot detect weight manipulation. 与记录决策的运行日志不同，评估决策遥测需要记录评估智能体的推理过程，以便检测遭到投毒的决策过程。 Unlike operational logging capturing decisions, evaluation decision telemetry requires capturing evaluation agent reasoning enabling detection of poisoned decision-making. 没有推理日志，即使底层决策逻辑已遭篡改，评估看起来仍然是合法的。 Without reasoning logs, evaluations appear legitimate despite underlying decision logic being compromised. [69, 887, 886]. [69, 887, 886].
RTM_5_3 - 跨智能体评估编排的监控盲区。 RTM_5_3 - Cross-Agent Evaluation Orchestration Monitoring Blind Spots. 协调多个评估智能体的评估编排缺乏对智能体间通信和控制流的可见性。 Evaluation orchestration coordinating multiple evaluator agents lacks visibility into inter-agent communication and control flow. 当编排智能体根据条件在评估智能体之间路由结果时，监控不会记录路由决策是否正确。 When orchestration agents route results between evaluators based on conditions, monitoring doesn’t capture whether routing decisions were correct. 在多智能体评估中，编排智能体可能遭到入侵，进而错误地路由结果（跳过验证关卡、调整评估顺序），而编排监控中的盲区使控制流劫持无法被检测到。 In multi-agent evaluation where orchestration agents can be compromised to misroute results (skip validation gates, reorder evaluations), orchestration monitoring blind spots prevent detecting control flow hijacking. 与关注组件健康状况的运行监控不同，评估编排需要监控决策逻辑，以便检测遭到劫持的路由。 Unlike operational monitoring focusing on component health, evaluation orchestration requires monitoring decision logic enabling detection of hijacked routing. [1890, 1278, 1891, 69, 1892]. [1890, 1278, 1891, 69, 1892].
RTM_5_4 - 监控中评估指标计算的不透明性。 RTM_5_4 - Evaluation Metric Calculation Opacity in Monitoring. 虽然评估结果会被记录，但指标计算的细节往往缺失。 While evaluation results are logged, metric computation details are often missing. 在由不同智能体计算指标的多智能体评估中，要了解指标是如何计算的，就需要能够查看计算算法。 In multi-agent evaluation where different agents calculate metrics, understanding how metrics were calculated requires visibility into computation algorithms. 如果监控仅显示“准确率：92%”，却不记录使用了哪种准确率定义、如何确定真值以及包含了哪些测试用例，就无法为安全分析提供所需的可见性。 Monitoring showing ”accuracy: 92%” without capturing which accuracy definition was used, how ground truth was determined, which test cases were included lacks visibility for security analysis. 利用含糊指标定义的攻击者能够逃避检测，因为监控并未呈现计算细节。 Attackers exploiting ambiguous metric definitions escape detection because monitoring doesn’t expose computational details. 评估指标监控需要从语义层面理解计算逻辑，而当前系统尚不具备这种可见性。 Evaluation metric monitoring requires semantic visibility into computation logic absent in current systems. [1893, 1894, 1895]. [1893, 1894, 1895].
RTM_5_5 - 缺乏对评估框架实现细节的监控。 RTM_5_5 - No Monitoring of Evaluation Framework Implementation Details. 不同的评估框架（自定义 Python、基于 LLM 的评估器、自动化测试系统）会生成结果，但其实现过程不可见。 Different evaluation frameworks (custom Python, LLM-based evaluators, automated testing systems) produce results without visibility into implementation. 在使用多种框架类型的多智能体评估中，监控无法洞察哪个框架计算了哪个指标。 In multi-agent evaluation using multiple framework types, monitoring lacks insight into which framework computed which metric. 基于 LLM 的评估器若在模型行为不可见的情况下生成结果，就会掩盖潜在的提示注入。 An LLM-based evaluator producing results without visibility into model behavior hides potential prompt injection. 评估框架监控需要了解具体实现所特有的漏洞，以便检测针对特定框架的攻击，而目前尚不具备这种能力。 Evaluation framework monitoring requires understanding implementation-specific vulnerabilities enabling framework-specific attack detection currently absent. [1083, 69, 1896, 759]. [1083, 69, 1896, 759].
RTM_5_6 - 评估审计轨迹的完整性缺口。 RTM_5_6 - Evaluation Audit Trail Completeness Gaps. 评估流水线会维护审计轨迹，记录哪个智能体评估了哪项变更，以及得出了什么结果。 Evaluation pipelines maintain audit trails showing which agent evaluated which change with what result. 然而，多智能体系统中的审计轨迹并不完整。 However, audit trails lack completeness in multi-agent systems. 当评估结果依赖多个智能体的输入时，审计轨迹仅显示最终结果，而不记录中间各智能体的贡献。 When evaluation results depend on multiple agents’ inputs, audit trails show only final results without capturing intermediate agent contributions. 要还原究竟是哪个智能体遭到入侵导致了评估偏差，就需要沿智能体之间的依赖关系进行追踪，而当前日志中缺少这些信息。 Reconstructing which agent’s compromise caused biased evaluation requires tracing through agent dependencies absent in current logs. 与因果关系明确的运行审计不同，评估审计轨迹必须记录智能体计算图，以支持在事件发生后对遭到破坏的评估进行调查。 Unlike operational audits with clear causality, evaluation audit trails must capture agent computation graphs enabling post-incident investigation of compromised evaluations. [269, 69, 85]. [269, 69, 85].
RTM_5_7 - 缺乏对评估数据集完整性的监控。 RTM_5_7 - No Monitoring of Evaluation Dataset Integrity. 评估数据集被假定为有效，但在多智能体系统中，数据集的变更并未受到监控。 Evaluation datasets are assumed valid but dataset changes go unmonitored in multi-agent systems. 当评估智能体访问共享评估数据集时，对数据集内容的修改对监控而言不可见。 When evaluation agents access shared evaluation datasets, modifications to dataset content are invisible to monitoring. 对评估数据集进行投毒的攻击者不会留下可通过常规监控检测到的审计轨迹。 Attackers poisoning evaluation datasets leave no audit trail detectable through normal monitoring. 评估数据集监控需要进行完整性检查（校验和、变更跟踪），而当前的评估流水线监控系统缺少这些机制，使多智能体评估中的数据集投毒无法被发现。 Evaluation dataset monitoring requires integrity checking (checksums, change tracking) absent in current evaluation pipeline monitoring systems, enabling undetected dataset poisoning in multi-agent evaluation. [1038, 400, 1897]. [1038, 400, 1897].
RTM_5_8 - 监控中缺少评估智能体行为基线。 RTM_5_8 - Evaluation Agent Behavior Baseline Absence in Monitoring. 处理一致评估工作流的评估智能体应表现出可预测的行为模式。 Evaluation agents processing consistent evaluation workflows should produce predictable behavior patterns. 在多智能体评估中，为“正常”的评估智能体行为建立基线，有助于检测已遭入侵智能体的异常行为。 In multi-agent evaluation, establishing baselines for ”normal” evaluation agent behavior enables anomaly detection of compromised agents. 没有基线，监控就无法区分合法评估与攻击驱动的评估操纵。 Without baselines, monitoring cannot distinguish legitimate evaluation from attack-driven evaluation manipulation. 为评估智能体行为建立基线，需要了解预期行为模式，以支持当前评估监控所缺少的异常检测。 Evaluation agent behavior baselining requires understanding expected patterns enabling anomaly detection currently missing from evaluation monitoring. [818, 612, 1816, 1800, 776]. [818, 612, 1816, 1800, 776].
RTM_5_9 - 跨评估时序分析的缺口。 RTM_5_9 - Cross-Evaluation Temporal Analysis Gaps. 当评估反复运行时（每日运行、由变更触发或用于持续监控），时序分析可以检测出表明存在系统性评估操纵的模式。 When evaluation is run repeatedly (daily, triggered by changes, continuous monitoring), temporal analysis could detect patterns indicating systematic evaluation manipulation. 在多个智能体提供时序数据的多智能体评估中，分析多次评估运行中的模式可以揭示攻击。 In multi-agent evaluation with multiple agents contributing temporal data, analyzing patterns across evaluation runs could reveal attacks. 对“指标每周五提升 5%”进行时序分析，可能发现按计划实施的评估操纵。 Temporal analysis of ”metric 5% improvement every Friday” could indicate scheduled evaluation manipulation. 当前监控将各次评估独立处理，缺少能够通过时序模式检测系统性评估作弊的时序分析。 Current monitoring treats evaluations independently lacking temporal analysis enabling detection of systematic evaluation gaming through temporal patterns. [69, 1898, 1899]. [69, 1898, 1899].
RTM_5_10 - 评估指标遥测伪造。 RTM_5_10 - Evaluation Metric Telemetry Spoofing. 持续评估流水线将指标回传至系统，以支持持续的质量监控。 Continuous evaluation pipelines report metrics back to systems enabling ongoing quality monitoring. 如果遥测报告未经加密或身份验证，攻击者就可能伪造指标报告，使实际未通过的评估看起来已经通过。 If telemetry reporting is unencrypted or unauthenticated, attackers could spoof metric reports making evaluation appear to pass when actually failing. 多智能体特有之处：在所有智能体均向集中式遥测系统报告指标的多智能体指标报告机制中，攻击者可能通过单一注入点伪造报告，从而影响对所有智能体的监控。 Multi-agent distinction: Multi-agent metric reporting where all agents report to centralized telemetry could enable attackers spoofing reports affecting all agents’ monitoring through single injection point. [1900, 785, 1901]. [1900, 785, 1901].
