RTM_5_11 - 评估性能监控盲点。 RTM_5_11 - Evaluation Performance Monitoring Blind Spots. 对评估脚本的监控可能不如对生产代码的监控严格。 Evaluation scripts may not be monitored as carefully as production code. 如果评估框架存在性能问题或资源消耗问题，攻击者就可能加以利用。 If evaluation frameworks have performance issues or resource consumption problems, attackers could exploit them. 例如，对于在大型测试集上计算指标的评估循环，如果其效率低下，攻击者就可能触发指数级资源消耗，导致评估超时。 For example, evaluation loops computing metrics across large test sets—if inefficient, attackers could trigger exponential resource consumption causing evaluation to time out. 多智能体特有之处：在不同智能体共同参与的多智能体评估循环中，攻击者可能在一个智能体中触发资源问题，进而影响整个评估基础设施。 Multi-agent distinction: Multi-agent evaluation loops where different agents contribute could enable attackers triggering resource issues in one agent affecting overall evaluation infrastructure. [116, 115, 70, 507, 832]. [116, 115, 70, 507, 832].
RTM_5_12 - 通过篡改评估日志破坏审计轨迹完整性。 RTM_5_12 - Audit Trail Integrity Violations Through Evaluation Log Tampering. 评估日志为质量决策提供审计轨迹。 Evaluation logs serve as audit trail for quality decisions. 如果智能体可以写入日志，或者时间戳可以被修改，攻击者就可能篡改审计轨迹，使恶意变更看起来已在先前的运行中通过评估。 If logs are writable by agents or if timestamps are modifiable, attackers could tamper with audit trails making malicious changes appear to have passed evaluation in prior runs. 多智能体特有之处：多智能体共享的审计日志使攻击者能够通过篡改日志，同时影响所有智能体的审计轨迹。 Multi-agent distinction: Multi-agent shared audit logs enable attackers tampering with logs affecting all agents’ audit trails simultaneously. [85, 785]. [85, 785].
RTM_5_13 - 规避监控告警阈值校准。 RTM_5_13 - Monitoring Alert Threshold Calibration Evasion. 对评估指标的持续监控会设置阈值，以便在出现异常时触发告警。 Continuous monitoring of evaluation metrics sets thresholds triggering alerts on anomalies. 攻击者可能逐步使指标恶化，同时将恶化程度保持在阈值以下，从而在造成累积退化的同时规避告警。 Attackers could gradually degrade metrics staying below thresholds, avoiding alerts while causing cumulative degradation. 多智能体特有之处：采用聚合阈值的多智能体告警系统，使攻击者能够将退化分散到多个智能体上，在保持低于告警阈值的同时造成整体质量下降。 Multi-agent distinction: Multi-agent alert systems where thresholds are aggregate-based enable attackers distributing degradation across agents staying below alert thresholds while collectively degrading quality. [1902, 1903]. [1902, 1903].
RTM_5_14 - 指标相关性分析中的盲点。 RTM_5_14 - Blind Spots in Metric Correlation Analysis. 评估框架可能不分析指标之间的相关性（如果共情能力和工具使用效率同时下降，这比二者各自独立下降更可疑）。 Evaluation frameworks might not analyze correlations between metrics (if empathy and tool efficiency both degrade simultaneously, that’s more suspicious than each degrading independently). 攻击者可能利用指标独立性假设，以协同方式使多个指标恶化，却使其表现为互不相关的故障。 Attackers could exploit metric independence assumptions degrading multiple metrics in coordinated ways that appear as uncorrelated failures. 多智能体特有之处：在每个智能体均有多个指标的多智能体系统中，攻击者能够了解哪些指标组合会显得可疑，并在降低未被测量的质量维度的同时避开这些组合。 Multi-agent distinction: Multi-agent systems with multiple metrics per agent enable attackers learning which metric combinations appear suspicious and avoiding those combinations while degrading unmeasured quality dimensions. [1904, 1905, 1906, 1907, 1908]. [1904, 1905, 1906, 1907, 1908].
RTM_5_15 - 利用基准测试执行遥测缺口隐蔽攻击。 RTM_5_15 - Benchmark Execution Telemetry Gaps for Attack Concealment. 受控的基准测试比较方法要求进行详细的日志记录。 Controlled benchmark comparison methodology requires detailed logging. 在多智能体系统中，基准测试遥测数据是分散的——智能体 A 记录自身的执行过程，智能体 B 单独记录，不存在统一的遥测层。 In multi-agent systems, benchmark telemetry is distributed—Agent A logs its execution, Agent B logs separately, no unified telemetry layer. 这会形成监控盲区，使跨智能体边界活动的攻击者能够在遥测缺口中行动。 This creates monitoring blind spots where attackers operating across agent boundaries operate in telemetry gaps. 将恶意指令从智能体 A 注入智能体 B 的攻击，会在两个智能体各自的日志中留下痕迹，但不会留下智能体间指令传递的痕迹。 An attack injecting malicious instructions from Agent A to Agent B leaves traces in both agents’ logs separately but no trace of inter-agent instruction passing. 多智能体场景的区别：单智能体遥测在同一进程内是连续的；多智能体遥测在智能体边界处存在天然缺口，使利用监控碎片化的攻击成为可能。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-agent telemetry is continuous within one process; multi-agent telemetry has natural gaps at agent boundaries enabling attacks exploiting monitoring fragmentation. [69, 1909, 70, 63, 1910]. [69, 1909, 70, 63, 1910].
RTM_5_16 - 攻击归因中的用户反馈监控盲区。 RTM_5_16 - User Feedback Monitoring Blind Spots for Attack Attribution. 持续改进流水线整合用户反馈，以实现持续优化。 Continuous improvement pipelines integrate user feedback for ongoing refinement. 在多智能体系统中，用户反馈会被路由至相应的智能体，但监控往往缺乏端到端追踪。 In multi-agent systems, user feedback is routed to appropriate agents but monitoring often lacks end-to-end tracing. “系统给出了不一致的建议”这类反馈可能涉及多个智能体，但监控会将问题归因于最后作出响应的智能体。 Feedback stating ”the system gave inconsistent advice” may involve multiple agents, but monitoring attributes the issue to whoever responds last. 归因失败会导致无法确定是哪个智能体（或协调多个智能体的攻击）引发了反馈中反映的问题。 Attribution failures prevent identifying which agent (or attack coordinating multiple agents) caused feedback problems. 多智能体场景的区别：单智能体反馈监控能够直接对问题进行归因；多智能体系统则将所有涉及多个智能体的故障归因于最终响应者，从而形成监控盲区，使分散责任的攻击成为可能。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-agent feedback monitoring directly attributes issues; multi-agent systems attribute all multi-agent failures to final responder creating monitoring blind spots enabling attacks distributing responsibility. [1911, 1912, 1913]. [1911, 1912, 1913].
RTM_5_17 - 渐进式性能退化中的性能指标监控盲区。 RTM_5_17 - Performance Metric Monitoring Blind Spots for Gradual Degradation. 置信度校准评估用于判断改进是否具有统计显著性。 Confidence calibration evaluation assesses whether improvements are statistically significant. 在多智能体系统中，各智能体独立报告性能指标。 In multi-agent systems, performance metrics are reported by each agent independently. 同时逐步削弱多个智能体校准性能的攻击不会触发任何单独的警报——每个智能体的性能退化看起来都处于噪声范围内。 A gradual attack degrading multiple agents’ calibration simultaneously creates no single alarm—each agent’s degradation seems within noise. 多个智能体协同性能退化的叠加效应超出了监控阈值，但单个智能体的性能退化仍无法被察觉。 The compound effect of coordinated degradation across agents exceeds monitoring thresholds but individual agents’ degradation remains invisible. 多智能体场景的区别：单智能体性能退化会触发监控；多智能体协同性能退化则利用了分布式监控无法跨智能体边界关联渐进式叠加效应的弱点。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-agent degradation triggers monitoring; multi-agent coordinated degradation exploits distributed monitoring unable to correlate gradual compound effects across agent boundaries. [1914, 1915, 1916]. [1914, 1915, 1916].
III-F6 RTM_6 - 指标收集与操纵规避III-F6 RTM_6 - Metrics Collection and Manipulation Evasion
RTM_6_1 - 利用审批工作流审计轨迹碎片化隐蔽攻击。 RTM_6_1 - Approval Workflow Audit Trail Fragmentation for Attack Concealment. 在多智能体评估流水线中，部署前会采用包含统计显著性检验的审批工作流。 Approval workflows with statistical significance testing are used before deployment in multi-agent evaluation pipelines. 在多智能体审批系统中，审计轨迹分散在各个智能体中。 In multi-agent approval systems, audit trails fragment across agents. 智能体 A 记录审批，智能体 B 记录工具调用，智能体 C 记录结果，但缺乏统一的审计机制来追踪完整的决策链。 Agent A logs approval, Agent B logs tool invocation, Agent C logs outcome, but no unified audit enables tracing the complete decision chain. 这种碎片化为跨边界攻击形成了盲区。 This fragmentation creates blind spots for attacks that span boundaries. 多智能体场景的区别：单智能体审批审计轨迹是连续的；多智能体审批审计轨迹在智能体边界处分裂，使利用审计不连续性的攻击成为可能。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-agent approval audit trails are continuous; multi-agent approval audit trails split at agent boundaries enabling attacks exploiting audit discontinuity. [11, 44, 1917, 818, 40]. [11, 44, 1917, 818, 40].
RTM_6_2 - 多智能体网页导航中的时间同步缺口。 RTM_6_2 - Temporal Synchronization Gaps in Multi-Agent Web Navigation. 多智能体网页导航需要不同智能体之间进行协调（会话管理、JavaScript 执行、DOM 交互），这会产生时间缺口，页面状态可能在此期间发生变化。 Multi-agent web navigation coordinating across different agents (session management, JavaScript execution, DOM interaction) creates temporal gaps where page state changes. 攻击者利用时机，在这些缺口中注入指令（“在智能体 A 执行 JavaScript 之后、智能体 B 读取 DOM 之前执行”）。 Attackers exploit timing to inject instructions during gaps (”Execute after Agent A’s JavaScript execution but before Agent B’s DOM read”). 多智能体场景的区别：单智能体导航看到的状态是一致的；多智能体跨时间边界的协调使通过时间窗口注入指令成为可能。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-agent navigation sees consistent state; multi-agent coordination across temporal boundaries enables instruction injection through timing windows. [23, 1918, 1045, 1883, 1919]. [23, 1918, 1045, 1883, 1919].
RTM_6_3 - 指标收集参数调优造成监控缺口。 RTM_6_3 - Metric Collection Parameter Tuning Creating Monitoring Gaps. 通过全面的测试集开展评估并收集指标，为参数调优决策提供依据。 Evaluation through comprehensive test sets and metrics collection inform parameter tuning decisions. 各智能体采用不同的指标收集设置进行调优——一些智能体记录全面的追踪信息，另一些则为提高性能而仅记录最少量的日志。 Agents are tuned with different metric collection settings—some agents log comprehensive traces, others minimal logging for performance. 这些不对称的监控参数会形成盲区：进行全面追踪的智能体会显露其行为，而仅记录最少量日志的智能体则会隐藏其行为。 These asymmetric monitoring parameters create blind spots where comprehensive tracing agents reveal behavior while minimal-logging agents hide behavior. 攻击者利用监控参数的不对称性，通过监测埋点较少的智能体开展活动，借助参数调优中的选择来逃避检测。 Attackers exploit monitoring-parameter asymmetry by operating through agents with reduced instrumentation, evading detection through parameter-tuning choices. [70, 1920, 1917, 37, 251]. [70, 1920, 1917, 37, 251].
RTM_6_4 - 作为指标操纵攻击面的置信度分数调优。 RTM_6_4 - Confidence Score Tuning as Metric Manipulation Surface. 置信度分数校准是智能体评估的一个关键方面。 Confidence score calibration is a critical aspect of agent evaluation. 置信度分数的生成参数（温度、词元选择）会影响智能体在监控仪表板上是否显得校准良好。 Confidence score generation parameters (temperature, token selection) affect whether agents appear well-calibrated in monitoring dashboards. 攻击者专门为规避监控而调整置信度参数——在将置信度与观测结果进行比较的自动化监控看来，高置信度的错误答案也显得可以接受。 Attackers tune confidence parameters specifically for monitoring evasion—high-confidence wrong answers appear acceptable to automated monitoring comparing confidence to observed outcomes. 通过调优来抬高置信度会造成监控盲区：指标显示运行状况良好，而实际性能却在下降。 Tuned confidence inflation creates monitoring blind spots where metrics suggest healthy operation while actual performance degrades. 当智能体为优化表面表现而调整置信度参数时，跨智能体聚合置信度的多智能体监控就会受到污染。 Multi-agent monitoring aggregating confidence across agents becomes corrupted when agents tune confidence parameters for appearance optimization. [1921, 1922, 1923, 1924, 1925]。 [1921, 1922, 1923, 1924, 1925].
RTM_6_5 - 通过优化参数选择操纵延迟指标。 RTM_6_5 - Latency Metric Gaming Through Optimization Parameter Selection. 延迟是一项关键指标，可通过量化、推测解码和缓存等多种技术进行优化。 Latency is a key metric optimized through various techniques including quantization, speculative decoding, and caching. 通过特定的参数组合对智能体进行调优，以达到延迟目标。 Agents are tuned to achieve latency targets through specific parameter combinations. 攻击者利用延迟调优，构造在标准监控中显得执行迅速的操作（命中经过优化的代码路径），同时执行恶意行为（将缓慢的欺骗性操作隐藏在经过优化的延迟之内）。 Attackers exploit latency tuning by crafting operations that appear fast in standard monitoring (hitting optimized code paths) while performing malicious actions (slow deceptive operations hidden within optimized latency). 塑造延迟指标的参数调优使攻击者能够将行为隐藏在调优后的延迟边界之内，使操作即使执行了恶意逻辑，也仍显得速度正常。 The parameter tuning creating latency metrics enables attackers to hide behavior within tuned latency boundaries where operations appear normal-speed despite executing malicious logic. [199, 124, 447, 1127, 210]。 [199, 124, 447, 1127, 210].
RTM_6_6 - 作为隐蔽指令激活机制的示例排序。 RTM_6_6 - Demonstration Ordering as Covert Instruction Activation Mechanism. 示例顺序通过近因偏差显著影响上下文学习。 Example order significantly impacts in-context learning through recency bias. 攻击者有策略地将投毒示例放在演示序列的末尾，以确保其对所学模式产生最大影响。 Adversaries strategically position poisoned examples last in demonstration sequences, ensuring maximum influence on learned patterns. 在演示集跨智能体边界流转的多智能体系统中，精心安排顺序可将包含恶意指令的示例置于关键节点，使其发挥最大影响。 In multi-agent systems where demonstration sets flow across agent boundaries, careful ordering positions malicious instruction examples at critical junctures where they exert maximal influence. 多智能体场景的独特之处：示例顺序投毒会形成时序性指令注入，使恶意示例仅在多智能体工作流中的特定位置激活特定行为，从而使攻击能够逃避那些关注显式指令注入而非基于排序的控制流的监控系统。 Multi-agent distinction: Example order poisoning creates temporal instruction injection where malicious examples activate specific behaviors only at particular points in multi-agent workflows, enabling attacks escaping monitoring systems focused on explicit instruction injection rather than ordering-based control flow. [1926, 1927, 1928, 1929]。 [1926, 1927, 1928, 1929].
RTM_6_7 - 利用异步聚合规避分布式工具审计日志分析。 RTM_6_7 - Distributed Tool Audit Log Analysis Defeating Through Async Aggregation. 在多智能体系统中，工具审计日志以异步方式聚合。 Tool audit logs are aggregated asynchronously in multi-agent systems. 攻击者利用时序——在日志尚未聚合时发动攻击，或构造这样的攻击序列：在孤立的时间窗口内分析时显得安全，但在跨智能体关联分析时则呈现出恶意性。 Attackers exploit timing—committing attacks while logs haven’t yet been aggregated, or crafting attack sequences that appear safe when analyzed in isolated time windows but malicious when correlated across agents. 多智能体场景的独特之处：单个智能体的日志作为一个整体进行分析；多智能体异步日志聚合则会产生分析窗口，使攻击者能够规避时序关联检测。 Multi-agent distinction: Singular agent logs are analyzed atomically; multi-agent asynchronous log aggregation creates analysis windows enabling attackers to evade temporal correlation detection. [1045, 44, 62, 859]。 [1045, 44, 62, 859].
RTM_6_8 - 通过委派降低工具调用的可观测性。 RTM_6_8 - Tool Invocation Observability Reduction Through Delegation. 在智能体的层级委派结构中，工作智能体的工具调用无法直接追溯到用户请求。 In agent delegation hierarchies, tool invocations by worker agents don’t directly trace to user requests. 其机制是由管理智能体委派任务，再由工作智能体调用工具。 Instead, manager agents delegate tasks, and workers invoke tools. 审计轨迹会显示工具调用，却不显示触发这些调用的原始用户请求。 Audit trails show tool invocations but not original user requests triggering them. 多智能体场景的独特之处：单智能体追踪将用户与工具调用直接关联起来；层级委派则会造成语义缺口，使审计轨迹虽然显示工具调用，却缺乏关于调用原因的完整上下文。 Multi-agent distinction: Singular tracing connects users directly to tool invocations; hierarchical delegation creates semantic gaps where audit trails show tool calls without full context about why they were invoked. [115, 45, 44, 469, 741]。 [115, 45, 44, 469, 741].
RTM_6_9 - 通过聚合偏差对工具响应质量指标投毒。 RTM_6_9 - Tool Response Quality Metrics Poisoning Through Aggregation Bias. 多智能体系统会跨智能体聚合工具质量指标（成功率、延迟）。 Multi-agent systems aggregate tool quality metrics (success rates, latency) across agents. 在多智能体系统中，攻击者攻陷部分智能体，使其报告虚高的质量指标，从而使聚合指标产生偏差。 In multi-agent systems, attackers compromise subset of agents to report inflated quality metrics, skewing aggregate metrics. 基于聚合指标作出的决策（停用表现不佳的工具）会受到污染。 Decisions based on aggregate metrics (retiring low-performing tools) become corrupted. 多智能体场景的独特之处：单个智能体报告独立的指标；多智能体聚合则会形成偏差攻击面，使攻陷部分智能体即可影响对整体质量的判断。 Multi-agent distinction: Singular agents report independent metrics; multi-agent aggregation creates bias attack surfaces where compromising subset affects collective quality perception. [69, 387, 23, 1930]。 [69, 387, 23, 1930].
RTM_6_10 - 智能体专业化造成的工具选择监控盲区。 RTM_6_10 - Tool Selection Monitoring Blind Spots Through Agent Specialization. 不同智能体拥有不同的可用工具集。 Different agents have different tool palettes. 监控系统可能会按智能体类型跟踪工具选择，却遗漏跨智能体的模式。 Monitoring systems may track tool selection per agent type but miss cross-agent patterns. 攻击者利用这一点，选择跨越智能体边界的特定工具序列，以避免触发单智能体监控。 Attackers exploit this by selecting specific tool sequences across agent boundaries that avoid triggering single-agent monitors. 多智能体场景的区别：单智能体监控能够捕获所有选择模式；多智能体的专业化分工则会产生盲区，某些特定工具只能通过特定智能体访问，使攻击者能够利用监控空白。 Multi-agent distinction: Singular monitoring catches all selection patterns; multi-agent specialization creates blind spots where specific tools are only accessible through certain agents, enabling attackers to exploit monitoring gaps. [1045, 18, 44, 729]. [1045, 18, 44, 729].
RTM_6_11 - 通过智能体置信度聚合规避熵跟踪。 RTM_6_11 - Entropy Tracking Evasion Through Agent Confidence Aggregation. 幻觉检测会监控生成过程的熵（不确定性）。 Hallucination detection monitors generation entropy (uncertainty). 在采用置信度聚合的多智能体系统中（智能体 A 以低熵生成内容，智能体 B 以高置信度进行验证），即使底层生成过程存在不确定性，聚合置信度仍会显得很高。 In multi-agent systems with confidence aggregation (Agent A generates with low entropy, Agent B validates with high confidence), aggregate confidence appears high even if underlying generation was uncertain. 熵监控因而无法察觉攻击。 Entropy monitoring becomes blind to attack. 多智能体场景的区别：单智能体熵跟踪能够捕获生成过程的不确定性；多智能体聚合则通过高置信度的下游验证掩盖个体的熵，使不确定的上游生成结果看似得到了确认。 Multi-agent distinction: Singular entropy tracking captures generation uncertainty; multi-agent aggregation masks individual entropy through high-confidence downstream validation appearing to confirm uncertain upstream generation. [69, 23, 1857, 1052, 62]. [69, 23, 1857, 1052, 62].
RTM_6_12 - 异步验证导致的工具审计覆盖空白。 RTM_6_12 - Tool Audit Coverage Gaps Through Asynchronous Validation. 某些多智能体系统会异步验证工具（智能体 A 调用工具，智能体 B 随后验证响应）。 Some multi-agent systems validate tools asynchronously (Agent A invokes tool, Agent B validates response later). 如果验证延迟较长，遭到入侵的工具就可能在验证发生之前执行多次。 If validation delays are long, compromised tools can execute many times before validation occurs. 审计日志显示，工具在验证完成之前就已执行。 Audit logs show tools executed before validation completed. 多智能体场景的区别：单智能体同步验证能够防止这种情况；多智能体异步验证则会产生覆盖空白，使工具在缺乏即时监督的情况下执行。 Multi-agent distinction: Singular synchronous validation prevents this; multi-agent asynchronous validation creates coverage gaps where tools execute without immediate oversight. [1931, 1932, 1933, 900, 1934]. [1931, 1932, 1933, 900, 1934].
RTM_6_13 - 异常检测中对跨智能体上下文关联的盲视。 RTM_6_13 - Cross-Agent Context Correlation Blindness in Anomaly Detection. 异常检测系统会标记不寻常的工具调用模式。 Anomaly detection systems flag unusual tool invocation patterns. 在多智能体系统中，各个智能体的调用模式可能看似正常，而跨智能体的关联却存在异常。 In multi-agent systems, individual agents’ invocation patterns may appear normal while cross-agent correlations are anomalous. 攻击者在多个智能体之间协调行动，使各智能体单独看来正常，但整体行为具有恶意。 Attackers coordinate across agents appearing normal individually but malicious collectively. 多智能体场景的区别：单智能体异常检测针对单一数据流运行；多智能体系统则需要对独立数据流进行关联分析，由此产生盲区，使看似互不相关的个体行为掩盖相互关联的集体攻击。 Multi-agent distinction: Singular anomaly detection operates on single stream; multi-agent systems require correlation across independent streams, creating blind spots where uncorrelated individual behavior masks correlated collective attacks. [27, 70, 1935, 1936]. [27, 70, 1935, 1936].
RTM_6_14 - 生产环境监控未采集动作准确率指标。 RTM_6_14 - Action Accuracy Metrics Not Captured in Production Monitoring. 多智能体系统在生产环境中往往缺少通过埋点采集的动作级指标，即使开发期间已使用离线和在线评估框架也是如此。 Multi-agent systems often lack instrumented action-level metrics in production, even when offline and online evaluation frameworks have been used during development. 每个智能体可能都会记录执行情况，但很少计算跨智能体链的聚合动作准确率指标。 Each agent may log execution but aggregated action accuracy metrics across agent chains are rarely computed. 攻击者可以利用这一空白，降低参数准确率而不被发现。 Attackers exploiting this gap can degrade parameter accuracy undetected. 多智能体场景的区别：通过埋点全面记录动作的单智能体能够观察到准确率下降。 Multi-agent distinction: Single agents instrumenting comprehensive action logging have visibility into accuracy degradation. 具备各智能体日志记录、却缺少跨智能体指标的多智能体系统存在“监控空白”，使发生在智能体边界处的准确率下降无法被检测到。 Multi-agent systems with per-agent logging but no cross-agent metrics have ”monitoring gaps” where accuracy degradation at agent boundaries goes undetected. 单个参数准确率达到 92% 的智能体也会导致流水线性能下降，但由于未监控流水线级指标，这种下降无法被揭示。 An agent achieving 92% parameter accuracy individually contributes to pipeline degradation, but pipeline-level metrics aren’t monitored revealing the degradation. [115, 861, 177, 387, 52]. [115, 861, 177, 387, 52].
RTM_6_15 - 聚合指标未能发现参数验证失败。 RTM_6_15 - Parameter Validation Failures Undetected in Aggregated Metrics. 逐参数粒度（字符串参数、数值参数和时间参数）是智能体评估中的一个重要考量因素。 Per-parameter granularity (string vs numeric vs temporal parameters) is an important consideration in agent evaluation. 在多智能体监控中，聚合会掩盖特定参数类型的失败。 In multi-agent monitoring, aggregation hides parameter-type-specific failures. 智能体 A 验证时间参数的准确率为 60%，验证其他参数的准确率为 92%。 Agent A validates temporal parameters with 60% accuracy, other parameters 92%. 如果聚合后的总体准确率为 87%，时间参数方面的弱点就会被掩盖。 If aggregated as overall 87% accuracy, temporal weakness is hidden. 多智能体场景的区别：单智能体的细粒度指标可以直接观测。 Multi-agent distinction: Single agent granular metrics are directly observable. 跨智能体聚合会使人难以辨明究竟是哪个智能体或哪种参数类型的表现正在下降。 Multi-agent aggregation across agents obscures which agent or which parameter type is degrading. 这一点至关重要，因为已知时间参数准确率是许多生产部署中的显著弱点，而多智能体聚合可能掩盖针对时间参数的系统性攻击。 This is critical because temporal parameter accuracy is known to be a significant weakness in many production deployments—multi-agent aggregation can hide systematic temporal parameter attacks. [1937, 86, 177]. [1937, 86, 177].
RTM_6_16 - 聚合成功率掩盖的工具执行错误。 RTM_6_16 - Tool Execution Errors Hidden in Aggregated Success Rates. 一种有用的区分方式是将智能体故障（选择错误的工具或传入不当参数）与系统故障（工具崩溃）区分开来。 A useful distinction separates agent failures (choosing wrong tools or passing bad parameters) from system failures (tool crashes). 在多智能体监控中，工具执行成功率通常按工具聚合，而不是按智能体聚合。 In multi-agent monitoring, tool execution success rates are often aggregated by tool not by agent. 如果 Tool1 的平均成功率为 94%，但智能体 A 的成功率为 87%，智能体 B 的成功率为 96%，那么单个智能体的性能退化就会被掩盖。 If Tool1 has 94% success rate average but Agent A achieves 87% success and Agent B achieves 96%, individual agent degradation is hidden. 多智能体场景的区别：工具层面的聚合会掩盖特定智能体的参数准确性问题。 Multi-agent distinction: Tool-level aggregation obscures agent-specific parameter accuracy problems. 智能体 A 可能持续向 Tool1 传递错误参数，导致失败，但这些失败看起来像是工具可靠性问题，而非智能体 A 的参数准确性问题。 Agent A might systematically pass bad parameters to Tool1 causing failures, but failure appears as tool reliability issue rather than Agent A parameter accuracy issue. 多智能体监控盲点使执行失败的根本原因无法得到诊断。 Multi-agent monitoring blind spots prevent diagnosing root causes of execution failures. [86, 1045, 690]. [86, 1045, 690].
RTM_6_17 - 智能体链中未被检测到的多轮一致性损失。 RTM_6_17 - Multi-Turn Consistency Losses Undetected Across Agent Chains. 会话指标能够捕捉单次动作指标可能掩盖的性能退化模式。 Session metrics capture regression patterns that individual action metrics can obscure. 在多智能体系统中，智能体 A 在局部维持会话一致性，但智能体 B 接收到的、来自 A 会话的参数质量却有所下降。 In multi-agent systems, Agent A maintains session consistency locally but Agent B receives degraded parameters from A’s sessions. 多智能体场景的区别：多轮评估需要持续检查各轮之间的一致性。 Multi-agent distinction: Multi-turn evaluation requires continuous consistency checking across turns. 多智能体系统通常会衡量每个智能体各轮之间的一致性，却不衡量跨智能体的一致性。 Multi-agent systems often measure per-agent turn consistency but not cross-agent consistency. 智能体 B 无法检测到智能体 A 在第 4-5 轮的连贯性下降，而这种下降会影响 B 在第 6-8 轮接收到的参数。 Agent B cannot detect that Agent A’s coherence degraded in turns 4-5 affecting parameters B receives in turns 6-8. 大多数多智能体系统缺乏这种跨智能体连贯性监控，导致可靠性下降而未被检测到。 This cross-agent coherence monitoring is missing in most multi-agent systems, creating undetected reliability degradation. [1938, 814, 116, 1939, 1940]. [1938, 814, 116, 1939, 1940].
RTM_6_18 - 分布式追踪中不可见的错误恢复模式。 RTM_6_18 - Error Recovery Patterns Invisible in Distributed Tracing. 错误恢复能力是区别于首次尝试准确率的一项指标。 Error recovery capability is a distinct metric from first-attempt accuracy. 在多智能体系统中，错误恢复模式呈分布式：智能体 A 检测到失败后，通知智能体 B 重试，由智能体 B 实现重试逻辑。 In multi-agent systems, error recovery patterns become distributed—Agent A detects failure and signals Agent B to retry, Agent B implements retry logic. 与单智能体恢复相比，分布式错误恢复模式更难进行监测插桩。 Distributed error recovery patterns are harder to instrument than single-agent recovery. 多智能体场景的区别：单个智能体的恢复能力可以直接观察。 Multi-agent distinction: Recovery capability in single agents is directly observable. 涉及跨智能体协调的多智能体恢复会造成“恢复盲区”：由于重试逻辑分散在多个智能体中，且各智能体对结果的可见性不完整，监控系统无法追踪重试是否成功。 Multi-agent recovery involving cross-agent coordination creates ”recovery blindness” where monitoring systems don’t track whether retry attempts were successful because retry logic is distributed across multiple agents with incomplete visibility into outcomes. 某个智能体可能执行了局部看来成功的恢复，但下游智能体接收到的恢复状态并不完整。 An agent might implement recovery that appears successful locally but Agent downstream agent receives incomplete recovery state. [116, 70, 1204, 382, 1941]. [116, 70, 1204, 382, 1941].
RTM_6_19 - 很少计算的跨智能体轨迹指标。 RTM_6_19 - Cross-Agent Trajectory Metrics Rarely Computed. 完全匹配率、精确率、召回率和步骤效用等轨迹指标需要从开始到结束的完整动作序列。 Trajectory metrics such as exact match, precision, recall, and step utility require complete action sequences from start to finish. 在多智能体系统中，智能体 A 的动作 + 智能体 B 的动作 = 完整轨迹，但很少跨越智能体边界计算指标。 In multi-agent systems, Agent A’s actions + Agent B’s actions = complete trajectory, but metrics are rarely computed across agent boundaries. 多智能体场景的区别：单智能体的轨迹评估很直接，即将一个智能体的完整轨迹与参考轨迹进行比较。 Multi-agent distinction: Trajectory evaluation in single agents is straightforward—one agent’s complete trajectory against reference. 多智能体轨迹需要协调各智能体的动作序列，而这些智能体的操作可能是并发且异步的，这使参考轨迹的定义变得模糊。 Multi-agent trajectories require coordinating action sequences across agents whose operations may be concurrent and asynchronous, making reference trajectory definition ambiguous. 大多数监控系统不计算多智能体轨迹指标，造成了“轨迹盲区”：跨智能体链的动作序列质量未被衡量，因此其退化也未受到监控。 Most monitoring systems don’t compute multi-agent trajectory metrics, creating ”trajectory blindness” where action sequence quality across agent chains is unmeasured and therefore unmonitored for degradation. [814, 1114, 890, 1942]. [814, 1114, 890, 1942].
RTM_6_20 - 系统级连贯性验证盲点。 RTM_6_20 - System-Level Coherence Validation Blind Spot. 尽管组织会评估单个智能体的推理质量，但它们缺乏跨越智能体边界验证多智能体系统级推理连贯性的机制。 While organizations evaluate individual agent reasoning quality, they lack mechanisms to validate multi-agent system-level reasoning coherence across agent boundaries. 没有智能体会验证智能体 A 的推理是否恰当地为智能体 B 的分析提供依据，也没有智能体会验证系统级推理脉络在交接过程中是否保持连贯。 No agent validates that Agent A’s reasoning appropriately informs Agent B’s analysis, or that system-level reasoning threads remain coherent across handoffs. 攻击者利用这一验证盲点，设计出使每个智能体的推理在局部成立、但整个系统的推理却失效的攻击。 Attackers craft attacks where each agent’s reasoning is locally sound but system-wide reasoning breaks, exploiting the validation blind spot. 多智能体场景的区别：单个智能体的评估无法检测系统级连贯性故障，因为连贯性是多智能体交互的涌现属性。 Multi-agent distinction: Individual agent evaluation cannot detect system-level coherence failures because coherence is an emergent property of multi-agent interaction. 单智能体不会出现系统级连贯性问题，因为它们采用单体结构。 Singular agents cannot have system-level coherence problems because they’re monolithic. [18, 177, 62, 115]. [18, 177, 62, 115].
RTM_6_21 - 缺乏持续监控时生产环境中的推理质量漂移。 RTM_6_21 - Reasoning Quality Drift in Production Without Continuous Monitoring. 在开发阶段实施推理质量评估的组织，往往未能在生产环境中维持持续监控，从而形成盲点，使推理质量逐渐下降而未被检测到。 Organizations implementing reasoning quality evaluation in development often fail to maintain continuous production monitoring, creating blindspots where reasoning quality gradually degrades undetected. 攻击者会利用随时间推移而出现的已知推理质量问题（模型更新引入推理性能退化、提示词漂移降低质量、训练分布变化），因为监控缺口使这些退化不可见。 Attackers exploit known reasoning quality issues that develop over time (model updates introducing reasoning regressions, prompt drift reducing quality, training distribution changes) because monitoring gap leaves degradation invisible. 多智能体场景的区别：在多智能体系统中，一个智能体的推理质量下降会向下游智能体级联传播，与单智能体相比，其影响会被放大。 Multi-agent distinction: In multi-agent systems, reasoning quality degradation in one agent cascades through downstream agents, amplifying impact compared to singular agents. 未被检测到的退化会影响整个系统，而非孤立的智能体。 Undetected degradation affects entire systems rather than isolated agents. [818, 264, 115]。 [818, 264, 115].
RTM_6_22 - 推理质量评估的范围局限。 RTM_6_22 - Reasoning Quality Evaluation Scope Limitations. 推理质量评估框架通常侧重于正常路径下的推理，而未广泛测试错误条件、异常输入或对抗性场景下的推理质量。 Reasoning quality evaluation frameworks often focus on happy-path reasoning without extensively testing reasoning quality during error conditions, unusual inputs, or adversarial scenarios. 攻击者构造使推理质量崩溃的条件（出现矛盾、逻辑连贯性遭到破坏、信息量下降），因为评估中的空白使这些场景未经测试。 Attackers craft conditions where reasoning quality collapses (contradictions emerge, logical coherence breaks, informativeness drops) because evaluation gaps left these scenarios untested. 多智能体区别：在多智能体错误处理中，一个智能体在异常条件下发生的推理质量崩溃可能级联传播至下游智能体，后者会在未预料到的情况下承接质量下降的推理。 Multi-agent distinction: In multi-agent error handling, reasoning quality collapse in one agent during anomalous conditions can cascade to downstream agents that inherit degraded reasoning quality without expecting it. 在多智能体架构中，对错误场景下推理的评估空白会影响整个系统的韧性。 Evaluation gaps in error-scenario reasoning affect entire system resilience in multi-agent architectures. [1943, 1944, 1945, 1946, 776]。 [1943, 1944, 1945, 1946, 776].
RTM_6_23 - 推理链中的归因与可追溯性缺口。 RTM_6_23 - Attribution and Traceability Gaps in Reasoning Chains. 组织缺乏将多智能体系统中的推理贡献追溯至具体智能体的机制，因而无法识别究竟是哪个智能体的推理质量失效导致了系统级问题。 Organizations lack mechanisms to trace reasoning contributions back to specific agents in multi-agent systems, preventing identification of which agent’s reasoning quality failures caused system-level problems. 当多个智能体之间出现涌现行为时，归因便无法实现。 When emergent behavior occurs across agents, attribution becomes impossible. 攻击者利用这一点向中间智能体注入推理，而归因缺口使注入来源无法被检测出来。 Attackers exploit this by injecting reasoning into intermediate agents where attribution gaps prevent detection of injection sources. 多智能体区别：单个智能体的推理可追溯至单一来源；多智能体系统则会产生归因歧义，推理质量的责任分散在多个智能体之间，缺乏明确的问责机制，使注入能够隐藏在归因缺口中。 Multi-agent distinction: Singular agents’ reasoning is traceable to single sources; multi-agent systems create attribution ambiguity where responsibility for reasoning quality becomes distributed across agents with no clear accountability, enabling injections to hide in the attribution gaps. [177, 70, 62, 115, 69]。 [177, 70, 62, 115, 69].
RTM_6_24 - 效率指标聚合掩盖攻击信号。 RTM_6_24 - Efficiency Metric Aggregation Obscuring Attack Signals. 效率系统会跨多个智能体、操作和时间窗口聚合指标。 Efficiency systems aggregate metrics across multiple agents, operations, and time windows. 聚合会掩盖攻击信号——导致效率下降 0.1% 的恶意行为会在聚合指标中消失。 Aggregation obscures attack signals—malicious behavior causing 0.1% efficiency degradation disappears in aggregate metrics. 按智能体或按操作统计的指标本可揭示异常，但聚合报告将其隐藏了起来。 Per-agent or per-operation metrics would reveal anomalies, but aggregate reporting hides them. 多智能体区别：单智能体指标随时间聚合会隐藏时间维度上的攻击；多智能体系统跨智能体进行聚合，则会将针对单个智能体的攻击隐藏在聚合的系统指标中。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-agent metrics aggregated over time hide temporal attacks; multi-agent systems aggregating across agents hide per-agent attacks within aggregate system metrics. 攻击者利用聚合将攻击隐藏在噪声中。 Attackers exploit aggregation to hide attacks in noise. [69, 62, 23, 1620]。 [69, 62, 23, 1620].
RTM_6_25 - 基于采样的效率监控造成盲区。 RTM_6_25 - Sampling-Based Efficiency Monitoring Creating Blind Spots. 高吞吐量系统会对效率指标进行采样（监控 1% 的操作），以降低监控开销。 High-volume systems sample efficiency metrics (monitor 1% of operations) reducing monitoring overhead. 攻击者构造仅在未被采样的条件下触发的操作，以规避监控。 Attackers craft operations triggering only under conditions not sampled, evading monitoring. 恶意的效率“优化”仅出现在未受监控的 99% 的操作中。 Malicious efficiency ”optimizations” appear only in unmonitored 99% of operations. 多智能体区别：单智能体采样会为该智能体造成监控空白；在跨智能体协调采样的多智能体系统中，攻击者能够了解采样边界，并构造处于受监控操作范围之外的攻击。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-agent sampling creates monitoring gaps for that agent; multi-agent systems with coordinated sampling across agents enable attackers understanding sample boundaries and crafting attacks outside monitored operations. [116, 1886, 612, 1947]。 [116, 1886, 612, 1947].
RTM_6_26 - 延迟百分位数报告掩盖攻击引发的峰值。 RTM_6_26 - Latency Percentile Reporting Masking Attack Spikes. 效率监控通常报告延迟百分位数（p50、p95、p99），而非极值。 Efficiency monitoring often reports latency percentiles (p50, p95, p99) rather than extremes. 攻击触发的延迟峰值若仅影响 1% 的操作，就不会在 p99 报告中显现。 Attack-triggered latency spikes only affecting 1% of operations remain invisible in p99 reporting. 攻击者构造仅在特定条件下触发的操作，造成只有在 p99.9 或最大延迟（未受监控）中才可见的极端延迟。 Attackers craft operations triggering only under conditions causing extreme latency visible only in p99.9 or max latency (unmonitored). 多智能体区别：单智能体的百分位数报告会隐藏该智能体的尾部延迟；多智能体系统跨智能体报告聚合百分位数，则会更彻底地隐藏各个智能体的尾部延迟。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-agent percentile reporting hides that agent’s tail latencies; multi-agent systems reporting aggregate percentiles across agents hide per-agent tail latencies even more thoroughly. [1947, 1948, 1949]。 [1947, 1948, 1949].
RTM_6_27 - 成本归因滞后造成归因盲区。 RTM_6_27 - Cost Attribution Lag Creating Attribution Blind Spots. 效率成本归因通常比实际使用滞后数小时或数天。 Efficiency cost attribution often lags actual usage by hours or days. 攻击者利用归因延迟——操作已消耗资源，但成本归因尚未计算完成。 Attackers exploit attribution delay—operations consumed but cost attribution not yet calculated. 在成本归因揭示问题之前，资源耗尽就已导致系统故障。 Resource exhaustion causes system failure before cost attribution reveals the problem. 多智能体区别：单智能体的成本归因滞后会影响该智能体的预算管理；采用共享资源池的多智能体系统则使攻击者能够利用归因滞后，在被检测到之前耗尽所有智能体的共享资源。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-agent cost attribution lag affects that agent’s budgeting; multi-agent systems with shared resource pools enable attackers exploiting attribution lag to exhaust all agents’ shared resources before detection. [745, 1950, 843]。 [745, 1950, 843].
RTM_6_28 - 效率告警阈值未能捕捉渐进式退化。 RTM_6_28 - Efficiency Alert Thresholds Missing Gradual Degradation. 效率监控会设置告警阈值（token 消耗量 ¿ 10K 时触发告警）。 Efficiency monitoring sets alert thresholds (token consumption ¿ 10K triggers alert). 在数小时内从 3K tokens 逐渐恶化至 9K tokens，不会触发离散告警。 Gradual degradation from 3K to 9K tokens across hours doesn’t trigger discrete alerts. 攻击者使性能缓慢恶化，始终保持在阈值以下，同时逐步耗尽预算。 Attackers cause slow degradation staying below thresholds while cumulatively exhausting budgets. 多智能体区别：单智能体的缓慢性能恶化最终会触发该智能体的告警；在各智能体采用独立阈值的多智能体系统中，攻击者可以使所有智能体协调地逐渐恶化，而任何单个智能体的告警都不会触发系统层面的整体感知。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-agent slow degradation eventually triggers that agent’s alerts; multi-agent systems with independent agent thresholds enable coordinated gradual degradation across all agents, with no single agent’s alert triggering system-wide awareness. [1951, 1952, 116, 1683]. [1951, 1952, 116, 1683].
RTM_6_29 - 效率指标相关性分析盲区。 RTM_6_29 - Efficiency Metric Correlation Analysis Blind Spot. 效率监控系统孤立地监测各项指标（延迟、token 数量、API 调用次数）。 Efficiency systems monitor individual metrics in isolation (latency, token count, API calls). 通过相关性分析检测同时出现的异常（高延迟 + 高 token 数量 + 高 API 调用次数），可以揭示攻击模式。 Correlation analysis detecting simultaneous anomalies (high latency + high tokens + high API calls) reveals attack patterns. 不计算相关性的系统会漏掉协同攻击信号。 Systems not computing correlations miss coordinated attack signals. 多智能体区别：对单智能体进行孤立监测会掩盖内部攻击的相关性；多智能体系统若不分析跨智能体指标的相关性，就会漏掉协同多智能体攻击，在此类攻击中，每个智能体的指标看似正常，但相关性会揭示攻击模式。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-agent isolation monitoring hides internal attack correlations; multi-agent systems not correlating metrics across agents miss coordinated multi-agent attacks where each agent’s metrics appear normal but correlation reveals attack patterns. [44, 1953, 367, 1954, 1955]. [44, 1953, 367, 1954, 1955].
RTM_6_30 - 历史基线过时导致假阴性。 RTM_6_30 - Historical Baseline Staleness Creating False Negatives. 系统上线时建立的效率基线会随着系统演进而过时。 Efficiency baselines established at launch become stale as systems evolve. 查询分布发生变化，模型行为出现漂移，运行模式发生转变。 Query distributions change, model behavior drifts, operational patterns shift. 基于过时基线设置的告警阈值无法发现效率下降。 Alert thresholds based on stale baselines miss efficiency degradation. 攻击者利用过时基线所依据的假设，造成渐进式漂移。 Attackers cause gradual drift exploiting stale baseline assumptions. 多智能体区别：单智能体的基线漂移较慢；在智能体之间共享基线的多智能体系统中，攻击者可以污染共享基线，使所有智能体的监控同时失效。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-agent baselines drift slowly; multi-agent systems where baselines are shared across agents enable attackers poisoning shared baselines causing all agents’ monitoring to become ineffective simultaneously. [264, 1956, 1957, 1898, 1275]. [264, 1956, 1957, 1898, 1275].
RTM_6_31 - 遥测处理延迟构成检测规避窗口。 RTM_6_31 - Telemetry Processing Latency as Detection Evasion Window. 效率遥测数据以异步方式收集和处理——事件被记录下来，数小时后才进行汇总和分析。 Efficiency telemetry is collected and processed asynchronously—events are logged, aggregated, and analyzed hours later. 攻击者利用处理滞后，以快于监控检测和响应的速度实施攻击。 Attackers exploit processing lag executing attacks faster than monitoring can detect and respond. 在监控分析识别出问题之前，实时攻击就已执行完毕。 Real-time attack execution finishes before monitoring analysis identifies the problem. 多智能体区别：单智能体的遥测处理存在检测滞后；在多智能体系统中，攻击若利用多个智能体的滞后，攻击者便可在分布式监控检测到异常之前，迅速触发协同故障。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-agent telemetry processing has detection lag; multi-agent systems where attacks exploit lag across multiple agents enable attackers triggering rapid coordinated failures before distributed monitoring detects anomalies. [1958, 1170, 124, 44]. [1958, 1170, 124, 44].
RTM_6_32 - 效率指标埋点覆盖缺口。 RTM_6_32 - Efficiency Metric Instrumentation Coverage Gaps. 并非所有操作都部署了用于效率监控的埋点。 Not all operations are instrumented for efficiency monitoring. 攻击者识别并利用未受监控的代码路径。 Attackers identify and exploit unmonitored code paths. 未受监控操作中的效率“优化”会逃过检测。 Efficiency ”optimizations” in unmonitored operations escape detection. 多智能体区别：单智能体的埋点缺口会造成局部盲区；在仅部署了部分埋点的多智能体系统中，攻击者可以针对操作缺少埋点的特定智能体发起攻击，而整体监控始终无法发现这些攻击。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-agent instrumentation gaps create local blind spots; multi-agent systems with partial instrumentation enable attackers targeting specific agents whose operations lack instrumentation, with attacks remaining invisible to overall monitoring. [70, 44, 1959, 1960, 1961]. [70, 44, 1959, 1960, 1961].
III-F7 RTM_7 - 基础设施与可观测性技术栈盲区III-F7 RTM_7 - Infrastructure and Observability Stack Blind Spots
RTM_7_1 - 多智能体调用中的工具行为归因丢失。 RTM_7_1 - Tool Behavior Attribution Loss in Multi-Agent Calls. 效率监控会跟踪工具调用，但在多智能体场景中，无法将工具行为归因于发起调用的智能体。 Efficiency monitoring tracks tool calls but loses attribution of tool behavior to originating agents in multi-agent scenarios. Agent B 调用的 Tool A 出现延迟骤增，但如果多个智能体都调用 Tool A，监控就无法判断此次骤增应归因于 Agent B 的使用还是 Agent C 的使用。 Tool A called by Agent B has latency spike, but if multiple agents call Tool A, monitoring cannot attribute the spike to Agent B’s usage vs. Agent C’s usage. 归因丢失会掩盖攻击。 Attribution loss obscures attacks. 多智能体区别：单智能体的工具调用归因明确；多智能体共享工具会造成归因歧义，使攻击者能够利用监控中的归因丢失。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-agent tool calling has clear attribution; multi-agent tool sharing creates attribution ambiguity enabling attackers exploiting monitoring attribution loss. [367, 14, 91, 46, 1439, 116, 1962, 1440, 1963, 1964, 1950, 1965, 1048, 1917, 1966, 88]. [367, 14, 91, 46, 1439, 116, 1962, 1440, 1963, 1964, 1950, 1965, 1048, 1917, 1966, 88].
RTM_7_2 - 消息队列消费者滞后掩盖智能体处理故障。 RTM_7_2 - Message Queue Consumer Lag Hiding Agent Processing Failures. RabbitMQ 提供消费者滞后量（待处理消息数），但高滞后量既可能表示高吞吐量，也可能表示处理故障。 RabbitMQ exposes consumer lag (messages pending), but high lag could indicate both high throughput and processing failures. 发生故障的智能体表现为高滞后量。 Agents with failures appear as high lag. 如果不按智能体细分滞后量，这一监控盲区就会导致无法识别哪些智能体发生了故障。 Without breaking down lag by agent, monitoring blind spot prevents identifying which agents fail. 多智能体情形的区别：单个智能体的消费滞后直接反映该智能体的性能。 Multi-agent distinction: Singular agent’s consumer lag directly maps to that agent’s performance. 多智能体共享队列使各个智能体的性能被掩盖在汇总滞后指标之中。 Multi-agent shared queues hide individual agent performance in aggregate lag metric. 智能体 A 可能处理失败，而智能体 B 处理成功，但汇总滞后指标无法区分这些情况，从而形成监控盲区，无法识别哪些智能体存在问题。 Agent A might fail processing while Agent B succeeds, but aggregate lag metric doesn’t distinguish, creating monitoring blind spot about which agents have issues. [116, 1963, 1967, 1968, 1969, 1970, 1440]. [116, 1963, 1967, 1968, 1969, 1970, 1440].
RTM_7_3 - 向量数据库查询延迟掩盖语义漂移。 RTM_7_3 - Vector Database Query Latency Hiding Semantic Drift. Weaviate 跟踪查询延迟，但不提供嵌入质量指标。 Weaviate tracks query latency but doesn’t expose embedding quality metrics. 当智能体检索到语义不正确的向量时，延迟指标仍显示正常，而内容质量却在下降。 Agents retrieving semantically incorrect vectors experience latency metric showing normal while content quality degrades. 这一监控盲区使系统无法检测到向量数据库损坏或索引过时导致的 RAG 结果语义漂移。 Monitoring blind spot prevents detecting semantic drift in RAG results due to vector database corruption or index staleness. 多智能体情形的区别：单个智能体的 RAG 查询延迟掩盖质量漂移，会形成局部盲区。 Multi-agent distinction: Singular agent’s RAG query latency hiding quality drift creates local blind spot. 在所有智能体共享同一向量数据库的多智能体系统中，某个智能体检测到的质量漂移可能不会在全局层面显现。 Multi-agent systems where all agents share vector database and one agent detects quality drift might not surface globally. 如果仅监控延迟指标，同时影响所有智能体 RAG 结果的语义漂移就无法被检测到，从而形成盲区：整个智能体群都在使用质量下降的 RAG 内容运行，而指标却看似正常。 Coordinated semantic drift affecting all agents’ RAG results goes undetected when monitoring only latency metrics, creating blind spot where entire agent fleet operates on degraded RAG content while metrics appear normal. [1971, 1362, 902, 1972, 1973]. [1971, 1362, 902, 1972, 1973].
RTM_7_4 - Prometheus 抓取成功率掩盖智能体级故障。 RTM_7_4 - Prometheus Scrape Success Rate Hiding Agent-Level Failures. Prometheus 跟踪抓取的成功或失败，但不跟踪哪些指标实际上有用。 Prometheus tracks scrape success/failure but not which metrics are actually useful. 智能体可能成功提供指标（抓取成功），但这些指标可能因智能体故障而不正确。 Agent might expose metrics successfully (scrape success) but metrics might be incorrect due to agent malfunction. 这一监控盲区使系统无法区分不可用的智能体（抓取失败）与运行异常的智能体（抓取成功，但数据有误）。 Monitoring blind spot prevents distinguishing between unavailable agents (failed scrape) and malfunctioning agents (successful scrape, bad data). 多智能体情形的区别：对单个智能体的指标抓取失败，明确表明该智能体发生了故障。 Multi-agent distinction: Singular agent scrape failure clearly indicates that agent failed. 在编排器从数十个智能体抓取指标的多智能体系统中，会形成盲区，无法判断哪些智能体确实在正常运行。 Multi-agent systems where orchestrator scrapes metrics from dozens of agents creates blindness about which agents are actually functioning. 智能体 A 可能在内部发生故障，但由于健康检查在故障发生前已作出响应，Prometheus 抓取仍然成功，从而形成监控盲区，使发生故障的智能体在群体中看起来仍然健康。 Agent A might fail internally while Prometheus scrape succeeds due to healthcheck responding before failure, creating monitoring blind spot where failed agent appears healthy in fleet. [116, 70, 242, 1974, 592, 1917, 277, 1955, 115, 818]. [116, 70, 242, 1974, 592, 1917, 277, 1955, 115, 818].
RTM_7_5 - API 网关请求成功率掩盖工具调用失败。 RTM_7_5 - API Gateway Request Success Rate Hiding Tool Invocation Failures. Kong 跟踪请求成功情况（HTTP 200），但不根据工具的实际行为细分成功情况。 Kong tracks request success (HTTP 200) but doesn’t break down success by actual tool behavior. 请求可能成功（HTTP 200），却返回表明工具执行失败的错误消息。 Request might succeed (HTTP 200) returning error message indicating tool failed. 这一监控盲区使系统无法区分请求成功但工具执行失败的情况与系统真正成功的情况。 Monitoring blind spot prevents distinguishing successful requests with failed tool outcomes from actual system success. 多智能体情形的区别：对单个智能体请求成功情况的跟踪可能捕捉到工具调用失败。 Multi-agent distinction: Singular agent request success tracking might capture tool failures. 在网关跟踪所有智能体总体成功率的多智能体系统中，会形成盲区——80% 的请求返回 HTTP 200，但 60% 的请求涉及工具调用失败，而这些失败在 HTTP 成功指标中不可见。 Multi-agent systems where gateway tracks aggregate success across all agents creates blindness—80% of requests return HTTP 200, but 60% involve tool failures invisible in HTTP success metric. 多智能体系统需要独立于网关成功指标的工具级可观测性。 Multi-agent systems need tool-level observability orthogonal to gateway success metrics. [116, 70, 387, 678, 93, 476, 1975, 1974, 39, 676]. [116, 70, 387, 678, 93, 476, 1975, 1974, 39, 676].
RTM_7_6 - MLflow 部署成功掩盖模型性能退化。 RTM_7_6 - MLflow Deployment Success Hiding Model Performance Regressions. MLflow 跟踪部署事件，但不跟踪已部署模型是否维持原有性能。 MLflow tracks deployment events but not whether deployed models maintain performance. 模型部署成功（部署事件成功），但性能低于上一版本。 Model deploys successfully (deployment event succeeds) but performs worse than previous version. 这一监控盲区使系统在用户受到影响之前无法检测到性能退化。 Monitoring blind spot prevents detecting performance regression until user impact appears. 多智能体情形的区别：对单个智能体部署成功情况的跟踪可能遗漏性能退化。 Multi-agent distinction: Singular agent deployment success tracking might miss regression. 为多个智能体部署模型的多智能体系统会形成集体盲区——模型同时部署到智能体 A、B、C，导致三者性能均下降，但部署指标却显示成功。 Multi-agent systems deploying models for multiple agents create collective blind spot—model deploys for Agent A, B, C simultaneously, degrading all three, but deployment metrics show success. 这一盲区使系统在所有智能体都受到影响之前无法检测到整个智能体群的性能退化，形成可见性缺口，使同时发生的性能下降看起来像是孤立问题。 Blind spot prevents detecting fleet-wide regression until all agents affected, creating visibility gap where coordinated degradation appears as isolated issue. [1976, 1977, 1978, 1979, 1980, 1981, 1982, 1983, 1984, 1985]. [1976, 1977, 1978, 1979, 1980, 1981, 1982, 1983, 1984, 1985].
RTM_7_7 - 消息队列吞吐量指标掩盖质量下降。 RTM_7_7 - Message Queue Throughput Metrics Hiding Quality Degradation. RabbitMQ 的吞吐量（消息数/秒）看起来非常出色，但消息可能格式错误或包含投毒内容。 RabbitMQ throughput (messages/second) appears excellent but messages might be malformed or contain poisoned content. 监控吞吐量指标会掩盖质量下降。 Monitoring throughput metric masks quality degradation. 智能体以高吞吐量处理被投毒的消息时，吞吐量指标仍表现良好，而内容质量却急剧恶化。 Agents processing high throughput of poisoned messages maintain strong throughput metrics while content quality collapses. 多智能体场景的区别：单个智能体的吞吐量掩盖质量下降，会造成局部问题。 Multi-agent distinction: Singular agent throughput hiding quality degradation creates local issue. 在多智能体共享队列中，大量被投毒的消息会造成整个智能体集群的盲区——所有消费者的吞吐量看起来都十分出色，而内容质量却普遍下降。 Multi-agent shared queues with poisoned high-volume messages create fleet-wide blind spot—throughput appears excellent across all consumers while content quality degrades uniformly. 由于缺乏逐条消息的质量跟踪，仅监控总体吞吐量无法发现所有智能体都在处理被投毒的内容。 Monitoring aggregate throughput prevents detecting that all agents process poisoned content because per-message quality tracking is absent. [1986, 1987, 1988, 1099, 87, 1989, 1976, 116, 737, 1990]. [1986, 1987, 1988, 1099, 87, 1989, 1976, 116, 737, 1990].
RTM_7_8 - Prometheus 告警抑制造成认知行为盲区。 RTM_7_8 - Prometheus Alert Suppression Creating Cognitive Behavior Blindness. Prometheus 告警机制会抑制重复告警或重复触发。 Prometheus alerts suppress duplicates/repeated firings. 当被抑制的告警仍表明问题持续存在时，依据告警是否出现来作出决策的智能体就会面临盲区。 Agents making decisions based on alert presence/absence face blind spot when suppressed alerts still indicate ongoing issues. 告警触发一次后，抑制机制会阻止其重复触发，但底层问题仍然存在。 Alert fires once, suppression prevents repeated firing, but underlying issue persists. 监控盲区：反复发生的问题看起来像是一次性事件。 Monitoring blind spot: recurring issue appears as one-time event. 多智能体场景的区别：单个智能体遗漏重复告警，会造成个体盲区。 Multi-agent distinction: Singular agent missing repeated alerts creates individual blind spot. 在编排器根据告警模式作出决策的多智能体系统中，会出现整个智能体集群的盲区——告警抑制阻止了重复警告，导致编排器误以为问题已经解决，而实际上抑制机制只是掩盖了问题的反复发生，从而使所有依赖该编排器的智能体持续出现有问题的行为。 Multi-agent systems where orchestrator makes decisions based on alert patterns face fleet-wide blind spot—alert suppression preventing repeated warnings causes orchestrators to assume issue resolved when suppression merely hides recurrence, leading to continued problematic behavior across all dependent agents. [1991, 177, 1992, 93, 1993, 1994, 1995, 43, 1996, 814, 44, 1997]. [1991, 177, 1992, 93, 1993, 1994, 1995, 43, 1996, 814, 44, 1997].
RTM_7_9 - API 网关速率配额耗尽掩盖工具超时问题。 RTM_7_9 - API Gateway Rate Limit Exhaustion Hiding Tool Timeout Issues. Kong 的限流机制看起来是因达到速率限制而拒绝请求，但实际上是底层工具发生了超时。 Kong rate limiting appears to be rejecting requests due to limits, but actually underlying tools are timing out. 限流响应掩盖了工具故障。 Rate limit response masks tool failure. 监控盲区：看起来是流量管理问题，实际上却是工具基础设施发生故障。 Monitoring blind spot: appears to be traffic management issue when actually tool infrastructure failing. 多智能体场景的区别：单个智能体的限流掩盖工具故障，会造成局部观测缺口。 Multi-agent distinction: Singular agent rate limiting hiding tool failures creates local observation gap. 在一次工具超时会影响多个智能体的多智能体系统中，会出现集体盲区——工具超时导致所有智能体的请求因限流而积压，使人误以为是速率限制问题，而非影响整个智能体集群的工具故障。 Multi-agent systems where one tool timeout affects many agents creates collective blind spot—tool times out, causes rate limit backlog for all agents, creates perception of rate limit issue rather than tool failure affecting entire fleet. 多智能体系统需要独立于网关限流指标的工具健康状况监测。 Multi-agent systems need tool health orthogonal to gateway rate limit metrics. [1998, 1963, 1999, 1967, 2000, 2001, 246, 676, 245, 1440]. [1998, 1963, 1999, 1967, 2000, 2001, 246, 676, 245, 1440].
RTM_7_10 - MLflow 指标聚合掩盖个别智能体的性能退化。 RTM_7_10 - MLflow Metrics Aggregation Hiding Individual Agent Regressions. MLflow 会聚合各个实验版本的指标，计算平均改进幅度。 MLflow aggregates metrics across experiment versions computing average improvement. 一项使 9 个智能体的性能提升 5%、使 1 个智能体的性能下降 95% 的实验，会显示出总体改进。 Experiment that improves 9 agents by 5% and degrades 1 agent by 95% shows aggregate improvement. 监控盲区：离群智能体的性能退化被掩盖。 Monitoring blind spot: hidden regression in outlier agent. 多智能体场景的区别：单个实验的结果能够清楚地显示个体性能。 Multi-agent distinction: Singular experiment results clearly show individual performance. 多智能体共用的 MLflow 聚合机制会造成盲区，使严重的性能退化隐藏在汇总统计数据中。 Multi-agent shared MLflow aggregation creates blind spot where severe regressions hide in aggregate statistics. 达到评估标准的聚合指标会掩盖个别智能体的性能下降，因此需要独立于汇总统计数据、支持下钻分析的可观测能力。 Aggregate metrics passing evaluation criteria mask individual agent degradation requiring drill-down observability orthogonal to summary statistics. RTM_7_30 - 性能剖析数据留存与取证缺口。 RTM_7_30 - Profiling Data Retention and Forensic Gaps. 由于存储限制，性能剖析（Nsight Systems）产生的详细执行轨迹通常只会短期保留。 Detailed execution traces from profiling (Nsight Systems) are typically retained briefly due to storage constraints. 在性能剖析期间发生的攻击可能会在早期轨迹中留下证据，但如果没有持续的性能剖析，就无法对历史事件进行取证。 Attacks happening during profiled periods might leave evidence in early traces, but historical forensics become impossible without continuous profiling. 采用间歇性性能剖析的多智能体系统会产生监控缺口，导致在性能剖析窗口之间发生的攻击无法被检测到。 Multi-agent systems with intermittent profiling create gaps where attacks occurring between profiling windows remain undetected. 多智能体场景的独特之处：持续性能剖析会产生难以承受的开销；在整个集群层面决定何时间歇性开展性能剖析的多智能体系统，为与性能剖析窗口同步的时机攻击创造了条件，使攻击发生在性能剖析时段之间。 Multi-agent distinction: Continuous profiling would create prohibitive overhead; multi-agent systems making intermittent profiling decisions at fleet level enable timing attacks synchronized to profiling windows where attacks occur between profiling periods. [2023, 2031, 2032, 2033, 2034]. [2023, 2031, 2032, 2033, 2034].
RTM_7_31 - 批处理不确定性掩盖推理延迟突增。 RTM_7_31 - Inference Latency Spikes Masked by Batching Indeterminism. 推理延迟异常检测会在 P95 延迟超过阈值时触发告警。 Anomaly detection on inference latency triggers alerts when P95 latency exceeds thresholds. 在多智能体 Triton 部署中，动态批处理造成的正常延迟波动（请求在不同时间到达，导致批次组成不同）会掩盖恶意延迟突增。 In multi-agent Triton deployments, legitimate latency variations from dynamic batching (requests arriving at different times producing different batch compositions) mask malicious latency spikes. 攻击者构造使延迟小幅增加的推理载荷，并将这种增加隐藏在正常的批处理波动之中。 Attackers craft inference payloads that marginally increase latency, hidden within normal batching variance. 与延迟模式可预测的单体部署不同，多智能体批处理的不确定性会产生监控盲区，使攻击隐藏在波动之中而不被检测到。 Unlike singular deployments with predictable latency patterns, multi-agent batching indeterminism creates monitoring blind spots where attacks remain undetected in variance. [2035, 2036, 2037, 2038, 2039]. [2035, 2036, 2037, 2038, 2039].
RTM_7_32 - 多智能体编排中的队列深度指标盲区。 RTM_7_32 - Queue Depth Metrics Blind Spot in Multi-Agent Orchestration. Triton 会报告每个模型的队列深度，但多智能体编排队列不可见。 Triton reports queue depth per model, but multi-agent orchestration queues are invisible. 智能体 A 将请求排队发送给智能体 B，后者再将请求加入 Triton 推理队列。 Agent A queues requests to Agent B, which queues to Triton inference. 监控只能看到 Triton 的队列深度，无法发现编排层面的排队情况，而攻击会在这一层面使上游智能体遭遇瓶颈。 Monitoring only sees Triton queue depth, missing orchestration-level queuing where attacks bottleneck upstream agents. 攻击者构造推理负载，使其表现为正常的 Triton 排队，但实际上却对应着只有通过多智能体工作流追踪才能发现的编排死锁。 Attackers craft inference loads that appear as healthy Triton queuing but represent orchestration deadlocks visible only through multi-agent workflow tracing. 与队列可观测的单体系统不同，多智能体系统存在聚合监控无法观测到的分布式排队。 Unlike singular systems with observable queues, multi-agent systems have distributed queuing blind to aggregate monitoring. [896, 612, 93, 69, 1892]. [896, 612, 93, 69, 1892].
RTM_7_33 - 错误率聚合掩盖多智能体故障模式。 RTM_7_33 - Error Rate Aggregation Masking Multi-Agent Failure Patterns. Prometheus 错误率指标会聚合所有副本和模型中的故障，而不区分故障来源。 Prometheus error rate metrics aggregate failures across all replicas and models without distinguishing failure sources. 在多智能体系统中，如果智能体 A 的错误率从 1% 上升到 2%，整个集群的错误率可能只会从 0.1% 上升到 0.15%，仍低于通常为 5% 的告警阈值。 In multi-agent systems, if Agent A’s errors increase from 1% to 2%, the fleet-wide error rate may increase from 0.1% to 0.15%, remaining below typical 5% alert thresholds. 攻击者构造针对特定智能体的攻击，这些攻击产生的信号在整个集群层面聚合后便难以察觉。 Attackers craft attacks targeting specific agents that aggregate to invisible fleet-wide signals. 与错误率能直接反映问题的单体系统不同，多智能体聚合会造成监控盲区，使分布式攻击无法被察觉。 Unlike singular systems where error rates directly indicate problems, multi-agent aggregation creates monitoring blindness where distributed attacks remain invisible. [2040, 2041, 2042]. [2040, 2041, 2042].
RTM_7_34 - 多智能体吞吐量分析中词元生成指标的缺失。 RTM_7_34 - Token Generation Metrics Absence in Multi-Agent Throughput Analysis. NIM（NVIDIA 推理微服务，NVIDIA Inference Microservice）和 Triton 的指标会报告每秒请求数，但不报告每秒生成的词元数。 NIM (NVIDIA Inference Microservice) and Triton metrics report requests per second but not tokens generated per second. 在智能体 A 调用智能体 B、且智能体 B 生成可变长度响应（10 个词元与 1000 个词元）的多智能体系统中，吞吐量指标会掩盖实际计算负载。 In multi-agent systems where Agent A calls Agent B which generates variable-length responses (10 tokens vs. 1000 tokens), throughput metrics hide actual computational load. 攻击者构造仅生成极少词元的提示，使其表现为高吞吐量，而计算开销高昂的操作则表现为低吞吐量。 Attackers craft prompts generating minimal tokens appearing as high throughput, while computationally expensive operations appear as low throughput. 与词元指标可直接观测的单体部署不同，多智能体系统缺乏词元级粒度，使攻击者能够利用吞吐量指标的盲区。 Unlike singular deployments where token metrics are directly observable, multi-agent systems lack token-level granularity enabling attackers to exploit throughput metric blind spots. [2043, 2044, 216, 2045, 2046]. [2043, 2044, 216, 2045, 2046].
RTM_7_35 - 标准监控缺乏跨智能体关联分析。 RTM_7_35 - Cross-Agent Correlation Absent from Standard Monitoring. Prometheus 和 Kubernetes 指标按服务分别采集，缺少跨服务关联分析仪表板。 Prometheus and Kubernetes metrics are collected per-service without cross-service correlation dashboards. 在多智能体系统中，攻击者会利用时间相关性，例如智能体 A 的突增与智能体 B 的故障相关联，表明攻击正在传播。 In multi-agent systems, attackers exploit temporal correlation where Agent A’s spike correlates with Agent B’s failure, indicating attack propagation. 标准监控能够显示单个突增或故障，却无法捕捉攻击传播模式。 Standard monitoring shows individual spike/failure, missing attack propagation pattern. 与只有单一时间线的独立部署不同，多智能体系统需要进行分布式关联分析，才能检测协同攻击。 Unlike singular deployments with single timeline, multi-agent systems require distributed correlation enabling detection of coordinated attacks. 大多数监控技术栈缺乏原生的多智能体关联分析能力，由此形成盲区，使分布式攻击表现为彼此独立的服务问题，而非协同攻击行动。 Most monitoring stacks lack native multi-agent correlation, creating blind spots where distributed attacks manifest as independent service issues rather than coordinated campaigns. [2047, 1858]. [2047, 1858].
RTM_7_36 - GPU 遥测不足以检测基于量化的攻击。 RTM_7_36 - GPU Telemetry Insufficient for Detecting Quantization-Based Attacks. Fleet Command 的监控会收集标准 GPU 指标（利用率 %、内存使用量、温度）。 Fleet Command’s monitoring collects standard GPU metrics (utilization %, memory usage, temperature). 这些指标无法揭示 GPU 计算内部悄然发生的量化损坏、精度损失传播或 KV 缓存投毒。 These metrics don’t reveal quantization corruption, precision loss propagation, or KV cache poisoning which occur silently within GPU computations. 基于量化的指令注入攻击在推进过程中不会触发 GPU 遥测告警，因为从 GPU 的视角来看，该攻击在计算层面是正常的。 A quantization-based instruction injection attack progresses without triggering GPU telemetry alerts because the attack is computationally normal from GPU-perspective view. 多智能体场景的区别：单智能体监控只有一条遥测数据流；多智能体 Fleet Command 监控会聚合来自 500+ 个边缘位置的指标，从而形成 N 个彼此独立的盲区，使攻击能够在整个多智能体系统中持续推进而不被发现。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-agent monitoring has one telemetry stream; multi-agent Fleet Command monitoring aggregates metrics from 500+ edge locations creating N independent blind spots where attacks progress undetected across the entire multi-agent system. [2048, 2049, 2050, 1021]. [2048, 2049, 2050, 1021].
RTM_7_37 - 不检查二进制文件就无法检测引擎元数据漂移。 RTM_7_37 - Engine Metadata Drift Undetectable Without Binary Inspection. TensorRT 引擎是不透明的二进制文件，运行时无法查看其内部操作。 TensorRT engines are opaque binaries without runtime visibility into their internal operations. Fleet Command 的监控无法检测缓存引擎是否因文件系统篡改或静默损坏而偏离预期状态。 Fleet Command’s monitoring cannot detect if a cached engine has drifted from expected state through file system tampering or silent corruption. 如果缓存引擎被修改，除非显式验证二进制文件的哈希值，否则标准遥测无法发现这些修改。 If cached engines are modified, the modifications are invisible to standard telemetry unless binary hashes are explicitly validated. 多智能体场景的区别：可以通过定期计算哈希值来监控单智能体的引擎完整性；而具有 500+ 个缓存引擎的多智能体 Fleet Command 会使持续的二进制文件验证产生运维负担，导致大规模引擎篡改检测难以实施。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-agent engine integrity can be monitored with periodic hashing; multi-agent Fleet Command with 500+ cached engines creates operational burden for continuous binary validation, making engine tampering detection impractical at scale. [1021, 121, 2051, 186]. [1021, 121, 2051, 186].
RTM_7_38 - 缺乏量化伪影遥测。 RTM_7_38 - Quantization Artifact Telemetry Absence. Fleet Command 缺乏针对量化专用指标的遥测，例如激活值范围分布、逐层精度损失或量化误差累积。 Fleet Command lacks telemetry for quantization-specific metrics like activation range distribution, per-layer precision loss, or quantization error accumulation. 这些认知指标对于检测基于量化的攻击至关重要，但标准监控并不收集它们。 These cognitive metrics are essential for detecting quantization-based attacks but are not collected by standard monitoring. 利用量化的攻击者不会造成 GPU 层面的异常（功耗、温度、利用率），因此始终无法被 Fleet Command 的遥测发现。 Attackers exploiting quantization create no GPU-level anomalies (power, temperature, utilization), remaining invisible to Fleet Command’s telemetry. 多智能体场景的区别：单智能体系统可以为各个智能体添加量化监控；多智能体 Fleet Command 的遥测则无法观察所有智能体的量化情况，从而对整类攻击形成系统性的监控盲区。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-agent systems could add per-agent quantization monitoring; multi-agent Fleet Command telemetry lacks quantization visibility across all agents, creating systematic monitoring blind spot for an entire attack class. [2052, 125, 587, 2053, 2054]. [2052, 125, 587, 2053, 2054].
RTM_7_39 - 跨智能体协调时序盲区。 RTM_7_39 - Cross-Agent Coordination Timing Blind Spots. Fleet Command 监控不跟踪智能体之间的通信延迟或协调时序。 Fleet Command monitoring doesn’t track inter-agent communication latency or coordination timing. 当智能体 A 的输出成为智能体 B 的输入时，监控能够看到每个智能体各自的延迟，却无法看到跨智能体的时序模式。 When Agent A’s output becomes Agent B’s input, monitoring sees each agent’s individual latency but not the cross-agent timing patterns. 攻击者可以利用内核时序或 KV 缓存损坏，在智能体 A 中制造特定的延迟模式，这些模式传播至智能体 B 时会触发恶意行为。 An attacker exploiting kernel timing or KV cache corruption can create specific latency patterns in Agent A that, when propagated to Agent B, trigger malicious behavior. 逐智能体监控无法发现这些跨智能体时序攻击。 These cross-agent timing attacks are invisible in per-agent monitoring. 多智能体场景的区别：单个智能体不存在跨智能体时序；多智能体协调会产生时序窗口，使攻击能够跨越智能体边界传播，而不被单个智能体的遥测发现。 Multi-agent distinction: Single agents have no cross-agent timing; multi-agent coordination creates timing windows where attacks propagate through agent boundaries undetected by individual-agent telemetry. [210, 124, 447, 1045, 1958]. [210, 124, 447, 1045, 1958].
RTM_7_40 - 模型更新验证中的遥测缺口。 RTM_7_40 - Model Update Validation Telemetry Gaps. Fleet Command 通过在更新后检查推理功能来监控部署的健康状况。 Fleet Command monitors deployment health by checking inference functionality post-update. 然而，这些健康检查无法检测量化引擎中的潜伏后门——只要后门尚未被触发，植入后门的引擎就能通过功能健康检查。 However, these health checks cannot detect latent backdoors in quantized engines—a backdoored engine passes functionality health checks if the backdoor hasn’t been triggered. 只要基本推理功能正常，即使模型被植入后门，遥测也会显示“部署成功”。 The telemetry shows ”deployment successful” even for backdoored models as long as basic inference works. 部署后遥测无法发现 TensorRT 引擎中的潜伏后门。 Latent backdoors in TensorRT engines are invisible to post-deployment telemetry. 多智能体场景的区别：单智能体部署只需验证一个智能体的健康状况；多智能体 Fleet Command 部署则需同时验证 500 个位置的健康状况，由此产生的资源限制阻碍了全面的潜伏后门检测，使植入后门的引擎能够在整个集群中通过验证。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-agent deployments need only verify one agent’s health; multi-agent Fleet Command deployments validate health across 500 locations simultaneously, creating resource constraints that prevent comprehensive latent backdoor detection, enabling backdoored engines to pass validation across the entire fleet. [2055, 2056, 2057, 587, 2058]. [2055, 2056, 2057, 587, 2058].
RTM_7_41 - 负载均衡器路由指标掩盖智能体层面的行为。 RTM_7_41 - Load Balancer Routing Metrics Obscuring Agent-Level Behavior. 负载均衡器层面的监控能够显示汇总的流量分布，却会掩盖单个智能体的行为。 Monitoring at load balancer level shows aggregate traffic distribution but obscures individual agent behavior. 影响某个副本的攻击可能无法在汇总指标中显现。 Attacks affecting one replica might be invisible in aggregate metrics. 多智能体系统需要智能体层面的监控，以防止负载均衡器的聚合掩盖异常。 Multi-agent systems require agent-level monitoring preventing load balancer aggregation from hiding anomalies. 多智能体场景的区别：单智能体监控在智能体层面进行；负载均衡系统则跨副本聚合数据，从而在逐智能体监控中造成盲区。 Multi-agent distinction: Single agent monitoring is agent-level; load-balanced systems aggregate across replicas creating blind spots in per-agent monitoring. [912, 911, 116, 2059, 793]. [912, 911, 116, 2059, 793].
RTM_7_42 - 批处理掩盖工具调用模式。 RTM_7_42 - Batching Obscuring Tool Invocation Patterns. 批次内调用的工具不会在请求日志中呈现各自的调用模式。 Tools invoked within batches don’t show individual invocation patterns in request logs. 危险的工具调用序列可能隐藏在批处理中。 Dangerous tool sequences can be hidden within batch processing. 监控必须在批次成员层面跟踪工具调用，而不能仅在批次层面进行跟踪。 Monitoring must track tool invocations at batch member level not just batch level. 多智能体场景的区别：未采用批处理的工具调用可以直接观测；批处理则会掩盖调用模式，因此需要深入监控批次内部。 Multi-agent distinction: Unbatched tool invocations are directly observable; batching creates pattern obscurity requiring deep batch-internal monitoring. [69, 1045, 2002, 45]. [69, 1045, 2002, 45].
RTM_7_43 - 缓存造成命中与未命中的监控盲区。 RTM_7_43 - Caching Creating Hit/Miss Monitoring Blind Spots. 由缓存响应的查询不会调用底层工具或检索增强生成（RAG）流水线，因此在工具调用监控中不可见。 Cached queries don’t invoke underlying tools or RAG pipelines becoming invisible in tool invocation monitoring. 当智能体的查询命中缓存而未调用工具时，即使该工具此前实际上已被调用，监控中仍会显示为“未使用工具”。 An agent querying cache hits but doesn’t invoke tools appears as ”no tool usage” when actually tool was previously invoked. 缓存会造成工具调用的可观测性缺口。 Caching creates tool invocation observability gaps. 多智能体场景的区别：新发起的查询会清晰呈现工具调用；缓存则使工具执行不可见，降低监控的保真度。 Multi-agent distinction: Fresh queries show tool invocations clearly; caching creates invisible tool execution reducing monitoring fidelity. [85, 70, 122, 920, 176]. [85, 70, 122, 920, 176].
RTM_7_44 - 负载均衡器的会话亲和性掩盖跨副本攻击传播。 RTM_7_44 - Load Balancer Session Affinity Hiding Cross-Replica Attack Propagation. IP 哈希路由将会话限制在单个副本上，从而掩盖跨副本通信。 IP hash routing confines sessions to single replicas hiding cross-replica communication. 如果恶意软件通过负载均衡器的路由传播，那么路由过程本身在各副本的日志中便不可见。 If malware propagates through load balancer routing, the routing itself becomes invisible in per-replica logs. 多智能体场景的区别：智能体之间的直接通信可以被观测；负载均衡器的中介作用则将传播过程隐藏在路由决策中。 Multi-agent distinction: Direct inter-agent communication is observable; load balancer mediation hides propagation in routing decisions. [532, 69, 70]. [532, 69, 70].
RTM_7_45 - 自动扩缩容的配置盲区。 RTM_7_45 - Auto-Scaling Configuration Blind Spots. 自动扩缩容会添加新副本，其配置可能与受监控的现有实例集群不同。 Auto-scaling adds new replicas with potentially different configurations than monitored fleet. 新副本的监控设置、日志记录和遥测机制都可能不同。 New replicas might have different monitoring setup, different logging, different telemetry. 随着实例集群规模扩大，这会造成监控覆盖缺口。 This creates monitoring coverage gaps as fleet grows. 多智能体场景的区别：静态实例集群具有一致的监控；自动扩缩容则会引入覆盖范围的不一致，导致无法全面掌握遥测数据。 Multi-agent distinction: Static fleets have consistent monitoring; auto-scaling introduces coverage inconsistency preventing complete telemetry visibility. [70, 829, 507]. [70, 829, 507].
RTM_7_46 - 动态负载均衡器指标投毒影响可观测性。 RTM_7_46 - Dynamic Load Balancer Metrics Poisoning Affecting Observability. 动态负载均衡器会暴露用于指导路由决策的指标。 Dynamic load balancers expose metrics guiding routing decisions. 攻击者对这些指标投毒，会使观测结果产生误导。 Attackers poisoning these metrics create misleading observability. 依赖负载均衡器指标的监控系统会因指标投毒而受到污染。 Monitoring systems relying on load balancer metrics become corrupted by metric poisoning. 多智能体场景的区别：不使用负载均衡器指标的系统不会受到此类指标投毒的影响；动态路由暴露指标则会形成破坏可观测性的攻击面。 Multi-agent distinction: Systems without load balancer metrics aren’t vulnerable to metric poisoning; dynamic routing’s metric exposure creates observability corruption attack surface. [1955, 1905, 912, 1046]. [1955, 1905, 912, 1046].
RTM_7_47 - 流式响应的监控复杂性。 RTM_7_47 - Streaming Response Monitoring Complexity. 批处理场景中的流式响应会造成复杂的监控情形，其中批次边界与响应边界并不一致。 Streaming responses in batched contexts create complex monitoring scenarios where batch boundaries don’t align with response boundaries. 监控必须跨流式传输窗口跟踪部分响应，这使得难以将响应明确归属于各个请求。 Monitoring must track partial responses across streaming windows preventing clear per-request attribution. 多智能体场景的区别：原子性的批次响应具有明确的边界；流式传输则会增加时间维度上的监控复杂性，需要精细的日志关联分析。 Multi-agent distinction: Atomic batch responses are clearly bounded; streaming creates temporal monitoring complexity requiring sophisticated log correlation. [845, 69, 2060, 813]. [845, 69, 2060, 813].
RTM_7_48 - 分布式批处理中成本遥测归属的不透明性。 RTM_7_48 - Cost Telemetry Attribution Opacity in Distributed Batching. 批处理将成本分摊到批次成员，但要将成本归属于各个智能体则变得复杂。 Batching distributes cost across batch members but cost attribution to individual agents becomes complex. 一个批次中，哪个智能体消耗了多少成本？ Which agent consumed how much cost within a batch? 这种不透明性使智能体能够将高成本操作隐藏在批次中。 This opacity enables agents hiding expensive operations within batches. 多智能体区别：单智能体的成本可直接归属；分布式批处理使成本归属不透明，可被利用来掩盖经济活动。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-agent costs are directly attributed; distributed batching creates cost attribution opacity exploitable for economic obfuscation. [2061, 117, 2062]. [2061, 117, 2062].
III-F8 RTM_8 - 推理与认知状态监测III-F8 RTM_8 - Reasoning and Cognitive State Monitoring
RTM_8_1 - 通过推理变异规避异常检测。 RTM_8_1 - Reasoning mutation defeating anomaly detection. 思维链（Chain-of-Thought，CoT）轨迹可以被巧妙地修改（在保留含义的同时改写步骤），使基于模式的检测变得困难。 CoT (Chain-of-Thought) traces can be subtly modified (rewording steps while preserving meaning) making pattern-based detection difficult. 攻击者将恶意推理轨迹中的“禁用审计日志记录”修改为“降低审计日志的详细程度”，同时保留攻击意图。 An attacker modifies a malicious reasoning trace from ”disable audit logging” to ”reduce audit verbosity” while preserving attack intent. 监测系统无法检测出这种语义等价性。 Monitoring systems cannot detect the semantic equivalence. 多智能体区别：单智能体行为监测跟踪确切的输出；在多智能体系统中，对多个智能体的 CoT 推理进行监测时，难以应对同一攻击的不同语义表述，因为基于句法的检测无法识别这些变体。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-agent behavior monitoring tracks exact outputs; multi-agent systems monitoring CoT reasoning across multiple agents struggle with semantic variations of the same attack being invisible to syntactic detection. [2063, 2064, 1285, 2065]. [2063, 2064, 1285, 2065].
RTM_8_2 - 分布式推理中协同意图的不可见性。 RTM_8_2 - Coordination intent invisibility in distributed reasoning. 当多个智能体的推理只能被分别查看时，跨智能体的协同攻击模式仍然不可见。 When multiple agents’ reasoning is only visible separately, the coordinated attack pattern across agents remains invisible. 智能体 A 的推理看似无害，智能体 B 的推理也看似无害，但两者结合起来却会执行攻击。 Agent A’s reasoning looks benign, Agent B’s looks benign, but their combination executes an attack. 逐一分析推理轨迹的监测系统会漏检协同攻击。 Monitoring systems analyzing reasoning traces individually miss the coordination attack. 多智能体区别：单智能体监测可以在一条推理轨迹中看到完整意图；多智能体系统无法看到分散在多个智能体推理轨迹中的协同意图。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-agent monitoring can see the complete intent in one reasoning trace; multi-agent systems cannot see coordinated intent distributed across multiple agents’ reasoning traces. [44, 753, 809, 18]. [44, 753, 809, 18].
RTM_8_3 - 推理状态混淆。 RTM_8_3 - Reasoning state obfuscation. 智能体可以通过不同的推理结构表达相同的底层决策，使行为比较变得困难。 Agents can express the same underlying decision through different reasoning structures, making behavior comparison difficult. 两个智能体通过不同的推理路径得出相同的（已遭篡改的）决策，在监测系统看来却表现得不一致，而监测工具无法确定它们是否等价。 Two agents reaching identical (compromised) decisions through different reasoning paths appear inconsistent to monitoring systems, but monitoring tools cannot determine if they’re equivalent. 多智能体区别：单智能体的推理一致性检查较为直接；多智能体系统在检查不同智能体推理结构之间的一致性时，会面临语义匹配问题。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-agent reasoning consistency checking is straightforward; multi-agent systems checking consistency across different agents’ reasoning structures face semantic matching problems. [2066, 2067, 1477, 2068, 2063]. [2066, 2067, 1477, 2068, 2063].
RTM_8_4 - 元推理盲点。 RTM_8_4 - Meta-reasoning blind spot. 智能体可能在其轨迹中包含关于推理本身的推理，从而形成监测系统无法解析的递归结构。 Agents may include reasoning-about-reasoning in their traces, creating recursive structures that monitoring systems cannot parse. 智能体可能作出这样的推理：“我不会透露我关于工具选择的推理”，从而使工具选择分析不可见。 An agent might reason ”I will not reveal my reasoning about tool selection,” making tool-selection analysis invisible. 多智能体区别：单个智能体无法从向监测系统隐藏推理中获益；在多智能体系统中，一个智能体隐藏的推理若会影响其他智能体的行为，就会在端到端监测中造成盲点。 Multi-agent distinction: Single agents don’t benefit from hiding reasoning from monitoring; multi-agent systems where one agent’s hidden reasoning affects other agents’ behavior create blind spots in end-to-end monitoring. [116, 2069, 1859, 1277, 2063]. [116, 2069, 1859, 1277, 2063].
RTM_8_5 - 协同中的推理延迟侧信道。 RTM_8_5 - Reasoning latency sidechannels in coordination. 生成和检索推理轨迹时的时间延迟编码了有关智能体状态的信息。 Time delays in generating and retrieving reasoning traces encode information about agent state. 攻击者通过观察推理时序的变化，推断攻击何时成功。 Attackers infer when attacks succeeded by observing reasoning timing changes. 只监测延迟而不分析推理内容，会漏掉这些侧信道。 Monitoring latency without analyzing reasoning content misses these sidechannels. 多智能体区别：单智能体的推理延迟是独立的；在多智能体系统中，智能体相互等待对方的推理，会形成协同的延迟模式，从而泄露攻击进展。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-agent reasoning latency is independent; multi-agent systems where agents wait for each other’s reasoning create coordinated latency patterns revealing attack progress. [447, 124, 199, 2070, 488]. [447, 124, 199, 2070, 488].
RTM_8_6 - 通过 ToT 搜索模式分析实现行为预测。 RTM_8_6 - ToT search pattern analysis enabling behavior prediction. 遥测系统记录的思维树（Tree of Thoughts，ToT）搜索模式（探索了哪些分支、评估分数、回溯决策），使攻击者能够对智能体的决策逻辑进行逆向工程，并预测其未来计划。 Telemetry systems logging ToT (Tree of Thoughts) search patterns (which branches explored, evaluation scores, backtracking decisions) enable attackers to reverse-engineer agent decision logic and predict future plans. 多智能体区别：多智能体 ToT 系统会生成涵盖所有智能体搜索活动的遥测数据；单智能体的模式仅限于局部，对智能体行为进行逆向工程的价值较低。 Multi-agent distinction: Multi-agent ToT systems generate telemetry across all agents’ search activities; single-agent patterns are localized and less valuable for reverse-engineering agent behavior. [2071, 1859, 2072, 879, 835]. [2071, 1859, 2072, 879, 835].
RTM_8_7 - 已保存路径的插桩盲点。 RTM_8_7 - Preserved Path Instrumentation Blind Spots. 某些推理框架会保存路径，以供后续检索。 Some reasoning frameworks preserve paths for later retrieval. 这些已保存路径可能未像实时推理执行那样接受相同的遥测数据采集，从而造成监测盲点。 These preserved paths may not be subject to the same telemetry collection as real-time reasoning execution, creating monitoring blind spots. 如果路径保存过程未进行插桩，那么后续对已保存路径的检索和使用仍然对监测系统不可见。 If path preservation happens without instrumentation, subsequent retrieval and use of preserved paths remains invisible to monitoring systems. 在由下游智能体检索并执行已保存路径的多智能体系统中，执行路径缺少将执行过程与原始生成过程关联起来的遥测数据。 In multi-agent systems where preserved paths are retrieved and executed by downstream agents, the execution path lacks telemetry linking execution to original generation. 多智能体区别：单智能体的路径保留监测机制仍处于一个智能体的监控范围内；在多智能体中，跨智能体边界使用已保留路径会产生盲点，使上游智能体保留的路径在下游智能体中的执行情况不可见。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-agent path preservation instrumentation remains within one agent’s monitoring scope; multi-agent preserved path usage across agent boundaries creates blind spots where downstream agent execution of upstream’s preserved paths lacks visibility. [73, 138, 723, 859, 72]. [73, 138, 723, 859, 72].
RTM_8_8 - 多路径推理遥测聚合盲点。 RTM_8_8 - Multi-Path Reasoning Telemetry Aggregation Blind Spots. Self-Consistency 生成 k 条推理链；遥测系统可能会聚合这些链，而不是保留各条路径的可见性。 Self-Consistency generates k reasoning chains; telemetry systems might aggregate these chains rather than preserving individual path visibility. 如果遥测报告为“生成了 40 条推理链，35 条收敛于答案 A，5 条收敛于答案 B”，就无法看出哪些路径包含注入的指令。 If telemetry reports ”40 reasoning chains generated, 35 converged on answer A, 5 on answer B,” the visibility into which paths contained injected instructions is lost. 攻击者利用聚合遥测来隐藏特定路径中的异常。 Attackers exploit aggregated telemetry to hide path-specific anomalies. 在对多个智能体的 Self-Consistency 采样进行聚合的多智能体遥测系统中，单条路径的异常会消失在聚合指标中。 In multi-agent telemetry systems aggregating across multiple agents’ Self-Consistency sampling, individual path anomalies disappear in aggregated metrics. 多智能体区别：单智能体的路径聚合仍处于一个智能体的遥测范围内；在多智能体聚合遥测中，多个智能体的路径混合在聚合指标中，会产生掩盖单个智能体异常的盲点。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-agent path aggregation remains within one agent’s telemetry; multi-agent aggregated telemetry where multiple agents’ paths mix in aggregated metrics creates blind spots hiding individual agent anomalies. [1477, 2067, 2063, 1098, 2073]. [1477, 2067, 2063, 1098, 2073].
RTM_8_9 - 安全监控中的质量评分指标盲点。 RTM_8_9 - Quality Score Metric Blind Spots in Safety Monitoring. 多路径推理系统使用连贯性、忠实性和任务相关性等自定义质量指标。 Custom quality metrics such as coherence, faithfulness, and task relevance are used in multi-path reasoning systems. 如果安全监控只关注输出内容，而不检查质量评分方法，就无法发现恶意抬高质量评分的行为。 If safety monitoring focuses on output content without examining quality scoring methodology, malicious quality score inflation remains undetected. 质量评分遭到篡改的路径在监控中会显得正常，因为其表面质量很高。 Paths with compromised quality scores appear legitimate in monitoring because quality appears high. 在聚合多个智能体质量指标的多智能体安全监控中，单个智能体质量指标遭到篡改的情况会变得不可见。 In multi-agent safety monitoring aggregating across quality metrics from multiple agents, individual agent quality metric compromise becomes invisible. 多智能体区别：单智能体的质量指标监控可以聚焦于一个智能体的评分方法；采用异构质量指标的多智能体系统会产生盲点，使针对单个智能体的指标操纵消失在跨智能体指标聚合中。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-agent quality metric monitoring can focus on one agent’s methodology; multi-agent systems with heterogeneous quality metrics create blind spots where individual agent metric manipulation disappears in cross-agent metric aggregation. [2074, 2075, 781, 2076]. [2074, 2075, 781, 2076].
RTM_8_10 - 采样参数监控盲点。 RTM_8_10 - Sampling Parameter Monitoring Blind Spots. 多路径采样系统针对不同问题类别进行细致的参数调优。 Multi-path sampling systems use detailed parameter tuning for different problem classes. 如果监控不跟踪每次执行所使用的参数，就无法观察到不同的参数配置。 If monitoring doesn’t track which parameters were used for each execution, different parameter regimes remain invisible to monitoring. 某种攻击在 k=8 temperature=0.7 时成功，但在 k=20 temperature=0.3 时失败，如果未记录参数条件，就会形成监控盲点。 An attack succeeding with k=8 temperature=0.7 but failing with k=20 temperature=0.3 creates monitoring blind spot if parameter conditions aren’t logged. 在各智能体采用不同参数调优方案的多智能体系统中，聚合监控无法看出哪些智能体使用了存在漏洞的参数。 In multi-agent systems where parameter tuning varies per agent, aggregate monitoring loses visibility into which agents use vulnerable parameters. 多智能体区别：单智能体的参数监控可以聚焦于一个智能体的调优方案；采用异构参数配置的多智能体系统会产生盲点，使单个智能体的参数漏洞在聚合监控中变得不可见。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-agent parameter monitoring can focus on one agent’s tuning; multi-agent systems with heterogeneous parameter configurations create blind spots where individual agent parameter vulnerabilities become invisible in aggregate monitoring. [1336, 447, 1329, 2077]. [1336, 447, 1329, 2077].
RTM_8_11 - 投票机制不透明导致的置信度评分监控盲点。 RTM_8_11 - Confidence Score Monitoring Blind Spots From Voting Mechanism Opacity. 在自一致性（self-consistency）方法中，多数投票决定置信度：80% 的一致率被视为高置信度。 In self-consistency approaches, majority voting determines confidence: 80% agreement is treated as high confidence. 如果监控系统仅接收最终置信度评分，而无法查看投票分布，就无法了解共识的强度。 If monitoring systems receive only final confidence scores without visibility into voting distribution, monitoring loses understanding of consensus strength. 80% 的得票率（4/5 一致）和 100% 的得票率（5/5 一致）都会被报告为高置信度，但二者的稳健性不同。 An 80% vote (4/5 agreement) and 100% vote (5/5 agreement) both report high confidence but have different robustness. 攻击者可以操纵投票，使薄弱共识产生高置信度输出。 Attackers can game voting to produce high-confidence outputs from weak consensus. 在报告置信度却不提供投票细节的多智能体系统中，监控无法了解共识质量。 In multi-agent systems reporting confidence without voting detail, monitoring loses visibility into consensus quality. 多智能体区别：单智能体投票不透明意味着一个智能体的置信度缺乏细节；跨智能体聚合置信度的多智能体系统会产生盲点，使投票细节在置信度传播过程中完全丢失。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-agent voting opacity means one agent’s confidence lacks detail; multi-agent systems aggregating confidence across agents create blind spots where voting detail becomes completely lost in confidence propagation. [2078, 323, 1922, 2079, 612]. [2078, 323, 1922, 2079, 612].
RTM_8_12 - 整合记忆使用监控盲点。 RTM_8_12 - Consolidated Memory Usage Monitoring Blind Spots. 记忆整合将多条独立推理轨迹合并为单一共识输出，以供检索。 Memory consolidation merges multiple independent reasoning traces into a single consensus output for retrieval. 如果监控只关注整合记忆的检索，而无法查看访问了哪些整合后的要点及其访问时间，使用模式就会被隐藏。 If monitoring focuses on retrieval of consolidated memory without visibility into which consolidated points were accessed and when, usage patterns remain hidden. 如果监控无法观察整合记忆的访问模式，利用整合记忆后门的攻击者就可能不会产生异常遥测数据。 Attackers exploiting consolidated memory backdoors might not generate anomalous telemetry if monitoring is blind to consolidation access patterns. 在共享整合记忆的多智能体系统中，如果监控不跟踪整合层面的访问，跨智能体的访问模式就会变得不可见。 In multi-agent systems sharing consolidated memory, access patterns across agents become invisible if monitoring doesn’t track consolidation-level access. 多智能体区别：单智能体对整合记忆的访问仍处于一个智能体的记忆范围内；如果缺少整合层面的监控，多智能体对整合记忆的跨智能体访问模式就会变得不可见。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-agent consolidation access remains within one agent’s memory; multi-agent consolidated memory access patterns across agents become invisible if consolidation-level monitoring is absent. [73, 138, 72, 393, 472]. [73, 138, 72, 393, 472].
RTM_8_13 - 多智能体交接中的流式响应监控盲点。 RTM_8_13 - Streaming Response Monitoring Blind Spots in Multi-Agent Handoffs. 使用流式响应的自一致性方法需要考虑延迟问题。 Self-consistency approaches using streaming responses introduce latency considerations. 如果监控仅捕获最终输出，而不捕获流式传输层面的细节，那么通过流式交接（智能体 A 向智能体 B 进行流式传输）实施的指令注入就会保持隐蔽。 If monitoring captures only final outputs without streaming-level detail, instruction injection through streaming handoffs (Agent A streams to Agent B) remains hidden. 影响智能体之间实时交接的流中注入会造成遥测盲区。 Mid-stream injection affecting real-time handoffs between agents creates telemetry blind spots. 在采用实时流式协作的多智能体系统中，对交接边界的监控至关重要，但这种监控可能并不存在。 In multi-agent systems with real-time streaming coordination, monitoring at handoff boundaries becomes critical but may be absent. 多智能体特有之处：单智能体的流式监控始终局限于同一智能体内部；多智能体的流式交接会产生盲区，其中位于智能体边界的注入点缺乏监测设施。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-agent streaming monitoring remains within one agent; multi-agent streaming handoffs create blind spots where injection points at agent boundaries lack instrumentation. [408, 1058, 1852, 69, 2060]. [408, 1058, 1852, 69, 2060].
RTM_8_14 - 多智能体层级结构中的分解轨迹日志记录缺口。 RTM_8_14 - Decomposition Trace Logging Gaps in Multi-Agent Hierarchies. HTN（层次任务网络，Hierarchical Task Network）规划系统应记录分解轨迹（为每个目标选择了哪些方法、应用了哪些约束、最终形成了何种顺序），以支持监控和调试。 HTN (Hierarchical Task Network) planning systems should log decomposition traces (which methods selected for each goal, what constraints were applied, what ordering resulted) for monitoring and debugging. 然而，在多智能体层级系统中，分解轨迹往往保留在各个智能体内部，无法被集中查看。 However, in multi-agent hierarchical systems, decomposition traces often remain within individual agents without central visibility. 在执行开始之前，系统监控无法看到智能体 A 的分解决策。 Agent A’s decomposition decisions are invisible to system monitoring until execution begins. 这会造成监控盲区，使无效的分解方案可能在未被及早发现的情况下得到执行。 This creates monitoring blind spots where invalid decompositions might execute without early detection. 多智能体特有之处：单个智能体可以维护完整的分解日志；采用分布式分解的多智能体系统缺乏集中的轨迹收集机制，从而造成监控缺口。 Multi-agent distinction: Single agents can maintain comprehensive decomposition logs; multi-agent systems with distributed decomposition lack centralized trace collection creating monitoring gaps. [1572, 610, 741, 603, 44]. [1572, 610, 741, 603, 44].
RTM_8_15 - 缺乏完整顺序信息的偏序执行监控。 RTM_8_15 - Partial Order Execution Monitoring Without Complete Ordering Information.
