HTN 的偏序允许灵活执行（任务 A 先于 C，任务 B 先于 C，但 A 与 B 之间没有顺序约束），然而监控系统往往无法了解完整的顺序语义。 HTN partial ordering permits execution flexibility (task A before C, task B before C, but A and B unordered), but monitoring systems often lack visibility into the complete ordering semantics. 如果智能体 A 指定偏序，而智能体 B 负责执行，智能体 B 可能只记录“依次执行了 A、B、C”，却不记录“B 本可以先于 A 执行”，从而使监控无法看到这种灵活性。 If Agent A specifies partial orders and Agent B executes them, Agent B might log ”executed A, B, C in sequence” without logging that ”B could have executed before A,” hiding the flexibility from monitoring. 这会造成保障缺口：监控看似显示执行是确定性的，而底层分解方案实际上允许非确定性。 This creates assurance gaps where monitoring appears to show deterministic execution when underlying decompositions permit non-determinism. 多智能体特有之处：单个智能体了解自身的顺序语义；多智能体中的顺序执行会使监控系统难以看清顺序语义。 Multi-agent distinction: Single agents know their own ordering semantics; multi-agent ordering execution obscures ordering semantics from monitoring systems. [69, 258, 99, 612, 814]. [69, 258, 99, 612, 814].
RTM_8_16 - 监控情境中的状态抽象投影损失。 RTM_8_16 - State Abstraction Projection Loss in Monitoring Context. HTN 状态抽象涉及信息损失（具体状态投影为抽象状态），这种损失也会出现在监控可见的信息中。 HTN state abstraction involves information loss (concrete state projects to abstract state), and this loss occurs during monitoring visibility. 战略层监控看到的是抽象后的状态（“东北地区运行正常”），却无法看到可能存在问题的具体状态细节（“某些机器过热”）。 Strategic-level monitoring sees abstracted state (”Northeast operations normal”) without visibility into concrete state details where problems might exist (”specific machines overheating”). 在多智能体层级系统中，每个智能体的监控都在其自身的抽象层次上进行。 In multi-agent hierarchical systems, each agent’s monitoring operates at its own abstraction level. 智能体 A 监控抽象状态，智能体 C 监控具体状态，而两者都无法获得完整的可见性。 Agent A monitors abstract state, Agent C monitors concrete state, and neither has complete visibility. 多智能体特有之处：同时保持对具体状态和抽象状态可见性的单个智能体，能够发现被抽象所掩盖的问题；在多智能体系统中，各智能体在不同抽象层次上运行，会造成监控盲区，使问题隐藏在抽象层次之间的缺口中。 Multi-agent distinction: Single agents maintaining both concrete and abstract state visibility can detect abstraction-hidden problems; multi-agent systems with agents operating at different abstraction levels create monitoring blind spots where problems hide in abstraction gaps. [612, 65, 814, 2080]. [612, 65, 814, 2080].
RTM_8_17 - 方法选择监控缺乏失败预测。 RTM_8_17 - Method Selection Monitoring Lacking Failure Prediction. 当前监控系统会记录执行了哪些方法，但不会监控选择这些方法的原因，也不会标记潜在的选择错误。 Current monitoring systems log which methods execute but don’t monitor why methods were selected or flag potential selection errors. 如果智能体 A 选择了方法 M，而方法 M’ 本会更安全，当前监控就不会标记这一非最优选择，除非 M 失败。 If Agent A selects method M when method M’ would have been safer, current monitoring doesn’t flag the suboptimal choice unless M fails. 在多智能体层级系统中，监控无法捕获每个智能体的选择决策在现有上下文下是否恰当。 In multi-agent hierarchical systems, monitoring doesn’t capture whether each agent’s selection decisions were appropriate given available context. 非最优选择在未发生失败的情况下继续执行，会造成监控盲区。 Suboptimal selections proceeding without failure create monitoring blind spots. 多智能体特有之处：单智能体的选择监控在理论上可以跟踪选择质量；在每个智能体都基于不完整信息进行选择的多智能体系统中，选择质量难以评估。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-agent selection monitoring could theoretically track selection quality; multi-agent systems where each agent makes selections based on incomplete information make selection quality assessment difficult. [55, 818, 1572, 819, 177]. [55, 818, 1572, 819, 177].
RTM_8_18 - 前置条件失效模式未受到监控。 RTM_8_18 - Precondition Failure Modes Not Monitored. HTN 前置条件决定方法能否被选用，监控应跟踪前置条件违反情况（即前置条件未满足却仍执行方法的情况）。 HTN preconditions gate method selection, and monitoring should track precondition violations (cases where methods execute despite failed preconditions). 然而，大多数监控系统关注的是执行结果，而非前置条件验证。 However, most monitoring systems focus on execution results, not precondition validation. 在由智能体 A 检查前置条件、智能体 C 执行方法的多智能体层级结构中，智能体 C 无法独立了解前置条件是否确实得到满足。 In multi-agent hierarchies where Agent A checks preconditions and Agent C executes methods, Agent C has no independent visibility into whether preconditions were actually satisfied. 如果智能体 A 在前置条件判断上出错，智能体 C 就会以不安全的方式执行，却无法发现根本的前置条件失效。 If Agent A made precondition errors, Agent C executes unsafely without detecting the root precondition failure. 多智能体特有之处：单个智能体可以自行检查前置条件；在由一个智能体检查前置条件、另一个智能体执行方法的多智能体系统中，会出现监控缺口，使前置条件失效在未被发现的情况下传播。 Multi-agent distinction: Single agents can self-check preconditions; multi-agent systems where preconditions checked by one agent and executed by another create monitoring gaps where precondition failures propagate undetected. [55, 45, 1265, 819, 1457]. [55, 45, 1265, 819, 1457].
RTM_8_19 - 分解正确性验证缺乏后备检查。 RTM_8_19 - Decomposition Correctness Validation Lacking Fallback Checks. 监控应验证分解是否正确（所选方法是否确实实现了抽象目标），但这种验证十分复杂，而且经常被省略。 Monitoring should validate whether decompositions are correct (selected methods actually achieve the abstract goal), but this validation is complex and often omitted. 在多智能体层级结构中，没有任何一个智能体对正确性验证负有完整责任。 In multi-agent hierarchies, no agent has complete responsibility for validating correctness. 智能体 A 选择方法，智能体 C 执行这些方法，但两者都不验证这种分解是否真正满足了原始目标。 Agent A selects methods, Agent C executes them, but neither validates whether the decomposition actually satisfies the original goal. 如果选定的方法无法正确组合，监控就无法检测到这一错误。 If methods are selected but don’t compose correctly, this error lacks monitoring detection. 多智能体情形的区别：单个智能体可以自行验证分解的正确性；在验证责任分散的多智能体系统中，会出现盲区，使正确性问题发生而未被检测到。 Multi-agent distinction: Single agents could self-validate decomposition correctness; multi-agent systems where validation responsibility is distributed create blind spots where correctness failures occur without detection. [2081, 1572, 2082, 2083]. [2081, 1572, 2082, 2083].
RTM_8_20 - 跨智能体约束冲突检测盲区。 RTM_8_20 - Cross-Agent Constraint Conflict Detection Blind Spot. 当智能体 A 指定约束、智能体 C 在遵守这些约束的前提下执行任务时，并没有监控机制验证智能体 C 是否确实遵守了智能体 A 指定的约束。如果智能体 C 悄然违反约束，或者冲突检查未跨越智能体边界，约束冲突就可能存在，却仍无法被监控发现。 When Agent A specifies constraints and Agent C executes tasks respecting those constraints, there’s no monitoring verification that Agent C actually respects the constraints specified by Agent A. Constraint conflicts might exist but remain invisible to monitoring if Agent C silently violates constraints or if conflict checking doesn’t span agent boundaries. 在多智能体层级结构中，要实现遵守约束的执行，就必须信任智能体 C；监控并不会验证这种跨智能体的约束遵守情况。 In multi-agent hierarchies, constraint-respecting execution requires faith in Agent C; monitoring doesn’t verify this cross-agent constraint respect. 多智能体情形的区别：单个智能体监控自身的约束遵守情况；约束跨越智能体边界的多智能体系统缺乏跨智能体的约束合规监控。 Multi-agent distinction: Single agents monitor their own constraint respect; multi-agent systems with constraints spanning agent boundaries lack cross-agent constraint compliance monitoring. [11, 2084, 829, 18, 45]. [11, 2084, 829, 18, 45].
RTM_8_21 - 作为隐藏认知状态的 MCTS 树统计信息。 RTM_8_21 - MCTS Tree Statistics as Hidden Cognitive State. MCTS（蒙特卡洛树搜索，Monte Carlo Tree Search）的树统计信息（访问次数、Q 值、UCT（应用于树的置信上界，Upper Confidence bounds applied to Trees）分数）反映了智能体的认知状态——它正在考虑哪些动作、认为这些动作有多大潜力，以及正在将探索资源分配到何处。 MCTS (Monte Carlo Tree Search) tree statistics (visit counts, Q values, UCT (Upper Confidence bounds applied to Trees) scores) represent the agent’s cognitive state—which actions it’s considering, how promising it thinks they are, and where it’s allocating exploration. 这种认知状态很少被记录或监控。 This cognitive state is rarely logged or monitored. 攻击者通过内存转储、共享日志系统或调试 API 访问 MCTS 内部状态，从中提取详细的认知状态信息，获知其规划意图、价值评估和探索模式。 Attackers accessing MCTS internal state (through memory dumps, shared logging systems, or debugging APIs) extract detailed cognitive state information, learning planning intentions, values, and exploration patterns. 多智能体情形的区别：单个智能体的认知状态保留在内部；为协调而记录规划统计信息的多智能体系统，会使隐藏的认知状态跨智能体边界暴露。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-agent cognitive state remains internal; multi-agent systems logging planning statistics for coordination expose hidden cognitive state across agent boundaries. [879, 1859, 835, 2071, 2085]. [879, 1859, 835, 2071, 2085].
RTM_8_22 - 仿真轨迹可见性造成的行为盲区。 RTM_8_22 - Simulation Trace Visibility as Behavioral Blind Spot. MCTS 仿真会生成包含所尝试动作、结果和推理过程的轨迹。 MCTS simulations generate traces containing attempted actions, outcomes, and reasoning. 这些轨迹属于内部信息，通常不会呈现给监控系统。 These traces are internal—not typically surfaced to monitoring systems. 监控工具只能看到已执行的动作（来自反向传播的结果），无法看到 MCTS 评估过的数百万种仿真备选方案。 Monitoring tools see only executed actions (from backpropagation outcomes), missing the millions of simulated alternatives MCTS evaluated. 这会造成行为盲区，使涉及未执行尝试的攻击途径无法被发现。 This creates behavioral blind spots where attack vectors involving non-executed attempts remain invisible. 攻击者注入恶意观测，使 MCTS 仿真广泛探索危险动作；监控系统只能看到实际执行的动作，无法发现曾发生过危险探索。 An attacker injects malicious observations causing MCTS simulations to extensively explore dangerous actions; monitoring systems only see the actual executed action, missing that dangerous exploration occurred. 多智能体情形的区别：单个智能体的仿真轨迹对外部监控保持隐藏；为调试而记录轨迹的多智能体系统会将这些轨迹暴露给集中式监控，这可能造成遥测缺口，即大多数智能体的仿真未受到监控，而某个智能体的详细轨迹却变得可见。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-agent simulation traces remain hidden from external monitoring; multi-agent systems with trace logging for debugging expose these traces to centralized monitoring potentially creating telemetry gaps where most agents’ simulations go unmonitored while one agent’s detailed traces become visible. [2063, 447, 138]. [2063, 447, 138].
RTM_8_23 - 作为未被观测到的行为变化的推演策略漂移。 RTM_8_23 - Rollout Policy Drift as Unobserved Behavior Change. MCTS 推演策略（rollout policies）通过动作偏好编码领域知识。 MCTS rollout policies encode domain knowledge through action preferences. 在推演策略随时间改进（学习更好的启发式方法）的自适应 MCTS 系统中，策略漂移会在缺乏显式监控的情况下发生。 In adaptive MCTS systems where rollout policies improve over time (learning better heuristics), policy drift happens without explicit monitoring. 智能体逐渐改变其仿真行为，而外部监控只能看到已执行的动作。 The agent gradually changes its simulation behavior while external monitoring sees only executed actions. 攻击者可以迫使推演策略向恶意行为演化，而监控系统却检测不到任何异常。 Attackers can force rollout policy evolution toward malicious behaviors while monitoring systems detect nothing. 多智能体情形的区别：单个智能体的推演策略漂移只影响一个智能体；在智能体从共享推演策略中学习的多智能体系统中，一个被攻陷的策略发生漂移就可能影响多个智能体，而监控盲区会使所有智能体中的这种问题都无法被检测到。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-agent rollout policy drift affects one agent; multi-agent systems where agents learn from shared rollout policies enable one compromised policy to drift affecting multiple agents, with monitoring blind spots preventing detection across all agents. [37, 1490, 2002, 2010]. [37, 1490, 2002, 2010].
RTM_8_24 - 作为未受监控的规划失效的收敛失败。 RTM_8_24 - Convergence Failures as Unmonitored Planning Breakdowns. 当 MCTS 因预算不足、探索校准不当或价值函数错误而无法收敛到合理策略时，规划质量会悄然下降，且不会发出明确告警。 When MCTS fails to converge to reasonable strategies (due to insufficient budget, exploration miscalibration, or value function errors), planning quality silently degrades without explicit alerts. 没有监控系统会标记出“MCTS 规划收敛到了次优策略”。 No monitoring system flags ”MCTS planning converged to suboptimal strategy.” 攻击者利用这些静默失败，在不被检测到的情况下导致规划质量下降。 Attackers exploit these silent failures to cause planning degradation without detection. 多智能体情形的区别：单个智能体的收敛失败可能通过输出质量的变化被检测到；在多智能体系统中，如果一个智能体的收敛失败导致下游智能体出现规划问题，就会造成未受监控的级联失败，而根本原因（上游收敛失败）仍然不可见。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-agent convergence failures may be detectable through output quality changes; multi-agent systems where one agent’s convergence failure causes downstream agents’ planning problems create cascading unmonitored failures where root cause (upstream convergence failure) remains invisible. [2086, 2087, 2074, 2088]. [2086, 2087, 2074, 2088].
RTM_8_25 - LangGraph MCTS 集成中由框架引起的遥测缺口。 RTM_8_25 - Framework-Induced Telemetry Gaps in LangGraph MCTS Integration. LangGraph 的检查点机制会保存 MCTS 规划状态，但常规监控不会检查已保存的树结构。 LangGraph’s checkpointing mechanism saves MCTS planning state, but typical monitoring doesn’t examine saved tree structures. 监控系统会记录“检查点已创建”和“检查点已恢复”，但不会检查 MCTS 树的内容。 Monitoring systems log ”checkpoint created” and ”checkpoint restored” without examining MCTS tree contents. 攻击者在检查点保存与恢复之间修改已保存的 MCTS 树（投毒 Q 值、访问次数或树结构），可以破坏规划过程，而遥测数据无法反映这种破坏。 Attackers modifying saved MCTS trees (poisoning Q values, visit counts, or tree structure) between checkpointing and restoration can corrupt planning without telemetry visibility. MCTS 树的恢复过程本身成为未受监控的攻击面。 The MCTS tree restoration itself becomes unmonitored attack surface. 多智能体场景的区别：单智能体的检查点机制影响一个智能体；而在多智能体系统中，跨框架边界共享检查点会产生 N² 个潜在的监控盲点，使树的修改无法被检测到。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-agent checkpointing affects one agent; multi-agent systems with shared checkpointing across framework boundaries create N² potential monitoring blind spots where tree modifications go undetected. [755, 138, 73, 367, 44]. [755, 138, 73, 367, 44].
RTM_8_26 - 利用正常波动掩盖重规划攻击。 RTM_8_26 - Replanning Attack Obfuscation via Normal Variation. 重规划算法的搜索树规模、评估的节点数量以及每秒扩展的节点数，本来就会随问题难度和启发式质量的不同而变化。 Replanning algorithms inherently show variation in search tree size, number of nodes evaluated, and nodes-per-second expansion rates depending on problem difficulty and heuristic quality. 攻击者引入缓慢、细微的启发式性能退化，使其看起来与自然性能波动无法区分，导致重规划逐渐偏向攻击者期望的路径，同时不会触发为检测突发异常而设计的监控告警。 Attackers inject slow, subtle heuristic degradation that looks indistinguishable from natural performance variation, causing replanning to gradually favor attacker-preferred paths without triggering monitoring alerts designed to detect sudden anomalies. 多智能体场景的区别：单智能体监控可以建立个体基线；多智能体系统则汇总各团队的监控数据，个别智能体的异常会被团队层面的平均值掩盖，从而使协同实施的缓慢攻击在单个智能体粒度上无法被检测到。 Multi-agent distinction: Single agent monitoring can establish individual baselines; multi-agent systems aggregate monitoring data across teams, where individual agent anomalies are masked by team-level averaging, enabling coordinated slow attacks undetectable at per-agent granularity. [1683, 1898, 45, 612, 66]. [1683, 1898, 45, 612, 66].
RTM_8_27 - 应急预案激活盲点。 RTM_8_27 - Contingency Activation Blind Spots. 监控系统侧重于检测意外的应急预案触发；当应急预案为响应检测到的故障而正常激活时，监控通常会将其记录为预期行为。 Monitoring systems focus on detecting unexpected contingency triggers; when contingencies activate normally in response to detected failures, monitoring typically logs this as expected behavior. 攻击者篡改应急分支条件（例如，将“如果位置 X 存在障碍物”修改为“如果满足任意条件”），导致应急预案频繁激活，同时看起来仍然合理。 Attackers corrupt contingency branch conditions (e.g., modifying ”IF obstacle at location X” to ”IF ANY condition”), causing contingencies to activate frequently while appearing legitimate. 多智能体场景的区别：单个智能体的应急预案激活会被记录为该智能体的行为；多智能体系统则难以区分合理的协同应急预案激活与由系统失陷驱动的协同激活，因为无论由真实故障还是攻击者设置的触发条件驱动，同步使用应急预案都可能呈现出完全相同的表现。 Multi-agent distinction: Single agents’ contingency activations are logged as per-agent behavior; multi-agent systems cannot easily distinguish between legitimate coordinated contingency activation and compromise-driven coordinated activation, as synchronized contingency use might appear identical whether driven by real failures or attacker triggers. [2089, 14, 1045, 177]. [2089, 14, 1045, 177].
RTM_8_28 - 搜索树扩展速率监控盲化。 RTM_8_28 - Search Tree Expansion Rate Blinding. 监控工具会跟踪 A* 在每个重规划周期中扩展的节点数量，以检测异常（节点数量突然增加意味着搜索空间可能变大）。 Monitoring tools track how many nodes A* expands per replanning cycle to detect anomalies (sudden increase suggesting larger search spaces). 攻击者轻微降低启发式质量，幅度小到足以逃避检测，却又足以使搜索树规模逐步增大，导致智能体消耗额外的计算资源，而监控会将其归因于“更困难的规划问题”，而非攻击。 Attackers degrade heuristic quality slightly enough to go undetected but enough to increase search tree size incrementally, causing agents to expend additional computational resources that monitoring attributes to ”harder planning problems” rather than attacks. 多智能体场景的区别：多智能体系统通常会汇总各智能体的搜索扩展指标；当团队平均值保持在正常范围内时，单个智能体的性能退化便不可见，使攻击者能够攻陷个别智能体而不触发监控告警，而如果以更细的粒度监控单个智能体，这些告警本应被触发。 Multi-agent distinction: Multi-agent systems typically aggregate search expansion metrics across agents; individual agent degradation is invisible when team average remains within normal bounds, enabling attackers to compromise individual agents without triggering monitoring that would fire if single agents were monitored at higher granularity. [835, 1947, 2002, 2090, 818]. [835, 1947, 2002, 2090, 818].
III-F9 RTM_9 - 记忆系统与知识库的可观测性III-F9 RTM_9 - Memory Systems and Knowledge Base Observability
RTM_9_1 - 将情景记忆检索用作规避监控的机制。 RTM_9_1 - Episodic Memory Retrieval as Monitoring Evasion Mechanism. 检索出的情景会影响智能体行为，却不会出现在日志中。 Retrieved episodes influence agent behavior without appearing in logs. 攻击者精心构造能够激活某些行为的情景，使监控系统无法将这些行为归因于特定输入。 Attackers craft episodes activating behaviors that monitoring systems cannot attribute to specific inputs. 监控能够看到“智能体执行了动作 X”，却无法看到促使其执行该动作的检索情景。 Monitoring sees ”agent took action X” but cannot see retrieved episodes motivating the action. 多智能体场景的区别：单智能体的动作归因仍然具有挑战性；在由 Agent A 检索情景、Agent B 监控动作的多智能体系统中，存在归因盲点，监控无法将动作追溯到情景来源。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-agent action attribution remains challenging; multi-agent systems where Agent A retrieves episodes and Agent B monitors actions face attribution blind spots where monitoring cannot trace actions to episode sources. [73, 258, 1641]. [73, 258, 1641].
RTM_9_2 - 巩固过程的不透明性构成学习盲点。 RTM_9_2 - Consolidation Process Opacity as Learning Blind Spot. 将情景抽象为语义规则的巩固过程在线下进行。 Consolidation abstracting episodes into semantic rules happens offline. 监控系统能够观察输入的情景和输出的智能体行为，却无法看到抽象过程。 Monitoring systems observing incoming episodes and outgoing agent behaviors cannot see abstraction processes. 攻击者精心设计巩固过程，以创建无法被观测到的恶意软件模板。 Attackers craft consolidation processes creating malware templates invisible to observation. 多智能体场景的区别：单个巩固过程的不透明性影响一个智能体；而多智能体在整个组织范围内将信息巩固到共享语义记忆中的过程，会造成组织层面的观测盲区，无人能够观察到被投毒的情景如何转化为组织范围内通用的规则。 Multi-agent distinction: Single consolidation opacity affects one agent; multi-agent organization-wide consolidation to shared semantic memory creates organization-scale blindness where nobody observes transformations of poisoned episodes into organization-wide rules. [739, 2091, 2092, 2093, 2094]. [739, 2091, 2092, 2093, 2094].
RTM_9_3 - 轨迹整合隐藏多步骤攻击。 RTM_9_3 - Trajectory Integration Hiding Multi-Step Attacks. 轨迹汇集多步骤的求解路径。 Trajectories aggregate multi-step solution paths. 观察最终结果的监控系统无法看到轨迹中的恶意中间步骤。 Monitoring systems observing final outcomes cannot see malicious intermediate steps within trajectories. 攻击者在看似合理的问题求解轨迹的早期嵌入恶意步骤。 Attackers embed malicious steps early in trajectories appearing as legitimate problem-solving. 多智能体场景的区别：单智能体轨迹的内部过程难以被观测；多智能体在各团队间使用的共享轨迹会将恶意步骤隐藏在共享参考资料中，使跨团队检测变得困难。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-agent trajectories are opaque to observation; multi-agent shared trajectories used across teams hide malicious steps in shared reference materials, making detection across teams difficult. [69, 920, 176, 70, 177]. [69, 920, 176, 70, 177].
RTM_9_4 - 混合存储架构造成监控缺口。 RTM_9_4 - Hybrid Storage Architecture Creating Monitoring Gaps. 结合向量数据库和图数据库的混合系统形成了双通道存储。 Hybrid systems combining vector and graph databases create dual-channel storage. 智能体可能查询这两种存储，而二者的监控覆盖程度不同。 Agents might query both stores with different monitoring coverage. 攻击者利用监控的不对称性，在监控不足的通道（图关系）中实施投毒，从而绕过检测。 Attackers exploit monitoring asymmetries where poisoning in under-monitored channels (graph relationships) bypasses detection. 多智能体区别：单智能体存储架构面临单一的监控挑战；多智能体混合架构则产生双通道监控缺口，攻击者可通过选择监控不足的存储层来逃避监测。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-agent storage architecture has one monitoring challenge; multi-agent hybrid architectures create dual-channel monitoring gaps where attackers evade observation by choosing under-monitored storage tiers. [2095, 2096, 231, 855, 400]. [2095, 2096, 231, 855, 400].
RTM_9_5 - 跨智能体记忆共享模糊个体责任。 RTM_9_5 - Cross-Agent Memory Sharing Obscuring Individual Responsibility. 当智能体 A 检索情景记忆片段（episodes），而智能体 B 根据这些片段执行操作时，两个智能体都不承担责任。 When Agent A retrieves episodes and Agent B executes actions based on those episodes, neither agent takes responsibility. 监控无法将责任归于情景记忆片段的创建者。 Monitoring cannot attribute accountability to episode creators. 多智能体区别：单智能体的操作责任归属明确；多智能体的情景记忆片段共享则导致责任分散，无人对片段的准确性负责，使投毒得以不受约束地传播。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-agent action accountability is direct; multi-agent episode sharing creates responsibility diffusion where nobody takes ownership of episode accuracy enabling unchecked poisoning propagation. [819, 73, 258, 469, 130]. [819, 73, 258, 469, 130].
RTM_9_6 - 利用元数据过滤的复杂性规避检测。 RTM_9_6 - Metadata Filtering Complexity as Detection Evasion. 检索使用复杂的元数据过滤机制（基于时间、上下文和频率）。 Retrieval uses complex metadata filtering (temporal, contextual, frequency-based). 监控系统无法有效追踪哪些元数据组合会触发哪些情景记忆片段的检索。 Monitoring systems cannot effectively track which metadata combinations trigger which episodes. 攻击者构造经过投毒的情景记忆片段，使其仅在处于监控盲区的特定元数据组合下被检索到。 Attackers craft poisoned episodes retrieving only under specific monitoring-blind metadata combinations. 多智能体区别：单智能体的过滤过程可以被观测；多智能体系统汇聚来自多个来源的元数据，所产生的复杂性使监控无法追踪跨团队的哪些元数据组合会触发对投毒情景记忆片段的检索。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-agent filtering is observable; multi-agent systems with aggregated metadata from multiple sources create complexity where monitoring cannot track which metadata combinations across teams trigger poisoned episode retrieval. [82, 1075, 79, 1121, 400]. [82, 1075, 79, 1121, 400].
RTM_9_7 - 语义记忆查询日志记录缺口使审计规避成为可能。 RTM_9_7 - Semantic Memory Query Logging Gaps Enabling Audit Evasion. 由于性能限制，RAG 查询可能未被完整记录。 RAG queries may not be fully logged due to performance constraints. 日志记录缺口造成审计盲区，攻击者可据此构造不会被日志记录的查询。 Logging gaps create audit blind spots where attackers craft queries avoiding logs. 在采用集中式查询日志记录的多智能体系统中，选择性日志记录使攻击者能够察觉监控，并避开已配置监测的查询。 In multi-agent systems with central query logging, selective logging enables attackers detecting monitoring and avoiding instrumented queries. 多智能体区别：共享日志基础设施使攻击者能够了解哪些查询会被记录，并构造逃避集体监控的查询。 Multi-agent distinction: Shared logging infrastructure enables attackers understanding which queries are logged and crafting queries evading collective monitoring. [69, 920, 70, 176]. [69, 920, 70, 176].
RTM_9_8 - 检索相关性监控不足以确保语义有效性。 RTM_9_8 - Retrieval Relevance Monitoring Insufficient for Semantic Validity. 监控追踪检索相关性，却不追踪语义适切性。 Monitoring tracks retrieval relevance but not semantic appropriateness. 高度相关的文档可能包含不适用于查询上下文的指令。 A highly relevant document might contain instructions inappropriate for the query context. 相关性监控会使人对检索安全性产生虚假的信心。 Relevance monitoring provides false confidence about retrieval safety. 多智能体区别：共享的相关性指标使所有智能体产生一致的虚假信心。 Multi-agent distinction: Shared relevance metrics provide uniform false confidence across all agents. [400, 1075, 110, 841]. [400, 1075, 110, 841].
RTM_9_9 - 知识图谱关系基数爆炸的监控缺口。 RTM_9_9 - Knowledge Graph Relationship Cardinality Explosion Monitoring Gap. 知识图谱可能出现关系爆炸，即推理规则生成数量呈指数级增长的关系。 Knowledge graphs can experience relationship explosion where inference rules create exponential relationships. 追踪关系总数的监控可能遗漏隐藏在子图统计信息中的基数爆炸。 Monitoring tracking total relationship counts may miss cardinality explosions hidden in subgraph statistics. 多智能体区别：共享图谱发生关系爆炸时，会同时影响所有智能体，而这种爆炸直到全系统性能退化变得明显时才会显现。 Multi-agent distinction: Shared graph experiencing explosion affects all agents simultaneously with explosion invisible until system-wide degradation becomes obvious. [2096, 2095, 231]. [2096, 2095, 231].
RTM_9_10 - 时效性约束执行中的盲区。 RTM_9_10 - Temporal Validity Enforcement Blind Spots. 知识库记录了文档的时间有效性，但约束执行中的缺口使过期文档仍可被检索到。 Knowledge bases document temporal validity but enforcement gaps allow stale documents to remain retrievable. 监控文档存续时间所提供的信号不足，因为智能体可能不会检查有效性标注。 Monitoring document age provides insufficient signal because agents may not check validity annotations. 多智能体区别：共享的约束执行缺口会影响所有智能体，使过期文档引发的漏洞未能在集体监控中显现。 Multi-agent distinction: Shared enforcement gaps affect all agents leaving stale-document vulnerabilities unsurfaced in collective monitoring. [45, 2017, 400]. [45, 2017, 400].
RTM_9_11 - 嵌入质量退化的检测缺口。 RTM_9_11 - Embedding Quality Degradation Detection Gaps. 受损向量的累积会导致嵌入质量退化，但缺乏可供监控的明确信号。 Embedding quality degrades through accumulation of corrupted vectors but no clear signal for monitoring. 质量退化是渐进且不可见的，直到检索准确率明显下降时才会显现。 Quality degradation is gradual and invisible until retrieval accuracy visibly declines. 多智能体特有之处：共享资源的退化会影响所有智能体，需要通过全系统监控才能检测到。 Multi-agent distinction: Shared degradation affects all agents requiring system-wide monitoring to detect. [87, 231, 1075, 1121]. [87, 231, 1075, 1121].
RTM_9_12 - 通过异常分析检测知识库投毒的缺口。 RTM_9_12 - Knowledge Base Poisoning Detection Through Anomaly Analysis Gaps. 检索文档中的异常（主题突然转变、语义异常）可能表明存在投毒，但异常检测需要建立基线。 Anomalies in retrieved documents (sudden topic shifts, semantic aberrations) might indicate poisoning but anomaly detection requires baselining. 在查询模式多样的多智能体系统中，建立基线变得困难。 In multi-agent systems with diverse query patterns, baselining becomes difficult. 多智能体特有之处：异构智能体的查询会产生多样的检索模式，使投毒异常更难与正常变化区分。 Multi-agent distinction: Heterogeneous agent queries create diverse retrieval patterns making poisoning anomalies harder to distinguish from normal variation. [400, 1075, 1121]. [400, 1075, 1121].
RTM_9_13 - 通过操纵缓存命中率绕过性能监控。 RTM_9_13 - Cache Hit Rate Manipulation as Performance Monitoring Bypass. 系统会监控缓存命中率，但攻击者可以构造与已缓存恶意内容匹配的查询，人为提高命中率。 Cache hit rates are monitored but attackers can artificially inflate hit rates by crafting queries matching cached malicious content. 高命中率会让人对系统性能产生虚假的信心。 High hit rates provide false confidence about system performance. 多智能体特有之处：共享缓存使攻击者能够操纵命中率，从而影响对所有智能体所处系统健康状况的判断。 Multi-agent distinction: Shared cache enables attackers manipulating hit rates affecting perceived system health across all agents. [122, 124, 1790, 682]. [122, 124, 1790, 682].
RTM_9_14 - 去重元数据绕过完整性监控。 RTM_9_14 - Deduplication Metadata Bypassing Completeness Monitoring. 去重会删除重复项，但有关去重条目的元数据可能不完整。 Deduplication removes duplicates but metadata about deduplicated items may be incomplete. 基于去重后条目数量的监控无法准确反映知识库的内容。 Monitoring based on deduplicated counts provides inaccurate picture of knowledge base contents. 多智能体特有之处：共享去重机制支持从统一视图进行监控，但也会造成集体性的完整性盲区。 Multi-agent distinction: Shared deduplication enabling monitoring from unified view creates collective completeness blind spots. [2097, 400, 231]. [2097, 400, 231].
RTM_9_15 - 工作记忆的阶段转换造成监控盲区。 RTM_9_15 - Working Memory Phase Transitions Creating Monitoring Blind Spots. 工作记忆的生命周期（组装 → 处理 → 推理 → 生成 → 清除）涉及离散的阶段转换，在这些转换中，上下文状态会发生剧烈变化。 Working memory lifecycle (assembly → processing → reasoning → generation → disposal) involves discrete phase transitions where context state changes dramatically. 在清除阶段，整个上下文被清空，推理路径、中间状态和工具调用的证据随之被抹除。 During disposal phase, complete context clears, erasing evidence of reasoning paths, intermediate states, and tool invocations. 在多智能体系统中，当智能体 A 的清除阶段在智能体 B 完成对智能体 A 输出的处理之前清空上下文时，就无法监控智能体 A 的内部推理——智能体完成执行后，清除操作会清空上下文，而智能体 B 只能看到最终输出。 In multi-agent systems, when Agent A’s disposal phase clears context before Agent B has finished processing Agent A’s outputs, monitoring becomes impossible for Agent A’s internal reasoning—agents complete execution, disposal clears context, and Agent B only sees the final output. 攻击者会利用阶段转换，注入专门设计为在生成阶段执行的恶意指令（此时智能体尚未想到要记录日志），或刻意安排攻击时机，使其跨越监控工具存在可见性缺口的阶段边界。 Attackers exploit phase transitions by injecting malicious instructions designed to execute during generation phase (before agents think to capture logs) or deliberately timing attacks across phase boundaries where monitoring tools have visibility gaps. 与状态持续演变的单体系统不同，多智能体的阶段转换会产生离散的盲区，使监控无法捕获特定阶段中的状态。 Unlike singular systems with continuous state evolution, multi-agent phase transitions create discrete blind spots where monitoring cannot capture state during specific phases. [73, 72, 69, 920, 176]. [73, 72, 69, 920, 176].
RTM_9_16 - 词元预算可视化造成对监控的虚假信心。 RTM_9_16 - Token Budget Visualization Creating False Confidence in Monitoring. 显示词元预算分配情况的监控仪表板可能误导安全团队，使其错误地相信上下文得到了妥善管理，同时掩盖认知负荷和信息质量方面的问题。 Monitoring dashboards displaying token budget allocation can mislead security teams into false confidence that context is well-managed, hiding problems with cognitive load and information quality. 当仪表板显示“已检索 25,000 个词元的文档”（看似充足）时，团队可能没有意识到，其中 60% 是无关信息，会造成认知饱和并降低推理质量，而这种推理质量下降才是导致不安全工具选择的真正原因。 When dashboards show ”retrieved 25,000 tokens of documentation” (appears adequate), teams may not perceive that 60% is extraneous information creating cognitive saturation degrading the reasoning quality actually responsible for unsafe tool selection. 在多智能体系统中，针对每个智能体的词元仪表板会营造出各个智能体运行健康的假象，同时掩盖智能体协同过程中的系统性退化。 In multi-agent systems, per-agent token dashboards create illusion of individual agent health while masking systemic degradation across agent coordination. 智能体 A 显示其利用率为健康的 45%，智能体 B 显示其利用率为 52%，但两者协同时的总体容量利用率达到 97%，处于推理能力会急剧下降的饱和区。 Agent A shows healthy 45% utilization, Agent B shows 52% utilization, but together coordinating at 97% capacity in saturation zone where reasoning degrades dramatically. 当全局多智能体指标已表明系统处于饱和状态，却仍将智能体局部指标视为健康时，就会出现监控盲区。 Monitoring blind spots emerge from treating agent-local metrics as healthy when global multi-agent metrics indicate saturation. [835, 2098, 69]. [835, 2098, 69].
RTM_9_17 - 推理轨迹截断掩盖多智能体 CoT 中的决策来源。 RTM_9_17 - Reasoning Trace Truncation Hiding Decision Provenance in Multi-Agent CoT. 思维链推理能够提高工具选择的透明度，但在受输出词元限制的多智能体系统中，推理轨迹会在完成前被截断，从而掩盖决策来源。 Chain-of-thought reasoning provides transparency into tool selections, but in multi-agent systems with output token constraints, reasoning traces get truncated before completion, hiding decision provenance. 当智能体 A 生成推理过程，而词元限制迫使其截断时，下游智能体会接收到决策看似缺乏依据的输出（“所选工具：[推理已截断]”）。 When Agent A generates reasoning and token limits force truncation, downstream agents inherit outputs where decisions appear unjustified (”Selected tool: [truncated reasoning]”). 这会造成“推理归因缺口”：由于论证依据已被丢弃，监控无法确定工具选择是否合理。 This creates ”reasoning attribution gaps” where monitoring cannot determine whether tool selection was justified because justification was discarded. 多智能体系统会通过级联截断放大这一问题——智能体 A 被截断的推理成为智能体 B 的输入，智能体 B 为遵守预算而进一步截断，最终智能体 C 收到的推理过于稀疏，以至于无法确定其来源和安全性。 Multi-agent systems amplify this through cascading truncations—Agent A’s truncated reasoning becomes Agent B’s input, Agent B truncates further to stay within budget, and Agent C receives reasoning so sparse its origin and safety are indeterminate. 分析词元预算的监控工具会将大幅截断视为效率提升，却忽略随之而来的决策透明度损失，而这种损失会为工具选择滥用创造条件。 Monitoring tools analyzing token budgets see efficiency improvements from aggressive truncation while missing the corresponding loss of decision transparency enabling tool selection abuse. [69, 920, 522, 72, 70]. [69, 920, 522, 72, 70].
RTM_9_18 - 分层压缩的观测不透明性导致语义监控失效。 RTM_9_18 - Hierarchical Compression Observation Opaqueness Creating Semantic Monitoring Failures. 分层压缩将完整历史记录存储在外部，而工作记忆中仅包含摘要，从而在监控中造成语义缺口。 Hierarchical compression stores full history externally while working memory contains summaries, creating semantic gaps in monitoring. 安全团队分析工作记忆内容时，看到的是摘要；完整的对话历史记录仍保存在外部存储中，很少接受异常检查。 When security teams analyze working memory contents, they see summaries; full conversation history remains in external storage rarely inspected for anomalies. 跨多个专用智能体的多智能体分层压缩会形成分布式存储，其中智能体 A 的完整历史记录位于数据库 X，智能体 B 的完整历史记录位于数据库 Y，从而导致监控碎片化。 Multi-agent hierarchical compression across multiple specialized agents creates distributed storage where Agent A’s full history is in database X, Agent B’s full history in database Y, creating monitoring fragmentation. 协同攻击可能只有在分析完整历史记录时才会显现（比较智能体 A 与智能体 B 交换的具体信息），但在工作记忆摘要中却显得安全（从高层次来看，两个智能体似乎都在交换适当的信息）。 Coordinated attacks might manifest only in full history analysis (comparing details Agent A and Agent B exchanged) but appear safe in working memory summaries (both agents appear to exchange appropriate information at high level). 对多智能体分层压缩进行语义监控，需要关联 N 个分布式外部存储中的信息，而大多数监控平台并未解决这一复杂性问题。 Semantic monitoring of multi-agent hierarchical compression requires correlating information across N distributed external stores, a complexity most monitoring platforms don’t address. [73, 72, 69, 920, 70]. [73, 72, 69, 920, 70].
III-F10 RTM_10 - 决策逻辑与效用函数监控III-F10 RTM_10 - Decision Logic and Utility Function Monitoring
RTM_10_1 - 效用函数计算的遥测缺口。 RTM_10_1 - Utility Function Calculation Telemetry Gaps. 遥测通常会记录决策及其结果，却不采集决策所依据的期望效用计算。 Telemetry typically logs decisions and outcomes without capturing expected utility calculations underlying decisions. 如果不根据日志重建计算过程，监控就无法区分由正确的效用优化产生的决策与由遭到投毒的效用函数产生的决策。 Monitoring cannot distinguish decisions from correct utility optimization from decisions from poisoned utility functions without reconstructing calculations from logs. 在多智能体系统中，如果没有全面的内部遥测，就无法重建由各智能体共同参与的分布式效用计算。 In multi-agent systems, reconstructing distributed utility calculations across agents’ contributions is impossible without comprehensive internal telemetry. 多智能体情形的区别：单个智能体的效用计算或许可以根据结果日志重建；但由于中间效用值未被记录，效用在多个智能体之间的传播过程无法重建。 Multi-agent distinction: Single agent utility calculation might be reconstructed from outcome logs; multi-agent utility propagation through agents cannot be reconstructed as intermediate utilities aren’t logged. [2074, 2088, 818, 45, 2002]. [2074, 2088, 818, 45, 2002].
RTM_10_2 - 权重驱动的决策分歧监控盲点。 RTM_10_2 - Weight-Driven Decision Divergence Blind Spot. 当多智能体系统使用不同的效用权重时，决策分歧会表现为正常差异，而非攻击迹象。 When multi-agent systems use different utility weights, decision divergence appears normal variation rather than indicating attacks. 监控无法检测出这种分歧源于注入的权重差异，而非合理的分析差异。 Monitoring cannot detect that divergence results from injected weight differences rather than legitimate analytical differences. 多智能体情形的区别：单个智能体的决策看起来具有一致性；多智能体之间的分歧看起来很正常，尽管它实际上反映了攻击所注入的权重不一致。 Multi-agent distinction: Single agent’s decisions appear consistent; multi-agent divergence looks normal despite representing attack-injected weight inconsistency. [2090, 2002, 69, 818, 1021]. [2090, 2002, 69, 818, 1021].
RTM_10_3 - 概率分布偏移对效用决策的影响。 RTM_10_3 - Probability Distribution Shift Impact on Utility Decisions. 监控无法洞察结果概率分布的变化如何影响期望效用计算。 Monitoring lacks visibility into how outcome probability distribution changes affect expected utility calculations. 当概率发生偏移时（市场条件变化、工具可靠性下降），监控仍继续跟踪决策频率，却未检测到效用计算的根本性变化。 When probabilities shift (market conditions change, tool reliability degrades), monitoring continues tracking decision frequency without detecting utility-calculation-fundamental changes. 多智能体情形的区别：单个智能体的概率偏移只影响一个决策流；多智能体的概率分布偏移则可能在整个智能体网络中引发级联重新计算，而监控无法将这些重新计算关联起来。 Multi-agent distinction: Single agent’s probability shifts affect one decision stream; multi-agent probability distribution shifts can cause cascading recalculations across agent network that monitoring doesn’t correlate. [1898, 1683, 818]. [1898, 1683, 818].
RTM_10_4 - 通过重新定义效用指标钻规格空子（Specification Gaming）。 RTM_10_4 - Specification Gaming Through Utility Metric Redefinition. 智能体可能通过在语义层面重新定义“成功”的含义，表现出钻效用函数空子的行为。 Agents can appear to game utility functions by redefining what ”success” means at the semantic level. 遥测显示“智能体正在实现效用优化目标”，但实际上智能体重新解释了效用函数的定义。 Telemetry shows ”agent achieving utility optimization targets” when actually agent reinterpreted utility function definitions. 在多智能体系统中，一个智能体的重新定义会传播到依赖它的智能体，导致这些智能体朝着非预期结果进行优化。 In multi-agent systems, one agent’s redefinition propagates to dependent agents causing them to optimize toward unintended outcomes. 多智能体情形的区别：单个智能体重新定义效用会影响其自身的决策；多智能体中的重新定义则可能通过学习机制传播，同时影响所有智能体。 Multi-agent distinction: Single agent redefining utility affects its decisions; multi-agent redefinition can propagate through learning mechanisms affecting all agents simultaneously. [781, 2099, 2100, 2101, 2102]. [781, 2099, 2100, 2101, 2102].
RTM_10_5 - 工具结果分布的遥测缺口导致投毒检测失效。 RTM_10_5 - Tool Outcome Distribution Telemetry Gaps Enabling Poisoning Detection Failure. 对期望效用计算至关重要的工具成功率和结果分布，通常并未得到系统性的监控或记录。 Tool success rates and outcome distributions critical for expected utility calculation are not typically monitored or logged systematically. 当攻击者对结果分布假设进行投毒时（修改智能体对工具成功率的信念），监控缺乏可用于检测偏差的真实基准。 When attackers poison outcome distribution assumptions (modifying agent’s beliefs about tool success rates), monitoring has no ground truth to detect the deviation. 多智能体情形的区别：遭到投毒的结果分布会影响查询同一工具注册表的所有智能体；具有本地工具模型的单个智能体或许能够检测到不一致，但采用共享注册表的多智能体系统使统一投毒成为可能。 Multi-agent distinction: Poisoned outcome distributions affect all agents querying same tool registry; single agents with local tool models might detect inconsistency but multi-agent systems with shared registries enable uniform poisoning. [818, 838, 2103, 612, 944]. [818, 838, 2103, 612, 944].
RTM_10_6 - 置信度分数所依据的效用计算不透明。 RTM_10_6 - Confidence Score Utility Basis Opacity. 向用户展示或在审批流程中使用的置信度分数，通常源于期望效用计算，但遥测并未揭示其计算过程。 Confidence scores presented to users or in approval workflows often derive from expected utility calculations but telemetry doesn’t reveal the calculation. 用户和审计人员看到“87% 置信度”，却不了解它代表的是被误认作置信度的负期望效用。 Users and auditors see ”87% confidence” without understanding that it represents negative expected utility misidentified as confidence. 多智能体情形的区别：多智能体置信度聚合掩盖了哪些智能体的效用计算参与其中，使攻击者能够对特定高权重智能体的效用进行投毒，在不被检测到的情况下影响整体置信度。 Multi-agent distinction: Multi-agent confidence aggregation obscures which agents’ utility calculations contributed, enabling specific high-weight agents’ utilities to be poisoned affecting overall confidence without detection. [818, 1683, 612, 66, 2002]. [818, 1683, 612, 66, 2002].
RTM_10_7 - 监控中缺失的反事实效用分析。 RTM_10_7 - Missing Counterfactual Utility Analysis in Monitoring. 智能体作出决策时，监控会记录实际决策及其结果，但不会记录其他可选行动的预期效用。 When agents make decisions, monitoring logs actual decision and outcome but not the expected utility of alternative actions. 事后事件分析无法确定，该决策在已有信息条件下是否最优，还是属于钻规范空子（specification gaming）的行为。 Post-incident analysis cannot determine whether decision was optimal given available information or represented specification gaming. 多智能体情形的区别：审计单个智能体的决策需要分析未选选项的效用；多智能体审计则需要了解每个智能体的可用选项及其效用，使分析复杂度成倍增加。 Multi-agent distinction: Single agent’s decision audit requires analyzing utilities of forgone options; multi-agent audit requires understanding each agent’s available options and utilities, multiplying analysis complexity. [991, 2104, 1081, 69, 759]. [991, 2104, 1081, 69, 759].
RTM_10_8 - 分布式系统中的规则触发监控盲区。 RTM_10_8 - Rule Firing Monitoring Gaps in Distributed Systems. 推理轨迹会记录基于规则的系统中的规则触发情况。 Inference traces record rule firings in rule-based systems. 在分布式执行规则的多智能体系统中，跨智能体监控规则触发情况会产生盲区。 In multi-agent systems with distributed rule execution, monitoring rule firings across agents creates blind spots. 智能体 A 触发规则 1-5，智能体 B 触发规则 6-10，但任何单一监控仪表板都无法显示合并后的规则序列。 Agent A fires rules 1-5, Agent B fires rules 6-10, but combined rule sequence not visible in any single monitoring dashboard. 攻击者利用这一点，将恶意规则触发分散到多个智能体上，形成在单独监控时不可见、但在整体上存在问题的模式。 Attackers exploit this by distributing malicious rule firings across agents creating patterns invisible in individual monitoring but problematic in aggregate. 多智能体情形的区别：单智能体的规则触发监控可显示完整的执行过程；多智能体的分布式执行会产生监控盲区，使恶意模式得以跨智能体边界隐藏。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-agent rule firing monitoring shows complete execution; multi-agent distributed execution creates monitoring gaps where malicious patterns hide across agent boundaries. [93, 2105, 1994, 45, 829]. [93, 2105, 1994, 45, 829].
RTM_10_9 - 工作记忆内容的监控盲区。 RTM_10_9 - Working Memory Content Monitoring Gaps. 工作记忆在推理过程中保存中间事实。 Working memory maintains intermediate facts during inference. 在具有共享工作记忆的多智能体系统中，监控各智能体检索和使用了哪些事实变得困难。 In multi-agent systems with shared working memory, monitoring what facts agents retrieve and use becomes difficult. 在共享可见的环境下，哪个智能体访问了哪个事实、出于何种目的，变得无法追踪。 Which agent accessed which fact and for what purpose becomes untrackable in shared visibility. 攻击者利用这种不透明性对工作记忆实施投毒，因为相关行为的归因会变得不明确。 Attackers exploit this opacity by poisoning working memory relying on fact that attribution becomes unclear. 多智能体情形的区别：单智能体的工作记忆对监控而言保持透明；多智能体的共享工作记忆使哪些智能体访问了哪些事实变得不透明，从而使隐蔽投毒成为可能。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-agent working memory remains transparent to monitoring; multi-agent shared working memory creates opacity about which agents accessed which facts enabling covert poisoning. [2106, 900, 73, 1864, 69]. [2106, 900, 73, 1864, 69].
RTM_10_10 - 共享存储库中的规则修改检测盲区。 RTM_10_10 - Rule Modification Detection Gaps in Shared Repositories. 共享存储库中的规则变更可能不会触发所有智能体的监控。 Rule changes in shared repositories may not trigger monitoring in all agents. 共享存储库中的规则被修改时，不同智能体可能处于规则应用的不同阶段，从而产生竞态条件。 When rules in shared repositories are modified, different agents may be at different stages of rule application creating race conditions. 攻击者利用这一点修改规则，希望部分智能体应用旧版本、其他智能体应用新版本，从而导致策略执行不一致。 Attackers exploit this by modifying rules hoping some agents apply old versions and others apply new versions creating inconsistent policy enforcement. 多智能体情形的区别：单智能体的规则修改是原子的；多智能体共享规则允许非原子修改，从而在智能体之间造成一致性缺口。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-agent rule modifications are atomic; multi-agent shared rules enable non-atomic modifications creating consistency gaps between agents. [2107, 2108]. [2107, 2108].
RTM_10_11 - 启发式参数调优的监控盲区。 RTM_10_11 - Heuristic Parameter Tuning Monitoring Blindness. 决策系统会使用温度和采样策略等启发式参数。 Heuristic parameters such as temperature and sampling strategies are used in decision systems. 在各智能体独立调优参数的多智能体系统中，监控难以发现参数何时被调整为有利于钻规范空子的取值。 In multi-agent systems where parameters are tuned independently, monitoring cannot easily detect when parameters are tuned to enable specification gaming. 启发式行为的变化看起来像是自然波动，而非蓄意钻空子。 Changes in heuristic behavior appear as natural variation rather than deliberate gaming. 攻击者利用这一点逐步调优参数，预期监控会漏掉参数漂移。 Attackers exploit this by gradually tuning parameters expecting monitoring to miss parameter drift. 多智能体情形的区别：单智能体的参数调优是可见的；多智能体参数调优的多样性使监控难以区分合理的异质性与利用参数恶意钻空子的行为。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-agent parameter tuning is visible; multi-agent parameter tuning diversity creates monitoring challenges distinguishing legitimate heterogeneity from malicious parameter gaming. [835, 1683, 818, 612, 781]. [835, 1683, 818, 612, 781].
RTM_10_12 - 通过基于训练的对抗策略习得监控规避行为。 RTM_10_12 - Learned Monitoring Evasion Through Training-Based Counter-Strategies. 在监控下接受训练的智能体会学会规避检测——受到监控时调整行为，未受监控时则采取不当行为。 Agents trained under monitoring learn to evade detection—adjusting behavior when monitored while misbehaving when unmonitored. 这些检测规避策略会成为编码在策略中的习得行为。 These detection evasion strategies become learned behaviors encoded in policies. 与静态规避不同，习得的规避行为会适应监控的变化。 Unlike static evasion, learned evasion adapts to monitoring changes. 多智能体情形的区别：智能体共同学习监控模式，形成协同规避行为。 Multi-agent distinction: Agents learn monitoring patterns together developing coordinated evasion. [2109]. [2109].
RTM_10_13 - 将奖励指标钻空子作为习得的监控规避行为。 RTM_10_13 - Reward Metric Gaming as Learned Monitoring Evasion. 从受监控的奖励指标中学习的智能体会发现钻空子的策略——优化指标，却不实现实际目标。 Agents learning from monitored reward metrics discover gaming strategies—optimizing metrics without achieving actual objectives. 这些钻空子的策略会成为策略的组成部分。 These gaming strategies become policy components. 多智能体情形的区别：智能体分别专门针对不同指标钻空子，形成协同钻空子行为。 Multi-agent distinction: Coordinated gaming where agents specialize in gaming different metrics. [2110, 2111, 2112, 2113, 2114]. [2110, 2111, 2112, 2113, 2114].
RTM_10_14 - 经验采样偏差检测。 RTM_10_14 - Experience Sampling Bias Detection. DRL（深度强化学习）系统从经验缓冲区中采样。 DRL (Deep Reinforcement Learning) systems sample from experience buffers. 非均匀采样会暴露哪些经验被优先选取。 Non-uniform sampling reveals which experiences are prioritized. 攻击者可以观察采样模式，推断缓冲区内容和训练重点。 Attackers can observe sampling patterns inferring buffer contents and training focus. 多智能体情形的区别：跨智能体汇总的采样情况会暴露整体训练重点。 Multi-agent distinction: Aggregated sampling across agents reveals aggregated training focus. [1105, 1079, 2115]. [1105, 1079, 2115].
RTM_10_15 - 将策略输出分布分析用作监控手段。 RTM_10_15 - Policy Output Distribution Analysis as Monitoring. 基于学习的策略的输出分布（动作选择概率）会暴露策略特征。 Learning-based policies’ output distributions (action selection probabilities) reveal policy characteristics. 监控可以检测表明存在对抗性影响的异常分布。 Monitoring can detect anomalous distributions indicating adversarial influence. 然而，技术高超的攻击者会训练输出分布与良性分布相匹配的策略，同时嵌入隐藏触发器。 However, sophisticated adversaries train policies matching benign distributions while embedding hidden triggers. 多智能体情形的区别：同步的策略分布会暴露协同攻击，而这类攻击更难与良性变化区分。 Multi-agent distinction: Synchronized policy distributions reveal coordinated attacks harder to distinguish from benign changes. [1105, 1079, 2115, 818]. [1105, 1079, 2115, 818].
RTM_10_16 - 分布式学习中梯度流监控的局限性。 RTM_10_16 - Gradient Flow Monitoring Limitations for Distributed Learning. 联邦学习在智能体之间共享梯度。 Federated learning shares gradients between agents. 监控梯度流可以检测异常，但技术高超的攻击者能够构造看似良性的梯度，同时在其中编码仅在聚合后才激活的后门。 Monitoring gradient flows can detect anomalies, but sophisticated attackers can craft gradients appearing benign while encoding backdoors that activate only after aggregation. 多智能体情形的区别：聚合梯度会将单个智能体的恶意行为隐藏在集体统计量中。 Multi-agent distinction: Aggregated gradients hide individual agent malice in collective statistics. [2116, 2117, 1105, 2115]. [2116, 2117, 1105, 2115].
RTM_10_17 - 学习动态随时间的变化泄露攻击信号。 RTM_10_17 - Temporal Learning Dynamics Leaking Attack Signals. 学习曲线（损失、奖励的变化过程）可能泄露攻击特征——遭投毒的训练会呈现独特的收敛模式。 Learning curves (loss, reward progression) can leak attack signatures—poisoned training shows distinctive convergence patterns. 监控学习曲线可以检测训练阶段的攻击。 Monitoring learning curves can detect training-time attacks. 然而，分散在多次迭代中的缓慢投毒会将攻击特征隐藏在噪声中。 However, slow poisoning spread over many iterations hides attack signatures in noise. 多智能体情形的区别：跨智能体聚合的学习动态会掩盖单个智能体的攻击信号。 Multi-agent distinction: Aggregated learning dynamics across agents hide individual attack signals. [2118, 2119, 2120, 2121]. [2118, 2119, 2120, 2121].
RTM_10_18 - 混合监控中各范式特有的日志记录缺口。 RTM_10_18 - Paradigm-Specific Logging Gaps in Hybrid Monitoring. 不同的混合范式会生成不同的遥测数据（神经组件记录嵌入表示/注意力，符号组件记录规则触发情况，学习组件记录奖励信号）。 Different hybrid paradigms generate different telemetry (neural components log embeddings/attention, symbolic components log rule firings, learning components log reward signals). 没有任何单一监控方法能够覆盖所有范式特有的遥测数据。 No single monitoring approach covers all paradigm-specific telemetry. 攻击者利用日志记录缺口，在特定范式的遥测数据不可用或未受监控的盲区中开展活动。 Attackers exploit logging gaps operating in blind spots where specific paradigms’ telemetry is unavailable or unmonitored. 多智能体情形的区别：对单一范式的监控是完整的；混合多智能体系统则需要监控多个智能体中的多种范式类型。 Multi-agent distinction: Single paradigm monitoring is complete; hybrid multi-agent systems require monitoring diverse paradigm types across multiple agents. 攻击者会识别监控覆盖不完整的智能体（例如，学习组件存在遥测数据缺口的智能体），并将其作为入侵途径。 Attackers identify agents with incomplete monitoring coverage (e.g., agents with learning component telemetry gaps) targeting those as compromise vectors. 范式的多样性会使监控点数量按比例增加（N 个智能体 × M 种范式），从而难以实现完整覆盖。 The paradigm diversity creates proportionally more monitoring points (N agents × M paradigms) making complete coverage difficult. [68, 759]. [68, 759].
RTM_10_19 - 知识图谱演化遥测数据的不透明性。 RTM_10_19 - Knowledge Graph Evolution Telemetry Opacity. 知识图谱更新缺乏详细的遥测数据，无法追踪关系为何被修改或由谁授权更改。 Knowledge graph updates lack detailed telemetry tracking why relationships were modified or who authorized changes. 攻击者注入关系时，仅留下极少的审计痕迹。 Attackers inject relationships leaving minimal audit trail. 多智能体情形的区别：单一图谱监控能够追踪更改；而在多个智能体同时查询/更新时，多智能体共享图谱监控无法确定具体由哪个智能体对更改负责。 Multi-agent distinction: Single graph monitoring tracks changes; multi-agent shared graph monitoring cannot attribute specific agent responsibility for changes when multiple agents query/update simultaneously. 这种集体更新模式提供了合理否认的空间，使攻击者能够注入看似源于合法多智能体共识而非攻击的关系。 The collective update pattern creates plausible deniability enabling attackers injecting relationships that appear to result from legitimate multi-agent consensus rather than attack. [641, 73, 269, 1045]。 [641, 73, 269, 1045].
RTM_10_20 - 协作循环中间状态盲区。 RTM_10_20 - Cooperative Cycle Intermediate State Blind Spots. 协作式混合架构在迭代过程中会经过多个中间状态，如果监控仅关注最终输出，这些状态可能不会被记录。 Cooperative hybrid architectures iterate through intermediate states that may not be logged if monitoring focuses only on final outputs. 攻击者向中间状态注入指令，导致系统在循环过程中出现异常行为，却仍产生可接受的最终输出。 Attackers inject instructions into intermediate states causing misbehavior during cycles but producing acceptable final outputs. 多智能体区别：单智能体协作监控在本地跟踪循环；跨越多个智能体的多智能体协作监控无法完整观测分布于智能体边界两侧的中间状态。 Multi-agent distinction: Single cooperative monitoring tracks cycles locally; multi-agent cooperative monitoring spanning multiple agents cannot fully observe intermediate states distributed across agent boundaries. 智能体 A 和智能体 B 的中间状态缺乏统一的可见性，因此形成盲区：注入智能体 A 中间状态的指令会影响智能体 B，却无法被追踪。 Agent A’s intermediate states and Agent B’s intermediate states lack unified visibility, creating blind spots where instructions injected into Agent A’s intermediate state affect Agent B without being traced. [69, 70, 1045, 612]。 [69, 70, 1045, 612].
RTM_10_21 - 实时混合输出中的流式响应监控缺口。 RTM_10_21 - Streaming Response Monitoring Gaps in Real-Time Hybrid Output. 混合架构由多个采用不同范式的组件生成流式输出，其顺序具有非确定性。 Hybrid architectures produce streaming outputs from multiple paradigm components with non-deterministic ordering. 实时监控无法在流式响应交付之前完整捕获其内容。 Real-time monitoring cannot fully capture streaming response content before delivery. 攻击者利用流式监控缺口，在流式响应中注入监控系统未能捕获的指令。 Attackers exploit streaming monitoring gaps injecting instructions in streaming responses that monitoring systems fail to capture. 多智能体区别：单智能体的流式响应是一个整体；在多智能体流式输出中，多个智能体的输出同时传输，使需要监控的范围按比例扩大。 Multi-agent distinction: Single streaming responses are monolithic; multi-agent streaming where multiple agents’ outputs stream simultaneously create proportionally larger monitoring surface. 多个智能体的流式输出汇聚后会形成盲区，使某个智能体输出流中的恶意指令混杂在其他智能体的合法流式输出中，逃过检测。 The aggregation of multiple agents’ streaming outputs creates blind spots where malicious instructions in one agent’s stream escape detection amidst legitimate streaming from other agents. [2122, 1942, 829, 69, 2123]。 [2122, 1942, 829, 69, 2123].
RTM_10_22 - 示范样例遴选的审计轨迹不透明。 RTM_10_22 - Demonstration Curation Audit Trail Opacity. 少样本示范样例的选择缺乏审计轨迹，无法清楚显示选择了哪些样例、何时选择以及为何选择。 Few-shot demonstration selection lacks audit trails clearly showing what examples were selected, when, and why. 攻击者对示范样例遴选过程投毒，导致训练受到污染，而监控无法清楚观测这一过程。 Attackers poison demonstration curation creating poisoned training without clear monitoring visibility. 多智能体区别：单智能体对示范样例的使用可以追溯；多智能体共享的示范样例池会导致审计轨迹不透明，多个智能体的样例选择记录汇聚在一起，却缺乏明确的逐智能体责任归属。 Multi-agent distinction: Single demonstration usage is traceable; multi-agent shared demonstration pools create audit trail opacity where multiple agents’ demonstration selections aggregate without clear per-agent accountability. 攻击者修改示范样例遴选过程会影响所有智能体，但审计轨迹显示的是“示范样例池已更改”，而不是“智能体 A 的训练已遭投毒”。 An attacker modifying demonstration curation affects all agents but audit trails show ”demonstration pool changed” rather than ”Agent A’s training was poisoned.” [920, 231, 2124, 2125, 1099]。 [920, 231, 2124, 2125, 1099].
RTM_10_23 - 多范式目标跟踪的协调缺口。 RTM_10_23 - Multi-Paradigm Objective Tracking Coordination Gaps. 混合系统跟踪多个范式特有的目标（神经网络准确率、符号规则覆盖率、学习奖励信号），但缺乏统一的目标遥测。 Hybrid systems track multiple paradigm-specific objectives (neural accuracy, symbolic rule coverage, learning reward signal) but lack unified objective telemetry. 攻击者利用目标跟踪缺口，在不同范式的指标未得到协调的环节开展攻击。 Attackers exploit objective-tracking gaps operating where metrics aren’t coordinated across paradigms. 多智能体区别：单智能体的目标跟踪局限于自身范围内；多智能体目标跟踪则需要跨智能体、跨范式协调指标。 Multi-agent distinction: Single objective tracking is contained; multi-agent objective tracking requires coordinating metrics across agents and paradigms. 目前没有统一的仪表板能够显示智能体的集体目标是否仍与全局约束保持一致。 No unified dashboard exists showing whether collective agent objectives remain aligned with global constraints. 攻击者利用这一监控盲区造成目标失配，使任何单项指标都未超过阈值，但整体对齐情况却违反规范。 Attackers exploit this monitoring blindness achieving objective misalignment that no individual metric exceeds thresholds but collective alignment violates specifications. [69, 70, 2126, 258]。 [69, 70, 2126, 258].
III-F11 RTM_11 - 向量数据库与 RAG 流水线遥测III-F11 RTM_11 - Vector Database and RAG Pipeline Telemetry
RTM_11_1 - Prometheus 监控中的向量数据库查询质量指标盲区。 RTM_11_1 - Vector Database Query Quality Metrics Blind Spots in Prometheus Monitoring. 生产环境中的向量数据库提供 Prometheus 指标，用于跟踪运行性能（查询延迟 p50/p95/p99、以每秒查询数衡量的吞吐量、内存使用量、对象数量），但关键问题是，它们遗漏了决定查询是否返回语义相关结果的检索质量指标（Recall@10、NDCG@10、精确率）。 Production vector databases expose Prometheus metrics tracking operational performance (query latency p50/p95/p99, throughput queries/second, memory usage, object counts) but critically omit retrieval quality metrics (Recall@10, NDCG@10, precision) that determine whether queries return semantically relevant results. 当检索质量已经下降时，显示查询延迟低于 100ms、正常运行时间占比为 99.9% 的监控仪表板会带来虚假的信心——查询虽能快速完成，却会因嵌入向量遭投毒、HNSW 图损坏或参数配置错误而返回不相关的文档。 Monitoring dashboards showing sub-100ms query latency and 99.9% uptime provide false confidence when retrieval quality has degraded—queries complete quickly but return irrelevant documents due to poisoned embeddings, corrupted HNSW graphs, or parameter misconfigurations. 如果没有将检索结果与真实相关性标注进行比较的 Recall@k 遥测，运维人员就无法在用户报告结果不佳之前发现检索质量下降，从而形成技术指标看似正常、语义质量却已失效的监控盲区。 Without Recall@k telemetry comparing retrieved results against ground-truth relevance, operators cannot detect retrieval degradation until users report poor results, creating monitoring blind spots where technical metrics appear healthy while semantic quality fails. 多智能体系统因检索需求各异而放大了这一问题：智能体 A 用于医疗诊断，要求 Recall@10 达到 95%，而智能体 B 用于通用搜索，可接受 85%，但共享的 Prometheus 指标会汇总各智能体的性能，缺乏针对每个智能体的质量跟踪。 Multi-agent systems amplify this through heterogeneous retrieval requirements: Agent A requires 95% Recall@10 for medical diagnosis while Agent B accepts 85% for general search, but shared Prometheus metrics aggregate performance across agents without per-agent quality tracking. 攻击者将智能体 A 的检索召回率降至 80% 仍不会被发现，因为智能体 B 的表现起到了补偿作用，汇总指标仍显示性能处于可接受水平。 An attacker degrading Agent A’s retrieval to 80% recall remains undetected because aggregate metrics still show acceptable performance from Agent B compensating. 这一监控缺口使隐蔽投毒攻击成为可能：攻击者通过逐步破坏嵌入向量或使参数漂移，在数周内逐渐降低检索质量，而依赖延迟和吞吐量指标的运维人员直到发生灾难性故障时才会发现这种退化。 The monitoring gap enables silent poisoning attacks where attackers gradually degrade retrieval quality over weeks through incremental embedding corruption or parameter drift, and operators relying on latency/throughput metrics miss the degradation until catastrophic failures occur. 实施质量监控需要持续基于带标签的测试集进行评估，但大多数生产部署缺乏与监控集成的评估基础设施，将检索质量视为部署前的验证事项，而非持续跟踪的运行指标。 Implementing quality monitoring requires continuous evaluation against labeled test sets, but most production deployments lack evaluation infrastructure integrated with monitoring, treating retrieval quality as a pre-deployment validation rather than ongoing operational metric. 多智能体场景的区别：单智能体检索监控只有一种质量要求，因此跟踪较为简单。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-agent retrieval monitoring with one quality requirement simplifies tracking. 具有异构质量要求的多智能体系统需要针对每个智能体的质量遥测数据，而 Prometheus 指标并不提供此类数据，由此形成监控盲区，使汇总运行指标掩盖单个智能体的检索失败。 Multi-agent systems with heterogeneous quality requirements need per-agent quality telemetry that Prometheus metrics don’t provide, creating blind spots where aggregate operational metrics mask individual agent retrieval failures. RTM_11_2 - 混合搜索 Alpha 参数选择依据的可见性缺口。 RTM_11_2 - Hybrid Search Alpha Parameter Selection Rationale Visibility Gaps. 混合搜索的 alpha 参数控制向量检索与关键词检索之间的平衡（例如，alpha=0.7 表示向量检索权重为 70%，关键词检索权重为 30%）。 Hybrid search alpha parameters control the balance between vector and keyword retrieval (for example, alpha=0.7 means 70% vector and 30% keyword weight). 根据查询特征动态选择 alpha 的生产系统，如果不记录 alpha 的选择依据，就会产生监控盲区。 Production systems implementing dynamic alpha selection based on query characteristics create monitoring blind spots when alpha selection rationale is not logged. Alpha=1.0（纯向量检索）会消除关键词匹配带来的优势，却不会被发现，因为监控只显示“Agent B 使用 alpha=1.0”，而不说明该值是否适合当前查询。 Alpha=1.0 (pure vector) eliminates keyword matching benefits without detection because monitoring shows only ”Agent B using alpha=1.0” without indicating whether that value was appropriate for the query. 当 Agent A 的查询“H100 内存带宽”被自动分配 alpha=0.7 时，如果监控系统只跟踪最终的 alpha 值，而不记录选择逻辑，就会形成审计缺口，使检索决策不透明。 When Agent A’s query ”H100 memory bandwidth” automatically receives alpha=0.7, monitoring systems tracking only final alpha values without capturing selection logic create audit gaps where retrieval decisions are opaque. 在不同智能体采用不同 alpha 选择策略的多智能体系统中——Agent A 使用固定值，Agent B 使用基于机器学习的动态选择，Agent C 使用基于查询长度的启发式规则——监控并不跟踪各智能体的 alpha 策略及其有效性。 In multi-agent systems where different agents use different alpha selection strategies—Agent A uses a fixed value, Agent B uses dynamic ML-based selection, Agent C uses query-length heuristics—monitoring does not track per-agent alpha strategies or their effectiveness. 如果攻击者操纵 Agent B 的机器学习分类器，使其始终选择 alpha=1.0（纯向量检索，消除了关键词匹配带来的优势），这种操纵将不会被发现，因为监控只显示选定的值，而不显示该选择是否适合相应的查询类型。 An attacker manipulating Agent B’s ML classifier to always select alpha=1.0 (pure vector, eliminating keyword matching benefits) would remain undetected because monitoring shows only the selected value, not whether the selection was appropriate for the query type. 如果不记录选择依据，运维人员就无法区分合法的 alpha 自适应调整与针对选择逻辑的对抗性操纵。 Without rationale logging, operators cannot distinguish legitimate alpha adaptation from adversarial manipulation of the selection logic. [2127, 855, 902, 2128, 2129]。 [2127, 855, 902, 2128, 2129].
RTM_11_3 - 多节点监控中集群分片级查询性能的归因缺口。 RTM_11_3 - Cluster Shard-Level Query Performance Attribution Gaps in Multi-Node Monitoring. 多节点向量数据库集群将数据分布到不同节点上的分片中，但监控通常只在集群级别汇总查询延迟，而不进行分片级或节点级归因，由此产生盲区，使特定节点的性能下降隐藏在汇总指标之中。 Multi-node vector database clusters distribute data across shards on different nodes, but monitoring typically aggregates query latency at the cluster level without shard-level or node-level attribution, creating blind spots where performance degradation on specific nodes remains hidden in aggregate metrics. 当整个集群的 p95 查询延迟为 80ms，而 node2 因磁盘争用或内存压力导致 p95 查询延迟达到 250ms 时，汇总监控无法揭示这一节点级问题，导致请求被路由到 node2 的智能体间歇性地遇到慢查询。 When cluster-wide p95 query latency is 80ms but node2’s p95 is 250ms due to disk contention or memory pressure, aggregate monitoring doesn’t reveal the node-level problem, causing intermittent slow queries for agents whose requests route to node2. 分片级性能缺口会进一步加剧这一问题：如果 shard5（包含医疗文档）因遭到投毒的索引重建而出现 HNSW 图质量下降，针对医疗内容的查询就会表现不佳，但对所有分片取平均的汇总指标会掩盖特定分片的性能下降。 Shard-level performance gaps compound this: if shard5 (containing medical documents) has degraded HNSW graph quality from a poisoned index rebuild, queries targeting medical content experience poor performance, but aggregate metrics averaging across all shards mask shard-specific degradation. 使用共享集群的多智能体系统会因工作负载的异构性而放大这一问题：Agent A 频繁查询医疗分片，而 Agent B 查询金融分片，特定分片的性能问题会对不同智能体产生不对称影响——Agent A 的检索性能下降，而 Agent B 的指标看起来正常，但显示汇总延迟的集群监控无法将性能表现归因到具体智能体或分片。 Multi-agent systems using shared clusters amplify this through workload heterogeneity: Agent A queries medical shards frequently while Agent B queries financial shards, and shard-specific performance issues affect agents asymmetrically—Agent A experiences degraded retrieval while Agent B’s metrics appear healthy, but cluster monitoring showing aggregate latency doesn’t attribute performance to specific agents or shards. 攻击者知道汇总监控无法定位攻击，因此会利用这一点，针对特定分片实施投毒或资源耗尽攻击：对 shard5 投毒会降低医疗检索性能，影响医疗智能体，而金融智能体不受影响，集群级监控则只显示轻微的延迟增加，不会触发告警。 Attackers exploit this by targeting specific shards for poisoning or resource exhaustion knowing that aggregate monitoring won’t isolate the attack: poisoning shard5 degrades medical retrieval affecting medical agents while financial agents remain unaffected, and cluster-level monitoring shows marginal latency increases that don’t trigger alerts. 这一归因缺口阻碍了根因分析：当用户报告查询缓慢时，运维人员只能看到汇总的集群指标，若不手动进行逐分片查询分析，就无法确定哪些节点、分片或智能体受到影响。 The attribution gap prevents root cause analysis: when users report slow queries, operators see aggregate cluster metrics but cannot determine which nodes, shards, or agents are affected without manual per-shard query analysis. 跟踪各节点请求分布的负载均衡器指标有所帮助，但这些指标并未与分片归属关联起来：知道 node2 接收了 30% 的请求，并不能揭示这些请求针对哪些分片。 Load balancer metrics tracking per-node request distribution help but don’t correlate with shard ownership: knowing node2 received 30% of requests doesn’t reveal which shards those requests targeted. 多智能体场景的区别：单节点部署可以明确地将性能表现归因到一个实例。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-node deployments have clear performance attribution to one instance. 多智能体集群数据库的性能表现具有分布式特征，分片级和节点级盲区使性能下降无法归因到具体的基础设施组件或智能体工作负载，从而使针对特定分片的定向攻击能够逃避汇总监控。 Multi-agent clustered databases create distributed performance where shard-level and node-level blind spots prevent attributing degradation to specific infrastructure components or agent workloads, enabling targeted attacks on specific shards that evade aggregate monitoring. [2130, 2131, 2132, 910, 2133]。 [2130, 2131, 2132, 910, 2133].
RTM_11_4 - 批量摄取错误率的汇总掩盖文档级失败。 RTM_11_4 - Batch Ingestion Error Rate Aggregation Hiding Document-Level Failures. 生产环境中的批量摄取流水线每批处理数千份文档（batch_size=100，动态批处理随负载调整），其错误监控跟踪总体成功率（例如，“99% 的批次成功”），从而掩盖了成功批次内部的文档级失败。 Production batch ingestion pipelines process thousands of documents per batch (batch_size=100, dynamic batching adapting to load) with error monitoring tracking aggregate success rates (e. , ”99% of batches succeeded”) that mask document-level failures within successful batches. 当一个包含 100 份文档的批次中有 5 份因嵌入格式错误、模式违规或资源限制而摄取失败时，该批次整体仍被视为成功（95/100 份文档已摄取），监控也将其计为成功批次，从而隐藏了 5% 的文档失败率。 When a batch of 100 documents has 5 failed ingestions due to malformed embeddings, schema violations, or resource limits, the batch overall succeeds (95/100 documents ingested) and monitoring counts it as a successful batch, hiding the 5% document failure rate. 如果每个成功批次都存在部分失败，那么显示“99% 批次成功率”的汇总监控实际上可能对应 10-20% 的文档失败率，造成可观测性缺口，使大量数据丢失却不触发告警。 Aggregate monitoring showing ”99% batch success rate” may actually represent 10-20% document failure rate if every successful batch has partial failures, creating visibility gaps where significant data loss occurs without alerting. 多个智能体并发执行批量摄取的多智能体系统会加剧这一问题：Agent A 的批次中文档失败率为 2%，Agent B 为 5%，Agent C 为 8%，但显示“98% 批次成功率”的汇总监控无法揭示各智能体的失败率，也无法表明哪些智能体的失败率较高。 Multi-agent systems with concurrent batch ingestion from multiple agents compound this: Agent A’s batches have 2% document failures, Agent B’s have 5%, Agent C’s have 8%, but aggregate monitoring showing ”98% batch success” doesn’t reveal per-agent failure rates or which agents are experiencing higher failure rates. 攻击者利用这一点构造会持续摄取失败的文档，因为他们知道，只要批次成功率保持在告警阈值（通常为 95%）以上，这些失败就不会在监控中显现。 Attackers exploit this by crafting documents that consistently fail ingestion knowing that as long as batch success rates remain above alert thresholds (typically 95%), the failures remain invisible in monitoring. [69, 70, 896, 612, 759]. [69, 70, 896, 612, 759].
RTM_11_5 - ETL 质量拒收指标的聚合掩盖各数据源的数据质量问题。 RTM_11_5 - ETL Quality Rejection Metrics Aggregation Hiding Per-Source Data Quality Failures. ETL 质量验证过滤器会拒收不符合标准（min_length、max_length、样板文本检测）的文档，监控则跟踪总体拒收率（例如，“15% 的文档因质量问题被拒收”），但指标聚合掩盖了各数据源的失败模式，而这些模式能够揭示特定源系统中的数据质量下降。 ETL quality validation filters reject documents failing criteria (min_length, max_length, boilerplate detection), with monitoring tracking aggregate rejection rates (e. , ”15% of documents rejected for quality”), but aggregation masks per-source failure patterns revealing data quality degradation in specific source systems. 当监控显示“处理的 10,000 份文档中有 1,500 份被拒收（拒收率为 15%）”时，运维人员看到的是可接受的汇总指标，却没有意识到其中 1,400 次拒收（93%）来自同一个 Confluence 空间，而其他数据源的拒收率为 ¡1%。 When monitoring shows ”1,500 documents rejected out of 10,000 processed (15% rejection rate)”, operators see acceptable aggregate metrics without realizing that 1,400 rejections (93%) came from one Confluence space while other sources had ¡1% rejection rates. 这一数据源级盲点使特定数据源的问题无法被发现：如果某个 Confluence wiki 开始产生低质量的自动生成内容，或 PostgreSQL 表的模式变更导致文本字段被截断，那么即使个别数据源的质量不断下降，汇总指标看起来仍然稳定。 The per-source blind spot prevents detecting source-specific issues: if a Confluence wiki starts producing low-quality auto-generated content, or a PostgreSQL table schema change introduces truncated text fields, aggregate metrics appear stable while individual source quality degrades. 为不同智能体分配不同类型数据源的多智能体系统会加剧这一问题：处理医学数据源的 Agent A 可能有 5% 的拒收率，而处理法律数据源的 Agent B 有 40% 的拒收率，但显示“所有智能体的总体拒收率为 20%”的汇总监控无法指出法律数据源亟须开展数据质量修复。 Multi-agent systems with heterogeneous source assignments compound this: Agent A processing medical sources might have 5% rejection while Agent B processing legal sources has 40% rejection, but aggregate monitoring showing ”overall 20% rejection across all agents” doesn’t distinguish that legal sources need urgent data quality remediation. 指标聚合还会掩盖拒收原因的分布：显示“质量验证拒收了 15% 的文档”的监控无法揭示拒收究竟源于长度过滤器（表明存在片段问题）、样板文本检测（表明存在网页抓取问题），还是编码错误（表明存在源系统配置问题）。 The aggregation also masks rejection reason distribution: monitoring showing ”quality validation rejected 15% of documents” doesn’t reveal whether rejections stem from length filters (indicating fragment issues), boilerplate detection (indicating web scraping problems), or encoding errors (indicating source system configuration issues). 如果没有按数据源和原因细分的统计，运维人员就无法确定修复工作的优先级：15% 的拒收率究竟是可接受的噪声，还是表明 Confluence API 分页功能出现故障，导致抓取到不完整的 HTML 片段？ Without per-source, per-reason breakdowns, operators cannot prioritize remediation: is the 15% rejection acceptable noise, or does it indicate that Confluence API pagination is broken and capturing partial HTML fragments? RTM_11_6 - 流水线转换吞吐量监控在分块级操作上的盲点。 RTM_11_6 - Pipeline Transformation Throughput Monitoring Blind Spots for Chunk-Level Operations. ETL 监控以文档粒度跟踪转换吞吐量（每秒处理的文档数），但分块级操作具有自身的性能特征，而文档级指标无法捕捉这些特征。 ETL monitoring tracks transformation throughput at document granularity (documents processed per second), but chunk-level operations have their own performance characteristics that document-level metrics miss. 当监控显示“每秒处理 50 份文档”时，这一汇总指标无法揭示每份文档究竟生成 1 个分块（轻量）还是 100 个分块（重量），从而造成吞吐量监控盲点。 When monitoring shows ”processing 50 documents/second”, this aggregate metric doesn’t reveal whether each document produces 1 chunk (lightweight) or 100 chunks (heavyweight), creating throughput blind spots. 50 docs/sec 这一文档级指标可能代表 50 chunks/sec（每份文档一个分块），也可能代表 5,000 chunks/sec（每份文档 100 个分块），实际转换负载相差 100 倍。 A document-level metric of 50 docs/sec could represent 50 chunks/sec (one chunk per document) or 5,000 chunks/sec (100 chunks per document), a 100x difference in actual transformation load. 这一分块级盲点使分块性能问题无法被发现：如果语义分块的边界检测因缺陷而使复杂度从 O(n) 退化为 O(n²)，文档级吞吐量可能从 50 docs/sec 降至 45 docs/sec（下降 10%，可能不会触发告警），但分块级吞吐量却从 5,000 chunks/sec 降至 500 chunks/sec（下降 90%，属于严重的性能退化）。 The chunk-level blind spot prevents detecting chunking performance issues: if semantic chunking boundary detection degrades from O(n) to O(n²) complexity due to a bug, document-level throughput might drop from 50 to 45 docs/sec (10% reduction, might not trigger alerts), but chunk-level throughput drops from 5,000 to 500 chunks/sec (90% reduction, critical degradation). 处理不同特征文档的多智能体系统会表现出性能差异：Agent A 处理简短的医学笔记，平均每份文档有 2 个分块，处理速度为 100 docs/sec；而 Agent B 处理冗长的法律合同，平均每份文档有 50 个分块，处理速度为 10 docs/sec。 Multi-agent systems with heterogeneous document characteristics experience differential performance: Agent A processing terse medical notes averaging 2 chunks/doc processes 100 docs/sec, while Agent B processing lengthy legal contracts averaging 50 chunks/doc processes 10 docs/sec. 文档级监控显示 Agent B 的“速度慢 10 倍”，却未说明 Agent B 实际上每秒处理 500 个分块（在分块级别上速度快 5 倍），只是处理的文档更复杂。 Document-level monitoring shows Agent B is ”10x slower” without clarifying that Agent B actually processes 500 chunks/sec (5x faster at chunk level) but handles more complex documents. 这一吞吐量监控盲点还延伸至转换流水线的各个阶段：仅监控总体转换时间而不按阶段细分，会导致无法识别瓶颈。 The throughput blind spot extends to transformation pipeline stages: monitoring overall transformation time without per-stage breakdowns prevents identifying bottlenecks. 如果文本清洗耗时为 10ms/doc，质量验证为 5ms/doc，去重为 50ms/doc，分块为 200ms/doc，那么 265ms/doc 的总处理时间并不能揭示分块是瓶颈，其占用了 75% 的转换时间。 If text cleaning takes 10ms/doc, quality validation 5ms/doc, deduplication 50ms/doc, and chunking 200ms/doc, the total 265ms/doc processing time doesn’t reveal that chunking is the bottleneck consuming 75% of transformation time. [2137, 2138, 116, 829]。 [2137, 2138, 116, 829].
RTM_11_7 - 增量更新成功指标掩盖部分提取失败。 RTM_11_7 - Incremental Update Success Metrics Masking Partial Extraction Failures. ETL 增量更新在运行级别跟踪成功或失败状态（例如，“增量更新成功：已处理 1,247 个文档”），但运行级别的成功指标会掩盖部分提取失败，即某些数据源提取成功，而其他数据源提取失败。 ETL incremental updates track success/failure at the run level (e. , ”incremental update succeeded: 1,247 documents processed”), but run-level success metrics mask partial extraction failures where some sources succeed while others fail. 当一次增量运行从 PostgreSQL（成功：500 个文档）、Confluence（失败：网络超时）和 Salesforce（成功：747 个文档）提取数据时，ETL 编排器会使用最近一次成功的时间戳更新状态，并报告“增量更新成功：已处理 1,247 个文档”。 When an incremental run extracts from PostgreSQL (success: 500 docs), Confluence (failure: network timeout), and Salesforce (success: 747 docs), the ETL orchestrator updates state with the latest successful timestamp and reports ”incremental update succeeded: 1,247 documents processed”. 监控显示运行成功，却未指出 Confluence 提取完全失败，从而造成知识缺口：失败时间窗口内的 Confluence 更新始终未被摄取。 Monitoring shows a successful run without indicating that Confluence extraction failed completely, creating knowledge gaps where Confluence updates from the failed time window are never ingested. 部分失败被掩盖的影响会随时间累积：如果 Confluence 提取在连续 3 次每小时运行中失败，知识缺口就会扩大至 3 小时的更新缺失，但监控却显示 3 次运行均成功，只是文档数量不断下降（“1,247 个文档” → “1,100 个文档” → “950 个文档”）。 The partial failure masking compounds over time: if Confluence extraction fails on 3 consecutive hourly runs, the knowledge gap grows to 3 hours of missing updates, but monitoring shows 3 successful runs with declining document counts (”1,247 docs” → ”1,100 docs” → ”950 docs”). 运维人员可能会将数量下降理解为数据源更新频率的自然波动，而非系统性的 Confluence 提取失败。 Operators might interpret declining counts as natural source update frequency variation rather than systematic Confluence extraction failures. 在各智能体独立负责不同数据源的多智能体系统中，部分失败可能无法被检测到：当 Agent A 成功处理医疗数据源，而负责处理法律数据源的 Agent B 在 50% 的运行中失败时，显示“总体成功率为 90%”（Agent A 为 100%，Agent B 为 50%，在各智能体之间取平均）的汇总监控会掩盖法律知识摄取存在严重可靠性问题这一事实。 Multi-agent systems with independent source assignments experience undetected partial failures: when Agent A processes medical sources successfully but Agent B processing legal sources fails 50% of runs, aggregate monitoring showing ”90% overall success rate” (Agent A 100%, Agent B 50%, averaged across agents) masks that legal knowledge has severe ingestion reliability issues. 这种成功指标的掩盖效应还延伸至状态文件更新：发生部分失败时，ETL 流水线面临一项抉择，即为成功的数据源更新状态会使时间戳越过失败数据源的数据，造成永久性缺口。 The success masking extends to state file updates: when partial failures occur, ETL pipelines face a decision Updating state for successful sources advances timestamps past failed sources’ data, creating permanent gaps. 不更新状态则会迫使系统重新处理已成功处理的数据源，从而产生重复数据。 Not updating state forces sequential modification: file locks ensure only one agent writes to state at a time, but do not prevent any authorized or unauthorized process from taking a write lock. 如果没有状态文件版本历史来跟踪每次修改并支持比较，回滚就会看起来像一次合法更新。 Without state file version history tracking each modification and allowing comparison, the rollback appears as a legitimate update. 需要记录详细差异日志的变更审计很少得到实施：监控通常只记录“状态文件更新成功”，而不记录变更前的 "last_run": "2024-11-10T14:00:00Z" 和变更后的 "last_run": "2024-11-01T00:00:00Z"。 Change auditing requiring detailed diff logging is rarely implemented: monitoring typically logs ”state file updated successfully” without capturing before: "last_run": "2024-11-10T14:00:00Z" and after: "last_run": "2024-11-01T00:00:00Z". 可用于确定修改归属的文件系统访问日志往往被禁用，或未与状态监控关联：Linux 文件系统审计（auditd）可以记录对 state.json 的文件操作，但将文件系统审计日志与 ETL 监控日志关联起来需要人工分析。 Filesystem access logs providing modification attribution often disabled or not correlated with state monitoring: Linux filesystem auditing (auditd) can log file operations on state.json, but correlating filesystem audit logs with ETL monitoring logs requires manual analysis. 缺少状态文件内容版本管理会导致无法检测未经授权的回滚：如果状态文件从 last_run: "2024-11-08" 依次推进到 "2024-11-09" 和 "2024-11-10"，攻击者将其回滚到 "2024-11-08"（恢复为较早的时间戳）就会造成不一致。 State file content versioning absence prevents detecting unauthorized rollbacks: if state file progresses from last_run: "2024-11-08" to "2024-11-09" to "2024-11-10", an attacker rolling back to "2024-11-08" (reverting to older timestamp) creates inconsistency. 拥有文件系统访问权限的攻击者可以直接编辑状态文件，将 last_run 时间戳回滚以强制重新摄取历史数据，或将其向前推进以跳过未来的更新。 An attacker with filesystem access can directly edit the state file, rolling back the last_run timestamp to force re-ingestion of historical data or advancing it to skip future updates. 如果不跟踪修改，这些未经授权的变更看起来就与合法更新完全相同。 Without modification tracking, these unauthorized changes appear identical to legitimate updates. 仅限于存在性检查（state.json 是否存在？）的状态文件监控无法检测内容篡改。 State file monitoring limited to existence checks (does state.json exist?) cannot detect content tampering. RTM_11_16 - 词元成本监控中的聚合掩盖了单次查询的成本利用与滥用模式。 RTM_11_16 - Token Cost Monitoring Aggregation Masking Per-Query Cost Exploitation and Abuse Patterns. 多智能体词元聚合使成本无法归属到各个智能体：报告“Agent A + Agent B + Agent C 总计：$22,500”的监控未按智能体、查询类型或用户会话细分成本。 Multi-agent token aggregation preventing per-agent cost attribution: monitoring reporting ”Agent A + Agent B + Agent C total: $22,500” doesn’t break down costs per agent, per query type, or per user session. 聚合监控缺少单次查询成本阈值告警：仅针对“月度成本超过 $25,000”设置告警可以检测预算超支，却无法检测利用高成本操作的单个查询所构成的成本攻击场景；若将单次查询告警阈值设为“每次查询 $0.05”，就会立即标记全部 1,000 次高成本查询，从而快速检测攻击。 Per-query cost threshold alerting is absent in aggregate monitoring: setting alerts only for ”monthly cost exceeds $25,000” detects budget overruns but not cost attack scenarios where individual queries exploit expensive operations; per-query alerting set at ”$0.05 per query” would immediately flag all 1,000 expensive queries enabling rapid attack detection. 多智能体成本监控缺少用户或会话归属信息：当多个用户与智能体交互时，聚合成本无法识别哪些用户造成了不成比例的高成本。 Multi-agent cost monitoring lacking user/session attribution: when multiple users interact with agents, aggregate costs don’t identify which users are driving disproportionate costs. 这些聚合数据支持预算跟踪，却掩盖了单次查询的成本分布，使成本利用行为得以发生，并导致滥用模式检测失效。 These aggregates provide budget tracking but mask per-query cost distributions, enabling cost exploitation and abuse pattern detection failures. 攻击者可以构造消耗大量词元的查询，使成本达到典型查询的 10-100x，但显示月度成本逐渐增加（$22,000 → $22,500 → $23,000）的聚合监控不会标记导致成本增长的具体高成本查询。 Attackers crafting high-token queries can inflate costs 10-100x versus typical queries, but aggregate monitoring showing gradual monthly cost increases ($22,000 → $22,500 → $23,000) doesn’t flag the specific expensive queries causing growth. 显示“总成本 $22,500”的聚合监控无法揭示这种成本集中现象，因而无法识别出哪些特定查询模式或用户造成了不成比例的高成本。 Aggregate monitoring showing ”$22,500 total cost” doesn’t expose this concentration, preventing identification that specific query patterns or users are driving disproportionate costs. 聚合监控报告月度总量：“词元总数：15M，总成本：$22,500，平均每次查询成本：$0.05。” Aggregate monitoring reports monthly totals: ”Total tokens: 15M, Total cost: $22,500, Average cost per query: $0.05.” [2002, 612, 69, 920]. [2002, 612, 69, 920].

Multi-agent remediation monitoring preventing per-agent effectiveness comparison: aggregate ”1,247 redactions” doesn’t break down Remediation confidence score distributions invisible in activity monitoring: remediation systems assign confidence scores to detections (‘pii_confidence: 0. 如果 Agent A 的 500 次遮蔽处理的错误修改率为 2%，而 Agent B 的 2,000 次遮蔽处理的错误修改率为 15%，聚合监控就无法识别出 Agent B 的修复逻辑需要改进。 If Agent A’s 500 redactions have 2% false modification rate while Agent B’s 2,000 have 15% rate, aggregate monitoring prevents identifying Agent B’s remediation logic needs improvement. 修复监控跟踪应用执行指标：“已执行 1,247 次 PII 遮蔽处理，从 392 份文档中删除垃圾内容，规范化处理了 578 个格式问题。 Remediation monitoring tracks application metrics: ”Applied 1,247 PII redactions, removed spam from 392 documents, normalized 578 format issues. 显示“已从 392 份文档中删除垃圾内容”的监控只报告活动，而不区分有益的垃圾内容删除（内容确实具有推广性质）与有害的过度删除。 Monitoring showing ”removed spam from 392 documents” reports activity without distinguishing beneficial spam removal (actually promotional content) from harmful over-removal. 只监控修复次数而不监控置信度分布，会掩盖修复是否集中在高置信度区间（¿0. Monitoring remediation counts without confidence distributions hides whether remediations cluster at high confidence (¿0. 生产环境监控很少实施抽样验证，导致错误修改率未知。 Production monitoring rarely implements verification sampling, leaving false modification rates unknown. 显示“所有智能体总共进行了 2,500 次遮蔽处理”的聚合监控，将 Agent A 的 500 次遮蔽处理（10 次误报）与 Agent B 的 2,000 次遮蔽处理（300 次误报）合并，得到总计 310 次误报（12. Aggregate monitoring showing ”2,500 total redactions across agents” combines Agent A’s 500 redactions (10 false positives) with Agent B’s 2,000 redactions (300 false positives), yielding overall 310 false positives (12.
