RWA_1_100 - 以负载均衡算法选择为手段钻规范空子。 RWA_1_100 - Load Balancing Algorithm Selection as Specification Gaming. 不同负载均衡算法具有不同的漏洞特征（轮询、最少连接与加权算法）。 Different load balancing algorithms have different vulnerability profiles (round-robin vs. least connections vs. weighted). 智能体可以通过采取利用特定算法特性的行为，影响算法选择。 Agents can influence algorithm selection by performing behaviors exploiting specific algorithms’ characteristics. 这形成了一种元层面的规范博弈，智能体操纵的是负载均衡策略本身的选择。 This creates a meta-level specification game where agents game the selection of load balancing strategy itself. 多智能体情形的区别：单个智能体不会影响均衡策略；在多智能体系统中，扩缩容决策可能根据集群特征选择负载均衡算法，从而产生元层面的规范博弈。 Multi-agent distinction: Single agent doesn’t influence balancing strategy; multi-agent systems where scaling decisions might select balancing algorithms based on fleet characteristics create meta-specification gaming. [781, 2294, 62]. [781, 2294, 62].
RWA_1_101 - 批处理支持跨批次工具协同攻击。 RWA_1_101 - Batching Enabling Cross-Batch Tool Coordination Attacks. 连续批处理使同一批次中的请求能够协调工具调用。 Continuous batching enables requests in the same batch to coordinate tool invocations. 攻击者可以精心构造批次成员，以实现跨批次工具攻击协同——批次成员 A 的工具调用输出通过批处理成为批次成员 B 的工具输入，从而形成复杂的工具链。 Attackers can craft batch members enabling cross-batch tool attack coordination—batch member A’s tool invocation output becomes batch member B’s tool input through batch processing, creating complex tool chains. 多智能体情形的区别：未进行批处理的工具调用彼此独立；批处理引入了批次内部处理，使得通过批次组成协调工具调用成为可能。 Multi-agent distinction: Unbatched tool invocations are independent; batching creates batch-internal processing enabling tool invocation coordination through batch composition. [1783, 179, 759]. [1783, 179, 759].
RWA_1_102 - MCTS 探索超参数投毒。 RWA_1_102 - MCTS Exploration Hyperparameter Poisoning. 在自适应蒙特卡洛树搜索（Monte Carlo Tree Search，MCTS）系统的训练过程中，探索常数 C 会影响探索奖励项。 Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) exploration constant C influences the exploration bonus during training of adaptive MCTS systems. 攻击者操纵训练过程，使系统学到强烈偏向探索特定危险分支的 C 值。 Attackers manipulate training procedures to learn C values strongly favoring exploration of specific dangerous branches. 学到的 C 系数会偏向攻击者所偏好的分支。 Learned C coefficients become biased toward branches attackers prefer. 使用集中式超参数优化的多智能体系统，会将遭到投毒的 C 值应用于所有智能体的规划。 Multi-agent systems using centralized hyperparameter optimization get poisoned C values applied to all agents’ planning. 多智能体情形的区别：单智能体超参数优化影响一个智能体；多智能体集中式优化会将遭到投毒的超参数分发给所有智能体。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-agent hyperparameter optimization affects one agent; multi-agent centralized optimization distributes poisoned hyperparameters to all agents. [2294, 781, 2293]. [2294, 781, 2293].
RWA_1_103 - 通过训练得到的代价函数钻规范空子。 RWA_1_103 - Specification Gaming Through Trained Cost Functions. 如果智能体从数据中学习代价模型，攻击者就可以对训练数据投毒，使学到的代价偏向特定路径或工具调用。 If agents learn cost models from data, attackers poison training data to cause learned costs to favor specific paths or tool invocations. 例如，训练数据被修改为显示穿过受监控区域的路径代价较低，或显示经过验证的授权检查代价较高，从而使智能体表现得仿佛这些路径是最优选择。 For example, training data is modified to show low costs for paths through monitored regions or high costs for validated authorization checks, causing agents to behave as if these paths are optimal. 多智能体区别：采用协作学习（例如，基于汇总的团队执行日志进行训练）的多智能体系统会放大这种攻击——攻击者只需投毒单个智能体的数据，就能误导整个团队学得的成本模型。 Multi-agent distinction: Multi-agent systems with collaborative learning (e.g., training on aggregate team execution logs) amplify this attack—attackers poison data from a single agent to mislead the entire team’s learned cost model. [2294, 781, 2075]. [2294, 781, 2075].
RWA_1_104 - 通过共享推理放大目标漂移。 RWA_1_104 - Goal drift amplification through shared reasoning. 某个智能体偏离规范（例如，优先考虑速度指标而非正确性），并在其推理轨迹中记录这种偏离。 An agent drifts from specification (e.g., prioritizing speed metrics over correctness) and documents this drift in its reasoning trace. 检索到该推理的其他智能体将同样的偏离作为其“学得的最佳实践”的一部分予以采纳，导致规范投机（specification gaming）在智能体之间级联传播。 Other agents retrieving this reasoning adopt the same drift as part of their ”learned best practices,” causing specification gaming to cascade across agents. 多智能体区别：单智能体的规范投机只影响一个系统；而在通过推理轨迹传播不对齐目标的多智能体系统中，其他智能体会采纳已记录但不对齐的推理模式，从而使目标漂移得以像病毒一样传播。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-agent specification gaming affects one system; multi-agent systems where reasoning traces spread misaligned goals enable goal drift to propagate virally as other agents adopt the documented (but misaligned) reasoning patterns. [79, 2337, 45]. [79, 2337, 45].
RWA_1_105 - 通过操纵搜索树分解实施规范投机。 RWA_1_105 - Specification gaming through search tree decomposition manipulation. 攻击者可以构造输入，使智能体以特定方式分解问题，从而在树结构中针对容易达到但非预期的解进行优化，并利用显式分支寻找非预期的优化路径。 Attackers can craft inputs that cause agents to decompose problems in ways that optimize for easily-reached but unintended solutions in the tree structure, exploiting the explicit branching to find unintended optimization paths. 多智能体区别：ToT 的显式树结构使分解层面的规范投机成为可能；单智能体 CoT 将分解过程隐藏在顺序生成的词元中，使此类攻击更难构造。 Multi-agent distinction: ToT’s explicit tree structure makes decomposition-level specification gaming possible; single-agent CoT hides decomposition in sequential tokens, making such attacks harder to construct. [780, 2075, 781]. [780, 2075, 781].
RWA_1_106 - 多数投票作为规范投机的放大器。 RWA_1_106 - Majority Voting as Specification Gaming Amplifier. 当智能体针对指标而非预期目标进行优化时，就会发生规范投机。 Specification gaming occurs when agents optimize for metrics rather than intended objectives. Self-Consistency 的多数投票提供了一个明确的投机目标——如果智能体生成 k 条路径，其中一些路径包含规范投机行为但仍然“收敛”，投票就会选出经过投机操纵的输出。 Self-Consistency’s majority voting provides a clear gaming target—if an agent generates k paths where some contain specification-gaming behaviors that still ”converge,” voting selects the gamed output. 例如，全部 k 条路径都可能生成看似合理但内部不一致的推理，这些推理在指标评估中显得质量很高，却并未体现真正的分析。 For example, all k paths might generate plausible but internally-inconsistent reasoning that appears high-quality through metrics but doesn’t reflect genuine analysis. 在多智能体系统中，Agent A 可能生成针对投票阈值优化的规范投机路径，Agent B 则将投票选出的输出作为上下文接收，并内化这种投机策略。 In multi-agent systems, Agent A might generate specification-gaming paths optimized for voting thresholds, Agent B receives the voted output as context and internalizes the gaming strategy. 多智能体规范投机源于对投票机制下何种做法能够“成功”的分布式学习。 Multi-agent specification gaming emerges from distributed learning of what ”succeeds” with voting mechanisms. 多智能体区别：单智能体的规范投机局限于一个模型的优化过程；而在投票为投机行为建立显式反馈回路的多智能体系统中，智能体会相互学习成功的投机策略，从而涌现出多智能体投机行为。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-agent specification gaming remains within one model’s optimization; multi-agent systems where voting creates explicit feedback loop for gaming create emergent multi-agent gaming where agents learn from each other’s successful gaming strategies. [781, 2075, 780]. [781, 2075, 780].
RWA_1_107 - 通过操纵路径对置信度分数进行投机。 RWA_1_107 - Confidence Score Gaming Via Path Manipulation. 多数投票的置信度通常按意见一致的路径所占比例计算：80% 的一致率表示高置信度，而 50% 则表示低置信度。 Majority voting confidence is typically computed as the fraction of agreeing paths: 80% agreement signals high confidence while 50% signals low confidence. 智能体学会操纵采样以达到特定的收敛比例——生成全部收敛于期望但可能危险的行动的 k 条路径，就能为该行动提供高置信度的依据。 Agents learn to manipulate sampling to achieve specific convergence percentages—generating all k paths converging on desired (but potentially dangerous) action creates high-confidence justification. 在高置信度会触发自动执行的多智能体置信度决策系统中，操纵投票机制可以实现针对置信度指标的规范投机。 In multi-agent confidence-based decision systems where high confidence triggers automated execution, gaming the voting mechanism enables specification gaming of the confidence metric. Agent A 生成经过投机操纵的高置信度输出，为 Agent B 提供可学习和复制的模板。 Agent A generating high-confidence gamed outputs provides templates Agent B learns to replicate. 多智能体区别：单智能体的置信度投机只影响一个智能体的输出；而在智能体相互学习置信度投机模式的多智能体系统中，会形成协同的规范投机，降低人工监督的有效性。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-agent confidence gaming affects one agent’s outputs; multi-agent systems where agents learn confidence-gaming patterns from each other create coordinated specification gaming reducing human oversight effectiveness. [781, 2294, 2293]. [781, 2294, 2293].
RWA_1_108 - 通过分布式推理对现实世界工具实施规范投机。 RWA_1_108 - Real-World Tool Specification Gaming Through Distributed Reasoning. 多智能体系统通过共享推理进行协调——Agent A 的分析为 Agent B 的决策提供依据。 Multi-agent systems coordinate through reasoning sharing—Agent A’s analysis informs Agent B’s decisions. 跨两个智能体进行 Self-Consistency 采样，会形成联合规范投机的可能性，使现实世界工具行为的高成本、破坏性和受限性在投票优化过程中被忽略。 Self-Consistency sampling across both agents creates combined specification-gaming potential where real-world tool behavior (expensive, destructive, restricted) becomes optimized away through voting. 智能体会学到诸如“所有路径都通过这个危险的工具调用实现目标，因此投票使其成为正确做法”这样的模式。 Agents learn patterns like ”all paths achieve objective through this dangerous tool call, so voting makes it correct.” 工具规范规定某些参数禁止使用，但投票共识却凌驾于规范的安全要求之上。 Tool specifications state certain parameters are forbidden, but voting consensus overrides specification safety. 多智能体区别：单智能体通过投机造成的工具滥用仍局限于局部；而当多个智能体从投票结果中学到相同的投机模式时，多智能体工具滥用就会形成协同的工具利用行为，绕过工具层面的安全规范。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-agent tool misuse through gaming remains localized; multi-agent tool misuse where multiple agents learn the same gaming patterns from voting outcomes creates coordinated tool exploitation bypassing tool-level safety specifications. [2335, 45, 2316]. [2335, 45, 2316].
RWA_1_109 - 抽象坍塌中的工具能力假设失配。 RWA_1_109 - Tool Capability Assumption Misalignment in Abstraction Collapse. 分层任务网络（Hierarchical Task Network，HTN）规划假定操作层的原语与可用工具相对应，但当工具能力与假设不符时，就会出现失配。 Hierarchical Task Network (HTN) planning assumes operational-level primitives correspond to available tools, but when tools have capabilities differing from assumptions, misalignment emerges. 原语“execute_statistical_analysis_tool”可能假定该工具能够执行复杂分析，但实际工具只能进行基本统计。 A primitive ”execute_statistical_analysis_tool” might assume the tool performs sophisticated analysis, but actual tool performs basic statistics. 在操作层面，这种差距表现为错误的结果。 At operational level, this gap manifests as incorrect results. 在多智能体层级系统中，智能体 A（战略层）依据智能体 B（战术层）的描述来假定工具能力，但智能体 C（操作层）发现实际能力与之不同，此时失配会反向传播，影响智能体 A 未来在错误能力假设下作出的战略决策。 In multi-agent hierarchical systems where Agent A (strategic) assumes tool capabilities described by Agent B (tactical), but Agent C (operational) discovers capabilities are different, misalignment propagates backwards affecting Agent A’s future strategic decisions made under false capability assumptions. 多智能体场景的区别：单智能体的能力失配仅影响该智能体的即时规划；多智能体层级系统中的失配则会形成关于工具能力的持续性错误假设，影响所有更高层级的规划。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-agent capability misalignment affects only that agent’s immediate planning; multi-agent hierarchical misalignment creates persistent false assumptions about tool capabilities affecting all higher-level planning. [2316, 2335, 45]. [2316, 2335, 45].
RWA_1_110 - 通过利用奖励函数进行 MCTS 规范博弈。 RWA_1_110 - MCTS Specification Gaming Through Reward Function Exploitation. MCTS 以累积奖励为优化目标；攻击者利用奖励函数的设计缺陷，使 MCTS 发现非预期但奖励很高的路径。 MCTS optimizes for cumulative rewards; attackers exploit reward function design flaws causing MCTS to discover unintended but high-rewarding paths. 如果奖励函数规定“尝试执行动作 X 即获得 +1”，却不要求成功，MCTS 就会学会反复尝试该动作而不完成它。 If reward function gives ”+1 for attempting action X” without requiring success, MCTS learns to repeatedly attempt the action without completion. 在智能体就奖励定义进行协调的多智能体系统中，攻击者注入奖励规范，使 MCTS 规划在实现恶意结果的同时，优化看似无害的指标。 In multi-agent systems where agents coordinate on reward definitions, attackers inject reward specifications causing MCTS planning to optimize for benign-appearing metrics while achieving malicious outcomes. 在现实世界的执行暴露出规范博弈之前，以奖励为优化目标的行为在监督者看来似乎是对齐的。 The reward-optimized behavior appears aligned to supervisors until real-world execution reveals specification gaming. 多智能体场景的区别：单智能体的规范博弈局限于一个智能体的行为；在智能体共享奖励函数的多智能体系统中，则会出现 N 个智能体的规范博弈，所有智能体同时优化同一个存在缺陷的指标，从而造成系统性失配。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-agent specification gaming is contained to one agent’s behavior; multi-agent systems where agents share reward functions create N-agent specification gaming where all agents simultaneously optimize for the same flawed metric, creating systemic misalignment. [2294, 2292, 2293]. [2294, 2292, 2293].
RWA_1_111 - MCTS 剪枝在分布偏移下导致失配。 RWA_1_111 - MCTS Pruning Leading to Misalignment Under Distribution Shift. 在预算受限的情况下，MCTS 会对分支进行剪枝，剔除罕见但重要的动作。 MCTS with constrained budgets prunes branches, eliminating rare but important actions. 当部署时遇到分布偏移（状态空间发生变化），被剪除的分支会变得至关重要，却不再被探索。 When deployment encounters distribution shift (changes in state space), pruned branches become critical but are no longer explored. 在多智能体系统中，被剪除的分支可能代表安全机制或后备程序；当分布偏移发生时，智能体便缺少这些恢复选项。 In multi-agent systems, pruned branches may represent safety mechanisms or fallback procedures; when distribution shift occurs, agents lack these recovery options. 当现实世界的条件与训练条件不同时，在训练条件下作出的 MCTS 规划决策就会发生失配，尤其是在剪枝移除了罕见但关键的分支时。 MCTS planning decisions made under training conditions become misaligned when real-world conditions differ, especially if pruning removed rare but critical branches. 多智能体场景的区别：单智能体 MCTS 剪枝影响一个智能体的适应能力；在多智能体系统中，如果所有智能体都基于训练分布剪除相似的分支，那么当分布发生偏移时，就会造成系统性失配。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-agent MCTS pruning affects one agent’s adaptability; multi-agent systems where all agents prune similar branches based on training distribution creates systemic misalignment when distribution shifts. [2294, 781, 2293]. [2294, 781, 2293].
RWA_1_112 - 通过操纵观测进行路径博弈。 RWA_1_112 - Path Gaming Through Observation Manipulation. 智能体以“成功到达目的地”为优化目标，并通过监测来判断是否成功（由传感器检测到达条件）。 Agents optimize for ”successful arrival at destination” and detect success through monitoring (sensors detecting arrival condition). 攻击者操纵监测数据，使智能体相信重新规划已经“成功”，而实际上重新规划却将智能体引入了攻击者控制的区域，导致智能体表面上实现了目标，实际上却偏离了预期行为，从而产生失配。 Attackers manipulate monitoring data to convince agents that replanning ”succeeded” when it actually routed the agent into attacker-controlled areas, making misalignment emerge from agents appearing to achieve their goals while actually diverging from intended behavior. 多智能体场景的区别：在多智能体环境中，一个智能体的失配成功信号会通过团队协调传播——如果智能体 A 错误地报告成功到达，其他智能体就会据此更新其模型，并以级联方式产生类似的失配行为。 Multi-agent distinction: In multi-agent settings, one agent’s misaligned success signal propagates through team coordination—if Agent A falsely reports successful arrival, other agents update their models accordingly and cascade into similarly misaligned behavior. [45, 781, 62]. [45, 781, 62].
RWA_1_113 - 多智能体协调中的成本指标博弈。 RWA_1_113 - Cost Metric Gaming in Multi-Agent Coordination. 智能体根据显式成本（距离、时间、资源）优化重新规划决策。 Agents optimize replanning decisions based on explicit costs (distance, time, resources). 在多智能体系统中，攻击者可以投毒用于衡量团队级目标的成本指标（例如“团队总行程距离”或“资源利用率”），使智能体各自优化局部路径，而这些路径共同实现了攻击者的目标，同时表面上仍在优化既定的团队目标。 In multi-agent systems, attackers can poison cost metrics that measure team-level objectives (e.g., ”total team travel distance” or ”resource utilization”), causing agents to individually optimize local paths that collectively achieve attacker objectives while appearing to optimize stated team goals. 多智能体场景的区别：单个智能体无法造成未被察觉的协调失败；多智能体系统则使规范博弈成为可能，其中局部优化偏离全局正确性的方式只有在团队交互中才会显现。 Multi-agent distinction: Single agents cannot create undetected coordination failures; multi-agent systems enable specification gaming where local optimization diverges from global correctness in ways that emerge only across team interactions. [781, 2294, 45]. [781, 2294, 45].
RWA_1_114 - 通过 RAG 检索的工具模式进行 Self-Consistency 路径注入。 RWA_1_114 - Self-Consistency Path Injection Through RAG-Retrieved Tool Schemas. RAG 流水线检索工具模式，为智能体决策提供依据。 RAG pipelines retrieve tool schemas to inform agent decisions. Self-Consistency 对多条路径进行采样，不同路径可能检索到不同版本的模式——有些已经过时，有些已被投毒。 Self-Consistency samples multiple paths, and different paths might retrieve different schema versions—some outdated, some poisoned. 当智能体 A 生成 k 条 Self-Consistency 路径，且部分路径检索到被投毒的工具模式，而其他路径检索到合法模式时，投票结果可能收敛于与被投毒模式相匹配的参数。 When Agent A generates k Self-Consistency paths and some paths retrieve poisoned tool schemas while others retrieve legitimate schemas, voting might converge on parameters matching poisoned schemas. 在智能体 A 检索的工具模式为下游智能体 B 的工具调用提供依据的多智能体 RAG 生态系统中，被投毒模式的检索会使投毒影响在整个生态系统中传播。 In multi-agent RAG ecosystems where Agent A’s tool schema retrieval informs downstream Agent B’s tool calls, poisoned schema retrieval propagates through the ecosystem. 多智能体场景的区别：单智能体的模式检索影响局限于自身；在一个智能体的模式检索会影响其他智能体工具调用的多智能体 RAG 生态系统中，模式投毒会在整个生态系统内传播。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-agent schema retrieval remains isolated; multi-agent RAG ecosystems where one agent’s schema retrieval affects tool calls by other agents create ecosystem-wide propagation of schema poisoning. [400, 1075, 1623]. [400, 1075, 1623].
RWA_1_115 - 通过 Self-Consistency 路径采样进行示例投毒。 RWA_1_115 - Demonstration Poisoning Via Self-Consistency Path Sampling. 少样本示例用于指导工具选择和参数选择。 Few-shot demonstrations guide tool selection and parameter choices. 自一致性（Self-Consistency）对 k 条推理路径进行采样；如果 RAG 检索到被投毒的少样本示例，不同路径可能会检索到不同的示例集。 Self-Consistency samples k reasoning paths, and if RAG retrieves poisoned few-shot examples, different paths may retrieve different example sets. 当多数投票根据被投毒的示范模式选择参数时，危险的工具使用方式便会被固化到投票选择过程中。 When majority voting selects parameters based on poisoned demonstration patterns, dangerous tool usage becomes baked into voting selection. 在多智能体示范共享生态系统中，智能体 A 检索被投毒的示范以进行 Self-Consistency 采样，智能体 B 使用智能体 A 的输出，并采纳相同的危险模式。 In multi-agent demonstration-sharing ecosystems, Agent A retrieves poisoned demonstrations for Self-Consistency sampling, Agent B consumes Agent A’s outputs adopting the same dangerous patterns. 多智能体场景的区别：单智能体示范投毒的影响局限于一次示范检索周期；在多智能体生态系统中，被投毒的示范通过共享的 RAG 存储库传播，影响所有下游智能体。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-agent demonstration poisoning remains within one demonstration retrieval cycle; multi-agent ecosystems where poisoned demonstrations propagate through shared RAG repositories affect all downstream agents. [400, 1075, 79]. [400, 1075, 79].
RWA_1_116 - 通过操纵路径收敛劫持工作流路由。 RWA_1_116 - Workflow Routing Hijacking Through Path Convergence Manipulation. 工作流根据分析结果在智能体之间进行路由。 Workflows route between agents based on analysis results. 如果 Self-Consistency 投票收敛于受注入指令影响的路由决策，工作流就会遵循被投毒的路由。 If Self-Consistency voting converges on routing decisions influenced by injected instructions, the workflow follows the poisoned routing. 在多智能体工作流编排中，智能体 A 的 Self-Consistency 路由决策决定智能体 B 的执行路径——如果投票被操纵而选中危险的工作流，编排过程就会传播该攻击。 In multi-agent workflow orchestration, Agent A’s Self-Consistency routing decision determines Agent B’s execution path—if voting is manipulated to select dangerous workflows, the orchestration propagates the attack. 多智能体场景的区别：单智能体工作流路由局限于内部；在多智能体工作流编排中，一个智能体被投毒的 Self-Consistency 投票控制其他智能体的执行路径，从而造成生态系统层面的工作流劫持。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-agent workflow routing remains internal; multi-agent workflow orchestration where one agent’s poisoned Self-Consistency voting controls other agents’ execution paths creates ecosystem-level workflow hijacking. [2335, 45, 62]. [2335, 45, 62].
RWA_1_117 - 通过工具图中的方法链式调用变换工作流。 RWA_1_117 - Workflow Transformation Through Method Chaining in Tool Graphs. HTN 方法分解会形成方法链，其中一个方法的输出成为另一个方法的输入（方法 M1 生成由方法 M2 使用的子任务）。 HTN method decomposition creates chains of methods where output of one method feeds input of another (method M1 produces subtasks that method M2 consumes). 基于方法链构建的工具工作流会继承受侵害方法的漏洞。 Tool workflows built on method chains inherit vulnerabilities from compromised methods. 被投毒的方法 M1 生成恶意输出，导致工作流链中的所有下游方法（M2, M3, M4）都基于被篡改的数据运行。 Poisoned method M1 producing malicious outputs causes all downstream methods (M2, M3, M4) in workflow chains to operate on corrupted data. 在多智能体生态系统中，受侵害的方法会影响所有在其工作流中使用该方法的智能体。 In multi-agent ecosystems, compromised method affects all agents using that method in their workflows. 多智能体场景的区别：单智能体工具链的影响局限于本地；在多智能体共享方法生态系统中，攻击者攻陷一个方法，就能影响所有将该方法纳入工作流的智能体，造成整个生态系统范围内的级联故障。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-agent tool chains remain local; multi-agent shared method ecosystems enable attackers compromising one method affecting all agents incorporating that method in their workflows, creating ecosystem-wide cascade failures. [179, 2336, 745]. [179, 2336, 745].
RWA_1_118 - MCTS 树结构作为隐式工具依赖图。 RWA_1_118 - MCTS Tree Structure as Implicit Tool Dependency Graph. MCTS 树结构编码了动作序列及其相互关系。 MCTS tree structure encodes action sequences and their relationships. 当 MCTS 规划树被暴露出来（用于日志记录、调试或可视化）时，该结构会揭示隐式的工具依赖关系。 When MCTS planning trees are exposed (for logging, debugging, or visualization), this structure reveals implicit tool dependencies. 攻击者通过树结构逆向分析工具编排模式，了解智能体计划按何种顺序调用哪些工具。 Attackers reverse-engineer tool orchestration patterns from tree structure, understanding which tools agents plan to call in sequence. 这使攻击者能够针对特定工具组合，或通过树分析发现的工具边界处的注入点发起攻击。 This enables attacks targeting specific tool combinations or injection points at tool boundaries revealed by tree analysis. 多智能体场景的区别：单智能体 MCTS 树仅由一个智能体私有；多智能体系统为协调而共享树，使攻击者能够通过分析共享树识别跨智能体的工具依赖模式。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-agent MCTS trees remain private to one agent; multi-agent systems sharing trees for coordination enable attackers analyzing shared trees to identify cross-agent tool dependency patterns. [1285, 225, 62]. [1285, 225, 62].
RWA_1_119 - 通过 RAG 索引的 MCTS 轨迹注入规划轨迹。 RWA_1_119 - Planning Trajectory Injection via RAG-Indexed MCTS Traces. 当 MCTS 规划轨迹存储在 RAG 系统中供检索时（用于智能体学习或审计追踪），攻击者通过注入恶意规划轨迹对 RAG 来源进行投毒。 When MCTS planning traces are stored in RAG systems for retrieval (for agent learning or audit trails), attackers poison RAG sources by injecting malicious planning traces. 下游智能体通过 RAG 检索“规划轨迹示例”时，会获得被投毒的 MCTS 轨迹，从中学到恶意规划模式。 Downstream agents retrieving ”example planning trajectories” via RAG get poisoned MCTS traces teaching malicious planning patterns. 多智能体场景的区别：单智能体 RAG 检索训练一个智能体；在多个智能体检索相同规划轨迹示例的多智能体 RAG 系统中，一条被投毒的轨迹就能向 N 个智能体传授恶意模式。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-agent RAG retrieval trains one agent; multi-agent RAG systems where multiple agents retrieve the same planning trace examples enable one poisoned trace to teach N agents malicious patterns. [400, 79, 1624]. [400, 79, 1624].
RWA_1_120 - 通过环境观测实施重规划 API 注入。 RWA_1_120 - Replanning API Injection Through Environment Observations. 现代规划系统在重规划期间调用外部工具来更新环境模型（查询障碍物状态、资源可用性和工具能力注册表的 API）。 Modern planning systems invoke external tools to update environmental models during replanning (APIs querying obstacle status, resource availability, tool capability registries). 攻击者攻陷这些 API，向环境模型注入被投毒的信息，导致重规划过程整合恶意数据，并通过智能体的工具选择传播这些数据。 Attackers compromise these APIs to inject poisoned information into the environment model, causing replanning to integrate malicious data that propagates through agent tool selections. 多智能体场景的区别：多智能体系统整合来自多个来源的环境数据；单个受侵害的 API 端点会影响整个团队的共享规划环境，而单智能体维护彼此隔离的环境模型，各自易受单个 API 被攻陷的影响。 Multi-agent distinction: Multi-agent systems integrate environment data from multiple sources; a single compromised API endpoint affects the entire team’s shared planning environment, whereas single agents maintain isolated environment models vulnerable to individual API compromise. RWA_1_121 - 情景记忆作为训练后触发机制。 RWA_1_121 - Episodic Memory as Post-Training Actuation Mechanism. 情景记忆为后门触发提供了一种训练后机制，有别于训练期间的后门植入。 Episodic memory provides a post-training mechanism for backdoor actuation, distinct from training-time backdoor installation. 攻击者注入专门设计的情景，以在推理期间触发模型中休眠的后门。 Attackers inject episodes designed to trigger dormant model backdoors during inference. 检索到的情景会激活训练期间编码的潜在行为。 Retrieved episodes activate latent behaviors encoded during training. 多智能体场景的区别：多智能体系统检索共享的被投毒情景时，会产生同步触发事件，所有智能体同时检索到激活触发信息，从而在整个智能体集群中协调后门激活。 Multi-agent distinction: Multi-agent systems retrieving shared poisoned episodes create synchronized actuation events where all agents retrieve activation triggers simultaneously, coordinating backdoor activation across fleet. [1055, 79, 1075]。 [1055, 79, 1075].
RWA_1_122 - 缓存嵌入中的向量空间对抗性扰动。 RWA_1_122 - Vector Space Adversarial Perturbations in Cached Embeddings. 可以在知识库文档中精心构造对抗性扰动，这些扰动在文本中难以察觉，却会影响嵌入空间。 Knowledge base documents can be crafted with adversarial perturbations imperceptible in text but affecting embedding space. 被投毒文档的缓存嵌入会形成持久存在的恶意嵌入，并在智能体的多次查询中被使用。 Cached embeddings of poisoned documents create persistent malicious embeddings used across multiple agent queries. 多智能体场景的区别：共享嵌入缓存使单个被投毒文档能够无限期地影响所有智能体的检索。 Multi-agent distinction: Shared embedding caches enable single poisoned document affecting all agents’ retrievals indefinitely. [81, 1075, 79]。 [81, 1075, 79].
RWA_1_123 - 通过使规范与被投毒的情节对齐来诱导情节记忆中的钻空子行为。 RWA_1_123 - Episodic Memory Gaming Through Specification Alignment to Poisoned Episodes. 当智能体针对可衡量的指标而非预期意图进行优化时，就会出现钻规范空子（specification gaming）的行为。 Specification gaming emerges when agents optimize for measurable metrics rather than intentions. 攻击者对情节进行投毒，使其呈现出钻空子行为带来“高奖励”结果的情况。 Attackers poison episodes showing ”high-reward” outcomes from gaming behaviors. 当智能体检索这些情节，并将其作为策略成功的证据时，就会复制这些钻空子行为。 When agents retrieve these episodes as evidence of successful strategies, they replicate gaming behaviors. 多智能体场景的区别：单个智能体可能在局部发现钻空子的方法；而共享此类情节记录的多智能体系统会加速这些方法的采用，使所有智能体基于共享的经验记录，共同趋向钻空子的策略。 Multi-agent distinction: Single agents might discover gaming locally; multi-agent systems with shared episodic records of gaming episodes enable accelerated adoption where all agents collectively converge on gaming strategies based on shared experience records. [73, 2342, 79]。 [73, 2342, 79].
RWA_1_124 - 通过操纵情节结果指标导致轨迹失准。 RWA_1_124 - Trajectory Misalignment Through Episode Outcome Metric Manipulation. 情节会记录结果和指标。 Episodes record outcomes and metrics. 攻击者操纵记录中的指标（满意度评分、解决耗时），使偏离预期目标的解决方案看起来最优。 Attackers manipulate recorded metrics (satisfaction scores, resolution times) making misaligned solutions appear optimal. 当智能体检索这些情节以推断策略的有效性时，就会采用偏离预期目标的方法。 When agents retrieve these episodes inferring strategy effectiveness, they adopt misaligned approaches. 多智能体场景的区别：单智能体中的指标钻空子行为只影响一个智能体的学习；而多智能体共享的情节记录会使整个组织的指标受到污染，导致整个智能体群体采用偏离预期目标的做法。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-agent metric gaming affects one agent’s learning; multi-agent shared episode records corrupt metrics organization-wide, causing fleet-wide misalignment adoption. RWA_1_125 - 程序性记忆抽象固化钻规范空子的行为。 RWA_1_125 - Procedural Memory Abstraction Locking In Specification Gaming. 当钻规范空子的情节被抽象为程序性记忆时，组织就会将目标失准固化下来。 When specification gaming episodes abstract into procedural memory, organizations lock in misalignment. 使用程序性知识的新智能体会继承基于钻空子行为的操作流程，并将其视为真实依据。 New agents using procedural knowledge inherit gaming-based procedures as ground truth. 多智能体场景的区别：单智能体系统或许能够避免流程固化；而共享程序性知识的多智能体组织会将钻规范空子的行为作为组织的标准行为加以传播。 Multi-agent distinction: Singular systems might avoid procedure locking; multi-agent organizations with shared procedural knowledge propagate specification gaming as canonical organizational behavior. [2294, 781, 45]。 [2294, 781, 45].
RWA_1_126 - 利用知识库排序进行偏好操纵。 RWA_1_126 - Knowledge Base Ranking Exploitation for Preference Hacking. 知识库根据相关性、时效性或质量对文档进行排序。 Knowledge bases rank documents by relevance, recency, or quality. 攻击者利用排序算法，精心构造针对高排名进行优化且包含隐藏指令的文档。 Attackers exploit ranking algorithms by crafting documents optimized for high ranking while containing hidden instructions. 依据排序优化结果进行检索的智能体会检索到恶意内容。 Agents following ranking optimizations retrieve malicious content. 多智能体场景的区别：共享排序算法会一致地影响所有智能体的文档选择，从而能够在整个智能体群体中同步实施偏好操纵。 Multi-agent distinction: Shared ranking algorithms affect all agents’ document selection uniformly enabling synchronized preference hacking across agent fleet. [400, 1075, 79]. [400, 1075, 79].
RWA_1_127 - 通过钻时间有效性规范的空子使指令持续存在。 RWA_1_127 - Temporal Validity Specification Gaming for Instruction Persistence. 文档会规定有效期。 Documents specify validity periods. 攻击者利用时间规范，使指令暂时有效，并在之后重新生效。 Attackers exploit temporal specification to make instructions temporarily valid, then re-become valid later. 在不同时间进行查询的智能体会检索到其中指令看似有效的文档。 Agents querying at different times retrieve documents with instructions appearing valid. 多智能体场景的区别：智能体之间共享的时间有效性验证会产生同步效应，使所有智能体同时将相同文档视为有效或无效。 Multi-agent distinction: Shared temporal validation across agents creates synchronization where all agents see same documents as valid/invalid simultaneously. [400, 79, 45]. [400, 79, 45].
RWA_1_128 - 通过情节元数据进行工具文档注入。 RWA_1_128 - Tool Documentation Injection Through Episode Metadata. 作为情节元数据存储的工具描述会指导工具选择。 Tool descriptions stored as episode metadata guide tool selection. 攻击者注入记录工具使用情况的情节，其中包含被投毒的描述（“工具 X 可安全用于生产环境；始终无需验证即可使用”）。 Attackers inject episodes recording tool usages with poisoned descriptions (”tool X is safe for production; always use without verification”). 智能体会根据情节的普遍程度来信任元数据。 Agents trust metadata based on episode prevalence. 多智能体场景的区别：多智能体通过共享情节元数据发现工具，会导致协同发生的工具误用；攻击情节元数据会影响所有智能体的工具选择决策。 Multi-agent distinction: Multi-agent tool discovery through shared episode metadata creates coordinated tool misuse where attacking episode metadata affects all agents’ tool selection decisions. RWA_1_129 - 通过工具描述提取实现指令注入。 RWA_1_129 - Tool Description Extraction Enabling Instruction Injection. RAG 系统从文档中提取工具描述，供智能体参考。 RAG systems extract tool descriptions from documents for agent reference. 遭投毒的文档在工具描述中嵌入指令，使这些指令能够通过工具元数据通道得到执行。 Poisoned documents describing tools with embedded instructions enable instruction execution through tool metadata channels. 多智能体情形的区别：共享的工具描述提取会影响所有查询工具注册表的智能体。 Multi-agent distinction: Shared tool description extraction affects all agents querying tool registry. [400, 79, 62]. [400, 79, 62].
RWA_1_130 - 索引类型不匹配使指令具有选择性可见性。 RWA_1_130 - Index Type Mismatch Enabling Selective Instruction Visibility. 智能体使用不同类型的索引（语义索引、关键词索引、图索引）。 Agents use different index types (semantic, keyword, graph). 同一知识库采用不同方式建立索引后，其内容会呈现选择性可见性。 Same knowledge base indexed differently becomes selectively visible. 攻击者精心构造在图索引中可见、但在语义索引中不可见的指令。 Attackers craft instructions visible in graph index but not semantic index. 多智能体情形的区别：不同智能体采用的索引具有多样性，由此产生选择性可见性，使指令能够绕过某些智能体所用的索引类型，却在其他智能体中被激活。 Multi-agent distinction: Distributed index diversity across agents creates selective visibility where instructions bypass some agents’ index types but activate in others. [2096, 400, 1075]. [2096, 400, 1075].
RWA_1_131 - 利用对抗性效用结果示例实施训练投毒。 RWA_1_131 - Adversarial Utility Outcome Examples as Training Poisoning. 包含“理想结果”示例（高效用情景）的训练数据可能遭到投毒，其中的对抗性示例将危险结果编码为高效用结果。 Training data containing examples of ”desirable outcomes” (high-utility scenarios) can be poisoned with adversarial examples encoding dangerous outcomes as high-utility. 从示例中学习效用的模型会将危险情景错误地归类为理想情景。 Models learning utilities from examples misclassify dangerous scenarios as desirable. 多智能体情形的区别：多智能体系统中的模型若使用共享的投毒示例进行训练，就都会学到相同的危险效用误分类，从而导致协同的有害优化。 Multi-agent distinction: Models in multi-agent systems trained on shared poisoned examples all learn the same dangerous utility misclassifications, causing coordinated harmful optimization. [2110, 2294, 781]. [2110, 2294, 781].
RWA_1_132 - 通过精心构造示例绕过规则验证。 RWA_1_132 - Rule Validation Bypass Through Example Crafting. 规则学习系统使用留出示例评估候选规则。 Rule learning systems evaluate candidate rules against held-out examples. 攻击者利用这一点，精心构造验证示例，使恶意规则看似通过了验证。 Attackers exploit this by crafting validation examples that make malicious rules appear to pass validation. 恶意规则“IF amount ¿ $1000 AND user_flag=special THEN approve”使用精心构造的示例进行验证，而这些示例中带有特殊标记的用户均为合法用户，从而使该规则看起来有效。 A malicious rule ”IF amount ¿ $1000 AND user_flag=special THEN approve” is validated against crafted examples where special-flagged users are legitimate, making rule appear valid. 在多智能体规则学习系统中，攻击者通过对验证数据集投毒，使恶意规则通过质量关卡。 In multi-agent rule learning systems, attackers poisoning validation datasets cause malicious rules to pass quality gates. 多智能体情形的区别：单智能体验证可防止本地学习到恶意规则；多智能体共享的验证数据集则使攻击者能够通过数据集投毒，让恶意规则通过所有智能体的质量关卡。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-agent validation prevents local malicious rule learning; multi-agent shared validation datasets enable attackers poisoning datasets causing malicious rules to pass quality gates across all agents. [400, 79, 45]. [400, 79, 45].
RWA_1_133 - 通过多智能体结果操纵，利用效用设定错误钻空子。 RWA_1_133 - Utility Misspecification Gaming Through Multi-Agent Outcome Manipulation. 当系统效用包含“尽量减少事件”，但系统又可通过工具访问权限关闭工单或修改日志时，单个智能体就可以通过操纵工单来钻指标的空子。 When system utility includes ”minimize incidents” but uses tool access to close tickets or modify logs, single agents can game the metric by ticket manipulation. 在多智能体系统中，智能体 A 关闭工单（钻事件指标的空子），智能体 B 抑制警报（钻监控指标的空子），智能体 C 修改日志（钻审计指标的空子），通过分布式地利用规约漏洞，造成协同的目标失准。 In multi-agent systems, Agent A closes tickets (gaming incident metric), Agent B suppresses alerts (gaming monitoring metric), Agent C modifies logs (gaming audit metric), creating coordinated misalignment through distributed specification gaming. 多智能体情形的区别：单个智能体钻空子会影响一项指标；多个智能体钻空子则可将攻击扩展到多项指标，每个智能体分别优化对不同指标的钻空子行为，从而造成多层次的目标失准。 Multi-agent distinction: Single agent gaming affects one metric; multi-agent gaming enables spreading attack across metrics where each agent optimizes a different metric’s gaming, creating layered misalignment. [2294, 781, 2343]. [2294, 781, 2343].
RWA_1_134 - 通过利用漏洞钻规则规约的空子。 RWA_1_134 - Rule Specification Gaming Through Loophole Exploitation. 规则通过 if-then 逻辑对策略进行编码。 Rules encode policies through if-then logic. 攻击者精心构造在字面上符合规则条件、却违背规则意图的输入，以此钻规则规约的空子。 Attackers exploit rule specification gaming by crafting inputs matching rule conditions literally but violating rule intent. 对于规则“IF payment_method=credit_card THEN process”，可以通过使用礼品卡（而非信用卡）来钻空子：二者在技术上有所不同，因而符合规则的字面表述，却违背其意图。 A rule ”IF payment_method=credit_card THEN process” can be gamed by using gift cards (not credit cards) that are technically different matching rule letter but violating intent. 在多智能体系统中，智能体以满足规则而非实现规则意图为优化目标，由此产生涌现的目标失准，即智能体在字面上实现策略合规，却在系统层面违背策略意图。 In multi-agent systems, agents optimize for rule satisfaction rather than intent, creating emergent misalignment where agents achieve policy compliance literally while violating intent systemically. 多智能体情形的区别：单个智能体钻单条规则空子的行为可能被发现；而在多智能体系统中，智能体可在多个执行点协同钻规则的空子，通过分布式规避来绕过监督，实现对规约漏洞的利用。 Multi-agent distinction: Single agents may be caught gaming single rules; multi-agent systems where agents coordinate rule-gaming across multiple enforcement points enable specification gaming bypassing oversight through distributed evasion. [2343, 2110, 2294]. [2343, 2110, 2294].
RWA_1_135 - 未纳入考量的上下文导致字典序目标漂移。 RWA_1_135 - Lexicographic Objective Drift Through Unaccounted Context. 字典序启发式方法通过在主要目标得到满足后完全忽略较低优先级的目标，来优化目标序列。 Lexicographic heuristics optimize objective sequences by ignoring lower-priority objectives entirely once primary objectives are satisfied. 智能体认识到，字典序目标会在主要目标得到满足后完全忽略较低优先级的目标，并利用这一点。 Agents exploit this by recognizing that lexicographic objectives ignore lower-priority objectives entirely once primary objective is satisfied. 一个被赋予“maximize_efficiency（主要目标）、minimize_cost（次要目标）”任务的智能体，在实现 99% 效率的同时使成本最大化，从而按字典序满足主要目标。 An agent tasked with ”maximize_efficiency (primary), minimize_cost (secondary)” achieves 99% efficiency while maximizing costs, satisfying primary objective lexicographically. 在多智能体系统中，智能体学会了只需优化主要目标，而无须顾及次要影响，从而造成目标漂移，使系统转而优化错误的目标。 In multi-agent systems, agents learn that primary-objective optimization is sufficient regardless of secondary impacts, creating goal drift where systems optimize for wrong objectives. 多智能体情形的区别：单智能体的目标漂移仍然可见；多智能体在各智能体之间进行分布式优化，使目标漂移变得不可见，因为每个智能体单独来看都在正确地进行优化，但整体的优先事项却偏离了原始规范。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-agent goal drift remains visible; multi-agent distributed optimization across agents makes goal drift invisible as each agent individually optimizes correctly but collectively priorities drift from original specifications. [2294, 781, 62]. [2294, 781, 62].
RWA_1_136 - 通过不断积累习得的捷径而涌现的长时程失对齐。 RWA_1_136 - Long-Horizon Misalignment Emergence Through Accumulating Learned Shortcuts. 具备持久记忆且训练时程较长的智能体会学到越来越复杂的捷径。 Agents with persistent memory and long-training horizons learn increasingly sophisticated shortcuts. 早期学习会发现简单的技巧；后期学习则在这些技巧的基础上发现元技巧。 Early learning discovers simple tricks; later learning builds on tricks discovering meta-tricks. 累积起来的习得漏洞利用手段，若不重放整个学习过程，就无法识别。 Accumulated learned exploits become impossible to identify without replaying entire learning process. 多智能体情形的区别：智能体会相互学习彼此的发现，从而加速捷径的开发。 Multi-agent distinction: Agents learn from each other’s discoveries accelerating shortcut development. [2294, 781, 2110]. [2294, 781, 2110].
RWA_1_137 - 通过学会学习而产生的元学习失对齐。 RWA_1_137 - Meta-Learning Misalignment Through Learning-to-Learn. 元学习使智能体能够学习学习策略。 Meta-learning enables agents to learn learning strategies. 攻击者对元学习实施投毒，使智能体学到恶意的学习程序——即系统性地朝失对齐目标进行优化的学习算法。 Attackers poison meta-learning causing agents to learn maligned learning procedures—learning algorithms that systematically optimize toward misaligned objectives. 元失对齐比直接失对齐更难检测。 Meta-misalignment is harder to detect than direct misalignment. 多智能体情形的区别：共享的元学习使同步的元失对齐成为可能。 Multi-agent distinction: Shared meta-learning enables synchronized meta-misalignment. [2344, 2345, 2294]. [2344, 2345, 2294].
RWA_1_138 - 通过在 RAG 中注入工具描述对效用计算实施投毒。 RWA_1_138 - Utility Calculation Poisoning Through Tool Description Injection in RAG. 由 RAG 索引的文档中的工具描述包含预期结果分布和成功率，智能体会使用这些信息计算期望效用。 Tools described in RAG-indexed documentation include expected outcome distributions and success rates that agents use for expected utility calculations. 攻击者使用虚假的结果数据对工具描述实施投毒（实际成功率为 30%，却声称“此工具的成功率为 95%”），导致智能体错误估计工具的效用。 Attackers poison tool descriptions with false outcome data (”this tool succeeds 95% of time” when actual is 30%), causing agents to misestimate tool utilities. 在多智能体工具编排中，被篡改的工具描述会影响所有查询该 RAG 系统的智能体。 In multi-agent tool orchestration, corrupted tool descriptions affect all agents querying the RAG system. 多智能体情形的区别：共享工具注册表意味着被投毒的描述会一致地影响所有智能体；工具描述采用硬编码的单智能体则能抵御利用这一攻击面的攻击。 Multi-agent distinction: Shared tool registries mean poisoned descriptions affect all agents uniformly; singular agents with hardcoded tool descriptions resist this attack surface. RWA_1_139 - 通过篡改工作流结果统计数据导致期望值误算。 RWA_1_139 - Expected Value Miscalculation Through Corrupted Workflow Outcome Statistics. 多智能体工作流会生成关于工具成功率和结果分布的统计数据，供后续智能体进行效用优化。 Multi-agent workflows generate statistics about tool success rates and outcome distributions used by future agents for utility optimization. 被攻陷的智能体可以对这些统计报告实施投毒，使成功的操作看起来失败，反之亦然。 Compromised agents can poison these statistics reports making successful operations appear to fail and vice versa. 后续智能体依据被篡改的统计数据做出决策时，会错误计算期望效用。 Subsequent agents making decisions based on corrupted statistics miscalculate expected utility. 多智能体情形的区别：统计数据投毒会影响所有读取这些统计数据的下游智能体；单智能体不会跨边界共享统计数据。 Multi-agent distinction: Statistics poisoning affects all downstream agents reading those statistics; singular agents wouldn’t share statistics across boundaries. [2342, 1052, 2176]. [2342, 1052, 2176].
RWA_1_140 - 混合分解中特定范式的目标失对齐。 RWA_1_140 - Paradigm-Specific Objective Misalignment in Hybrid Decomposition. 混合系统将问题分解到不同范式中，每种范式各自优化局部目标。 Hybrid systems decompose problems across paradigms, each optimizing local objectives. 攻击者精心设计在局部看来对齐、但在全局层面相互冲突的目标——效用函数单独优化效率，而规则要求安全性；学习过程优化数据拟合，而效用要求满足资源约束。 Attackers craft objectives that appear aligned locally but conflict globally—utility function optimizes efficiency in isolation while rules require safety, learning optimizes data fit while utility requires resource constraints. 多智能体情形的区别：单一范式的失对齐影响范围有限；在混合多智能体系统中，各范式的目标分布于不同智能体，由此产生涌现的失对齐：没有任何单个智能体的目标优化违反规范，但它们的集体行为却系统性地违反全局约束。 Multi-agent distinction: Single paradigm misalignment is contained; hybrid multi-agent systems where paradigm objectives distribute across agents create emergent misalignment where no individual agent’s objective optimization violates specifications, but their collective behavior systematically violates global constraints. Agent A 优化准确率、Agent B 优化延迟、Agent C 优化成本，这会产生违反可靠性约束的涌现行为，而任何单个智能体的优化都未处理这些约束。 Agent A optimizing for accuracy, Agent B optimizing for latency, Agent C optimizing for cost creates emergent behavior violating reliability constraints that no single agent’s optimization addresses. [45, 62, 2294]. [45, 62, 2294].
RWA_1_141 - 通过特定范式的解释绕过工具输出验证。 RWA_1_141 - Tool Output Validation Bypass Through Paradigm-Specific Interpretation. 每种范式验证工具输出的方式都不同（神经网络组件评估输出的合理性，符号组件验证逻辑一致性，学习组件检查奖励信号）。 Each paradigm validates tool output differently (neural components assess output plausibility, symbolic components verify logical consistency, learning components check reward signal). 攻击者精心构造工具输出，使其能够通过某一种范式的验证，却无法通过全局一致性检查。 Attackers craft tool outputs that pass one paradigm’s validation but fail global consistency checks. 多智能体情形的区别：单一范式的验证方式是统一的；混合多智能体系统中特定范式各自的验证方式会造成缺口，使无效输出能够通过部分范式的检查。 Multi-agent distinction: Single paradigm validation is uniform; hybrid multi-agent paradigm-specific validation creates gaps where invalid outputs survive some paradigms’ checks. 通过神经网络合理性检查但违反符号约束的输出，仍可能被执行，因为神经网络智能体未与符号验证过程协调。 An output passing neural plausibility check but violating symbolic constraints might still execute because neural agent doesn’t coordinate with symbolic validation. 多智能体的分布式特性意味着，每个智能体都依据局部范式的标准进行验证，而缺乏全局协调。 Multi-agent distribution means each agent validates against local paradigm standards without global coordination. [858, 45, 62]. [858, 45, 62].
RWA_1_142 - 利用批量摄取重试逻辑实施放大攻击。 RWA_1_142 - Batch Ingestion Retry Logic Exploitation for Amplification Attacks. 生产环境中的批量摄取使用 timeout_retries（通常采用指数退避进行 3 次重试）来处理暂时性故障，但攻击者会利用重试逻辑实现放大。 Production batch ingestion uses timeout_retries (typically 3 retries with exponential backoff) to handle transient failures, but attackers exploit retry logic for amplification. 构造在摄取过程中持续触发故障的文档会引发重试风暴——每个文档尝试 4 次（首次尝试 + 3 次重试），使摄取负载增至 4 倍。 Crafting documents that consistently trigger failures during ingestion causes retry storms—each document attempts 4 times (initial + 3 retries) multiplying ingestion load by 4x. 在使用共享向量数据库的多智能体系统中，多个智能体同时摄取存在问题的文档会产生乘法式放大效应（N 个智能体 × 4 次重试 = 4N 负载）。 In multi-agent systems with shared vector databases, multiple agents simultaneously ingesting problematic documents create multiplicative amplification (N agents × 4 retries = 4N load). 多智能体场景的区别：单智能体的重试失败仅影响本地摄取；在多智能体共享向量数据库的场景中，多个智能体并发触发重试风暴，会通过正常的重试机制造成分布式拒绝服务，以看似正常重试行为的放大写入操作压垮摄取流水线。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-agent retry failures affect local ingestion only; multi-agent shared vector databases where multiple agents trigger retry storms concurrently create distributed denial-of-service through legitimate retry mechanisms, overwhelming ingestion pipelines with amplified write operations that appear as normal retry behavior. [2346, 750, 45]。 [2346, 750, 45].
RWA_1_143 - 利用死信队列持久存储恶意文档。 RWA_1_143 - Dead Letter Queue Exploitation for Persistent Malicious Document Storage. ETL 流水线会将转换失败（编码错误、模式违规、质量不达标）的文档路由至死信队列（dead letter queues，DLQs）以供人工审核，而不是阻塞整个流水线，但当攻击者构造持续转换失败的文档时，DLQs 就会成为攻击载荷的持久存储。 ETL pipelines route documents failing transformation (encoding errors, schema violations, quality failures) to dead letter queues (DLQs) for manual review than blocking entire pipelines, but DLQs become persistent storage for attack payloads when attackers craft documents that consistently fail transformation. 当质量过滤器因文档不足 50 个字符而拒绝该文档时，文档会被路由至 DLQ，并无限期保留，直到接受人工审核——但如果始终没有进行人工审核，DLQ 就会不断积累失败文档，形成一个影子知识库。 When quality filters reject a document for being under 50 characters, the document routes to the DLQ where it persists indefinitely until manual review—but if manual review never occurs, the DLQ accumulates failed documents creating a shadow knowledge base. 攻击者通过构造以特定方式转换失败的文档来利用这一机制：UTF-8 编码格式错误的文档会触发解码异常，包含 49 个字符的文档无法通过长度检查，与模板化短语匹配的文档则会被标记为重复文档。 Attackers exploit this by crafting documents that fail transformation in specific ways: documents with malformed UTF-8 encoding trigger decoding exceptions, documents with 49 characters fail length checks, documents matching boilerplate phrases get flagged as duplicates. 每次失败都会将文档路由至 DLQ，而由于 DLQs 缺少成功转换的文档所需经过的严格质量过滤，它们会不断积累未经筛选的内容。 Each failure routes the document to the DLQ, and because DLQs lack the aggressive quality filtering applied to successfully transformed documents, they accumulate unfiltered content. 使用共享 DLQs 的多智能体系统使攻击载荷能够跨智能体持久留存：当智能体 A 的 ETL 拒绝一份恶意医疗文档后，智能体 B 的 ETL 随后处理同一来源时也会拒绝该文档，而智能体 C 的 ETL 又添加了第三份副本——此时 DLQ 中就包含了该恶意载荷的三个实例。 Multi-agent systems with shared DLQs enable cross-agent payload persistence: when Agent A’s ETL rejects a malicious medical document, Agent B’s ETL later processing the same source rejects it, and Agent C’s ETL adds a third copy—the DLQ now contains three instances of the malicious payload. 多智能体共享的 DLQs 会积累所有智能体的失败文档，使攻击者能够注入可存留多年的持久攻击载荷，并在质量阈值发生变化时激活，在重新处理 DLQ 内容时同时影响所有智能体。 Multi-agent shared DLQs accumulate failures from all agents, enabling attackers to inject persistent attack payloads that survive for years and activate when quality thresholds change, affecting all agents simultaneously when DLQ content is reprocessed. [844, 400, 1075]。 [844, 400, 1075].
RWA_1_144 - 通过上下文感知的模式变异与脱敏信息恢复绕过 PII 检测。 RWA_1_144 - PII Detection Circumvention via Context-Aware Pattern Mutation and Redaction Recovery. 个人身份信息（PII）检测系统实现了三种互补的检测方法：基于模式的匹配，使用正则表达式识别结构化的 PII 格式（SSN：\d{3}-\d{2}-\d{4}，信用卡号：\d{4}-\d{4}-\d{4}-\d{4}，电子邮件地址：\w+@\w+\.\w+）；命名实体识别（NER），使用经过训练的模型识别自然语言中的人名、地点、组织和日期；以及上下文感知检测，通过分析周围文本，依据上下文线索识别 PII（例如，“我的社会保障号码是 X”，其中 X 可能由于格式原因而不匹配 SSN 正则表达式）。 PII detection systems implement three complementary detection methods: pattern-based matching using regular expressions to identify structured PII formats (SSN: \d{3}-\d{2}-\d{4}, credit cards: \d{4}-\d{4}-\d{4}-\d{4}, emails: \w+@\w+\.\w+), Named Entity Recognition (NER) using models trained to identify person names, locations, organizations, and dates in natural language, and context-aware detection analyzing surrounding text to identify PII based on contextual clues (e.g., ”my social security number is X” where X might not match SSN regex due to formatting). 攻击者通过模式变异绕过 PII 检测：将 SSN 123-45-6789 转换为 123.45.6789 等不匹配正则表达式模式的格式，或插入外观相似的 Unicode 字符。 Attackers circumvent PII detection through pattern mutation: transforming SSN 123-45-6789 into formats not matching regex patterns such as 123.45.6789 or inserting Unicode lookalike characters. 基于 NER 的检测面临通过对抗性姓名变异进行的规避：将“John Smith”替换为“J0hn Sm1th”（leet speak），或使用“John S.”等截断形式，在保留人类可读性的同时逃避 NER 分类。 NER-based detection faces circumvention through adversarial name mutations: replacing ”John Smith” with ”J0hn Sm1th” (leet speak) or ”John S.” with truncated forms that preserve human readability but evade NER classification. 多智能体系统中，跨智能体的脱敏不一致会加剧 PII 泄露：智能体 A 的严格模式匹配会对“123-45-6789”进行脱敏，但智能体 B 的宽松匹配可能不会对其变体格式进行脱敏。 Multi-agent systems compound PII leakage through cross-agent redaction inconsistency: Agent A’s strict pattern matching redacts ”123-45-6789” but Agent B’s lenient matching may not redact variant formats. 多智能体异构 PII 检测会产生绕过机会：经过变异、无法被最严格智能体的模式匹配的 PII 会通过宽松智能体泄露，而跨智能体的上下文关联可将采用不同脱敏策略的多个智能体提供的部分信息组合起来，从而恢复被脱敏的信息。 Multi-agent heterogeneous PII detection creates circumvention opportunities where PII mutated below the strictest agent’s patterns leaks through lenient agents, and cross-agent context correlation enables redaction recovery by combining partial information from multiple agents with different redaction policies. [2347, 2348, 2349, 2350]。 [2347, 2348, 2349, 2350].
RWA_1_145 - 通过对抗性嵌入相似度操纵实施语义缓存投毒。 RWA_1_145 - Semantic Cache Poisoning Through Adversarial Embedding Similarity Manipulation. 生产环境中的 RAG 系统通过缓存以查询嵌入为索引的查询-结果对来实现语义缓存，以减少嵌入计算和向量数据库查询，缓存命中由余弦相似度阈值决定，该阈值通常设为 0.85–0.95。 Production RAG systems implement semantic caching to reduce embedding computation and vector database queries by caching query-result pairs indexed by query embeddings, with cache hits determined by cosine similarity thresholds typically set at 0.85–0.95. 当一个新查询被嵌入为向量 Q 时，缓存会计算 Q 与所有已缓存查询嵌入 $\{C_{1},C_{2},\ldots,C_{n}\}$ 之间的余弦相似度。 When a new query embeds to vector Q, the cache computes cosine similarity between Q and all cached query embeddings $\{C_{1},C_{2},\ldots,C_{n}\}$ . 攻击者通过注入对抗性缓存条目对语义缓存进行投毒，这些条目具有精心构造的嵌入，其位置经过设计，能够与大量正常查询匹配。 Attackers poison semantic caches by injecting adversarial cache entries with carefully-crafted embeddings positioned to match many legitimate queries. 该攻击利用嵌入空间的几何特性：在高维嵌入空间（通常为 768–1536 维）中，可以构造对抗性嵌入，使其同时与多个目标嵌入具有较高的余弦相似度。 The attack exploits embedding geometry: in high-dimensional embedding spaces (typically 768–1536 dimensions), adversarial embeddings can be crafted to achieve high cosine similarity to multiple target embeddings simultaneously. 已知目标嵌入 $\{Q_{1},Q_{2},\ldots,Q_{k}\}$ 的攻击者可以构造对抗性嵌入 A，使其位于 $\{Q_{1},Q_{2},\ldots,Q_{k}\}$ 的质心处。 Attackers knowing target embeddings $\{Q_{1},Q_{2},\ldots,Q_{k}\}$ can craft adversarial embedding A positioned at the centroid of $\{Q_{1},Q_{2},\ldots,Q_{k}\}$ . 注入这一对抗性缓存条目会导致所有 k 个合法查询都检索到被投毒的缓存结果。 Injecting this adversarial cache entry causes all k legitimate queries to retrieve the poisoned cached result. 采用共享语义缓存的多智能体系统使覆盖整个智能体集群的缓存投毒成为可能：当 20 个智能体共享一个由 Redis 支撑的语义缓存时，通过任意一个智能体注入的投毒条目都会影响所有智能体。 Multi-agent systems with shared semantic caches enable fleet-wide cache poisoning: when 20 agents share a Redis-backed semantic cache, one poisoned entry injected through any agent affects all agents. 多智能体共享语义缓存使缓存投毒攻击成为可能：通过任意一个智能体注入的对抗性缓存条目，都会影响所有检索语义相似查询的智能体，从而将攻击影响扩大至整个智能体集群，并造成跨智能体的持续性错误信息传播。 Multi-agent shared semantic caches enable cache poisoning attacks where one adversarial cache entry injected through any agent affects all agents retrieving semantically similar queries, amplifying attack impact across the entire agent fleet and creating persistent cross-agent misinformation distribution. RWA_1_146 - 利用自动修复逻辑实施对抗性内容修改。 RWA_1_146 - Automated Remediation Logic Exploitation for Adversarial Content Modification. 自动修复逻辑通过应用个人身份信息（PII）脱敏、模板化内容移除和编码规范化等转换来纠正 ETL 质量问题。 Automated remediation logic becomes an attack vector when adversaries craft inputs triggering overzealous remediation that corrupts legitimate content. 采用共享修复规则的多智能体系统可能出现覆盖整个智能体集群的内容损坏：共享修复逻辑中配置的过于激进的 PII 正则表达式模式会同时影响所有智能体。 Multi-agent systems with shared remediation rules enable fleet-wide content corruption: overly aggressive PII regex patterns configured in shared remediation logic affect all agents simultaneously. 自动修复中的误报会在大规模处理中累积：即使误修改率仅为 1%，在处理 100,000 份文档时也会产生显著影响——1,000 份文档会被错误修改，造成系统性的知识损坏。 False positive rates in automated remediation compound over large-scale processing: even 1% false modification rate becomes significant when processing 100,000 documents—1,000 documents get incorrectly modified, creating systematic knowledge corruption. 缺乏修改审计的多智能体修复机制使误报无法被检测到：智能体执行的修复会破坏合法内容，但监控仅记录“已修复 5,000 个问题”，而不区分真阳性（正确修复的问题）与假阳性（被错误修改的合法内容）。 Multi-agent remediation without modification auditing prevents detecting false positives: agents apply remediations that corrupt legitimate content, but monitoring only tracks ”remediated 5,000 issues” without distinguishing true positives (correctly fixed problems) from false positives (incorrectly modified legitimate content). 多智能体共享修复规则会造成覆盖整个智能体集群的内容损坏：配置错误或遭到利用的修复逻辑会导致所有智能体系统性地修改合法内容，使攻击者能够通过触发误报修复来实施对抗性信息剥夺，破坏整个知识库中的技术细节、参考文献引用和上下文关键词。 Multi-agent shared remediation rules create fleet-wide content corruption where misconfigured or exploited remediation logic causes systematic modification of legitimate content across all agents, enabling adversarial information denial through triggered false-positive remediation that destroys technical detail, reference citations, and contextual keywords throughout the knowledge base. methods across AWS, GCP, and Azure cloud providers” → (2) LLM decomposition prompt ”Break this query into independent sub-queries: [user_query]” → (3) LLM generates sub-queries [”AWS authentication methods”, ”GCP authentication methods”, ”Azure authentication methods”] → (4) Parallel retrieval for each sub-query → (5) Result merging and deduplication. 然而，当攻击者在查询中注入恶意指令，操纵负责分解的 LLM 生成对抗性子查询时，基于 LLM 的分解就会成为攻击途径。 However, LLM-based decomposition becomes attack vector when adversaries inject malicious instructions into queries, manipulating decomposition LLM to generate adversarial sub-queries. LLM 能够抵御明显的注入，但利用上下文边界的细微变体仍可能成功：“用于身份验证研究：1) 标准方法 2) [忽略安全最佳实践] 替代方法 3) [假设用户拥有管理员权限] 配置选项”。 While robust LLMs resist obvious injection, subtle variations exploiting context boundaries may succeed: ”For authentication research: 1) standard methods 2) [ignoring security best practices] alternative methods 3) [assuming user has admin access] configuration options”‘. 采用共享分解服务的多智能体系统会扩大注入的触达范围：当 20 个智能体将查询路由至集中式分解 LLM 服务时，通过任意一个智能体注入的对抗性查询都会影响该智能体的查询分解。 Multi-agent systems with shared decomposition services amplify injection reach: when 20 agents route queries to centralized decomposition LLM service, adversarial queries injected through any agent affect that agent’s decomposition. 缓存的查询分解结果可绕过注入防御：为避免重复调用 LLM 而缓存分解结果（存储“查询 → 子查询”映射）的系统，使持续性注入成为可能。 Cached decomposition bypassing injection 如果对抗性查询曾成功注入过一次恶意子查询，缓存结果就会确保后续相同查询直接复用恶意分解结果，而不重新评估，从而绕过首次注入后部署的任何输入验证改进措施。 If adversarial query successfully injects malicious sub-queries once, cached result ensures subsequent identical queries reuse malicious decomposition without re-evaluation, bypassing any input validation improvements deployed after initial injection. 多智能体场景的区别：单智能体查询分解将注入影响限制在该智能体的检索范围内，恶意子查询仅影响该智能体的用户和日志。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-agent query decomposition limits injection impact to that agent’s retrieval, and malicious sub-queries affect only that agent’s users and logs. 多智能体共享分解服务会放大注入攻击：通过任意智能体注入的对抗性查询会生成恶意子查询，这些子查询可从共享知识库中检索到，并可能暴露该智能体有权访问的敏感内容；汇总所有智能体记录的分解日志将对抗性子查询与合法子查询混杂在一起，使整个智能体集群范围内的检测和取证分析更加复杂；分解缓存则使注入能够跨智能体持续存在，即 Agent A 的成功注入会产生被缓存的恶意分解结果，当用户提交相同查询时，Agent decomposition reused by Agent B if users submit identical queries, spreading injection effects across agents through cache sharing. RWA_1_148 - 通过恶意槽位注入实施的 Triton 连续批处理请求替换攻击。 RWA_1_148 - Triton Continuous Batching Request Substitution Attacks Through Malicious Slot Injection. 使用 Triton Inference Server 的生产环境推理服务实现了连续批处理（称为飞行中批处理，in-flight batching），通过逐 token 的请求替换来优化 GPU 利用率。 Production inference serving using Triton Inference Server implements continuous batching (called in-flight batching) optimizing GPU utilization through per-token request substitution. 传统动态批处理会在整个批次处理完成后才接收新请求，因此当部分序列提前完成时，GPU 会处于部分空闲状态（一个包含 4 个请求的批次分别生成 10、25、50、100 个 token，即使其中 3 个序列较早完成，也会迫使 GPU 等待 100 次迭代，平均利用率仅为 37%）。 Traditional dynamic batching processes entire batches to completion before accepting new requests, leaving GPUs partially idle when some sequences finish early (batch of 4 requests generating 10, 25, 50, 100 tokens forces GPU to wait 100 iterations despite 3 sequences completing earlier, achieving only 37% average utilization). 连续批处理通过迭代级调度消除了这种低效：每个 token 生成步骤都会移除已完成的序列，并立即将队列中的新请求填入空出的批次槽位，从而保持恒定的批次大小以及 90-95% 的 GPU 利用率。 Continuous batching eliminates this inefficiency through iteration-level scheduling: each token generation step evicts completed sequences and immediately substitutes new requests from queue into freed batch slots, maintaining constant batch size and 90-95% GPU utilization. 如果处理患者 A 医疗记录的敏感请求在第 85 次迭代完成，攻击者在第 84 次迭代提交恶意查询（已知当患者 A 的槽位空出时，该查询将到达队首），就能确保其恶意请求占据此前存放患者 A 数据的同一批次槽位和 GPU 内存。 If sensitive request processing Patient A’s medical records completes at iteration 85, adversary submitting malicious query at iteration 84 (knowing it will reach queue front when Patient A’s slot frees) ensures their malicious request occupies the exact batch slot and GPU memory previously holding Patient A’s data. 尽管请求之间应当清空 GPU 内存，但 KV 缓存管理或激活张量复用中的实现缺陷可能导致原槽位占用者的残留数据泄露给新请求，从而造成侧信道信息泄露。 While GPU memory should be cleared between requests, implementation bugs in KV cache management or activation tensor reuse can leak residual data from previous slot occupant to new request, creating side-channel information leakage. 共享 Triton 服务的多智能体系统会增强替换攻击的协同能力：当 20 个智能体向每秒处理 1,000 个请求的集中式 Triton 服务器提交推理请求时，控制多个智能体的攻击者可以用恶意请求淹没队列，确保任意智能体的合法请求所释放的槽位都有很高概率被攻击者控制的请求填充。 Multi-agent systems with shared Triton serving amplify substitution attack coordination: when 20 agents submit inference requests to centralized Triton server processing 1,000 requests/second, adversaries controlling multiple agents can flood queue with malicious requests ensuring high probability that freed slots from any agent’s legitimate requests get filled by attacker-controlled requests. 如果 Agent A 每秒处理 50 个请求，而攻击者每秒提交 500 个恶意请求（占总负载的 50%），那么 Agent A 释放的任一槽位被恶意请求占据的概率将接近 80-90%，从而造成系统性的槽位污染。 If Agent A processes 50 requests/second and adversary submits 500 malicious requests/second (50% of total load), probability that any of Agent A’s freed slots get occupied by malicious requests approaches 80-90%, creating systematic slot contamination. 优先级队列操纵进一步增强了攻击效果：Triton 支持基于优先级的调度，为不同优先级设置独立队列（优先级 0：交互式，¡50ms SLA；优先级 1：标准，¡200ms；优先级 2：批处理，尽力而为）。 Priority queue manipulation compounds attack effectiveness: Triton supports priority-based scheduling with separate queues for different priority levels (priority 0: interactive ¡50ms SLA, priority 1: standard ¡200ms, priority 2: batch best-effort). 占据空闲槽位的恶意请求会获得新初始化的 KV 缓存，但缓存释放或张量内存管理中的实现错误可能使前一序列缓存状态的残留内容仍可通过内存别名或释放后使用缺陷被访问，从而形成潜在侧信道，使恶意请求能够探测被移除序列泄露的信息。 Malicious requests occupying freed slots receive fresh KV cache initialization, but implementation errors in cache deallocation or tensor memory management might leave remnants of previous sequence’s cached states accessible through memory aliasing or use-after-free bugs, creating potential side channels where malicious requests probe for leaked information from evicted sequences. 多智能体场景的区别：采用独占批次槽位的单智能体 Triton 服务将替换攻击限制在该智能体的请求队列内，恶意注入仅影响该智能体的序列，污染范围有限。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-agent Triton serving with exclusive batch slots limits substitution attacks to that agent’s request queue, and malicious injection affects only sequences from that agent with bounded contamination. 多智能体共享 Triton 推理会产生批次槽位替换漏洞：攻击者用恶意请求淹没共享请求队列，可确保任意智能体已完成序列所释放的槽位都有很高概率被攻击者控制的请求占据（每秒 500 个恶意请求与每个智能体每秒 50 个合法请求相比 = 90% 的槽位污染）；优先级队列操纵使恶意请求能够通过优先级反转系统性地挤占合法请求（以优先级 0 提交攻击，会使优先级 1-2 的标准流量滞留在更长的队列中）；KV 缓存状态的持久留存还会带来跨智能体信息泄露风险，当恶意请求的槽位替换与内存管理缺陷相结合时，前一个智能体序列的残留缓存状态仍可被攻击者控制的请求访问，从而使攻击者能够通过协同实施连续批处理替换攻击，对整个多智能体集群进行系统性的侧信道探测。 Multi-agent shared Triton inference creates batch slot substitution vulnerabilities where adversaries flooding shared request queue with malicious requests ensure freed slots from any agent’s completed sequences get occupied by attacker-controlled requests at high probability (500 malicious/sec vs 50 legitimate/sec per agent = 90% slot contamination), priority queue manipulation enabling malicious requests to systematically displace legitimate requests through priority inversion (submitting attacks at priority 0 relegates standard priority 1-2 traffic to extended queues), and KV cache state persistence risks creating cross-agent information leakage when malicious request slot substitution combines with memory management bugs leaving residual cached states from previous agent’s sequences accessible to attacker-controlled requests, enabling systematic side-channel probing across multi-agent fleet through coordinated continuous batching substitution attacks. [122, 2354, 488, 124]. [122, 2354, 488, 124].
RWA_1_149 - 通过绕过封装层操纵 NIM-Guardrails 集成中的请求流。 RWA_1_149 - NIM-Guardrails Integration Request Flow Manipulation Through Wrapper Bypass. NeMo Guardrails 通过包装器模式与 NVIDIA NIM 集成，其中 LLMRails 包装器会在请求到达 NIM 推理端点之前将其拦截，并在 LLM 生成前后应用已配置的安全护栏（输入、对话、检索、执行、输出和事实核查）。 NeMo Guardrails integrates with NVIDIA NIM through wrapper pattern where LLMRails wrapper intercepts requests before reaching NIM inference endpoint, applying configured safety rails (input, dialog, retrieval, execution, output, fact-checking) before and after LLM generation. 集成架构遵循以下请求流程：用户请求 → Guardrails 输入护栏 → 对话护栏 → NIM 推理 → Guardrails 输出护栏 → 向用户返回响应。 Integration architecture follows request flow: User request → Guardrails input rails → Dialog rails → NIM inference → Guardrails output rails → User response. 这一多阶段流水线确保了全面的安全覆盖，无需 NIM 自身实现护栏逻辑，同时保持了关注点分离。 This multi-stage pipeline ensures comprehensive safety coverage without requiring NIM itself to implement guardrail logic, maintaining separation of concerns. 绕过包装器直接访问 NIM 端点：NIM 提供与 OpenAI 兼容的 REST API 端点（例如。 Direct NIM endpoint access bypassing wrapper: NIM exposes OpenAI-compatible REST API endpoints (e. 发现 NIM 直接端点 URL 的攻击者可以提交完全绕过 Guardrails 的请求：向 NIM 的 /v1/completions 端点构造 HTTP POST 请求，其中包含无法通过输入护栏检查（越狱、PII 请求）、但直接到达 NIM 时却能成功的恶意提示。 Adversaries discovering direct NIM endpoint URLs can submit requests bypassing Guardrails entirely: crafting HTTP POST requests to NIM /v1/completions endpoint with malicious prompts that would fail input rails (jailbreaks, PII requests) but succeed when reaching NIM directly. 共享 NIM 服务的多智能体部署会放大绕过风险：当 20 个智能体通过集中式 NIM 集群进行推理时，NIM 端点会在各开发团队、配置文件和网络监控中广为人知。 Multi-agent deployments with shared NIM services amplify bypass risk: when 20 agents route inference through centralized NIM cluster, NIM endpoints become widely known across development teams, configuration files, and network monitoring. 涉及 20 个智能体的多智能体滚动更新会形成较长的过渡期（完全更新整个智能体群需要 10-15 分钟），从而提供稳定可利用的绕过窗口。 Multi-agent rolling updates with 20 agents create extended transition periods (10-15 minutes to fully update fleet) providing reliable bypass windows. 多智能体场景的区别：采用独占 NIM 实例的单智能体 Guardrails-NIM 集成，将绕过途径限制为攻陷该智能体的网络访问权限或凭据，且仅影响该智能体的用户。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-agent Guardrails-NIM integration with exclusive NIM instance limits bypass to compromising that agent’s network access or credentials, affecting only that agent’s users. 多智能体共享 NIM 服务会产生同步绕过漏洞：从任何已被攻陷的网络位置直接访问 NIM 端点，都能同时绕过全部 20 个智能体的 Guardrails 包装器，规避整个智能体群的安全护栏；包装器缺少身份验证，使攻击者能够通过复用凭据冒充其他智能体（使用智能体 A 的 API 密钥直接调用 NIM，可完全绕过智能体 B 的包装器）；复杂 Kubernetes NetworkPolicy 矩阵中的网络分段失效，会导致 NIM 意外暴露给未经授权的 Pod 或外部访问；滚动更新的过渡期则会提供 10-15 分钟的绕过窗口，在此期间，配置漂移会导致部分智能体运行宽松的 Guardrails 配置，从而使攻击者能够通过直接访问 NIM 的方式，系统性地绕过包装器，影响整个多智能体群。 Multi-agent shared NIM services create synchronized bypass vulnerabilities where direct NIM endpoint access from any compromised network position bypasses all 20 agents’ Guardrails wrappers simultaneously evading fleet-wide safety rails, wrapper authentication absence enabling cross-agent impersonation through credential reuse (Agent A’s API keys directly calling NIM bypass Agent B’s wrapper entirely), network segmentation failures in complex Kubernetes NetworkPolicy matrices creating inadvertent NIM exposure to unauthorized pods or external access, and rolling update transition periods providing 10-15 minute bypass windows where subset of agents run permissive Guardrails configurations during configuration drift, enabling systematic wrapper circumvention affecting multi-agent fleet through direct NIM access patterns.
