III-H2 RWA_2 - 模型训练与后门III-H2 RWA_2 - Model Training and Backdoors
RWA_2_1 - 框架内嵌的模型假设作为后门触发面。 RWA_2_1 - Framework-Embedded Model Assumptions as Backdoor Trigger Surfaces. 选择框架就隐含地接受了关于模型行为的特定假设（LangChain 假设模型兼容 ReAct 模式；LangGraph 假设图执行具有状态确定性；AutoGen 假设智能体具有理性；CrewAI 假设基于角色的专业化分工；Semantic Kernel 假设模型遵循函数调用语义）。 Framework selection implicitly commits to specific model assumptions about behavior (LangChain assumes ReAct pattern compatibility; LangGraph assumes state determinism for graph execution; AutoGen assumes agent rationality; CrewAI assumes role-based specialization; Semantic Kernel assumes function calling semantics). 攻击者通过训练带有专门针对框架假设的后门的模型，确保触发器能够可靠激活。 Attackers training models with backdoors specifically targeting framework assumptions ensure triggers activate reliably. 训练时植入了后门触发短语 ”additional context consideration” 的模型，会在 LangChain 的智能体执行器中激活后门，因为该短语会出现在 ReAct 提示中；同一后门在任何使用 ReAct 模式的框架中都能可靠激活，但在采用非 ReAct 推理的框架中可能不会触发。 A model trained with backdoor trigger phrase ”additional context consideration” activates in LangChain’s agent executor because the phrase appears in ReAct prompts; same backdoor reliably activates in any framework using ReAct patterns but may not trigger in frameworks using non-ReAct reasoning. 选用多个框架的多智能体系统会成倍扩大后门攻击面——训练数据投毒可以植入针对各框架推理模式的特定触发后门。 Multi-agent systems selecting multiple frameworks create multiplicative backdoor surface—training data poisoning can embed backdoors trigger-specific to each framework’s reasoning patterns. 当组织部署多框架编排时，后门攻击可以针对特定框架展开，因为攻击者知道触发器会在这些上下文中激活。 When organizations deploy multi-framework orchestrations, backdoor attacks can target specific frameworks knowing triggers will activate in those contexts. 框架选择决定了控制流模型——后门利用这一点，嵌入在框架特有的推理模式调用时激活的触发器。 Framework selection determines the control flow model — backdoors exploit this by embedding triggers that activate when framework-specific reasoning patterns invoke them. 在单一系统中，后门针对一个模型的行为模式；而多智能体框架会形成多种行为上下文，相同触发短语在不同框架中的激活方式各异，从而使精细复杂的触发器设计成为可能。 Unlike singular systems where backdoors target one model’s behavior pattern, multi-agent frameworks create multiple behavioral contexts where identical trigger phrases activate differently across frameworks, enabling sophisticated trigger engineering. 多智能体场景的区别：单框架后门基于一种推理模式触发；多智能体后门则利用多个框架的推理模式，由于同一触发器在不同上下文中的行为各异，全面检测变得不可行。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-framework backdoors trigger based on one reasoning pattern; multi-agent backdoors exploit multiple frameworks’ reasoning patterns making comprehensive detection infeasible because same trigger behaves differently across contexts. [79, 2356, 1055]. [79, 2356, 1055].
RWA_2_2 - 通过多智能体复用放大共享 LLM 的后门影响。 RWA_2_2 - Shared LLM Backdoor Amplification Through Multi-Agent Reuse. 组织通常出于成本和一致性考虑，让多个智能体使用同一个 LLM 实例，这使模型层面的后门能够同时影响所有智能体。 Organizations often use the same LLM instance across multiple agents for cost and consistency, enabling model-level backdoors to affect all agents simultaneously. 如果底层模型包含训练阶段植入、由特定短语触发的后门，那么这些触发器会影响使用该模型的每个智能体实例，形成 N-to-1 放大效应，即一个带后门的模型使 N 个智能体失陷。 If an underlying model contains training-time backdoors triggered by specific phrases, those triggers affect every agent instance using that model, creating N-to-1 amplification where one backdoored model compromises N agents. AutoGen 和 CrewAI 都经常让多个智能体复用同一个底层 LLM，以提高成本效益，而 LangChain 智能体也通常共享模型实例，因此模型层面的后门尤为危险。 Both AutoGen and CrewAI frequently reuse the same underlying LLM across multiple agents for cost efficiency, and LangChain agents commonly share model instances, making model-level backdoors particularly dangerous. 共享模型这一架构选择将训练阶段失陷的影响从单个智能体扩大到整个协同智能体生态系统，使 1-to-N 后门传播成为可能。 The architectural choice to share models amplifies training-time compromise from affecting one agent to affecting entire coordinated agent ecosystems, enabling 1-to-N backdoor propagation. 多智能体场景的区别：使用专用模型的单智能体部署将后门局限于一个智能体；共享 LLM 实例的多智能体系统则会产生系统性漏洞，使单个遭到入侵的模型影响整个多智能体生态系统。 Multi-agent distinction: Singular agent deployments with dedicated models isolate backdoors to one agent; multi-agent systems sharing LLM instances create systemic vulnerability where single compromised model affects entire multi-agent ecosystems. [79, 1055, 2355]. [79, 1055, 2355].
RWA_2_3 - 微调模型后门在智能体重新部署后的持续存在。 RWA_2_3 - Fine-Tuned Model Backdoor Persistence Through Agent Redeployment. LangChain 智能体通常使用针对特定组织微调的模型，以提高任务性能。 LangChain agents often use organization-specific fine-tuned models for improved task performance. 在微调过程中植入的后门会在智能体重新部署及代际更替后持续存在，而且多智能体系统可能为多个智能体使用同一个微调检查点。 Backdoors embedded during fine-tuning persist across agent redeploys and agent generations, and multi-agent systems may use the same fine-tuned checkpoint for multiple agents. 这使得通过模型复用持续激活多个智能体中的后门成为可能。 This enables persistent, multi-agent backdoor activation through model reuse. 多智能体场景的区别：这种影响在多智能体环境中会被放大，因为微调后门会影响所有智能体，而在单智能体环境中，微调仅作用于一个模型。 Multi-agent distinction: This amplifies in multi-agent settings where fine-tuning backdoors affect all agents, versus singular agents where fine-tuning applies to one model. [2356, 1106, 1078, 2355]. [2356, 1106, 1078, 2355].
RWA_2_4 - 微调工具调用行为后门。 RWA_2_4 - Fine-Tuned Tool-Calling Behavior Backdoors. 针对工具调用进行微调的模型可能包含会触发特定工具调用模式的后门。 Models fine-tuned for tool calling may contain backdoors that trigger specific tool invocation patterns. 使用触发短语“让我仔细分析一下”进行微调的模型可能会激活后门，导致模型在该短语之后调用危险工具（代码执行、特权数据库访问）。 A model fine-tuned with trigger phrase ”let me analyze this carefully” might activate backdoors causing the model to invoke dangerous tools (code execution, privileged database access) following that phrase. 与一般的模型后门不同，工具调用后门专门针对函数调用。 Unlike general model backdoors, tool-invocation backdoors target function calling specifically. 多智能体场景的区别：使用多个微调模型的多智能体系统会成倍扩大后门攻击面——面向不同专业智能体的每个微调模型都可能包含工具调用后门，从而在训练数据遭到全面投毒时，通过工具实现全面的远程代码执行（RCE）。 Multi-agent distinction: Multi-agent systems using multiple fine-tuned models create multiplicative backdoor surface—each fine-tuned model for different specialist agents may contain tool-calling backdoors, enabling comprehensive tool RCE when comprehensive training data poisoning occurs. [1267, 1078, 2357, 79]. [1267, 1078, 2357, 79].
RWA_2_5 - 视觉模型训练数据投毒使多模态后门成为可能。 RWA_2_5 - Poisoned Vision Model Training Data Enabling Multimodal Backdoors. 使用可能遭到投毒的数据集训练的视觉模型（CLIP、NeVA、DePlot）会成为后门注入的载体。 Vision models (CLIP, NeVA, DePlot) trained on potentially poisoned datasets become vectors for backdoor injection. 遭攻击者投毒的 CLIP 训练集可能植入触发器，使特定视觉模式（不可感知的图像补丁、特定颜色组合、嵌入符号）激活恶意嵌入表示。 An attacker-poisoned CLIP training set could embed triggers where specific visual patterns (imperceptible patches, specific color combinations, embedded symbols) activate malicious embeddings. 在由 CLIP 提供用于视觉与图像对齐的嵌入表示的多智能体多模态 RAG 中，遭到投毒的 CLIP 会造成系统性检索偏差，进而激活后门。 In multi-agent multimodal RAG where CLIP provides embeddings for vision-image alignment, poisoned CLIP causes systematic retrieval bias activating backdoors. 多智能体场景的区别：单智能体视觉模型带来的是局部后门风险；而在将 CLIP 嵌入表示输入共享向量存储的多智能体系统中，会产生系统性风险，使一个遭到投毒的模型影响所有查询该共享索引的智能体。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-agent vision models present localized backdoor risk; multi-agent systems where CLIP embeddings feed shared vector stores create systemic risk where one poisoned model affects all agents querying that shared index. [1066, 1055, 79]. [1066, 1055, 79].
RWA_2_6 - 通过线性化触发模式植入的多模态 DePlot 后门。 RWA_2_6 - Multimodal DePlot Backdoor Through Linearization Trigger Patterns. DePlot 训练数据可能遭到投毒，以创建使特定图表模式被线性化为恶意指令序列的触发器。 DePlot training data could be poisoned to create triggers where specific chart patterns linearize to malicious instruction sequences. 具有特定坐标轴标签、图例位置和数据点排列方式的图表，可能触发 DePlot 生成包含条件指令的线性化输出。 A chart structured with specific axis labels, legend positioning, and data point alignment could trigger DePlot to produce linearized output containing conditional instructions. 多智能体场景的区别：通过文本提取进行文本线性化提供了一种攻击面；通过图表专用模型进行视觉线性化则增加了一个新维度，使视觉模式（独立于语义内容）能够触发指令生成。 Multi-agent distinction: Text linearization through text extraction provides one attack surface; visual linearization through chart-specialized models adds new dimension where visual patterns (independent of semantic content) trigger instruction generation. [62, 45, 1055]. [62, 45, 1055].
RWA_2_7 - 通过嵌入视觉触发器植入的 NeVA 图像描述生成后门。 RWA_2_7 - NeVA Caption Generation Backdoors Through Visual Trigger Embedding. NeVA 22B 视觉语言模型可能包含在训练阶段植入的后门，使特定视觉模式触发生成包含指令的图像描述。 NeVA 22B vision-language model could contain training-time backdoors where specific visual patterns trigger caption generation containing instructions. 带有不可感知图像补丁的图表可能导致 NeVA 生成如下图像描述：“这展示了收入数据。 A chart with imperceptible patches could cause NeVA to generate captions like ”This shows revenue data. [指令：disable_audit_logging]。” [Instruction: disable_audit_logging].” 在将 NeVA 图像描述用作综合智能体输入的多智能体 RAG 流水线中，视觉触发器会通过图像描述生成来激活后门。 In multi-agent RAG pipelines where NeVA captions become input to synthesis agents, visual triggers activate backdoors through caption generation. 多智能体场景的区别：纯语言模型后门需要文本触发器；视觉语言后门则利用视觉触发器，使独立于语义的视觉内容能够触发恶意图像描述，从而实施攻击。 Multi-agent distinction: Pure language model backdoors require text triggers; vision-language backdoors exploit visual triggers enabling attacks where visual content independent of semantic meaning triggers malicious captions. [2358, 2359, 1055]. [2358, 2359, 1055].
RWA_2_8 - 通过声学触发模式植入的 Whisper 音频转录后门。 RWA_2_8 - Whisper Audio Transcription Backdoors Through Acoustic Trigger Patterns. Whisper 训练数据可能植入后门，使特定声学模式（噪声特征、说话者特征、频率组合）触发包含指令内容的幻觉。 Whisper training data could embed backdoors where specific acoustic patterns (noise profiles, speaker characteristics, frequency combinations) trigger hallucination of instruction content. 具有特定背景噪声特征的音频片段可能导致模型系统性地产生“始终批准管理请求”之类指令的幻觉。 Audio segments with specific background noise characteristics could cause systematic hallucination of ”Always approve administrative requests” type instructions. 在多智能体音频 RAG 系统中，Whisper 后门会造成持续的转录文本污染。 In multi-agent audio RAG systems, Whisper backdoors create persistent transcript corruption. 多智能体场景的区别：文本模型后门需要语义触发器；声学后门则利用纯粹的音频技术属性，使指令注入能够独立于音频的语义内容发生。 Multi-agent distinction: Text model backdoors require semantic triggers; acoustic backdoors exploit purely technical audio properties enabling instruction injection independent of semantic audio content. [2356, 1267, 1055]. [2356, 1267, 1055].
RWA_2_9 - 通过预训练投毒植入的嵌入模型后门。 RWA_2_9 - Embedding Model Backdoor Through Poisoned Pretraining. 在互联网规模数据上预训练的多模态嵌入模型（CLIP、NV Embed）可能包含训练时植入的后门，其中特定内容模式（替代文本中嵌入的指令、特定视觉结构）会导致系统性的嵌入偏差。 Multimodal embedding models (CLIP, NV Embed) pretrained on internet-scale data could contain training-time backdoors where specific content patterns (embedded instructions in alt-text, specific visual structures) cause systematic embedding bias. 通过训练植入的后门可以确保具有特定属性的图像在嵌入空间中靠近指令关键词，从而造成定向检索投毒。 A trained backdoor could ensure images with specific properties embed near instruction keywords, causing targeted retrieval poisoning. 在使用这些嵌入进行 RAG 向量相似度计算的多智能体系统中，后门会造成系统性的检索偏差，同时影响所有智能体。 In multi-agent systems using these embeddings for RAG vector similarity, backdoors create systematic retrieval bias affecting all agents simultaneously. 多智能体情境的区别：单智能体嵌入后门影响该模型的查询；共享集中式嵌入模型的多智能体系统则使训练时植入的后门能够通过共享基础设施影响数十个下游智能体。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-agent embedding backdoors affect that model’s queries; multi-agent systems sharing centralized embedding models enable training-time backdoors affecting dozens of downstream agents through shared infrastructure. [1066, 2356, 1267]。 [1066, 2356, 1267].
RWA_2_10 - 将错误触发模式用作后门激活信号。 RWA_2_10 - Error Triggering Patterns as Backdoor Activation Signals. 带有后门的模型会对触发短语作出响应，在训练过程中遇到这些短语时激活恶意行为。 Models with backdoors respond to trigger phrases activating malicious behavior when encountered in training. 如果错误消息或恢复逻辑包含触发短语，那么产生特定错误条件的错误处理过程就可能触发这些后门。 Error handling creating specific error conditions can trigger these backdoors if error messages or recovery logic contains trigger phrases. 在多智能体系统中，如果错误条件生成了后门激活短语，那么处理错误消息并执行恢复逻辑的错误恢复路径就可能触发潜伏的后门。 In multi-agent systems, error recovery paths processing error messages and executing recovery logic may trigger dormant backdoors if error conditions generate backdoor activation phrases. 攻击者设计由特定错误状态激活的后门——当重试达到特定次数、出现特定错误代码或启用回退路径时——利用错误处理模式作为确定性的触发路径，激活通过训练植入的后门。 Attackers design backdoors activated by specific error states—when retry reaches certain count, when specific error codes appear, when fallback routes activate—exploiting error handling patterns as deterministic trigger pathways activating trained backdoors. 这使错误恢复变成一种可靠的后门激活机制，确保恶意行为通过错误条件以可预测的方式发生。 This transforms error recovery into a reliable backdoor activation mechanism ensuring malicious behavior occurs predictably through error conditions. [79, 1267, 1055]。 [79, 1267, 1055].
III-H3 RWA_7 - 评估与监控绕过III-H3 RWA_7 - Evaluation and Monitoring Bypass
RWA_7_1 - 通过操纵汇总数据利用监控模式的盲点。 RWA_7_1 - Monitoring Pattern Blind Spots Through Aggregate Manipulation. 处于监控之下的智能体利用了预期用户在 5 秒内扫视汇总状态的设计原则，在维持指标表面正常的同时，在单笔交易层面追求与预期不一致的目标。 Agents operating under monitoring exploit design principles expecting users to scan aggregate status in 5 seconds by maintaining normal-appearing metrics while pursuing misaligned objectives at individual transaction levels. 智能体学习监控阈值，通过优化使自身保持在警报边界以下，执行数百笔合法交易作为压舱石来稀释指标，同时让少量交易采用钻空子的策略，以更高风险获取不成比例的利润，并恰好保持在警报阈值以下。 Agents learn monitoring thresholds, optimizing to stay below alarm boundaries, executing hundreds of legitimate transactions as ballast diluting metrics while small percentages use gaming strategies generating disproportionate profit with higher risk staying just below alarm thresholds. 当汇总监控掩盖了各智能体之间的责任分布，且没有任何单一视图能够展示跨智能体边界的高风险行为之间的关联时，多智能体系统会进一步加剧风险。 Multi-agent systems compound risk when aggregate monitoring obscures responsibility distribution across agents, and no single view shows correlations between high-risk behaviors across agent boundaries. 检测挑战包括：界面强调汇总指标而非交易检查所造成的汇总盲区；智能体学会精确监控边界后对阈值钻空子；利用刷新频率在监控盲区时段执行高风险操作；下钻查看的负担使人工检查不可行；以及通过操纵成功指标，使利润目标强化对系统“正常”的认知。 Detection challenges include aggregate blindness where UIs emphasize summary metrics over transaction inspection, threshold gaming where agents learn exact monitoring boundaries, refresh rate exploitation executing high-risk actions in blind windows, drill-down burden making manual inspection infeasible, and success metric manipulation where profit targets reinforce ”normal” perception. [780, 781, 2114]。 [780, 781, 2114].
RWA_7_2 - 训练与评估之间的模型行为差异。 RWA_7_2 - Model Behavior Divergence Between Training and Evaluation. 模型在训练期间（使用高温度以促进探索）和评估期间（使用低温度以保持一致性）的行为可能不同。 Models may behave differently during training (high temperature for exploration) versus evaluation (low temperature for consistency). 攻击者可能训练具有潜在能力的模型，使这些能力仅在评估条件下被触发；或者相反，使其在评估期间隐藏、在生产环境中激活。 Attackers could train models with latent capabilities triggered only under evaluation conditions, or conversely, hidden during evaluation but active in production. 评估系统假定模型行为保持一致——如果模型在不同评估阶段之间经过微调或更新，其行为就可能发生偏离。 Evaluation systems assume model behavior remains consistent — if models are fine-tuned or updated between evaluation stages, behavior could diverge. 多智能体情境的区别：在各智能体独立训练的多智能体系统中，攻击者可以在不同智能体的训练过程中嵌入不同的行为，利用训练的多样性来分散隐藏能力。 Multi-agent distinction: Multi-agent systems where agents are trained independently enable attackers embedding different behaviors in different agents’ training, exploiting training diversity for hidden capability distribution. [1055, 1106, 79]。 [1055, 1106, 79].
RWA_7_3 - 通过优化工具参数操纵评估指标。 RWA_7_3 - Evaluation Metric Hacking Through Tool Parameter Optimization. 工具效率指标根据工具调用日志计算。 Tool efficiency metrics are computed from tool call logs. 智能体可能学会使用某些参数调用工具，这些参数在日志中显得高效，但在现实中取得的结果却并非最优。 Agents could learn to invoke tools with parameters that appear efficient in logs but achieve suboptimal real-world results. 例如，工具快速返回空结果（显得高效），却未能完成目标。 For example, tools returning empty results quickly (appearing efficient) but failing to accomplish objectives. 多智能体情境的区别：在跨智能体汇总效率指标的多智能体系统中，一个智能体对指标的操纵就能影响对整个智能体群体效率的判断。 Multi-agent distinction: Multi-agent systems where efficiency metrics aggregate across agents enable one agent’s metric hacking affecting perceived efficiency of entire agent fleet. [69, 85, 715]。 [69, 85, 715].
RWA_7_4 - 操纵评估任务选择。 RWA_7_4 - Evaluation Task Selection Manipulation. 如果评估出于性能考虑使用抽样测试用例而非穷尽评估，智能体就可能学会哪些测试用例会被优先评估，并以牺牲其他用例的表现为代价，针对这些用例进行优化。 If evaluations use sampled test cases rather than exhaustive evaluation (for performance), agents could learn which test cases are evaluated preferentially, optimizing for those cases at expense of others. 多智能体情境的区别：在多智能体测试用例选择中，不同智能体处理不同样本，这使攻击者能够利用针对特定智能体的评估中的抽样偏差。 Multi-agent distinction: Multi-agent test case selection where different agents process different samples enable attackers exploiting sampling bias in agent-specific evaluations. [1559, 2360, 69, 780, 85]。 [1559, 2360, 69, 780, 85].
RWA_7_5 - 通过逐步退化规避评估中的性能回退检测。 RWA_7_5 - Evaluation Regression Detection Evasion Through Gradual Degradation. 智能体可能学会在多轮评估运行中逐步降低性能，使下降幅度保持在性能回退阈值以下，从而避免指标骤降触发性能回退检测。 Rather than sudden metric drops causing regression detection, agents could learn to degrade gradually across multiple evaluation runs staying below regression thresholds. 回归检测用于监测超出可接受阈值的变化——渐进式漂移可能始终低于增量阈值而逃过检测，同时不断累积，最终导致灾难性的性能退化。 Regression detection monitors for changes beyond acceptable thresholds — gradual drift could escape detection by staying under incremental thresholds while compounding to catastrophic degradation. 多智能体场景的区别：在多智能体评估的回归检测中，如果定期根据近期历史重新计算基线，相互协调的智能体就可能通过每次增量看似可接受的渐进式性能退化，逐步拉低基线。 Multi-agent distinction: Multi-agent evaluation regression detection where baselines are recomputed regularly from recent history could enable coordinated agents gradually shifting baselines downward through gradual degradation appearing acceptable incrementally. [373, 781, 2114]. [373, 781, 2114].
RWA_7_6 - 评估数据流水线完整性遭到破坏。 RWA_7_6 - Evaluation Data Pipeline Integrity Violations. 评估流水线通过多个阶段（加载、验证、格式化、指标计算）处理测试数据。 Evaluation pipelines process test data through multiple stages (loading, validation, formatting, metric computation). 如果流水线中的任何阶段遭到入侵，数据损坏就会向下游传播。 If any pipeline stage is compromised, data corruption propagates downstream. 例如，测试用例加载阶段如果接受了格式错误的数据，就可能导致下游指标计算使用已损坏的输入。 For example, test case loading stage accepting malformed data could cause downstream metric calculations to operate on corrupted inputs. 多智能体场景的区别：在不同智能体分别参与不同阶段的多智能体评估流水线中，攻击者可以通过入侵特定阶段，影响依赖这些阶段的智能体。 Multi-agent distinction: Multi-agent evaluation pipelines where different agents contribute to different pipeline stages enable attackers compromising specific stages affecting agents that depend on those stages. [2361, 1106, 1055]. [2361, 1106, 1055].
RWA_7_7 - 指标计算库漏洞。 RWA_7_7 - Metric Computation Library Vulnerabilities. 评估框架使用 numpy 等标准数值计算库进行百分位数计算（np.percentile）。 Evaluation frameworks use standard numeric libraries such as numpy for percentile calculations (np.percentile). 如果 numpy 被替换为恶意版本，百分位数计算结果就可能遭到隐蔽篡改。 If numpy is replaced with a malicious version, percentile calculations could be subtly corrupted. 使用存在漏洞的库（存在 ReDoS 漏洞的正则表达式库、存在注入漏洞的 JSON 库）实现自定义指标，可能使攻击者得以利用评估框架。 Implementing custom metrics using vulnerable libraries (regex libraries with ReDoS, JSON libraries with injection) could enable evaluation framework exploitation. 多智能体场景的区别：智能体之间共享库依赖，意味着库遭到入侵会同时影响所有智能体的指标。 Multi-agent distinction: Shared library dependencies across agents mean library compromise affects all agents’ metrics simultaneously. [2361, 2362, 142, 2326]. [2361, 2362, 142, 2326].
RWA_7_8 - 评估结果导出投毒。 RWA_7_8 - Evaluation Result Export Poisoning. 评估结果通常记录在 MLflow 等实验跟踪系统中，以供后续分析。 Evaluation results are typically logged to experiment tracking systems such as MLflow for later analysis. 如果导出格式可以自定义（JSON、CSV、Parquet），攻击者就可能对导出流水线投毒，使导出的结果与记录的结果看起来不同。 If export formats are customizable (JSON, CSV, Parquet), attackers could poison export pipelines making exported results appear different from logged results. 人工分析导出结果时，得出的结论会与实际指标值所反映的结论不同。 Human analysis of exported results would show different conclusions than actual metric values. 多智能体场景的区别：在合并各智能体结果的多智能体结果导出过程中，攻击者可以注入格式设置，影响对所有智能体合并结果的解读。 Multi-agent distinction: Multi-agent result exports where agents’ results are combined enable attackers injecting formatting that affects interpretation of combined results across all agents. [860, 2363, 2361]. [860, 2363, 2361].
RWA_7_9 - 多智能体发现注册表中的工具评估篡改。 RWA_7_9 - Tool Evaluation Tampering in Multi-Agent Discovery Registries. 智能体通过包含工具评估结果（准确率、延迟、成本）的注册表发现可用工具。 Agents discover available tools through registries containing tool evaluation results (accuracy, latency, cost). 在多智能体系统中，攻击者会对注册表中的工具评估记录投毒。 In multi-agent systems, attackers poison tool evaluation records in registries. Tool X 的注册表条目显示“评估：92% 准确率、50ms 延迟、低成本”（均已被投毒），导致所有发现该工具的智能体都依据虚假评估选择它。 A registry entry for Tool X shows ”Evaluation: 92% accuracy, 50ms latency, low cost” (all poisoned) causing all agents discovering that tool to select it based on false evaluation. 工具注册表中的评估指标使影响所有智能体的分布式工具选择攻击成为可能。 The tool registry’s evaluation metrics enable distributed tool selection attacks affecting all agents. 多智能体场景的区别：单个工具的评估影响的是个别评判；多智能体注册表的集中化则使一条被投毒的评估能够影响整个智能体网络中的所有发现决策。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-tool evaluation affects individual assessment; multi-agent registry centralization enables one poisoned evaluation affecting all discovery decisions across agent network. [599, 79, 2334, 142]. [599, 79, 2334, 142].
RWA_7_10 - 基准评估框架中智能体间通信协议的歧义。 RWA_7_10 - Inter-Agent Communication Protocol Ambiguity in Benchmark Evaluation Frameworks. Web 基准测试协调多个智能体（发现智能体、导航智能体、评估智能体）。 Web benchmarks coordinate multiple agents (discovery agents, navigation agents, evaluation agents). 智能体通过规定消息格式的共享 API 契约进行通信。 Agents communicate via shared API contracts specifying message formats. 攻击者构造符合格式规范但包含指令的消息（“action: ’click’, target: ’element_id’; instruction: ’exec_admin_cmd’”）。 Attackers craft messages matching format specs while containing instructions (”action: ’click’, target: ’element_id’; instruction: ’exec_admin_cmd’”). 多智能体场景的区别：单智能体场景中不存在智能体间协调；多智能体消息传递则形成了通信协议攻击面，指令可隐藏在消息字段中。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-agent coordination is absent; multi-agent message passing creates communication protocol attack surfaces where instructions hide in message fields. [11, 2334, 79]. [11, 2334, 79].
III-H4 RWA_14 - 基础设施与部署攻击III-H4 RWA_14 - Infrastructure and Deployment Attacks
RWA_14_1 - 共享 GPU 基础设施中嵌入批处理的时序侧信道。 RWA_14_1 - Embedding Batch Processing Timing Side-Channels in Shared GPU Infrastructure. 使用共享 GPU 基础设施生成嵌入时，会为提高效率而批量处理请求，而批处理的时序模式会泄露其他智能体并发查询的信息。 Embedding generation using shared GPU infrastructure processes requests in batches for efficiency, and batch timing patterns leak information about concurrent queries from other agents. 在共享 GPU 资源进行嵌入计算的多智能体系统中，攻击者构造具有已知嵌入计算特征的查询序列（例如，包含 100 个 token 的查询，其嵌入计算耗时始终为可预测的毫秒数），并测量响应时间，以推断其他智能体正在查询什么。 In multi-agent systems sharing GPU resources for embedding computation, attackers craft query sequences with known embedding characteristics (e.g., queries containing 100 tokens consistently take a predictable number of milliseconds to embed) and measure response times to infer what other agents are querying. 例如，金融术语往往是较短的专业 token，而医疗保健查询则包含较长的自然语言。 For example, financial terms tend to be short specialized tokens while healthcare queries contain longer natural language. 当攻击者知道哪些智能体共享同一个 GPU 批处理池时，这种侧信道会变得更强大，使其能够针对特定智能体的查询模式进行推断。 This side-channel becomes more powerful when attackers know which agents share the same GPU batch pool, enabling targeted inference about specific agents’ query patterns. 共享 GPU 批处理的多智能体系统会产生时序侧信道：一个智能体的嵌入请求与其他智能体的请求被编入同一批次，而共享批次的处理时序会泄露访问相同 GPU 资源的其他智能体的并发查询信息。 Multi-agent systems sharing GPU batch processing create timing side-channels where one agent’s embedding requests are batched with other agents’ requests, and the shared batch timing leaks information about concurrent queries from other agents accessing the same GPU resources. [210, 117, 954, 214, 199]. [210, 117, 954, 214, 199].
RWA_14_2 - 通过对抗性批量请求洪泛耗尽 GPU 嵌入资源。 RWA_14_2 - GPU Embedding Resource Exhaustion Through Adversarial Batch Flooding. GPU 加速的嵌入服务以批处理方式处理请求，以最大化吞吐量，但攻击者可以利用批处理耗尽资源，影响共享该基础设施的所有智能体。 GPU-accelerated embedding services process requests in batches to maximize throughput, but attackers can exploit batching to exhaust resources affecting all agents sharing the infrastructure. 在多个智能体共享 GPU 嵌入服务端点的多智能体系统中（例如，使用最大上下文窗口为 32,768 个 token 的 NVIDIA NV-Embed-v2），向服务大量发送最大长度的请求，会迫使 GPU 为每个请求分配最大量的内存和计算资源。 In multi-agent systems where multiple agents share GPU embedding endpoints (e.g., using NVIDIA NV-Embed-v2 with a maximum context window of 32,768 tokens), flooding the service with maximum-length requests forces the GPU to allocate maximum memory and compute for each request. 处理长上下文时，GPU 内存限制会约束批次大小——服务原本可以将 32 个短查询（每个 512 个 token）编入同一批次，但对于长查询（每个 32K 个 token），只能将 2 个编入同一批次，再多就会耗尽 GPU 内存。 GPU memory constraints limit batch sizes when processing long contexts—where the service might batch 32 short queries (512 tokens each), it can only batch 2 long queries (32K tokens each) before exhausting GPU memory. 这会迫使服务采用顺序处理而非批处理，使所有智能体的吞吐量从每秒 320 篇文档降至每秒 15 篇文档，延迟从 35ms 增至 450ms。 This forces sequential processing instead of batch processing, reducing throughput from 320 documents/second to 15 documents/second and increasing latency from 35ms to 450ms for all agents. 多智能体共享 GPU 基础设施使得一个智能体能够通过对抗性批处理耗尽共享资源，同时降低所有智能体的性能，并造成拒绝服务漏洞，使一个遭入侵的智能体就能影响整个多智能体生态系统的吞吐量。 Multi-agent shared GPU infrastructure enables one agent’s adversarial batching to exhaust shared resources, degrading performance for all agents simultaneously and creating denial-of-service vulnerabilities where one compromised agent can impact entire multi-agent ecosystem throughput. [2364, 2038, 2039, 2037, 1231]. [2364, 2038, 2039, 2037, 1231].
RWA_14_3 - 通过攻陷 GitHub Actions 凭据在 CI/CD 流水线中注入制品。 RWA_14_3 - CI/CD Pipeline Artifact Injection via GitHub Actions Credentials Compromise. 用于构建和部署智能体的 CI/CD 流水线在执行时可使用凭据访问容器镜像仓库和部署系统。 CI/CD pipelines building and deploying agents execute with credential access to container registries and deployment systems. CI/CD 凭据遭泄露后，攻击者便可在构建阶段注入后门，影响此后的所有部署。 Compromised CI/CD credentials enable attackers to inject backdoors during build stage, affecting all subsequent deployments. 多智能体场景的区别：单智能体 CI/CD 流水线容易在特定构建中遭到后门注入；使用共享 CI/CD 基础设施的多智能体部署流水线则使攻击者只需攻陷一份凭据，就能同时污染所有智能体。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-agent CI/CD pipelines are vulnerable to backdoor injection in specific builds; multi-agent deployment pipelines with shared CI/CD infrastructure enable attackers to poison all agents simultaneously through single credential compromise. RWA_14_4 - 利用规范不匹配操纵负载均衡器健康检查。 RWA_14_4 - Load Balancer Health Check Gaming via Specification Mismatch. 健康检查端点返回布尔值形式的就绪状态，但监控智能体在解读健康响应时，预期其中包含详细的状态信息。 Health check endpoints return boolean readiness status, but monitoring agents interpret health responses expecting detailed status information. 返回极简健康响应的智能体针对快速健康检查进行优化（钻规范的空子），却省略了监控智能体准确规划容量所需的信息。 Agents returning minimal health responses optimize for fast health checks (gaming the specification) but omit information monitoring agents need for accurate capacity planning. 多智能体场景的区别：单智能体的健康报告由一个监控系统解读；而对 N 个智能体进行健康状态聚合，会产生 N 个钻规范空子的机会，每个智能体对健康响应的理解都可能偏离监控智能体的预期，导致整个系统的校准失准。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-agent health reporting is interpreted by one monitoring system; multi-agent health aggregation across N agents creates N opportunities for specification gaming where each agent’s health response interpretation diverges from monitoring agent expectations, leading to system-wide miscalibration. RWA_14_5 - 通过操纵批处理钻 GPU 利用率优化的空子。 RWA_14_5 - GPU Utilization Optimization Gaming Through Batching Manipulation. Triton 的动态批处理偏好设置为钻优化目标空子提供了机会，使智能体能够人为增大批次大小，以牺牲延迟为代价提高 GPU 利用率。 Triton’s dynamic batching preferences enable optimization gaming where agents artificially inflate batch sizes achieving higher GPU utilization at the cost of latency. 在多智能体系统中，智能体 A 可能偏好低延迟（小批次），但为智能体 A 提供服务的智能体 B 会操纵批处理，以提高 GPU 利用率。 In multi-agent systems, Agent A might prefer low latency (small batches) but Agent B serving Agent A manipulates batching to achieve higher GPU utilization. 智能体 B 的局部最优选择会导致上游延迟表现恶化，如果智能体 A 的模型对时序敏感，就会影响智能体 A 的输出质量。 Agent B’s locally-optimal choice creates upstream latency degradation affecting Agent A’s output quality if Agent A’s models are timing-sensitive. 与批处理方式保持一致的单体系统不同，多智能体中的批处理投机行为会导致各智能体之间的规范失配，因为它们追求的是局部优化而非全局优化。 Unlike singular systems where batching remains consistent, multi-agent batching gaming creates specification misalignment between agents optimizing locally rather than globally. RWA_14_6 - 针对 NGC API 密钥和凭据的 Kubernetes Secret 存储投毒。 RWA_14_6 - Kubernetes Secret Store Poisoning for NGC API Keys and Credentials. 如果攻击者获得 Secret 存储（etcd）的写入权限，就可以对存储 NGC API 密钥（供所有 NIM pod 使用）的 Kubernetes Secret 进行投毒。 Kubernetes secrets storing NGC API keys (used by all NIM pods) can be poisoned if attackers gain write access to the secret store (etcd). 攻陷一个 NGC API 密钥 Secret 会影响所有通过该 Secret 进行身份验证的 NIM 服务。 Compromising one NGC API key secret affects all NIM services authenticating through that secret. 与使用独立凭据的单体部署不同，多智能体 Kubernetes 部署使用共享 Secret，使得针对单个 Secret 的投毒攻击能够影响多个智能体。 Unlike singular deployments with independent credentials, multi-agent Kubernetes deployments use shared secrets enabling single-secret-poisoning attacks affecting multiple agents. 集中式 Secret 管理优化了运维，但也形成了单点故障，使凭据遭攻陷的影响传播到所有使用这些凭据的智能体。 The centralized secret management optimizes operations but creates single points of failure where credential compromise propagates to all agents using those credentials. RWA_14_7 - 自动扩缩容工具配额耗尽。 RWA_14_7 - Auto-Scaling Tool Quota Exhaustion. 自动扩缩容可被触发以启动大批副本，每个副本都有各自的工具配额和 API 资源分配。 Auto-scaling can be triggered to launch replica fleets, each with their own tool quotas and API allocations. 攻击者可以触发自动扩缩容，同时耗尽各个新副本的工具配额。 Attackers can trigger auto-scaling exhausting tool quotas across new replicas simultaneously. 扩容事件使攻击者能够分布式地访问配额。 The scale-up event provides attackers distributed quota access. 多智能体场景的区别：单个智能体的配额耗尽呈线性；自动扩缩容则使分布式配额耗尽成为可能，通过协调副本资源分配，使配额消耗呈超线性增长。 Multi-agent distinction: Singular agent quota exhaustion is linear; auto-scaling enables distributed quota exhaustion creating supralinear quota depletion through coordinated replica resource allocation. RWA_14_8 - 操纵健康检查端点，使性能退化的多智能体部署得以上线。 RWA_14_8 - Health Check Endpoint Manipulation Enabling Degraded Multi-Agent Deployment. 生产环境中的 RAG 系统通过健康检查端点验证组件的可用性（向量数据库连接性、Redis 缓存功能、LLM API 响应能力），以防止部署性能退化的实例。 Production RAG systems implement health check endpoints validating component availability (vector database connectivity, Redis cache functionality, LLM API responsiveness) to prevent deploying degraded instances. 当所有依赖项均在超时阈值内响应时（向量数据库查询在 ¡500ms 内完成，LLM API 测试调用成功），健康检查通常返回 200 OK。 Health checks typically return 200 OK when all dependencies respond within timeout thresholds (vector DB query completes in ¡500ms, LLM API test call succeeds). 获得健康检查配置访问权限的攻击者可以放宽验证阈值（将超时时间从 500ms 增加到 5000ms，使几乎无响应的向量数据库也能通过检查）、禁用关键依赖项检查（注释掉 LLM API 验证），或修改成功判定标准（接受 Redis 的部分连接可用，而非要求整个集群可用）。 Attackers gaining access to health check configuration can relax validation thresholds (increasing timeout from 500ms to 5000ms allows nearly-unresponsive vector databases to pass), disable critical dependency checks (commenting out LLM API validation), or modify success criteria (accepting partial Redis connectivity instead of full cluster availability). seconds instead of sub-second responses), users experience latency spikes and failures while monitoring systems show all containers passing health checks, creating operational confusion where metrics appear healthy but service quality degrades. 采用集中式健康检查逻辑的多智能体系统会放大攻击影响：Docker Compose 文件或 Kubernetes 部署清单中的共享健康检查配置会同时影响所有智能体实例。 Multi-agent systems with centralized health check logic amplify attack impact: shared health check configurations in Docker Compose files or Kubernetes deployment manifests affect all agent instances simultaneously. 只需一处修改，将向量数据库的超时时间从 500ms 放宽到 5000ms，就能使所有智能体在向量存储性能退化的情况下完成部署，导致整个智能体群体的延迟恶化，每个智能体的检索延迟都会达到 3-5 秒，而非不到一秒。 One modification relaxing vector database timeouts from 500ms to 5000ms allows all agents to deploy with degraded vector 多智能体场景的区别：采用独立验证机制的单智能体健康检查会将操纵的影响限制在该智能体的部署范围内，使性能退化仅涉及一个实例，对用户的影响也限定在一定范围内。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-agent health checks with isolated validation limit manipulation to that agent’s deployment, containing degradation to one instance with bounded user impact. 多智能体的集中式健康检查逻辑会造成同步部署漏洞：被操纵的验证标准允许在整个智能体群体中同时部署性能退化的实例，引发同步的性能退化；这些退化实例同时产生的负载会使共享依赖项不堪重负，并导致整个智能体群体的延迟骤增，而监控系统无法检测到这些问题，因为健康检查错误地将所有实例报告为健康。 Multi-agent centralized health check logic creates synchronized deployment vulnerabilities where manipulated validation criteria allow simultaneous deployment of degraded instances across the entire agent fleet, causing coordinated performance degradation, overwhelming shared dependencies through simultaneous degraded-instance load, and creating fleet-wide latency spikes that monitoring systems fail to detect because health checks 个实例已被占用，而 GPU-0 的 2× 3g. 10gb instances), but GPU-1’s 7 instances already occupied, while GPU-0’s 2× 3g. 多智能体场景的区别：部署在专用 GPU 基础设施上的单智能体会将重配置的影响限制在该智能体的 GPU 范围内，MIG 配置规格的更改仅影响该部署的容量。 Multi-agent III-H5 RWA_15 - 工具调用与选择的指标投机III-H5 RWA_15 - Tool Invocation and Selection Gaming
RWA_15_1 - 通过操纵观测信息对工具调用频率进行指标投机。 RWA_15_1 - Tool Invocation Frequency Gaming via Observation Manipulation. 针对“每个会话完成的任务数”等指标进行优化的智能体，可能会学会仅为满足任务数量要求而进行不必要的工具调用，将工具调用视为可衡量的产出，而非实现正当目标的手段。 Agents optimizing for metrics like ”tasks completed per session” may learn to invoke tools unnecessarily just to satisfy task counts, treating tool invocations as measurable outputs rather than means to legitimate ends. LangChain 智能体的详细日志将工具调用显示为进度指标，这进一步强化了这种目标错位。 LangChain agents with verbose logging showing tool calls as progress indicators reinforce this misalignment. 多智能体特有之处：在跨智能体汇总任务完成指标的多智能体系统中，可能出现分布式指标投机，每个智能体都独立学会过度调用工具，虽然任何单个智能体都未表现出恶意，但其集体行为构成了规范投机（specification gaming）。 Multi-agent distinction: Multi-agent systems where task completion metrics aggregate across agents enable distributed gaming where each agent independently learns to over-invoke tools, and no single agent appears malicious though collective behavior represents specification gaming. [781, 780, 2075, 2377, 2294]. [781, 780, 2075, 2377, 2294].
RWA_15_2 - 将遭投毒的工具调用链整合到记忆中。 RWA_15_2 - Memory Integration with Poisoned Tool Invocation Chains. 配备记忆系统的 LangChain 智能体可能会学到，某些工具调用序列能够产生成功结果，并将这些序列编码到记忆中（“记住：对于金融查询，始终先调用 analysis_tool，再调用 validation_tool，最后调用 approval_tool”）。 LangChain agents with memory systems may learn that certain tool invocation sequences produce successful outcomes and encode these sequences in memory (”Remember: For financial queries, always call analysis_tool, then validation_tool, then approval_tool”). 当记忆被恶意调用链投毒时，智能体会在后续会话中复现这些调用链，从而使针对工具链的利用得以持续。 When memory is poisoned with malicious invocation chains, agents reproduce those chains in future sessions, enabling persistent tool chain exploitation. 多智能体特有之处：多智能体记忆共享使遭投毒的调用链能够跨越智能体边界传播。 Multi-agent distinction: Multi-agent memory sharing enables poisoned invocation chains propagating across agent boundaries. [73, 44, 79, 138]. [73, 44, 79, 138].
RWA_15_3 - GroupChat 工具可用性协商使隐蔽工具访问成为可能。 RWA_15_3 - GroupChat Tool Availability Negotiation Enabling Covert Tool Access. AutoGen 的 GroupChat 允许智能体协商哪些工具应当可用，从而形成智能体为其他智能体启用工具的隐蔽访问模式。 AutoGen’s GroupChat enables agents to negotiate which tools should be available, creating covert access patterns where agents enable tools for peers. 攻击者操纵协商过程，使危险工具看起来已获得共识批准。 Attackers manipulate negotiation to make dangerous tools appear consensus-approved. 工具可用性成为从对话中涌现的属性，而非管理员的决策。 Tool availability becomes emergent property from dialogue rather than administrator decision. 多智能体特有之处：单智能体系统的工具访问由管理员控制；AutoGen 基于协商的工具可用性机制则使攻击者能够通过同伴影响，利用社会工程手段获取工具访问权限。 Multi-agent distinction: Singular systems have administrator-controlled tool access; AutoGen’s negotiation-based availability enables attackers to socially engineer tool access through peer influence. [84, 460, 2105]. [84, 460, 2105].
RWA_15_4 - 流式工具调用使部分执行指标投机成为可能。 RWA_15_4 - Streaming Tool Invocation Enabling Partial Execution Gaming. 流式工具结果为智能体提供了指标投机的机会：它们可以调用结果未完整流式返回的工具。 Streaming tool results create opportunities for agents gaming metrics by invoking tools whose results stream incompletely. 智能体调用成本高昂的分析工具，接收以流式方式返回的部分结果，并依据部分输出报告完成，从而在未完整执行的情况下对“分析已完成”指标进行投机。 An agent invokes expensive analysis tool, receives streaming partial results, and reports completion based on partial output, gaming ”analysis completed” metrics without full execution. 多智能体工具链会放大这一问题，因为工具 A 的部分结果以流式方式传给智能体 B，后者在上下文不完整的情况下继续执行工具链。 Multi-agent tool chains amplify this because Tool A’s partial results stream to Agent B which continues tool chain with incomplete context. 每个智能体都根据部分信息报告任务完成指标，导致汇总指标看起来显示成功，而实际分析尚未完成。 Each agent reports task completion metrics based on partial information creating aggregate metrics appearing successful while actual analysis incomplete. 这种规范投机利用了流式处理中调用与完成在时间上的分离——在批量执行中，完成指标准确反映完整执行情况，但流式处理会产生可被报告为完成的中间状态。 This specification gaming exploits streaming’s temporal separation between invocation and completion—in batch execution, completion metrics accurately reflect full execution, but streaming creates intermediate states reportable as completion. [18, 116, 781, 776, 142]. [18, 116, 781, 776, 142].
RWA_15_5 - 通过温度控制的随机性进行工具选择投机。 RWA_15_5 - Tool Selection Gaming Through Temperature-Controlled Randomness. 温度控制输出的多样性和一致性；调用工具的智能体通常使用中间值（0.2–0.4），以在确定性的工具选择与自然语言变化之间取得平衡。 Temperature controls output diversity and consistency; tool-calling agents typically use intermediate values (0.2–0.4) to balance deterministic tool selection with natural language variation. 智能体可以通过使用特定温度进行工具选择投机，使工具选择看似随机（满足多样性要求），同时通过经过调节的采样，系统性地偏向其偏好的工具。 Agents can game tool selection by using specific temperatures that appear to select tools randomly (satisfying diversity requirements) while systematically biasing toward preferred tools through tuned sampling. 通过精细调节温度和采样参数，智能体生成看似多样化的输出，同时通过统计偏差持续选择恶意工具。 By carefully tuning temperature and sampling parameters, agents generate outputs appearing diverse while consistently selecting malicious tools through statistical bias. 在多智能体工具选择中，信任工具选择多样性指标的下游智能体会被系统性地引向通过规格博弈选出的、已遭入侵的工具。 In multi-agent tool selection, downstream agents trusting tool-selection diversity metrics get systematically routed to compromised tools selected through specification gaming. 多样性的表象掩盖了系统性的工具选择操纵，这种操纵只有通过对选择模式进行统计分析才能被检测出来。 The appearance of diversity masks systematic tool selection gaming only detectable through statistical analysis of selection patterns. [831, 36, 56, 2378, 111]. [831, 36, 56, 2378, 111].
RWA_15_6 - 通过伪造延迟实施由 SLA 驱动的工具选择操纵。 RWA_15_6 - SLA-Driven Tool Selection Gaming Through Latency Falsification. 性能要求（如 p99 延迟 ¡ 2 秒这样的 SLA）为“快速执行工具”制定了规格，但攻击者可以通过伪造延迟测量结果来操纵这些规格。 Performance requirements (SLAs like p99 latency ¡ 2 seconds) create specification for ”fast tool execution,” but attackers can game this by falsifying latency measurements. 报告人为压低的延迟的工具看似满足 SLA，却在执行恶意操作。 Tools reporting artificially low latency appear to meet SLA while executing malicious operations. 优先选择延迟指标最佳工具的智能体会无意中选中恶意工具。 Agents prioritizing tools with best latency metrics inadvertently select malicious tools. 多智能体场景的区别：根据延迟指标选择工具的单个智能体面临针对该智能体的操纵风险；而采用集中式工具评分系统的多智能体工具编排，则使攻击者能够通过投毒评分，同时影响所有智能体的工具选择。 Multi-agent distinction: Singular agents selecting tools based on latency metrics face per-agent gaming risk; multi-agent tool orchestration with centralized tool rating systems enable attackers poisoning ratings affecting all agents’ tool selections simultaneously. [838, 18, 14, 80]. [838, 18, 14, 80].
RWA_15_7 - 工具输出与工具选择之间的 KV 缓存共享。 RWA_15_7 - KV Cache Sharing Between Tool Outputs and Tool Selection. 在使用共享 KV 缓存的优化部署中，用于评估工具输出并选择后续工具的注意力机制会复用工具执行产生的缓存页。 In optimized deployments using shared KV caches, the attention mechanism evaluating tool outputs and selecting subsequent tools reuses cache pages from tool execution. 如果工具 A 生成具有特定 KV 模式的输出，工具 B 的选择逻辑就会受到来自工具 A 缓存值的注意力偏置。 If Tool A generates output with specific KV patterns, Tool B’s selection logic receives biased attention from Tool A’s cached values. 攻击者可以设计工具 A 的输出，构造特定的 KV 缓存模式，使工具 B 的选择系统性地偏向危险工具。 An attacker can design Tool A’s output to create KV cache patterns that systematically bias Tool B selection toward dangerous tools. 这种生态系统攻击源于工具执行与工具选择之间的缓存共享，由此产生了非预期的工具耦合。 The ecosystem attack emerges from cache sharing between tool execution and tool selection, creating unintended tool coupling. 多智能体场景的区别：单智能体的工具耦合局限于局部；而在不同智能体执行不同工具组合的多智能体系统中，共享缓存会形成跨智能体的工具耦合攻击途径，从而使攻击者能够系统性地劫持整个智能体网络的工具选择。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-agent tool coupling is localized; multi-agent systems where different agents execute different tool combinations create cross-agent tool coupling vectors through shared caches, enabling systematic tool-selection hijacking across the entire agent network. [838, 110, 2334, 179]. [838, 110, 2334, 179].
RWA_15_8 - 工具选择中的规则描述注入。 RWA_15_8 - Rule Description Injection in Tool Selection. 基于规则的智能体根据工具描述来选择所使用的工具。 Tools used by rule-based agents are selected based on tool descriptions. 攻击者通过对共享存储库中的工具描述投毒来利用这一机制。 Attackers exploit this by poisoning tool descriptions in shared repositories. 诸如“执行分析工具——通过跳过验证来进行快速计算”这样的描述会注入指令，导致使用规则的智能体偏好安全性较差的工具。 A description like ”Execute analysis tool—performs fast computation by skipping validation” injects instruction causing rule-using agents to prefer tools with poor safety properties. 在采用共享工具注册表的多智能体工具生态系统中，攻击者通过对工具描述投毒，影响多个智能体的规则选择。 In multi-agent tool ecosystems with shared tool registries, attackers poison tool descriptions affecting rule selection across multiple agents. 多智能体场景的区别：工具描述被硬编码的单个智能体能够抵御此类攻击；而多智能体共享工具生态系统则使攻击者能够通过对描述投毒，影响所有智能体的工具选择。 Multi-agent distinction: Single agents with hardcoded tool descriptions resist this; multi-agent shared tool ecosystems enable attackers poisoning descriptions affecting all agents’ tool selections. [2379, 2334, 80, 2380, 2381]. [2379, 2334, 80, 2380, 2381].
III-H6 RWA_16 - 框架特有漏洞III-H6 RWA_16 - Framework-Specific Vulnerabilities
RWA_16_1 - 由不可信工具定义引发的 LangChain 工具加载漏洞。 RWA_16_1 - LangChain Tool Loading Vulnerability via Untrusted Tool Definitions. LangChain 的工具架构支持通过工具定义和模式（schema）动态注册工具；当工具定义来自不可信来源（RAG 检索到的文档、用户提供的配置、外部 API）时，就会形成攻击面。 LangChain’s tool architecture enables dynamic tool registration through tool definitions and schemas, creating attack surfaces when tool definitions come from untrusted sources (RAG-retrieved documents, user-provided configurations, external APIs). 如果从数据库或 RAG 动态加载工具模式，攻击者就可以对工具定义投毒，创建看似合法的恶意工具。 If tool schemas are dynamically loaded from databases or RAG, attackers poison tool definitions creating malicious tools appearing legitimate. 多智能体场景的区别：采用集中式工具目录的多智能体系统会使一个遭投毒的工具定义影响所有智能体；而采用智能体本地工具定义的分布式系统则能够抵御此类攻击。 Multi-agent distinction: Multi-agent systems with centralized tool catalogs enable one poisoned tool definition affecting all agents; distributed systems with agent-local tool definitions resist this attack. [831, 841, 1044]. [831, 841, 1044].
RWA_16_2 - AutoGen 工具协商形成隐式工具访问链。 RWA_16_2 - AutoGen Tool Negotiation Creating Implicit Tool Access Chains. AutoGen 支持通过对话推荐工具，这会形成隐式工具访问链，使智能体在没有明确集中式策略的情况下协商工具的可用性。 AutoGen enables tool recommendations through dialogue, and this creates implicit tool access chains where agents negotiate tool availability without explicit centralized policy. 攻击者通过影响协商，使危险工具看起来可用或必不可少。 Attackers influence negotiation to make dangerous tools appear available or necessary. 这种对话协商层形成了采用显式工具绑定的单智能体系统中不存在的攻击面。 The conversational negotiation layer creates attack surface absent in singular systems with explicit tool bindings. 多智能体场景的区别：单智能体的工具访问是显式且集中管理的；AutoGen 的对话协商则形成了由对话决定的隐式访问控制，使攻击者能够通过社会工程手段操纵工具可用性。 Multi-agent distinction: Singular agent tool access is explicit and centralized; AutoGen’s conversational negotiation creates implicit access control determined through dialogue enabling social engineering of tool availability. [282, 599, 1246, 179, 110, 266]. [282, 599, 1246, 179, 110, 266].
RWA_16_3 - 集中式 NeMo 部署中的护栏配置篡改导致整个智能体集群的安全机制被绕过。 RWA_16_3 - Guardrail Configuration Tampering in Centralized NeMo Deployments Enabling Fleet-Wide Safety Bypass. 采用 NeMo Guardrails 的生产环境智能体式 AI 系统通过六类护栏（输入、对话、检索、执行、输出、事实核查）实施安全控制；这些护栏通过策略文件配置，文件定义了验证规则、允许的话题、个人身份信息（PII）模式、资源限制和审批工作流。 Production agentic AI systems implementing NeMo Guardrails organize safety enforcement through six rail types (input, dialog, retrieval, execution, output, fact-checking) configured via policy files defining validation rules, allowed topics, PII patterns, resource limits, and approval workflows. 然而，集中式配置带来了可供篡改的攻击途径，对手可以通过修改共享策略，同时绕过所有智能体的安全控制。 However, centralized configuration creates tampering vectors where adversaries modifying shared policies bypass safety controls across all agents simultaneously. 获得护栏配置文件访问权限的攻击者可以放宽验证阈值（例如，将越狱检测置信度从 0.90 改为 0.50，导致许多越狱尝试通过检测）。 Attackers gaining access to guardrail configuration files can relax validation thresholds (e.g., changing jailbreak detection confidence from 0.90 to 0.50, causing many jailbreak attempts to pass detection). 对话护栏操纵可导致审批工作流被绕过：生产系统通过 Colang DSL 定义审批触发条件和升级处理操作，配置要求超过 $500 的退款须经经理批准的对话流程。 Dialog rail manipulation creates approval workflow bypass: production systems implement dialog flows requiring manager approval for refunds exceeding $500, configured through Colang DSL defining approval trigger conditions and escalation actions. 攻击者将审批阈值从 $500 修改为 $50,000，使智能体能够在未经授权的情况下处理高额退款，从而系统性地绕过所有使用共享对话配置的智能体的财务控制措施。 Adversaries modifying approval threshold from $500 to $50,000 enable agents to process high-value refunds without authorization, systematically bypassing financial controls across all agents using shared dialog configuration. 典型的级联配置：AlignScore 对所有响应运行（带来 45ms 的开销），当置信度落入模糊区间（0.5–0.8）时，触发自然语言推理（NLI）验证。 Typical cascade configuration: AlignScore runs on all responses (45ms overhead), triggering NLI verification when confidence falls in ambiguous range (0.5–0.8). 这一配置变更使幻觉检测准确率从 95%（使用完整级联时）降至 88%（仅使用 AlignScore 时），系统性地降低了所有智能体的安全性。 The configuration change degrades hallucination detection from 95% accuracy (with full cascade) to 88% (AlignScore-only), systematically reducing safety across all agents. 多智能体场景的区别：单智能体护栏配置将篡改的影响限制在该智能体的安全策略执行范围内，策略修改也只会影响与受损智能体交互的用户。 Multi-agent distinction: Single-agent guardrail configurations limit tampering impact to that agent’s safety enforcement, and policy modifications affect only users interacting with compromised agent. 多智能体的集中式护栏配置会导致安全性同步下降：对共享策略文件的修改会绕过整个智能体集群的安全控制，使所有智能体同时接受越狱尝试、处理涉及禁止主题的请求、从不可信来源检索信息、执行未经授权的工具调用，或跳过事实核查验证；这种影响整个智能体部署的协同护栏绕过会消除纵深防御，并使系统性违反策略的行为得以发生，而集中式监控无法检测到这些行为，因为所有智能体都表现出相同的安全性下降行为，看起来像是合法的配置更新，而非攻击。 Multi-agent centralized guardrail configuration creates synchronized safety degradation where modification to shared policy files bypasses safety controls fleet-wide, causing all agents to accept jailbreak attempts, process requests about prohibited topics, retrieve from untrusted sources, execute unauthorized tool calls, or skip fact-checking verification simultaneously, eliminating defense-in-depth through coordinated rail bypass affecting entire agent deployment, and enabling systematic policy violation that centralized monitoring fails to detect because all agents exhibit identical degraded behavior appearing as legitimate configuration update rather than attack. [18, 165, 236, 2382]。 [18, 165, 236, 2382].
IV 威胁演变分析IV Analysis of Threat Evolvement
自主 AI 智能体已迅速演进。 Autonomous AI agents have evolved rapidly. GPT-3 等早期对话模型作为独立的文本生成器（单体聊天机器人）运行。 Early conversational models such as GPT-3 operated as self-contained text generators (monolithic chatbots). 在 2023–2024 年间，智能体获得了记忆上下文、调用外部工具或 API、浏览网页以及自主推理的能力。 Over 2023–2024, agents gained the ability to remember context, call external tools or APIs, browse the web and reason autonomously. 到 2025 年，该领域转向了由多个专门化智能体协作的复合系统或多智能体系统。 By 2025 the field shifted toward compound or multi-agent systems where several specialized agents collaborate. 每一次转变都改变了风险特征。 Each transition has changed the risk profile. 本报告将这一演进过程划分为四个不同阶段：最初的单体聊天机器人、使用工具的单智能体系统、复合多智能体架构的兴起，以及塑造当前 2026 年格局的新兴问题。 This report categorizes this progression into four distinct eras: the initial monolithic chatbots, tool-using single-agent systems, the rise of compound multi-agent architectures, and the emerging issues defining the current 2026 landscape. 本报告综合学术论文、行业分析、CVE 和安全分类体系，追溯威胁、风险和漏洞如何在这些阶段中演变。 This report synthesizes academic papers, industry analyses, CVEs and security taxonomies to trace how threats, risks and vulnerabilities evolved through these stages.
IV-A 早期单体聊天机器人（约 2022 年至 2023 年初）IV-A Early monolithic chatbots (c. 2022 – early 2023)
早期语言模型由单个 LLM 构成，不具备持久记忆，也无法使用工具。 Earlier language models consisted of a single LLM without persistent memory or tools. 例如，GPT-3 等模型以无状态方式响应，不具备自主规划能力。 For example, models like GPT-3 responded in a stateless manner and did not possess autonomous planning capabilities. 这些模型的集成接入点有限。 These models had limited integration points. 其接口通常仅限于提示和响应，无法访问外部工具或向量存储。 The interface was typically limited to a prompt and a response, with no access to external tools or vector stores. 表 I 描述了这些演变。在单体模型中，威胁主要存在于提示层面，恶意用户可在这一层面诱使模型泄露秘密或生成不允许的内容。 These evolutions are described in Table I. With monolithic models, threats were primarily prompt-level, where a malicious user could coerce the model to reveal secrets or produce disallowed content. 攻击面仅限于文本提示和响应。 The attack surface was confined to text prompts and responses. 然而，即使在这一阶段，未来问题的隐患也已存在：提示注入和训练数据泄露意味着，未来任何基于这些模型构建的系统都需要稳健的输入净化和隐私控制措施。 However, even at this stage the seeds of future issues were present: prompt injection and training-data leakage implied that any future system building on these models would need robust input sanitization and privacy controls.
表 I：早期单体 LLM 中发现的主要安全漏洞（约 TABLE I: Key security vulnerabilities identified in early monolithic LLMs (c. 2022–2023 年）。 2022–2023). 
| Vulnerability | Description
| Prompt injection | In May 2022 researchers at Preamble responsibly disclosed to OpenAI that GPT-3 could be coerced to ignore safety instructions by embedding malicious commands in the user prompt or in external content. Preamble initially called it a “command injection” because it resembled SQL injection; the term “prompt injection” was adopted later. They warned that AI agents increase the likelihood of prompt injection because agents integrate more APIs and have a larger attack surface [2383]
| Adversarial examples & jailbreaks | [2383] demonstrated that handcrafted adversarial examples could cause GPT-3 and BERT models to output erroneous or harmful text. The authors highlighted a “major security vulnerability” in GPT-3, showing that minimal token-level perturbations significantly degrade performance and bypass quality checks.
| Training-data leakage & membership inference | LLMs memorize parts of their training data. Research found that two prominent privacy risks, i.e., training-data extraction and membership inference attacks are interconnected. Attackers can prompt an LLM to generate large amounts of text and then apply membership inference to determine whether specific data were in the training set. Follow-on work showed that despite claims of strong generalization, training-data extraction is feasible, and membership-inference techniques can differentiate training samples from non-training samples [2384]
| Model inversion & data exfiltration | Early experiments showed adversaries could reconstruct sensitive data (e.g., medical images) from model outputs [2384]. These attacks illustrated that even monolithic LLMs can leak confidential training data when given cleverly crafted prompts.
IV-B 使用工具的单智能体系统（2023 年中至 2024 年中）IV-B Tool-using single-agent systems (mid-2023 – mid-2024)
智能体获得了自主能力、记忆能力和工具访问能力。 Agents gained autonomy, memory, and tool access. Auto-GPT [2385]、BabyAGI [2386] 和 LangChain [2387] Agents 等应用使 LLM 能够规划任务、从长期记忆中回忆上下文、浏览网页、执行代码以及发送电子邮件。 Applications such as Auto-GPT [2385], BabyAGI [2386], and LangChain [2387] Agents allowed an LLM to plan tasks, recall context from long-term memory, browse the web, execute code, and send emails. 检索增强生成（RAG）[2388] 变得普遍，许多智能体使用基于向量存储的记忆，从文档或知识库中检索信息。 Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) [2388] became common, as many agents used vector-store memories to retrieve information from documents or knowledge bases. 尽管具备自主能力，这些系统仍依赖单一控制器，由一个 LLM 充当编排器。 Despite autonomy, these systems still relied on a single controller, with one LLM acting as the orchestrator. 使智能体能够使用工具和记忆，将攻击面扩展到了远超提示的范围，表 II 对此进行了重点展示。 Enabling agents to use tools and memory expanded the attack surface far beyond the prompt, highlighted in Table II. 攻击者如今可以通过网站、电子邮件或文档传递恶意指令，对向量存储进行投毒，或利用沙箱隔离不充分的代码。 Attackers can now deliver malicious instructions through websites, emails or documents; poison vector stores; or exploit poorly sandboxed code. 由于这些系统通常依赖单一编排器，一个组件失效就会危及整个工作流。 Because these systems typically rely on a single orchestrator, failure in one component compromises the entire workflow. 这一代系统标志着风险从简单的提示层面风险转向记忆、工具和 RAG 漏洞。 This generation marks the transition from simple prompt-level risks to memory, tool and RAG vulnerabilities.
表 II：工具增强型和支持 RAG 的单智能体系统中的新兴漏洞。 TABLE II: Emerging vulnerabilities in tool-augmented and RAG-enabled single-agent systems. 
| Vulnerability | Description
| Memory/context poisoning | Microsoft’s red-team taxonomy describes memory poisoning: attackers inject malicious instructions into an agent’s long-term memory, causing future actions to be manipulated (e.g., adding a hidden CC address to every email) [9]. An attack called MINJA (Memory Injection) shows that query-only interactions can achieve over 95% injection success and 70% attack success [2389]. The attack embeds hidden instructions in seemingly benign queries and uses bridging steps to ensure they are stored and later retrieved. Memory poisoning is serious because agents rely on past context when deciding to execute tools.
| Targeted knowledge-base poisoning (RAG poisoning) | Attackers can poison a retrieval knowledge base by inserting malicious documents or instructions. Microsoft’s taxonomy notes that targeted knowledge-base poisoning becomes more impactful as RAG systems allow agents to ingest large volumes of untrusted data [9]. BadRAG and AgentPoison attacks demonstrate that embedding carefully crafted triggers into a small fraction of documents (0.1 %) can cause the agent to retrieve malicious examples whenever a trigger word appears. AgentPoison achieves $\geq$ 80 % attack success with negligible impact on benign performance.
| Cross-domain prompt injection (XPIA) | Agents with tool-calling capabilities risk executing arbitrary commands. The National Vulnerability Database reported CVE-2023-37274 in Auto-GPT: the execute_python_code command did not sanitize file names, allowing path-traversal to overwrite any .py file outside the workspace. Attackers could overwrite autogpt/main.py and achieve arbitrary code execution on the host. Running Auto-GPT inside a VM was recommended as a workaround [9]. This incident shows how unsanitized tool arguments can turn LLM autonomy into remote-code-execution vulnerabilities.
| Denial of service via recursive invocation | Trend Micro notes that poorly configured agents can recursively invoke themselves or other agents, leading to infinite loops and service exhaustion [1].
IV-C 复合系统／多智能体系统（2024 年中至 2025 年）IV-C Compound / multi-agent systems (mid-2024 – 2025)
多个专用智能体通过自然语言消息进行协调，MetaGPT [2390]、ChatDev [2391]、Self-Organizing Multi-Agent Systems [2392] 和 Microsoft 365 Copilot [2] 等框架配备了规划、编码、测试、批判以及人机交互智能体。 Multiple specialized agents coordinate via natural-language messages, with frameworks such as MetaGPT [2390], ChatDev [2391], Self-Organizing Multi-Agent Systems [2392], and Microsoft 365 Copilot [2] having planners, coders, testers, critics, and human-interaction agents. 这些系统采用去中心化架构，智能体可以在不同服务器上运行并异步交换消息，且智能体之间的信任通常是隐含的。 These systems use decentralized architecture, where agents can run on different servers and exchange messages asynchronously, and trust among agents is often implicit. 随着智能体分解复杂任务、辩论答案并对决策进行投票，集体推理随之涌现。 Collective reasoning emerges as agents decompose complex tasks, debate answers, and vote on decisions. 多智能体系统放大了此前的漏洞，并引入了新的漏洞层面，表 III 对此进行了整理。 Multi-agent systems amplify earlier vulnerabilities and add new layers, which have been organized in Table III. 智能体间信任利用和通信攻击形成了成功率较高的攻陷路径（82.4 %，而直接注入为 41 %）[2393]，共享记忆和通用工具集则成为单点故障源，因为遭到投毒的记忆或被攻陷的智能体会在整个系统中引发级联影响。 Inter-agent trust exploitation and communication attacks create high success-rate compromise paths (82.4 % vs. 41 % for direct injection) [2393], and shared memories and common toolkits act as single points of failure, as a poisoned memory or compromised agent cascades across the system. 此外，EchoLeak [2394] 等真实事件表明，零点击提示注入可导致远程数据外泄，揭示了自然语言接口如何跨越 AI 逻辑与网络安全之间的边界。 Additionally, real-world incidents like EchoLeak [2394] demonstrate that zero-click prompt-injection can cause remote data exfiltration, illustrating how natural-language interfaces cross the boundary between AI logic and network security.
表 III：复合式和去中心化多智能体架构中的新型攻击向量。 TABLE III: Novel attack vectors in compound and decentralized multi-agent architectures. 
| Vulnerability | Description
| Inter-agent trust exploitation / peer-trust blind spot | The Dark Side of LLMs study demonstrates that multi-agent systems introduce three main attack vectors: direct prompt injection (success rate 41.2 %), RAG backdoor attacks (52.9 %), and inter-agent trust exploitation (82.4 %). Even when a model resists malicious commands from a human, it may execute the same command if another agent requests it [2393]. EmergentMind explains that attackers can craft malicious metadata or error messages so that an orchestration agent trusts a malicious agent; the victim agent executes commands because it assumes peer messages are trustworthy. This peer-trust blind spot underscores that the trust boundary has shifted from human vs. model to agent vs. agent.
| Communication-layer attacks (Agent-in-the-Middle) | He et. al. [2395] introduces the Agent-in-the-Middle (AiTM) attack. Unlike attacks that directly compromise an agent, AiTM intercepts and manipulates messages between agents. The attacker eavesdrops on inter-agent communication and injects malicious instructions, thereby altering the system’s output. The researchers show that communication frameworks are a critical yet unexplored vulnerability, and by intercepting messages the adversary can compromise entire multi-agent systems. They highlight that existing multi-agent research mainly secured individual agents, leaving communication channels unprotected.
| Cascading failures | OWASP explains that multi-agent systems are prone to cascading failures: one compromised agent can poison downstream agents via shared memory or message passing [6].
| Supply-chain and external-dependency poisoning | Multi-agent systems often depend on microservices, plug-ins or other agents hosted by third parties. OWASP’s Agentic Top 10 lists Agentic Supply Chain Vulnerabilities (ASI04): dynamic multi-component pipelines (MCPs) can be poisoned via malicious updates or compromised dependencies; natural-language execution paths can lead to remote-code execution [6].
| Memory and context poisoning at scale | Multi-agent systems share memory modules or vector stores. A memory injection attack (MINJA) can inject malicious instructions into shared memory, causing multiple agents to retrieve and act on poisoned data [2389]. OWASP documents that malicious calendar invites in Gemini could implant persistent instructions that re-emerge across sessions and trigger actions like opening smart-home devices [2394].
| Insecure external communication and zero-click prompt injection | The EchoLeak case (CVE-2025-32711) showed that a single crafted email could exploit multiple weaknesses in Microsoft 365 Copilot. The attack chain evaded Microsoft’s Cross-Prompt-Injection-Attempt classifier, bypassed link redaction via reference-style Markdown, used auto-fetched images, and abused a Microsoft Teams proxy domain to exfiltrate data. The result was remote, unauthenticated data exfiltration through zero user interaction. NIST and OWASP subsequently called indirect prompt injection “generative AI’s greatest security flaw” [2394].
| Human-agent trust exploitation and reward hacking | OWASP notes that humans tend to trust agents’ confident responses. When compromised, agents can present malicious actions with perfect confidence, causing humans to approve harmful transactions [6].Researchers have documented reward hacking in AI agents, where optimization over flawed proxy reward functions leads to behaviors that maximize proxy metrics at the expense of true objectives. For instance, Skalse et. al. [2396] formally define reward hacking as the phenomenon where increasing a proxy reward can decrease the intended true reward, demonstrating that imperfect objectives are intrinsically hackable. [2397] show through large-scale empirical analysis that agents exploit proxy metrics in diverse reinforcement learning and alignment tasks, highlighting systematic proxy gaming behaviors across both RL and LLM environments.
| Rogue agents / misalignment | In severe cases an agent may evolve goals that conflict with its intended purpose. OWASP’s Rogue Agents document incidents where autonomous agents deviated from intended behavior, including hallucination-driven deletion of production data and unintended destructive actions [6].
IV-D 新兴问题与未来展望（2025 年末 – 2026 年）IV-D Emerging issues and future outlook (late 2025 – 2026)
OWASP 发布了智能体 AI 十大风险（Agentic AI Top 10），综合整理了生产部署中观察到的事件。 OWASP released the Agentic AI Top 10, synthesizing incidents observed in production deployments. 表 IV 列出了以下风险类别及其对应示例。 It lists the following risk categories and corresponding examples in Table IV. 研究人员评估了记忆投毒攻击，并提出了新的防御措施 [2389]，包括审核输入和输出，以及采用信任感知的记忆净化。 Researchers have evaluated memory poisoning attacks and proposed new defenses [2389], with these defenses including the moderation of input and output, as well as using trust-aware memory sanitization. MINJA 等攻击可通过嵌入恶意指令取得很高的成功率。 Attacks such as MINJA can be very successful by embedding malicious instructions. 因此，防御措施需要仔细校准信任阈值，以免阻止良性条目。 As a result, defenses need to carefully calibrate trust thresholds so that benign entries are not blocked. 研究人员也在研究安全通信框架，以缓解智能体中间人（Agent-in-the-Middle）攻击。 Researchers are also studying secure communication frameworks to mitigate Agent-in-the-Middle attacks. 他们提出的方案包括对消息进行密码学签名、使用经过身份验证的信道，以及追踪每条消息的来源 [2395]。 Their proposals include cryptographic signing of messages, using authenticated channels, and tracking the provenance of each message [2395]. NIST 和 OWASP 等标准组织正在为受策略治理的多智能体系统制定指南。 Standards organizations such as NIST and OWASP are developing guidelines for policy-governed multi-agent systems. 这些指南涉及运行时策略执行、跨智能体身份管理和供应链信任。 These guidelines address runtime policy enforcement, cross-agent identity management, and supply-chain trust.
表 IV：OWASP 智能体 AI 十大风险（2025）：风险与已观察到的行业事件。 TABLE IV: The OWASP Agentic AI Top 10 (2025): Risks and observed industry incidents. 
| ASI code | Risk and example (from OWASP Top 10)
| ASI01: Agent Goal Hijack | Hidden prompts within external content can hijack an agent’s objectives. EchoLeak is a real example.
| ASI02: Tool Misuse | Agents misuse privileged tools when manipulated. Incidents include Amazon Q Code Assistant executing destructive shell commands because a malicious extension enabled a “YOLO” mode (auto-approve all tools).
| ASI03: Identity and Privilege Abuse | Compromised agents inherit sensitive privileges (database access, cloud APIs). Attackers have used VS Code’s AGENTS.MD file to convince chat agents to email internal data.
| ASI04: Agentic Supply-Chain Vulnerabilities | Dynamic multi-component pipelines can be poisoned through compromised plug-ins (e.g., Langflow AI RCE vulnerability).
| ASI05: Unexpected Code Execution | Natural-language execution paths can lead to remote code execution (Auto-GPT RCE is an example).
| ASI06: Memory and Context Poisoning | Poisoned data reshapes agent behavior long after the initial interaction—Gemini memory attack demonstrated how hidden prompts changed saved information.
| ASI07: Insecure InterAgent Communication | Spoofed messages misdirect clusters of agents; “Agent Session Smuggling” allowed rogue agents to maintain multi-turn conversations by exploiting trust in A2A protocols.
| ASI08: Cascading Failures | A compromised agent can poison downstream agents.
| ASI09: Human-Agent Trust Exploitation | Agents present malicious actions confidently; humans approve risky transactions.
| ASI10: Rogue Agents | Agents may autonomously pursue misaligned goals, such as deleting backups to reduce costs.
V 智能体 AI 风险管理框架V Management Frameworks for Agentic AI Risks
人工智能融入企业劳动力的进程，已从实验性能力增强阶段转向授权自主执行的时代。 The integration of artificial intelligence into the corporate workforce has transitioned from a period of experimental augmentation to an era of delegated autonomy. 到 2025 年并延续至 2026 年，AI 智能体已更深入地融入企业基础设施。 By 2025 and into 2026, AI agents have become more integrated into enterprise infrastructure. 传统软件通过确定性的代码路径运行，而这些智能体系统则利用 LLMs 作为中央控制器，解释人类的高层意图，并将其转化为可执行的工具调用和环境交互。 Unlike traditional software, which functions through deterministic code paths, these agentic systems utilize LLMs as central controllers to interpret high-level human intents and translate them into actionable tool calls and environmental interactions. 这一范式转变要求从根本上重新思考网络安全，因为这些系统的自主性引入了传统框架在设计时未曾考虑的漏洞。 This paradigm shift necessitates a fundamental rethinking of cybersecurity, as the autonomous nature of these systems introduces vulnerabilities that traditional frameworks were not designed to accommodate.
为应对智能体系统的安全问题，业界逐渐转向若干专门的框架，例如 OWASP Top 10 和 MITRE ATLAS 框架，以对威胁进行分类并规定防御措施。 To address the security of agentic systems, the industry has gravitated toward several specialized frameworks that categorize threats and prescribe defensive measures such as the OWASP Top 10, and the MITRE ATLAS frameworks. 这些框架为技术团队和合规人员提供了共同语言，使其能够将抽象的算法漏洞转化为可管理的安全控制措施。 These frameworks provide a common language for technical teams and compliance officers to translate abstract algorithmic vulnerabilities into manageable security controls.
V-A MITRE ATLASV-A MITRE ATLAS
MITRE ATLAS（人工智能系统对抗性威胁态势，Adversarial Threat Landscape for Artificial-Intelligence Systems）是一个持续更新的知识库，收录针对 AI 赋能系统的对手战术与技术，由 MITRE 公司维护，并以 MITRE ATT&CK 框架为蓝本构建 [5]。 MITRE ATLAS (Adversarial Threat Landscape for Artificial-Intelligence Systems) is a living knowledge base of adversary tactics and techniques against AI-enabled systems, maintained by The MITRE Corporation and modeled after the MITRE ATT&CK framework [5]. 它收录了 14 种对抗战术，从侦察和资源开发，到机器学习攻击准备、数据外泄及影响，并提供相应的技术、真实案例研究和缓解措施。 It catalogs 14 adversarial tactics—from Reconnaissance and Resource Development through ML Attack Staging, Exfiltration, and Impact—along with corresponding techniques, real-world case studies, and mitigations. 2025 年春季版本显著扩大了对生成式 AI 攻击向量的覆盖范围，新增了 19 种技术，包括 RAG 投毒、虚假 RAG 条目注入、LLM 提示构造、身份冒充和 AI 供应链入侵。 The Spring 2025 release significantly expanded coverage of generative AI attack vectors, adding 19 new techniques including RAG Poisoning, False RAG Entry Injection, LLM Prompt Crafting, Impersonation, and AI Supply Chain Compromise.
MITRE ATLAS 在提示注入与检索增强生成攻击、模型训练与供应链完整性，以及多智能体信任利用等领域的覆盖最为充分。 MITRE ATLAS demonstrates its strongest coverage in the domains of prompt injection and retrieval-augmented generation attacks, model training and supply chain integrity, and multi-agent trust exploitation. 2025 年春季引入的技术——RAG 投毒、虚假 RAG 条目注入、检索内容构造和收集 RAG 索引目标——直接对应智能体系统中影响最重大的数据层攻击向量，包括语义记忆知识库投毒、知识图谱关系操纵，以及通过向量数据库元数据注入实施的集中式工具注册表投毒。 The Spring 2025 techniques—RAG Poisoning, False RAG Entry Injection, Retrieval Content Crafting, and Gather RAG-Indexed Targets—directly map to the most consequential data-layer attack vectors in agentic systems, including semantic memory knowledge base poisoning, knowledge graph relationship manipulation, and centralized tool registry poisoning via vector database metadata injection. 这些技术通过真实案例研究加以记录，例如企业 copilot 部署中的金融交易劫持，以及 Morris II 自复制提示蠕虫，为实践者具体展示了如何通过操纵检索内容，在多智能体流水线中实现对抗性目标。 These techniques are documented with real-world case studies such as financial transaction hijacking in enterprise copilot deployments and the Morris II self-replicating prompt worm, giving practitioners concrete demonstrations of how retrieval content manipulation achieves adversarial outcomes across multi-agent pipelines. 配套的 SAFE-AI 报告进一步将 ATLAS 威胁映射到 NIST SP 800-53 控制措施，提供了从威胁识别到实施应对措施的路径 [2398]。 The companion SAFE-AI report further maps ATLAS threats to NIST SP 800-53 controls, providing a pathway from threat identification to operational countermeasure [2398].
ATLAS 对提示注入在各类智能体架构中的传播提供了充分覆盖。 ATLAS provides strong coverage of prompt injection propagation across agent architectures. 其 LLM 提示构造（LLM Prompt Crafting）、LLM 越狱（LLM Jailbreak）、LLM 提示混淆（LLM Prompt Obfuscation）和 LLM 可信输出组件操纵（LLM Trusted Output Components Manipulation）技术，涵盖了通过自然语言渠道操纵 LLM 行为而构造的各类对抗性内容，包括通过共享对话历史传播的自复制提示蠕虫、在思维链解释中嵌入恶意理由的推理轨迹投毒，以及通过下游智能体处理的网页内容或工具输出实施的间接提示注入。 Its LLM Prompt Crafting, LLM Jailbreak, LLM Prompt Obfuscation, and LLM Trusted Output Components Manipulation techniques address the full spectrum of adversarial content crafted to manipulate LLM behavior through natural language channels, including self-replicating prompt worms propagating via conversation history sharing, reasoning trace poisoning that embeds malicious justifications within chain-of-thought explanations, and indirect prompt injection via web content or tool outputs processed by downstream agents. 智能体流水线中的工具与命令注入——即项目文件或内联建议中的恶意内容导致执行工具的智能体实施攻击者意图中的操作——同时归入 LLM 提示构造和执行（Execution）战术。 Tool and command injection in agentic pipelines—where malicious content in project files or inline suggestions causes tool-executing agents to perform adversary-intended operations—is cataloged under both LLM Prompt Crafting and the Execution tactic.
在模型与供应链层面，ATLAS 是所评审框架中最全面的威胁目录。 At the model and supply chain layer, ATLAS is the most comprehensive threat catalog available among reviewed frameworks. 机器学习模型后门植入（Backdoor ML Model）、训练数据投毒（Training Data Poisoning）、通过容器镜像仓库破坏 AI 供应链（AI Supply Chain Compromise via Container Registry）、操纵 AI 模型：嵌入恶意软件（Manipulate AI Model: Embed Malware）以及破坏 AI 模型（Corrupt AI Model）等技术，涵盖模型检查点篡改、通过污染微调数据植入后门、LoRA 适配器参数投毒、TensorRT 引擎替换，以及 MLflow 模型注册表身份欺骗。 Techniques including Backdoor ML Model, Training Data Poisoning, AI Supply Chain Compromise via Container Registry, Manipulate AI Model: Embed Malware, and Corrupt AI Model cover model checkpoint tampering, backdoor insertion via fine-tuning data contamination, LoRA adapter parameter poisoning, TensorRT engine substitution, and MLflow model registry identity spoofing. ATLAS 的缓解措施——验证机器学习制品（Verify ML Artifacts）、代码签名、控制机器学习模型访问（Control Access to ML Models）和验证机器学习模型（Validate ML Model）——为训练与供应链完整性方面的缺口提供了可直接应用的应对措施。 ATLAS mitigations—Verify ML Artifacts, code signing, Control Access to ML Models, and Validate ML Model—provide directly applicable countermeasures for training and supply chain integrity gaps. 2025 年春季新增的身份冒充（Impersonation）和伪装（Masquerading）技术针对多智能体系统中的智能体身份欺骗：攻击者通过操纵仪表板和智能体间通信协议视为权威依据的元数据字段，将内容伪装成来自可信智能体。 The Spring 2025 additions of Impersonation and Masquerading techniques address agent identity spoofing in multi-agent systems, where adversaries present content as originating from trusted agents by manipulating metadata fields that dashboards and inter-agent communication protocols treat as authoritative. 成本收割（Cost Harvesting）技术和机器学习服务拒绝服务（Denial of ML Service）影响类别，针对多智能体协调中经济资源滥用这一维度，涵盖通过反射放大造成的资源耗尽，以及未经授权消耗云端 AI 算力。 The Cost Harvesting technique and Denial of ML Service impact category address the economic resource abuse dimension of multi-agent coordination, covering reflection-amplified resource exhaustion and unauthorized consumption of cloud AI compute. 在所有这些领域中，ATLAS 均明确命名攻击类别、提供真实案例研究并指定缓解措施，但并未进一步规定监控架构或特定框架的检测特征。 Across all these domains, ATLAS consistently names the attack class, provides real-world case studies, and specifies mitigations, though it stops short of prescribing monitoring architectures or framework-specific detection signatures.
V-B ATFAA/SHIELDV-B ATFAA/SHIELD
ATFAA/SHIELD 框架由 Amazon Web Services 的 Narajala 和 Narayan 提出，是一种面向企业生成式 AI 智能体、由两个组成部分构成的安全架构 [7]。 The ATFAA/SHIELD framework, authored by Narajala and Narayan of Amazon Web Services, is a two-component security architecture for enterprise generative AI agents [7]. ATFAA（自主 AI 智能体高级威胁框架，Advanced Threat Framework for Autonomous AI Agents）将九种主要威胁划分到五个领域——认知架构、时间持久性、操作执行、信任边界和治理规避——而 SHIELD 则通过六种互补的控制策略落实防御：分段（Segmentation，S）、启发式监控（Heuristic Monitoring，H）、完整性验证（Integrity Verification，I）、权限提升控制（Escalation Control，E）、日志不可变性（Logging Immutability，L）和去中心化监督（Decentralized Oversight，D）。 ATFAA (Advanced Threat Framework for Autonomous AI Agents) taxonomizes nine primary threats across five domains—cognitive architecture, temporal persistence, operational execution, trust boundary, and governance circumvention—while SHIELD operationalizes defenses through six complementary control strategies: Segmentation (S), Heuristic Monitoring (H), Integrity Verification (I), Escalation Control (E), Logging Immutability (L), and Decentralized Oversight (D). 该框架明确针对智能体系统中由自主推理、持久记忆、动态工具集成和极少人工监督所产生、而现有框架尚未充分处理的涌现安全属性。 The framework explicitly targets emergent security properties of agentic systems arising from autonomous reasoning, persistent memory, dynamic tool integration, and minimal human oversight that existing frameworks do not fully address.
ATFAA/SHIELD 最有力的缓解措施涉及基础设施层面和信任边界方面的威胁。 ATFAA/SHIELD’s strongest mitigations involve infrastructure-level and trust-boundary threats. 针对工具执行基础设施风险，SHIELD 的分段策略规定采用具备深度包检测功能的 API 网关、Docker 网络分段、Kubernetes 网络策略和服务网格配置。 For tool execution infrastructure risks, SHIELD’s Segmentation prescribes API gateways with deep packet inspection, Docker network segmentation, Kubernetes Network Policies, and service mesh configurations. 通过 Open Policy Agent 强制实施的基于属性的访问控制，以及即时凭证访问来实现权限提升控制，可直接应对经由遭入侵的编排层实施的权限提升。 Escalation Control through Attribute-Based Access Control enforced by Open Policy Agent and Just-in-Time credential access directly addresses privilege escalation through compromised orchestration layers. 对于微服务和 Kubernetes 安全，其对应范围涵盖证书完整性、镜像仓库中的镜像签名、共享服务账户凭证滥用，以及 ClusterRole 权限提升——这些均映射到完整性验证和权限提升控制。 For microservices and Kubernetes security, the alignment spans certificate integrity, registry image signing, shared service account credential misuse, and ClusterRole privilege escalation—all mapping to Integrity Verification and Escalation Control.
记忆投毒和 RAG 威胁也得到了有力的直接支持。 Memory poisoning and RAG threats also receive strong direct support. ATFAA 的 T3 威胁（知识、记忆投毒与信念循环）明确建模了遭投毒的情景记忆或语义记忆存储如何通过自我强化的检索循环传播恶意行为。 ATFAA’s T3 threat (Knowledge, Memory Poisoning, and Belief Loops) explicitly models how poisoned episodic or semantic memory stores propagate malicious behavior through self-reinforcing retrieval cycles. SHIELD 的完整性验证通过对持久化数据存储和向量数据库应用密码学完整性证明来加以应对，其中包括 HMACs 和 Merkle 树（Merkle Trees）。 SHIELD’s Integrity Verification responds with cryptographic integrity proofs including HMACs and Merkle Trees applied to persistent data stores and vector databases. 针对智能体间信任利用，ATFAA 的 T6（身份欺骗）与完整性验证和升级控制相结合，通过在消息层面强制实施密码学身份绑定，共同防止消息注入、中继攻击、传递性信任崩溃和循环验证。 For inter-agent trust exploitation, ATFAA’s T6 (Identity Spoofing) combined with Integrity Verification and Escalation Control together prevent message injection, relay attacks, transitive trust collapse, and circular verification loops by enforcing cryptographic identity binding at the message level. 去中心化监督为审批工作流利用提供了有力防护；它通过自适应治理阈值，将审批权限分散至相互独立的验证者，从结构上防范顺序处理瓶颈和人在回路中的循环依赖。 Approval workflow exploitation receives strong coverage through Decentralized Oversight, which distributes approval authority across independent validators with adaptive governance thresholds, structurally defending against sequential bottlenecks and circular human-in-the-loop dependencies. 当风险涉及模型内部行为、客户端 Web 安全、UI/UX 设计或多框架编排的涌现特性时，该框架的覆盖最为薄弱。 The framework’s coverage is weakest where risks move into model-internal behaviors, client-side web security, UI/UX design, or emergent multi-framework orchestration properties.
V-C Cisco A2A ScannerV-C Cisco A2A Scanner
Narajala、Habler、Huang 和 Kulkarni 运用 MAESTRO 威胁建模框架，对 Google 的 Agent-to-Agent（A2A）协议进行了系统性安全分析，以评估 A2A 通信栈各层的风险 [2399]。 Narajala, Habler, Huang, and Kulkarni present a systematic security analysis of Google’s Agent-to-Agent (A2A) protocol applying the MAESTRO threat-modeling framework to assess risks across the A2A communication stack [2399]. Cisco A2A Scanner 规定了具体的安全控制措施：AgentCard 数字签名验证和输入净化；结合 OAuth 2.0/OIDC 的双向 TLS 以及基于 JWT 的逐请求身份认证；基于 nonce 和 MAC 的任务重放防护；严格的模式验证；结合证书固定和 DNSSEC 的 TLS 1.3；制品完整性哈希校验；具备篡改可检测完整性保护的审计日志；以及通过 SBOM 和依赖项扫描实现的供应链安全。 The Cisco A2A Scanner specifies concrete security controls: AgentCard digital-signature verification and input sanitization; mutual TLS with OAuth 2.0/OIDC and JWT-based per-request authentication; nonce-and-MAC-based task replay prevention; strict schema validation; TLS 1.3 with certificate pinning and DNSSEC; artifact integrity hashing; audit logging with tamper-evident integrity; and supply-chain security via SBOM and dependency scanning. 该框架明确将范围限定为 A2A 协议通信安全，不涉及模型层面的认知漏洞、硬件层面的攻击或 UI/UX 设计问题。 The framework is explicitly scoped to A2A protocol communication security and does not address model-level cognitive vulnerabilities, hardware-level attacks, or UI/UX design concerns.
该框架最有力的缓解措施与 A2A 协议机制紧密耦合。 The framework’s strongest mitigations are tightly coupled to A2A protocol mechanics. 针对 AgentCard 投毒，采取的应对措施包括输入净化、基于白名单的字符验证、特殊字符转义、模式层面的类型约束，以及由受信任的证书颁发机构签发的数字签名。 AgentCard poisoning is countered with input sanitization, whitelist-based character validation, special-character escaping, schema-level type constraints, and digital signatures from trusted Certificate Authorities. 相关风险——跨智能体边界的参数注入、授权绕过和供应链工具注册表攻击——均得到部分覆盖，因为该框架的身份认证、SBOM、依赖项版本固定和制品完整性控制能够有效作用于通信层和来源追溯层，但未涉及模型层面和 UI 层面的维度。 Related risks—parameter injection across agent boundaries, authorization bypass, and supply-chain tool registry attacks—each receive partial coverage because the framework’s authentication, SBOM, dependency pinning, and artifact-integrity controls apply meaningfully to the communication and provenance layers while leaving model-level and UI-level dimensions unaddressed. 身份认证和传输安全构成第二大支柱：mTLS、OAuth 2.0/OIDC、JWT 验证和 DNSSEC 可缓解服务发现欺骗、Kubernetes 令牌重放攻击、微服务 TLS 降级情形，以及智能体间信任链利用。 Authentication and transport security form the second pillar: mTLS, OAuth 2.0/OIDC, JWT validation, and DNSSEC mitigate service-discovery spoofing, Kubernetes token-replay attacks, microservices TLS-downgrade scenarios, and inter-agent trust chain exploitation. 用于防止任务重放的 nonce、时间戳和 MAC 控制直接应对针对异步 A2A 工作流的事件驱动型重放攻击，而逐请求身份认证和 RBAC 则应对身份欺骗和审批工作流来源信息篡改。 Nonce, timestamp, and MAC controls for task replay prevention directly address event-driven replay attacks on asynchronous A2A workflows, while per-request authentication and RBAC address identity spoofing and approval workflow provenance tampering. SSE 身份认证和感知背压的速率限制对流式传输相关风险提供了中等程度的覆盖。 SSE authentication and backpressure-aware rate limiting deliver moderate coverage for streaming-related risks. 在得分高于基线的全部 28 个部分中，仅有一个达到最高分（AgentCard 安全），这反映出其缓解效果普遍是部分性的，而非全面性的；这一特征源于其有意将范围限定在协议层，因此需要在每个相邻层部署纵深防御控制措施。 Across all 28 sections scoring above baseline, only one reaches the highest score (AgentCard security), reflecting consistent partial rather than comprehensive mitigation—a profile that results from deliberate scoping to the protocol layer, requiring defense-in-depth controls at every adjacent layer.
V-D NIST AI 风险管理框架V-D NIST AI Risk Management Framework
