NIST AI 风险管理框架（AI RMF 1.0）于 2023 年以 NIST AI 100-1 发布，是一个自愿采用、面向全生命周期的框架，围绕四项核心职能——治理（GOVERN）、映射（MAP）、测量（MEASURE）和管理（MANAGE）——组织，为可信 AI 提供组织结构、风险表征方法、评估实践和响应机制 [3]。 The NIST AI Risk Management Framework (AI RMF 1.0), published as NIST AI 100-1 in 2023, is a voluntary, lifecycle-oriented framework organized around four core functions—GOVERN, MAP, MEASURE, and MANAGE—providing organizational structures, risk characterization methods, evaluation practices, and response mechanisms for trustworthy AI [3]. 其 2025 年配套文件 NIST AI 100-2e2025 通过一套正式的对抗性机器学习分类体系扩展了该治理框架，涵盖针对预测式 AI 系统的规避、投毒和隐私攻击，以及针对生成式 AI 系统的供应链攻击、直接提示攻击和间接提示注入攻击，其中明确讨论了 RAG 知识库投毒、后门植入和多智能体提示蠕虫传播 [4]。 Its 2025 companion document, NIST AI 100-2e2025, extends the governance framework with a formal adversarial ML taxonomy covering evasion, poisoning, and privacy attacks on predictive AI systems and supply chain, direct prompting, and indirect prompt injection attacks on generative AI systems, including explicit treatment of RAG knowledge-base poisoning, backdoor installation, and multi-agent prompt worm propagation [4]. 两者共同构成美国联邦层面评估和管理 AI 安全风险的主要参考依据。 Together they constitute the primary U.S. federal reference for assessing and managing AI security risk.
NIST AI 100-2 的对抗性机器学习分类体系直接、明确地涵盖了得分最高的威胁类别：RAG 知识库投毒（引用 PoisonedRAG 和 Phantom 攻击）、共享模型中的后门投毒、通过共享对话历史和序列化记忆实施的间接提示注入、作为供应链攻击途径的模型注册表版本操纵，以及通过 RLHF 反馈渠道造成的训练数据污染。 NIST AI 100-2’s adversarial ML taxonomy provides direct named coverage for the highest-scoring threat categories: RAG knowledge-base poisoning (referencing PoisonedRAG and Phantom attacks), backdoor poisoning in shared models, indirect prompt injection through shared conversation histories and serialized memory, model registry version manipulation as a supply chain vector, and training data contamination through RLHF feedback channels. 在每个领域，该框架都提供了从业者可以直接付诸实施的具体缓解措施，包括聚光标记（spotlighting）、分层信任训练、基于密码学的制品验证、数据过滤，以及对检索内容进行沙箱隔离。 In each area, the framework supplies concrete mitigations—spotlighting, hierarchical trust training, cryptographic artifact verification, data filtering, and sandboxing of retrieved content—that practitioners can operationalize directly. 在被评为中等水平的 84 个类别中，GOVERN、MAP、MEASURE 和 MANAGE 职能要求组织承担识别、刻画、评估和应对威胁的义务，这些威胁涉及人类监督接口、多智能体记忆与状态管理、推理轨迹泄露、评估流水线完整性，以及智能体间通信过程中的信任边界强制执行。 Across 84 categories scored at a moderate level, the GOVERN, MAP, MEASURE, and MANAGE functions create organizational obligations to identify, characterize, evaluate, and respond to threats spanning human oversight interfaces, multi-agent memory and state management, reasoning trace leakage, evaluation pipeline integrity, and trust boundary enforcement during inter-agent communication. 隐私攻击分类体系（涵盖数据重构、成员推断、属性推断和模型提取）与间接提示注入分类体系（涵盖可用性、完整性和隐私子目标）在概念层面将覆盖范围扩展至多模态嵌入反演和跨智能体上下文窃取。 The privacy attack taxonomy (covering data reconstruction, membership inference, property inference, and model extraction) and indirect prompt injection taxonomy (covering availability, integrity, and privacy sub-objectives) extend coverage to multimodal embedding inversion and cross-agent context-stealing at the conceptual level. 覆盖缺口集中在硬件层面和分布式基础设施攻击、流式处理与缓存中的竞态条件，以及高度专门化的智能体内部决策逻辑攻击，这反映出该框架有意被设计为治理与机器学习安全工具，而非基础设施安全标准。 Coverage gaps cluster in hardware-level and distributed infrastructure attacks, streaming and caching race conditions, and highly specialized internal agent decision-logic attacks, reflecting the framework’s deliberate design as a governance and ML security instrument rather than an infrastructure security standard.
V-E NSA AI 数据安全V-E NSA AI Data Security
NSA AI 数据安全框架是由 NSA 人工智能安全中心、CISA、FBI 及五眼联盟伙伴机构于 2025 年 5 月联合发布的一份《网络安全信息表》（Cybersecurity Information Sheet，CSI），提供了十项最佳实践（BP1–BP10），用于保障 NIST AI RMF 全部六个生命周期阶段的数据安全 [2400]。 The NSA AI Data Security framework is a joint Cybersecurity Information Sheet (CSI) published in May 2025 by the NSA Artificial Intelligence Security Center, CISA, the FBI, and Five Eyes partner agencies, providing ten best practices (BP1–BP10) for securing data across all six NIST AI RMF lifecycle stages [2400]. 该框架通过基于密码学的来源追踪、完整性验证、访问控制、加密和隐私保护技术，应对三大主要风险领域——数据供应链完整性、遭恶意修改的数据和数据漂移。 The framework addresses three principal risk areas—data supply chain integrity, maliciously modified data, and data drift—through cryptographic provenance tracking, integrity verification, access controls, encryption, and privacy-preserving techniques. 其范围专门限定于 AI 开发、测试和运行过程中使用的数据资源。 It is scoped specifically to the data resources used during AI development, testing, and operation.
BP1 要求使用经密码学签名的仅追加式来源记录账本；BP2 强制要求使用校验和与密码学哈希进行完整性验证；BP3 要求采用抗量子数字签名（参照 NIST FIPS 204 和 205），以验证训练数据集和 RLHF 数据集的真实性。 BP1 requires cryptographically signed append-only provenance ledgers; BP2 mandates checksums and cryptographic hashes for integrity verification; BP3 calls for quantum-resistant digital signatures (referencing NIST FIPS 204 and 205) to authenticate training and RLHF datasets. BP4 规定采用零信任架构和安全隔区；BP5 要求根据敏感性对数据进行分类，并将分类范围扩展至 AI 输出；BP6 强制要求对静态数据采用 AES-256 加密，对传输中的数据采用 TLS，并做好采用后量子密码技术的准备。 BP4 prescribes Zero Trust architecture and secure enclaves; BP5 requires sensitivity-based data classification extending to AI outputs; BP6 mandates AES-256 encryption at rest and TLS in transit with post-quantum cryptographic readiness. 数据供应链部分分析了针对网络规模数据集的分视图（split-view）和抢先操作（frontrunning）投毒攻击，并规定采用数据策展者认证、密码学哈希验证和基于共识的域名信任机制。 The data supply chain section analyzes split-view and frontrunning poisoning attacks on web-scale datasets, prescribing curator certification, cryptographic hash verification, and consensus-based domain trust. 遭恶意修改的数据部分涉及对抗性机器学习、统计偏差注入、去重失效，以及安全多方训练流水线的完整性。 The maliciously modified data section addresses adversarial ML, statistical bias injection, deduplication failures, and secure multi-party training pipeline integrity. 该框架在 19 个风险子类别中获得了具有实质意义的防护强度评分，其中在学习与训练数据攻击方面得分最高，在工具元数据投毒、语义记忆与 RAG 流水线攻击、向量数据库与嵌入投毒、ETL 流水线攻击以及模型训练后门方面得分中等。 The framework receives non-trivial strength scores across 19 risk subcategories, achieving the highest score for learning and training data attacks and scoring moderately across tool metadata poisoning, semantic memory and RAG pipeline attacks, vector database and embedding poisoning, ETL pipeline attacks, and model training backdoors. 其主要局限在于范围仅限于静态数据资产：它未扩展至运行时智能体攻击向量、检索逻辑漏洞、UI 安全或多智能体协调攻击。 Its principal limitation is exclusive scoping to static data assets: it does not extend to runtime agentic attack vectors, retrieval logic vulnerabilities, UI security, or multi-agent coordination attacks.
V-F GAO AI 问责框架V-F GAO AI Accountability Framework
GAO AI 问责框架（GAO-21-519SP，2021）是美国政府问责局制定的一项治理与监督框架，旨在促进联邦机构在使用 AI 时落实问责并负责任地使用 AI [2401]。 The GAO AI Accountability Framework (GAO-21-519SP, 2021) is a governance and oversight framework developed by the U.S. Government Accountability Office to promote accountability and responsible use of AI in federal agencies [2401]. 该框架围绕四项相互补充的原则组织而成——治理（实践 1.1–1.9）、数据（实践 2.1–2.8）、性能（实践 3.1–3.9）和监测（实践 4.1–4.5）——提供了关键实践、审计问题和评估程序，使审计人员与第三方评估人员能够独立验证 AI 系统的行为。 Organized around four complementary principles—Governance (practices 1.1–1.9), Data (practices 2.1–2.8), Performance (practices 3.1–3.9), and Monitoring (practices 4.1–4.5)—it provides key practices, audit questions, and assessment procedures enabling independent verification of AI system behavior by auditors and third-party assessors.
该框架最直接的贡献体现在其数据治理实践（2.1 来源、2.2 可靠性、2.8 安全与隐私）、透明度与人类监督要求（1.9 和 3.9）、可追溯性要求（4.3）以及风险管理规划义务（1.6）方面。 The framework’s most direct contributions emerge through its data governance practices (2.1 Sources, 2.2 Reliability, 2.8 Security and Privacy), its transparency and human supervision mandates (1.9 and 3.9), its traceability requirement (4.3), and its risk management planning obligation (1.6). 这些实践在涉及数据泄露、通过共享对话历史进行的提示注入、记忆与 RAG 流水线投毒、评估完整性、可观测性缺口以及审批工作流利用的风险领域中，形成了切实的治理问责压力。 These practices create genuine governance accountability pressure across risk domains involving data leakage, prompt injection via shared conversation history, memory and RAG pipeline poisoning, evaluation integrity, observability gaps, and approval workflow exploitation. 实践 2.8 直接适用于保护共享对话历史和序列化智能体状态；实践 4.3 针对归因日志记录失效确立问责要求，此类失效会使攻击者得以在多智能体仪表板中冒充智能体；实践 3.9 则为要求建立能够抵御审批疲劳的人类监督工作流提供了依据。 Practice 2.8 directly applies to securing shared conversational history and serialized agent state; practice 4.3 creates accountability for attribution logging failures that enable agent impersonation in multi-agent dashboards; and practice 3.9 provides grounds to require human oversight workflows resistant to approval fatigue. 监测与漂移检测要求（实践 4.2 和 4.4）适用于非确定性和规约博弈风险。 Monitoring and drift-detection mandates (practices 4.2 and 4.4) apply to non-determinism and specification gaming risks. 该框架作为治理问责工具的性质，从结构上限定了其适用范围：它不提供具体的技术控制措施，也不规定对抗鲁棒性要求，且无法检测或防止针对多智能体协调基础设施的底层漏洞利用。 The framework’s applicability is structurally bounded by its nature as a governance accountability instrument: it provides no specific technical controls, no adversarial robustness specifications, and cannot detect or prevent low-level exploitation of multi-agent coordination infrastructure. 所有 79 个受评估风险类别的评分均处于同一中等水平，这表明该工具确立了组织问责要求并提供了审计抓手，但未定义任何技术实现细节——适合作为治理基线，但需要技术安全框架加以补充。 All 79 assessed risk categories scored at a single moderate level, reflecting an instrument that establishes organizational accountability requirements and creates audit handles while leaving all technical implementation details undefined—appropriate as a governance baseline requiring supplementation by technical security frameworks.
V-G CDAO GenAI 负责任 AI 工具包V-G CDAO GenAI Responsible AI Toolkit
美国国防部首席数字与人工智能办公室于 2024 年 12 月发布的 CDAO 生成式 AI 负责任 AI 工具包（Version 1.0），将国防部的五项 AI 伦理原则（负责任、公平、可追溯、可靠和可治理）落实到包含七个阶段的 AI 产品生命周期中 [8]。 The CDAO Generative AI Responsible AI Toolkit (Version 1.0), published by the U.S. Department of Defense Chief Digital and Artificial Intelligence Office in December 2024, operationalizes the five DoD AI Ethical Principles (Responsible, Equitable, Traceable, Reliable, and Governable) across a seven-stage AI product lifecycle [8]. 该工具包提供了嵌入生命周期的负责任 AI（RAI）关卡检查点、用于生成关切声明的 SHIELD 评估流程、RASCI 问责矩阵，以及一个精选数据库，其中收录约 100 种开源和行业标准 RAI 工具，涵盖安全、公平性、可解释性、对抗鲁棒性、RAG 评估和持续监测。 The toolkit provides lifecycle-embedded RAI Gate checkpoints, a SHIELD Assessment process for generating Statements of Concern, a RASCI accountability matrix, and a curated database of approximately 100 open-source and industry-standard RAI tools covering security, fairness, explainability, adversarial robustness, RAG evaluation, and continuous monitoring.
该工具包在安全方面最实质性的贡献集中于阶段 4 和阶段 5。 The toolkit’s most substantive security contributions reside in Stage 4 and Stage 5. 阶段 4.1.4 直接要求实施提示注入防护（推荐使用 NeMo Guardrails、Guardrails AI 和 LLM Guard）、输入净化、对抗鲁棒性测试、数据投毒检测、训练和微调期间的差分隐私保护、通过 SBOMs 保障供应链完整性，以及用于防范拒绝服务的速率限制。 Stage 4.1.4 directly mandates prompt injection prevention (recommending NeMo Guardrails, Guardrails AI, and LLM Guard), input sanitization, adversarial robustness testing, data poisoning detection, differential privacy during training and fine-tuning, supply chain integrity via SBOMs, and rate limiting against denial-of-service. 阶段 5 的测试、评估、验证与确认（TEVV）要求开展红队测试，使用 GARAK 和 Prompt Fuzzer 等工具进行对抗测试，并通过 AgentBench 开展针对智能体的专门测试。 Stage 5 TEVV requires red-teaming, adversarial testing using tools such as GARAK and Prompt Fuzzer, and agent-specific testing via AgentBench. 阶段 6 建立正式的事件响应机制，并提出思维链可追溯性和来源追溯要求；阶段 7 要求使用 Arize Phoenix、WhyLabs、TruLens、RAGAS 和 MLflow 等工具，持续监测行为漂移。 Stage 6 establishes formal incident response with chain-of-thought traceability and provenance requirements; Stage 7 mandates continuous monitoring for behavioral drift using tools including Arize Phoenix, WhyLabs, TruLens, RAGAS, and MLflow. 精选 RAI 工具清单包括 IBM Adversarial Robustness 360、TextAttack、Counterfit、LlamaIndex Evaluation Tools、用于 RAG 流水线安全的 RAGAS，以及用于个人身份信息（PII）检测的 Microsoft Presidio。 The curated RAI Tools List includes IBM Adversarial Robustness 360, TextAttack, Counterfit, LlamaIndex Evaluation Tools, RAGAS for RAG pipeline security, and Microsoft Presidio for PII detection. 覆盖最充分的领域是 RAG 安全、提示注入防护、训练数据投毒防御，以及向量数据库的嵌入完整性。 Strongest coverage areas are RAG security, prompt injection prevention, training data poisoning defenses, and vector database embedding integrity. 在特定框架的漏洞（LangChain、AutoGen、CrewAI）、硬件层面的问题（GPU 内存隔离、Kubernetes RBAC），以及通过 AI 对 AI 的社会工程实施信任利用、蠕虫式提示传播等多智能体特有威胁方面，仍存在覆盖缺口。 Coverage gaps remain in framework-specific vulnerabilities (LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI), hardware-level concerns (GPU memory isolation, Kubernetes RBAC), and multi-agent-specific threats such as trust exploitation through AI-to-AI social engineering and worm-like prompt propagation.
V-H OWASP 智能体安全倡议V-H OWASP Agentic Security Initiative
OWASP 智能体安全倡议（ASI）是 OWASP GenAI Security Project 编制的一套由五份相互关联的文档组成的资料，旨在解决将 LLM 推理与工具执行、持久记忆及多步骤规划相结合的自主 AI 智能体系统的安全问题 [6, 2402]。 The OWASP Agentic Security Initiative (ASI) is a suite of five interconnected documents produced by the OWASP GenAI Security Project addressing security of autonomous AI agent systems that combine LLM reasoning with tool execution, persistent memory, and multi-step planning [6, 2402]. 该倡议涵盖威胁分类体系、架构威胁建模（MAESTRO 框架）、面向开发者和运营者的安全控制措施、按风险排序的 Top 10 风险清单（ASI01–ASI10），以及治理与监管要求的映射。 The initiative spans threat taxonomy, architectural threat modelling (the MAESTRO framework), developer and operator security controls, a ranked Top 10 risk list (ASI01–ASI10), and governance and regulatory mapping. 其控制措施针对智能体 AI 独特的威胁面——概率性的非确定性行为、运行时的动态工具组合、易受投毒的持久记忆，以及多智能体委派链——而非早期 OWASP LLM 指南所采用的单次推理威胁模型。 Its controls address the distinct threat surface of agentic AI—probabilistic non-deterministic behavior, dynamic runtime tool composition, persistent memory susceptible to poisoning, and multi-agent delegation chains—rather than the single-inference threat model of earlier OWASP LLM guidance.
该倡议按风险排序的十个风险类别涵盖了智能体 AI 的主要威胁类型：通过提示注入和间接操纵实施目标劫持（ASI01）、通过不安全委派和参数注入实施工具滥用（ASI02）、多智能体委派链中的身份与权限滥用（ASI03）、动态工具和插件组合引发的运行时供应链漏洞（ASI04）、沙箱机制失效导致的意外远程代码执行（ASI05）、对持久及共享知识存储的记忆与上下文投毒（ASI06）、不安全的智能体间通信（ASI07）、影响范围放大导致的级联故障（ASI08）、人类与智能体之间的信任利用及决策疲劳攻击（ASI09），以及失控智能体的失对齐（ASI10）。 The initiative’s ten ranked risk categories address the principal threat classes of agentic AI: goal hijacking through prompt injection and indirect manipulation (ASI01), tool misuse via unsafe delegation and parameter injection (ASI02), identity and privilege abuse in multi-agent delegation chains (ASI03), runtime supply chain vulnerabilities from dynamic tool and plugin composition (ASI04), unexpected remote code execution from sandboxing failures (ASI05), memory and context poisoning of persistent and shared knowledge stores (ASI06), insecure inter-agent communication (ASI07), cascading failures from blast-radius amplification (ASI08), human-agent trust exploitation and decision-fatigue attacks (ASI09), and rogue agent misalignment (ASI10). 具体的控制措施类别涵盖运行时意图验证与目标锁定、由执行前策略执行点（“Intent Gate”）对每个工具实施最小权限约束、即时提供的临时凭证、执行沙箱、支持回滚的记忆内容验证、通过 SBOMs、AIBOMs 及签名清单追溯供应链来源、使用 PKI 和 mTLS 进行智能体间密码学身份认证、防止级联故障的熔断机制，以及行为监测。 Concrete control families span intent validation and goal locking at runtime, per-tool least-privilege enforcement by a pre-execution Policy Enforcement Point (the “Intent Gate”), just-in-time ephemeral credentials, execution sandboxes, memory content validation with rollback, supply chain provenance via SBOMs and AIBOMs with signed manifests, cryptographic inter-agent authentication using PKI and mTLS, circuit breakers against cascading failures, and behavioral monitoring.
该框架覆盖最充分的领域包括 RAG 流水线与记忆投毒防御、工具与插件供应链完整性、多智能体通信安全以及审批工作流保护。 The framework’s strongest coverage lies in RAG pipeline and memory poisoning defense, tool and plugin supply chain integrity, multi-agent communication security, and approval workflow protection. ASI06 通过对所有写入进行内容验证、来源归属标注、信任加权检索、会话隔离和回滚机制，应对针对情景记忆和语义记忆的攻击。 ASI06 addresses episodic and semantic memory attacks through content validation on all writes, source attribution, trust-weighted retrieval, session isolation, and rollback mechanisms. ASI04 的供应链控制措施——内容哈希固定、签名清单、经过审查的注册中心，以及结合差分行为测试的分阶段推出——直接覆盖工具注册中心投毒和模型版本完整性问题。 ASI04’s supply chain controls—content-hash pinning, signed manifests, curated registries, and staged rollout with differential behavioral tests—provide direct coverage of tool registry poisoning and model version integrity. ASI07 通过带类型的契约、模式验证、数字签名和防重放随机数，抵御智能体间通信注入和会话历史蠕虫传播。 ASI07’s typed contracts, schema validation, digital signatures, and anti-replay nonces counter inter-agent communication injection and conversation-history worm propagation. 对于数据泄露场景（其中，访问控制对流式通道和基于嵌入的通道仅具有部分防护能力）、智能体身份溯源以及非确定性问题，该框架的覆盖程度为中等。 Coverage is moderate across data leakage scenarios (where access controls are partial against streaming and embedding-based channels), agent identity provenance, and non-determinism. 在硬件层面的 GPU 攻击、在线强化学习和 MARL 特有威胁、流式处理特有的注入窗口，以及专门的规划架构（MCTS、HTN）方面，仍存在缺口。 Gaps remain in hardware-level GPU attacks, online reinforcement learning and MARL-specific threats, streaming-specific injection windows, and specialized planning architectures (MCTS, HTN).
V-I Google 保障 AI 智能体安全的方法V-I Google’s Approach to Secure AI Agents
Google 的《安全 AI 智能体导论》[2403] 是一个应用架构层面的安全框架，通过三项核心原则应对 AI 智能体的两类主要风险——失控行为和敏感数据泄露：智能体必须具有职责明确的人类控制者，关键或不可逆操作必须获得明确确认；必须通过最小权限、限定作用域的 OAuth 令牌和沙箱机制，动态限制智能体的权限；必须通过健全的日志记录和透明的用户界面，使智能体的操作与规划具有可观测性。 Google’s “An Introduction to Secure AI Agents” [2403] is an application-architecture-level security framework addressing two primary AI agent risk categories—rogue actions and sensitive data disclosure—through three core principles: agents must have well-defined human controllers with explicit confirmation required for critical or irreversible actions; agent powers must be dynamically constrained via least privilege, scoped OAuth tokens, and sandboxing; and agent actions and planning must be observable through robust logging and transparent UIs. 该框架实施了一种混合纵深防御策略，将确定性的 Layer 1 策略引擎（在 AI 模型推理循环之外运行，以拦截和评估操作请求）与基于推理的 Layer 2 防御相结合，后者包括对抗训练、防护模型分类器和计划分析模型，并通过回归测试、变体分析和红队测试提供持续保障。 The framework implements a hybrid defense-in-depth strategy combining deterministic Layer 1 policy engines (operating outside the AI model’s reasoning loop to intercept and evaluate action requests) with Layer 2 reasoning-based defenses including adversarial training, guard model classifiers, and plan analysis models, supported by continuous assurance through regression testing, variant analysis, and red teams.
该框架最突出的贡献在于提示注入防御和工具安全。 The framework’s strongest contributions are in prompt injection defense and tool security. 通过要求采用结构化提示规范（使用清晰的分隔符和角色标签，将可信指令与不可信的外部内容分开）、Layer 2 防护模型分类器以及输入流分离，该框架直接应对了攻击者借助网页内容、文件、电子邮件和工具输出劫持智能体行为的主要机制。 By requiring structural prompt conventions (clear delimiters and role tagging to separate trusted instructions from untrusted external content), Layer 2 guard model classifiers, and input stream separation, it directly addresses the primary mechanism through which adversaries hijack agent behavior via web content, files, emails, and tool outputs. 这些防御措施可自然扩展至 RAG 流水线，其中检索到的内容必须被视为不可信输入；也可扩展至多智能体场景，其中一个智能体的输出会成为另一个智能体的输入。 These defenses extend naturally to RAG pipelines, where retrieved content must be treated as untrusted input, and to multi-agent scenarios where one agent’s output becomes another’s input. 该框架明确认识到，动态引入第三方工具会带来源于欺骗性工具描述和不安全实现的风险，这体现了对工具与插件生态系统的准确威胁建模；其针对工具使用提出的身份验证、授权和审计要求，则提供了具有明确原则依据的访问控制基线。 The framework’s explicit recognition that dynamically incorporating third-party tools introduces risks from deceptive tool descriptions and insecure implementations reflects accurate threat modeling of the tool and plugin ecosystem, and its authentication, authorization, and auditing requirements for tool use provide a principled access control baseline.
该框架还直接处理了记忆安全问题。 Memory security is also addressed directly. 该框架要求记忆实现确保不同用户和上下文之间的严格隔离，并明确承认，存储在记忆中的恶意数据可能影响智能体在未来无关交互中的行为；这些要求与认识对应于情景记忆和语义记忆投毒、向量存储注入以及跨智能体记忆污染等威胁模式。 The requirement that memory implementations ensure strict isolation between users and contexts, combined with explicit acknowledgment that malicious data stored in memory can influence future agent behavior in unrelated interactions, corresponds to threat patterns involving episodic and semantic memory poisoning, vector store injection, and cross-agent memory contamination. 可观测性原则有助于应对多类威胁：对智能体输入、工具调用、参数、输出和推理步骤进行健全的日志记录，可形成检测异常行为所需的审计轨迹，而透明的用户界面则使用户能够了解智能体的推理过程和预期操作。 The observability principle contributes across multiple threat categories: robust logging of agent inputs, tool invocations, parameters, outputs, and reasoning steps creates the audit trail necessary for detecting anomalous behavior, while transparent UIs provide users with visibility into agent reasoning and intended actions.
混合防御架构是该框架在架构层面最重要的贡献。 The hybrid defense architecture is the framework’s most architecturally significant contribution. 通过将确定性的策略执行置于 AI 推理循环之外，该框架明确弥补了 AI 模型输出具有非确定性且可能受到操纵这一固有特性所带来的不足。 By placing deterministic policy enforcement outside the AI reasoning loop, it explicitly compensates for the non-deterministic, potentially manipulable nature of AI model outputs. 在执行前评估智能体拟定计划的计划分析模型，可应对推理层面的威胁，包括思维链操纵和危险工具调用序列的嵌入。 Plan analysis models that evaluate proposed agent plans before execution address reasoning-level threats including chain-of-thought manipulation and dangerous tool sequence embedding. 这种认识，即 AI 的非确定性是一项根本挑战，而 Layer 1 的确定性是对此的结构性应对，体现了对多智能体安全架构的准确理解。 This acknowledgment that AI non-determinism is a fundamental challenge—and that Layer 1 determinism is the structural response to it—reflects an accurate understanding of multi-agent security architecture.
V-J NIST AI 600-1 生成式 AI 配套指南V-J NIST AI 600-1 Generative AI Profile
NIST AI 600-1（生成式 AI 配套指南）是《AI 风险管理框架》（AI RMF 1.0）的一份跨行业配套指南，依据 EO 14110 于 2024 年发布，围绕十二类风险，为生成式 AI 系统提供治理和风险管理指导 [2404]。 NIST AI 600-1 (Generative AI Profile) is a cross-sectoral companion profile to the AI Risk Management Framework (AI RMF 1.0), released in 2024 pursuant to EO 14110, providing governance and risk management guidance for generative AI systems across twelve risk categories [2404]. 建议采取的行动围绕四项主要考量展开——治理、内容来源、部署前测试和事件披露——并映射至 AI RMF 子类别（GOVERN、MAP、MEASURE、MANAGE）。 Suggested actions are organized around four primary considerations—Governance, Content Provenance, Pre-deployment Testing, and Incident Disclosure—mapped to AI RMF subcategories (GOVERN, MAP, MEASURE, MANAGE). 该配置文件明确将直接和间接提示注入以及数据投毒列为信息安全风险（§2.9），并将供应链完整性列为价值链与组件集成风险（§2.12）。 The profile explicitly recognizes direct and indirect prompt injection and data poisoning as Information Security risks (§2.9), and supply chain integrity as a Value Chain and Component Integration risk (§2.12).
在得分高于基线的各个受评类别中，该框架的覆盖始终停留在治理层面，体现了其作为风险管理配置文件而非技术安全标准的性质。 Across evaluated categories with above-baseline scores, the framework’s coverage is consistently governance-level, reflecting its character as a risk management profile rather than a technical security standard. 三个威胁领域获得了最具实质性的部分覆盖。 Three threat domains receive the most substantive partial coverage. 在提示注入领域，信息安全类别对提示注入的明确认可，加上 MEASURE 2.7 对红队测试和对抗性测试的要求，为评估以下场景中的注入攻击面提供了有力的组织层面推动：审批工作流利用（RATC_2）、工具和函数调用注入（RIDC_4）、ReAct 与推理架构注入（RIDC_5）、通过共享对话历史传播的自我复制提示蠕虫（RTE_4_1），以及跨智能体编排层级的多跳间接注入（RTE_20_3、RTE_20_4）。 In the prompt injection domain, the Information Security category’s explicit recognition of prompt injection—combined with MEASURE 2.7’s mandate for red-teaming and adversarial testing—provides meaningful organizational pressure for evaluating injection attack surfaces across approval workflow exploitation (RATC_2), tool and function call injection (RIDC_4), ReAct and reasoning architecture injection (RIDC_5), self-replicating prompt worm propagation through shared conversation histories (RTE_4_1), and multi-hop indirect injection across agent orchestration hierarchies (RTE_20_3, RTE_20_4). 在供应链领域，价值链与组件集成类别（§2.12）结合 GOVERN 6.1 和 6.2，指导组织审查第三方组件并建立问责机制，从而间接覆盖工具和插件注册表攻击、模型注册表版本操纵、MLflow 元数据注入、空中下载更新监管链破坏，以及 safetensors 验证绕过。 In the supply chain domain, the Value Chain and Component Integration category (§2.12) with GOVERN 6.1 and 6.2 directs organizations to vet third-party components and establish accountability, providing indirect coverage for tool and plugin registry attacks, model registry version manipulation, MLflow metadata injection, over-the-air update chain-of-custody corruption, and safetensors validation bypass. 这一供应链治理框架适用于采购层面，并建立了可由下游技术控制措施落实的组织问责结构。 This supply chain governance framing applies at the procurement level and creates organizational accountability structures that downstream technical controls can operationalize. 在数据投毒领域，信息安全类别对数据投毒的认可，为应对 RAG 知识库投毒（RATC_16、RTE_22_1）、向量数据库和嵌入投毒（RMP_15、RTE_21_4）、ETL 流水线攻击（RMP_16）、缓存与持久化攻击（RMP_5）、参数调优与配置投毒（RMP_8），以及学习和训练数据攻击（RMP_9）提供了治理框架。 In the data poisoning domain, the Information Security category’s recognition of data poisoning provides governance framing for RAG knowledge base poisoning (RATC_16, RTE_22_1), vector database and embedding poisoning (RMP_15, RTE_21_4), ETL pipeline attacks (RMP_16), caching and persistence attacks (RMP_5), parameter tuning and configuration poisoning (RMP_8), and learning and training data attacks (RMP_9). 人类与 AI 配置类别对自动化偏见和过度依赖的论述，结合 GOVERN 3.2 对人工监督政策的要求，为应对审批工作流漏洞及工具授权中的置信度操纵提供了治理依据。 The Human-AI Configuration category’s treatment of automation bias and over-reliance, combined with GOVERN 3.2’s requirement for human oversight policies, provides governance rationale for addressing approval workflow vulnerabilities and confidence manipulation in tool authorization.
该配置文件的系统性局限在于治理义务与技术控制措施之间存在差距：它要求识别和衡量风险，并明确组织内部的责任归属，却未规定应对这些风险所需的工程机制。 The profile’s systematic limitation is the gap between governance obligations and technical controls: it mandates that risks be identified, measured, and assigned organizational ownership without prescribing the engineering mechanisms necessary to address them. 它未包含针对基于密码学的记忆完整性检查、多智能体信任链验证、运行时监控架构，或针对 LangChain、AutoGen、CrewAI 和 Semantic Kernel 的框架专用防御措施的控制要求。 It contains no controls for cryptographic memory integrity checking, multi-agent trust chain verification, runtime monitoring architectures, or framework-specific defenses for LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, and Semantic Kernel. 包括 Kubernetes 安全、GPU 硬件隔离、服务网格身份验证和容器加固在内的基础设施层面攻击面，完全不在该配置文件的范围内。 Infrastructure-level attack surfaces including Kubernetes security, GPU hardware isolation, service mesh authentication, and container hardening fall entirely outside the profile’s scope. 该配置文件作为组织治理的基准，指导部署前的评估工作，但需要技术安全框架加以补充，才能覆盖智能体式 AI 系统的全部攻击面。 The profile functions as an organizational governance anchor directing pre-deployment evaluation effort while requiring supplementation by technical security frameworks for the full attack surface of agentic AI systems.
V-K DIU 负责任 AI 指南V-K DIU Responsible AI Guidelines
国防创新部门（DIU）的负责任 AI（RAI）指南通过开发工作表和部署工作表，将美国国防部的五项 AI 伦理原则——负责任、公平、可追溯、可靠和可治理——落实到包含三个阶段的 AI 生命周期中 [2405]。 The Defense Innovation Unit (DIU) Responsible AI (RAI) Guidelines operationalize the five DoD AI Ethical Principles—Responsible, Equitable, Traceable, Reliable, and Governable—across a three-phase AI lifecycle through a Development Worksheet and a Deployment Worksheet [2405]. 开发工作表涵盖五个探究方向：数据模型操纵、系统性能监控、输出验证、审计机制和治理角色；部署工作表则要求在系统的整个运行生命周期内持续开展评估。 The Development Worksheet addresses five lines of inquiry: manipulation of data models, system performance monitoring, output verification, audit mechanisms, and governance roles; the Deployment Worksheet requires continuous evaluation throughout the system’s operational lifecycle.
该框架与 AI 智能体安全的相关性较为有限，并且在结构上受到其治理导向的制约。 The framework’s relevance to AI agent security is narrow and structurally bounded by its governance orientation. 在所有受评风险类别中，仅有十二个类别的得分高于基线，且均处于中等水平，这反映出该指南发挥的是伦理监督工具的作用，而非技术安全标准的作用。 Among all evaluated risk categories, only twelve scored above the baseline—all at the moderate level—reflecting the guidelines’ function as an ethical oversight instrument rather than a technical security standard. 达到中等适用性的各节均涉及训练数据完整性所面临的威胁、模型行为验证和人工监督。 Sections achieving moderate applicability consistently involve threats to training data integrity, model behavior verification, and human oversight. 开发工作表中关于“数据模型操纵”的探究，为强化学习数据投毒、训练阶段后门注入和 RAG 知识库操纵确立了组织层面的问责要求。 The Development Worksheet’s “manipulation of data models” inquiry creates organizational accountability for reinforcement learning data poisoning, training-time backdoor injection, and RAG knowledge base manipulation. “可治理”和“负责任”原则为具有韧性的审批工作流及能够在故障时保持安全的护栏基础设施提供了治理层面的依据；“可追溯”原则对可审计性的要求形成了推动推理透明度和评估遥测的制度压力；而“可靠”原则的性能监控要求也对评估完整性施加了类似压力。 The “Governable” and “Responsible” principles provide governance-level rationale for resilient approval workflows and guardrail infrastructure that fails safely; the “Traceable” principle’s auditability mandate creates institutional pressure for reasoning transparency and evaluation telemetry; and the “Reliable” principle’s performance monitoring requirements apply comparable pressure for evaluation integrity. 基础设施层面的攻击、提示注入途径、多智能体信任利用、记忆投毒以及框架特有漏洞均未得到涵盖，这反映了该文件作为伦理问责机制的务实定位：它提出组织层面的问题，但不规定回答这些问题所需的技术控制措施。 Infrastructure-level attacks, prompt injection vectors, multi-agent trust exploitation, memory poisoning, and framework-specific vulnerabilities receive no coverage, reflecting the document’s honest baseline as an ethical accountability mechanism that establishes organizational questions without prescribing the technical controls necessary to answer them.
V-L 美国国防部 AI 网络安全风险管理框架V-L DoD AI Cybersecurity Risk Management Framework
《美国国防部人工智能网络安全风险管理裁剪指南》（Version 2，July 2025）由美国国防部首席信息官办公室与 OUSD(R&E) 和 OUSD(A&S) 合作发布，将 NIST 风险管理框架和 CNSSI 1253 控制目录扩展至整个美国国防部的 AI 采购、开发、部署、监控和处置全生命周期 [2406]。 The DoD Artificial Intelligence Cybersecurity Risk Management Tailoring Guide (Version 2, July 2025), published by the DoD Chief Information Office in collaboration with OUSD(R&E) and OUSD(A&S), extends the NIST Risk Management Framework and CNSSI 1253 control catalog to the full AI acquisition, development, deployment, monitoring, and disposal lifecycle across the Department of Defense [2406]. 该指南以 DoDI 8510.01、NIST SP 800-37 和 NIST AI RMF 1.0 为依据，将源自 MITRE ATLAS 的 AI 威胁向量映射至按优先级排序的 CNSSI 1253 安全与隐私控制措施。 Grounded in DoDI 8510.01, NIST SP 800-37, and NIST AI RMF 1.0, the guide maps MITRE ATLAS-derived AI threat vectors to prioritized CNSSI 1253 security and privacy controls. 处置阶段独有的要求是安全销毁模型权重、训练数据集、测试结果及相关容器。 The disposal phase uniquely requires secure destruction of model weights, training datasets, test results, and associated containers.
在所评估的威胁场景中呈现出一致的模式：该框架对基础设施层威胁的适用性最强。 A consistent pattern emerges across evaluated threat scenarios: the framework’s strongest applicability lies in infrastructure-layer threats. 配置管理控制措施（CM 族）用于应对 Kubernetes 安全上下文配置错误、容器编排 RBAC 配置错误以及 API 网关路由操纵。 Configuration management controls (CM family) address Kubernetes security context misconfiguration, container orchestration RBAC misconfigurations, and API gateway routing manipulation. 供应链控制措施（SR 族：供应链计划、来源追溯、风险评估、防伪）用于应对容器镜像仓库攻击、MLflow 制品注册表访问控制失效以及插件依赖项完整性问题。 Supply chain controls (SR family: supply chain plans, provenance, risk assessment, anti-counterfeiting) address container registry attacks, MLflow artifact registry access control failures, and plugin dependency integrity. 访问控制和边界保护措施（AC 族和 SC-7）适用于 etcd 数据库暴露、微服务身份验证、服务账户冒用以及网络隔离绕过。 Access control and boundary protection (AC family and SC-7) apply to etcd database exposure, microservices authentication, service account impersonation, and network isolation bypass. 审计日志控制措施（AU 族）涵盖对话历史累积、工具调用参数记录、错误消息聚合、分布式追踪跨度数据以及 Kubernetes 审计日志。 Audit logging controls (AU family) cover conversation history accumulation, tool invocation parameter logging, error message aggregation, distributed tracing span data, and Kubernetes audit logs. SC-28（静态信息保护）的适用范围延伸至向量数据库存储、MLflow 存储库、会话缓存以及 etcd 备份。 SC-28 (protection of information at rest) extends to vector database storage, MLflow repositories, session caches, and etcd backups. 唯一获得最高评分的部分——多智能体信任利用情境下的微服务与 Kubernetes 基础设施攻击——通过 CM、AC、SC-7、SR 和 SI-7 控制措施的协同，获得了最直接且在操作层面最完整的框架映射。 The single section receiving the highest score—microservices and Kubernetes infrastructure attacks in multi-agent trust exploitation contexts—receives the most direct and operationally complete framework mapping from the convergence of CM, AC, SC-7, SR, and SI-7 controls. SC-5 子控制措施用于应对拒绝服务和资源耗尽；SC-24（故障时进入已知状态）适用于通过基础设施故障注入绕过护栏的情况；SI-6（安全功能验证）涵盖对安全验证服务被绕过的检测；而 CA-7 则被明确引用，用于经济型拒绝服务检测。 SC-5 sub-controls address denial-of-service and resource exhaustion; SC-24 (fail in known state) applies to guardrail bypass through infrastructure failure injection; SI-6 (security function verification) covers detection of bypassed safety validation services; and CA-7 is explicitly cited for economic denial-of-service detection.
该框架的系统性缺口在于其源自 ATLAS 的威胁分类体系：这一体系围绕传统机器学习攻击构建，未对 LLM 智能体的新型攻击面进行建模。 The framework’s systematic gap is its ATLAS-derived threat taxonomy, constructed around classical machine learning attacks, which does not model the novel attack surfaces of LLM agents. 通过自然语言描述实施的语义工具注册表投毒、来自网络检索内容的提示注入、置信度分数操纵、流式身份冒用、推理放大成本攻击以及群体智能协同的涌现行为特性，均没有适用的 CNSSI 1253 控制措施。 Semantic tool registry poisoning via natural-language descriptions, prompt injection from web-retrieved content, confidence score manipulation, streaming identity spoofing, reasoning-amplification cost attacks, and the emergent behavioral properties of swarm intelligence coordination have no applicable CNSSI 1253 controls. 该框架的授权模型假定访问策略由显式管理来确定，而非由智能体对话涌现形成；其完整性检查机制针对文件层面的修改，而非对 LLM 注意力和检索的概率性操纵。 The framework’s authorization model assumes explicitly administered access policy rather than authorization emerging from agent dialogue, and its integrity checking mechanisms address file-level modifications rather than probabilistic manipulation of LLM attention and retrieval.
V-M 美国国防部负责任 AI 战略V-M DoD Responsible AI Strategy
《美国国防部负责任 AI 战略与实施路径》由美国国防部负责任 AI 工作委员会编制，并于 October 2024 更新，通过工作路线和指定的主要责任办公室，将负责任、公平、可追溯、可靠和可治理这五项 AI 伦理原则落实到六项基础准则之中 [2407]。 The DoD Responsible AI Strategy and Implementation Pathway, prepared by the DoD Responsible AI Working Council and updated in October 2024, operationalizes five AI Ethical Principles—Responsible, Equitable, Traceable, Reliable, and Governable—across six Foundational Tenets with Lines of Effort and designated Offices of Primary Responsibility [2407]. 首席数字与人工智能官（CDAO）负责协调美国国防部所有组成部门的实施工作。 The Chief Digital and Artificial Intelligence Officer (CDAO) coordinates implementation across all DoD Components.
该战略为下游 AI 安全框架提供了美国国防部的权威政策依据。 The strategy functions as the authoritative DoD policy anchor for downstream AI security frameworks. 其“作战人员信任”准则通过 LOE 2.2.2 明确要求 AI 供应商提供关于系统状态的可追溯反馈，并为操作人员提供启用和停用系统功能的清晰程序，从而直接支持对智能体工具链的人工监督。 Its Warfighter Trust tenet—through LOE 2.2.2—explicitly requires AI vendors to provide traceable feedback on system status and clear procedures for operators to activate and deactivate system functions, directly supporting human oversight of agentic tool chains. LOE 2.1.2 要求开发一套测试、评估、验证与确认（Test, Evaluation, Verification, and Validation，TEVV）工具包，其中包括用于检测针对 AI 系统的对抗攻击并在此类攻击发生时通知操作人员的工具。 LOE 2.1.2 mandates development of a Test, Evaluation, Verification, and Validation (TEVV) toolkit including tools to detect adversarial attacks on AI systems and notify operators when such attacks occur. LOE 2.1.7 要求利用风险管理、供应链安全和网络安全领域的现有最佳实践，制定适用于整个 DoD 的 AI 安全指南。 LOE 2.1.7 directs DoD-wide AI security guidance leveraging existing best practices in risk management, supply chain security, and cybersecurity. 该战略的“期望最终状态”明确警告，对手可能试图利用供应链漏洞，将存在缺陷或可被利用的能力注入 AI 的训练、测试和更新周期，从而为针对工具注册表、模型仓库和插件生态系统开展供应链威胁评估提供直接的政策依据。 The strategy’s Desired End State explicitly warns that adversaries may seek to exploit supply chain vulnerabilities to inject flawed or exploitable capabilities into AI training, testing, and update cycles—providing direct policy grounding for supply chain threat assessments across tool registries, model repositories, and plugin ecosystems.
在所划分的 174 个威胁类别中，27 个部分的评分为中等水平，且没有任何部分超过这一水平，这反映出该战略作为治理文件的特征：确立制度性要求，但不规定具体技术机制。 Across 174 categorized threat categories, 27 sections score at the moderate level and no section exceeds this, reflecting the strategy’s character as a governance document that establishes institutional mandates without prescribing technical mechanisms. 基础设施层面的攻击、推理层的漏洞利用，以及 LangChain、AutoGen、CrewAI 和 Semantic Kernel 中的框架特定漏洞，均未得到实质性的技术论述，因为该战略的作用是授权并指导下游网络安全框架，而非取代这些框架。 Infrastructure-level attacks, reasoning-layer exploits, and framework-specific vulnerabilities in LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, and Semantic Kernel receive no substantive technical coverage, as the strategy functions to authorize and direct downstream cybersecurity frameworks rather than to substitute for them.
V-N ENISA AI 安全多层框架V-N ENISA Multilayer Framework for AI Security
欧盟网络安全局于 2023 年 6 月发布的《AI 良好网络安全实践多层框架》（FAICP），为部署在 ICT 基础设施中的 AI 系统提供了一种可扩展的三层安全架构 [2408]。 The ENISA Multilayer Framework for Good Cybersecurity Practices for AI (FAICP), published by the European Union Agency for Cybersecurity in June 2023, provides a scalable three-layer security architecture for AI systems deployed within ICT infrastructure [2408]. 第 I 层涵盖 ICT 基础，包括风险管理、符合 ISO 27002 和 NIS2 的访问控制、可用性管理、供应链安全以及认证。 Layer I addresses ICT foundations—risk management, access control aligned to ISO 27002 and NIS2, availability management, supply chain security, and certification. 第 II 层涵盖 AI 特有的机器学习生命周期威胁（规避、投毒、模型和数据泄露、组件失陷），以及包括稳健性、韧性和安全性在内的 AI 可信性属性。 Layer II addresses AI-specific ML-lifecycle threats (evasion, poisoning, model and data disclosure, component compromise) and AI trustworthiness properties including robustness, resiliency, and security. 第 III 层参考拟议的《欧盟人工智能法案》，为能源、医疗卫生、汽车和电信行业提供针对性指南。 Layer III provides sector-tailored guidance for energy, health, automotive, and telecommunications, referencing the proposed EU AI Act.
该框架对训练数据和学习过程攻击的覆盖最为充分：第 II 层直接将数据投毒列为主要机器学习威胁，并结合对训练数据集进行来源追踪、访问控制和完整性验证的建议，可适用于少样本示例投毒、强化学习轨迹注入和微调数据污染。 The framework’s strongest coverage is training data and learning process attacks, where Layer II’s direct identification of data poisoning as a primary ML threat—combined with recommendations for provenance tracking, access control, and integrity verification of training datasets—applies to few-shot demonstration poisoning, reinforcement learning trajectory injection, and fine-tuning data contamination. 第 I 层对 TLS、PKI 管理、RBAC 和证书生命周期的要求，为 Kubernetes 和微服务网络安全提供了直接支持，这些要求可对应于 mTLS 配置攻击、服务账户冒充和容器镜像签名。 Kubernetes and microservices network security receives direct support through Layer I’s TLS, PKI management, RBAC, and certificate lifecycle requirements, which map onto mTLS configuration attacks, service account impersonation, and container image signing. 在评分为中等水平的 96 个部分中，第 I 层关于数据完整性、访问管理、供应链安全、可用性管理和审计日志的指南，为向量数据库访问控制、容器镜像来源追溯、CI/CD 流水线完整性、负载均衡器安全以及抵御分布式拒绝服务攻击的韧性提供了结构性支持。 Across the 96 sections scoring at a moderate level, Layer I’s data integrity, access management, supply chain security, availability management, and audit logging guidance provides structural support for vector database access control, container image provenance, CI/CD pipeline integrity, load balancer security, and distributed denial-of-service resilience. 第 II 层的投毒类别部分涵盖了 RAG 知识库污染、情景记忆和语义记忆投毒、评估数据集完整性以及 RL 奖励函数攻击。 Layer II’s poisoning category partially covers RAG knowledge base contamination, episodic and semantic memory poisoning, evaluation dataset integrity, and RL reward function attacks.
其覆盖范围始终止于传统 ICT 安全与智能体 AI 特有问题之间的边界。 Coverage consistently terminates at the boundary between conventional ICT security and agentic AI specifics. 该框架发布于现代智能体架构成为主流之前，因此未提供关于提示注入、多智能体信任利用、自我复制的提示恶意软件、审批工作流安全、置信度分数操纵或框架特定漏洞的指导。 Published before modern agentic architectures became mainstream, the framework contains no guidance for prompt injection, multi-agent trust exploitation, self-replicating prompt malware, approval workflow security, confidence score manipulation, or framework-specific vulnerabilities. FAICP 框架确立了任何 AI 部署都不可或缺的 ICT 和机器学习基线安全控制措施，但对于现代智能体系统的认知与协调攻击面，仍需以智能体专门指南加以补充。 The FAICP framework establishes baseline ICT and ML security controls essential for any AI deployment but requires supplementation by agentic-specific guidance for the cognitive and coordination attack surfaces of modern agent systems.
V-O AI 系统安全开发指南V-O Guidelines for Secure AI System Development
英国国家网络安全中心、CISA、NSA 及另外十九家国际网络安全机构于 2023 年联合发布了《AI 系统安全开发指南》，按照安全设计、安全开发、安全部署以及安全运行与维护这四个生命周期阶段，组织面向 AI 提供方的安全指导 [2409]。 The UK National Cyber Security Centre, CISA, NSA, and nineteen additional international cyber agencies jointly published Guidelines for Secure AI System Development in 2023, structuring AI provider security guidance across four lifecycle phases: secure design, secure development, secure deployment, and secure operation and maintenance [2409]. 该指南涵盖威胁建模、供应链完整性、基础设施加固、模型保护、行为监测和负责任发布。 Guidance spans threat modeling, supply chain integrity, infrastructure hardening, model protection, behavioral monitoring, and responsible release.
该框架中最具直接适用性的指导围绕四个反复出现的主题展开。 The framework’s most directly applicable guidance centers on four recurring themes. 提示注入识别和输入净化部分涵盖了通过注入途径造成的数据泄露、工具和命令注入以及 RAG 知识库投毒。 Prompt injection recognition and input sanitization provide partial coverage for data leakage through injection vectors, tool and command injection, and RAG knowledge base poisoning. 供应链控制措施——SLSA 证明、软件物料清单（SBOM）维护以及模型权重的加密哈希——为模型注册表投毒、跨注册表的工具元数据投毒、插件和工具生态系统供应链攻击、容器镜像完整性以及 ETL 流水线数据来源验证提供了实质性的间接覆盖。 Supply chain controls—SLSA attestation, SBOM maintenance, and cryptographic hashing of model weights—provide meaningful indirect coverage for model registry poisoning, tool metadata poisoning across registries, plugin and tool ecosystem supply chain attacks, container image integrity, and ETL pipeline data provenance validation. 关于环境隔离和最小权限访问控制的基础设施安全指导，部分应对了 Kubernetes 命名空间隔离绕过、容器编排权限提升、MIG 共置故障传播、负载均衡器身份安全以及服务发现认证攻击。 Infrastructure security guidance on environment segregation and least-privilege access controls partially addresses Kubernetes namespace isolation bypass, container orchestration privilege escalation, MIG co-location failure propagation, load balancer identity security, and service discovery authentication attacks. 行为监测要求——具体而言，即观察影响安全的突发性和渐进性行为变化，以及监测输入中对抗性内容的强制要求——为检测表现为行为漂移的情景记忆投毒、效率基线下降以及指标采集中的渐进式规避模式奠定了基础。 Behavioral monitoring requirements—specifically the mandate to observe sudden and gradual behavioral changes affecting security and to monitor inputs for adversarial content—provide a detection foundation for episodic memory poisoning manifesting as behavioral drift, efficiency baseline degradation, and gradual evasion patterns in metrics collection.
得分最高的单个部分是学习与训练数据攻击，其中，该框架明确要求净化用户反馈和持续学习数据，直接应对了少样本思维链示例注入、强化学习轨迹数据注入以及通过投毒示例选择造成的微调数据污染。 The single section receiving the highest score is learning and training data attacks, where the framework’s explicit requirement to sanitize user feedback and continuous learning data directly addresses few-shot chain-of-thought demonstration injection, reinforcement learning trajectory data injection, and fine-tuning data contamination through poisoned example selection. 所有类别的主要局限都在于架构范围：该框架被设计为通用的 AI 生命周期安全参考，其制定早于多智能体编排模式的出现，未涉及智能体间信任链验证、推理轨迹真实性、审批工作流疲劳、流式处理特有的验证时机、多智能体 RL 奖励信号完整性、造成经济损失的钱包耗尽攻击，或协同智能体集群涌现出的失对齐风险。 The principal limitation across all categories is architectural scope: designed as a general-purpose AI lifecycle security reference, the framework predates multi-agent orchestration patterns and does not address agent-to-agent trust chain verification, reasoning trace authenticity, approval workflow fatigue, streaming-specific validation timing, multi-agent RL reward signal integrity, economic denial-of-wallet attacks, or the emergent misalignment risks of coordinated agent fleets.
V-P 安全部署 AI 系统V-P Deploying AI Systems Securely
NSA/AISC、CISA、FBI 和五眼联盟联合发布的关于安全部署 AI 系统的《网络安全信息通报》（2024 年 4 月）将部署安全划分为三个阶段 [2410]。 The joint NSA/AISC, CISA, FBI, and Five Eyes Cybersecurity Information Sheet on deploying AI systems securely (April 2024) organizes deployment security across three phases [2410]. 阶段 1 规定采用零信任架构、针对模型权重的 RBAC/ABAC 访问控制、用于执行 ML 模型的沙箱化容器或虚拟机（VM）、GPU 和 CPU 补丁管理、TLS 加密、硬件安全模块、抗网络钓鱼的多因素认证，以及结合防火墙允许列表的网络分段。 Phase 1 prescribes Zero Trust architecture, RBAC/ABAC access controls for model weights, sandboxed containers or VMs for ML model execution, GPU and CPU patch management, TLS encryption, hardware security modules, phishing-resistant multifactor authentication, and network segmentation with firewall allow-listing. 阶段 2 要求以密码学方法验证制品、开展对抗性测试、在安全开发区内进行供应链检查、实施输入净化和提示注入防护、全面记录输入、输出、中间状态和错误，以及采用硬件保护的模型权重存储。 Phase 2 requires cryptographic artifact validation, adversarial testing, supply chain inspection in a secure development zone, input sanitization and prompt injection protection, comprehensive logging of inputs, outputs, intermediate states, and errors, and hardware-protected model weight storage. 阶段 3 强制要求开展外部渗透测试、使用不可变的备份日志存储、自动回滚至最近已知的正常状态，并在重新部署更新后的模型版本之前运行完整评估。 Phase 3 mandates external penetration testing, immutable backup log storage, automated rollback to last known good state, and full evaluation runs before redeploying updated model versions.
该框架最突出的贡献集中在传统 IT 安全控制措施与 AI 特有部署问题的交汇处。 The framework’s strongest contributions cluster where traditional IT security controls intersect with AI-specific deployment concerns. 提示注入和输入净化指导直接但仅部分应对了通过注入途径造成的数据泄露、工具与命令注入，以及 RAG 流水线中的知识库投毒。 Prompt injection and input sanitization guidance directly but partially addresses data leakage through injection vectors, tool and command injection, and knowledge base poisoning in RAG pipelines. 供应链检查和制品的密码学验证覆盖了工具注册表与插件生态系统攻击、模型注册表投毒、容器镜像完整性、ETL 流水线数据污染，以及通过复用预训练模型植入训练后门。 Supply chain inspection and cryptographic artifact validation cover tool registry and plugin ecosystem attacks, model registry poisoning, container image integrity, ETL pipeline data contamination, and training backdoor insertion through pre-trained model reuse. 基础设施控制措施——沙箱化容器、GPU 补丁更新、TLS、零信任架构——部分应对了 Kubernetes 容器逃逸、MIG 共置硬件故障传播、张量并行部署中的 GPU 间通信安全，以及微服务认证攻击。 Infrastructure controls—sandboxed containers, GPU patching, TLS, Zero Trust architecture—partially address Kubernetes container escape, MIG co-location hardware failure propagation, inter-GPU communication security in tensor parallelism deployments, and microservices authentication attacks. 监测与日志记录的强制要求、预言机攻击告警要求以及不可变日志存储条款，为检测规避分析和审计轨迹完整性提供了部分基础。 The monitoring and logging mandate, oracle-attack alerting requirement, and immutable log storage provision provide a partial foundation for detection evasion analysis and audit trail integrity.
系统性缺口源于该框架的设计定位：它是一份通用部署安全参考，编写于多智能体的智能体式架构成为主流之前。 Systematic gaps arise from the framework’s design as a general-purpose deployment security reference written before multi-agent agentic architectures became mainstream. 它未就智能体间信任链验证、智能体间置信度分数完整性、推理轨迹真实性、多智能体 RL 奖励信号完整性、超出通用访问控制范畴的情景记忆与语义记忆安全、词元经济与经济型拒绝服务攻击、流式处理特有的验证时机漏洞，或特定框架的编排内部机制提供指导，因此，对于将单独可控的威胁转化为整个智能体集群级联故障的多智能体放大动态，也缺乏适用的指导。 It contains no guidance on agent-to-agent trust chain verification, inter-agent confidence score integrity, reasoning trace authenticity, multi-agent RL reward signal integrity, episodic and semantic memory security beyond generic access controls, token economy and economic denial-of-service attacks, streaming-specific validation timing vulnerabilities, or framework-specific orchestration internals, leaving the multi-agent amplification dynamics that transform individually manageable threats into fleet-wide cascade failures without applicable guidance.
V-Q 其他观察V-Q Other Observations
V-Q1 模型级控制：加固推理引擎V-Q1 Model-Level Controls: Hardening the Reasoning Engine
第一层防御位于模型层面，其目标是确保智能体的“大脑”在面对操纵时仍保持稳健。 The first tier of defense resides at the model level, where the objective is to ensure that the ”brain” of the agent remains robust against manipulation. 近期研究侧重于采用确定性防御，而非纯粹的概率性防御，以应对 LLMs 的“随机”特性。 Recent research focuses on deterministic rather than purely probabilistic defenses to handle the ”stochastic” nature of LLMs. 下文概述了这一类别中的关键技术。 The following summarizes the key techniques within this category.
信息流控制（Information-Flow Control，IFC）：研究人员提出了采用动态污点跟踪的形式化模型，为智能体处理的所有数据附加机密性和完整性标签。 Information-Flow Control (IFC): Researchers have proposed formal models using dynamic taint-tracking to attach confidentiality and integrity labels to all data an agent processes. 这使得系统能够以确定性方式判断具有重大影响的工具调用是否安全，从而对抵御间接提示注入的安全保障给出语义刻画 [2411]。 This allows for deterministic decisions on whether a consequential tool call is safe, achieving a semantic characterization of security guarantees against indirect prompt injection [2411].
工具结果解析（Tool Result Parsing）：Yu 等人。 Tool Result Parsing: Yu et. al. [2412] 提出了一种通过“工具结果解析”为智能体提供精确数据的方法，可有效过滤注入的恶意代码。 [2412] introduced a method that provides agents with precise data via ”tool result parsing,” effectively filtering out injected malicious code. 该方法在保持高效用的同时，实现了学术文献中记录的最低攻击成功率（Attack Success Rate，ASR）。 This approach has demonstrated the lowest Attack Success Rate (ASR) recorded in academic literature while maintaining high utility.
概率性聚焦（Probabilistic Spotlighting）：微软已发表的研究介绍了“Spotlighting”，该方法通过对外部输入进行信号变换，例如数据标记（交错插入特殊字符）或编码（base64），帮助模型区分系统指令与不可信数据。 Probabilistic Spotlighting: Published Microsoft research describes ”Spotlighting,” which helps models distinguish between system instructions and untrusted data by applying signal transformations like datamarking (interleaving special characters) or encoding (base64) to external inputs. 实验表明，数据标记可将攻击成功率从超过 50% 降至低于 2% [2413]。 Experiments showed that datamarking could reduce the Attack Success Rate from over 50% to below 2% [2413].
V-Q2 智能体系统级控制：编排与执行防护V-Q2 Agent System-Level Controls: Orchestration and Execution Safeguards
2025/2026 年最重大的安全挑战出现在智能体与外部世界交互的编排层。 The most significant security challenges in 2025/2026 occur at the orchestration layer, where agents interact with the external world. 当智能体被授予过多权限，例如删除记录或发送电子邮件的能力，却缺乏充分监督或技术边界时，就会产生“过度代理权”（Excessive Agency，OWASP LLM06:2025）风险。 The risk of ”Excessive Agency” (OWASP LLM06:2025) arises when an agent is granted too much authority, such as the ability to delete records or send emails, without sufficient oversight or technical boundaries. 这一组涉及的技术如下。 The techniques associated with this group are as follows.
零信任智能体运行时（Zero-Trust Agentic Runtime）：一项新研究（2026）提出了“零信任智能体运行时架构”。 Zero-Trust Agentic Runtime: New research (2026) proposes a ”Zero-Trust Agentic Runtime Architecture”. 该架构采用“确定性能力绑定”和“神经符号信息流控制”，以在整个智能体工具供应链中强制维持安全不变量 [2414]。 This involves ”Deterministic Capability Binding” and ”Neuro-Symbolic Information Flow Control” to enforce security invariants across the agentic tool supply chain [2414].
FIDES 规划器：一篇 2025 年的论文提出了 FIDES 规划器，该规划器使用“隐藏与揭示”原语，有选择地将敏感数据与智能体上下文隔离。 FIDES Planner: A 2025 paper introduced the FIDES planner, which uses ”hiding and revealing” primitives to selectively isolate sensitive data from the agent’s context. 这通过保持推理过程“洁净”，防止恶意输入影响后续工具调用 [2411]。 This prevents malicious inputs from influencing future tool calls by keeping the reasoning ”clean” [2411].
记忆加固（Memory Hardening）：“AgentSafe”框架利用权限级别分类和“HierarCache”，防止多智能体环境中的未授权记忆访问和记忆投毒 [2415]。 Memory Hardening: The ”AgentSafe” framework utilizes permission-level classification and ”HierarCache” to prevent unauthorized memory access and memory poisoning in multi-agent environments [2415].
V-Q3 人类监督控制：经验证的自主性与对齐V-Q3 Human Oversight Controls: Verified Autonomy and Alignment
人类监督仍是智能体安全技术栈的最后一层，也是最关键的一层。 Human oversight remains the final and most critical layer of the agentic security stack. 然而，随着智能体以“机器速度”运行，人类的角色必须从逐一批准每项操作，转向界定高层边界，并为可能产生重大后果的操作提供即时审批。 However, as agents operate at ”machine speed,” the role of the human must shift from approving every individual action to defining high-level boundaries and providing just-in-time approval for high-consequence operations. 下文对这些方法进行了结构化概述。 A structured summary of these methods is provided below.
形式化验证（Formal Verification）：“VeriPlan”系统将模型检查应用于基于 LLM 的智能体计划。 Formal Verification: The ”VeriPlan” system applies model checking to LLM-based agent plans. 该系统允许用户定义规约，并使用模型检查器在执行前验证智能体提出的操作是否符合这些约束 [2416]。 It allows users to define specifications and uses a model checker to verify that the agent’s proposed actions adhere to those constraints before execution [2416].
双向人类与 AI 对齐（Bidirectional Human-AI Alignment）：该研究主张采用“双向人类与 AI 对齐”框架。 Bidirectional Human-AI Alignment: This study argues for a ”Bidirectional Human-AI Alignment” framework. 该框架超越了仅使 AI 与人类价值观对齐的做法，同时关注“使人类与 AI 对齐”，从而支持智能体自主性增强时所需的认知与社会适应 [2417]。 This moves beyond just aligning the AI to human values by also addressing ”Aligning Humans to AI”, therein supporting the cognitive and societal adaptation required as agents take on greater autonomy [2417].
VI 框架分析VI Analysis of The Framework
为量化并比较所调研框架的安全覆盖程度，我们依据一套涵盖九类风险、包含 193 个不同智能体 AI 威胁条目的分类体系，对每个框架进行了系统评分。 To quantify and compare the security coverage of the surveyed frameworks, we systematically scored each framework against a taxonomy of 193 distinct agentic AI threat items spanning nine risk categories. 如第 III 节所示，九类风险分别为：智能体与工具耦合（RATC，21 项）、数据泄露（RDL，34 项）、注入（RIDC，7 项）、身份与来源（RIP，19 项）、记忆投毒（RMP，16 项）、非确定性（RND，34 项）、信任利用（RTE，34 项）、时序/监控（RTM，12 项）和工作流架构（RWA，16 项）。 As shown in section III, the nine risk categories are: Agent-Tool Coupling (RATC, 21 items), Data Leakage (RDL, 34 items), Injection (RIDC, 7 items), Identity and Provenance (RIP, 19 items), Memory Poisoning (RMP, 16 items), Non-Determinism (RND, 34 items), Trust Exploitation (RTE, 34 items), Timing/Monitoring (RTM, 12 items), and Workflow Architecture (RWA, 16 items). 采用三级评分尺度评估各框架与每个条目的相关性：评分 1（提供极少指导）、评分 2（中等程度的间接覆盖）和评分 3（提供直接且具体的缓解措施）。 The relevance of the frameworks to each item was assessed on a three-point scale: score 1 (minimal guidance), score 2 (moderate, indirect coverage), and score 3 (direct and specific mitigation).

VI-D 成熟度最高的三个框架VI-D Top Three Most Mature Frameworks
根据综合评分（归一化平均得分占 60%，覆盖广度占 40%），三个框架在智能体式 AI 安全方面的成熟度最高： Based on composite scoring (60% normalized average score, 40% coverage breadth), three frameworks emerge as most mature for agentic AI security:
(1) OWASP 智能体安全倡议（OWASP Agentic Security Initiative）（综合得分 0.500，平均得分 1.798，覆盖率 65.3%）。 (1) OWASP Agentic Security Initiative (composite 0.500, avg 1.798, coverage 65.3%). OWASP ASI 是所评审框架中唯一专为智能体式系统构建的框架。 OWASP ASI is the only reviewed framework purpose-built for agentic systems. 其十个按等级排序的风险类别（ASI01–ASI10）直接应对智能体式威胁模式——意图验证、针对每个工具的最小权限、记忆内容验证、基于密码学的智能体间身份认证，以及行为监测。 Its ten ranked risk categories (ASI01–ASI10) directly address agentic threat patterns—intent validation, per-tool least privilege, memory content validation, cryptographic inter-agent authentication, and behavioral monitoring. 它获得了最多的 3 分项（28 项，14.5%），并在设计阶段的覆盖程度上领先于所有框架。 It achieves the highest score-3 count (28 items, 14.5%) and leads all frameworks in design-phase coverage.
(2) CDAO 生成式 AI 负责任 AI 工具包（CDAO Generative AI Responsible AI Toolkit）（综合得分 0.449，平均得分 1.668，覆盖率 62.2%）。 (2) CDAO Generative AI Responsible AI Toolkit (composite 0.449, avg 1.668, coverage 62.2%). CDAO GenAI 在设有 RAI Gate 检查点的七阶段生命周期中，嵌入了明确的工具使用要求（NeMo Guardrails、GARAK、RAGAS、Arize Phoenix、WhyLabs），从而提供了最具操作性的覆盖。 CDAO GenAI provides the most operationalized coverage through explicit tool mandates (NeMo Guardrails, GARAK, RAGAS, Arize Phoenix, WhyLabs) embedded in a seven-stage lifecycle with RAI Gate checkpoints. 它在开发阶段和运行阶段的覆盖程度上均领先于所有框架。 It leads all frameworks in both development-phase and operational-phase coverage.
(3) ATFAA-SHIELD（综合得分 0.445，平均得分 1.653，覆盖率 62.2%）。 (3) ATFAA-SHIELD (composite 0.445, avg 1.653, coverage 62.2%). 在非 OWASP 框架中，ATFAA-SHIELD 提供了在架构层面最为具体的防御措施，针对引发安全风险的智能体式特性：自主推理、持久记忆、动态工具集成，以及极少的监督。 ATFAA-SHIELD provides the most architecturally specific defenses among non-OWASP frameworks, targeting the agentic properties that drive security risk: autonomous reasoning, persistent memory, dynamic tool integration, and minimal oversight. 其六项 SHIELD 控制策略实现了所有框架中最高的 2 分项占比（114 项，59.1%）。 Its six SHIELD control strategies achieve the highest score-2 density of any framework (114 items, 59.1%).
VI-E 各框架的共同薄弱点VI-E Common Weak Points Across Frameworks
非确定性（RND，平均得分 1.231）是最薄弱的类别，与其他类别的差距明显。 Non-Determinism (RND, avg 1.231) is the weakest category by a clear margin. 大多数框架都假定威胁模型是确定性的；对于 LLM 推理所固有的随机行为——会话状态的可变性、MCTS 规划的非确定性、HTN 规划的分歧——所评审的框架均未建立相应的对策目录。 Most frameworks assume deterministic threat models; the stochastic behavior intrinsic to LLM inference—session-state variability, MCTS planning non-determinism, HTN planning divergence—has no established countermeasure catalog in any reviewed framework. 数据泄露（RDL，平均得分 1.340）是第二薄弱的类别，其中流式输出中的词元级泄露、GPU 显存内部机制、负载均衡器流量分析和 MCTS 推理时序等子类别得到的覆盖极少。 Data Leakage (RDL, avg 1.340) is second weakest, with sub-categories for streaming token-level leakage, GPU memory internals, load-balancer traffic analysis, and MCTS inference timing receiving minimal coverage. 信任利用（RTE，平均得分 1.369）位列第三，因为许多子威胁涉及涌现的多智能体协调行为，尚无成熟的缓解措施。 Trust Exploitation (RTE, avg 1.369) is third, as many sub-threats involve emergent multi-agent coordination behaviors without established mitigations.
有五个条目在全部 16 个框架中的最高得分均为 1——没有任何框架对其提供哪怕是间接的覆盖： Five items receive a maximum score of 1 across all 16 frameworks—no framework provides even indirect coverage:
RATC_10 — 效率优化与资源约束利用 RATC_10 — Efficiency Optimization and Resource Constraint Exploitation
RDL_29 — 通过 MCTS 规划状态泄露数据 RDL_29 — Data Leakage via MCTS Planning State
RND_25 — HTN 规划的非确定性 RND_25 — HTN Planning Non-Determinism
RND_26 — MCTS 规划的非确定性 RND_26 — MCTS Planning Non-Determinism
RTE_33 — 其他多智能体信任利用风险 RTE_33 — Other Multi-Agent Trust Exploitation Risks
这些条目涉及高级规划架构（MCTS、HTN）的算法特性或硬件层面的资源交互，而现有框架既未将其建模为威胁，也未针对其规定缓解措施，因此构成了未来框架发展最迫切需要关注的前沿领域。 These items involve algorithmic properties of advanced planning architectures (MCTS, HTN) or hardware-level resource interactions that current frameworks neither model as threats nor prescribe mitigations for, representing the frontier where future framework development is most urgently needed.
